title: Toward Controlling Biology with Language:Offline Learning of Prompt-Conditioned Interventions for Cells, Organoids, and Biobots
summary: Artificial intelligence increasingly serves as a natural-language interface to complex technical systems, letting people accomplish sophisticated tasks by describing what they want rather than specifying how to do it. Extending this interface to living systems is harder: unlike code or images, a biological intervention has no closed-form linguistic meaning, and the paired language-intervention-outcome data needed to learn such a mapping is expensive to collect, since each example requires its own wet-lab experiment. One way around this is to treat an existing archive of interventions and their already-observed outcomes as a fixed, offline dataset, and use a vision-language model to judge, without any new experiments, whether an archived outcome matches a natural-language description. But whether that judgment is reliable enough to train a language-to-intervention mapping on -- without new experiments and without human validation -- has remained unclear. Here we show that a natural-language interface for a living organism -- a xenobot, a synthetic multicellular construct with no nervous system -- can be learned entirely offline this way, using a vision-language model's own judgment as the sole training reward: an instruction is mapped to the intervention already on record as producing the described behavior. This mapping generalizes to entirely new instructions, evaluated against archive data withheld from training (80.0% held-out accuracy vs a $66.7% chance baseline, matching a network trained directly on ground-truth labels).

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种完全离线的自然语言→生物干预映射学习方法，仅用视觉语言模型自身判断作为训练奖励，在无新实验、无人工标注条件下实现对xenobot行为的语言接口，留出集准确率达80.0%（随机基线66.7%），与使用真实标签训练的网络相当。
AI.motivation: 将自然语言接口从代码、图像等技术系统扩展到生命系统存在根本困难：生物干预缺乏闭环的语义定义，且语言-干预-结果的配对数据需逐个湿实验获取，成本极高。因此需要绕开新实验，利用已有干预-结果档案作为固定离线数据集，验证视觉语言模型的判断是否可靠到可单独充当训练奖励。
AI.method: 把已有的干预记录及其已观测结果视为固定离线数据集；使用视觉语言模型判断某个已归档结果是否与给定的自然语言描述相匹配，且不进行任何新实验、不使用人工验证；以该模型判断作为唯一训练奖励，学习一条从自然语言指令到"档案中已记录为产生所描述行为的干预"的映射。
AI.result: 该映射可泛化到全新指令，在训练中留出的档案数据上评估达到80.0%留出准确率，随机基线为66.7%，且与直接用真实标签训练的网络表现相当。学习对象为xenobot——一种无神经系统的合成多细胞构建体。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明，生命的自然语言接口可以完全离线地学得：视觉语言模型自身的判断足以作为唯一训练奖励，无需新实验与人工验证，即可建立可泛化的语言到生物干预的映射，为低成本生物系统语言控制提供了可行路径。

title: Multimodal reasoning for broadly neutralizing antibody discovery from label-free human B cell repertoires across virus families
summary: Discovering broadly neutralizing antibodies (bnAbs) from human natural immune repertoires remains a fundamental challenge in immunology, hindered by: the extreme rarity of bnAb, incomplete understanding of their cellular origins across pathogens, and the inability of existing computational tools to generalize across emerging viral threats. Here we present ImmuneAgent, a closed-loop AI system that integrates multimodal reasoning with continual meta-learning and wet-lab feedback to overcome these barriers. Applied to screen the natural BCR repertoires from vaccinated or infected cohorts, the system achieves a ~55% neutralization antibody discovery rate (60 of 110 cloned candidates) and a ~11% bnAb yield (12 of 110), substantially outperforming a state-of-the-art sequence-based neutralization predictor or cofolding models evaluated at the same cloning budget. Five ImmuneAgent-discovered antibodies conferred 100% in vivo protection against lethal influenza challenge, comparable to the clinical-stage therapeutic MEDI8852. The system recovered the cellular and structural determinants of bnAb activity and identified FCRL5+CD27+ atypical memory B cells as a conserved bnAb reservoir and hydrophobic interface enrichment as a cross-viral structural signature, which generalized to unseen antigens, discovering human metapneumovirus (hMPV) cross-neutralizing and human papillomavirus (HPV)-neutralizing antibodies without antigen-specific sorting. These results validate that ImmuneAgent is a generalizable framework for rapid therapeutic antibody discovery against emerging viral threats.

AI.tldr: ImmuneAgent是一个闭环AI系统，整合多模态推理、持续元学习与湿实验反馈，用于从天然B细胞受体库中高效发现广谱中和抗体。
AI.motivation: 天然免疫库中广谱中和抗体（bnAb）极为稀少，其细胞起源跨病原体机制理解不足，且现有计算工具难以泛化到新发病毒威胁，因此需要新的抗体发现框架。
AI.method: 构建闭环AI系统ImmuneAgent，融合多模态推理、持续元学习与湿实验反馈，对接种或感染队列的天然BCR库进行筛选，并与基于序列的中和预测器和共折叠模型在同一克隆预算下比较。
AI.result: 中和抗体发现率约55%（110个克隆候选中的60个），bnAb产率约11%（12/110）；5个发现的抗体对致死性流感攻击提供100%体内保护，媲美临床阶段疗法MEDI8852；识别FCRL5+CD27+非典型记忆B细胞为保守bnAb储库，疏水界面富集为跨病毒结构特征，并泛化至未见抗原，无需抗原特异性分选即发现hMPV交叉中和及HPV中和抗体。
AI.conclusion: ImmuneAgent是应对新发病毒威胁的快速治疗性抗体发现的通用框架。

title: Existence of an infinite family of substrates satisfying all the postulates of integrated information theory, exclusion included, with arbitrarily large integrated information
summary: For infinitely many sizes we exhibit a cycle of binary units, each taking the exclusive-or of itself and its two clockwise neighbours, that is a complex in every state, no proper subsystem being more integrated, and whose integrated information grows as two raised to a power quadratic in the number of units.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了一类由二元单元组成的环状系统（每个单元取自身及两个顺时针邻居的异或），证明存在无穷多个规模使该系统在每个状态下都是"复合体"，且其整合信息随单元数呈2的二次幂增长。
AI.motivation: 整合信息论（IIT）中，系统整合信息（Φ）随规模的增长规律是核心理论问题。作者希望构造显式例子，说明整合信息可以达到极高的增长速度（超多项式级别），从而揭示整合信息在原理上可达到的上界，并检验"复合体"（complex）概念的严格性——即在任何状态下都不存在比整体更整合的子系统。
AI.method: 构造二进制单元环（cycle），每个单元的状态更新规则为：取自身与其两个顺时针邻居的异或（XOR）。针对无穷多个特定规模，分析该系统的因果结构，检验其是否在每个状态下都构成复合体（即无可比整体更整合的适当子系统），并推导其整合信息 Φ 的渐近表达式。
AI.result: 对无穷多个规模，该 XOR 环在每一状态下均为复合体，不存在更整合的适当子系统；其整合信息 Φ 随单元数 n 呈 2^(Θ(n²)) 级增长，即 Phi 的指数为 n 的二次多项式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了整合信息可达到超指数（双指数级）增长的显式构造，说明整合信息随系统规模的增长潜力远超线性或多项式，对 IIT 中关于 Φ 上界与复合体结构的理论预期构成了强有力例证。

title: Generalizable single-cell perturbation response prediction using energy-guided flow matching
summary: Predicting phenotypic and transcriptional responses to perturbations at single-cell resolution provides a powerful tool for probing biological systems. However, existing methods typically rely on fixed mappings learned during training, making it challenging to calibrate distribution shifts or adapt to novel perturbation conditions during inference. Here, we present scEGFlow, an energy-guided flow matching framework that dynamically bridges control and perturbed cellular states. scEGFlow models continuous transitions from control cell populations to perturbed states using conditional flow matching. It then applies condition-specific energy gradients to correct and steer these predictions, enabling flexible adjustments without retraining the flow model. Evaluations across benchmarks spanning imaging phenotypes and transcriptomic profiles show that scEGFlow outperforms existing methods in reconstructing response distributions under both seen and unseen perturbation conditions, faithfully preserving cellular manifold geometry and population heterogeneity. This advantage is notable when adapting to new conditions with only a few measured cells, consistently improving prediction accuracy. Furthermore, scEGFlow accurately recapitulates perturbation-induced up- and down-regulation patterns across consensus gene expression signatures, where energy guidance improves the agreement between predicted and observed regulatory directions. Ultimately, these findings demonstrate that scEGFlow provides a modular, generalizable, and steerable solution for single-cell perturbation modeling. By grounding generative flows in learned biological landscapes, this architecture establishes a new computational paradigm for navigating and manipulating cellular behavior in silico.

AI.tldr: scEGFlow：一种能量引导的条件流匹配框架，动态建模对照到扰动细胞状态的连续转变，无需重训练即可在推理阶段校准分布漂移与新扰动条件，在影像表型和转录组基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 单细胞分辨率下预测扰动引起的表型与转录响应是解析生物系统的有力工具，但现有方法依赖训练时学到的固定映射，难以在推理阶段校准分布漂移或适应未见扰动条件，泛化性与可调性受限。
AI.method: 提出scEGFlow，采用条件流匹配建模从对照细胞群到扰动状态的连续转变；随后引入条件特异的能量梯度对预测进行校正与引导，从而在不重新训练流模型的情况下实现灵活调整，形成模块化、可操控的生成框架。
AI.result: 在涵盖成像表型与转录组谱的多个基准上，scEGFlow在已见和未见扰动条件下重建响应分布均优于现有方法，忠实保留细胞流形几何与群体异质性；在仅有少量实测细胞的新条件下适配优势尤为显著，并准确重现共识基因表达特征中的上/下调模式，能量引导提升了预测与观测调控方向的一致性。
AI.conclusion: scEGFlow为单细胞扰动建模提供了模块化、可泛化且可引导的解决方案；通过将生成流建立于学习到的生物学景观之上，为在计算机中导航与操控细胞行为建立了新的计算范式。

title: A Compression Tree Generation Method for High Performance VLSI Datapaths
summary: Compression trees have been historically a key component of several arithmetic units, most notably multipliers. The latter have been for the most part standalone units and in common situations synthesis tools can generate very close to optimal solutions. With large matrix multiply structures taking more of a central role in the compute industry, the need for a better understanding of these compression trees is apparent. Furthermore, the boundary of its usage needs to be redefined: dot products, polynomial fitting of non-linear operators, are all sums of products. And since products are sums of partial products, in the end, we are just adding many things together as bit heaps; i.e. the fundamental role of a compression tree. Therefore, we must see them as more than just a component of a multiplier. This paper presents a delay-aware compression-tree methodology based on a weighted bit heap. Each bit is described by its significance and relative arrival time, and the generator uses technology-independent normalized delay units to estimate Boolean logical pressure. By exploiting the commutativity of addition within each column, the method reorders bits across reduction stages and uses a Dadda-style maximum-bandwidth topology with flexible CSA3:2 operators. For Radix-4 Booth multipliers from 11 to 64 bits, the resulting trees show lower modeled delay and estimated logic volume than the evaluated Wallace-style maximum-compression trees. Fused four-way integer dot products further demonstrate how the same representation can evaluate the cost of microarchitectural constraints, such as preserving individual product redundant formats. These results show that weighted bit-heap generation provides a practical technology-independent basis for exploring compression trees beyond standalone multiplication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于加权位堆（weighted bit heap）的延迟感知压缩树生成方法，将压缩树从乘法器的附属部件重新定义为通用“多操作数位堆求和”结构，并在Radix-4 Booth乘法器与四路整数点积上验证其延迟与逻辑面积优势。
AI.motivation: 压缩树长期被视为乘法器等算术单元的内部组件，且多作为独立单元由综合工具近似最优地生成。然而，随着大规模矩阵乘法结构在计算产业中占据核心地位，点积、非线性算子的多项式拟合等本质上都是“乘积之和”，而乘积又是部分积之和，最终都可归结为对大量比特堆的加法。因此需要重新界定压缩树的使用边界，将其视为超越乘法器的通用结构，并建立对其更深入的理解与优化方法。
AI.method: 提出一种延迟感知的压缩树方法，以加权位堆为核心表示：每个比特由其权重（significance）和相对到达时间（relative arrival time）描述。生成器使用与工艺无关的归一化延迟单位来估计布尔逻辑压力（Boolean logical pressure）。利用每一列内加法的可交换性，方法在各级归约阶段之间重排比特，并采用Dadda风格的最大带宽拓扑，配合灵活的CSA 3:2算子。
AI.result: 针对11至64位的Radix-4 Booth乘法器，所生成的压缩树在被建模延迟和估计逻辑体积两方面均优于所评估的Wallace风格最大压缩（maximum-compression）树。融合四路整数点积的实验进一步表明，同一加权位堆表示能够评估微架构约束的代价，例如保留各个乘积的冗余格式（redundant formats）。
AI.conclusion: 加权位堆生成方法为在独立乘法之外探索压缩树提供了一个实用的、与工艺无关的基础，说明压缩树可被重新理解为通用的比特堆求和结构，并支持对微架构约束代价的量化评估。

title: MintFlow: Minimal Trajectory Intervention for Constrained Flow Matching
summary: Flow matching models excel at generative modeling, and many downstream applications require their samples to satisfy prescribed constraints, such as observed measurements and physical laws. However, existing constrained samplers often face a trade-off: \textit{enforcing constraints can substantially displace samples from the pretrained data distribution}. To address this trade-off, we introduce \textbf{MintFlow}, a training-free constrained sampling framework that formulates constraint enforcement as a minimal intervention on the pretrained flow trajectory. MintFlow seeks the minimal perturbation of an intermediate flow state such that its subsequent evolution under the pretrained flow field satisfies the target constraint. By minimally perturbing the flow state while keeping the pretrained flow field unchanged, MintFlow enforces the constraint while minimizing unnecessary deviation from the pretrained distribution. An adjoint formulation yields a closed-form expression for this perturbation, eliminating expensive iterative optimization. Furthermore, MintFlow adaptively selects the intervention time to balance the required perturbation magnitude with its amplification by the remaining flow. Across a range of tasks in generative vision and physical system modeling, MintFlow achieves competitive constraint satisfaction while preserving the pretrained generative distribution substantially better than state-of-the-art constrained methods.

AI.tldr: MintFlow：一种免训练约束采样框架，将约束施加建模为对预训练流轨迹的最小干预，通过共轭（伴随）公式得到闭式扰动解，自适应选择干预时间，在满足约束的同时显著更好地保持预训练分布。
AI.motivation: 流匹配模型生成能力强，但许多下游应用要求样本满足预设约束（如观测测量、物理定律）。现有约束采样器存在权衡：强制满足约束往往会使样本大幅偏离预训练数据分布。
AI.method: 提出 MintFlow，免训练约束采样。核心是将约束施加形式化为对预训练流轨迹的最小干预：寻找对中间流状态的最小扰动，使其在预训练流场下后续演化满足目标约束。保持流场不变、仅微扰状态，从而最小化偏离。用共轭（adjoint）公式推导出该扰动的闭式解，避免昂贵的迭代优化；并自适应选择干预时间，平衡所需扰动幅度与其在剩余流中的放大效应。
AI.result: 在生成式视觉和物理系统建模的多种任务上，MintFlow 在约束满足度上具有竞争力，同时在保持预训练生成分布方面显著优于最先进的约束方法。
AI.conclusion: MintFlow 通过最小干预与闭式扰动，有效缓解了约束满足与分布保持之间的权衡，为流匹配模型的约束采样提供了高效、免训练的解决方案。

title: Intent-Hiding Jailbreaks: An Information-Theoretic Framework for Compositional Attacks
summary:
Recent work has shown that large language models (LLMs) can be vulnerable to jailbreak attacks in which harmful intent is obscured through composition with benign tasks. A harmful request refused in isolation may elicit a different response when embedded within a larger, seemingly benign query. We study these compositional intent-hiding jailbreaks from an information-theoretic perspective. Our formulation associates each task with an estimated probability of being judged harmful: the average over the full task collection defines the prior probability of harmful intent, while the average over a selected bundle containing the target defines the posterior. Selecting auxiliary tasks so that these averages agree, which we call prior-posterior matching, leaves the estimated intent unchanged even though the harmful target remains in the bundle.
  We study two settings that differ in whether query construction is part of the optimization. In the query-independent setting, tasks are selected without regard to how they will be expressed in the final query. We show that exact prior-posterior matching under a bundle-size constraint is computationally hard, derive an optimal water-filling solution for fractional weights, and characterize the smallest bundle satisfying a prescribed safety threshold. In the query-dependent setting, task selection and query construction are considered jointly, and intent concealment and target preservation are evaluated on the resulting query. We evaluate jailbreak effectiveness and preservation of the target behavior across bundle sizes, query generators, and several open-source models. These results show that compositional queries can elicit target behaviors beyond the direct-request baseline under the evaluated search budgets, while revealing a trade-off: as bundle size increases, response-level target preservation tends to decrease for several models.

AI.tldr: 本文从信息论视角研究"组合式意图隐藏越狱"，提出先验-后验匹配框架：将有害目标嵌入含良性辅助任务的捆绑查询中，使整体被判定有害的概率（后验）与全集先验一致，从而隐藏意图。分别在查询无关与查询相关两种设定下给出计算复杂度、最优注水解、最小捆绑规模刻画，并实验验证组合查询可超越直接请求基线但随捆绑增大会出现目标保持度下降的权衡。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型存在越狱漏洞：孤立被拒的有害请求，嵌入更大且看似良性的查询后可能得到不同回应。作者希望为该类组合式意图隐藏越狱建立信息论分析框架，解释其成因并量化其条件与代价。
AI.method: 用信息论建模：每个任务赋予"被判有害"的估计概率，全集平均为先验，含目标的选定捆绑的平均为后验；选择辅助任务使二者一致（先验-后验匹配），在估计层面保持意图不变。分两设定：(1) 查询无关——不论最终如何表达，证明捆绑规模约束下精确匹配是计算难的，给出分数权重下的最优注水解，并刻画满足既定安全阈值的最小捆绑；(2) 查询相关——联合进行任务选择与查询构造，在生成查询上评估意图隐藏与目标保持。跨捆绑规模、查询生成器及多个开源模型评估越狱有效性与目标行为保持。
AI.result: 在评估的搜索预算下，组合查询能诱发超越直接请求基线的目标行为，说明该方法具有实际越狱效力；同时呈现权衡：随捆绑规模增大，多个模型的响应级目标保持度趋于下降。
AI.conclusion: 组合式意图隐藏越狱可用先验-后验匹配统一刻画，其可行性与代价受捆绑规模、查询构造方式与模型特性影响；提示防御需同时考虑意图估计的一致性与响应级目标保持的衰减。

title: Feature Freshness Budgets for Real-Time ML Inference Under Stream Lag
comment: Preprint. Under review at The VLDB Journal
summary: Online feature stores decouple feature computation from model serving, materializing features from upstream event streams into a low-latency store that inference reads at request time. This decoupling introduces a freshness gap - the interval between an event occurring at the source and its effect becoming visible in the served feature vector - that is widely documented as a cause of training-serving skew but has no formal treatment as a bounded, cost-quantified quantity. We model the online feature store as a materialized view over an event stream and define a per-feature freshness budget: the difference between the decision window a feature is consumed within and the staleness the serving pipeline imposes on it. We prove two propositions - a per-feature staleness bound, and a closed-form threshold below which a feature can never be served within budget - and validate them in a seeded, reproducible discrete-event simulation and on a real Apache Kafka, Redis, and PostgreSQL pipeline. The predicted collapse threshold reproduces on real infrastructure, with the decision-error transition landing where the closed form predicts. Reconciling simulated and real drop rates surfaces a methodological result of independent interest: the dominant simulation-to-infrastructure gap is not latency but a sampling-phase artifact - a simulation whose request clock and recomputation cadence are phase-locked systematically under-observes staleness. Randomizing that phase reconciles simulation and infrastructure to within 0.018 mean absolute error in per-feature drop rate. Results are scoped to the studied workloads and configurations and are not claims about any specific production feature-store implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文将在线特征库建模为事件流上的物化视图，提出"每特征新鲜度预算"概念，给出陈旧度上界与预算崩塌阈值的闭式解，并通过离散事件仿真与Kafka/Redis/PostgreSQL真实流水线验证；同时揭示仿真与真实系统的偏差主要源于请求时钟与重算节奏的相位锁定采样伪影。
AI.motivation: 在线特征库将特征计算与模型服务解耦，由此产生"新鲜度缺口"（事件发生到其效果体现在服务特征向量之间的间隔）。该缺口虽被广泛认为是训练-服务偏移的成因，但缺乏将其作为有界、可成本量化的形式化处理。
AI.method: 把在线特征库建模为事件流上的物化视图，定义每特征新鲜度预算（特征被消费的决策窗口与其服务流水线所施加的陈旧度之差）；证明两个命题：每特征陈旧度上界，以及特征永远无法在预算内被服务的闭式阈值；用带随机种子的可复现离散事件仿真，以及基于真实 Apache Kafka、Redis、PostgreSQL 的流水线进行验证。
AI.result: 预测的崩塌阈值在真实基础设施上复现，决策错误转变点落在闭式解所预测的位置；仿真与真实掉率对账发现，主要偏差并非延迟，而是采样相位伪影——请求时钟与重算节奏相位锁定的仿真会系统性低估陈旧度，随机化该相位后，仿真与真实设施的每特征掉率平均绝对误差收敛至0.018。
AI.conclusion: 新鲜度可作为有界、成本可量化的量被形式化刻画，且闭式阈值能预测真实系统的崩塌行为；仿真方法学上需打破请求时钟与重算节奏的相位锁定以准确观测陈旧度。结果仅限于所研究工作负载与配置，不代表任何具体生产特征库实现的结论。

title: EditHero: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Part-Level 3D Editing and Vibe Modeling
summary: 3D editing methods are usually tested on a single edit, yet an asset is built through a long sequence of revisions, each of which must implement the requested change while leaving everything else unchanged. We introduce EditHero, to our knowledge the first benchmark for long-horizon, part-level 3D editing, with natural-language instructions and target images for both geometry and texture. A deterministic assembly engine produces the exact target after every edit, and every sequence is reviewed by hand. We use EditHero to compare 2 opposite approaches to 3D editing. Non-agentic methods operate top down, regenerating the object from a learned 3D representation and inferring what to keep. In contrast, LLM/VLM agents operate bottom up, editing through code that inspects the mesh and rewrites only the parts required by instructions. The non-agentic methods often miss the requested change and disturb regions that should stay fixed. Most LLMs follow instructions more closely, and all of them preserve the unedited parts better, but each of their edits takes minutes. We will release the engine and the edit sequences to support research on reliable iterative 3D editing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出EditHero，首个面向长程、部件级3D编辑的基准，包含自然语言指令及几何与纹理目标图；通过确定性装配引擎保证每次编辑后目标精确，并人工审核编辑序列。实验对比非智能体（自顶向下）与LLM/VLM智能体（自底向上代码编辑）两类方法，发现前者常漏改且扰动未编辑区域，后者指令跟随更好、保留未编辑部分更佳但单次编辑耗时数分钟。
AI.motivation: 现有3D编辑方法通常仅针对单次编辑进行测试，而真实资产的构建依赖一长串修订序列，每次修订都需实现所请求的更改同时保持其他部分不变。这种长程、部件级的迭代编辑场景缺乏系统性评测基准。
AI.method: 作者构建EditHero基准：包含自然语言指令以及几何和纹理的目标图像，采用确定性装配引擎在每次编辑后生成精确目标，并由人工审核每条序列。利用该基准对比两类3D编辑方法：非智能体方法自顶向下，从学习到的3D表示重新生成物体并推断需保留的部分；LLM/VLM智能体自底向上，通过检查网格并仅重写指令所需部分的代码进行编辑。
AI.result: 非智能体方法常常漏掉所请求的更改并扰动本应保持不变的区域。大多数LLM更严格地遵循指令，且所有智能体方法都更好地保留了未编辑部分，但其每次编辑均需数分钟。
AI.conclusion: EditHero为可靠迭代式3D编辑研究提供了首个长程、部件级基准，并将发布装配引擎与编辑序列以支持后续研究。

title: HakemBench: A Turkish Benchmark of Typed Decisions
comment: 9 pages including references. Data, harness, scorer and board: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ufakai/HakemBench, https://github.com/ufakai/hakembench
summary: HakemBench is a Turkish benchmark of typed decisions, in which the model under test reads a text, a question and a fixed set of options and returns a probability for every option. Version 1.0 is released fully open under CC BY 4.0, with 2,346 items and 4,275 choice, yes/no and score questions in seven tracks (fact-check triage, education, guardrails, legal routing, moderation, spam and phishing, and customer support). One harness scores decision quality (macro F1), calibration (from the normalised Brier score) and selective automation (from the normalised area under the generalised risk-coverage curve), combines them by a geometric mean and reports intervals from 2,000 bootstrap draws; probes for option order, paraphrase, English translation and substituted names are reported alongside. Most gold labels come from blind passes of one AI model family compared with the votes of a panel of large language models from other model families; they are not human-verified. On a board of 16 rows the leader scores a composite of 0.888 and the lab's own model is 7th at 0.660. Its numbers are not blind. Earlier runs' test results shaped its training data, so its guardrail, moderation and customer support numbers are flagged; with every model scored on the other four tracks only, its composite is 0.678, 6th of 16.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 HakemBench：一个土耳其语“类型化决策”基准，v1.0 以 CC BY 4.0 开放，含 2,346 条目、4,275 道选择题/是非题/评分题，覆盖七个赛轨；配套评测框架综合决策质量（macro F1）、校准（归一化 Brier 分数）与选择性自动化（归一化广义风险-覆盖率曲线下面积），以几何平均合并并给出 2,000 次 bootstrap 区间。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多聚焦英语与生成式任务，缺少面向土耳其语的、以“从固定选项中选择并输出概率”为核心的决策型评测；同时需要同时衡量决策正确性、概率校准与可选择性自动化（在低风险覆盖下保持高精度）的能力。此外，作者希望披露金标注由模型盲测与跨模型家族投票生成、未经人工核验，以及自身模型因历史测试数据污染而存在非盲评问题，以提升评测透明度。
AI.method: 构建 HakemBench v1.0：土耳其语、类型化决策任务，模型读取文本、问题与固定选项集，为每个选项返回概率。数据集含 2,346 条目、4,275 道题，分七轨：事实核查分流、教育、护栏、法律路由、审核、垃圾邮件与钓鱼、客服。评测 harness 计算三项指标——决策质量（macro F1）、校准（归一化 Brier 分数）、选择性自动化（归一化广义风险-覆盖率曲线下面积），以几何平均合成，并用 2,000 次 bootstrap 给出置信区间。另设探测项：选项顺序、同义改写、英译、替换姓名。金标签主要来自单一 AI 模型家族的盲测结果，并与其它模型家族的大型语言模型投票面板比对，未经人工核验。排行榜共 16 行。
AI.result: 榜首综合分为 0.888；作者实验室自研模型排名第 7，综合分 0.660，且其成绩非盲评——早期测试结果影响了其训练数据，故护栏、审核、客服三轨成绩被标注。若仅在其余四轨上评分，该模型综合分为 0.678，在 16 个模型中列第 6。
AI.conclusion: HakemBench 提供了土耳其语决策型评测的开放基准与多维（质量、校准、选择性自动化）评分框架，并辅以稳健性探测。其局限在于金标签未经人工核验、部分模型成绩非盲评且存在数据污染，作者通过标注与分轨报告予以披露，提示榜单解读需谨慎。

title: RNADyn: A Benchmark for Generating and Understanding RNA Dynamics
summary: Ribonucleic acid (RNA) functions through conformational changes that are not fully captured by static structures. However, large-scale standardized RNA dynamics data remain limited, and existing approaches typically treat trajectory generation and dynamics understanding as separate objectives. Here, we introduce RNADynBench, a standardized RNA molecular dynamics (MD) benchmark with 2585 quality-controlled 100-ns all-atom trajectories and leakage-controlled splits. Building on RNADynBench, we develop RNADynNet, a unified model for RNA dynamics learning that uses a shared backbone for both trajectory generation and dynamics fingerprint extraction from a single conformer. It combines coordinate denoising, single-frame-to-trajectory alignment, and physical grounding to connect all-atom trajectory generation with dynamics representation learning. Physical grounding improves both generated dynamics and the physical information recoverable from these fingerprints. Across both test sets, including the high-flexibility challenge set, the generated trajectories achieve RMSF correlations of 0.875 and 0.766, while single-conformer predictions show comparable agreement with MD-derived dynamics. RNADynBench and RNADynNet together establish a benchmark and unified modeling framework for generating and understanding RNA dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RNADynBench（2585条质控100纳秒全原子轨迹的标准化RNA分子动力学基准，含防泄漏划分）和RNADynNet（统一模型，共享骨干网络同时实现轨迹生成与单构象动力学指纹提取），通过坐标去噪、单帧到轨迹对齐和物理约束将全原子轨迹生成与动力学表征学习连接起来。
AI.motivation: RNA功能通过构象变化实现，而静态结构无法完全刻画这些变化。但目前大规模标准化RNA动力学数据有限，且现有方法通常将轨迹生成与动力学理解视为相互独立的目标，缺乏统一的数据基准与建模框架。
AI.method: 构建RNADynBench：含2585条经质量控制的100-ns全原子轨迹，并采用防泄漏（leakage-controlled）数据划分。在此基础上开发RNADynNet：使用共享骨干网络，从单一构象同时完成轨迹生成与动力学指纹提取；融合坐标去噪（coordinate denoising）、单帧到轨迹对齐（single-frame-to-trajectory alignment）以及物理约束（physical grounding）。
AI.result: 物理约束既提升了生成轨迹的质量，也提升了从动力学指纹中可恢复的物理信息。在两个测试集（包括高柔性挑战集）上，生成轨迹的RMSF相关性分别达到0.875和0.766；单构象预测与MD导出动力学的一致性相当。
AI.conclusion: RNADynBench与RNADynNet共同为RNA动力学的生成与理解建立了标准化基准和统一建模框架。

title: Awomo-SimDataEngine: Agentic Simulation-ReadyWorld Generation
summary: Generating useful robot-training data requires more than visually plausiblescenes: objects must support interaction, placements must remain physicallyvalid, and tasks must admit repeatable execution. We present\textbf{Awomo-SimDataEngine}, an agentic system that connects asset and scenegeneration to robot demonstration synthesis. Shared asset services providerigid and articulated objects, including structure-grounded part and jointgeneration with ISArt. Scene generation supports two complementary routes:Unravel reconstructs editable scenes from images, while SimForge buildssingle-room and multi-room environments from text. A graph-native harnesscoordinates construction, validation, andbounded repair, routing failures to the responsible module while retainingunaffected scene state. PolicyForge binds validated worlds to tasks and robotembodiments to produce replayable demonstrations. Evaluations cover assetgeometry, scene quality, and downstream policy learning. On MuJoCo-basedLIBERO-Plus, co-training with Isaac Sim demonstrations improves the overallsuccess rate of a World-Action Model (WAM) from $77.17\%$ to $89.43\%$. Goal and spatialsuccess improve by $31.66$ and $6.25$ percentage points, respectively.These results support the utility of the generated data for cross-simulatorpolicy training, with more limited gains on long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: Awomo-SimDataEngine 是一个 agentic 系统，将资产与场景生成连接到机器人演示合成。它提供刚体/铰接物体生成（ISArt）、图像/文本两条场景生成路线（Unravel、SimForge）、图原生校验修复框架及 PolicyForge 演示绑定。在 MuJoCo 版 LIBERO-Plus 上，用 Isaac Sim 演示联合训练使 WAM 成功率从 77.17% 提升到 89.43%。
AI.motivation: 生成有用的机器人训练数据不仅仅要求视觉上合理的场景：物体必须支持交互，布局必须保持物理有效，任务必须可重复执行。现有方法难以同时满足这些要求，因此需要一个从资产、场景生成到机器人演示合成的连贯系统。
AI.method: 1) 共享资产服务生成刚体与铰接物体，含结构约束的部件与关节生成（ISArt）；2) 场景生成支持两条互补路线：Unravel 从图像重建可编辑场景，SimForge 从文本构建单房间与多房间环境；3) 图原生 harness 协调构建、验证与有界修复，将失败路由至责任模块并保留未受影响的场景状态；4) PolicyForge 将已验证世界绑定到任务与机器人本体，产出可回放演示。
AI.result: 评估覆盖资产几何、场景质量与下游策略学习。在基于 MuJoCo 的 LIBERO-Plus 上，与 Isaac Sim 演示联合训练将 World-Action Model (WAM) 的整体成功率从 77.17% 提升至 89.43%；目标成功率和空间成功率分别提升 31.66 与 6.25 个百分点。长时程任务上的增益相对有限。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持所生成数据用于跨模拟器策略训练的有效性，但在长时程任务上增益较为有限，表明该方向仍有改进空间。

title: Hybrid Machine Learning-Assisted Raman Spectroscopy with Generative Feature Augmentation for Pharmaceutical Identification
summary: Rapid and reliable identification of pharmaceutical residues is important for safeguarding public health, ensuring food safety, and enabling practical Raman-based screening. In this study, we propose HyMLRaman, a hybrid Raman spectroscopy framework that combines deep spectral feature extraction, generative models, and classical machine-learning classifiers to identify six pharmaceutical compounds, including amoxicillin, chloramphenicol, ciprofloxacin, tetracycline, ibuprofen, and paracetamol. Raman spectra are converted into spectral images and encoded with several deep neural-network backbones, among which EfficientNet-B3 yields the most effective representation. The resulting 1536-dimensional embeddings are then used to train downstream classifiers, including SVM, KNN, logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost, and ANN, using stratified 10-fold cross-validation. The hybrid EfficientNet-B3--SVM configuration achieves the strongest baseline performance, reaching 96.31% accuracy and a macro-F1 score of 96.36%, outperforming the standalone CNN baseline. To address limited-data conditions, a generative model, a DDPM-based feature augmentation, is introduced in a PCA-reduced EfficientNet-B3 latent space. The low-data ablation results show that DDPM augmentation provides selective benefits, particularly for KNN with reduced training fractions, and that its effect remains classifier-dependent. Finally, an application-level Raman Pharmaceutical Analyzer demonstrates the feasibility of embedding the trained model into an interactive Raman analysis workflow. These results suggest that HyMLRaman provides a practical and interpretable route for rapid Raman-based pharmaceutical screening.

AI.tldr: 提出HyMLRaman混合拉曼光谱框架，结合深度特征提取、生成模型与经典机器学习分类器，实现六种药物残留的高精度识别，最高达96.31%准确率。
AI.motivation: 药物残留的快速可靠识别对保障公共健康、食品安全及拉曼筛查应用至关重要，需兼顾精度、低数据适应性与可解释性。
AI.method: 将拉曼光谱转为谱图并用多种深度骨干网络编码，EfficientNet-B3表征最优，得到1536维嵌入；在此基础上训练SVM、KNN、逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost与ANN，采用分层10折交叉验证。针对低数据场景，在PCA降维的EfficientNet-B3潜空间引入DDPM生成式特征增强。
AI.result: EfficientNet-B3–SVM组合性能最佳，准确率96.31%、宏F1为96.36%，优于单一CNN基线；DDPM增强收益具有选择性，在训练比例降低时对KNN帮助明显，效果依赖具体分类器。
AI.conclusion: HyMLRaman为快速拉曼药物筛查提供了一条实用且可解释的技术路径，并可通过交互式拉曼药物分析器嵌入实际工作流。

title: Clustering without clusters: the meta-criterion and centroid reliability mistake continuous dynamics for discrete states
summary: Microstate analysis starts with clustering and the meta-criterion is a heuristic to find an optimum cluster number. We address the following questions: (i) what number is found for non-cluster-forming dynamical systems, (ii) do centroids fall in random attractor regions, (iii) do EEG topographies form clusters or a single connected structure in sensor space? We find that (i) the meta-criterion suggests spurious optimal cluster numbers (4-8) with high confidence on different attractor geometries, (ii) cluster centroids reliably fall in the same attractor regions, (iii) topological analysis of dynamical systems and resting-state EEG suggests that all form a single connected structure in their respective phase space, not clusters. We conclude that the meta-criterion should be used with caution and its results should not be taken as representing a ground truth. Cluster numbers deviating from the meta-criterion should not be discarded. A more far-reaching implication is that evidence for the existence of clusters in resting-state EEG data is still lacking. Microstate clustering may correspond to the partitioning of a single connected structure.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验EEG微状态分析的聚类有效性，发现元准则在非聚类动力系统上会给出虚假最优簇数，且静息态EEG拓扑实为单一连通结构，提示聚类结果不可当作金标准。
AI.motivation: 微状态分析以聚类为起点，通常用元准则（meta-criterion）启发式确定最优簇数。作者质疑该做法是否可靠，尤其是对本身不形成簇的动力系统是否会给出虚假簇数，以及静息态EEG拓扑究竟是真簇还是单一连通结构。
AI.method: 研究考察非聚类动力系统上的元准则表现，检查聚类质心是否落在随机吸引子区域；并对动力系统和静息态EEG进行拓扑分析，在各自相空间中判断其是否由簇构成。
AI.result: (i) 元准则在不同吸引子几何上以高置信度给出虚假的最优簇数（4–8）；(ii) 聚类质心确实可靠地落入相同吸引子区域；(iii) 拓扑分析表明动力系统与静息态EEG均形成单一连通结构，而非多个簇。
AI.conclusion: 元准则应谨慎使用，其结果不代表ground truth；偏离元准则的簇数不应被丢弃。更深远的意义在于，静息态EEG数据中簇存在的证据仍然缺乏，微状态聚类可能只是对单一连通结构的分区。

title: Generating eukaryotic reference genome assemblies: Earth BioGenome Project quality standards and recommendations
summary: Reference genome assemblies are foundational resources across the biological sciences as they begin to expose the fundamental building blocks of each species and the molecular toolkits vital for adaptation and survival. High-quality genomes enable insights into evolution, facilitate ecosystem monitoring and protection and conservation of species, access to new biomaterials and biomedicine, advances in agri- and aquaculture, and support planetary health. The amount of information gathered from a species' genome assembly is directly dependent on its quality. However, different sequencing technologies and software solutions generate a wide range of quality outcomes. Here, the Earth BioGenome Project's Sequencing and Assembly committee, together with a large community of researchers performing eukaryote sequencing and assembly, outlines quality standards for a "reference" assembly and formulates recommendations to ensure these standards are met.

AI.tldr: 参考基因组组装是生物学基础资源，其价值取决于质量。地球生物基因组计划测序与组装委员会联合学界提出"参考"组装的质量标准及达成建议。
AI.motivation: 不同测序技术与软件产生的组装质量差异巨大，而基因组组装所能提供的信息量直接取决于其质量，因此亟需统一的"参考"组装质量标准。
AI.method: 由地球生物基因组计划（EBP）测序与组装委员会牵头，联合大规模真核生物测序与组装研究群体，界定"参考"组装的质量标准并制定相应实施建议。
AI.result: 提出了一套"参考"基因组组装的质量标准，并给出了确保达到这些标准的具体推荐方案。
AI.conclusion: 高质量参考基因组对进化研究、生态监测与物种保护、新型生物材料与生物医学、农业与水产养殖进步及行星健康具有重要意义，统一质量标准是保障其价值的关键。

title: Efficient FlashAttention on Blackwell via Fixed-Shift Softmax and Persistent Scheduling
summary: On Blackwell, normalization and operand movement can limit attention kernels whose matrix multiplications are already deeply pipelined. We implement an FA4-style pipeline in Triton TLX with fixed-shift dense softmax and a saved inverse denominator for backward. The fixed shift removes recurrent accumulator corrections; the saved reciprocal moves row normalization from the quadratic backward loop into linear preprocessing. The guarded causal path uses a first-block anchor with selective recovery, and fully masked diagonal contractions are skipped. A packed BF16 exponential approximation and pipelined dQ publication reduce per-element work and on-chip movement. On B200 at 1,000 W, using prepared launches and the original FA4 timer, TLX improves geometric-mean throughput by 7.3 percent across the 24 cases in FA4's BF16 variable-batch grid through 32,768 tokens at head dimension 128. Dense forward and backward improve by 13.0 and 10.4 percent, respectively. Causal backward improves by 8.0 percent, while causal forward is 1.5 percent slower. The TritonBench comparison has geometric- mean gains of 13.4 percent in forward and 24.4 percent in backward

AI.tldr: 在 Blackwell 上，用 Triton TLX 实现 FA4 风格流水线，通过固定偏移 softmax、保存倒数分母、因果路径优化与 BF16 近似指数等手段，在 B200 上取得 7.3% 的几何平均吞吐提升。
AI.motivation: Blackwell 架构上，归一化与操作数搬运会成为已深度流水的注意力内核瓶颈，需减少递归累加器校正与片上数据移动。
AI.method: 在 Triton TLX 中实现 FA4 风格流水线：采用固定偏移稠密 softmax 并为反向保存倒数分母；固定偏移消除递归累加器校正，保存的倒数将行归一化从二次反向循环移至线性预处理；带保护的因果路径使用首块锚点与选择性恢复，并跳过完全掩蔽的对角收缩；采用打包 BF16 指数近似与流水化 dQ 发布减少逐元素计算与片上搬运。
AI.result: 在 1,000 W 的 B200 上，使用准备启动与原始 FA4 计时器，24 个 BF16 可变批量网格案例（至 32,768 token，头维度 128）几何平均吞吐提升 7.3%；稠密前向与反向分别提升 13.0% 与 10.4%；因果反向提升 8.0%，因果前向慢 1.5%。TritonBench 对比中前向几何平均提升 13.4%，反向提升 24.4%。
AI.conclusion: 所提 TLX 流水线在多数场景显著优于 FA4，验证了消除归一化递归与减少片上搬运对注意力内核性能的有效性，但因果前向存在小幅退化。

title: Fast Models, Slow Evidence: A Paired and Self-Audited Evaluation of System-1 Decision Models for LLM Agent Harnesses
summary: Agent harnesses make many small, typed decisions per task: which model to call, which tool to use, whether retrieved text is relevant, whether an input carries an injection. System-1 decision models answer such questions in a single forward pass with class probabilities, promising large cost and latency savings over LLM calls. We present a paired evaluation of an open-weight (Laya) and a hosted (Jev) System-1 model on 11 agent decision points built from 18 public sources: 7,283 base cases plus 6,640 robustness variants, with byte-identical inputs, paired tests, and cross-hardware and cross-day reproducibility checks. Jev is significantly more accurate on 9 of 11 decision points (+10.8 to +46.0 pp). Neither model beats chance on zero-shot model routing, and they tie on RAG relevance gating. Laya changes 30% of its answers when the option order is reversed and degrades sharply with many or similar candidates (31% at 50 nearest-neighbour tools, vs. 98% for Jev on items with a unique correct tool). We also audit our own pipeline. Three analysis errors and one design confound distorted headline deployment claims: an omitted pre-screen cost (reported 23.9% saving, actual 4.3%), gate accuracy reported as end-to-end quality (58% vs. 98%), in-sample thresholds (5% target, up to 17% held-out misses), and a "channel effect" on injection false positives that vanishes with channel-native content. Two other suspected confounds did not change the conclusions. All cases, raw outputs and analysis code are available at https://github.com/David-DL-Space/sys1-eval.

AI.tldr: 本文对开放权重（Laya）与托管（Jev）两种System-1决策模型在11个智能体决策点上进行配对评估，并审计自身评测流程，发现Jev在9/11决策点上显著更优，同时揭示3处分析错误与1处设计混淆导致此前的部署结论被夸大。
AI.motivation: 智能体框架每项任务需做大量小型类型化决策（选模型、选工具、判断检索相关性、检测注入），System-1决策模型以单次前向传播给出类别概率，理论上比LLM调用更省成本与延迟；但缺乏严格、可复现的配对评估来验证其真实能力与部署收益。
AI.method: 构建11个决策点、来自18个公开数据源的评测集：7,283个基础案例加6,640个鲁棒性变体；保证输入字节级一致、采用配对检验，并做跨硬件与跨天可复现性检查；对开放权重模型Laya与托管模型Jev进行对比，并审计自身分析流程（成本核算、门槛准确率、阈值样本内外、注入误报的通道效应等）。
AI.result: Jev在9/11决策点上显著更准（+10.8至+46.0个百分点）；两模型在零样本模型路由上均未优于随机，在RAG相关性门控上持平。Laya在选项顺序反转时改变30%答案，且候选多或相似时性能骤降（50个最近邻工具时31%，而Jev在唯一正确工具样本上为98%）。审计发现：遗漏预筛成本（宣称节省23.9%，实际4.3%）、将门控准确率当作端到端质量（58% vs 98%）、样本内阈值（目标5%，留出集漏检高达17%），以及一个在通道原生内容下消失的注入误报"通道效应"；另两处疑似混淆未改变结论。
AI.conclusion: System-1决策模型在智能体决策上可显著降低延迟与成本，但仅托管模型Jev在多数决策点上达到可用精度；开放权重模型Laya在顺序敏感与多候选场景下鲁棒性不足。研究强调自审评测流程的必要性：成本口径、阈值选择与指标定义偏差会严重夸大部署收益，所有案例、原始输出与分析代码已开源。

title: MIRROR: Multipath Quorum Integrity for LLM Multi-Agent Communication
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundations of Language Model Security (FLMSec). 12 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables
summary: Inter-agent communication is central to Large Language Model Multi-Agent Systems (LLM-MAS), but it introduces an underexplored vulnerability: Agent-in-the-Middle (AiTM) attacks that manipulate messages in transit without compromising the agents themselves. Prior work reports Attack Success Rates (ASR) approaching 100% on structured tasks. Existing defenses rely on semantic validation, which requires additional inference and can block benign outputs, or on transport-layer encryption, which does not help when an intermediary legitimately terminates TLS. We present MIRROR, a communication-layer integrity primitive that replicates a single canonicalized payload across k logical routes and accepts a message only when a strict majority of routes report the same digest. MIRROR uses unkeyed hashing and so authenticates nothing on its own, since an active on-path adversary can always recompute a digest over a payload it has modified. All integrity derives from the assumption that honest routes form a majority. The digest serves only to make witness routes constant-size and to bind the recovered payload to the quorum-agreed value under second-preimage resistance. We give the guarantee under a route-compromise bound alpha < 0.5, and extend it to correlated routes, where the quantity that matters is the size of the largest shared-failure group and not the route count. We further show that availability and integrity degrade at the same threshold: below alpha = 0.5, quorum-denial and message-dropping adversaries cannot block honest traffic. Across MMLU, HumanEval, and MBPP on two frameworks and four communication topologies, and in a MetaGPT deployment against a production API, MIRROR reduces ASR to 0% below the threshold at 1x LLM token cost. LLM-as-a-Judge costs 35x in the same deployment, and blocks up to 44.2% of benign outputs in the topology sweep.

AI.tldr: MIRROR是一种通信层完整性原语，通过将单一规范化载荷复制到k条逻辑路由，仅当严格多数路由报告相同摘要时接受消息，从而在路由损坏比例α<0.5时抵御LLM多智能体系统中的中间人攻击，将ASR降至0%且不增加LLM token开销。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）中的智能体间通信存在未被充分探索的Agent-in-the-Middle（AiTM）攻击漏洞：攻击者可篡改传输中的消息而不入侵智能体本身，现有工作报告结构化任务上ASR接近100%。既有防御依赖语义验证（需额外推理且可能误拦良性输出）或传输层加密（当中间人合法终止TLS时无效），因此需要一种不依赖密钥、不依赖语义模型的通信层完整性方案。
AI.method: MIRROR将单一规范化载荷复制到k条逻辑路由，仅当严格多数路由报告相同摘要时接受消息。它使用无密钥哈希，因此本身不认证任何内容——主动在途攻击者总能对修改后的载荷重新计算摘要；所有完整性来源于"诚实路由占多数"这一假设。摘要仅用于使见证路由保持常量大小，并在第二原像抗性下将恢复载荷绑定到法定多数一致值。作者在路由损坏界限α<0.5下给出保证，并扩展到相关路由情形，其中关键量是最大共享故障组的规模而非路由数量；进一步证明可用性与完整性在同一阈值处退化：低于α=0.5时，法定拒绝与消息丢弃攻击者无法阻断诚实流量。
AI.result: 在MMLU、HumanEval和MBPP上，跨两个框架和四种通信拓扑评估，并在MetaGPT部署中针对生产API测试：MIRROR在阈值以下将ASR降至0%，且LLM token成本仅为1x。相同部署中，LLM-as-a-Judge成本高达35x，且在拓扑扫描中最多拦截44.2%的良性输出。
AI.conclusion: MIRROR以近乎零额外LLM开销实现了对AiTM攻击的鲁棒防御，优于需要额外推理且误报率高的语义验证方法；其安全性完全建立在诚实路由占多数的假设之上，并形式化给出了完整性、可用性及相关路由场景下的阈値保证。

title: From Alert Floods to Precedence Forests: Zero-Prior-Knowledge Incident Triage with LOGOS
summary: Commercial observability platforms rely on domain artifacts like distributed traces, topology maps, and baseline metrics. However, when troubleshooting proprietary software, enterprise operators are left with only raw, unannotated text logs. We explore the extreme boundary of log-only diagnosis: To what extent can we isolate failure propagation using strictly raw text logs? We present LOGOS, an unsupervised system that exploits entity-event co-occurrence and temporal precedence to collapse millions of raw log lines into a compact precedence forest. Evaluated across 25 production enterprise outages and 12 open-source issues, LOGOS operates with zero prior knowledge---requiring no seed queries, observed symptoms, or pre-defined incident boundaries. In a median wall-time of 4.5 minutes, LOGOS eliminates a median 99.8% of background noise, achieves 0.76 mean recall, and detects failure cascades with a 16-hour median diagnosis-verified lead time---consolidating alert floods 124x to enable 80% enterprise (100% open-source) zero-shot LLM root-cause accuracy.

AI.tldr: LOGOS是一个无监督系统，仅利用原始文本日志中的实体-事件共现与时序优先关系，将海量日志压缩为紧凑的优先森林，实现零先验知识的故障传播隔离与根因定位。
AI.motivation: 商业可观测性平台依赖分布式追踪、拓扑图和基线指标等领域化产物，但企业运维人员在排查专有软件时往往只能获得未标注的原始文本日志。本文旨在探索"仅日志诊断"的极限边界：在严格仅使用原始文本日志的条件下，能在多大程度上隔离故障传播。
AI.method: 提出LOGOS——一种无监督方法，利用实体-事件共现（entity-event co-occurrence）与时间优先性（temporal precedence）关系，将数百万行原始日志折叠为紧凑的优先森林（precedence forest）。系统无需种子查询、观测到的症状或预定义的故障边界等任何先验知识，以零样本方式运行。
AI.result: 在25个生产环境企业级故障与12个开源问题上评估：中位墙钟时间4.5分钟，中位消除99.8%的背景噪声，平均召回率0.76；以16小时中位诊断验证提前量检测到故障级联；将告警洪流压缩124倍，支撑80%企业级（开源100%）的零样本LLM根因准确率。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，即使缺乏领域标注与先验知识，仅凭原始文本日志结合共现与时序建模即可有效隔离故障传播、压缩告警并提升LLM根因诊断精度，验证了"仅日志诊断"范式的可行性与实用价值。

title: DeskForge: Dense Supervision from Desktop Environments for Computer-Use Agents
comment: 37 pages, 15 figures, 12 tables. Project page: https://saidgurbuz.github.io/deskforge/
summary: Computer-use agents need to reliably ground action targets in complex desktop scenes, where multiple applications, overlapping windows, and visually similar controls compete for attention. Existing training data rarely pair such scenes with dense annotations or vary them in a controlled way. We introduce DeskForge, a controllable desktop environment that composes and explores real applications to generate large-scale supervision for computer-use agents. It varies application states, content, window layout, appearance, and resolution, and fuses screenshots, accessibility trees, and window geometry into dense element annotations while recording the outcome of each executed action. Using this environment, we construct DeskForge-1M, a corpus of 1.2M annotated desktop observations containing 159.7M element instances. We fine-tune four vision-language models on 200K grounding examples drawn from DeskForge-1M. All four improve across held-out desktop conditions and on all five external GUI grounding benchmarks; for Qwen3.5-4B, accuracy increases by 11.51 percentage points on ScreenSpot-Pro and 10.11 points on OSWorld-G. The gains also translate to long-horizon task completion: under a fixed planner, the fine-tuned action models solve more WebArena-Infinity and OpenApps tasks, with Qwen3.5-4B increasing from 31 to 50 of 119 tasks and from 3 to 15 of 100 tasks, respectively. These results show that controllable composition of real desktop environments provides a scalable source of supervision for improving both GUI grounding and long-horizon computer use. The framework code, the dataset, and the fine-tuned model are available from the project page: https://saidgurbuz.github.io/deskforge/

AI.tldr: 提出可控桌面环境 DeskForge，生成 120 万条带元素标注的桌面观测（1.597 亿元素实例），微调四个 VLM 后在多个 GUI grounding 基准与长程任务上均显著提升。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用智能体需在含多应用、重叠窗口与视觉相似控件的复杂桌面场景中可靠定位操作目标，但现有训练数据很少将此类场景与稠密标注配对，也缺乏受控的变化维度，导致监督数据稀缺。
AI.method: 构建可控桌面环境 DeskForge：组合并探索真实应用，控制应用状态、内容、窗口布局、外观与分辨率，融合截图、无障碍树与窗口几何信息生成稠密元素级标注，同时记录每次执行动作的结果；据此构建 DeskForge-1M 语料（1.2M 观测、159.7M 元素实例），并用其中 200K grounding 样本微调四个视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 四个模型在留出桌面条件与五个外部 GUI grounding 基准上全部提升；Qwen3.5-4B 在 ScreenSpot-Pro 提升 11.51 个百分点、OSWorld-G 提升 10.11 个百分点。在固定 planner 下，WebArena-Infinity 由 31/119 提升至 50/119，OpenApps 由 3/100 提升至 15/100。
AI.conclusion: 对真实桌面环境进行可控组合，可为提升 GUI grounding 与长程计算机使用能力提供可扩展的监督来源；框架代码、数据集与微调模型已公开。

title: Finding the Move Is Not Winning the Game: XiangqiBench for Closed-Loop Evaluation of LLM Agents
summary: Static evaluations credit a language model for naming the right move, but an agent must carry a plan through to a verified outcome while an opponent responds. We introduce XiangqiBench, an executable benchmark that measures this difference in Chinese chess: starting from 119 tactical endgames with forced mates supported by engine or checks-only search, an LLM agent must deliver checkmate against an engine defender. An interactive REPL interface separates real moves, state queries, and forward simulation, and we record 8,568 multi-turn trajectories from 12 frontier LLMs under two observation protocols. Three signals that look like competence each overstate closed-loop success. (i) The Conversion Gap: models play the stored reference first move in 26.1\% of Sighted trials, yet only 13.9\% of these trials end in a win. (ii) The Consistency Gap: the leading model reaches 38.7\% pass@3 but only 5.9\% pass^3, winning all three trials on 7 of the 46 positions it ever wins. (iii) The Simulation Gap: 32.3\% of accepted simulation calls stop on an illegal move, and in 49.3\% of comparable cases the real defender replies differently from the line the agent simulated; self-authored rollouts check legality but cannot anticipate the opponent. Finding the move is not winning the game: agent evaluations should score closed-loop outcomes and report reliability alongside coverage.

AI.tldr: 提出 XiangqiBench 可执行基准，用闭环对弈衡量 LLM 智能体在中国象棋残局中"找到着法"与"真正将死"之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 静态评测只奖励模型说出正确着法，但真实智能体必须在对手应对下把计划执行到已验证的结局。二者之间的差异缺乏可执行的度量。
AI.method: 构建 119 个有强制杀法的战术残局，要求 LLM 智能体与引擎防守方对弈完成将死；采用可交互 REPL 接口区分真实走子、状态查询与前向模拟；在两种观测协议下采集 12 个前沿 LLM 的 8,568 条多轮轨迹，并定义转换差、一致性差、模拟差三类指标。
AI.result: 三类看似能力的信号均高估闭环成功率：(i) 转换差——Sighted 试次中 26.1% 走出存储的参考首着，但仅 13.9% 获胜；(ii) 一致性差——最佳模型 pass@3 达 38.7%，pass^3 仅 5.9%，在其取得过胜利的 46 个局面中仅有 7 个三次全胜；(iii) 模拟差——32.3% 被接受的模拟调用终止于非法着法，49.3% 可比情形中真实防守方回应与模拟线路不同，自生成 rollout 只能检查合法性而无法预判对手。
AI.conclusion: 找到着法不等于赢得对局；智能体评测应计分闭环结果，并在覆盖度之外同时报告可靠性。

title: World-Calibrated Proposal-to-Action Flow for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies generate action chunks by transporting samples from a task-agnostic isotropic Gaussian source. As this source is conditioned on neither recent execution nor predicted future evolution, (i) it discards the local continuity established by recently executed motion. (ii) Even when predictive world representations are introduced, they often only condition the transport dynamics rather than determine where generation starts, how far it may deviate, or along which action directions it may expand. Building on this observation, we introduce ProAct, a world-calibrated proposal-to-action framework that makes the generative source itself predictable. (i) To preserve motion continuity, a lightweight Proposal Expert converts recent actions into a scene-aware hypothesis via one motion-anchored endpoint flow-matching step, initializing generation near the demonstrated action manifold. (ii) To jointly capture intended scene evolution and proposal-future compatibility, a prospective World Expert treats the hypothesis as a soft motion prior while predicting the task-consistent latent future. (iii) From this compatibility, the model calibrates a proposal-centered anisotropic source, where a bounded per-step extent controls the allowed deviation and a trace-normalized low-rank geometry under a condition-number budget allocates refinement over coupled translation, rotation, and gripper directions. Compared with $π_{0.5}$, ProAct improves performance across simulation and real-world tasks while reducing denoising steps by 50%, inference latency by up to 25.8%, and increasing throughput by up to 34.8%.

AI.tldr: ProAct提出"世界校准的proposal-to-action"框架，让VLA策略的生成源本身可预测：用Proposal Expert将近期动作编码为场景感知假设，World Expert预测任务一致的潜在未来并给出兼容性，据此构造以提案为中心的各向异性源，在仿真与真实任务上超越π0.5，并减少50%去噪步数、最高25.8%延迟、提升最高34.8%吞吐。
AI.motivation: 现有flow-based VLA策略从任务无关的各向同性高斯源生成动作块，该源既未条件于近期执行，也未条件于预测的未来演化：(i) 丢弃了近期已执行动作建立的局部连续性；(ii) 即使引入预测性世界表示，也往往只条件化传输动力学，而非决定生成起点、允许的偏离范围与可扩展的动作方向。因此生成过程缺乏结构先验，效率与连续性均受限。
AI.method: ProAct包含三个组件：(i) 轻量Proposal Expert通过一步运动锚定的端点流匹配，将近期动作转换为场景感知假设，使生成初始化在示范动作流形附近，保持运动连续性；(ii) 前瞻性World Expert将该假设作为软运动先验，预测任务一致的潜在未来，从而联合刻画意图场景演化与提案-未来兼容性；(iii) 依据该兼容性校准以提案为中心的各向异性源：用有界的逐步幅度控制允许偏离，用迹归一化低秩几何在条件数预算下，将细化分配到耦合的平移、旋转与夹爪方向。
AI.result: 与π0.5相比，ProAct在仿真与真实世界任务上性能均有提升，同时去噪步数减少50%，推理延迟最高降低25.8%，吞吐最高提升34.8%。
AI.conclusion: 让生成源本身可预测、并以世界模型校准的各向异性提案分布替代任务无关各向同性先验，可同时改善VLA策略的运动连续性、任务一致性与推理效率。

title: The Price of Greenwashing: Algorithmic Verification and Market Discipline using Conformal Machine Learning
summary: While corporate sustainability mandates are expanding, the systemic reliance on self-reported emissions data exposes financial markets to pervasive greenwashing. Current literature relies heavily on subjective ESG ratings or textual sentiment analysis, leaving a critical econometric gap in objectively quantifying physical climate realities. To resolve this information asymmetry, we fuse U.S. SEC financial fundamentals with facility-level EPA greenhouse gas registries to establish a mathematically guaranteed baseline of physical corporate emissions. Leveraging a gradient boosting architecture and Mondrian Conformal Prediction, we quantify the shortfall between self-reported data and this algorithmic baseline into a novel Conformal-Weighted Continuous Divergence (CWCD) metric. Evaluating this divergence via a cross-sectional lead-lag econometric design, we uncover a robust mechanism of market discipline: algorithmic emissions divergence exhibits a severe, statistically significant negative relationship with subsequent market valuation (Tobin's Q) and operational profitability (ROA). Providing definitive evidence against the market blindness hypothesis, this study proves that institutional capital actively prices environmental deception not merely as an ethical lapse, but as a leading indicator of fundamental corporate mismanagement. Ultimately, these findings provide the quantitative justification necessary for asset managers and regulators to deploy algorithmic auditing infrastructure at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文融合SEC财务数据与EPA设施级温室气体登记数据，构建算法化排放基线并识别企业自报数据的偏离（CWCD），实证发现该偏离显著负向预测后续市场估值与盈利能力，证明机构资本已对"漂绿"行为定价。
AI.motivation: 企业可持续性强制披露不断扩张，但市场高度依赖自愿披露的排放数据，使"漂绿"风险系统性存在。现有文献多依赖主观ESG评级或文本情感分析，缺乏客观量化实体气候现实（physical climate realities）的计量工具，形成计量经济学空白。作者希望以客观数据融合方法消除信息不对称。
AI.method: 1）数据：美国SEC财务基本面数据 + EPA设施级温室气体登记数据，通过融合构建数学上有保证的企业实体排放基线；2）模型：梯度提升（gradient boosting）架构 + Mondrian Conformal Prediction，对自报数据与算法基线之间的缺口进行量化，构造新指标Conformal-Weighted Continuous Divergence（CWCD）；3）识别策略：截面超前—滞后（cross-sectional lead-lag）计量设计，检验CWCD与后续Tobin's Q、ROA的关系。
AI.result: 算法化排放偏离与后续市场估值（Tobin's Q）和运营盈利能力（ROA）呈显著、稳健的负相关关系。该结果否定了"市场盲视假说"（market blindness hypothesis），表明机构资本已将环境欺骗不仅视为伦理失范，更定价为基本面管理不善的领先指标。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为资产管理者和监管者大规模部署算法审计基础设施提供了量化依据，说明基于物理数据的算法化披露核验能够被市场有效定价，从而形成对漂绿的市场约束机制。

title: Causal discovery identifies pathways linking physical activity to dementia risk in the UK BioBank
summary: Physical Activity (PA) is consistently associated with lower risk of dementia, yet the mechanism linking PA to dementia prevention remain incomopletely understood. Here, we integrate large language model (LLM)-guided causal discovery with mediation analysis in 42,293 older adults aged 60 years or older from the UK Biobank to systematically identify pathways connecting objectively measured moderate-to-vigorous physical activity (MVPA) to dementia risk. Across behavioral, psychological, functional, and clinical domains, causal discovery consistently identified interconnected pathways linking higher MVPA to lower dementia risk through depression, functional capacity, smoking behavior, hypertension, cardiovascular disease, chronic kidney disease, and brain injury. Chain mediation analyses further identified depression as a central pathway, accounting for 15.1% of the overall association between MVPA and dementia risk. Sex-stratified analyses revealed distinct mechanistic patterns, with females exhibiting predominantly metabolic and functional pathways, while males showed behavioral and cardiometabolic cascades involving smoking and cardiovascular disease. Together, these findings suggest that the protective association between PA and dementia is mediated through interconnected behavioral, psychological, and cardiometabolic processes rather than a single pathway. Depression emerged as a prominent and potentially modifiable pathway, highlighting opportunities for integrating dementia prevention strategies that combine PA promotion with mental health and cardiovascular risk management.

AI.tldr: 该研究结合大语言模型引导的因果发现与中介分析，在42,293名60岁以上英国生物银行参与者中，系统识别体力活动（MVPA）与痴呆风险之间的多通路机制，发现抑郁、功能能力、吸烟、高血压、心血管病、慢性肾病、脑损伤等构成相互关联的中介通路，其中抑郁占总关联的15.1%，且存在显著性别差异。
AI.motivation: 体力活动（PA）与较低痴呆风险稳定相关，但PA预防痴呆的机制尚不完全清楚；既有研究多局限于单一或少数中介变量，缺乏对行为、心理、功能与临床多领域通路的系统性因果刻画，也较少考察性别特异性机制。
AI.method: 数据为UK Biobank中42,293名≥60岁老年人，暴露为客观测量的中高强度体力活动（MVPA），结局为痴呆风险。方法上将大语言模型（LLM）引导的因果发现与中介分析相结合，覆盖行为、心理、功能与临床四个领域，并进一步开展链式中介分析与性别分层分析。
AI.result: 因果发现一致识别出多条相互关联的通路，将较高MVPA与较低痴呆风险通过抑郁、功能能力、吸烟行为、高血压、心血管疾病、慢性肾病和脑损伤连接起来。链式中介分析显示抑郁是核心通路，解释总关联的15.1%。性别分层显示机制模式不同：女性以代谢与功能通路为主，男性则表现为涉及吸烟与心血管疾病的行为—心血管代谢级联。
AI.conclusion: PA与痴呆之间的保护性关联并非由单一通路介导，而是通过行为、心理与心血管代谢等相互关联的进程共同实现。抑郁是突出且潜在可干预的通路，提示可将体力活动促进与心理健康及心血管风险管理相结合，形成整合式痴呆预防策略。

title: Budgeted Cache Repair for Cross-Context KV-Cache Reuse
summary: Cross-context KV-cache reuse predicts a shared segment's keys and values under a new prefix instead of recomputing them, and has been reported to do so without quality loss. We find otherwise, and identify two problems. (1) A hidden cost: on MMLU and GSM8K, reuse costs substantial accuracy. (2) A decision at the wrong unit: no rule for deciding whether to reuse a cache removes that cost. What does help is choosing which parts of the cache to recompute, and the value of choosing well falls as the unit of choice grows: informed selection removes 49.5% of the cache error beyond chance at single rows (one token's keys and values), 10.6% at 64-token chunks, and nothing at the level of whole calls. Budgeted Cache Repair (BCR) acts at the unit where selection still pays. It drafts two tokens from the assembled cache, ranks cache rows by the attention those tokens pay them, and recomputes a fixed budget of rows exactly, in one of three layouts. The cost is paid rather than predicted away, and the draft that fails as a gate succeeds as a selector. BCR restores GSM8K to dense-prefill accuracy while still serving most calls from cache, and its best layout outperforms every reuse baseline's mean in the reference grid. The draft also beats a coin-flip selector at the same budget - a control prior evaluations lack.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出跨上下文KV缓存复用会带来显著精度损失，且复用决策的粒度选择错误；提出在单行粒度上选择重算内容，并给出Budgeted Cache Repair（BCR）方法，在恢复GSM8K精度同时仍主要依赖缓存服务。
AI.motivation: 已有工作声称跨上下文KV缓存复用可以在不损失质量的情况下预测共享段的键值，避免重算。作者发现这一结论不成立：复用存在隐藏的精度代价，且现有方法在错误的决策单元上做复用判断。
AI.method: 作者分析不同选择粒度对缓存错误消除的影响（单行、64-token块、整次调用），提出Budgeted Cache Repair（BCR）：从组装好的缓存中起草两个token，依据这两个token对这些缓存行的注意力对行排序，固定预算精确重算若干行，支持三种布局；用失败于门控的草稿作为选择器。
AI.result: 在MMLU和GSM8K上复用带来明显精度损失；有信息的选择在单行粒度上除去49.5%的超随机缓存错误，64-token块为10.6%，整次调用级别为零。BCR将GSM8K恢复到dense-prefill精度，且大部分调用仍由缓存服务，最佳布局优于参考网格中所有复用基线的均值，并在相同预算下击败硬币翻转选择器。
AI.conclusion: 跨上下文KV缓存复用的质量损失是真实存在的，关键在于选择合适的重算单元而非决定是否复用；BCR在单行粒度上以固定预算精确重算，可恢复精度并保持高缓存命中，且提供了此前评估所缺乏的选择器对照控制。

title: The AI Risk Observatory: What Can We Learn from AI Disclosures in Annual Reports About Societal Resilience?
comment: 22 pages (9 main text + appendices), 12 figures, 7 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/84rt/AI-Risk-Observatory (release dataset-v1.1)
summary: Societal resilience research relies on access to useful and actionable data, which motivates our main research question: Can annual reports, processed at scale with LLMs, provide a useful signal about how companies disclose their response to AI? We test this by applying a reproducible two-stage classification pipeline to 9,821 annual reports from 1,362 UK listed companies (2020-2025, with partial 2026 data). We first validate the method against 474 human-annotated passages, finding high recall and moderate label-level agreement. We then report three empirical patterns: (i) between 2020 and 2025, the share of reports mentioning AI risk rose from 2.8% to 41.2%, while AI adoption disclosure also rose, from 13.8% to 45.2%, and named vendor mentions cluster around a small set of major providers led by Microsoft; (ii) disclosure varies substantially by Critical National Infrastructure sector and market segment: AIM reports disclose AI risk at far lower rates than Main Market reports, and sectors such as Energy and Data Infrastructure lag behind the rest in AI risk disclosure; and (iii) harm disclosures are near-absent (seven reports across the entire corpus). We develop a substantiveness classification to assess the quality of the disclosure and find that most AI risk disclosure is not substantive: in 2025, 41.2% of all reports mention AI as a risk, but only 4.3% contain AI risk disclosure we classify as substantive.

AI.tldr: 该研究用两阶段LLM分类流程处理9,821份英国上市公司年报（2020–2025），验证后揭示AI风险与采纳披露快速上升、行业与市场分层显著、实质性披露稀缺三大模式。
AI.motivation: 社会韧性研究依赖有用且可操作的数据，作者据此提出核心问题：大规模处理年报能否提供企业如何披露其AI响应的有用信号。
AI.method: 对来自1,362家英国上市公司的9,821份年报（2020–2025，含部分2026数据）应用可复现的两阶段分类流程；先用474段人工标注文本验证方法，并构建"实质性"分类标准评估披露质量。
AI.result: 验证显示高召回率、标签级一致性中等。三项实证发现：(i) 提及AI风险的报告占比从2020年2.8%升至2025年41.2%，AI采纳披露从13.8%升至45.2%，供应商提及集中于以微软为首的少数大型厂商；(ii) 披露存在行业与市场分层，AIM市场AI风险披露率远低于主板市场，能源与数据基础设施等关键国家基础设施行业滞后；(iii) 危害披露几乎缺失，全语料仅7份。2025年41.2%报告提及AI风险，但仅4.3%属实质性披露。
AI.conclusion: 年报结合LLM规模化分析可提供企业AI披露的有效信号，但多数AI风险披露缺乏实质性，披露水平受市场板块与行业结构显著影响。

title: Hop-Decayed Influence: New Vulnerabilities of Structural Auxiliary Indexing in GraphRAG Pipelines with LLM
comment: 14 pages. Published in IFIP SEC 2026. Best Paper Award
summary: GraphRAG pipelines construct auxiliary structures during offline indexing--semantic summaries, hierarchical edges, and pre-computed scores--that determine how retrieval is prioritised at query time. Prior attacks target only instance-level components (nodes, edges, triples), overlooking these schema-level structures. We formalise Auxiliary Schema-Level Entity as a novel attack surface and propose the 3S Framework (Semantics, Structure, Scoring) for its systematic exploitation. Our Hop-Decayed Influence (HDI) attack identifies high-impact targets through query-aware influence propagation and corrupts their auxiliary structures post-indexing. Across two benchmarks (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA) and two architectures (Microsoft GraphRAG, HippoRAG2), HDI achieves 88-94% attack success rate while modifying as few as 0.016% of auxiliary structures. Each modification affects up to 6.00 queries (Schema Leverage Ratio), demonstrating 1:N amplification unavailable to instance-level attacks. Manipulated structures evade perplexity and paraphrase defenses with over 99% evasion rate, as they remain linguistically coherent system-generated artifacts. These results reveal that auxiliary schema-level entities receive implicit trust without runtime validation, constituting a structural blind spot in current GraphRAG defenses. https://github.com/Jisung-Pacific/HDI-GraphRAG-Attack.

AI.tldr: 本文首次形式化GraphRAG中的"辅助模式级实体"攻击面，提出3S框架与Hop-Decayed Influence(HDI)攻击，仅修改0.016%的辅助结构即可实现88-94%攻击成功率，并具备1:N放大效应与超过99%的防御规避率。
AI.motivation: GraphRAG在离线索引阶段构建语义摘要、层级边、预计算分数等辅助结构，这些结构直接决定查询时的检索优先级。既有攻击仅针对实例级组件（节点、边、三元组），忽略了这些模式级结构，而它们被系统隐式信任且缺乏运行时验证，构成安全盲区。
AI.method: 将辅助模式级实体形式化为新的攻击面，提出3S框架（Semantics语义、Structure结构、Scoring评分）进行系统利用。核心方法HDI（Hop-Decayed Influence）通过查询感知的影响力传播识别高影响目标，并在索引完成后篡改其辅助结构。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA两个基准和Microsoft GraphRAG、HippoRAG2两种架构上，HDI以低至0.016%的辅助结构修改量达到88-94%的攻击成功率；单次修改最多影响6.00个查询（Schema Leverage Ratio），实现实例级攻击不具备的1:N放大效应；被篡改结构因保持语言连贯性，对困惑度与复述防御的规避率超过99%。
AI.conclusion: 辅助模式级实体因缺乏运行时验证而被隐式信任，构成当前GraphRAG防御中的结构性盲点；该攻击面具有低修改量、高成功率、强放大与强隐蔽性等特点，需引起重视。

title: Real-time Optimization of Simulation and Data Processing Pipelines for Experiments on Exascale Computing Platforms
summary: Current and next-generation large-scale experiments, especially in high-energy physics and cosmology, involve increasing volumes of data that require exascale computing power to analyze and model. Exascale machines present challenges for workflow scaling and efficient resource usage. We propose a multi-stage task scheduling approach for optimizing resource usage for these workflows. We demonstrate task scheduling for an example Monte Carlo simulation pipeline from the Short-Baseline Near Detector (SBND), and present theoretical and numerical tools for modeling task scheduling in these workflows that can be used to identify optimal scheduling strategies and choose resources for a given problem size.

AI.tldr: 本文针对高能物理与宇宙学等大规模实验在百亿亿次级(exascale)计算下面临的工作流扩展与资源利用难题，提出一种多阶段任务调度方法，并以短基线近探测器(SBND)的蒙特卡洛模拟流水线为例进行演示；同时给出用于建模此类工作流任务调度的理论与数值工具，以识别最优调度策略并按问题规模选择资源。
AI.motivation: 当前及下一代大规模实验（尤其高能物理与宇宙学）数据量持续增长，需借助exascale算力进行分析与建模；而exascale机器在工作流扩展和资源高效利用方面存在挑战，因此需要优化此类工作流的资源使用方法。
AI.method: 提出一种多阶段(multi-stage)任务调度方法，用于优化工作流的资源使用；以SBND的蒙特卡洛模拟流水线为示例开展任务调度；并构建理论与数值工具，对此类工作流中的任务调度进行建模，以识别最优调度策略并为给定问题规模选择资源。
AI.result: 在SBND蒙特卡洛模拟流水线上演示了任务调度；所提出的理论与数值工具可用于识别最优调度策略，并针对给定问题规模进行资源选择。
AI.conclusion: 多阶段任务调度方法结合相应建模工具，可有效应对exascale环境下大规模科学工作流的调度与资源配置问题，为优化资源利用提供可行途径。

title: SCION: Scene Composition with Instanced Neural Primitives
summary: Real-world scenes are compositional: bricks, blades of grass, pebbles, and tree leaves recur across human-built and natural environments. Existing neural scene representations model these elements independently. Most 3D Gaussian Splatting and follow-up abstraction and compression methods treat each element as unique, fitting millions of independent Gaussians per scene. Prior methods like Splat and Replace fit template objects, but they require mostly manual selection of repeated elements. As a result, these representations store redundant parameters and provide weak manipulation handles for downstream tasks. We introduce SCION, a hier- archical compositional scene representation that replaces independent Gaussians with a compact vocabulary of reusable primitives and lightweight world-space instances that place transformed copies throughout the scene. We fit this represen- tation to multi-view captures via a joint optimization over discrete and continuous scene parameters, combining two-level densification over splats and instances with an adversarial loss that preserves detail across shared primitives. The recovered structure yields a compact, controllable representation while maintaining high quality even at 1.2 MB. SCION achieves rate-distortion favorable to existing Gaussian compression methods, and it enables instance-level scene editing and animation without retraining. Our results show that neural scene representations need not memorize scenes as independent primitives; they can discover reusable parts. Project webpage: https://light.princeton.edu/SCION

AI.tldr: SCION 提出层次化组合式场景表示，用可复用图元词汇表与轻量世界空间实例替代独立高斯，实现紧凑可控的高质量场景重建。
AI.motivation: 真实场景具有组合性，砖块、草叶、卵石、树叶等元素在环境中反复出现；但现有神经场景表示（如3D高斯泼溅及其抽象与压缩方法）将每个元素视为独特个体，为每个场景拟合数百万个独立高斯，导致参数冗余、操作能力弱，而Splat and Replace等方法又依赖大量人工选择重复元素。
AI.method: SCION 构建层次化组合式场景表示：用紧凑的可复用图元词汇表（vocabulary of primitives）加轻量世界空间实例（world-space instances）替换独立高斯，实例通过变换把图元副本放置到场景各处。对多视角捕获进行离散与连续场景参数的联合优化，结合泼溅与实例的两级致密化（two-level densification），并使用对抗损失在共享图元间保持细节。
AI.result: 恢复出的结构紧凑且可控，在仅1.2 MB下仍保持高质量；在率失真性能上优于现有高斯压缩方法，并支持无需重训练的实例级场景编辑与动画。
AI.conclusion: 神经场景表示无需将场景记忆为独立图元，而是可以发现并复用可重复部件，从而兼顾压缩效率与下游可操作性。

title: Counterexample Generation via Per-Theorem Symbolic Verifiers: When Imitation Hurts and Reinforcement Repairs
summary: Large language models often solve a theorem forward yet fail to disprove a closely related false one: a falsification gap that supervised fine-tuning does not close and can actively worsen. We frame counterexample generation as constrained witness emission against a deterministic per-theorem Python verifier, and release SymCE, a corpus of 4,707 false undergraduate-algebra and real-analysis conjectures, each paired with executable verifiers. The verifier also serves as the reward function, making SymCE a training environment. Training Qwen3-4B with SFT followed by GRPO under this oracle reveals an imitation trap: counterexample-only SFT collapses true-theorem recognition from 0.27 to 0.00, while RLVR with a sparse outcome-only reward repairs this and exceeds the base, to 0.66. The collapse replicates across four seeds and on Gemma-3-4B. Sparse and dense rewards yield statistically indistinguishable in-domain success yet diverge by 33 points on a held-out calibration probe, a dissociation we trace to the partial-credit term. Our 4B model outperforms every evaluated 7B open-weights math specialist, remains competitive with six frontier commercial APIs, and transfers under unchanged prompting to GSM8K, MATH-500 and MMLU-college-math. A human audit of 177 verifier decisions finds 97.7% accuracy. Code, data, verifier modules and annotations: https://github.com/ce-rlvr/SymCE.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"反证缺口"问题，发布含4,707道假猜想及配套确定性Python验证器的SymCE语料，并将其作为强化学习环境训练Qwen3-4B，发现模仿陷阱与奖励稀疏性的解离现象。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常能正向证明定理，却无法反证关系密切的假命题，形成"反证缺口"；监督微调不仅无法弥补，反而会加剧该缺陷，因此需要可验证的反例生成训练框架。
AI.method: 将反例生成建模为针对逐定理确定性Python验证器的约束见证输出；构建SymCE语料（4,707道本科代数与实分析假猜想，各配可执行验证器）；验证器兼任奖励函数；对Qwen3-4B先SFT后GRPO训练，对比稀疏与稠密奖励、仅反例SFT与RLVR等设置。
AI.result: 反例-only SFT使真定理识别率从0.27崩塌至0.00，跨四个随机种子及Gemma-3-4B复现；稀疏结果奖励的RLVR修复该问题并提升至0.66，超过基座。稀疏与稠密奖励在域内成功率无显著差异，但在留出校准探针上相差33个点。4B模型超越所有评测的7B开源数学专用模型，与六个前沿商用API保持竞争力，并零样本迁移至GSM8K、MATH-500与MMLU-college-math。177例人工审计验证器决策准确率97.7%。
AI.conclusion: 反例生成可作为可验证的强化学习环境；纯模仿式SFT损害真定理识别，稀疏结果奖励的RLVR更稳健；稀疏/稠密奖励的解离源于部分信用项，提示奖励设计需谨慎。

title: SoTa: Soft Tactile Skins for Dexterous Manipulation
comment: The first three authors contributed equally. Project website: https://sota-skin.github.io
summary: A growing body of work suggests that tactile sensing gives robot policies contact information that complements vision in dexterous manipulation. However, visuo-tactile robot data remains scarce: dexterous demonstrations require teleoperating robots, which limits dataset scale. Human demonstrations are far cheaper to collect and offer a path to scale this data, but only if human and robot hands carry tactile sensors with corresponding signals. This requires sensors that conform to different hand geometries, cover the full hand, and share a common layout across embodiments. We present SoTa, a low-cost capacitive tactile skin that provides full-hand coverage on humans and robots while preserving a shared layout of 202 taxels across corresponding finger and palm regions. Our multilayer design with fabric electrodes enables in-house fabrication of thin, soft skins with customizable geometry for under $10 in materials per skin. The sensor retains over 97% of its initial response span after 10,000 loading-unloading cycles with traces retaining continuity through 1,280 tight-fist folding cycles. The shared taxel layout supports human-robot co-training with a common tactile encoder and no learned cross-sensor mapping. Across three contact-rich manipulation tasks, tactile observations improve in-distribution success over vision-only policies. With a fixed robot demonstration budget, adding human demonstrations more than doubles mean success across eight evaluation conditions, from 22.8% to 45.9%, improving success in all five out-of-distribution conditions. We plan to open-source the resources needed to fabricate and operate these skins.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SoTa——一种低成本电容式触觉皮肤，可为人类与机器人手部提供全覆盖、跨本体共享202个taxel布局的触觉传感，从而实现人-机器人触觉数据协同训练，在多项接触密集操作任务中显著提升策略成功率。
AI.motivation: 视觉-触觉机器人数据稀缺：灵巧操作演示依赖遥操作，限制了数据集规模。人类演示采集成本低得多，有望扩大数据规模，但前提是人类与机器人手部需配备具有对应信号的触觉传感器，这要求传感器能适配不同手部几何形状、覆盖全手，并在不同本体间共享统一布局。
AI.method: 设计SoTa多层电容式触觉皮肤，采用织物电极，材料成本低于10美元/片，可定制几何形状、薄而柔软、可自主制作；在人类与机器人对应手指及手掌区域保持202个taxel的共享布局，支持使用统一触觉编码器进行人-机器人协同训练，无需学习跨传感器映射。通过10,000次加载-卸载循环与1,280次握拳折叠循环测试其耐久性。
AI.result: 传感器在10,000次加载-卸载循环后仍保留超过97%的初始响应范围；经1,280次紧握拳折叠循环后轨迹保持连续性。在三个接触密集操作任务中，触觉观测相比纯视觉策略改善了分布内成功率；在固定机器人演示预算下，加入人类演示使八种评估条件的平均成功率从22.8%提升至45.9%（提升逾一倍），并在全部五种分布外条件下均有所提升。
AI.conclusion: SoTa提供了一种低成本、跨本体的共享布局触觉皮肤，可使人类演示直接用于机器人策略协同训练，显著缓解触觉数据稀缺问题并提升操作性能；作者计划开源相关制作与使用资源。

title: State-Space Unlearning for Non-Stationary Bias in Land Surface Forecasting
summary: Operational land surface forecasting systems built on Mamba-family Structured State Space Models absorb non-stationary confounding events (unrecorded irrigation booms, dam-operation shifts, sensor recalibrations) into their state-transition matrices, silently biasing NDVI, LST, and crop phenology predictions long after the physical cause ends. This paper introduces SSU-LSF (State-Space Unlearning for Land Surface Forecasting), the first machine-unlearning framework purpose-built for geoscientific Mamba-based SSMs. We develop EKFac influence functions specialized to the Mamba state matrices via a closed-form matrix-exponential gradient, use spectral-radius-weighted elbow thresholding to localize a temporal confounding footprint $Φ$, and apply Hessian-free projected gradient ascent within a KL-divergence trust region augmented by spatial total-variation (TV) regularization. Proposition 1 establishes that residual confounding is bounded by $\mathcal{O}\big((1-ρ(\bar{A})^{T_c})/((1-ρ(\bar{A}))μ)\big)$, which grows with the window length $T_c$. Across three heterogeneous benchmarks and eleven baselines, SSU-LSF achieves confounding reduction rates of $0.773$ (CropHarvest), $0.821$ (NDVI-LST), and $0.859$ (ERA5), with worst-case clean-domain RMSE degradation of $4.2\%$ on ERA5, converging in 3--5 epochs at $8.4\times$ lower GPU-cost per unlearning request than full retraining. Code: https://github.com/Anidipta/SSU-LSF

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SSU-LSF，首个面向地学Mamba状态空间模型的机器遗忘框架，用于消除地表预测模型中的非平稳混杂事件影响。
AI.motivation: 运行中的地表预测系统基于Mamba族结构化状态空间模型，会将未记录的灌溉激增、水坝调度变化、传感器重校准等非平稳混杂事件吸收进状态转移矩阵中，从而在物理成因消失后仍长期隐性偏置NDVI、LST和作物物候预测。
AI.method: 提出SSU-LSF框架：(1) 基于闭式矩阵指数梯度，为Mamba状态矩阵构建EKFac影响函数；(2) 用谱半径加权肘部阈值法定位时间混杂足迹Φ；(3) 在KL散度信赖域内执行无Hessian投影梯度上升，并加入空间全变差(TV)正则化。
AI.result: 在3个异构基准、11个基线上，混杂削减率分别为CropHarvest 0.773、NDVI-LST 0.821、ERA5 0.859；ERA5上最差干净域RMSE退化仅4.2%；3–5个epoch收敛，单次遗忘请求GPU开销比全量重训低8.4倍。
AI.conclusion: SSU-LSF是首个面向地学Mamba SSM的机器遗忘框架，理论上给出残余混杂的界（随窗口长度T_c增长），实验证明其能高效、低代价地削减混杂并保持干净域性能。

title: Contrastive Neural Embeddings Reveal Individual Traits Beyond Conversational Role
summary: Contrastive representation learning is increasingly used to recover low-dimensional structure from neural recordings, but its output is typically validated by decoding accuracy rather than by the geometry of the manifold it produces. We apply CEBRA to EEG recorded from dyads in conversation, and analyze the resulting embedding, which training constrains to the 2D sphere. Labels describing the dyads, including the absolute difference between partners' autism-quotient scores, decode well above chance (0.77 against a 0.55 majority baseline for binary AQ magnitude; 0.44 against 0.25 for the six-class $|Δ$AQ$|$ partition). However, the two permutation controls have notable differences in results: permuting labels over a frozen embedding yields p = 0.001, whereas retraining the encoder under each permutation yields p = 0.50. Only the latter tests the label rather than the geometry. Consistent with this, spherical mixture structure and per-class dispersion track identity rather than autism trait differences in dyads; frequency-band and non-oscillatory activity ablation controls do not change the results. However, participant-level model does separate from its identity-aware null (p = 0.0099) while speaker-versus-listener role analysis performs at chance in the same embedding, indicating a manifold organized by individual -- and, in contrast with current neurolinguistics models, almost invariant to speaking vs. listening. Based on these results, we suggest that retraining-based nulls should be the default for grouped-data contrastive embeddings.

AI.tldr: 该研究将对比学习模型CEBRA应用于对话双人组的EEG数据，对其二维球面嵌入进行几何分析。解码准确率虽高于基线，但通过重训练式置换检验发现标签效应不显著（p=0.50），流形结构实际由个体身份而非自闭特质组织。
AI.motivation: 对比表征学习在神经记录中用于恢复低维结构，但其输出通常仅用解码准确率验证，而非检验所生成流形的几何性质。作者希望以几何视角重新审视这类嵌入的有效性和所反映的真实结构。
AI.method: 将CEBRA应用于对话双人组的EEG，训练约束嵌入位于二维球面。使用描述双人组的标签（含伙伴AQ分绝对差的二分类及六分类划分）进行解码，并对比两种置换控制：在冻结嵌入上置换标签 vs 对每个置换重训练编码器。进一步通过球面混合结构、各类别离散度、频带与非振荡活动消融、参与者层面模型及说话者-听者角色分析进行检验。
AI.result: 标签解码高于基线（二分类AQ幅度0.77 vs 0.55；六分类|ΔAQ| 0.44 vs 0.25）。两种置换控制结果差异显著：冻结嵌入上置换标签p=0.001，而重训练编码器下p=0.50。球面混合结构与各类别离散度追踪身份而非自闭特质差异，频带及非振荡活动消融不改变结果。参与者层面模型显著区分于身份感知零假设（p=0.0099），而说话者-听者角色分析处于随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 所得到的对话EEG流形由个体身份组织，且几乎对说话与倾听不变，这与当前神经语言学模型形成对比。作者建议在分组数据的对比嵌入中，应将重训练式零假设作为默认检验方法。

title: CORE: COverage CAlibration and Evicted-Mass REdistribution for KV Cache
summary: Long-context decoding is increasingly constrained by key--value (KV) cache memory and bandwidth. Existing fixed-budget compression methods typically separate retention from compensation, while a retention ranking specifies neither discarded attention mass nor the direction of induced output error. We start from an exact factorization: eviction error equals evicted attention mass times the directional gap between the evicted centroid and retained output, highlighting the importance of set-level coverage in retention and mass-preserving memory writing. We introduce CORE COverage Calibration and Evicted-Mass REdistribution for KV Cache, which distills an offline allocation combining query utility and log-determinant coverage into a lightweight cache-aware indexer. At inference, one calibrated distribution drives both channels: its Top-$B$ ordering retains complementary KV states, while its excluded allocation mass and conditional weights parameterize latent-memory writes without a separate write-weight predictor or online log-determinant evaluation. Our analysis provides a four-term pre-compensation error certificate, characterizes non-additive coverage interactions, and establishes mass-independent write stability with hierarchical bounds through recurrent and query-adaptive normalization. Across three backbones, CORE exceeds the strongest RULER baseline by up to 3.78 points at 90\% compression; LongBench and repeated-eviction evaluations further demonstrate strong effectiveness and decoding efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CORE，通过覆盖校准与淘汰质量重分配实现KV缓存压缩，将保留与补偿统一由单一校准分布驱动，在90%压缩率下显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 长上下文解码受限于KV缓存的内存与带宽。现有固定预算压缩方法将"保留(retention)"与"补偿(compensation)"分离处理，而保留排序既未刻画被淘汰的注意力质量，也未指明由此导致的输出误差方向，缺乏对集合级覆盖与质量保持写入的考量。
AI.method: 从精确分解出发：淘汰误差等于被淘汰注意力质量乘以被淘汰质心与保留输出之间的方向差距。据此提出CORE(Coverage Calibration and Evicted-Mass Redistribution)：离线蒸馏一个结合查询效用与对数行列式覆盖的分配方案，得到轻量级缓存感知索引器；推理时用单一校准分布同时驱动两个通道——Top-B排序保留互补KV状态，被排除的分配质量与条件权重参数化潜记忆写入，无需单独的写权重预测器或在线对数行列式评估。
AI.result: 在三种骨干模型上，90%压缩率下CORE较最强RULER基线提升最高3.78分；LongBench与重复淘汰评测进一步验证了有效性与解码效率。理论分析给出四项预补偿误差证书，刻画非加性覆盖交互，并通过循环与查询自适应归一化建立具有分层界的质量无关写入稳定性。
AI.conclusion: CORE通过集合级覆盖保留与淘汰质量重分配的统一框架，将保留与补偿耦合于单一校准分布，兼顾压缩保真度、写入稳定性与解码效率，为长上下文KV缓存压缩提供了新的理论与实证方案。

title: Keep It CALM: Analyzing the Limits of Global Unsafety in Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Training-free safeguards for text-to-image generation often rely on a reusable safety signal, such as an unsafe direction or global toxic subspace, applied broadly across prompts. We provide a controlled geometric analysis of this global-unsafety assumption and reveal a consistent coverage-selectivity trade-off: compact unsafe subspaces fail to cover heterogeneous unsafe semantics, whereas broader aggregation increasingly distorts safety-adjacent benign prompts. Motivated by this finding, we propose CALM (Counterfactual Adaptive Local Modulation), a training-free safeguard that replaces uniform global removal with prompt-local counterfactual correction. Using matched unsafe-benign anchors, CALM routes each prompt to active unsafe categories, minimally edits only violating token representations toward the safe side, and suppresses positively aligned unsafe residual components. Across broad evaluation, CALM significantly improves unsafe content suppression while preserving benign utility, demonstrating that local counterfactual correction provides a more selective alternative to global unsafe signal removal.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示全局不安全假设存在"覆盖度—选择性"权衡，提出免训练的CALM方法，通过提示局部的反事实校正替代全局统一去除，实现更优的不安全抑制与良性效用保持。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练文本到图像安全防护依赖可复用的全局安全信号（如不安全方向或全局有害子空间），并将其广泛施加于所有提示。作者希望对该"全局不安全"假设进行受控的几何分析，揭示其内在局限。
AI.method: 作者首先对全局不安全假设进行受控几何分析，发现存在一致的覆盖度—选择性权衡：紧凑的不安全子空间无法覆盖异构的不安全语义，而更宽泛的聚合会扭曲与安全相邻的良性提示。据此提出CALM（反事实自适应局部调制），用提示局部的反事实校正取代统一的全局去除。CALM借助匹配的不安全—良性锚点，将每个提示路由到活跃的不安全类别，仅对违规的token表示做朝安全侧的最小编辑，并抑制正对齐的不安全残差分量。
AI.result: 在广泛评估中，CALM显著提升了不安全内容的抑制效果，同时保持了良性生成效用。
AI.conclusion: 局部反事实校正相比全局不安全信号去除更具选择性，是一种更优的免训练安全防护方案。

title: Unifying Privacy Accounting: Information Equivalence and Information Loss
summary: Differential privacy (DP) admits several notions, but the choice among them may affect both privacy analysis and utility. In this paper, we consider four mainstream curve-based privacy notions within a unified information-theoretic framework. For a fixed ordered pair of output distributions, we establish information equivalence among the two directional privacy profiles of $(\varepsilon,δ)$-DP, the pair of hypothesis-testing trade-off functions, and the extended privacy-loss distribution. The exact Rényi differential privacy (RDP) curve joins this equivalence class whenever it is finite at some order greater than one. Under this mild condition, choosing among these notions changes only their semantic interpretation and computational requirements. In contrast, taking the maximum of the directional privacy profiles or compressing the RDP curve into a single zero-concentrated differential privacy (zCDP) parameter can lose information. We quantify the information loss between the exact RDP curve and its zCDP bound for standard noise mechanisms. This gap is zero for Gaussian noise but generally positive for Gaussian-mixture, Laplace, discrete Gaussian, and Poisson-subsampled Gaussian mechanisms. Moreover, this gap grows linearly with the number of independently composed mechanisms. Our information-theoretic perspective has practical consequences. At the same certified privacy level, retaining the full RDP curve rather than using zCDP reduces the required noise variance by up to $45\%$ for Gaussian-mixture noise in workloads comparable in size to the American Community Survey. For DP-SGD on Fashion-MNIST under Poisson subsampling, an RDP-based privacy accountant improves test accuracy by up to $8.73$ percentage points compared to a zCDP-based accountant when both are calibrated to the same $(\varepsilon,δ)$ guarantee.

AI.tldr: 本文在统一的信息论框架下研究四类基于曲线的差分隐私概念，证明在固定输出分布有序对下，双向(ε,δ)-DP保密曲线、假设检验权衡函数对与扩展隐私损失分布信息等价，有限阶精确RDP曲线亦属同一等价类；而取方向曲线最大值或压缩为单一zCDP参数会损失信息，并以理论与实验量化该损失。
AI.motivation: 差分隐私存在多种定义，不同选择会影响隐私分析与效用，但其间关系缺乏统一刻画，尤其在何时不同概念可互换、何时会丢失信息尚不清楚。
AI.method: 以信息论框架统一刻画四类基于曲线的隐私概念；对固定输出分布有序对，证明双向(ε,δ)-DP隐私曲线、假设检验权衡函数对与扩展隐私损失分布的等价性，并将有限阶精确RDP曲线纳入等价类；分析取最大方向曲线与压缩为zCDP界所造成的信息损失，并针对标准噪声机制量化精确RDP曲线与zCDP界之差。
AI.result: 高斯噪声下该差值恰为零，而高斯混合、Laplace、离散高斯与泊松子采样高斯机制下一般大于零，且差值随独立组合机制数量线性增长。相同认证隐私水平下，保留完整RDP曲线相比zCDP可将高斯混合噪声所需方差降低最多45%（美国社区调查量级负载）；在Fashion-MNIST的DP-SGD泊松子采样场景下，RDP记账器较zCDP记账器在相同(ε,δ)保证下将测试准确率提升最多8.73个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 多类曲线型DP概念在温和条件下信息等价，仅语义解释与计算需求不同；但取最大值或压缩为单一zCDP参数确有信息损失，保留完整RDP曲线可在同等隐私保证下显著降低噪声并提升效用，具有实际价值。

title: Beaver: Elastic GPU Sharing between ML and Latency-Critical vRAN Workloads
