summary: Within the shared industry vision of AI-RAN, AI-and-RAN seeks to co-locate virtualized radio access network (vRAN) workloads and AI services on shared GPUs. This sharing is inherently asymmetric: vRAN workload is latency-critical, whereas the machine learning (ML) workload is a throughput-oriented, best-effort co-tenant. We present Beaver, a GPU sharing system that jointly manages compute and memory resources while protecting the vRAN's strict processing deadline. Beaver sizes the vRAN's streaming multiprocessor (SM) allocation from each slot's scheduled workload, repartitions SM allocations at slot granularity, and rewrites compiled ML kernels to yield HBM bandwidth during the vRAN's memory-critical phases. We implement Beaver and evaluate it using NVIDIA Aerial with heterogeneous multi-cell workloads, real-world cellular traces, production inference kernels, and full-stack LLM serving. On an H200 GPU, Beaver keeps the vRAN's p99.9 latency within its 1.5ms uplink deadline while retaining 74% of Llama-3.3-70B serving throughput. It also incurs no observed deadline misses under replayed cellular traces, protects a 375us downlink deadline, and generalizes to other GPUs including A100, GB10 and GH200.

AI.tldr: Beaver是一种GPU共享系统，通过联合管理计算与内存资源并重写ML内核，在共享GPU上同时运行vRAN与AI负载时保护vRAN的严格时延截止约束。
AI.motivation: 在AI-RAN的行业愿景下，AI-and-RAN希望将虚拟化无线接入网（vRAN）工作负载与AI服务共置于共享GPU上。但这种共享存在固有的不对称性：vRAN工作负载对时延极度敏感、有严格的截止期限，而机器学习工作负载是面向吞吐、尽力而为的共租户。如何在提升GPU利用率的同时不破坏vRAN的实时性，是亟待解决的核心问题。
AI.method: Beaver从三个方面联合管理资源：一是根据每个slot的调度负载来确定vRAN的SM（流多处理器）分配规模；二是以slot为粒度对SM分配进行重新划分；三是在vRAN的内存关键阶段，通过重写已编译的ML内核来让出HBM带宽。基于NVIDIA Aerial实现，并在异构多小区负载、真实蜂窝网络trace、生产推理内核以及全栈LLM服务上进行评测。
AI.result: 在H200 GPU上，Beaver将vRAN的p99.9时延控制在1.5ms上行截止期限内，同时保留74%的Llama-3.3-70B服务吞吐；在重放的蜂窝网络trace下未观察到截止期违约，并保护了375us的下行截止期限；此外可泛化到A100、GB10和GH200等其他GPU。
AI.conclusion: Beaver证明，通过计算与内存的联合、细粒度（slot级）资源管理，可在共享GPU上高效共存时延敏感的vRAN与吞吐导向的ML负载，在满足严格实时截止约束的同时保持较高的AI服务吞吐，并具备跨GPU平台的通用性。

title: SCOPE-4D: Endoscopic 4D Geometry Foundation Models
summary: Geometric understanding supports endoscopic navigation and robotic assistance, but learning reliable endoscopic geometry faces two challenges: scarce geometric annotations and ambiguity between camera motion and tissue deformation. We present SCOPE-4D, an endoscopic 4D geometry foundation model that jointly predicts camera parameters, dense geometry, and 3D tissue trajectories from monocular RGB video in a single forward pass. Our curation and annotation pipeline constructs SCOPE-5K, a collection of approximately 5,000 clips spanning real and synthetic gastrointestinal endoscopy and laparoscopy. The collection provides rich geometric supervision and includes newly collected phantom and real-colonoscopy evaluation sets. Geometric supervised fine-tuning on SCOPE-5K learns endoscopic priors that improve camera and depth estimation. Common--Residual Motion (CRM) further constrains local deformation relative to common tissue movement. Together with geometric supervision, CRM and trajectory supervision further improve camera and depth estimation over geometric fine-tuning alone while enabling dense 3D tissue tracking. Evaluations on public and newly collected benchmarks demonstrate strong in-domain and out-of-domain geometry, superior 3D tracking, and more stable long-sequence colon reconstruction. A blinded user study further supports the perceived reconstruction quality on real clinical video. Together, these results demonstrate the value of large-scale endoscopic supervision and motion constraints for joint geometry estimation and tissue tracking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCOPE-4D，一个可从单目RGB视频单次前向预测相机参数、密集几何与3D组织轨迹的内窥镜4D几何基础模型，并构建了约5000个片段的SCOPE-5K数据集，结合CRM运动约束实现联合几何估计与组织跟踪。
AI.motivation: 内窥镜几何理解对导航与机器人辅助至关重要，但面临两个挑战：几何标注稀缺，以及相机运动与组织形变之间的耦合歧义，导致可靠的内窥镜几何学习困难。
AI.method: 提出SCOPE-4D基础模型，单次前向联合预测相机参数、密集几何与3D组织轨迹；通过数据策管与标注流程构建SCOPE-5K（约5000个片段，涵盖真实与合成胃肠内镜及腹腔镜），并提供新采集的体模与真实结肠镜评测集；采用几何监督微学习内窥镜先验，引入Common–Residual Motion（CRM）约束局部形变相对于组织共同运动，并结合轨迹监督。
AI.result: 在公开与新建基准上展现出强域内与域外几何性能、更优的3D跟踪以及更稳定的长序列结肠重建；盲法用户研究进一步支持真实临床视频上的重建质量感知。CRM与轨迹监督在几何微调基础上进一步提升了相机与深度估计。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，大规模内窥镜监督与运动约束对联合几何估计与组织跟踪具有重要价值。

title: FinDialogLens: Event Extraction over Multi-Party Dialogue for Missed-Trade Identification in Financial Chatrooms
summary: Multi-party financial chatrooms are vital for sales-and-trading professionals, but their complexity makes manual recovery of missed trades infeasible: each Request for Quote (RFQ) is an event whose final price and trade outcome appear many messages after the RFQ-trigger message (the inquiry message), interleaved with concurrent RFQs from other participants. We cast this as event extraction (EE) over multi-party dialogue and present FinDialogLens, a hybrid LLM pipeline in which compact fine-tuned classifiers act as inference-time scaffolds: they detect RFQ-triggers and price/trade outcome metadata, an RFQ-Level Module segments per-event RFQ windows, and a Trade Engine fills argument roles. With GPT-4o, FinDialogLens reaches 92.1% and 94.3% accuracy on final price and trade outcome, respectively, outperforming full-chatroom CoT prompting methods; fine-tuned open-source LLMs with as few as 3B parameters achieve comparable performance with modest in-domain data. To make the LLM-based solution practical at scale, a difficulty-aware router balances cost and accuracy by allocating RFQs between a low-cost rule-based engine and the higher-performing LLM-powered Trade Engine, cutting LLM calls by 85% on final price while recovering half of the accuracy gap to FinDialogLens (GPT-4o), saving over $300/day at our 70,000-RFQ/day scale.

AI.tldr: 该论文将多边金融聊天室中的遗漏交易恢复问题形式化为多边对话上的事件抽取，提出混合LLM流水线FinDialogLens，通过微调小模型作为推理脚手架，结合路由机制在成本与准确率间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 多边金融聊天室对销售与交易人员至关重要，但其中每个请求报价（RFQ）的最终价格与交易结果往往出现在触发消息之后的多条消息中，且与其他参与者的并发RFQ交错，导致人工恢复遗漏交易不可行。因此需要自动化的事件抽取方法。
AI.method: 提出FinDialogLens混合LLM流水线：紧凑的微调分类器作为推理期脚手架，检测RFQ触发器及价格/交易结果元数据；RFQ-Level模块按事件切分RFQ窗口；Trade Engine填充论元角色。并引入难度感知路由器，将RFQ在低成本规则引擎与高性能LLM驱动的Trade Engine之间分配。
AI.result: 结合GPT-4o，FinDialogLens在最终价格和交易结果上分别达到92.1%和94.3%准确率，优于整段聊天室的CoT提示方法；仅3B参数的微调开源LLM在适度域内数据下即可达到相当性能。难度感知路由器在最终价格任务上减少85%的LLM调用，恢复了一半与FinDialogLens（GPT-4o）的准确率差距，在每日7万RFQ规模下每天节省超过300美元。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了以微调小模型为脚手架、LLM为核心的混合流水线在多边对话事件抽取中的有效性，并通过难度感知路由实现了大规模场景下的成本与准确率权衡，具备实际部署价值。

title: NEEDLEWORK: Offline Rewriting of Robot Data with Verified Local Stitches
comment: Submitted to ICLR 2027. Project page: https://needle-work.github.io
summary: Robot demonstrations may contain useful behavior even when individual episodes are inefficient or unsuccessful. Trajectory stitching offers a way to compose these behaviors into improved training data, but identifying useful connections and verifying their feasibility is difficult in high-dimensional robot data, where many prior methods rely on low-dimensional state representations. We introduce NEEDLE, an offline dataset-augmentation algorithm that addresses these challenges by adding short, verified action bridges between recorded observations in high-dimensional robot demonstrations. First, NEEDLE identifies and creates connections that bypass suboptimal detours, broaden action coverage, and augment the original dataset with failed trajectories, using only RGB images, proprioception, and episode-level outcomes, without new environment interaction or privileged object state. Next, we present a sampling technique that incorporates accepted bridges into policy training without synthesizing intermediate images or discarding the original demonstrations, allowing policies to learn alternative actions while retaining the original dataset's coverage. On real-robot tasks, NEEDLE improves success rate over the strongest baseline on each task by an average of 21 percentage points. Videos and supplementary materials are on https://needle-work.github.io/.

AI.tldr: NEEDLE是一种离线数据集增强算法，通过在已有机器人演示的高维观测之间添加经过验证的短动作桥接，将低效或失败的轨迹拼接为更有价值的训练数据，从而提升策略成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人演示数据中即使单条轨迹低效或失败，其中仍包含可用行为。轨迹拼接可将这些行为组合为更优训练数据，但在高维机器人数据中，识别有用连接并验证其可行性十分困难，许多已有方法依赖低维状态表示，限制了适用性。
AI.method: NEEDLE首先在记录的观测之间识别并创建连接，用以绕过次优绕路、扩大动作覆盖，并利用失败轨迹增强原始数据集；仅使用RGB图像、本体感知和回合级结果，无需新环境交互或特权物体状态。随后提出一种采样技术，将接受的桥接并入策略训练，而不合成中间图像、也不丢弃原始演示，使策略能学习替代动作同时保留原数据集的覆盖范围。
AI.result: 在真实机器人任务上，NEEDLE相对各任务最强基线，成功率平均提升21个百分点。
AI.conclusion: NEEDLE表明，仅凭高维视觉与本体感知即可在离线条件下识别并验证轨迹桥接，实现有效的数据集增强；其采样机制兼顾新动作学习与原始数据保留，在真实机器人任务中显著优于现有基线。

title: Nearest-neighbour baselines for fingerprint prediction from MS/MS spectra under different assumptions
summary: It has recently been shown that nearest-neighbour retrieval provides a strong baseline for molecular fingerprint prediction from MS/MS spectra, with several variants matching or outperforming current deep learning models (Khoo and Barzilay, 2026; Liu et al., 2026; Gupta et al., 2026). Importantly, "nearest neighbour" encompasses a family of retrieval methods that differ in the information assumed to be available at inference. In this report, we systematically compare several nearest-neighbour variants and show how these differing assumptions affect performance. Our goal is to establish stricter baselines that enable more rigorous benchmarking and better measure progress in this area.

AI.tldr: 该报告系统比较了多种最近邻检索变体在MS/MS谱分子指纹预测中的表现，揭示不同推理假设对性能的影响，旨在建立更严格的基线以促进该领域更严谨的基准评测。
AI.motivation: 近期研究表明最近邻检索是MS/MS谱预测分子指纹的强基线，但"最近邻"实为假设推理时可用信息不同的方法家族，这些不同假设对性能的影响此前未被系统考察。
AI.method: 对若干最近邻检索变体进行系统性对比实验，区分它们在推理阶段所假设可用信息的不同。
AI.result: 展示了不同最近邻变体的推理假设差异如何影响性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 应确立更严格的基线，以实现更严谨的基准评测，并更准确地衡量该领域的进展。

title: Autoregressive Frontier Expansion: Growing Trees with Graph Machine Learning
summary: Tree-like branching structures are common in nature, from botanical trees to neurons, blood vessels and respiratory trees. Their branching shape often reflects function, making structural modelling central to understanding how these systems work. Because acquiring real-world 3D data is often expensive or infeasible, realistic generative models are valuable for simulation and data augmentation. Existing morphology-specific models either constrain how topology is generated or rely on hand-tuned, mechanistic procedures. Generic 3D graph generators, by contrast, do not exploit or enforce the structure of trees. We propose Autoregressive Frontier Expansion, a generative framework that constructs trees through an iterative expansion process, simulating the biological growth of real trees. At each step, a flow-matching model parameterised by an SO(2)-equivariant GNN expands the frontier by predicting whether each active branch bifurcates or terminates. We evaluate our method on cortical neurons and botanical trees in unconditional, class-conditioned, and morphology-guided generation. Across both domains, the generated morphologies agree closely with the reference distributions and, in conditional experiments, with the specified targets.

AI.tldr: 提出 Autoregressive Frontier Expansion 生成框架，将树状结构建模为迭代生长过程，用 SO(2)-等变 GNN 参数化的流匹配模型预测前沿分支的分叉或终止，在皮层神经元和植物树的生成任务中逼近参考分布并符合条件目标。
AI.motivation: 树状分支结构广泛存在于自然界（植物、神经元、血管、呼吸道等），其形态反映功能，因此结构建模对理解这些系统至关重要。真实三维数据获取昂贵甚至不可行，故需要逼真的生成模型用于仿真与数据增强。现有形态学专用模型要么限制拓扑生成方式，要么依赖手工调参的机制化流程；通用三维图生成器则不利用也不施加树结构约束。
AI.method: 提出 Autoregressive Frontier Expansion 生成框架：通过迭代扩展过程构建树，模拟真实树木的生物学生长。每一步由以 SO(2)-等变图神经网络（GNN）参数化的流匹配（flow-matching）模型扩展前沿，预测每个活跃分支是分叉还是终止。在皮层神经元与植物树两个域上进行无条件生成、类别条件生成与形态引导生成实验。
AI.result: 在皮层神经元和植物树两个域中，生成形态与参考分布高度吻合；在条件实验中，生成结果与指定目标高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将树结构先验与表达力强的生成建模相结合，兼顾拓扑生长的生物合理性，跨域验证表明其在无条件与条件生成任务中均有效，可作为树状生物结构的通用生成模型。

title: An Adaptive Heterogeneous Architecture for High-Ratio, High-Throughput Lossless Compression
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Under submission to Data Compression Conference (DCC 2027)
summary: Modern lossless data compression enforces an acute dichotomy: industrial streaming codecs (e.g., Zstandard) prioritize throughput (10 to 1000 MiB/s) at the expense of compression density, while context-mixing algorithms achieve superior ratios at unusable serial speeds (0.1 to 1 MiB/s). We present GPX, an adaptive heterogeneous compression architecture for structured data streams. While optimized for high-throughput enterprise and scientific large-block workloads (>= 4 MiB), GPX operates transparently across arbitrary stream lengths down to sub-kilobyte inputs (N >= 256 B). GPX combines a sub-15-microsecond native structural decision probe, GPU-native reversible domain transforms, AVX2 multi-hypothesis sequence optimization, and adaptive entropy boundaries. On the canonical Silesia benchmark (202.12 MiB) under a preregistered 7-repeat Median+IQR protocol (W = 6 workers), GPX Track A produces standard RFC 8878-compliant .zst streams that compress to 56.27 MiB at 235.41 MiB/s with native line-speed decompression (3074.27 MiB/s on unmodified libzstd), establishing non-domination among evaluated RFC 8878-compatible configurations. GPX Track B achieves 54.49 MiB at 259.76 MiB/s (CI [250.7, 287.6]), establishing an empirical Pareto frontier point and dominating Stock Levels 8-14. GPX Track A+B achieves 54.46 MiB at 191.90 MiB/s (CI [177.8, 206.7]), strictly dominating official Stock Zstandard Levels 10-14 under non-overlapping 95% Bootstrap confidence intervals (182.18 KB smaller than Level 14 and 1.15x to 18.70x faster than Levels 10-14). Zero-tuning out-of-sample generalization is confirmed across Canterbury (-0.650%), Calgary (-0.124%), and a 102.45 MB modern compiled binary (-0.246%), while enwik8 (+0.084%) documents the authentic failure mode of splitter over-segmentation. All outputs are 100% SHA-256 bit-exact round-trip verified.

AI.tldr: GPX是一种面向结构化数据流的自适应异构压缩架构，通过原生结构探测、GPU域变换、AVX2多假设优化和自适应熵边界，在保持高吞吐的同时逼近甚至优于上下文混合算法的压缩密度，兼容RFC 8878。
AI.motivation: 现有无损压缩存在尖锐二分：工业流式编码器（如Zstandard）追求吞吐但压缩密度低，上下文混合算法压缩比高但速度极慢（0.1–1 MiB/s）。作者希望弥合这一吞吐与密度之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: GPX结合四个组件：亚15微秒的原生结构决策探针、GPU原生可逆域变换、AVX2多假设序列优化、自适应熵边界；对高吞吐大块工作负载优化（>=4 MiB），同时可透明处理小至256 B的输入。
AI.result: 在Silesia基准（202.12 MiB，7次重复Median+IQR，W=6）上：Track A生成RFC 8878兼容.zst，压缩至56.27 MiB、速度235.41 MiB/s，原版libzstd解压3074.27 MiB/s；Track B为54.49 MiB、259.76 MiB/s，支配Stock Level 8-14；Track A+B为54.46 MiB、191.90 MiB/s，在非重叠95% Bootstrap置信区间下严格支配Stock Level 10-14（比Level 14小182.18 KB，比Levels 10-14快1.15x–18.70x）。跨集泛化：Canterbury -0.650%、Calgary -0.124%、现代编译二进制 -0.246%，enwik8 +0.084%（暴露分割过分割失败模式）。所有输出均经SHA-256逐位往返验证。
AI.conclusion: GPX在RFC 8878兼容配置中实现非支配，并在Pareto前沿上取得经验点，同时保持工业级吞吐与高压缩密度，验证了异构架构弥合吞吐-密度鸿沟的可行性。

title: Choosing Before Acting: Comparative Value Estimation for Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) rely on long-horizon tool invocation sequences for complex tasks, where each invocation can alter the task state and condition subsequent decisions. In long-horizon tool use, final-outcome rewards provide weak credit assignment over long interaction traces. Step-level rewards can offer more targeted feedback, but obtaining reliable step supervision often requires human or LLM judgment, or additional rollouts to estimate the downstream effect of an intermediate decision. In this paper, we argue that effective tool-use agents should estimate the long-horizon value of a possible next tool invocation before executing it. This objective requires comparative supervision over alternative invocations under the same context, while logged trajectories only contain the invocation that was actually taken. Therefore, we propose Comparative Inference for Tool-use Agents (CITA). CITA trains a Comparative Inference Model (CIM) from paired signals that combine observed tool behavior, scalable supervision from a Bayesian tool-graph simulator, and semantic judgments from LLM-based comparison. The resulting CIM learns to estimate how likely a possible next tool invocation is to support final task success under the current context. Across three tool-use benchmarks and multiple backbone LLMs, CITA consistently improves Tool F1 and task success. Additional analysis shows that CIM learns accurate step-level value estimates for comparative tool choices.

AI.tldr: 提出CITA（对比推断工具使用智能体），通过训练对比推断模型（CIM）估计下一步工具调用对最终任务成功的贡献，在三个工具使用基准上一致提升Tool F1与任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 长程工具调用中，最终结果奖励对长交互轨迹的信用分配过于稀疏；而步级奖励虽能提供更针对性的反馈，却依赖人工/LLM评判或额外回放来估计中间决策的下游影响，代价高。因此需要一种能在执行前估计候选下一步调用长期价值的方法，而这类比较式监督在仅含已执行调用的日志轨迹中并不存在。
AI.method: 提出CITA，训练对比推断模型（CIM）。监督信号由三部分配对信号组合而成：真实观测到的工具行为、来自贝叶斯工具图模拟器的可扩展监督、以及基于LLM比较的语义判断。CIM据此学习在当前上下文下估计某个可能的下一步工具调用支持最终任务成功的概率。
AI.result: 在三个工具使用基准、多种基座LLM上，CITA均一致提升Tool F1与任务成功率。分析表明CIM能够为比较性工具选择学到准确的步级价值估计。
AI.conclusion: 通过对比式推断建模下一步工具调用的长期价值，可在无需额外回放的情况下实现有效的步级信用分配，为长程工具使用智能体提供可扩展的监督方案。

title: Mitigating Private Data Leakage in LLMs with Whiteout
summary:
Modern large language models (LLMs) are trained on massive, largely unfiltered datasets, including content scraped from nearly every accessible website and user inputs. As a result, LLMs often memorize and reproduce personally sensitive information (PSI) such as birth dates, phone numbers, and home addresses. This leads to significant privacy risks, particularly for high-profile individuals such as executives, politicians, and judges. Existing mitigations largely rely on machine unlearning. However, these methods often remove more information than needed, degrade model utility and safety, and are highly vulnerable to attacks.
  This paper presents Whiteout, a practical tool that, upon requests by individuals, prevents LLMs from regurgitating their genuine PSIs, by overwriting them using precise and carefully designed obfuscation samples. We evaluate Whiteout on modern LLMs of varying sizes and makers, including a widely-used OpenAI model. Results show that Whiteout effectively prevents disclosure of the targeted PSIs, has negligible impact on model utility and safety, and outperforms existing alternatives. We also test Whiteout against a wide range of countermeasures, from black-box attacks like jailbreaking to white-box adaptive attacks like relearning and quantization. Finally, we conclude with a discussion on the security and ethical implications of Whiteout.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Whiteout，一种应个人请求、通过精确设计的混淆样本覆盖LLM中真实个人敏感信息（PSI）的实用工具，从而阻止模型复述这些信息。在多款不同规模与厂商的现代LLM（含某广泛使用的OpenAI模型）上评估表明，Whiteout能有效防止目标PSI泄露，对模型效用与安全性影响可忽略，并优于现有替代方案；针对越狱等黑盒攻击及重学习、量化等白盒自适应攻击亦通过测试。
AI.motivation: LLM在大规模、基本未过滤的数据集上训练，包含几乎全部可访问网站与用户输入，因此常记忆并复述生日、电话、住址等个人敏感信息，对高管、公职人员、法官等公众人物构成显著隐私风险。现有主要缓解手段依赖机器遗忘，但往往删除过多信息、损害模型效用与安全性，且极易被攻击。
AI.method: Whiteout：在个人提出请求后，用精确且精心设计的混淆样本对真实PSI进行覆写（overwriting），以阻止LLM复述其真实个人敏感信息。评估覆盖不同规模与厂商的现代LLM，包括一款广泛使用的OpenAI模型；并针对黑盒攻击（如越狱）与白盒自适应攻击（如重学习、量化）进行鲁棒性测试。
AI.result: Whiteout能有效阻止目标PSI被披露，对模型效用与安全性影响可忽略，性能优于现有替代方案；在越狱等黑盒攻击和重学习、量化等白盒自适应攻击下仍表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: Whiteout是一种实用且有效的PSI保护工具，相比机器遗忘避免了过度删除与效用/安全损失，并具备较强抗攻击性；文末讨论了其在安全与伦理层面的影响。

title: Annotation-Driven Migration of CUDA Programs to Tenstorrent Blackhole
comment: Accepted at the Thirteenth Workshop on Accelerator Programming and Directives (WACCPD 2026)
summary: Tenstorrent Blackhole combines distributed local memories, explicit inter-core communication, and Tensix cores decoupling data movement from computation. CUDA offers a substantial HPC software base but leaves physical data placement and scheduling largely implicit. Migrating CUDA HPC kernels to Blackhole requires spatial mapping across cores and per-core coordination of compute and data-movement kernels. We present an MLIR-based compiler deriving data placement, inter-core communication, and tile computation from a statically shaped affine CUDA subset. Declarative annotations express choices not fixed by the source, including compute/DM operation placement and streaming granularity. We evaluate it on Gaussian elimination, five-point stencil, and symmetric rank-k update. Relative to our compiler's default realizations, the best measured configurations achieve a 4.2x speedup for BF16 Gaussian and 2.1-2.2x for FP32 Gaussian and Jacobi. A choice's performance impact can reverse with surrounding policies, precision, and loop schedule, motivating comparison of alternative per-core realizations rather than independent policy selection.

AI.tldr: 提出基于MLIR的编译器，从静态仿射CUDA子集自动推导数据放置、核间通信与tile计算，在Tenstorrent Blackhole上实现CUDA HPC内核迁移。
AI.motivation: Blackhole采用分布式本地存储、显式核间通信，且Tensix核将数据搬移与计算解耦；而CUDA虽拥有庞大HPC软件基础，却将物理数据放置与调度隐含化。将CUDA HPC内核迁移到Blackhole需跨核空间映射，并逐核协调计算与数据搬移内核（DM），缺乏自动化手段。
AI.method: 构建基于MLIR的编译器，输入为静态形状的仿射CUDA子集，自动推导数据放置、核间通信与tile计算；通过声明式注解表达源程序未固定的选择，包括计算/DM操作的放置位置与流式粒度。
AI.result: 在Gaussian elimination、five-point stencil与symmetric rank-k update上进行评测。相对于编译器默认实现，最佳实测配置在BF16 Gaussian上取得4.2x加速，FP32 Gaussian与Jacobi取得2.1–2.2x加速。某选择的性能影响会随周围策略、精度与循环调度而反转。
AI.conclusion: 性能受策略间耦合影响，不能独立选择各策略；应比较备选的逐核实现方案，而非孤立地选取单个策略。

title: Confidence-Controlled XAI Auditing for Pedestrian Detection under Domain Shift
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Vehicular Electronics and Safety (ICVES 2026). 6 pages, 4 figures
summary: Explainability is increasingly required for perception models in intelligent vehicles, yet whether explanations remain faithful under driving domain shift is still poorly understood. This work audits post-hoc explanations of a fixed YOLOv8s pedestrian detector across PIE and JAAD using ROI-based D-Deletion, frozen confidence terciles, rank-based tests, bootstrap intervals, and Holm correction. The audit shows that deletion-based faithfulness is strongly coupled to detection strength at explanation time, with Spearman correlations between 0.70 and 0.82 for D-RISE, making naive confidence-stratified comparisons unreliable. After controlling for detection strength within fixed f0 bins, D-RISE faithfulness remains domain-dependent in the central f0 range, with PIE showing higher D-Deletion than JAAD and Holm-adjusted significance. A non-perturbative EigenCAM baseline is less faithful than D-RISE but also exhibits score coupling, suggesting that the effect is not specific to D-RISE and is related to the deletion-based evaluation setup. These results motivate confidence-controlled XAI audits for safety-critical perception under domain shift.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了YOLOv8s行人检测器在PIE与JAAD域偏移下的事后解释忠实性，发现删除式忠实度与检测强度强耦合，控制检测强度后D-RISE忠实性仍具域依赖性。
AI.motivation: 智能车辆感知模型日益需要可解释性，但解释在驾驶域偏移下是否保持忠实尚不清楚，尤其在安全关键场景中缺乏可靠的审计方法。
AI.method: 在固定的YOLOv8s行人检测器上，跨PIE与JAAD数据集审计事后解释；采用基于ROI的D-Deletion、冻结置信度三分位、基于秩的检验、Bootstrap置信区间及Holm校正，并加入非扰动的EigenCAM基线进行对比。
AI.result: 删除式忠实度与解释时的检测强度强耦合，D-RISE的Spearman相关系数达0.70–0.82，使朴素置信度分层比较不可靠；在固定f0分箱控制检测强度后，D-RISE忠实性在中心f0区间仍具域依赖性，PIE的D-Deletion高于JAAD且经Holm校正显著；EigenCAM忠实性低于D-RISE但同样表现出得分耦合。
AI.conclusion: 该效应并非D-RISE特有，而与删除式评估设置相关；研究结果呼吁在域偏移下对安全关键感知开展置信度受控的可解释性审计。

title: CUEing User Simulators: Calibrated User Embeddings for Multi-Turn Benchmarking
summary: Recent benchmarks rely on user simulators to evaluate AI agents in multi-turn interaction. While existing simulation techniques demonstrate surface fidelity to human style and behavior, ecologically valid interactive benchmarking also requires alignment in when and how agents fail across simulated and real user populations. We find that existing simulators lack outcome calibration: agreement with observed success rates and failure patterns when real users interact with the same agent. We introduce Calibrated User Embeddings (CUE), a framework that both encodes observed sessions and samples continuous representations, then decodes them into persona commands to steer LLMs to act as user simulators without training. Through this, we evaluate user-conditioned replay of past sessions and aggregate metric agreement when sampling novel personas for the same tasks. On $τ^2$-Bench, CUEd simulators commit fewer simulator-attributed errors and more faithfully reproduce real-user agent failure modes, aggregate success rates, and outcomes for specific task-user pairs than other persona-based simulation methods. These gains coexist with competitive user fidelity as measured using metrics established in prior work. After being fit to mostly customer support interactions, the same CUEd simulators generalize to document creation, math tutoring, and casual conversation, and remain effective across different simulator LLMs without CUE retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出Calibrated User Embeddings (CUE)框架，通过编码真实会话、采样连续用户表征并解码为persona指令来无训练地驱动LLM用户模拟器，在τ²-Bench上实现更优的结果校准与真实用户失败模式复现。
AI.motivation: 现有依赖用户模拟器的多轮智能体评测虽在风格与行为上具备表面保真度，但缺乏"生态效度"所需的结果校准：即模拟器在与真实用户群体交互时，其智能体失败的出现时机与方式（成功率与失败模式）需与真实情况一致，而现有模拟器在此方面存在明显不足。
AI.method: CUE框架先编码已观测到的真实会话，从中采样连续的用户表征，再将其解码为persona命令以引导LLM充当用户模拟器，全程无需训练。基于此，作者评估了用户条件化的历史会话回放，以及在相同任务上采样新persona时的聚合指标一致性。
AI.result: 在τ²-Bench上，CUEd模拟器相比其他基于persona的模拟方法，产生更少的模拟器归因错误，更忠实地复现真实用户的智能体失败模式、聚合成功率及特定任务-用户配对的结果，同时保持与既往指标相当的竞品级用户保真度。且当主要拟合于客户支持交互后，同一CUEd模拟器可泛化到文档创作、数学辅导与日常对话，并跨不同模拟器LLM保持有效性而无需重新训练。
AI.conclusion: CUE通过结果校准弥补了现有模拟器在生态效度上的关键缺口，实现了高保真且可泛化的用户模拟，有助于提升多轮交互智能体评测的有效性与可靠性。

title: Filter-Aware Fine-Tuning for Safe Humanoid Whole-Body Tracking
summary: Safe whole-body motion is essential for deploying humanoid robots in unstructured environments. Modern humanoid control commonly separates reference specification from execution, with a planner, teleoperator, or motion generator providing a reference that a reinforcement-learning policy tracks through dynamically feasible whole-body control. Runtime safety filters, such as control barrier functions (CBFs), offer a promising approach for enforcing newly introduced constraints via interventions on the tracker's outputs. We show, however, that treating the tracking policy and safety filter independently induces fundamental mismatches, as filtering alters both the executed actions and the induced state distribution. We study this policy-filter interface through case studies that isolate dynamics, objective, and information mismatches, highlight their root causes, and use these insights to develop CoFiT (Constrained Filter-aware Tuning), a filter-aware fine-tuning method for pretrained trackers. Across diverse constraint scenes, CoFiT reduces violation time relative to filter-only training by 91% on TWIST2 and 21% on SONIC, while requiring smaller safety filter corrections. On Unitree G1 hardware, CoFiT reduces violation time by 83% for TWIST2 and completes every trial without operator intervention, whereas 50% of baseline trials require an operator stop. Together, these results provide actionable insights into policy-filter interactions and establish design principles for integrating learned trackers with runtime safety filters.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究人形机器人全身运动控制中跟踪策略与运行时安全滤波器（CBF）之间的接口不匹配问题，并提出滤波器感知微调方法 CoFiT。
AI.motivation: 在非结构化环境中部署人形机器人需要安全的全身边运动控制。当前主流框架将参考轨迹生成（规划器/遥操作）与执行（强化学习跟踪策略）分离，而运行时安全滤波器（如控制障碍函数 CBF）通过对跟踪器输出进行干预来强制新约束。然而，作者指出将跟踪策略与安全滤波器独立处理会引入根本性不匹配：滤波不仅改变执行的动作，还改变诱导的状态分布。
AI.method: 通过案例研究隔离并分析三类不匹配：动力学不匹配、目标不匹配和信息不匹配，揭示其根本原因。基于这些洞察提出 CoFiT（Constrained Filter-aware Tuning），一种针对预训练跟踪器的滤波器感知微调方法。
AI.result: 在多种约束场景中，CoFiT 相比仅滤波器训练将违规时间在 TWIST2 上降低 91%，在 SONIC 上降低 21%，同时需要更小的安全滤波修正。在 Unitree G1 硬件上，CoFiT 将 TWIST2 的违规时间降低 83%，且所有试验均无需操作员干预；而基线试验中有 50% 需要操作员急停。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了关于策略-滤波器交互的可操作洞察，并建立了将学习型跟踪器与运行时安全滤波器集成的设计原则。

title: Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling for Diffusion Draft Trees
summary: Speculative sampling accelerates diffusion generation by verifying inexpensive draft states in parallel while preserving the target law. Recent tree-based methods allocate the parallel compute budget more effectively than single-chain drafts, as demonstrated by Diffusion Greedy Rejection Sampling (D-GRS). D-GRS generates $K$ conditionally independent candidates per node, and sequentially tests them in their generation order. Yet the sampled candidates admit an informative ranking without additional target-model evaluations. To exploit this, we introduce Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling (RASS), a verification rule for speculative draft trees based on rank-aware list coupling. RASS orders draft candidates along the proposal-target mean displacement and samples a rank with weights optimized to minimize total variation between the selected-proposal and target laws. Finally, the selected candidate is maximally coupled with the target, with residual correction ensuring exact sampling for any choice of rank weights. We evaluate RASS on a Gaussian-mixture target, unconditional pixel-space generation on FFHQ, conditional generation on CIFAR-10, and latent diffusion with Stable Diffusion 3.5 using COCO2014 prompts. Measured by the ratio of standard to speculative sampling's target-model evaluation counts, RASS improves on D-GRS across the evaluated settings, with gains reaching approximately 20% on CIFAR-10 at matched compute budgets.

AI.tldr: RASS（Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling）提出一种基于"秩感知列表耦合"的扩散模型推测采样验证规则，通过利用草稿候选间已有的信息性排序与提议-目标均值位移，优化秩权重以最小化选中提议分布与目标分布的全变差，并在任意秩权重下通过残差修正保证精确采样，在多个任务上较 D-GRS 提升约 20%。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型采样需要大量目标模型评估，推测采样可并行验证廉价草稿状态以加速，而基于树的草稿（如 D-GRS）比单链草稿能更有效利用并行计算预算。但 D-GRS 逐序测试 K 个条件独立候选，忽略了这些候选本身蕴含的有用排序信息，未加利用。
AI.method: 提出 RASS 验证规则：针对推测草稿树，按提议-目标的均值位移对草稿候选排序，采样一个秩并采用经优化以最小化"选中提议分布"与目标分布全变差的秩权重；随后将选中候选与目标做最大耦合，并用残差修正保证对任意秩权重选择均精确采样。
AI.result: 在 Gaussian 混合目标、FFHQ 无条件像素空间生成、CIFAR-10 条件生成、以及以 COCO2014 提示的 Stable Diffusion 3.5 潜空间扩散上评估；以标准/推测采样目标模型评估次数之比衡量，RASS 在所有设置上优于 D-GRS，在匹配算力预算下 CIFAR-10 增益约 20%。
AI.conclusion: 利用草稿候选间无需额外目标评估即可获得的排序信息，可显著提升树式推测采样的验证效率；RASS 在保持精确采样性质的同时优于现有 D-GRS 基线，表明秩感知的耦合与权重优化是扩散加速的有效方向。

title: NeuroLens: Learning Latent Embeddings of Neural Semantics from Chronic Recordings
summary: Understanding how neural activity represents higher-order cognition and how these representations evolve over time has long been a central pursuit in neuroscience. However, current analytical tools cannot easily distinguish representational plasticity from recording instability in chronic neural recordings. Here, we introduce NeuroLens (Latent Embeddings of Neural Semantics), a self-supervised model based on the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) framework that learns denoised, semantically informative latents from chronic neural recordings. An adaptive encoder maps changing neural populations into a common latent space, while a temporal predictor learns structure that supports prediction of future latent states. By predicting in latent space, NeuroLens captures temporally predictable structure and reduces sensitivity to transient, recording-specific variability. Across chronic intracortical data in mice and humans, the learned representations improve decoding of decision-making and semantic task variables. Multi-day pretraining enables generalization to future sessions, rapid few-shot adaptation to unseen neural populations, and more stable decoding over time than state-of-the-art baselines. Together, these results establish NeuroLens as a new paradigm for studying how neural representations change during learning and over long timescales.

AI.tldr: NeuroLens 是一个基于 JEPA 的自监督模型，通过自适应编码器与时间预测器在潜空间中学习去噪且语义丰富的表征，实现对慢性神经记录中表征可塑性与记录不稳定性解耦。
AI.motivation: 理解神经活动如何表征高阶认知及其随时间演变是神经科学核心问题，但现有分析工具难以在慢性神经记录中区分表征可塑性与记录不稳定性。
AI.method: 提出 NeuroLens（Latent Embeddings of Neural Semantics），基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的自监督模型：自适应编码器将变化的神经种群映射到公共潜空间，时间预测器学习支持预测未来潜状态的结构；通过在潜空间预测捕获时间可预测结构，降低对瞬态、记录特异性变异的敏感度。
AI.result: 在小鼠和人类慢性皮层内数据上，学习到的表征提升了对决策与语义任务变量的解码性能；多日预训练可泛化到未来会话，能对未见神经种群进行快速少样本适应，并且随时间推移的解码稳定性优于当前最先进基线。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果确立了 NeuroLens 作为研究学习过程中及长时间尺度上神经表征变化的新范式。

title: Calibrating the Checksum: An Empirical False-Positive Bound for One-Sided ABFT on bfloat16 GEMM, and What It Fails to Catch
comment: 15 pages. Code, data, and pre-registration documents at https://github.com/GautamTalksDev/assay-gpu (tag v0.1.1-paper). Also available at doi:10.5281/zenodo.22054179
summary: Algorithm-based fault tolerance detects corrupted matrix multiplications by comparing a checksum of the product against a checksum recomputed from the factors, flagging a fault when the residual exceeds a threshold. The classical threshold is tau = Ku, derived from a dot-product rounding bound that requires Ku <= 0.01. At bfloat16 with contraction length K = 4096, Ku is approximately 32, so the bound does not hold and the threshold is not defined. Prior work therefore evaluated checksum ABFT only at float32. We supply the missing calibration. This paper is a characterization of a detector under an output-level, post-GEMM perturbation model; it is not a characterization of faults in silicon, and no rate reported here estimates fault incidence in deployed hardware. We fit a Generalized Pareto distribution to 7.99e7 clean per-row residuals and extrapolate a threshold at a per-GEMM false-positive rate of 1e-6, obtaining 3.1445e-6, which sits between the two clean sample maxima we observed. The independence assumption behind the per-GEMM conversion is checked empirically rather than asserted, at a variance ratio of 0.985 against a binomial reference. Against this threshold the detector catches 304 of 400 single exponent-bit flips (76%), failing a bar of 90% that was registered before any data was collected, and catches 0 of 600 low-mantissa flips. Detectability is invariant in K across a 16x range even though the clean noise floor falls as K^-0.4999: signal and floor scale together, so bit position governs detectability and contraction length does not. This falsified the mechanism the study was designed around. We report four registered predictions that failed, including that one, and four retractions of our own earlier findings, two of which were caught by pre-publication audit rather than by prediction. Code, data, and timestamped pre-registration documents are released.

AI.tldr: 本文为bfloat16下基于校验和的ABFT检测器提供缺失的阈值标定：拟合广义帕累托分布得到阈值3.1445e-6，但检测率仅76%（低于预设90%门槛），且对低尾数位翻转完全失效，可检测性由位位置而非收缩长度决定，推翻了研究预设机制。
AI.motivation: 经典ABFT阈值τ=Ku源自点积舍入界，需Ku≤0.01；而在bfloat16、K=4096时Ku≈32，界不成立、阈值无定义，因此此前工作只在float32下评估校验和ABFT。本文旨在补上这一标定空白。
AI.method: 在输出级、GEMM后扰动模型下（非硅片故障表征、不估计硬件故障率），对7.99e7个干净逐行残差拟合广义帕累托分布，外推达到每次GEMM假阳性率1e-6的阈值；并经验检验每次GEMM换算所需的独立性假设（相对二项参考的方差比0.985）。针对该阈值评估400次单指数位翻转与600次低尾数位翻转的检测情况，并在16倍范围内考察K的影响。
AI.result: 外推阈值为3.1445e-6，位于观测到的两个干净样本极大值之间。检测器捕获400次单指数位翻转中的304次（76%），未达到数据采集前登记的90%门槛；600次低尾数位翻转全部未检出（0/600）。可检测性在16倍K范围内不变，而干净噪声本底按K^-0.4999下降，信号与本底同步缩放，故位位置决定可检测性、收缩长度不影响。
AI.conclusion: 结果否定了研究最初设计的机制，报告四项失败的预注册预测（含上述机制）及四项对自身早期结论的撤回，其中两项由发表前审计而非预测发现。代码、数据与带时间戳的预注册文档均已公开。

title: World Editing: Intervening on Executable Worlds at Increasing Depth
summary: Interactive world models are increasingly capable of generating environments and acting within them, yet deliberately editing an existing executable world remains underexplored. We formulate world editing as intervening on an existing world while preserving properties that should remain unchanged, and introduce intervention depth as an axis describing how strongly an edit couples world entities, dynamics, and systems. We instantiate this capability through industry-grade game modding and introduce IGMWorld, together with IGMBench, a benchmark of 110 tasks and over 1.1K executable state and behavioral criteria across Minecraft and Terraria. The tasks span property, entity, dynamics, and system interventions and are evaluated through deterministic executability, behavioral, preservation, and visual checks. Frontier coding agents already exhibit substantial world-editing capability: the strongest configuration solves 78.2% of tasks under a strict task-level criterion, while criterion-level performance reaches 94.8%. Reliability generally decreases with intervention depth, and this pattern persists even among tasks with similar numbers of evaluation criteria. Most failed edits still build and load successfully, suggesting that the main difficulty is making the edited world behave as requested. Visual consistency remains a separate weakness, with all evaluated configurations below 50% joint visual pass rate. These results show that world editing is a distinct capability from world generation and interaction, and that executable games provide a practical testbed for studying it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"世界编辑"这一新能力框架，将其形式化为在保留不变属性的前提下对既有可执行世界进行干预，并引入干预深度概念；通过游戏模组（Minecraft、Terraria）实例化为IGMWorld与IGMBench基准，评测前沿编码智能体在该任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模型已能生成环境并在其中行动，但"刻意编辑一个既有可执行世界"的能力仍缺乏研究。作者希望将世界编辑与"世界生成""世界交互"区分开，建立系统化的问题定义、评测基准与度量维度，填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1）将世界编辑形式化为：对现有世界进行干预，同时保持本应不变的属性；提出"干预深度"作为描述编辑对世界实体、动力学与系统耦合强度的维度。2）以工业级游戏模组为载体实例化该能力，构建IGMWorld。3）构建IGMBench基准，包含Minecraft与Terraria中的110个任务、逾1.1K个可执行的状态与行为判据。4）任务覆盖属性、实体、动力学、系统四类干预，并通过确定性可执行性、行为、保持性与视觉四类检查进行评测。
AI.result: 前沿编码智能体已展现可观的世界编辑能力：最强配置在严格任务级判据下解决78.2%的任务，判据级表现达94.8%。可靠性总体上随干预深度增加而下降，且该趋势在判据数量相近的任务中依然存在。大多数失败编辑仍能成功构建与加载，说明主要难点在于让编辑后的世界按预期"行为"。视觉一致性是独立短板，所有被测配置的联合视觉通过率均低于50%。
AI.conclusion: 世界编辑是一种区别于世界生成与世界交互的独立能力，可执行游戏为其研究提供了实用的测试平台。当前智能体的核心瓶颈在于编辑后世界的行为正确性（而非可构建/可加载性）及视觉一致性，随干预深度增加可靠性下降的问题亟待解决。

title: Evaluating and Improving the Robustness of Large Language Models to Input Sequence Variations
summary: Large language models (LLMs) in production systems face prompt injections, trojans (backdoors), and manipulation of automatic quality metrics. This thesis develops models, methods, and algorithms for evaluating and improving LLM robustness to adversarial input sequence variations. We propose R_stab(f), a generative robustness metric based on the Jensen-Shannon divergence between per-step output distributions under small input perturbations. For localized attacks we prove V(h) <= 1 - R_class(h), where R_class(h) is the probability that a decision operator h keeps its decision under small perturbations. For non-localized attacks we propose a calibrated empirical model. For LLM-as-a-Judge systems we develop ASA, an adaptive evolutionary black-box attack that reaches an attack success rate (ASR) of up to 73.8%, with transfer between open models up to 62.6%. On Trojan Detection Challenge 2023 data (Pythia-1.4B), surrogate triggers reach REASR ~0.99 while recall of the true triggers is ~0.17 against a baseline of ~0.14. On SaTML CTF 2024 we systematize four classes of bypasses of multi-layer defenses, which reduce the ASR from 90% to 15-25%. Committees of 5-7 heterogeneous models reduce the ASR for Gemma-3-4B by 47-55 percentage points, to 19.3% with 7 models. For agentic systems based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), we propose AttestMCP, which attests tool calls with HMAC-protected packets at under 0.1 ms per call, and the Commit Boundary isolation pattern. On the MCPBench benchmark of 847 scenarios they reduce the average ASR from 53.7% to 12.4%. The methods are implemented in the JudgeGuard and TrojanArmor software suites and the MCPSec module.

AI.tldr: 本论文围绕大语言模型（LLM）在对抗性输入序列扰动下的鲁棒性评估与提升，提出生成式鲁棒性度量 R_stab(f)、非局部攻击的经验模型，并开发了针对 LLM-as-a-Judge、木马检测与多智能体协议（MCP）的多种攻击与防御方法。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的 LLM 面临提示注入、木马（后门）以及自动质量指标被操纵等威胁。现有工作缺乏对 LLM 在对抗性输入序列变化下鲁棒性的系统性度量与提升手段，因此本文旨在建立相应的模型、方法与算法。
AI.method: 1) 提出基于微小输入扰动下逐步输出分布间 Jensen-Shannon 散度的生成式鲁棒性度量 R_stab(f)；2) 对局部化攻击证明 V(h) ≤ 1 - R_class(h)，对非局部化攻击提出校准的经验模型；3) 针对 LLM-as-a-Judge 提出自适应进化黑盒攻击 ASA；4) 在 Trojan Detection Challenge 2023 与 SaTML CTF 2024 上系统化防御绕过方法；5) 针对 MCP 智能体系统提出 AttestMCP（HMAC 保护的工具调用认证，单次开销低于 0.1 ms）与 Commit Boundary 隔离模式。
AI.result: ASA 攻击成功率（ASR）最高达 73.8%，开源模型间迁移率达 62.6%；在 Pythia-1.4B 上代理触发器 REASR≈0.99，真实触发器召回率约 0.17（基线约 0.14）；SaTML CTF 2024 中系统化四类绕过使 ASR 从 90% 降至 15-25%；5-7 个异构模型委员会将 Gemma-3-4B 的 ASR 降低 47-55 个百分点，7 模型时为 19.3%；在 MCPBench（847 场景）上 AttestMCP 与 Commit Boundary 使平均 ASR 从 53.7% 降至 12.4%。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的鲁棒性度量、攻击与防御方法有效评估并提升了 LLM 系统对对抗性输入扰动的鲁棒性，相关方法已实现于 JudgeGuard、TrojanArmor 软件套件及 MCPSec 模块中。

title: ByteSplat: Efficient Distributed 3D Gaussian Splatting Training via Intra- and Inter-GPU communication reduction
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic scene reconstruction, but training large-scale scenes requires substantial memory and computation. Distributing training across multiple GPUs increases available memory capacity, yet its performance is strictly constrained by data movement. We identify two dominant bottlenecks: repeated off-chip memory accesses during forward and backward rasterization, and inter-GPU communication of partial Gaussian gradients. To address these bottlenecks, we present ByteSplat, a distributed 3DGS training framework that jointly reduces intra- and inter-GPU data movement. First, ByteSplat fuses forward rasterization and backward rasterization into a single GPU kernel, retaining intermediate results on-chip to eliminate redundant off-chip transfers. Second, to alleviate the increased on-chip storage by fused rasterization, ByteSplat introduces hardware-aware pruning that considers both rendering quality and per-tile shared-memory constraints, increasing the overall performance of fused execution. Lastly, ByteSplat exploits gradient sparsity to eliminate zero partial gradients from inter-GPU communication. GPU-efficient encoder and decoder kernels compact the remaining records and directly aggregate the received gradients on their owner GPUs, reducing both communication volume and local aggregation overhead. We evaluate ByteSplat across six datasets. Compared with the baseline, ByteSplat reduces intra-GPU off-chip traffic and backward inter-GPU communication volume by 63.4% and 65.8%, respectively. On eight GPUs, ByteSplat achieves up to 6.1$\times$ training speedup while preserving reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: ByteSplat是一个分布式3DGS训练框架，通过融合前向/后向光栅化、硬件感知剪枝和梯度稀疏通信压缩，联合降低GPU内与GPU间的数据移动。
AI.motivation: 大规模3DGS训练内存与算力需求高，多GPU分布式训练虽扩展显存容量，但性能受数据移动制约。主要瓶颈为：光栅化前后向过程中反复的片外内存访问，以及部分高斯梯度的GPU间通信。
AI.method: 1) 将前向与后向光栅化融合为单一GPU内核，中间结果驻留片上以消除冗余片外传输；2) 针对融合光栅化带来的片上存储压力，引入兼顾渲染质量与每tile共享内存约束的硬件感知剪枝；3) 利用梯度稀疏性，用高效的编码/解码内核压缩非零部分梯度记录，并在拥有者GPU上直接聚合，降低通信量与本地聚合开销。
AI.result: 在六个数据集上评估，相比基线，GPU内片外流量降低63.4%，后向GPU间通信量降低65.8%；在8块GPU上实现最高6.1倍训练加速，同时保持重建质量。
AI.conclusion: ByteSplat通过协同优化GPU内与GPU间数据移动，有效缓解分布式3DGS训练的瓶颈，在保持重建质量的前提下显著提升训练效率。

title: EviDent-CBCT: Evidence-Bottlenecked Report Generation from Dental CBCT under Non-Exhaustive Report Supervision
summary: Dento-maxillofacial cone-beam CT (CBCT) reports may contain dozens of tooth-specific, anatomical, and spatial findings from a single 3D scan. Learning to generate such reports from limited clinical data is challenging because routine reports may not exhaustively document image findings, and a non-mention may reflect either absence or non-reporting. We present EviDent-CBCT, an evidence-bottlenecked framework designed for this incomplete supervision. An anatomy-aware network maps each CBCT scan to a discrete record of tooth-level, global, and tooth-IAC evidence. A dental-logic consistency projection reconciles incompatible evidence before a deterministic renderer and an image-blind local language model generate the report using only this record. For tooth-level evidence, reliability-aware training uses eligible non-mentions as reduced-weight negatives, while unreported global and tooth-IAC labels remain unknown. A metal-sensitive input channel preserves intensity cues from dental materials. Across three validation runs, EviDent-CBCT achieves $0.666\pm0.006$ merged evidence set-F1 and $0.402\pm0.003$ RadFact-Lite-Dental logical-F1, versus $0.371\pm0.018$ for the strongest controlled direct baseline. In the ODIN 2026 challenge, it ranked second in automated evaluation and third in blinded clinical Arena comparison on the hidden test set. These results support the discrete evidence record as an effective and auditable interface for CBCT report generation.

AI.tldr: EviDent-CBCT：以离散证据记录为接口的牙颌面CBCT报告生成框架
AI.motivation: 牙颌面CBCT单次扫描可产生数十条牙体、解剖与空间发现，但常规报告未必穷尽记录所见，"未提及"可能代表缺失或未报告，构成不完全监督难题。
AI.method: 解剖感知网络将CBCT扫描映射为牙体级、全局及牙-IAC的离散证据记录；牙科逻辑一致性投影调和不相容证据；确定性渲染器与图像盲局部语言模型仅凭该记录生成报告。牙体级证据采用可靠性感知训练，将符合条件的不提及作为降权负样本，未报告的全局与牙-IAC标签保持未知；并引入金属敏感输入通道保留牙科材料的强度线索。
AI.result: 三次验证运行中，合并证据集F1为0.666±0.006，RadFact-Lite-Dental逻辑F1为0.402±0.003，显著优于最强受控直接基线的0.371±0.018。在ODIN 2026挑战赛隐藏测试集上，自动评估排名第二，盲法临床Arena比较排名第三。
AI.conclusion: 离散证据记录是CBCT报告生成的有效且可审计的接口，为不完全监督下的结构化医学报告生成提供了可行方案。

title: APDMem: Agent-Controlled Progressive Disclosure for Query-Adaptive Long-Term Memory
summary: Personalized LLM assistants must recover sparse evidence from long conversation histories across queries of varying complexity. We introduce APDMem (Agent-controlled Progressive Disclosure Memory), a hierarchical long-term memory architecture that applies progressive disclosure to memory retrieval. Rather than relying on a flat memory store or fixed retrieval granularity, APDMem represents conversation history as four progressively detailed layers: thematic summaries, personalized key facts, turn-level evidence notes, and raw messages. At inference time, a controller applies progressive disclosure to the memory hierarchy: it first reads high-level summaries and drills into finer evidence only when needed. This creates an adaptive cost-fidelity trade-off: simple queries can terminate early, while complex temporal, multi-hop, or exact-evidence queries trigger deeper inspection. A note synthesizer converts retrieved evidence into a query-focused structure that consolidates facts, orders events, and flags contradictions before final answer generation. Experiments on LongMemEval show that APDMem achieves strong performance for long-context memory reasoning while accessing only 8% of the total conversations.

AI.tldr: APDMem 是一种分层长期记忆架构，将对话历史组织为四层递进粒度，并用控制器按需逐层披露检索，在 LongMemEval 上仅访问 8% 对话即取得强性能。
AI.motivation: 个性化 LLM 助手需在长对话历史中、面对不同复杂度查询时恢复稀疏证据。扁平记忆存储或固定检索粒度难以兼顾简单查询的低成本与复杂查询（时序、多跳、精确证据）的高保真需求。
AI.method: 将对话历史表示为四层递进细节结构：主题摘要、个性化关键事实、轮次级证据笔记、原始消息。推理时由控制器执行渐进披露：先读高层摘要，仅在需要时下钻到更细证据；简单查询可提前终止，复杂查询触发更深检查。另设笔记合成器，将检索到的证据转换为面向查询的结构，整合事实、排序事件并标记矛盾，供最终答案生成。
AI.result: 在 LongMemEval 数据集上，APDMem 在长上下文记忆推理任务中表现强劲，且仅访问总对话量的 8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过渐进披露式分层记忆检索，APDMem 实现了成本与保真度之间的自适应权衡，在显著降低访问开销的同时保持长上下文记忆推理性能。

title: SocialVLA: A Social Perception Gateway for Human-Reaction-Based Failure Detection and Recovery in VLA Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies enable diverse robotic manipulation but can fail during execution without recognizing their own errors. Human observers provide complementary signals, as unexpected robot behavior can trigger rapid vocal, facial, or verbal reactions before failure is completed. We introduce SocialVLA, a local, policy-agnostic social perception gateway that converts spontaneous human reactions into runtime intervention signals for VLA manipulation. SocialVLA combines causal paralinguistic audio detection, visual reaction recognition, explicit stop phrases, and robot-relevance estimation. An asynchronous first-event fusion mechanism triggers a VLA hold from the earliest sufficiently confident signal, while a separate speech channel captures verbal corrections for participant-directed continuation, restart, or instruction revision. We evaluate SocialVLA on physical Unitree G1 manipulation using 15 participants, with 238 annotated intervention-worthy episodes and 1.038 h of non-intervention behavior. Frozen offline replay achieves 54.6% recall and 69.5% precision, while unfiltered audio-video fusion reaches 64.3% recall. Relevance estimation reduces false-stop episodes from 100 to 57 and increases precision from 60.5% to 69.8%. In prospective deployment on an unseen 16th participant, the frozen system achieves 59.5% recall and 91.7% precision. Median detector-to-fusion latency is 47.9 ms, VLA-gate-to-physical-hold latency is 336 ms, and reaction-onset-to-hold latency is 1.021 s. These results demonstrate a complete local pathway from spontaneous social reaction to physical VLA interruption and participant-directed recovery.

AI.tldr: 提出SocialVLA：一个本地、策略无关的社会感知网关，将人类自发反应转化为VLA操作运行时的干预信号，实现从社会反应到物理中断与参与者引导恢复的完整闭环。
AI.motivation: VLA策略虽能完成多样操作任务，但执行中无法识别自身错误；而人类旁观者对机器人异常行为会迅速产生声音、面部或言语反应，这种互补信号可在失败完成前触发干预，因此需要将其转化为运行时中断信号。
AI.method: SocialVLA融合因果副语言音频检测、视觉反应识别、显式停止短语与机器人相关性估计；采用异步首事件融合机制，由最早达到足够置信度的信号触发VLA保持（hold），并用独立语音通道捕获口头纠正以实现继续、重启或指令修订。
AI.result: 在Unitree G1物理操作上以15名参与者评估，含238个标注干预片段与1.038小时非干预行为。冻结离线回放召回54.6%、精度69.5%，未过滤音视频融合召回64.3%；相关性估计将误停片段由100降至57，精度由60.5%升至69.8%。对未见第16名参与者的前瞻部署中，冻结系统召回59.5%、精度91.7%。检测到融合中位延迟47.9 ms，VLA门控到物理保持336 ms，反应起始到保持1.021 s。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了一条完整的本地通路：从自发社会反应到对物理VLA的中断，再到由参与者引导的恢复过程，证明社会感知可作为VLA运行时纠错的可行且低延迟的干预机制。

title: Counterfactual Predictions in Scientific Emulators Without Controlled Experiments
summary: Many scientific questions require reasoning about what was never observed: What if the conditions, interventions, or history had been different? Models can predict accurately on observed data yet fail on such what-if queries when correlated inputs are varied independently. A common remedy is to add controlled simulation data in which these factors are explicitly disentangled, but this requires access to a simulator, can be computationally expensive, and inherits the simulator's modeling assumptions. We introduce ReRoute, a framework for targeted scientific what-if prediction that combines factual data with partial mechanistic knowledge, without requiring controlled intervention data for adaptation. ReRoute fixes the queried input of a pretrained backbone to a reference value, reintroduces its variation through a known mechanistic pathway, and fine-tunes on the original factual data, while leaving downstream effects to the learned dynamics. We provide a causal identification result for this construction under explicit structural assumptions, with the core argument machine-checked in Lean. After showing that ReRoute achieves highly accurate counterfactual predictions in a controlled advection-diffusion system where exact responses are available, we turn to state-of-the-art climate emulation. On held-out coupled-climate interventions, ReRoute reduces aggregate climate error by 18.2-31.8% under severe CO$_2$ distribution shifts while preserving skill under standard conditions, at a small fraction of the cost of retraining on additional controlled simulations, without even accounting for the substantial expense of generating such data. Finally, on an emulator trained from historical ERA5 reanalysis, where no counterfactual reference exists, ReRoute preserves substantially more of the surface warming implied by the observed boundary conditions under a fixed-CO$_2$ counterfactual.

AI.tldr: ReRoute 是一种针对科学 what-if（反事实）预测的框架：将预训练主干网络的查询输入固定到参考值，通过已知机制通路重新引入其变化，并在原始事实数据上微调，无需受控干预数据即可适配。论文给出显式结构假设下的因果识别结果（核心论证经 Lean 机器验证），在受控平流-扩散系统中实现高精度反事实预测，并在气候仿真任务中将严重 CO₂ 分布偏移下的总体气候误差降低 18.2–31.8%，同时保持标准条件下的性能。
AI.motivation: 科学问题常需对从未观测的情形进行推理（不同条件、干预或历史下的 what-if 查询）。模型在观测数据上预测准确，但当相关输入被独立变动时，往往在 what-if 查询上失败。常见补救是加入显式解耦各因素的受控仿真数据，但这依赖仿真器、计算昂贵且继承仿真器的建模假设。
AI.method: ReRoute 将事实数据与部分机制知识结合，无需受控干预数据即可适配：把预训练主干网络的被查询输入固定为参考值，通过已知机制通路重新引入其变化，并在原始事实数据上微调，将下游效应留给学到的动力学。论文在显式结构假设下给出该构造的因果识别结果，核心论证以 Lean 形式化验证。
AI.result: 在可获精确响应的受控平流-扩散系统中，ReRoute 实现高精度反事实预测。在先进气候仿真任务中：在留出的耦合气候干预上，严重 CO₂ 分布偏移下将总体气候误差降低 18.2–31.8%，并在标准条件下保持技能，成本仅为在额外受控仿真上重训的一小部分（尚未计入生成此类数据的巨大开销）。在基于历史 ERA5 再分析训练的仿真器上（无反事实参考），ReRoute 在固定 CO₂ 反事实下显著更多地保留了观测边界条件所隐含的地表增温。
AI.conclusion: ReRoute 提供了一种无需受控干预数据、仅结合事实数据与部分机制知识的定向科学 what-if 预测方案，兼具因果识别保证与实践有效性：在受控系统与气候仿真中均提升反事实预测精度，降低成本，并可在无反事实参考的真实再分析数据场景中保持更多物理响应。

title: Broken scale symmetries in undercomplete linear autoencoders
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations Workshop
summary: Neural network loss landscapes have many symmetries, which are preserved by gradient flow but broken by finite-stepsize stochastic gradient descent (SGD). A canonical example of such a symmetry is scale in homogeneous networks: one can scale up the parameters in one layer and down in the next without changing the network output. Previous work has documented cases in which SGD breaks this symmetry in favor of balancing gradient noise or minimizing fluctuations. Here, we show that the solution geometry of undercomplete linear autoencoders instead selects a preferred sign for scale drift: on the PCA solution manifold, SGD favors large decoder weights. This directed scale drift occurs on a slow timescale, and its dynamics admit an analytically-tractable effective description. However, it cannot continue indefinitely: increasing scale eventually drives the dynamics towards a finite-stepsize stability boundary. The resulting solutions are sharper than a balanced baseline in the sense of the maximum eigenvalue of the loss Hessian, but different sharpness measures can move in opposing directions. Thus, undercomplete autoencoders give a concrete illustration of how loss geometry can convert residual gradient noise into directed motion along a manifold of functionally-equivalent solutions.

AI.tldr: 在欠完备线性自编码器的PCA解流形上，SGD会把有限步长导致的梯度噪声转化为有方向的尺度漂移，倾向增大解码器权重；该漂移缓慢、可用有效动力学解析描述，并最终停在有限步长稳定性边界处，使解在最大Hessian特征值意义上更"尖锐"。
AI.motivation: 神经网络损失景观具有多种对称性，梯度流保持这些对称性，而有限步长SGD会破缺它们。以齐次网络的尺度对称性为例，以往工作多记录SGD偏向平衡梯度噪声或最小化涨落，本文则关注解几何是否本身会为尺度漂移选定一个偏好方向。
AI.method: 以欠完备线性自编码器为易处理模型，研究其在PCA解流形上的SGD动力学；通过尺度重参数化（一层放大、相邻层缩小）追踪漂移方向，并给出缓慢时间尺度上可解析求解的有效动力学描述。
AI.result: 在PCA解流形上，SGD偏向较大的解码器权重，形成定向尺度漂移；该漂移在慢时间尺度上发生且有解析有效描述。漂移不能无限进行：尺度增大会把动力学推向有限步长稳定性边界。所得解在损失Hessian最大特征值意义上比平衡基线更尖锐，但不同尖锐度度量可给出相反结论。
AI.conclusion: 欠完备自编码器具体展示了损失几何如何把残余梯度噪声转化为沿功能等价解流形的定向运动，说明对称性破缺可产生有方向、可预测的参数漂移，并影响解的尖锐性刻画。

title: Hardware-Native Joint Sparse-Quantization for Trillion-Scale Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures allow frontier language models to scale to trillions of parameters, but their deployment is constrained by massive memory footprints and memory-bandwidth limitations. Although modern accelerators provide Sparse Tensor Cores (SpTCs) that reduce weight storage and increase throughput through low-precision semi-structured sparsity, exploiting them for MoEs remains challenging because of substantial model-quality degradation and the lack of grouped sparse GEMM primitives. We present an end-to-end hardware-software co-design framework that compresses expert weights into hardware-native, low-precision sparse representations and accelerates their execution on SpTCs. Algorithmically, our framework relaxes discrete semi-structured support selection through continuous reparameterization, enabling differentiable joint optimization with quantized weights under a router-weighted reconstruction objective and scalable expert-parallel compression. Systemically, we develop a custom grouped sparse GEMM kernel tailored to low-precision sparse MoE inference on SpTCs. Across MoE models ranging from 30 billion to one trillion parameters, our framework improves state-of-the-art joint sparse-quantization accuracy by up to 4.35 percentage points while preserving 96.09% of the original model's performance. On NVIDIA B200 GPUs, our kernel outperforms the vendor baseline by up to $1.65\times$, increasing serving throughput by $1.18\times$ and reducing end-to-end latency by up to $4.03\times$. These results establish hardware-software co-design as a practical path toward scalable and efficient MoE deployment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出端到端软硬件协同设计框架，将MoE专家权重量化为硬件原生低精度稀疏表示并在SpTC上加速，兼顾精度与效率。
AI.motivation: MoE架构可将前沿语言模型扩展到万亿参数，但部署受限于巨大内存占用和内存带宽瓶颈。现代加速器虽提供稀疏张量核（SpTC）以通过低精度半结构化稀疏降低存储、提升吞吐，但其用于MoE面临模型质量大幅下降和缺乏分组稀疏GEMM原语两大难题。
AI.method: 算法层面：通过连续重参数化松弛离散半结构化支撑集选择，在路由器加权重建目标下实现与量化权重的可微联合优化，并支持可扩展的专家并行压缩。系统层面：针对SpTC上的低精度稀疏MoE推理，开发定制的分组稀疏GEMM内核。
AI.result: 在30B至1T参数的MoE模型上，联合稀疏-量化精度较SOTA提升最多4.35个百分点，同时保留原模型96.09%的性能。在NVIDIA B200 GPU上，内核较厂商基线最高加速1.65倍，服务吞吐提升1.18倍，端到端延迟最高降低4.03倍。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明软硬件协同设计是实现可扩展、高效MoE部署的可行路径。

title: A Multi Method Importance and Performance Efficiency Analysis of Topological Metrics for Natural Visibility Graph Based Cyber Attack Detection
summary: Natural Visibility Graph (NVG) based analysis characterizes network traffic through topological descriptors reflecting different structural properties. However, not all descriptors contribute equally to cyber-attack classification, and extracting a large metric set can increase computational cost. This study evaluates 21 NVG derived topological metrics and investigates whether a compact subset can preserve classification capability while improving computational efficiency. Four importance analysis methods SHAP, grouped Permutation Importance, Boruta, and Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) are integrated through a Consensus Ranking strategy. Based on this ranking, Full21, Top15, Top10, Top7, Top5, and Top3 configurations are evaluated using the CICIDS2018 dataset, a CNN classifier, and stratified 5 fold cross validation. The three highest ranked metrics are avg_clustering_coeff_median, avg_clustering_coeff_std, and avg_clustering_coeff_mean. Top3 achieved the highest observed mean performance, with 97.148% accuracy, 97.055% weighted F1 score, and an MCC of 0.9675, compared with 95.999%, 95.521%, and 0.9549 for Full21, respectively. It also reduced total runtime from 14,961.39 s to 589.22 s (96.06%). These results indicate that importance guided metric reduction can provide a compact NVG representation with higher observed mean predictive performance and substantially lower computational cost under the evaluated setting.

AI.tldr: 本文评估21个NVG拓扑指标，通过四种重要性分析方法的共识排序进行特征选择，发现Top3指标子集在CICIDS2018上取得最优分类性能并将运行时间降低96.06%。
AI.motivation: NVG分析产生的拓扑描述符并非对攻击分类同等重要，提取大量指标会增加计算开销，因此需要探究能否用紧凑指标子集在保持分类能力的同时提升计算效率。
AI.method: 评估21个NVG拓扑指标，采用SHAP、分组排列重要性、Boruta与RFE四种重要性分析方法，通过共识排序策略整合结果；据此构建Full21、Top15、Top10、Top7、Top5、Top3等配置，在CICIDS2018数据集上使用CNN分类器与分层5折交叉验证进行评测。
AI.result: 排名前三的指标为avg_clustering_coeff_median、avg_clustering_coeff_std、avg_clustering_coeff_mean。Top3取得最高平均性能：准确率97.148%、加权F1 97.055%、MCC 0.9675，而Full21分别为95.999%、95.521%、0.9549；总运行时间从14,961.39秒降至589.22秒，减少96.06%。
AI.conclusion: 重要性引导的指标约简可提供紧凑的NVG表示，在所评估设定下具备更高的观测平均预测性能和显著更低的计算成本。

title: SoK: Stablecoins in the Quantum Era
summary: Stablecoins support payments, trading, collateral, and cross-chain settlement across the digital-asset ecosystem. They also concentrate value behind issuer, custody, upgrade, oracle, and bridge keys while inheriting the quantum vulnerabilities of host-chain accounts, consensus, rollups, and privacy systems. This paper presents a Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) on post-quantum stablecoins. We develop a stablecoin-specific threat model, map cryptographic dependencies to monetary control surfaces, and classify migration choices along three dimensions: who can authorize a change, where the change must occur, and whether it is hybrid, post-quantum native, or an encapsulation of a classical component. We emphasize an authority-liability gap: the party able to migrate a component is often different from the holders, exchanges, protocols, or issuers that bear the loss if it fails. We review the relevant cryptographic primitives, but distinguish general blockchain failures from their stablecoin-specific effects. We also examine recent blockchain and issuer-controlled interoperability proposals, and relate migration choices to redemption, continuity, and intervention requirements under current stablecoin regulation. Our findings identify open problems in aggregate and threshold authorization, operation-specific security levels and costs, dormant and wrapped supply, private and compliance-enabled transfers, and measurement of quantum-vulnerable stablecoin exposure.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于后量子稳定币的系统化知识（SoK）论文，构建了稳定币专属威胁模型，将密码学依赖映射到货币控制面，并从授权主体、变更位置、迁移形式三个维度对迁移方案进行分类，揭示了"权限—责任缺口"，并指出聚合/门限授权、休眠与包装供给、隐私与合规转账等开放问题。
AI.motivation: 稳定币在数字资产生态中支撑支付、交易、抵押与跨链结算，但其价值集中于发行方、托管方、升级、预言机与跨链桥密钥，同时继承主机链账户、共识、Rollup 与隐私系统的量子脆弱性。现有研究多讨论一般区块链的量子风险，缺乏针对稳定币的系统化分析，尤其忽视了迁移权限与损失承担者不一致的问题。
AI.method: 采用系统化知识（SoK）方法：1）构建稳定币专属威胁模型；2）将密码学依赖映射到货币控制面；3）沿三个维度对迁移选择进行分类——谁有权授权变更、变更必须发生在何处、以及形式为混合、后量子原生还是对经典组件的封装；4）回顾相关密码学原语，并区分一般区块链故障与其在稳定币场景下的特定影响；5）考察近期区块链与发行方控制的互操作性提案，并结合现行稳定币监管分析迁移选择与赎回、连续性、干预要求的关系。
AI.result: 提出了稳定币专属威胁模型与控制面映射框架，建立了三维迁移分类法，明确了"权限—责任缺口"：具备迁移某组件权限的一方，往往不同于在迁移失败时承担损失的持有者、交易所、协议或发行方。同时识别出若干开放问题：聚合与门限授权、按操作区分的安全等级与成本、休眠与包装供给、隐私与合规兼备的转账，以及量子脆弱稳定币敞口的度量。
AI.conclusion: 稳定币的后量子迁移不能简化为单一密码算法替换，而需在授权、责任、监管合规与运营连续性之间统筹权衡；未来研究应聚焦于聚合/门限授权机制、差异化的安全—成本配置、休眠与包装供给的治理、隐私与合规的兼容，以及量子脆弱敞口的量化度量。

title: PaxosLease in Relativistic Inertial Frames
summary: A lease grants one holder exclusive authority over a resource for a fixed term, and its safety property guarantees that at most one holder has the lease at any time. Under special relativity ``at any time'' has no frame-independent meaning for participants in relative motion. This note first restates the classical safety property with light cones, requiring a holder's expiry to lie in the causal past of any later acquisition by a different holder, an order every observer agrees about. Second, the paper modifies classical PaxosLease: the core change is that the containment and quarantine rules each gain a factor of $k = \sqrt{(1+β)/(1-β)}$, the relativistic Doppler factor, where $β$ is relative speed as a fraction of the speed of light.

AI.tldr: 本文将租约安全性用光锥重新表述，并修改经典PaxosLease使包含与隔离规则各引入相对论多普勒因子k=√((1+β)/(1-β))。
AI.motivation: 经典租约的“任意时刻至多一个持有者”假设绝对同时性，但在相对运动参与者之间“任意时刻”无与参考系无关的意义，因此需要相对论化定义与协议。
AI.method: 首先用光锥重述经典安全性：持有者到期必须落在后续不同持有者获取的因果过去中，这一顺序为所有观察者一致；其次修改经典PaxosLease，核心变化是包含（containment）与隔离（quarantine）规则各乘上相对论多普勒因子k=√((1+β)/(1-β))，β为相对速度与光速之比。
AI.result: 给出了基于光锥的租约安全性判据，并得到在相对运动下修正后的PaxosLease规则形式，其中包含与隔离阈值随β增大而被多普勒因子k缩放。
AI.conclusion: 相对论框架下租约安全性可由因果顺序而非绝对同时性刻画，经典PaxosLease需通过引入多普勒因子k来修正包含与隔离规则，以在相对运动参与者间保持至多一个持有者的安全性。

title: FactorSplat: Appearance-Controllable Gaussian Proxies for Medical Volume Rendering
summary: Transfer functions (TFs) control color and visibility in medical volume rendering, but image-trained Gaussian proxies typically bake one transfer function into their appearance. We present FactorSplat, a per-scene N-dimensional Gaussian splatting (N-DGS) proxy that accepts region-specific intensity-to-RGBA curves at inference. A local lookup applies the authored color and opacity change, while a shared functional encoder and low-rank per-Gaussian factors learn the residual appearance response. Geometry and directional appearance remain shared across presets, with visibility control and TF-aware pruning preserving the ability to hide and reveal structures. On seven CT and MR scans, FactorSplat improves mean PSNR and changed-region error over region-aware VEG across validation, interpolation, unseen composition, and out-of-distribution (OOD) edits. Across these four splits, seven-scan mean PSNR gains over VEG range from 1.10 to 1.52 dB. One checkpoint per scan supports unseen edits without retraining. At $1600^2$, the cached fast renderer averages 524 FPS with 1.17 ms TF switches. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/FactorSplat/.

AI.tldr: FactorSplat 提出一种逐场景的 N 维高斯泼溅代理，可在推理时接受区域特定的强度到 RGBA 曲线，实现无需重训练的传输函数编辑，在七例 CT/MR 扫描上全面超越 VEG。
AI.motivation: 医学体渲染中传输函数（TF）控制颜色与可见性，但基于图像训练的高斯代理通常把单一 TF 固化进外观，导致改TF需重训练，缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: 提出逐场景 N 维高斯泼溅（N-DGS）代理：用局部查表施加设定的颜色与不透明度变化，配合共享函数编码器与低秩逐高斯因子学习残差外观响应；几何与方向外观在所有预设间共享，并通过可见性控制与 TF 感知剪枝保留结构的隐藏/显现能力。
AI.result: 在七例 CT 与 MR 扫描上，于验证、插值、未见组合与分布外（OOD）编辑四个划分中，平均 PSNR 与变化区域误差均优于区域感知的 VEG；相对 VEG 的七扫描平均 PSNR 增益为 1.10–1.52 dB。每个扫描仅需一个检查点即可支持未见编辑。在 1600² 分辨率下，缓存快速渲染器平均达 524 FPS，TF 切换耗时 1.17 ms。
AI.conclusion: FactorSplat 通过将传输函数响应与几何/方向外观解耦，实现了可交互、无需重训练的 TF 编辑，并保持高质量与实时渲染性能，适用于医学体渲染的多预设与分布外编辑场景。

title: From Retrieval to Typed Decisions: Calibrated System One Models from Biomedical Sentence Encoders
summary: Typed decision models answer schema-constrained questions about a text in one forward pass and return probabilities meant to be thresholded. We ask whether biomedical sentence encoders trained for retrieval are good starting points for such models. We present SBERT2S1, which converts Sentence-Transformers encoders into bi-encoder, cross-head (C) and prior-fused residual (PFR) decision models, together with BIODECIDE, a biomedical typed-decision suite, and MEDLINE-S1, 243k training decisions derived from NLM indexing. Across six parent-retriever pairs, retrieval training improves zero-shot matching of content-bearing options. After fine-tuning, its effect depends on the head: across five pairs and three training-set sizes, retrieval training significantly helps PFR, which keeps the retrieval prior, in 10 of 15 comparisons, but helps C in one and hurts it in five. A matched grid of two heads and five training objectives shows that C outperforms PFR under every objective, and that the released RLCD recipe of open System One models trails cross-entropy by 2.5-3.0 points. The deficit stems mainly from its reward normalisation, which inflates the noisy score-function term 3.6-15-fold; an unbiased leave-one-out estimator recovers most of the gap. After temperature scaling, no objective is clearly better calibrated than cross-entropy. We release the code, the MEDLINE-S1 labels and a model.

AI.tldr: 检索训练对类型化决策模型是部分有效的起点：它提升零样本匹配与保留先验的PFR头，但帮助不如C头稳健；C头在所有目标下都优于PFR，且System One的RLCD配方因奖励归一化偏差落后交叉熵2.5–3.0点。
AI.motivation: 类型化决策模型需在一次前向中回答模式约束问题并返回可阈值化的概率，而生物医学领域已有大量检索训练的句子编码器；作者要检验这些检索编码器是否是训练此类模型的良好起点，并厘清其收益是依赖模型头还是训练目标。
AI.method: 提出SBERT2S1，将Sentence-Transformers编码器转换为双编码器决策模型，含交叉头（C）与先验融合残差头（PFR）；构建BIODECIDE生物医学类型化决策套件与MEDLINE-S1（由NLM索引衍生的243k训练决策）。在六对母检索器上比较零样本匹配，在五对与三种训练集规模上比较微调效果，并做2头×5训练目标的匹配网格与标定分析。
AI.result: 检索训练提升含内容选项的零样本匹配。微调后效果依赖头：PFR在10/15比较中显著获益，C仅在1例获益、5例受损。匹配网格显示C在每种目标下均优于PFR，且RLCD配方比交叉熵低2.5–3.0点，主要源于奖励归一化将噪声得分函数项放大了3.6–15倍；无偏留一估计器可弥补大部分差距。温度缩放后各目标标定无明显优劣。
AI.conclusion: 检索训练并非普遍有益的初始化：其作用由决策头与目标共同决定，C头更稳健且更优；RLCD的缺陷可通过无偏估计修正。作者发布代码、MEDLINE-S1标签与模型。

title: Rethinking World-Action Model for Compositional and In-Context Robotic Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon compositional manipulation has become increasingly important for real-world robot deployment, where a single task involves multiple coordinated subtasks. Existing world-action models (WAMs) jointly predict short-horizon visual futures and actions, but typically lack explicit subtask-level reasoning. We propose Visual Goal-conditioned Action Reasoning (ViGAR), a hierarchical framework that factorizes manipulation into a visual subgoal planner and a subgoal executor. Given the current observation and global instruction, the subgoal planner predicts a visual subgoal for the next subtask. The subgoal executor then jointly generates future visual trajectories and actions conditioned on the predicted subgoal. Both components share a pretrained world-model representation, enabling task-level planning and action generation to benefit from common physical knowledge. Moreover, our framework naturally supports in-context learning: using a global goal image as context can induce different subtask decompositions and behaviors without parameter updates. On the RoboTwin Clean2Random benchmark, ViGAR achieves 82.00% and 67.02% success rates under the Clean and Random settings, respectively, surpassing the strongest baseline by 12.86 percentage points in average success rate. Real-world robot experiments on five compositional and two in-context learning tasks further confirm the effectiveness of ViGAR.

AI.tldr: 提出分层框架ViGAR，将长时域组合操作分解为视觉子目标规划器与子目标执行器，二者共享预训练世界模型表示，并支持上下文学习，在RoboTwin与真实机器人任务上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 长时域组合操作是真实机器人部署的关键，单个任务包含多个需协调的子任务。现有世界-动作模型（WAMs）虽联合预测短时域视觉未来与动作，但缺乏显式的子任务级推理，难以完成长时域的组合任务。
AI.method: ViGAR是一个分层框架，将操作分解为两个组件：（1）视觉子目标规划器：以当前观测和全局指令为输入，预测下一个子任务的视觉子目标；（2）子目标执行器：以预测的子目标为条件，联合生成未来视觉轨迹与动作。两个组件共享预训练的世界模型表示，使任务级规划与动作生成共享物理知识。此外，框架天然支持上下文学习：以全局目标图像作为上下文，可在不更新参数的情况下诱导不同的子任务分解与行为。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin Clean2Random基准上，ViGAR在Clean和Random设置下分别达到82.00%和67.02%的成功率，平均成功率超过最强基线12.86个百分点。在五个组合任务和两个上下文学习任务的真实机器人实验进一步验证了ViGAR的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入显式的子任务级视觉子目标规划并与世界-动作模型共享表示，ViGAR有效提升了长时域组合操作的成功率，并展现出无需参数更新的上下文学习能力，在仿真基准与真实机器人上均得到验证。

title: Approximation Property of Dropout Neural Networks: Sobolev Rates and Confidence Bounds
summary: The universal approximation property of dropout neural networks does not by itself describe the network size required for an accurate random realization. In this work, we study approximation of the unit ball of $W^{n,\infty}([0,1]^d)$ by ReLU networks whose edges are retained independently with probability $p$. The approximation error is measured uniformly over the input domain, and the guarantee holds with probability at least $1-δ$ for a single sampled network. We construct networks of constant depth and size $\widetilde O_{n,d}(p^{-9}\varepsilon^{-\max\{d/n,2\}} \log(1/δ))$. The construction combines bounded local subnetworks, localization on a successful approximation event, and a multiscale Taylor decomposition. Conversely, Sobolev capacity imposes a lower bound on the number of surviving edges, while approximation of a fixed affine function requires an output-layer cost of order $((1-p)/p)\varepsilon^{-2}\log(1/δ)$ at sufficiently high confidence. For fixed $p\in(0,1)$ and $δ<\min\{1/2,1-p\}$, the upper and lower bounds match in the accuracy exponent under a fixed or logarithmic depth budget. When $d\leq2n$, they also match in confidence up to logarithms of accuracy. We extend the lower bounds to $W^{n,r}$ targets with $L^s$ error, and distinguish this extension from the upper bound for $W^{n,\infty}$. The optimal retention dependence and logarithmic factors remain open.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带dropout的ReLU网络对W^{n,∞}([0,1]^d)单位球的逼近，构造常深度、规模为Õ_{n,d}(p^{-9}ε^{-max{d/n,2}}log(1/δ))的网络，并给出匹配的下界。
AI.motivation: 通用逼近性未刻画随机实现所需的网络规模，需要研究单次采样网络以高概率达到给定精度的规模。
AI.method: 结合有界局部子网络、成功逼近事件上的局部化，以及多尺度Taylor分解构造网络；用Sobolev容量给出存活边数下界，分析仿射函数逼近的输出层代价。
AI.result: 上界为常深度、规模Õ(p^{-9}ε^{-max{d/n,2}}log(1/δ))；下界由存活边数容量与输出层ε^{-2}log(1/δ)代价给出；固定p、δ时精度指数匹配，d≤2n时置信度(对数内)匹配；并推广到W^{n,r}目标与L^s误差。
AI.conclusion: dropout网络逼近的上下界在精度指数及部分置信度意义下基本匹配，最优保留概率依赖与对数因子仍待解决。

title: AdaptViT: Runtime-Adaptive Vision Transformer Deployment on Custom RISC-V
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE 33rd International Conference on Electronics, Circuits and Systems (ICECS)
summary: Deploying Vision Transformers (ViTs) on low-power edge devices is challenging due to high computational demands. Conventional pruning frameworks require a separate compiled binary for each sparsity level, increasing storage overhead and limiting runtime adaptability. This paper presents an end-to-end deployment pipeline that transforms pretrained ViTs into a single runtime-configurable binary, enabling dynamic compute-budget switching on embedded CPUs. This is achieved by restructuring generated C kernels with modified loop bounds and binary-mask control logic, allowing execution to switch across discrete sparsity levels via compact external configuration files. Compared to multi-binary deployment, the proposed runtime-adaptive approach reduces on-device storage by up to 4.86x, requiring only 163 MB for ViT-Base instead of nearly 800 MB. To maximize pruning efficiency, we introduce a hardware-aligned block pruning strategy for Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) layers. In addition, a custom ISA extension is proposed to exploit input-reuse patterns in linear projection kernels. On a Synopsys TRV32P3FX RISC-V processor, the full system achieves up to 2.8x speedup at 65% MLP and 50% attention-head pruning for ViT-Base. The ISA extension alone provides a 1.56x speedup and 33% lower inference energy, with a 24.7% area overhead in a TSMC 28 nm implementation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种端到端部署流水线，将预训练ViT转换为单一运行时可配置二进制文件，支持在嵌入式CPU上动态切换稀疏度级别，实现存储降低最高4.86倍，并在RISC-V处理器上获得最高2.8倍加速。
AI.motivation: 在低功耗边缘设备上部署Vision Transformer（ViT）面临高计算需求挑战。传统剪枝框架需要为每个稀疏度级别单独编译二进制文件，导致存储开销增大且限制运行时适应性。
AI.method: 通过修改循环边界和二进制掩码控制逻辑重构生成的C内核，并借助紧凑的外部配置文件在离散稀疏度级别间切换执行；提出面向MLP层的硬件对齐块剪枝策略；设计定制ISA扩展以利用线性投影内核中的输入复用模式。
AI.result: 相比多二进制部署，运行时自适应方案将设备端存储降低最高4.86倍（ViT-Base仅需163 MB而非近800 MB）；在Synopsys TRV32P3FX RISC-V处理器上，ViT-Base在65% MLP与50%注意力头剪枝下获得最高2.8倍加速；ISA扩展单独带来1.56倍加速和33%推理能耗降低，TSMC 28 nm实现下面积开销为24.7%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过单一可配置二进制、硬件对齐块剪枝与定制ISA扩展，有效缓解了ViT在边缘设备上的存储、运行时适应性与能效瓶颈。

title: DeReAct: Decomposed Reasoning and Acting for Reliable AI Agents
summary:
ReAct-based agents typically rely on a single LLM policy to propose actions, interact with the environment, and decide when a task is complete. This coupling makes action authorization and completion control difficult to enforce independently, allowing errors to propagate and unsupported completion claims to terminate execution. We introduce DeReAct, a modular agent architecture that externalizes two gating policies: a Critic that validates proposed actions before execution, and a Context Manager that reconstructs an environment-supported \textsc{State} and certifies task completion.
  Across GAIA and SWE-bench Verified, DeReAct improves Pass@1 most for weaker Brain models, with gains of 6.5--7.0 points for Qwen3-Coder-480B and 4.2--5.2 points for Claude Sonnet~4.5; gains diminish as Brain capability increases. Trajectory and ablation analyses show that external gating is effective when targeted failures are sufficiently prevalent and the gating policy is itself sufficient. With Claude Opus~4.5, Pass@1 remains comparable to ReAct, while DeReAct produces more evidence-complete and constraint-satisfying trajectories, indicating that completion control can trade earlier termination for stronger grounding. Overall, DeReAct improves weaker agents while retaining grounding benefits as models strengthen.

AI.tldr: DeReAct 通过外部化动作验证与完成认证两个门控策略，将单一 LLM 策略解耦为模块化架构，在弱模型上显著提升 Pass@1，并在强模型上保持可比性能与更强证据完备性。
AI.motivation: ReAct 类智能体依赖单一 LLM 策略同时负责提出动作、与环境交互并判定任务完成，导致动作授权与完成控制无法独立实施，错误容易传播，且不被环境支持的任务完成声明会错误终止执行。
AI.method: 提出 DeReAct 模块化智能体架构，外部化两个门控策略：Critic 在执行前验证所提动作；Context Manager 重建环境支持的 State 并认证任务完成。
AI.result: 在 GAIA 与 SWE-bench Verified 上，DeReAct 对较弱 Brain 模型提升最大，Qwen3-Coder-480B 提升 6.5–7.0 分，Claude Sonnet 4.5 提升 4.2–5.2 分，随 Brain 能力增强收益递减。使用 Claude Opus 4.5 时 Pass@1 与 ReAct 相当，但轨迹更证据完备、更满足约束。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹与消融分析表明，外部门控在被针对的失败足够普遍且门控策略本身充分时最为有效。完成控制可以以更早终止换取更强接地。总体而言，DeReAct 提升较弱智能体，并在模型增强时保留接地收益。

title: SideKernel: A Usable microVM Sandbox for AI Coding Agents on macOS
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Georgia Tech M.S. Cybersecurity practicum project
summary: AI coding agents are untrusted system components, yet they require autonomy on the developer machines they run on. This contradiction is a security problem. Sandboxes provide an isolated environment, but for local macOS development, the existing local, open-source options for AI coding agents are few in number and cumbersome to use. I conducted a formative online user survey which indicates that fewer than 40% of AI coding agent users run their agents in a sandbox and identifies the top usability barriers hindering AI coding agent sandbox adoption. These findings are used to develop SideKernel: an open-source, local, microVM-based macOS sandbox for AI coding agents designed for usability. To evaluate SideKernel, I compiled a list of sandboxes available on the market and filtered it against five inclusion criteria. Then I performed a comparative analysis between SideKernel and the sandboxes that satisfy these criteria, across 23 capability tests derived from the usability barriers revealed by the user survey. I discovered that only a few sandboxes are similar to SideKernel, and that among those, Docker Sandboxes and SideKernel score highest on capability features related to usability. A secondary contribution of this paper is a survey of the existing solution space for local, open-source, microVM-based macOS sandboxes for AI coding agents.

AI.tldr: 本文针对AI编码代理作为不可信组件却需在开发者机器上自主运行的安全矛盾，调研发现不足40%用户使用沙箱，并据此开发了面向可用性的开源本地microVM macOS沙箱SideKernel，通过23项能力测试与现有沙箱对比评估。
AI.motivation: AI编码代理属于不可信系统组件，却需要在开发者本机上获得自主权限，构成安全矛盾。沙箱可提供隔离环境，但面向本地macOS开发的现有开源沙箱方案数量稀少且使用繁琐，阻碍了采用。
AI.method: 开展形成性在线用户调研，量化AI编码代理用户的沙箱使用率并识别主要可用性障碍；基于调研结果开发开源、本地、基于microVM的macOS沙箱SideKernel；构建市面沙箱清单并按五项纳入标准筛选，围绕由调研提炼的23项能力测试，将SideKernel与合格沙箱进行对比分析。
AI.result: 调研显示不足40%的AI编码代理用户使用沙箱运行代理，并识别出主要可用性障碍。对比分析表明，仅少数沙箱与SideKernel相似，其中Docker Sandboxes与SideKernel在可用性相关能力特征上得分最高。
AI.conclusion: SideKernel以可用性为核心设计，在本地macOS AI编码代理沙箱方案中具备竞争力。论文次要贡献是梳理了现有本地开源microVM macOS沙箱解决方案空间。

title: Coda: Exploiting Admission Flexibility for Coding-Agent Serving
summary:
Coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) repeatedly alternate between model inference and tool calls, creating long-lived sessions with reusable key-value (KV) states and asynchronous request resumptions. Logical readiness, however, does not ensure efficient admission in a shared serving system. Through direct trace analysis and trace-driven replay, we identify two mismatches: reusable KV states reside across storage tiers and incur unequal computational costs for state preparation, while requests with heterogeneous context lengths can decode inefficiently together. Our central insight is that exploiting admission flexibility can improve serving performance while preserving request progress.
  We present Coda, a coding-agent serving system that realizes this insight through a readiness-informed admission layer incorporating two mechanisms. Tiered-Aging state admission exploits bounded flexibility in admission order to improve admission efficiency and preserve request progress. Compatibility-Aware execution admission exploits flexibility in attention grouping within each model iteration to reduce mixed-context interference and improve shared decoding efficiency. For multi-worker configurations, Coda introduces a separate routing layer that considers KV-state residency, worker load, and request-to-worker context-length compatibility to guide efficient request placement. We evaluate Coda across different models and workloads against state-of-the-art coding-agent serving systems and vLLM. Across the single-worker and multi-worker experiments, Coda improves output-token and SLO-compliant throughput by 20.3% and 70.5% on average, with peak gains of 29.3% and 140.2%.

AI.tldr: Coda通过"就绪感知准入层"利用准入灵活性，改进编码智能体服务系统的效率，吞吐量平均提升20.3%（输出token）和70.5%（SLO合规）。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的编码智能体在模型推理与工具调用间反复交替，形成长生命周期会话，包含可复用的KV状态与异步请求恢复。但逻辑上的就绪并不等于共享服务系统中的高效准入。通过直接轨迹分析与轨迹驱动重放，发现两个不匹配点：可复用KV状态分布在多级存储中，其状态准备的算力开销不均；上下文长度异构的请求一起解码时效率低下。核心洞察是：利用准入灵活性可在保证请求进展的同时提升服务性能。
AI.method: Coda是一个编码智能体服务系统，通过就绪感知准入层实现核心洞察，包含两个机制：(1) Tiered-Aging状态准入：利用准入顺序上的有界灵活性，提升准入效率并保证请求进展；(2) Compatibility-Aware执行准入：利用每次模型迭代内注意力分组的灵活性，减少混合上下文干扰、提升共享解码效率。针对多worker配置，Coda引入独立的路由层，综合考虑KV状态驻留、worker负载以及请求与worker的上下文长度兼容性来指导高效的请求放置。
AI.result: 在不同模型和工作负载下，与最先进的编码智能体服务系统及vLLM对比评估。在单worker和多worker实验中，Coda的输出token吞吐量和SLO合规吞吐量平均提升20.3%和70.5%，峰值增益达29.3%和140.2%。
AI.conclusion: 准入灵活性是编码智能体服务系统中未被充分利用的性能优化维度。Coda通过就绪感知准入层（Tiered-Aging状态准入与Compatibility-Aware执行准入）以及多worker路由层，有效缓解了KV状态准备开销不均和异构上下文解码低效两大问题，在保证请求进展的前提下显著提升吞吐量。

title: Octrees as an Explicit 3D Language
summary: Existing 3D large language models (LLMs) compromise on two fronts: they compress shapes into latent codebook indices or coordinate text, which removes spatial structure from what the model observes, and they acquire the 3D modality by fine-tuning the backbone, which overwrites its general language ability. We present OctLLM, which addresses both limitations. Geometry enters as an explicit 3D sequence of octree occupancy tokens. However, full octree sequences grow rapidly with depth; OctLLM therefore randomly empties penultimate-level nodes and omits descendants while preserving shape, yielding a shorter coordinate- and depth-anchored Sparse Octree (S-Octree) for position-aware mask-modeling generation and 3D understanding. On the other front, existing methods introduce a new modality with full fine-tuning or LoRA, but full fine-tuning is costly, LoRA limits 3D capacity, and both modify the language pathway. OctLLM instead adds 3D capacity in parameters separate from the pretrained ones: mesh tokens are routed through independent trainable branches in a subset of blocks while text and image tokens retain the frozen vision-language pathway, and the two streams interact through shared self-attention. It trains far fewer parameters than full fine-tuning, yet sets a new state of the art among unified multimodal LLMs, lowering image-to-3D FID by $17.4\%$ and raising render-grounded captioning by $28.7$ points over ShapeLLM-Omni, while matching the backbone on general language benchmarks.

AI.tldr: OctLLM 用稀疏八叉树占位符序列作为显式 3D 输入，并通过独立可训练分支注入 3D 能力，在不破坏语言能力的前提下刷新统一多模态 LLM 的 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 大语言模型存在两方面缺陷：（1）将形状压缩为隐式 codebook 索引或坐标文本，破坏了模型所观测的空间结构；（2）通过微调骨干网络获取 3D 模态，覆盖了通用语言能力。此外，全量微调代价高，LoRA 限制 3D 容量，且二者都修改了语言通路。
