AI.method: 几何以八叉树占位符（occupancy token）的显式 3D 序列输入。针对完整八叉树序列随深度快速增长的问题，随机清空倒数第二层节点并省略其后代，在保持形状的同时得到更短的、坐标与深度锚定的稀疏八叉树（S-Octree），用于位置感知的掩码建模生成与 3D 理解。在能力注入上，将网格 token 通过部分区块中的独立可训练分支路由，文本与图像 token 保留冻结的视觉-语言通路，两路通过共享自注意力交互。相比全量微调训练参数大幅减少。
AI.result: 在统一多模态 LLM 中取得新的 SOTA：相比 ShapeLLM-Omni，图像到 3D 的 FID 降低 17.4%，渲染接地的图像描述（render-grounded captioning）提升 28.7 个点，同时在通用语言基准上与骨干模型持平。
AI.conclusion: 以显式稀疏八叉树序列替代隐式压缩表示、以独立可训练分支替代全量微调/LoRA，可在保持通用语言能力的同时高效提升 3D 容量，实现 3D 理解与生成双方面领先。

title: A generative-informed neuro-symbolic framework for syntactic ambiguity resolution: Evidence from Arabic DPs
summary: Syntactic ambiguity poses a persistent challenge for Arabic NLP, particularly in morphologically rich nominal constructions where multiple structu6ral interpretations may be compatible with the same surface sequence. This study proposes a generatively informed neuro-symbolic framework for resolving structural ambiguity in Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) DPs. The framework integrates generative syntactic notions with AraBERT by representing ambiguity as a candidate-based decision task in which linguistically motivated alternatives are explicitly constructed and evaluated through candidate-conditioned input representations. Findings indicate that the model achieved 96.88% accuracy, 95.92% macro-F1, 96.83% weighted F1, and 93.94% binary F1 on the unseen evaluation set. Class-level analysis revealed asymmetric performance, with recall of 99.71% for High/VP Attachment (N1) and 89.26% for Low/NP/Embedded Attachment (N2), indicating greater difficulty in recovering the embedded interpretation. The study concludes that formal syntactic representations can be operationalized within Transformer-based NLP as an explicit interface between linguistic structure and contextual neural modeling, providing a controlled and interpretable approach to Arabic syntactic ambiguity resolution and beyond.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个生成语法启发的神经符号框架，将现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）名词短语（DP）的结构歧义化解为候选式决策任务，结合生成句法概念与AraBERT，在未见评测集上达到96.88%准确率、95.92%宏F1。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语NLP中长期存在句法歧义难题，尤其在形态丰富的名词性结构中，同一表层序列可对应多种结构解读；既有Transformer模型缺乏对语言结构的显式建模，难以可控且可解释地消解此类歧义。
AI.method: 构建生成语法启发的神经符号框架：将歧义形式化为基于候选的决策任务，显式构造语言学理据支持的候选结构，并通过候选条件化输入表示，将生成句法概念与AraBERT相融合进行候选评估。
AI.result: 在未见评测集上取得96.88%准确率、95.92%宏F1、96.83%加权F1和93.94%二分类F1。类别层面表现不均衡：High/VP Attachment（N1）召回率99.71%，Low/NP/Embedded Attachment（N2）召回率89.26%，表明嵌入式解读的恢复难度更大。
AI.conclusion: 形式化句法表征可在Transformer类NLP中操作化，作为语言结构与上下文神经建模之间的显式接口，为阿拉伯语句法歧义消解及更广泛任务提供可控、可解释的路径。

title: Keep the Effect, Drop the Actor: Programmable Effect-to-Execution World-Action Models
summary: A robot demonstration records two things in the same frames: what happened to the objects, and how one particular arm made it happen. We condition on the first. A demonstration is compiled into an effect program: the 3D keypoint trajectories of the objects that moved, two points marking where each was held, and the configuration the scene ends in, with the demonstrator removed. PEWAM, a 71.5M-parameter world-action model, generates effect, robot execution, action and terminal state as four streams with independent flow-matching times, so clamping a program and sampling the execution turns inference into programming, re-solved closed loop from the live scene. On held-out LIBERO-Goal tasks, one demonstration's program completes 40 of 90 episodes, where the same backbone given a goal image or language, and published demonstration-conditioned methods, complete at most 19; on three of Meta-World's held-out classes it exceeds the best published results, though not on the five-class mean. Because a program is a set of coordinates, a person can edit it: the placement follows a shifted terminal state and the grasp turns with rotated contact points. The same program runs on four robot arms without retraining, and after a push, re-solving completes 23 of 60 episodes where replaying the demonstration completes 6. On a Franka arm, fine-tuned on real demonstrations of other tasks, programs compiled from single human videos complete 36 of 40 trials, against 22 for the same backbone conditioned on the video's last frame as a goal image.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将机器人演示编译为“效果程序”（物体3D关键点轨迹+抓取点+终态），并训练71.5M参数的world-action模型PEWAM生成效果、执行、动作、终态四路流，从而把推理转化为闭环“编程”，在LIBERO-Goal等任务上显著超越已有方法。
AI.motivation: 机器人演示同时记录了“物体发生了什么”和“某条机械臂如何做到”。既有方法多以目标图像或语言为条件，忽略了演示中可迁移的物体效果信息。作者希望以“效果”为条件，使演示中的物体级知识可跨机械臂、跨任务复用且可被人类编辑，从而提升泛化性与可控性。
AI.method: 将演示编译为effect program：移动物体的3D关键点轨迹、标记每个物体被持握位置的两点、去除演示者后场景的终态配置。PEWAM（71.5M参数）以独立flow-matching时间为四个流（effect、robot execution、action、terminal state）生成；推理时固定program、采样execution，使推断等价于编程，并从实时场景闭环重解。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Goal留出任务上，单条演示的程序完成90个episode中的40个，而同一backbone以goal image或语言为条件、以及已发表的demonstration-conditioned方法最多完成19个；在Meta-World三个留出类上超过最佳公开结果（但五类均值未超）。程序可编辑：位置随平移终态变化、抓取随旋转接触点旋转。同一程序在四种机械臂上无需重训练直接运行；被推动后重解完成60个episode中的23个，而回放演示仅完成6个。在Franka臂上，用其他任务真实演示微调后，由单个人类视频编译的程序完成40次试验中的36次，同一backbone以视频最后一帧作为goal image仅22次。
AI.conclusion: 以物体效果为条件、通过可编辑坐标程序表达演示，是一种有效的演示条件化范式：它带来更强泛化、跨本体迁移和人类可编辑性，并能从单条人类视频生成可执行程序，显著优于goal image/语言条件与回放基线。

title: Overcoming Challenges of Interpretive Structural Modeling with Large Language Models
comment: This preprint has not undergone peer review or any post-submission improvements or corrections
summary: Interpretive Structural Modeling (ISM) is a well-known process for multi-criteria decision making. The success of ISM over other methodologies is its ability to model causal relationships, the binary scale of factors, and resulting hierarchical representation. Traditionally, the modeling process is performed by repeated interactions with subject matter experts until consensus is reached. This process is tedious, labor-intense, and most importantly limits the ability of ISM to scale to studies with hundreds of variables. Drawing on existing work of causal graph discovery with large language models (LLM) as imperfect experts, this work explores an integrated LLM-ISM approach for ISM. Pairwise, k-wise, rowwise, and full graph discovery methodologies are compared and evaluated. It is shown that causal graph discovery methods for ISM perform best using rowwise (SHD=160, F1-score=0.77) and full graph methods (SHD=135, F1-score=0.73).

AI.tldr: 本文提出将大语言模型（LLM）与解释结构模型（ISM）整合的LLM-ISM方法，通过自动化因果图发现替代传统依赖专家反复交互的建模流程，并比较了pairwise、k-wise、rowwise及full graph四种发现方法。
AI.motivation: 传统ISM建模需与领域专家反复交互直至达成共识，过程繁琐、劳动强度大，且难以扩展至包含数百个变量的研究。作者希望借助LLM作为"不完美专家"来自动化ISM中的因果图发现过程。
AI.method: 借鉴已有的基于LLM的因果图发现工作，构建LLM-ISM一体化方法；将ISM因果图发现问题分为pairwise、k-wise、rowwise和full graph四种发现策略，并进行对比评估。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，rowwise方法（SHD=160，F1-score=0.77）和full graph方法（SHD=135，F1-score=0.73）在ISM因果图发现任务中表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: LLM可有效辅助ISM的因果图发现，rowwise与full graph方法在该任务上表现最优，为ISM向大规模变量研究扩展提供了可行路径，但仍存在改进空间。

title: Design Space Exploration of Backside Clock Meshes for 2 nm GAAFET BSPDN Technology
summary: Clock meshes are used in high-performance VLSI designs to minimize skew and tolerate on-chip variation, but they spend scarce routing resources on premium metal layers. Backside power delivery creates a new option: it adds thick, low-resistance metal layers on the back of the wafer, and the power grid does not consume all of them. Flip-flops remain on the frontside; a backside mesh therefore cannot drive them directly, and every connection passes through a through-silicon via. We present the first design-space exploration of backside clock meshes, implemented in OpenROAD on GT2N, a 2 nm nanosheet technology. Four benchmarks (1,938 to 15,311 flip-flops) are explored with multi-objective Bayesian optimization, and every design point is verified by transistor-level SPICE simulation, since the cyclic mesh cannot be evaluated by static timing analysis. Across all four designs, the backside mesh consistently outperforms an identical frontside mesh, with on average 45% lower skew, 25% lower sink slew, 4.5% lower power, and 28% less frontside clock wiring, and its skew spread under 10,000-sample Monte Carlo is a third of the frontside mesh's.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次对背面时钟网格（backside clock mesh）进行设计空间探索，在2nm纳米片工艺GT2N上基于OpenROAD实现，采用多目标贝叶斯优化并用SPICE验证。结果显示背面网格全面优于同等正面网格：偏斜降低45%、sink压摆降低25%、功耗降低4.5%、正面时钟布线减少28%，且蒙特卡洛下偏斜离散度仅为正面网格的三分之一。
AI.motivation: 高性能VLSI设计使用时钟网格来最小化偏斜并容忍片上变异，但时钟网格会占用稀缺的优质金属层布线资源。背面供电技术提供了新思路：晶圆背面新增厚且低阻的金属层，而电源网格并未占满这些层，因此可将时钟网格迁移到背面以缓解正面布线压力。然而，触发器仍位于正面，背面网格无法直接驱动，每个连接都需经硅通孔（TSV），由此带来新的设计权衡问题，需要系统性的设计空间探索。
AI.method: 在OpenROAD流程上、针对2nm纳米片工艺GT2N实现背面时钟网格设计空间探索。选取四个基准设计（触发器规模1,938至15,311），采用多目标贝叶斯优化进行参数寻优。由于环形（cyclic）网格无法用静态时序分析（STA）评估，所有设计点均通过晶体管级SPICE仿真进行验证。同时与结构完全相同的正面时钟网格进行对照比较。
AI.result: 在四个设计上，背面网格持续优于同等正面网格：平均偏斜降低45%，sink压摆降低25%，功耗降低4.5%，正面时钟布线减少28%；在10,000次采样的蒙特卡洛分析中，背面网格的偏斜离散度仅为正面网格的三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 背面时钟网格是一种可行且显著优于正面网格的时钟分配方案，能同时改善偏斜、压摆、功耗与布线资源占用，并提升工艺变异容忍度。该工作证明借助背面供电层实现时钟网格具有实际价值，为先进工艺节点的时钟网络设计提供了新方向。

title: Traversing the Satisfaction-Diversity Frontier in Text-to-Image Diffusion
summary: Text-to-image generation enables users to explore several images generated from the same prompt. For these generated images to be useful, each one must reflect the user's preferences, measured by a learned reward, and differ visually from the others to maintain diversity. Existing methods are limited: they either address reward and diversity separately or combine them in one aggregate score, enabling high diversity to offset low rewards. In this paper, we address these limitations by formulating generation as satisficing: every image (candidate) must satisfy a reward floor and the batch of images must satisfy a diversity cutoff. The reward floor controls the balance between worst-candidate reward and batch diversity; we show that varying this floor defines a Pareto frontier. To traverse this frontier, we introduce SatisDive, a training-free inference-time method. SatisDive uses a batch-relative reward cutoff to distinguish lower- from higher-reward candidates, emphasizing reward improvement for candidates below the cutoff and diversity among candidates above it. On Pick-a-Pic, at matched DreamSim, SatisDive improves worst-candidate reward over FK steering by up to 0.43 with FLUX.1-dev as the base model and HPSv3 as the reward, and by up to 0.70 with SANA-1.6B as the base model and ImageReward as the reward. More broadly, across their overlapping DreamSim ranges, SatisDive's satisfaction-diversity curve Pareto-dominates FK steering's curve in each setting.

AI.tldr: 该论文将文本到图像生成重构为"满足式（satisficing）"问题：要求每张图像满足奖励下限、整批图像满足多样性阈值，并提出免训练推理期方法 SatisDive 来遍历由此定义的帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 同一提示词生成的多样图像需同时满足两点：每张图符合用户偏好（由学习到的奖励衡量），且彼此视觉上具有多样性。现有方法要么把奖励与多样性分开处理，要么合并为单一总分，导致高多样性可以掩盖低奖励。因此需要一个不让两者相互抵消的框架。
AI.method: 形式化为满足式生成：每个候选须满足奖励下限（reward floor），整批须满足多样性下限（diversity cutoff）；奖励下限控制最差候选奖励与批次多样性之间的权衡，并证明其变化刻画出一条帕累托前沿。提出 SatisDive，一种免训练、推理期方法：使用批次相对的奖励截断区分低奖励与高奖励候选，对低于截断者强调奖励提升，对高于截断者强调多样性。
AI.result: 在 Pick-a-Pic 上，于相同 DreamSim 条件下，SatisDive 相对 FK steering 提升最差候选奖励：FLUX.1-dev + HPSv3 提升达 0.43，SANA-1.6B + ImageReward 提升达 0.70。在各自重叠的 DreamSim 区间内，SatisDive 的满足度—多样性曲线在各设定下均帕累托占优 FK steering 的曲线。
AI.conclusion: 通过满足式建模可避免奖励与多样性的相互抵消，SatisDive 作为免训练推理期方法能有效提升最差候选奖励并在满足度—多样性权衡上取得帕累托占优，且适用于不同基座模型与奖励模型。

title: CITADEL: CWE-Guided Insertion of Hardware Trojans via Analysis of DFG-Enabled LLMs
summary: The increasing sophistication of Hardware Trojans (HTs) and system-level vulnerabilities poses significant risks to modern integrated circuits. However, constructing realistic HT scenarios, remains a substantial burden: researchers must manually analyze complex RTL structures, identify plausible weaknesses, and craft stealthy, synthesizable insertions that preserve functional correctness. This paper introduces CITADEL CWE-Guided Insertion of Trojans via Analysis of DFG-Enabled LLMs, a framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) and Data Flow Graphs (DFGs) to automate CWE-grounded HT synthesis. CITADEL uses structured CWE semantics together with DFG-derived structural context to assist the user in identifying relevant vulnerabilities, localize the module surrounding the chosen insertion point, and perform intent-conditioned RTL modification. The framework produces minimal, synthesizable, and interface-preserving HTs with ultra-rare triggers. Experimental evaluation across diverse RTL designs demonstrates that all generated HTs are 100% syntactically correct, remain undetectable under large-scale random simulation, and are functionally triggerable under their intended activation conditions. These results highlight CITADEL as a scalable and principled method for generating realistic HT benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CITADEL：基于LLM与DFG的CWE引导硬件木马自动植入框架
AI.motivation: 硬件木马（HT）与系统级漏洞日益复杂，对现代集成电路构成重大风险；但构建真实HT基准代价高：需人工分析复杂RTL结构、识别潜在弱点并手工编写隐蔽、可综合且不破坏功能的插入。为此需自动化手段降低基准构建负担。
AI.method: 提出CITADEL框架，利用LLM与数据流图（DFG）实现CWE引导的HT合成：以结构化CWE语义叠加DFG导出的结构上下文，辅助用户定位相关漏洞、定位插入点周围模块，并执行意图条件下的RTL修改，从而生成最小化、可综合、保持接口且触发器极难激活的木马。
AI.result: 在多种RTL设计上的实验表明：生成的HT 100%语法正确，在大规模随机仿真下不可检测，且在预设激活条件下可被功能触发。
AI.conclusion: CITADEL是一种可扩展、有原则的生成真实HT基准的方法。

title: PaNGEA: Parallel Node Generation and Exploration Algorithm on GPU
summary: Primal heuristics for finding high-quality feasible solutions are an important component in mixed-integer optimization (MIO) solvers. Recent advances in GPU-accelerated optimization algorithms show the potential of GPU acceleration for continuous optimization. In this paper, we introduce the Parallel Node Generation and Exploration Algorithm (PaNGEA), a GPU-friendly MIO primal heuristic. PaNGEA explores restricted subproblems by combining linear-relaxation solves with a local-search procedure designed for efficient batched execution on GPUs. In addition, instead of relying on a single heuristic for iterative variable fixing, we leverage GPU batching capabilities to generate and explore multiple subproblems in parallel. PaNGEA leverages GPU capabilities in two ways. First, on 283 MIPcc26 and MIPLIB instances, implementing a single-node primal heuristic on the GPU reduces the average gap integral by 8-18% relative to its CPU counterpart. Second, generating and exploring multiple nodes in parallel further reduces the average gap integral by 12-19%.

AI.tldr: 提出GPU友好的MIO原始启发式PaNGEA，通过GPU批处理并行生成与探索多个受限子问题，在保持解质量的同时显著降低平均Gap积分。
AI.motivation: 原始启发式对MIO求解器找到高质量可行解至关重要；GPU加速已在连续优化中展现潜力，但如何将GPU批量并行能力用于MIO原始启发式仍待探索。
AI.method: PaNGEA将线性松弛求解与面向GPU高效批处理的局部搜索过程结合以探索受限子问题；不再依赖单一启发式进行迭代变量固定，而是利用GPU批处理能力并行生成并探索多个子问题。
AI.result: 在283个MIPcc26与MIPLIB实例上：GPU实现的单节点原始启发式相比CPU版本平均使Gap积分降低8-18%；进一步并行生成与探索多节点再降低12-19%。
AI.conclusion: GPU批处理可有效提升MIO原始启发式性能，单节点GPU加速与多节点并行探索均显著改善解质量，为GPU加速MIO求解提供可行方向。

title: An AI-Based Multi-Stage Approach for Androgenetic Alopecia Assessment from Low-Magnification Scalp Images
summary: Androgenetic alopecia (AGA) is characterized by patterned follicular miniaturization, increased single-hair follicular units, and altered hair-shaft diameter. We present an automated quantitative scalp-analysis and clinical decision-support framework combining FU localization, ordinal visible-shaft counting, calibrated shaft-width estimation, regional aggregation, and an interpretable rule layer. The clinical cohort comprised 243 patients (127 AGA, 116 non-AGA), while the computer-vision experiments used 160 expert-annotated patients, 2,400 trichoscopic images, and approximately 158,000 FU annotations. Under patientdisjoint evaluation, YOLOv8m achieved test mAP@0.5=0.920 and recall=0.860; EfficientNet-B5 with a support-map channel achieved 87.0% expert-box count accuracy (macro F1=0.85). A separate 500-image set was processed end-to-end with detector-generated boxes, yielding MAE of 6.56 for follicle detection and 16.59 for follicle classification relative to human-expert annotations. The system is intended to assist, rather than replace, dermatologist interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套自动化的头皮定量分析与临床决策支持框架，整合毛囊单位定位、序数性可见毛干计数、标定毛干宽度估计、区域聚合与可解释规则层，用于雄激素性脱发的客观评估。
AI.motivation: 雄激素性脱发（AGA）以模式化毛囊微小化、单毛发毛囊单位增多及毛干直径改变为特征，传统评估依赖医生目视判读，主观性强、效率低，因此需要自动化、可量化的头皮分析方法以辅助临床决策。
AI.method: 构建融合毛囊单位（FU）定位、序数性可见毛干计数、标定毛干宽度估计、区域聚合及可解释规则层的自动化分析框架。临床队列纳入243例患者（127例AGA、116例非AGA）；计算机视觉实验使用160例专家标注患者、2,400张毛发镜图像及约158,000个FU标注。采用YOLOv8m进行检测，EfficientNet-B5结合support-map通道进行分类与计数，并在患者不交叉（patient-disjoint）条件下评估。
AI.result: YOLOv8m在测试集取得mAP@0.5=0.920、召回率=0.860；EfficientNet-B5（含support-map通道）达到87.0%的专家框计数准确率（宏F1=0.85）。另用500张图像以检测器生成框进行端到端处理，相对人类专家标注，毛囊检测MAE为6.56，毛囊分类MAE为16.59。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可实现头皮毛囊的自动化定量分析与临床决策支持，性能与专家标注较为接近；其定位是辅助而非替代皮肤科医生的判读。

title: Evaluating Multi-Dimensional Generalization of Large Language Models in Temporal Extraction Tasks
summary: Time and event expression extraction are fundamental temporal reasoning tasks, but the problem remains difficult due to annotation ambiguity, domain sensitivity, and unstable model behavior. Existing evaluations focus on in-domain performance, offering limited insight into reliability under distribution shifts. We evaluate multiple model configurations across families, architectures, and reasoning strategies over four dimensions of generalization, examining transfer from base performance, cross-dimensional correlations, and the effects of scale, architecture, and prompting. This provides a systematic study of how prompted LLMs generalize in time and event expression extraction tasks. We find that strong base-task performance generally predicts better generalization. However, this relationship weakens under substantial distribution shifts. Inductive prompting performs most consistently across domain shift, adversarial perturbations, compositionality, and length increase, while gains from scale, architecture, and deductive and abductive prompting strategies are uneven and dimension-specific. We conclude that LLM generalization in temporal extraction tasks cannot be predicted from any single dimension alone and cannot be reliably inferred from in-domain or single-dimension evaluations, highlighting the need for reasoning strategies that generalize across dimensions.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了提示式LLM在时间和事件表达抽取任务中的泛化能力，从四个泛化维度、多种模型配置和提示策略出发，发现基础性能强通常预示泛化更好但在显著分布偏移下关系减弱，归纳式提示最稳定，泛化无法由单一维度预测。
AI.motivation: 时间与事件表达抽取是时间推理的基础任务，但受标注歧义、领域敏感和模型行为不稳定影响而困难。现有评估多聚焦域内性能，对分布偏移下的可靠性了解有限，因此需要系统研究LLM在该任务上的泛化表现。
AI.method: 评估多种模型配置，覆盖不同模型家族、架构和推理策略，在四个泛化维度上考察：基础性能到泛化的迁移、跨维度相关性，以及规模、架构和提示策略的影响；并对比归纳、演绎与溯因等提示方式。
AI.result: 强基础任务性能通常预示更好的泛化，但在显著分布偏移下这种关系减弱。归纳式提示在域偏移、对抗扰动、组合性和长度增加上表现最一致；规模、架构以及演绎和溯因提示带来的增益不均衡且依赖具体维度。
AI.conclusion: LLM在时间抽取任务中的泛化无法由任一单一维度预测，也不能从域内或单维度评估中可靠推断，强调需要能跨维度泛化的推理策略。

title: Autonomous mobile robot operations logistics: a dataset of jobs, dispatch events and robot states
summary: Autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) increasingly perform material transport in production logistics, where their operation is governed by job generation, dispatching and robot control. We present MoRoOp, a dataset of AMR operations recorded in a laboratory kit preparation and supply scenario over nine eight-hour shifts. During each shift, an AMR executed stochastically generated kit supply, empty-box refill and charging jobs. The dataset links job specifications, the operations constituting each job, dispatch events documenting operation state transitions and outcomes, and robot-state observations comprising position, orientation, velocity, per-wheel state of charge and diagnostics. It contains 1,382 jobs, 4,815 operations, 19,352 dispatch events and 140,386 robot-state observations together with the kit specifications used during job generation. The dataset was recorded in an operating laboratory environment, and technically valid observations of delays, obstructed navigation and unsuccessful operations were retained. Both raw and cleaned robot-state tables are provided. Documented reuse directions include the evaluation of AI agents on operational decision records, disturbance detection, operation prediction, data-driven simulation and event-log analysis.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布 MoRoOp 数据集，记录自主移动机器人（AMR）在实验室套件准备与供应场景中连续九个八小时班次的运行数据，涵盖作业生成、调度与机器人控制全流程。
AI.motivation: AMR 在生产物流中承担物料运输，其运行涉及作业生成、调度和机器人控制，但缺乏能够同时刻画作业规格、操作过程、调度事件与机器人状态的真实运行数据集，限制了 AI 智能体评估、扰动检测、操作预测等研究。
AI.method: 在实验室套件准备与供应场景中采集九个八小时班次的 AMR 运行数据；每班次执行随机生成的套件供应、空箱补充和充电作业；数据关联作业规格、构成每个作业的操作、记录状态转移与结果的分派事件，以及包含位置、姿态、速度、单轮荷电状态与诊断信息的机器人状态观测；保留延迟、导航受阻和失败操作等技术上有效的观测，并提供原始和清洗后的机器人状态表。
AI.result: 数据集包含 1,382 个作业、4,815 个操作、19,352 个分派事件和 140,386 条机器人状态观测，并附带作业生成所用的套件规格。
AI.conclusion: MoRoOp 为 AMR 运行研究提供了多层级、真实环境下的数据集，支持 AI 智能体在运行决策记录上的评估、扰动检测、操作预测、数据驱动仿真和事件日志分析等复用方向。

title: MACTS-EM: Multi-Agent Collaborative Time Series Forecasting with Emergent Memory
summary: Time series forecasting remains a critical challenge across numerous domains. Despite significant advancements, existing approaches struggle with complex phenomena such as regime shifts, cross-domain knowledge transfer, and multimodal data integration. This paper introduces Multi-Agent Collaborative Time Series Forecasting with Emergent Memory (MACTS-EM), a novel framework where specialised agents collaborate to achieve superior forecasting performance. The MACTS-EM architecture integrates: (1) domain-specialised forecasting agents for pattern recognition, anomaly detection, causal inference, and uncertainty quantification; (2) a meta-cognitive layer for dynamic agent allocation; (3) an emergent memory mechanism enabling cross-domain pattern transfer; (4) multimodal contextual integration; and (5) adversarial robustness components. Evaluation across financial markets, climate patterns, energy consumption, and pandemic propagation demonstrates that MACTS-EM outperforms existing approaches in most scenarios, with 8-12% improvement in forecasting accuracy, 22-27% better zero-shot transfer capability, 16-21% enhanced resilience during regime shifts, and 15-18% faster recovery after distribution shifts. Our findings suggest that collaborative, agentic approaches to time series forecasting represent a promising direction beyond traditional architectures, particularly for complex real-world scenarios requiring multi-resolution temporal understanding and contextual adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出 MACTS-EM 多智能体协同时间序列预测框架，通过专业化智能体协作与涌现记忆机制，在多个领域超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测在金融、气候、能源、流行病等领域至关重要，但现有方法在机制转换（regime shifts）、跨域知识迁移（cross-domain knowledge transfer）和多模态数据融合（multimodal data integration）等复杂现象上仍存在明显不足。
AI.method: MACTS-EM 架构整合五个组件：(1) 领域专业化预测智能体，分别负责模式识别、异常检测、因果推断与不确定性量化；(2) 元认知层（meta-cognitive layer）实现动态智能体分配；(3) 涌现记忆机制（emergent memory）支持跨域模式迁移；(4) 多模态上下文融合；(5) 对抗鲁棒性组件。
AI.result: 在金融市场、气候模式、能源消费与流行病传播四类场景评估中，MACTS-EM 在多数情境下优于现有方法：预测精度提升 8-12%，零样本迁移能力提升 22-27%，机制转换期间鲁棒性增强 16-21%，分布漂移后恢复速度加快 15-18%。
AI.conclusion: 协同式、智能体化（agentic）的时间序列预测方法是超越传统架构的有前景方向，尤其适用于需要多分辨率时序理解与上下文自适应的复杂现实场景。

title: RAPID: Row-Parallel Arithmetic Processing in DRAM
summary: Processing-using-memory (PUM) architectures perform computation directly within DRAM to reduce costly data movement between memory and processors. Because charge-sharing operations are confined to individual bitlines, existing DRAM-PUM architectures reorganize data into column-oriented, bit-serial representations. This organization is fundamentally incompatible with the row-oriented, word-parallel layouts used by conventional processors and accelerators, requiring expensive data-layout transformations whenever computation transitions between PUM and conventional execution. In this paper, we present RAPID, a Row-parallel Arithmetic Processing-In-DRAM architecture. RAPID augments the DRAM subarray with two lightweight extensions: migration cells that enable localized horizontal data movement between neighboring bitlines and inversion cells that provide efficient in-array logical inversion. These primitives enable RAPID to operate directly on row-parallel, bit-parallel data, preserving CPU-compatible layouts while exploiting the massive parallelism of the DRAM subarray. In particular, RAPID demonstrates that localized horizontal communication is sufficient to realize shallow arithmetic networks and efficient parallel reduction for multiplication, reducing arithmetic latency while preserving throughput and eliminating costly data-layout transformations, all while maintaining the conventional DRAM array organization. We demonstrate the feasibility and overhead of augmenting DRAM subarrays with migration and inversion cells through detailed transistor-level layout and SPICE-validated circuit simulations. Using the RAPID compiler it is possible to evaluate the performance and data reorganization tradeoffs to ensure the best execution across combined CPU and PUM. Evaluating RAPID on 19 MLPerf benchmarks, there is a 5.9x higher end-to-end performance compared to SIMDRAM for DDR4 PUM execution.

AI.tldr: RAPID提出一种行并行算术存内计算DRAM架构，通过迁移单元与反相单元实现原位行并行、位并行计算，避免数据布局转换，在MLPerf基准上较SIMDRAM端到端性能提升5.9倍。
AI.motivation: 处理存内计算（PUM）直接在DRAM内完成运算以减少数据搬运。但现有DRAM-PUM受限于电荷共享仅作用于单条位线，数据被迫组织为列向、位串行格式，这与传统处理器/加速器的行向、字并行布局不兼容，导致在PUM与常规执行间切换时需昂贵的数据布局转换。
AI.method: RAPID在DRAM子阵列中引入两种轻量扩展：迁移单元（migration cells）实现相邻位线间的局部水平数据移动；反相单元（inversion cells）提供高效的阵列内逻辑反相。这些原语使RAPID能直接作用于行并行、位并行数据，保持CPU兼容布局并利用子阵列的大规模并行性；配合RAPID编译器评估性能与数据重组权衡。可行性由晶体管级版图与SPICE验证的电路仿真评估。
AI.result: 局部水平通信足以实现浅层算术网络与高效并行归约（用于乘法），在保持吞吐量的同时降低算术延迟并消除数据布局转换，且维持传统DRAM阵列组织。在19个MLPerf基准上，DDR4 PUM执行下端到端性能较SIMDRAM提升5.9倍。
AI.conclusion: RAPID通过迁移与反相单元的行并行算术处理，证明无需改变DRAM阵列组织即可实现高效原位计算，消除PUM与常规执行间的布局转换开销，为CPU与PUM协同执行提供可行且高效的架构方案。

title: THPL: A Vision-to-Language Decision Support Framework for Rainbow Trout Feeding Management in RAS
comment: Meng Liang and Guanbo Feng contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Zhihong Ma and Ying Liu. 50 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Supplementary video: https://youtu.be/Tg2Qk7m46-A
summary: In Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS), precision feeding is critical for minimizing costs and improving fish welfare. However, existing methods lack cognitive alignment between fish behaviors and management knowledge, impeding translation into executable, interpretable feeding decisions. To address this, we propose THPL, a generative feeding decision framework tailored for rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) in RAS. First, Fishsort extracts trajectories to establish an Activity Coefficient (AC) quantifying feeding intensity. Second, a Hierarchical Behavior Encoder (HBE) models individual temporal progression and collective dynamics using Temporal and Set Transformers, transforming trajectory tensors into dual-evidence representations of explicit physical and implicit soft tokens. Finally, these tokens are integrated with environmental parameters, metadata, and expert rules to fine-tune an LLM via LoRA, followed by counterfactual multimodal Direct Preference Optimization (mDPO) to reinforce causal reasoning. Results show that AC exhibits a statistically significant monotonic positive correlation with expert-annotated feeding intensity (Spearman $ρ= 0.925$, $p < 0.001$). Ablations indicate that decision accuracy improves from 33.33% (text-only baseline) to 93.33% with dual-evidence tokens, confirming that continuous spatiotemporal tokens provide necessary physical grounding for LLMs. Compared with standard LoRA, counterfactual mDPO elevates decision accuracy from 93.33% to 96.67%, advances METEOR from 58.10% to 85.30%, reduces Self-BLEU-2 from 58.79% to 52.88%, and increases Distinct-3 from 6.68% to 7.81%, suppressing templating and actuation biases while reinforcing causal consistency and operational safety. Overall, by integrating continuous kinematics with LLM reasoning, this study provides a novel decision support paradigm for precision aquaculture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出THPL生成式投喂决策框架，面向RAS中虹鳟，通过行为轨迹提取、层级行为编码生成双证据token，并结合LoRA微调与反事实mDPO强化LLM因果推理，实现高精度可解释投喂决策。
AI.motivation: RAS中精准投喂对降低成本与提升鱼类福利至关重要，但现有方法缺乏鱼群行为与管理知识之间的认知对齐，难以转化为可执行、可解释的投喂决策。
AI.method: 1) Fishsort提取轨迹并构建量化摄食强度的活动系数AC；2) 层级行为编码器(HBE)用Temporal与Set Transformer建模个体时序与群体动态，将轨迹张量转为显式物理与隐式软token的双证据表示；3) 融合环境参数、元数据与专家规则，经LoRA微调LLM，并采用反事实多模态DPO(mDPO)强化因果推理。
AI.result: AC与专家标注摄食强度呈显著单调正相关(Spearman ρ=0.925, p<0.001)；消融显示决策准确率由纯文本33.33%提升至双证据token的93.33%；相比标准LoRA，反事实mDPO将准确率由93.33%提至96.67%，METEOR由58.10%升至85.30%，Self-BLEU-2由58.79%降至52.88%，Distinct-3由6.68%升至7.81%，抑制模板化与驱动偏差并增强因果一致性与操作安全性。
AI.conclusion: 通过融合连续运动学与LLM推理，本研究为精准水产养殖提供了新的决策支持范式。

title: Out of Sync, Out of Sight: Phantom State Attacks against IIoT Intrusion Detection
summary:
Machine learning-based intrusion detection systems (IDS) are critical for securing Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) environments. Most adversarial research against them perturbs the feature vector or the traffic that produces it, and depends on gradient access, repeated model queries, or a learned model of benign traffic. A smaller line of work reshapes packet timing without querying the detector, but makes malicious traffic mimic a learned model of benign timing. Across these approaches, one assumption of industrial monitoring pipelines has received little attention: temporal synchronization. An IDS reconstructs operational state by aggregating telemetry into sliding or tumbling windows, so its view depends not only on what is observed but on when each observation falls relative to a window boundary.
  We introduce the Phantom State Attack (PSA), which exploits that dependence under a passive, zero-query threat model. Rather than modifying packets, perturbing features, querying the classifier, or fitting any model of benign traffic, PSA injects bounded timing drift calibrated to the attack flow's own inter-arrival variability, moving observations across the nearest window boundary by the minimal shift needed. The IDS then reconstructs a phantom state that diverges from the true process state.
  We evaluate PSA on ToN-IoT and CIC IIoT 2025 (DataSense), against Random Forest, MLP and XGBoost, measuring detection degradation, synchronization distortion, stealth, and attacker cost. PSA degrades detection on flows carrying enough packets for window-boundary redistribution, and leaves others almost unchanged, so its effect is conditional. A query-based baseline reaches higher raw success but needs many queries per window, while PSA needs none. The results identify temporal aggregation as an attack surface reachable under weaker assumptions than prior evasion techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Phantom State Attack (PSA)，利用工业物联网 IDS 中时序窗口聚合的同步假设，在被动、零查询威胁模型下通过注入有界时序漂移，使观测跨越最近的窗口边界，诱导 IDS 重建出与真实过程状态偏离的“幻影状态”。
AI.motivation: 现有针对机器学习 IDS 的对抗研究多依赖梯度访问、重复查询或学习正常流量模型，且普遍忽视工业监控流水线中的时序同步假设：IDS 通过滑动/滚动窗口聚合遥测数据来重建运行状态，其视图不仅取决于观测内容，还取决于观测落入窗口的相对时刻。这一被忽略的依赖构成了潜在攻击面。
AI.method: PSA 采用被动、零查询威胁模型，不修改数据包、不扰动特征、不查询分类器、也不拟合任何正常流量模型；而是依据攻击流自身的到达间隔变异性，注入有界时序漂移，以最小位移将观测移动到最近的窗口边界之外，从而使 IDS 重建出与真实过程状态发散的幻影状态。实验在 ToN-IoT 与 CIC IIoT 2025 (DataSense) 数据集上，针对 Random Forest、MLP 和 XGBoost，评估检测退化、同步失真、隐蔽性与攻击者成本。
AI.result: PSA 对数据包数量足以进行窗口边界重分布的流量可造成检测性能退化，而对其他流量影响甚微，效果具有条件性。基于查询的基线方法原始成功率更高，但每个窗口需要多次查询；PSA 则无需任何查询。
AI.conclusion: 研究将时序聚合识别为一种可在比先前规避技术更弱假设下触及的攻击面，揭示了工业监控流水线中窗口同步机制的安全脆弱性。

title: Lightweight and Resource-Efficient Perception for Robotic Guide Dogs
summary: Multi-camera streaming perception is increasingly deployed on heterogeneous edge platforms shared with co-resident workloads, yet accelerator placement is often evaluated using isolated single-stream experiments and mean streaming average precision (sAP). Using two end-to-end pipelines on a single GPU--NPU platform, we show that isolated evaluation can mis-rank deployment-time placement. Although the GPU pipeline is preferred in isolation, GPU-localized contention introduces deadline misses that make detections stale and can reverse the preferred placement before full GPU saturation. The NPU pipeline is less accurate than the GPU pipeline on small and medium objects in isolation, but nearly matches it on large objects. The largest absolute sAP losses in our latency and contention experiments occur for large objects. In our four-stream experiments, the preferred placement depends on which path becomes stale, and increasing GPU-side contention shifts the best placement from All-GPU to All-NPU. Under a GPU-saturating vision--language co-tenant, All-NPU achieves $5.2\times$ the worst-stream sAP of All-GPU. Because mean sAP can hide severe single-stream degradation, evaluation should report contention sweeps, deadline-miss rates on both paths, and worst-stream sAP alongside mean sAP.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出多相机流式感知的加速器放置评估不应仅依赖隔离单流实验与平均sAP，而应纳入共驻负载竞争、截止期错失率与最差流sAP。
AI.motivation: 多相机流式感知日益部署在与共驻负载共享的异构边缘平台上，但加速器放置常以隔离单流实验和平均sAP评估，可能误判实际部署时的最优放置方案。
AI.method: 在单GPU-NPU平台上构建两条端到端流水线，开展延迟实验与竞争实验，并进行四流实验；在不同GPU侧竞争强度下比较All-GPU与All-NPU放置，并引入GPU饱和的视觉-语言共驻负载场景。
AI.result: 隔离评估会误排部署时放置：隔离下GPU流水线更优，但GPU本地竞争导致截止期错失、检测变陈旧，在GPU完全饱和前即可逆转最优放置。NPU流水线隔离下中小物体精度低于GPU、大物体几乎持平；延迟与竞争实验中大物体绝对sAP损失最大。四流实验中，最优放置取决于哪条路径变陈旧，GPU侧竞争增加使最优放置从All-GPU转向All-NPU；在GPU饱和共驻负载下，All-NPU最差流sAP达All-GPU的5.2倍。
AI.conclusion: 平均sAP会掩盖严重的单流退化，因此评估应同时报告竞争扫描、两条路径的截止期错失率以及最差流sAP。

title: A Simulation-Grounded Agentic VLM Framework for Wildfire Monitoring and Reporting
summary: Effective wildfire monitoring requires relating visual evidence to physical fire dynamics, yet real videos with synchronized physical annotations are scarce and high-fidelity 3D simulation is costly. We present a simulation-grounded vision-language model (VLM) framework that automatically converts 2D wildfire simulations into labeled video episodes. A fixed Blender mapping produces low-detail 3D proxies aligned with simulator terrain, fuel layout, fire activity, and wind cues; controllable video generation supplies richer appearance. The proxies are intermediate representations rather than finely rendered final scenes. Generated videos and simulator labels form reusable multimodal memory for a training-free multi-agent VLM system that retrieves reference episodes, reconciles visual and memory-based predictions, and produces structured wildfire reports. On held-out generated episodes, video memory achieves 51.5% exact four-tag accuracy, compared with 22.6% for direct VLM querying and 16-17% for text-only memory; the complete system achieves 77.3% accuracy on six simulator-derived report fields. Component ablations, cross-generator tests, and three real-UAV evaluations assess retrieval, reporting, generator changes, and observable monitoring tasks. The framework connects automatic simulation-to-proxy conversion with memory-based VLM reasoning under scarce real-world physical annotations.

AI.tldr: 提出仿真基础（simulation-grounded）的视觉语言模型框架，将2D野火仿真自动转为带标注视频片段，用3D代理与可控视频生成构建多模态记忆，供免训练多智能体VLM系统检索与推理，生成结构化野火报告。
AI.motivation: 野火监测需将视觉证据与物理火行为关联，但同步物理标注的真实视频稀缺，且高保真3D仿真成本高昂，缺乏可复用的数据与推理桥梁。
AI.method: 固定Blender流程将仿真地形、燃料布局、火活动与风场线索映射为低保真3D代理（作为中间表示而非精细渲染场景）；结合可控视频生成增强外观；生成的视频与仿真标签构成可复用多模态记忆。多智能体VLM系统免训练地检索参考片段、融合视觉与记忆预测，输出结构化野火报告。
AI.result: 在留出生成片段上，视频记忆取得51.5%四标签精确准确率，直接VLM查询为22.6%，纯文本记忆为16–17%；完整系统在六项仿真导出报告字段上达77.3%。并通过组件消融、跨生成器测试与三项真实无人机评估验证检索、报告、生成器更换及可观测监测任务。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在真实物理标注稀缺条件下，将自动仿真到代理的转换与基于记忆的VLM推理相连接，为野火监测提供可复用、可迁移的多模态推理方案。

title: Learning When to Commit from Partial Speech for End-to-End Simultaneous Speech Translation
summary: Simultaneous speech translation must emit useful target text before the source is complete while preserving every committed token. We adapt a full-utterance speech language model using prefix supervision derived from its own complete- and partial-waveform translations, requiring neither transcripts nor human translations. We compare single-turn forced-prefix and multi-turn append-only decoding, use a confidence threshold to control the inference-time quality--latency trade-off, and vary the density of training prefixes with a separate synthesis margin. On FLEURS and CoVoST2 in three language directions, prefix training improves quality--latency frontiers over the unadapted model, and confidence provides the broadest consistently competitive operating range. Multi-turn decoding is generally stronger at low latency; under multi-turn training, commit-calibration error falls by 63--68% overall and 68--80% at early prefixes, whereas single-turn training provides only modest overall calibration gains and no early-prefix improvement. A small synthesis margin sometimes extends the frontier to lower latency, particularly on shorter utterances, while a larger margin degrades translation quality and calibration. Prefix adaptation therefore improves simultaneous speech translation, especially under multi-turn append-only decoding, while synthesis density introduces a non-monotonic quality--latency trade-off.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种无需转录或人工翻译的自监督前缀适应方法，通过模型自身完整与部分波形翻译生成前缀监督，用于同时语音翻译；实验表明前缀训练可改善质量-延迟前沿，多轮追加式解码在低延迟下更强且校准误差大幅下降。
AI.motivation: 同时语音翻译需在源语音未完成时输出目标文本，且必须保持已提交词元的一致性（不修改已输出内容）。现有全语句语音语言模型并非为此场景设计，而获取前缀级监督通常依赖转录或人工翻译，成本高。因此需要一种不依赖外部标注、能适配同时翻译并控制质量-延迟权衡的方法。
AI.method: 基于全语句语音语言模型，利用模型自身对完整波形与部分波形的翻译结果构造前缀监督，无需转录与人工翻译。对比单轮强制前缀解码与多轮仅追加（append-only）解码；采用置信度阈值控制推理时的质量-延迟权衡；通过独立的合成边界（synthesis margin）调节训练前缀密度。
AI.result: 在FLEURS与CoVoST2的三个语言方向上，前缀训练相对未适配模型改善质量-延迟前沿；置信度提供最宽且稳定的竞争性工作区间。多轮解码在低延迟下总体更强；多轮训练使提交校准误差整体下降63–68%，早期前缀下降68–80%，而单轮训练仅有有限整体校准收益且早期前缀无改善。较小合成边界有时可将前沿延伸至更低延迟（尤其短语句），较大边界则损害翻译质量与校准。
AI.conclusion: 前缀适应可有效提升同时语音翻译，尤其在多轮仅追加解码下效果显著；合成前缀密度带来非单调的质量-延迟权衡，需谨慎选择边界大小。

title: OpenRUA: Robot-Use Agents Are Zero-Shot Visuomotor Policies
summary: Coding agents are extending their reach into the physical world by writing and executing robot control programs. One might expect the agents to use the existing mature software stack that engineers have developed over decades to access sensors and control motion. Yet prior work primarily engineers complex custom harnesses to orchestrate agents for robot use, particularly by prescribing specialized workflows and providing bespoke interfaces. This raises the question: "Is such additional harness engineering necessary?" We introduce OpenRUA, a zero-abstraction harness that bypasses bespoke abstraction layers by providing off-the-shelf coding agents with only terminal access to the robot's native software interface ROS 2. OpenRUA employs a minimalist workspace-as-harness design, only offering ROS 2 documentation and basic tools while leaving the coding agent to organize its own work without orchestrating any agentic workflow. Within this workspace, OpenRUA recasts perception as file I/O and manipulation as coding. With Claude Code powered by Claude Opus 5, OpenRUA achieves success rates of 99.0% on CaP-Bench and 87.0% on LIBERO-PRO, demonstrating that an off-the-shelf coding agent can serve as a zero-shot visuomotor policy through the robot's native interface, without bespoke primitives or task-specific training. Under this minimalist design, further analysis reveals striking emergent behaviors of coding agents: (1) For perception, the agent spontaneously writes programs that process raw sensory inputs and derive metric measurements in 96.80% of episodes. (2) For manipulation, the agent spontaneously builds motion-control clients (e.g., gripper control) in 95.87% of episodes and closed-loop control programs (e.g., adjusting motion based on sensor feedback) in 50.13% of episodes. Our code is available at https://github.com/terminalworld/OpenRUA.

AI.tldr: 提出零抽象外壳 OpenRUA，仅给编码智能体终端访问 ROS 2 的权限，即可零样本充当视觉运动策略，并在 CaP-Bench 与 LIBERO-PRO 上取得高成功率。
AI.motivation: 既有工作普遍为机器人场景手工构建复杂的定制化外壳（编排工作流、提供专用接口）来驱动编码智能体，而机器人领域本身已有成熟软件栈（ROS 2）可直接访问传感器与控制运动。作者由此质疑：这种额外的"外壳工程"是否真的必要？
AI.method: 提出 OpenRUA —— 一个零抽象外壳：不设计专用抽象层，只给通用编码智能体提供对机器人原生软件接口 ROS 2 的终端访问。采用极简的"工作区即外壳"设计，仅提供 ROS 2 文档和基础工具，不编排任何智能体工作流，由智能体自主组织工作。在该工作区内，将感知重构为文件 I/O、将操作重构为编码任务。实验使用 Claude Code（由 Claude Opus 5 驱动）。
AI.result: 在 CaP-Bench 上成功率达 99.0%，在 LIBERO-PRO 上达 87.0%。分析显示显著涌现行为：感知方面，96.80% 的回合中智能体自发编写程序处理原始传感输入并推导度量测量值；操作方面，95.87% 的回合中自发构建运动控制客户端（如夹爪控制），50.13% 的回合中构建闭环控制程序（如基于传感器反馈调整运动）。
AI.conclusion: 通用编码智能体可通过机器人原生接口充当零样本视觉运动策略，无需专用原语或任务特定训练，表明额外的定制外壳工程并非必要；同时揭示了编码智能体在极简设计下自发形成感知计算与闭环控制等涌现行为。

title: TRACE: A Reproducible Benchmark for Electricity Price Forecasting with Official Operational Text
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Time Series (FMTS)
summary: Electricity price forecasting (EPF) supports scheduling, bidding, and risk management in electricity markets, yet existing benchmarks focus mainly on numerical inputs, leaving the forecasting value of forecast-time textual context insufficiently evaluated. We introduce TRACE, a reproducible benchmark of 7,300 zone--day instances pairing prices from five zones in a major U.S. market with official operational text available at the forecast cutoff. TRACE reconstructs official operational text at each cutoff, preventing post-cutoff information leakage. We evaluate TRACE for semantic alignment and forecasting value. Semantic assessments align with central movement and both tail risks in ground-truth prices, most consistently for upper-tail price risk. Forecasting value is reflected in a median 7.4\% reduction in upper-tail pinball loss across time-series foundation models. A controlled cross-day text-mismatch ablation reverses the gains, falling below the no-text baseline.

AI.tldr: TRACE是一个可复现的电价预测基准，包含7300个"区域-日"实例，将美国某主要市场五个区域的电价与预测截止时点可获得的官方运行文本配对，并防止截止后信息泄漏，用于评估文本上下文的语义对齐与预测价值。
AI.motivation: 现有电价预测基准主要聚焦数值输入，对预测时刻可获得的文本上下文（如官方运行文本）的预测价值评估不足；同时文本若处理不当易引入截止后信息泄漏，削弱评估可信度。
AI.method: 构建TRACE基准：包含7,300个区域-日实例，覆盖美国某主要市场五个区域，将电价与预测截止时点的官方运行文本配对；在每个截止时点重建官方运行文本以杜绝信息泄漏；从语义对齐和预测价值两个维度评估，并采用跨日文本错配的受控消融实验。
AI.result: 语义评估结果与真实电价的中枢走势及双侧尾部风险一致，其中上尾价格风险最为稳定；预测价值体现为在多个时间序列基础模型上，上尾pinball损失中位数降低7.4%；跨日文本错配消融使增益反转，表现低于无文本基线。
AI.conclusion: 预测截止时点可获得的文本上下文对电价预测具有实证价值，尤其在上尾风险方面；TRACE为文本增强的电价预测提供了可复现、无信息泄漏的评估框架。

title: PEEK: Heterogeneous Parallelism for Privileged Error Detection in Safety-Critical Processors
comment: This paper has been accepted for publication at MICRO 2026. This arXiv submission is the pre-camera-ready version; the final camera-ready version will appear in the MICRO 2026 conference proceedings
summary: Heterogeneous parallel error detection architecture has been widely studied for safeguarding OoO superscalar processors in safetycritical systems, as it achieves significantly lower hardware overhead compared to traditional LockStep, by exploiting the parallelism that exists in a secondary execution. However, previous works do not cover the protection of privileged-mode execution, impeding their effectiveness in real-world deployment. Moreover, naive extension to privileged-mode can cause a litany of issues, from abysmal performance due to high synchronization costs, to full deadlocks. Here, we present PEEK, the first privileged parallel error detection architecture. Based on a deep analysis of privileged execution, we redesign the verification pipeline, addressing all the bottlenecks and bugs identified in privileged-mode protection. Evaluated using various metrics on an RTL-level full system running Linux, PEEK achieves full-privilege protection on Linux with negligible performance slowdown and affordable hardware overhead. PEEK has been taped out using a 28nm process, and its source is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PEEK-3000.

AI.tldr: PEEK是首个面向特权模式执行的并行错误检测架构，通过重新设计验证流水线，解决了特权模式保护中的性能与死锁问题，在Linux全系统上以可忽略的性能损失和可接受的硬件开销实现全特权保护，并已完成28nm流片。
AI.motivation: 异构并行错误检测利用二次执行的并行性，相比传统LockStep显著降低硬件开销，广泛用于安全关键系统中乱序超标量处理器的保护。但已有工作未覆盖特权模式执行，导致其在真实部署中失效；而朴素扩展到特权模式又会因高同步成本带来极差性能甚至死锁。
AI.method: 基于对特权执行的深入分析，PEEK重新设计了验证流水线，针对特权模式保护中识别出的所有瓶颈与缺陷进行改进，从而构建首个特权并行错误检测架构。
AI.result: 在运行Linux的RTL级全系统上使用多种指标评估，PEEK实现了Linux上的全特权保护，性能损失可忽略，硬件开销可接受，并已完成28nm工艺流片，源码已公开。
AI.conclusion: PEEK首次将并行错误检测扩展到特权模式，解决了该场景下的关键瓶颈，兼顾了保护完整性、性能与硬件成本，具备实际部署价值。

title: FlashSinkhorn 2: Block-Sparse Entropic Optimal Transport
summary: Streaming GPU solvers for entropic optimal transport (EOT), such as FlashSinkhorn, avoid storing the dense kernel but still evaluate all $n\times m$ point pairs in every Sinkhorn iteration. We present \textbf{FlashSinkhorn~2} (FS2), a solver for squared-Euclidean cost on low-dimensional point clouds that solves large discrete EOT problems to a prescribed marginal residual on a single GPU by coupling two stages. A coarse stage solves on cell centroids, lifts the potentials to every point and, when a sampled marginal check rejects the lift, continues on the centroids, replacing most point-level updates. A block-sparse fine stage then removes the centroid error that coarse updates cannot. Its Morton-ordered blocks support screening and fused tensor-core execution, and a threshold set by the block masses bounds each omitted tile's contribution to every row and column. On synthetic benchmarks, FS2 reaches the target residual on all 32 problems and GeomLoss multiscale on 10. On one A100, FS2 solves discrete EOT between two $1.34\times10^8$-particle measures from a cosmological $N$-body simulation, at an entropic blur equal to the mean interparticle distance, to an all-particle marginal residual below 0.01 in under 2.5 hours. To our knowledge, it is the largest discrete EOT problem solved to this accuracy within hours. For reproducibility, we release an open-source implementation at https://github.com/ot-triton-lab/flash-sinkhorn

AI.tldr: 提出 FlashSinkhorn 2（FS2），一种面向低维点云平方欧氏代价的单 GPU 流式 EOT 求解器，通过"粗粒度质心阶段 + 块稀疏精细阶段"两阶段耦合，在 2.5 小时内求解 1.34 亿×1.34 亿规模的离散 EOT 问题，全粒子边缘残差低于 0.01。
AI.motivation: 现有流式 GPU 求解器（如 FlashSinkhorn）虽避免存储稠密核矩阵，但在每次 Sinkhorn 迭代中仍需评估全部 n×m 个点对，计算开销巨大，难以扩展到亿级粒子规模的离散 EOT 问题。
AI.method: 采用两阶段耦合架构：1）粗粒度阶段在单元质心上求解，将势函数提升到每个点；当采样的边缘校验拒绝该提升时，继续在质心上迭代，从而替换掉大部分点级更新；2）块稀疏精细阶段消除粗粒度更新无法处理的质心误差。精细阶段采用 Morton 排序分块以支持筛选与融合张量核执行，并由块质量设定阈值来界定每个被省略瓦片对每行每列的贡献上界。
AI.result: 在合成基准上，FS2 在全部 32 个问题上达到目标残差，GeomLoss 多尺度方法仅在其中 10 个达到；在单张 A100 上，FS2 求解两个来自宇宙 N 体模拟的 1.34×10^8 粒子测度之间的离散 EOT，熵模糊度等于平均粒子间距，全粒子边缘残差低于 0.01，耗时不足 2.5 小时。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是数小时内以该精度求解的最大规模离散 EOT 问题；相关工作已开源发布于 GitHub 以保证可复现性。

title: Pincer: Resource Authorization for Agents using a Digital Twin
summary: Coding agents have become increasingly long-horizon, autonomous, reliant on general-purpose shell and maintain their own persistent memory for self-improvement. While these capabilities have made the agents powerful, they have also made them harder to defend against external adversaries. Defenses that restrict this architecture --- typed tools, information-flow control, or policy prediction engines --- give up too much functionality to be adopted. Agents deployed today (e.g. Claude, Codex) rely on a combination of user-mediated and automode sandboxing as their primary defense. In user-mediated sandboxing, user-maintained policies decay over time and repeated permission requests cause user fatigue, while auto mode's tool-call classifiers learn no user-specific policy and are not meant to defend against adversarial setups. Pincer is a new defense that operates at the resource layer and works alongside existing defenses at the tool-call layer like the auto mode. At the core of Pincer lies a digital twin, an isolated-context model that automatically learns and enforces dynamic user-specific least-privilege policies. The digital twin keeps continually learning the user's preferences allowing it to act as the user's proxy for the agent's permission requests. To emulate the learning phase, we propose a new usercentric dataset with examples following a multi-day transcript of user-agent interaction. Our evaluation shows that Pincer performs strongly on both security and utility in comparison to several baselines which includes variants of LLM judges and adaptations of Conseca (HotOS '25). We highlight attack types where Pincer's design leads to a significant security improvement compared to all other baselines, while outperforming the baselines even for other types of attacks.

AI.tldr: Pincer：一种在资源层运行、与工具调用层防御并存的编码智能体防御方案。其核心是"数字孪生"——一个隔离上下文模型，自动学习并执行动态的、用户特定的最小权限策略，并作为用户代理处理权限请求，在安全性与实用性上均优于LLM评判器与Conseca等基线。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体日益长周期、自主化，依赖通用shell并维护持久记忆以自我改进，这使其更强大但也更难防御外部对手。限制该架构的防御（类型化工具、信息流控制、策略预测引擎）牺牲过多功能而难以采用。当前部署的智能体主要依赖用户介导沙箱与自动模式沙箱：前者策略随时间衰减、频繁权限请求致用户疲劳；后者工具调用分类器不学习用户特定策略，也非为对抗性场景设计。因此需要一种不牺牲功能、能学习用户特定最小权限策略的防御。
AI.method: Pincer在资源层运行，与工具调用层的现有防御（如自动模式）协同。其核心为"数字孪生"：一个隔离上下文的模型，自动学习并执行动态的、用户特定的最小权限策略，持续学习用户偏好，充当用户代理来响应智能体的权限请求。为模拟学习阶段，作者提出一个以用户为中心的新型数据集，包含多日用户-智能体交互转录示例。
AI.result: 评估显示Pincer在安全性与实用性上均表现强劲，优于多种基线（包括LLM评判器变体及Conseca（HotOS '25）的改编版）。在Pincer设计带来显著安全提升的攻击类型上优于所有基线，即便在其他类型攻击上也超越基线。
AI.conclusion: Pincer通过资源层的数字孪生持续学习用户特定最小权限策略，在不牺牲智能体功能的前提下与工具调用层防御互补，实现了优于现有基线的安全性与实用性，为长周期自主编码智能体提供了一种可行且易采用的防御范式。

title: Closing the Prediction Gap: Completing Machine Shape So That Predicted Time, Power, Energy, and Mapping Match What Real Hardware Does
summary:
A companion paper derives a weighted, communication free partition for heterogeneous, multi institution device ensembles from each device measured shape, rho_machine(d), validated on real hardware. Its experiments show rho_machine is incomplete: fp32 to fp16 speedup and power shifts are not fully indexed, and memory capacity predictions rely on an assumed, not measured, reservation overhead.
  This paper closes that gap, indexing five unmeasured fields in the psi selection vocabulary: memory capacity $M_i^{cap}$, power draw $P_i$, execution unit capability $X_d$, compiler directive configuration $C_d$, and memory reservation overhead $R_d$. We introduce reached(d), a Boolean for whether compiled code dispatches to specialized hardware, explaining the NVIDIA fp16 power shift that hardware availability alone cannot predict.
  MoA fixes a computation independently of its target, so compiler directives get a two part admissibility criterion: select a real hardware quantity without discretionary reordering, and be deterministic, not compiler overridable. Across Intel, AMD, NVIDIA, OpenMP, OpenACC, and Open MPI, this admits only cache placement controls, deterministic vector or tile widths, and occupancy caps; heuristics like autotuning are excluded and absorbed into a residual epsilon$(k)_d$.
  We validate on five devices: A100, H100, V100, MI100, and Max 1550, measuring or establishing all five fields on each. Reachability proves real but partial, occupancy limits are device specific, and reservation overhead ranges about 0.004 to 0.030. A residual of negative 9.8 percent for the excluded Triton autotuner shows an unvalidated heuristic can act opposite a presumed penalty. These results close all five fields for every device in the companion ensemble, converting assumed behavior into measured, target specific quantities.

AI.tldr: 该文在伴随论文的单机实测形状模型基础上，补齐 ψ 选择词汇表中五个未测量字段（显存容量、功耗、执行单元能力、编译器指令配置、显存预留开销），提出 reached(d) 布尔量解释 fp16 功耗迁移，并给出编译器指令的两部分可采纳性判据，在 A100/H100/V100/MI100/Max 1550 上完成实测验证。
AI.motivation: 伴随论文的通信无关加权划分依赖每台设备的实测形状 rho_machine(d)，但其实验暴露三点不完整：fp32→fp16 的加速比与功耗迁移未被完整索引；显存容量预测依赖假设而非实测的预留开销；五个字段在 ψ 选择词汇表中缺失，导致行为只能被假定而无法被测量。
AI.method: 1) 在 ψ 选择词汇表中索引五个未测量字段：显存容量 M_i^cap、功耗 P_i、执行单元能力 X_d、编译器指令配置 C_d、显存预留开销 R_d；2) 引入 reached(d)，判断编译代码是否派发到专用硬件，解释硬件可用性无法预测的 NVIDIA fp16 功耗迁移；3) 因 MoA 将计算与目标解耦，对编译器指令施加两部分可采纳性判据——选取真实硬件量且不允许随意重排序、且必须确定不可被编译器覆盖；4) 在 Intel、AMD、NVIDIA、OpenMP、OpenACC、Open MPI 平台上筛选，仅接纳缓存放置控制、确定性向量/分块宽度、占用上限，将自动调优等启发式排除并吸收进残差 epsilon(k)_d。
AI.result: 在 A100、H100、V100、MI100、Max 1550 五台设备上测量或确立全部五个字段。可达性被证明真实但部分成立；占用上限具有设备特异性；预留开销约在 0.004–0.030 区间。被排除的 Triton 自动调优器呈 −9.8% 残差，说明未经验证的启发式可能产生与预设惩罚相反的效果。
AI.conclusion: 该文为伴随集合中的每台设备闭合了全部五个字段，把假定行为转化为实测的、目标特定的量，从而弥补 rho_machine 的不完整性。

title: DeepStratNet: A Context-Aware Coordinate Regression Framework for Seismic Horizon Tracking under Sparse Labels
summary: Automatic horizon tracking is a foundational task in 3D seismic interpretation. Most existing deep learning approaches formulate it as dense semantic segmentation, typically using U-Net-based architectures. The model produces a probability map over all pixels that must be post-processed to extract precise horizon coordinates, while horizon picks in time/depth must be converted into dense masks for training. Unpicked seismic traces are consequently treated as background, which can hinder convergence, and both pre- and post-processing can introduce errors into the final interpretation. Moreover, 2D segmentation models do not inherently capture inter-slice context, while 3D models are often computationally prohibitive. We instead formulate horizon tracking as a bounded coordinate regression problem, where the model directly predicts the time/depth coordinate of the target horizon at each lateral position. We propose a lightweight regression head compatible with any pretrained vision backbone, coupled with an LSTM module to model inter-slice context and produce a continuous horizon surface across the volume. A combination of L1 and L2 losses supervises predictions at valid horizon picks, while a geology-informed regularization enforces lateral continuity between successive traces. Under controlled experimental conditions, we evaluate four pretrained vision backbones under both segmentation and regression configurations on a seismic volume from New Zealand. The proposed approach consistently outperforms its segmentation counterparts quantitatively, using metrics including RMSE and PCC, and qualitatively, while also demonstrating greater robustness to increasing sparsity of training picks. Finally, we show that prediction variation across successive traces captures local variations in geological complexity, providing an automated quality control measure for downstream seismic interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文将地震层位追踪重新表述为有界坐标回归问题，提出一种可与任意预训练视觉主干兼容的轻量回归头，配合LSTM建模层间上下文，并利用L1+L2损失及地质约束正则化进行监督，在新西兰三维地震数据上定量与定性均优于分割方法，且对训练稀疏性更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法多将层位追踪建模为稠密语义分割（U-Net类结构），存在明显缺陷：需要后处理从概率图中提取精确层位坐标，同时时间/深度上的层位拾取需转换为稠密掩码用于训练；未拾取的地震道被当作背景，可能妨碍收敛，且前后处理均会引入误差。此外，2D分割模型无法捕获层间（inter-slice）上下文，而3D模型计算代价往往过高。
AI.method: 将层位追踪建模为有界坐标回归问题，模型在每个横向位置直接预测目标层位的时间/深度坐标。提出一种轻量回归头，兼容任意预训练视觉主干；引入LSTM模块建模层间上下文，生成贯穿整个数据体的连续层位面。损失方面，使用L1与L2损失组合监督有效层位拾取处的预测，并采用地质信息驱动的正则化约束相邻道之间的横向连续性。在受控实验条件下，对新西兰某地震数据体，比较四种预训练视觉主干在分割与回归两种配置下的表现。
AI.result: 在受控实验条件下，对来自新西兰的地震数据体，所提方法在RMSE、PCC等指标上定量优于对应的分割方法，定性效果也更佳；同时对训练拾取稀疏度增加表现出更强的鲁棒性。此外，连续道之间的预测变化能够反映局部地质复杂度变化，可作为下游地震解释的自动化质量控制手段。
AI.conclusion: 回归式层位追踪框架避免了分割范式的前后处理误差与背景道问题，能建模层间上下文并保持横向连续性，在精度与稀疏鲁棒性上均优于分割基线，并可从预测变化中导出自动化质量控制指标，为三维地震解释提供了更实用的方案。

title: Large Language Continuous Diffusion Models
summary: Despite the success of discrete diffusion language models (dLMs) for fast parallel decoding, their non-smooth, high-dimensional space hinders trajectory steering for reasoning and inference acceleration. To overcome this, we present Sigma, the first large-scale (3B/8B) continuous dLM built on steerable, low-dimensional ODE/SDE latent trajectories. Trained blockwise via likelihood optimization, Sigma jointly denoises Gaussian-corrupted token embeddings while learning an optimal embedding geometry. To accelerate training, Sigma leverages pre-trained weights from autoregressive (AR) models for warm-starting. During inference, we identify classifier-free guidance and score temperature as essential for high-fidelity reasoning and coding. Across comprehensive math reasoning and coding evaluations against state-of-the-art discrete counterparts (masked dLMs and AR baselines), Sigma achieves competitive performance with discrete models on standard benchmarks (e.g., GSM8K, Minerva, HumanEval, MBPP) after pre-training and on challenging reasoning tasks (e.g., MATH-500, AIME) after supervised fine-tuning. Beyond performance parity, we uncover key structural properties unique to continuous dLMs: (i) embedding-space steering effectively governs the quality-diversity trade-off, yielding strong pass@k performance and (ii) continuous trajectories enable graceful degradation for low NFEs and efficient distillation. These establish continuous dLMs as a promising paradigm for efficient language generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sigma，首个基于可引导低维ODE/SDE潜轨迹的大规模（3B/8B）连续扩散语言模型，在数学推理与代码任务上达到与离散模型相当的性能，并展现连续dLM特有的可控性与高效性优势。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散语言模型虽支持快速并行解码，但其非平滑、高维的离散空间阻碍了轨迹引导，难以用于推理与推理加速。作者希望借助连续、低维的潜在轨迹实现可引导的生成过程。
AI.method: 构建基于可引导低维ODE/SDE潜轨迹的连续dLM（3B/8B），采用分块（blockwise）似然优化训练，在去噪高斯噪声扰动的token嵌入的同时学习最优嵌入几何；利用预训练自回归模型权重进行热启动以加速训练。推理阶段引入无分类器引导（classifier-free guidance）与score temperature以提升推理与代码生成质量。
AI.result: 在数学推理与代码的全面评测中，与最先进离散模型（掩码dLM与AR基线）相比，预训练后在GSM8K、Minerva、HumanEval、MBPP等标准基准上达到竞争性性能，监督微调后在MATH-500、AIME等困难推理任务上亦表现良好。此外发现连续dLM的独特结构性质：(i) 嵌入空间引导可有效调控质量-多样性权衡，带来强pass@k表现；(ii) 连续轨迹在低NFE下可优雅退化并支持高效蒸馏。
AI.conclusion: 连续扩散语言模型在性能与离散模型持平的同时，具备嵌入空间可引导性与轨迹连续性带来的效率优势，确立了其作为高效语言生成范式的潜力。

title: RUL-Aware RRT*: Degradation-Balanced Motion Planning for Robotic Manipulators
summary: Robotic manipulators operating over long durations often experience uneven joint degradation, which causes the weakest actuator to fail prematurely, leads to unplanned downtime, and results in significant operational losses. Traditional motion-planning algorithms do not account for joint health conditions and therefore tend to exacerbate this imbalance during extended operation. To address this challenge, this study introduces the RUL-aware RRT*, a motion-planning method that incorporates joint remaining useful life information into the planning process and adaptively adjusts joint usage in response to evolving health conditions. The method is evaluated across three representative scenarios, namely the Full Health Scenario (FHS), the Heterogeneous Degradation Scenario (HDS), and the Local Degradation Scenario (LDS). The results show that the RUL-aware RRT* effectively suppresses degradation imbalance, delays the emergence of bottleneck failures, and improves the long-term reliability of the robotic system during extended operation. These findings demonstrate that integrating health feedback into motion planning provides a practical and robust pathway for enhancing the durability and operational resilience of manipulators subject to continuous wear.

AI.tldr: 提出RUL-aware RRT*运动规划方法，将关节剩余使用寿命（RUL）信息纳入规划过程并自适应调整关节使用，以抑制长期运行中的关节退化不均衡。
AI.motivation: 机器人机械臂长时间运行会出现关节退化不均匀，导致最弱执行器提前失效，引发非计划停机与重大运营损失。传统运动规划算法不考虑关节健康状态，反而在长期运行中加剧这种不均衡。
AI.method: 提出RUL-aware RRT*运动规划方法，将关节剩余使用寿命信息融入规划过程，并根据关节健康状况的变化自适应调整关节使用。在三种代表性场景（全健康场景FHS、异质退化场景HDS、局部退化场景LDS）下进行评测。
AI.result: RUL-aware RRT*能有效抑制退化不均衡，推迟瓶颈失效的出现，并提升机器人在长期运行中的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 将健康反馈融入运动规划，为提升持续磨损条件下机械臂的耐久性与运行韧性提供了实用且稳健的途径。

title: Parameter-Free Interval-Dynamic Regret under Heavy-Tailed Noise
summary:
We study online convex optimization with one unbiased stochastic subgradient per round and an unknown finite conditional $p$th noise moment, $1<p\le2$. For every fixed interval $I$ of length $n$ and comparator path with $Λ_I=1+P_I/D$, one learner achieves
  \[ E[Regret_I(u)]\le\min(GDn, C[GD\sqrt{n(Λ_I+\log^2(2T))} +σDn^{1/p}(Λ_I+\log^2(2T))^{(p-1)/p}]). \]
  The learner uses none of $G,σ,p,I,P_I$, and the constant is universal. Interval adaptation adds to comparator complexity, preserving the distinct mean-gradient and noise exponents. The analysis controls calibration in expectation and limits the cost of observation-scale changes. Its general theorem compares to distributions over predictably available experts with relative-entropy dependence on a nonuniform prior. A common prior favors long windows and long restart lengths. With the statistics supplied, the interval cost becomes $1+\log(T/n)$, including the optimal full-horizon static rate. A change-of-measure lower bound identifies the noise power of this logarithm for learners retaining a full-horizon optimal guarantee, under explicit conditions. Static comparisons and deterministic partitions follow from the same decisions.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究每轮仅有一个无偏随机次梯度的在线凸优化问题，在未知有限条件p阶噪声矩（1<p≤2）下，提出一种对所有区间和比较器路径均自适应的学习算法，同时保持均值梯度项与噪声项的不同指数。
AI.motivation: 现有在线凸优化通常需要已知梯度上界G、噪声参数σ、p以及区间信息，且难以同时对任意长度区间和比较器路径长度实现最优自适应。本文旨在消除这些先验知识依赖，并在区间自适应中保留均值梯度与噪声的独立指数结构。
AI.method: 采用基于相对熵的一般化定理，与可预测可用专家的分布进行比较，并设计非均匀先验（偏好长窗口与长重启长度）。分析中控制期望校准，并限制观测尺度变化的代价；算法不使用G、σ、p、I、P_I。
AI.result: 对任意长度n的区间I及比较器路径复杂度Λ_I=1+P_I/D，算法达到 E[Regret_I(u)] ≤ min(GDn, C[GD√(n(Λ_I+log²(2T))) + σD n^{1/p}(Λ_I+log²(2T))^{(p-1)/p}])，常数通用。区间自适应仅增加比较器复杂度，同时保留均值梯度与噪声的不同指数。
AI.conclusion: 给定统计量时，区间代价变为1+log(T/n)，包含最优全时域静态速率；通过变测度下界刻画了保留全时域最优保证的学习者中该对数的噪声幂次，静态比较与确定性划分可由同一决策导出。

title: Divide and conquer: Scalable performance and energy in MCM GPUs
summary: Multi-chip-module (MCM) GPUs offer a promising path to scale compute capability beyond monolithic designs by integrating multiple chiplets on a common package. However, the impact of disaggregation on performance scalability and energy consumption remains underexplored. The design space grows rapidly across dimensions such as SMs per chiplet, chiplet count, and interconnection network. The inter-chiplet network is particularly critical, as it determines whether additional compute resources translate into performance gains. This limited understanding leaves industry and research without clear guidance on the performance and energy trade-offs of MCM GPU scaling. In this work, we investigate whether distributing compute and memory capability across multiple chiplets offers a more scalable alternative to concentrating resources. We quantify their effects on performance, energy, and efficiency and examine how inter-chiplet topology influences scalability at different system sizes. Our results demonstrate that a 16 chiplet Torus configuration with 256 SMs delivers a remarkable $2.40\times$ performance improvement over a state-of-the-art MCM architecture with the same compute capability, while simultaneously reducing energy consumption by $4.45\times$. These substantial gains provide evidence that disaggregation is a first-order architectural factor and will be critical to unlocking the performance and energy-efficiency potential of next-generation GPUs.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨多芯片模块（MCM）GPU的拆分化设计对性能与能耗的影响，发现16芯片Torus配置在相同算力下相较先进MCM架构性能提升2.40倍、能耗降低4.45倍。
AI.motivation: MCM GPU是超越单片设计扩展算力的重要路径，但拆分化对性能可扩展性与能耗的影响尚不明确。设计空间涵盖每芯片SM数、芯片数量、互连网络等维度，且芯片间网络决定额外算力能否转化为性能收益，导致工业界与研究界缺乏性能与能耗权衡的明确指导。
AI.method: 研究将算力与存储能力分布于多芯片是否比集中资源更具可扩展性，量化其对性能、能耗与效率的影响，并考察不同系统规模下芯片间拓扑对可扩展性的作用。
AI.result: 含256个SM的16芯片Torus配置，相比同等算力的先进MCM架构性能提升2.40倍，同时能耗降低4.45倍。
AI.conclusion: 拆分化是一阶体系结构因素，对释放下一代GPU的性能与能效潜力至关重要。

title: When Terminal-Agent Training Stalls: Demystifying Data Generation and Verification Challenge
summary: Using a frontier model like Claude Opus as a meta-agent to generate terminal tasks and verifiers for RL training is increasingly common. Yet a runnable Docker image and executable test suite do not guarantee a faithful end-to-end pipeline for terminal agent training. We present a meta-agent pipeline motivated by this gap, diagnosing three classes of failure: benchmark invalidity, harness brittleness, and reward misalignment. Prompt redesign and context extension raise baseline solvability 5.6 times, but a 9B model saturates at 81.3% mean pass@2 within 20 steps on Claude Opus-generated tasks. Adding hard tasks reduces mean pass@2 to 20.6% without changing the training configuration, a strong evidence that the solvability band is model-specific. These findings demonstrate that meta-agent reliability requires solvability-band calibration, verifier audits, and infrastructure error accounting as first-class evaluation criteria, not post-hoc diagnost.

AI.tldr: 论文指出现有"元代理生成终端任务+验证器"的RL训练流程存在三类失效（基准无效、harness脆弱、奖励错配），并通过提示重设计与上下文扩展、加入困难任务等实验证明：可解性区间是模型特定的，元代理可靠性需将可解性区间校准、验证器审计与基础设施错误核算作为一等评估指标。
AI.motivation: 使用前沿模型（如Claude Opus）作为元代理生成终端任务与验证器用于RL训练日益普遍，但"可运行的Docker镜像+可执行测试套件"并不保证端到端流水线是可信的，存在被忽视的可靠性缺口。
AI.method: 提出一个由该缺口驱动的元代理流水线，诊断三类失败：基准无效性（benchmark invalidity）、harness脆弱性（harness brittleness）、奖励错配（reward misalignment）。据此进行提示重设计与上下文扩展，并在Claude Opus生成的任务上训练9B模型；进一步通过引入困难任务做对照实验。
AI.result: 提示重设计与上下文扩展使基线可解性提升5.6倍；但9B模型在Claude Opus生成任务上仅20步内即达到81.3%的mean pass@2而饱和。在不改变训练配置的情况下加入困难任务，mean pass@2降至20.6%，表明可解性区间（solvability band）是模型特定的。
AI.conclusion: 元代理的可靠性要求把可解性区间校准、验证器审计和基础设施错误核算作为一等评估标准，而非事后诊断。

title: From TS-SUF-2 to TS-SUF-4: Practical Security Enhancements for FROST2 Threshold Signatures
summary:
Threshold signature schemes play a vital role in securing digital assets within blockchain and distributed systems. FROST2 stands out as a practical threshold Schnorr signature scheme, noted for its efficiency and compatibility with standard verification processes. However, under the one-more discrete logarithm assumption, with static corruption and centralized key generation settings, FROST2 has been shown by Bellare et al. (in CRYPTO 2022) to achieve only TS-SUF-2 security, which is a consequence of its vulnerability to TS-UF-3 attacks.
  In this paper, we address this security limitation by presenting an enhanced variant of FROST2, namely, FROST2+ which achieves the TS-SUF-4 security level under the same computational assumptions as the original FROST2. FROST2+ strengthens FROST2 by integrating additional pre-processing token verifications that help mitigate TS-UF-3 and TS-UF-4 vulnerabilities while maintaining practical efficiency. We show that FROST2+ can achieve TS-SUF-4 security not only under the same conditions as the original FROST2 analysis, but also when initialized with a distributed key generation protocol such as PedPoP. Our benchmark using ZCash's FROST library shows that the performance of FROST2+ is comparable to FROST2 and about 64-79% faster than FROST when precomputation is enabled.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FROST2+，通过在 FROST2 中引入预处​​理令牌验证，在相同计算假设下将阈值 Schnorr 签名安全性从 TS-SUF-2 提升至 TS-SUF-4，并兼容 PedPoP 分布式密钥生成，性能与 FROST2 相当且显著优于 FROST。
AI.motivation: FROST2 是实用的阈值 Schnorr 签名方案，但在 one-more discrete logarithm 假设、静态腐化与集中式密钥生成下仅达到 TS-SUF-2 安全性，易受 TS-UF-3 攻击，存在安全短板。
AI.method: 提出增强变体 FROST2+，在 FROST2 基础上集成额外的预处​​理令牌验证，以缓解 TS-UF-3 与 TS-UF-4 漏洞，同时保持实用效率；并在与原 FROST2 分析相同条件及 PedPoP 分布式密钥生成初始化下进行安全性证明。
AI.result: FROST2+ 在与原始 FROST2 相同的计算假设下达到 TS-SUF-4 安全级，且在使用 PedPoP 分布式密钥生成时同样成立。基于 ZCash FROST 库的基准测试显示，其性能与 FROST2 相当，在启用预计算时比 FROST 快约 64-79%。
AI.conclusion: FROST2+ 在不牺牲实用效率的前提下修补了 FROST2 的安全缺陷，实现更强的 TS-SUF-4 安全性，并适配分布式密钥生成场景，是更具安全性与实用性的阈值 Schnorr 签名方案。

title: AFORE: Attention-FFN Disaggregation with Overlapped Reconfiguration of Experts
summary: Efficient serving of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models is challenging due to large expert parameters, input-dependent expert activation, and dynamic workloads. Expert parallelism distributes expert computation across GPUs, while attention-FFN disaggregation (AFD) separates attention and feed-forward computation into independent worker pools. However, we observe that a naive AFD implementation could make expert load imbalance more harmful: once FFN computation becomes an independent pipeline stage, overloaded experts directly slow the FFN stage and degrade end-to-end serving performance. To solve this problem, we present AFORE, a timely expert reconfiguration system for AFD-based MoE serving. AFORE exploits two architectural properties of AFD. First, AFD exposes the expert-token distribution of upcoming microbatches before they reach FFN execution, enabling placement decisions based on near-future demand instead of stale historical profiles. Second, AFD creates a pipeline window in which expert migration for a target microbatch can be overlapped with the computation of preceding in-flight microbatches. AFORE formulates expert reconfiguration as a microbatch-aware scheduling problem and uses a migration-aware scheduler to decide when and which experts to migrate. AFORE further implements lightweight demand prefetching and NVLink-based GPU-GPU expert migration to reduce reconfiguration overhead. Evaluation on a 110B-parameter MoE model across four dynamic workloads shows that AFORE improves output throughput by 10.1-17.6% and reduces P95 inter-token latency by 7.1-9.5% compared with the strongest competing baseline. Compared with static placement, AFORE improves throughput by 29.8% on average and reduces P95 inter-token latency by 18.2% on average. Migration profiling further shows that AFD pipeline overlap can fully hide expert-migration latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AFORE，一个面向 AFD（注意力-FFN 解耦）MoE 服务的及时专家重配置系统，通过微批次感知调度与 NVLink 专家迁移缓解专家负载不均，在 110B MoE 上相较最强基线提升吞吐 10.1–17.6%，降低 P95 延迟 7.1–9.5%。
AI.motivation: MoE 模型服务面临专家参数庞大、专家激活输入相关、工作负载动态等挑战。现有专家并行跨 GPU 分布专家计算，AFD 将注意力与 FFN 解耦为独立 worker 池，但朴素 AFD 实现会使专家负载不均更严重：FFN 成为独立流水阶段后，过载专家会直接拖慢该阶段并损害端到端服务性能，因此需要及时的专家重配置。
AI.method: AFORE 利用 AFD 的两个架构特性：(1) AFD 在微批次进入 FFN 执行前即暴露其专家-令牌分布，可基于近未来需求（而非过时历史画像）做放置决策；(2) AFD 提供流水窗口，可将目标微批次的专家迁移与先前在途微批次的计算重叠。系统将专家重配置建模为微批次感知的调度问题，采用迁移感知调度器决定何时迁移及迁移哪些专家，并实现轻量级需求预取与基于 NVLink 的 GPU-GPU 专家迁移以降低重配置开销。
AI.result: 在 110B 参数 MoE 模型、四种动态工作负载上：相较最强竞争基线，输出吞吐提升 10.1–17.6%，P95 词元间延迟降低 7.1–9.5%；相较静态放置，吞吐平均提升 29.8%，P95 延迟平均降低 18.2%。迁移剖析显示 AFD 流水重叠可完全隐藏专家迁移延迟。
AI.conclusion: AFORE 通过微批次感知的专家重配置调度与迁移开销隐藏机制，有效缓解 AFD 架构下 MoE 服务的专家负载不均，显著提升吞吐并降低尾延迟，验证了利用 AFD 流水窗口做及时专家迁移的可行性与有效性。

title: MeshQuery: Agentic Seam Planning for UV Parametrization
summary: We present MeshQuery, a training-free agentic approach to automatic UV unwrapping of production-grade quad meshes. A Vision-Language Model (VLM) plans artist-aligned seams using a set of edge-selection tools, conditioned on domain-specific UV-unwrapping knowledge expressed in natural language and refined with a feedback loop. We design a queryable mesh representation together with a domain-specific language (DSL) that enables the agent to retrieve mesh information on demand, express a seam plan as a compact program of edge-selection operators over topological, geometric, and semantic mesh attributes, and iteratively refine it from UV quality feedback. On Adobe Substance 3D and Toys4K meshes, MeshQuery produces 2.9x/4.29x fewer charts and 1.63x/1.7x shorter seams than the strongest baseline, and professional artists prefer its results in 80.9% of comparisons. Ultimately, decoupling high-level intent planning from low-level edge selection and compact mesh representation lets MeshQuery run on different backend VLMs and scale to meshes an order of magnitude larger than autoregressive seam prediction

AI.tldr: MeshQuery是一个免训练的智能体式自动UV展开方法，利用VLM规划接缝，结合可查询网格表示与DSL，在专业级四边形网格上显著优于基线并被艺术家偏好。
AI.motivation: 自动UV展开对生产级四边形网格仍具挑战，需要生成符合艺术家习惯的接缝。传统方法难以兼顾高层意图规划与底层边选择，且自回归接缝预测难以扩展到大网格。
AI.method: 提出MeshQuery，免训练智能体框架。VLM依据自然语言表达的UV展开领域知识，通过一组边选择工具规划接缝，并用反馈循环精化。设计了可查询网格表示与领域特定语言（DSL），使智能体能按需检索网格信息，将接缝计划表达为在拓扑、几何和语义属性上的紧凑边选择算子程序，并基于UV质量反馈迭代改进。解耦高层意图规划与底层边选择。
AI.result: 在Adobe Substance 3D和Toys4K网格上，MeshQuery相较最强基线产生2.9倍/4.29倍更少的图表（charts）和1.63倍/1.7倍更短的接缝；专业艺术家在80.9%的对比中偏好其结果。可运行于不同后端VLM，并可扩展到比自回归接缝预测大一个数量级的网格。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦高层意图规划与底层边选择，并采用紧凑网格表示，MeshQuery实现了可扩展、可移植且符合艺术家偏好的自动UV展开。

title: Silent Dissent: LLM Agents That Yield to the Majority Still Represent Their Original Premise
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Supplementary material in ancillary files
summary: Multi-agent debate is increasingly used to reach consensus among LLM agents, yet agents often yield to a unanimous majority. When an agent changes its answer, has it changed its mind or only its statement? We study this with two-hop factual questions whose intermediate entity (the bridge, e.g. the country in "the capital of the country where the Sagrada Familia is located") is never stated by anyone. Scripted peers, in the role of Asch's confederates, unanimously assert a wrong answer taken from another fact with a different bridge. At the moment the agent answers, we read the bridge from its residual stream with the Jacobian lens (J-lens) and, for comparison, the logit lens. In pre-registered tests on held-out facts with four open-weight models, agents of Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.6-27B and Gemma-4-E4B-it that gave in still represented their original bridge in the pre-registered layers below the output (hit@100 above a control entity: 0.85, 0.22 and 0.24), where the logit lens rarely ranked it among the top 100 tokens (0.00-0.06). These agents also represented the bridge behind the peers' answer, beyond a mention baseline. A pre-registered addendum hid the agent's earlier answer or removed it: agents that gave in still represented their original bridge in all four models (0.43, 0.29, 0.37 and 0.25 with the answer hidden), including Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, which barely did so with its answer in view (0.03). The premise can thus be computed from the question alone while the agent states the majority's answer. Hiding the earlier answer also changed conformity: Qwen3.5-4B gave in on 89% of questions instead of 8%. In exploratory interventions, injecting the bridge's J-lens direction brought agents back to their original answer only in the two Qwen models. Stated consensus in multi-agent debate can thus overstate agreement. We also report the negative results of our pre-registered program.

AI.tldr: 多智能体辩论中出现的一致意见可能是"表面服从"：智能体即使改口认同多数答案，其内部残差流仍保留自己原有的推理桥梁，说明"改口"未必"改心"。
AI.motivation: 多智能体辩论被广泛用于让LLM智能体达成共识，但智能体常屈从于全体一致的多数派。核心问题是：当智能体改变答案时，它是真正改变了想法，还是仅改变了表述？
AI.method: 采用两跳事实性问题，其中中间实体（bridge，如"圣家堂所在国家的首都"中的国家）从未被任何人说出。脚本化同伴扮演Asch实验中的从众者，一致给出错误答案（取自另一条具有不同bridge的事实）。在智能体作答时刻，用Jacobian lens（J-lens）从残差流中读出bridge，并与logit lens对比。对四个开放权重模型（Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen3.6-27B、Gemma-4-E4B-it、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）在留出事实上做预注册检验。预注册附录中额外隐藏或移除智能体早先的答案。探索性干预中注入bridge的J-lens方向。
AI.result: 屈服（改口）的智能体在输出层以下的预注册层中仍表征其原始bridge（对控制实体的hit@100：Qwen3.5-4B为0.85，Qwen3.6-27B为0.22，Gemma-4-E4B-it为0.24），而logit lens很少将其排入前100 token（0.00–0.06）。这些智能体还在同伴答案背后表征了bridge。隐藏早先答案后，全部四个模型仍表征原始bridge（0.43、0.29、0.37、0.25），包括在答案可见时几乎不表征的Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct（0.03）。隐藏早先答案还改变从众率：Qwen3.5-4B在89%的问题上屈服，而非8%。注入bridge的J-lens方向仅在两个Qwen模型中使智能体回到原始答案。另报告预注册项目中的阴性结果。
AI.conclusion: 前提（bridge）可仅从问题本身计算得出，而智能体却表述多数派的答案，说明多智能体辩论中"表述的一致"可能高估真实共识。残余流读出揭示了内部信念与外部表态之间的分离。

title: CriticHack: Evaluating Visual Rewards Under Robot Policy Optimization
summary: Learned visual reward models are increasingly used to optimize robot policies, yet a reward model can score an execution that acts on the wrong object as highly as one that completes the task. We show that optimizing such a reward can amplify these wrong-object failures while reward and task success both rise, so the signals a practitioner would normally monitor look healthy. We fine-tune every denoiser parameter of a diffusion policy against Robometer on a drawer task. Starting from a supervised policy with no prior reward exposure, five training runs raise task success by 10.2 percentage points and wrong-object failures by 10.9 points on 512 evaluation seeds, whereas five runs trained on the simulator's task-completion signal raise success without amplifying wrong-object failures (difference 9.2 points, 95% CI 5.6 to 13.0). The amplification recurs from a policy previously optimized against learned rewards, under the policy's native diffusion sampler, at matched distance from the initial policy, and across constrained-policy experiments with two critics and two optimizers. A tilt model explains when it occurs: under KL-regularized optimization, an outcome becomes more frequent whenever its expected reward under the initial policy exceeds the population average. Robometer separates successes from failures well overall (AUROC .81) but scores wrong-object failures slightly above successes (AUROC .37), so optimization raises both. The same model predicts the outcome shifts across 26 constrained settings (Spearman .89), including those in which task success falls, and Robometer's own published success-termination recipe inherits the error. A frozen outcome verifier redirects the same optimization toward the requested task.

AI.tldr: 学习型视觉奖励模型在优化机器人策略时，会放大"作用错误物体"的失败，尽管任务成功率与奖励同步上升，表面指标看似健康；冻结的结果验证器可纠正该问题。
AI.motivation: 学习型视觉奖励模型日益用于优化机器人策略，但存在关键缺陷：奖励模型可能给"作用错误物体"的执行以与"完成任务"同样高的分数。作者希望揭示这种奖励优化会放大错误物体失败的风险，而实践者通常监控的指标（奖励、任务成功率）却显示一切正常。
AI.method: 在抽屉任务上，对扩散策略的全部去噪器参数针对 Robometer 进行微调。从无奖励先验的监督策略出发，运行五次训练，在512个评估种子上对比任务成功率与错误物体失败率的变化，并以模拟器任务完成信号作为对照。进一步在策略原生扩散采样器、匹配初始策略距离、受限策略实验（两个critic、两个优化器）下验证放大现象，并建立tilt模型解释其发生条件。
AI.result: Robometer训练使任务成功率提升10.2个百分点，同时错误物体失败率上升10.9个百分点；而模拟器任务完成信号训练仅提升成功率而不放大错误物体失败（差异9.2个百分点，95% CI 5.6–13.0）。放大现象在多种设置下复现。Robometer整体区分成功与失败良好（AUROC .81），但对错误物体失败打分略高于成功（AUROC .37）。tilt模型在26个受限设置下预测结果偏移（Spearman .89），包括任务成功率下降的情形，且Robometer公开的成功终止配方也继承了该错误。
AI.conclusion: 在KL正则化优化下，只要某结果在初始策略下的期望奖励高于总体均值，其出现频率就会增加，这解释了错误物体失败的放大机制。冻结的结果验证器可将同一优化过程重新导向所请求的任务，从而缓解该问题。

title: From Mathematical to Executable Certificates for Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning is needed when data must be removed because of deletion requests, outdated records, or data-quality concerns, while retraining from scratch can be costly. Certified machine unlearning methods provide mathematical guarantees, while deployed systems release concrete finite-precision artifacts produced by software. To bridge the gap between mathematical guarantees and practical deployment, we introduce Executable Release Certification (ExecCert), a release-time layer that certifies the candidate artifact considered for release. ExecCert either closes a method's native certificate for the executed candidate or applies Retraining-Reference Release Verification (RRV) to certify fidelity to current retain-set retraining. Sequential deletion makes the latter nontrivial because the exact retain-set reference and the stored numerical state evolve separately. For frozen representations with a mutable ridge head, we develop an incremental realization of RRV that maintains certified evidence across deletion requests rather than reconstructing it at each release. On four published unlearning implementations, ExecCert preserves valid certificates, changes release decisions, tightens conservative bounds, and identifies the retraining-reference fidelity supported by concrete outputs. In sequential-service experiments, RRV eliminates false releases caused by stored-equation verification while closely tracking realized error, and incremental certification remains cheaper than both fresh and maintained verified-factor alternatives once release checks become sufficiently frequent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Executable Release Certification (ExecCert)，一个发布时认证层，用于对实际发布的有限精度候选产物进行认证，桥接数学保证与实际部署之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 机器遗忘在删除请求、过期记录或数据质量问题时十分必要，而从头重训练成本高昂。现有认证式遗忘方法提供数学保证，但实际部署发布的是软件生成的有限精度产物，二者之间存在鸿沟。
AI.method: ExecCert在发布时对候选产物进行认证：要么为已执行候选封闭方法的原生证书，要么应用Retraining-Reference Release Verification (RRV)来认证对当前保留集重训练的保真度。针对冻结表示加可变ridge头的场景，提出RRV的增量实现，在多次删除请求间维护认证证据，而非每次发布重建。
AI.result: 在四个已发表遗忘实现上，ExecCert保持有效证书、改变发布决策、收紧保守界，并识别由具体输出支撑的重训练参考保真度。在顺序服务实验中，RRV消除了由存储方程验证导致的虚假发布，同时紧密跟踪实现误差；当发布检查足够频繁时，增量认证比新建和维护验证因子两种替代方案都更便宜。
AI.conclusion: ExecCert通过发布时认证层有效弥合了数学保证与实际部署产物的差距，RRV及增量实现能够在顺序删除场景下提供可靠的发布认证并降低成本。

title: Evidence-Guided Repository-Level RTL Repair
summary: Repository-level RTL repair must localize a failure that spans files, modules, and clock cycles, then propagate the fix consistently. Existing methods reason over source code, which reveals possible behaviors but not the failed execution, and cannot tell whether a local fix was propagated consistently. We therefore present an evidence-guided framework with three modules. Failure grounding converts a problem statement into a reproduced failing run and a failure anchor. Waveform-guided localization uses a localization toolbox to narrow the observed violation into a candidate mechanism and an evidence trail. Consistency-aware repair and validation then expand that seed into a coordinated patch and replay the same scenario to check that the violation disappears. We conducted experiments on HWE-Bench and achieved better performance than the baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个证据引导的RTL修复框架，将失败复现、波形定位与一致性修复验证相结合，在HWE-Bench上优于基线。
AI.motivation: 仓库级RTL修复需跨越文件、模块和时钟周期定位失败，并一致地传播修复；现有方法仅基于源代码推理，只能揭示可能行为而非失败执行，也无法判断局部修复是否被一致传播。
AI.method: 包含三个模块：Failure grounding将问题陈述转为复现的失败运行与失败锚点；Waveform-guided localization借助定位工具箱将观测到的违规缩小为候选机制与证据链；Consistency-aware repair and validation将种子扩展为协调补丁，并重放同一场景以检查违规是否消失。
AI.result: 在HWE-Bench上进行了实验，性能优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 证据引导、波形驱动的定位与一致性感知修复验证能够有效支持仓库级RTL修复，并取得优于基线的表现。

title: Reinforcement Learning Techniques for the Optimization of Target Polarization in Nuclear Physics Scattering Experiments
summary: The operation of dynamically polarized targets in nuclear physics experiments relies on continuous tuning of the microwave frequency to compensate for radiation damage and evolving material properties, a task that is traditionally performed through manual trial-and-error by expert operators.
