This work presents a data-driven control framework that combines surrogate modeling with reinforcement learning to optimize the target polarization. Using operational data from the APOLLO cryogenic target system, we train and evaluate multilayer perceptron and Gaussian process regression models to predict polarization as a function of microwave frequency, beam current, and accumulated radiation dose. We show that Gaussian process-based models provide calibrated uncertainty estimates and reliably identify regions outside the training distribution, while MLPs exhibit limited sensitivity to distributional shift. To enable learning and control across multiple target samples, we introduce a Gaussian process approximation and embed the surrogate model within a standardized simulation environment. A reinforcement learning agent is trained using a lower-confidence-bound reward formulation that balances performance maximization against uncertainty. We are able to show an almost 2x improvement on the operators actions utilizing our RL agent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合代理模型与强化学习的数据驱动控制框架，用于动态极化靶的微波频率调优；基于APOLLO低温靶运行数据训练MLP与高斯过程回归模型，并构建标准化仿真环境训练RL智能体，实现约2倍于人工操作的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 动态极化靶运行中需持续调节微波频率以补偿辐射损伤与材料性质演化，传统上依赖专家人工试错，效率低且难以规模化，因此需要数据驱动的自动化控制方法。
AI.method: 使用APOLLO低温靶系统的运行数据，训练多层感知机（MLP）与高斯过程回归（GPR）模型，以微波频率、束流和累积辐射剂量为输入预测极化度；引入高斯过程近似并将代理模型嵌入标准化仿真环境，采用下置信界（LCB）奖励的强化学习智能体进行训练与控制。
AI.result: 高斯过程模型能提供校准良好的不确定性估计，并可靠识别训练分布之外的区域；MLP对分布偏移敏感性有限。所训练的RL智能体相较操作员行为取得近2倍的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 将具有不确定性量化的代理模型与强化学习结合，可有效实现动态极化靶的自动化调优，并在性能上显著超越人工操作，验证了数据驱动控制框架的可行性。

title: RMCW: A Deletion-Robust Watermark Based on Reed--Muller Codes for Language Models
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) watermarking provides a lightweight mechanism for identifying text generated by a specific model, but its robustness remains fragile under post-processing attacks. Deletion attacks are particularly challenging because they shift token positions and break the alignment between observed tokens and their original watermark positions. We propose Reed--Muller Code Watermarking (RMCW), an LLM watermarking method based on Reed--Muller codes. In contrast to global codeword recovery, RMCW searches for surviving local algebraic structure, leveraging the Reed--Solomon consistency induced by affine-line restrictions of Reed--Muller codewords. During generation, RMCW injects a Reed--Muller structure into the sequence via a secret-keyed vocabulary partition. During detection, it maps the given text to keyed vocabulary bins and tests local subsequences for low-degree Reed--Solomon consistency using Berlekamp--Welch tests. Experiments on C4 and ELI5 datasets with OPT-1.3B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct show that RMCW preserves strong clean-text detectability and outperforms or matches the baseline methods under several deletion and rewriting attacks. Our code is available at https://github.com/BaichengDanny/RMCW.

AI.tldr: 提出RMCW，基于Reed–Muller码的LLM水印方法，通过局部代数结构实现对删除攻击的鲁棒检测。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM水印在删除攻击下鲁棒性脆弱：删除操作会改变token位置，破坏观测token与原始水印位置的对齐。
AI.method: RMCW利用Reed–Muller码仿射线限制诱导的Reed–Solomon一致性，放弃全局码字恢复而搜索存活的局部代数结构。生成阶段通过密钥化词表划分注入Reed–Muller结构；检测阶段将文本映射到密钥词表桶，并用Berlekamp–Welch检验测试局部子序列的低阶Reed–Solomon一致性。
AI.result: 在C4与ELI5数据集、OPT-1.3B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型上的实验表明，RMCW保持较强的干净文本可检测性，并在多种删除与改写攻击下优于或匹配基线方法。
AI.conclusion: RMCW通过局部代数一致性检验提升了LLM水印在删除等后处理攻击下的鲁棒性，代码已开源。

title: VenusRL: A Fully Disaggregated Agentic RL System with Priority Scheduling and Scalable Interaction
summary: Agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) trains LLM agents through multi-turn interactions with external tool environments. Its multi-turn nature exposes two system-level bottlenecks unaddressed by existing agentic RL frameworks. First, end-to-end training throughput is constrained by the slowest trajectories to complete, yet optimizing per-GPU utilization alone scatters rollout progress across many groups, delaying the completion of enough groups to unblock the next training step. Second, tool sandboxes are statically over-provisioned by their declared memory ceilings, leaving most physical memory stranded while replicating near-identical state across sandboxes launched from the same prompt. We present VenusRL, a fully disaggregated agentic RL system that addresses both bottlenecks. VenusRL's priority-aware action scheduler uses length-prediction heuristics to identify sample groups whose completion is most likely to unblock the next training step, and pushes them ahead of others across batch admission, KV Cache residency, and cross-worker request orchestration. VenusRL's environment resource manager combines a memory-aware admission threshold with a template-keyed page-sharing pool, packing more sandboxes per node while preserving strict memory isolation via write-protected page table entry aliasing and copy-on-write. Across representative agentic RL workloads, VenusRL achieves up to 4.24x end-to-end training speedup over state-of-the-art baselines and reduces environment cost by up to 89%.

AI.tldr: VenusRL是一个全解耦的Agentic RL系统，通过优先级感知动作调度器和环境资源管理器，解决多轮交互训练中的吞吐瓶颈与内存浪费问题，实现最高4.24倍训练加速和89%环境成本降低。
AI.motivation: Agentic RL通过LLM智能体与外部工具环境多轮交互进行训练，其多轮特性暴露两个现有框架未解决的系统级瓶颈：(1) 端到端训练吞吐受限于最慢轨迹，仅优化单GPU利用率会导致rollout进度分散，延迟足够组完成以解锁下一步训练；(2) 工具沙箱按声明内存上限静态超额配置，导致物理内存闲置，同时同prompt启动的沙箱重复存储近乎相同的状态。
AI.method: VenusRL包含两个核心组件：(1) 优先级感知动作调度器，利用长度预测启发式识别最可能解锁下一步训练的样本组，并在批次准入、KV Cache驻留和跨worker请求编排中优先处理这些组；(2) 环境资源管理器，结合内存感知准入阈值与模板键控的页共享池，通过写保护页表项别名和写时复制保持严格内存隔离的同时，在同一节点打包更多沙箱。
AI.result: 在代表性agentic RL工作负载上，VenusRL相比最先进的基线实现最高4.24倍的端到端训练加速，并将环境成本降低最高89%。
AI.conclusion: VenusRL通过全解耦架构和优先级感知调度、内存共享机制，有效解决了agentic RL的多轮交互系统瓶颈，在显著提升训练效率的同时大幅降低环境资源开销。

title: From Fragments to Global Maps: Learning Vectorized Map Aggregation with Large Language Models
summary: Large-scale vectorized HD maps provide structured road information that is essential for perception, localization, and planning in autonomous driving. Constructing such maps requires aggregating noisy, fragmented, and overlapping local predictions collected along a vehicle trajectory into a coherent global map. Existing aggregation methods typically rely on hand-crafted rules for fragment association and refinement. However, a fixed set of thresholds cannot effectively handle variations in road structures and prediction errors, often requiring detector-specific tuning or manual adjustment. To address this limitation, we propose MapMergeLLM, a data-driven framework that formulates vectorized map aggregation as conditional sequence generation with a large language model. Given serialized local vectorized maps, our model directly predicts the aggregated global map polylines. To reduce dependence on any particular upstream detector, we train the model on synthetic local maps generated from clean vector maps using corruptions that simulate representative prediction errors. We further introduce a coordinate tokenizer with geometry-aware pretraining to precisely represent map coordinates. In addition, we propose a line-level association loss that explicitly supervises correspondences between local observations of the same map element. Experiments on Argoverse2 and nuScenes using multiple recent upstream detectors demonstrate that MapMergeLLM substantially outperforms heuristic and optimization-based aggregation baselines without detector-specific retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出 MapMergeLLM，将矢量化高精地图聚合建模为条件序列生成任务，用大语言模型直接预测全局地图折线，在 Argoverse2 与 nuScenes 上显著优于启发式和优化类基线。
AI.motivation: 大规模矢量化高精地图需把车辆轨迹上收集的含噪、碎片化且重叠的局部预测聚合为一致的全局地图。现有方法多依赖手工规则进行碎片关联与细化，固定阈值难以适应道路结构与预测误差变化，常需针对特定检测器调参或人工调整。
AI.method: 提出 MapMergeLLM 数据驱动框架，将聚合表述为条件序列生成：输入序列化的局部矢量化地图，直接预测全局地图折线。为降低对特定上游检测器的依赖，使用由干净矢量地图经模拟典型预测误差的损坏过程生成的合成局部地图作为训练数据；引入具备几何感知预训练的坐标分词器以精确表示地图坐标；并提出线级关联损失，显式监督同一地图元素在不同局部观测间的对应关系。
AI.result: 在 Argoverse2 和 nuScenes 数据集上，配合多个近期上游检测器进行实验，MapMergeLLM 在无需针对检测器重新训练的情况下，显著优于启发式与基于优化的聚合基线。
AI.conclusion: 以大语言模型为骨干的条件序列生成范式可有效替代手工规则，实现鲁棒、检测器无关的矢量化地图聚合，验证了几何感知坐标分词与线级关联监督的必要性。

title: WakeKV: Reactive, Reversible KV Residency for Heads That Change Their Minds
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on ML for Systems. 2 figures, 4 tables, appendix
summary: Most KV-cache compression methods classify attention heads once, either offline or during prefill, and keep this classification fixed throughout generation. Across three models (1.5B-8B) and three regimes (needle retrieval, long chain-of-thought, and multi-turn recall), we measure head behavior on four model-regime combinations and find that most heads change their reading behavior at least once during generation. We introduce WakeKV, a reactive residency policy that moves cooling heads to a recoverable CPU reservoir rather than freezing or permanently evicting their state. At matched memory or budget, WakeKV consistently improves miss rate over frozen classification and destructive eviction, evaluated across five model-regime combinations and over three cited baselines (SnapKV, uniform R-KV, and ReasonAlloc) across four eligible combinations. A FlexiCache/vLLM implementation on Mistral-7B confirms the benefit on real hardware, improving throughput while retaining LongBench quality.

AI.tldr: 现有KV缓存压缩方法在生成过程中固定注意力头分类，但实测发现多数头在生成中会改变读取行为。作者提出WakeKV反应式驻留策略，将"冷却"头移至可恢复的CPU储备区，在匹配内存/预算下显著降低miss rate，并在真实硬件上验证吞吐提升且保持LongBench质量。
AI.motivation: 主流KV-cache压缩方法（离线或prefill阶段）对注意力头进行一次分类，并在整个生成过程中保持不变。作者质疑这一固定假设，通过跨3个模型（1.5B–8B）、3种任务场景（needle retrieval、长链思维、多轮召回）测量4种模型-场景组合下的头行为，发现大多数头在生成过程中至少改变一次读取行为，说明静态分类与实际动态行为不匹配，存在优化空间。
AI.method: 实证测量注意力头的动态读取行为以证伪固定分类假设；提出WakeKV，一种反应式（reactive）驻留策略：不冻结或永久驱逐"冷却"头，而是将其状态迁移至可恢复的CPU reservoir中，从而在需要时重新激活。
AI.result: 在匹配内存或预算条件下，WakeKV在5种模型-场景组合上较冻结分类和破坏性驱逐一致降低miss rate；在4个可比较组合上优于三个基线（SnapKV、uniform R-KV、ReasonAlloc）；基于FlexiCache/vLLM在Mistral-7B真实硬件上实现，验证了吞吐提升并保持LongBench质量。
AI.conclusion: 注意力头读取行为在生成过程中是动态变化的，静态头分类存在局限；采用可恢复的CPU驻留（而非冻结或驱逐）能有效降低miss rate并在真实硬件上兼顾吞吐与质量。

title: Real-time Event-camera Stereo Visual Odometry via Keytime Gaussian Process Regression
comment: Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2027, 8 pages, 1 figures, 3 tables. The corresponding video can be found at https://youtu.be/MmpH8QYR76g
summary:
Event cameras have microsecond-level temporal resolution and high dynamic range which make them more resilient to motion blur and poor illumination than standard frame-based cameras. Event-camera visual odometry (VO) pipelines maximize these benefits when they process the asynchronous event stream at the native temporal resolution. Continuous-time Gaussian process (GP) regression and a white-noise-on-acceleration (WNOA) prior can handle asynchronous measurements but result in a prohibitively large estimation state when applied naively.
  This paper presents a continuous-time event-camera stereo VO pipeline that maintains the native measurement times of asynchronous events while also running in real time. It reduces the estimation states to keytimes while maintaining full temporal resolution by interpolating measurements to their exact timestamps with a physically founded WNOA prior. This decouples the state size from the dense number of measurements without discarding their asynchronous nature.
  The real-time continuous-time VO pipeline is evaluated on the MVSEC and DSEC datasets. It provides estimates in real time that are more accurate than ES-PTAM, a state-of-the-art discrete estimator, in all but one of the tested sequences. The pipeline respectively provides estimates at 22 Hz and 6 Hz on MVSEC and DSEC and RMS relative errors of 0.46 cm and 0.038 degrees across all valid sequences, which were 11 and 15 times better than ES-PTAM, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种连续时间事件相机双目视觉里程计(VO)流水线，在保持异步事件原生时间分辨率的同时实现实时运行，通过WNOA先验将估计状态缩减到关键时间点，在MVSEC和DSEC数据集上精度超越ES-PTAM。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具备微秒级时间分辨率和高动态范围，对运动模糊和弱光更鲁棒。然而现有连续时间GP回归与WNOA先验虽能处理异步测量，但朴素应用会导致估计状态规模过大，难以实时运行，因此需要一种兼顾原生时间分辨率与实时性的VO方法。
AI.method: 提出连续时间事件相机双目VO流水线。利用物理依据充分的WNOA先验，将估计状态缩减到关键时间点(keytimes)，并把异步测量插值到其精确时间戳，从而在保持完整时间分辨率的同时解耦状态规模与密集测量数量，不丢失测量的异步特性。
AI.result: 在MVSEC和DSEC数据集上评估。除一个序列外，所有测试序列中精度均优于最先进的离散估计器ES-PTAM。在MVSEC和DSEC上分别以22 Hz和6 Hz实时输出估计，所有有效序列的RMS相对误差分别为0.46 cm和0.038度，较ES-PTAM分别提升11倍和15倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过关键时间点状态表示与WNOA插值，连续时间事件相机双目VO能够在保持异步测量原生时间分辨率的同时实现实时运行，并在精度与实时性上显著优于现有最先进的离散方法ES-PTAM。

title: CLEAN: Psychometrically Consistent Incremental Cognitive Diagnosis under Concept-Space Expansion via Architectural Isolation
summary: Cognitive diagnosis (CD) is a fundamental task in intelligent education that profiles learner proficiency over knowledge concepts. In real-world learning platforms, newly added items continually introduce previously unseen concepts, necessitating dynamic expansion of the underlying concept space. Yet existing incremental CD models assume a fixed concept space, allowing gradients from new items to overwrite historical pathways and induce catastrophic forgetting. More critically, these methods rely solely on soft constraints to preserve historical diagnoses. Such constraints may fail to satisfy the requirement of diagnostic invariance after incremental updates, a requirement known as psychometric consistency in cognitive diagnosis. Therefore, we propose CLEAN (Continual Learning with Expandable and Architecturally Isolated Networks), a novel incremental CD framework supporting concept-space expansion while providing structural guarantees for pointwise invariance of historical diagnoses. Specifically, CLEAN first introduces a strict topological bipartition protocol, freezes historical diagnostic functions and applies deterministic orthogonal column masking to sever gradient interference. Second, to accommodate concept expansion, expandable full-rank branches with micro-variance initialization are deployed to learn novel concepts. Finally, to verify that this architectural design achieves invariance by construction, we formalize Representation Drift (RD) to quantify the perturbation of historical traits. Extensive experiments on three large-scale educational datasets demonstrate that CLEAN achieves zero RD, preserving old-item metrics identically to static anchors through architectural isolation while remaining competitive with or superior to strong continual-learning baselines on new items.

AI.tldr: 提出CLEAN框架，通过可扩展且架构隔离的网络，实现认知诊断中概念空间动态扩展下历史诊断的逐点不变性。
AI.motivation: 现有增量认知诊断模型假设概念空间固定，新题目的梯度会覆盖历史路径导致灾难性遗忘；且仅依赖软约束，无法保证增量更新后诊断的不变性（心理测量一致性要求）。
AI.method: CLEAN引入严格拓扑二分协议，冻结历史诊断函数并用确定性正交列掩码切断梯度干扰；部署带微方差初始化的可扩展满秩分支学习新概念；形式化表示漂移（RD）以量化历史特质的扰动。
AI.result: 在三个大规模教育数据集上，CLEAN实现零RD，旧题指标与静态锚点完全一致，新题上媲美或优于强持续学习基线。
AI.conclusion: 架构隔离可在构造上保证历史诊断的逐点不变性，同时支持概念空间扩展，兼顾心理测量一致性与新知识学习能力。

title: Tropical Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning for large language models typically maximizes expected return, adding up the probabilities of all successful trajectories. However, the classical sum formulation can only report how often the model policy succeeds, not which solution actually worked, and because probabilities sum to one, reinforcing one solution can make the model forget another that was never shown to be wrong. This makes expected return a poor fit for compositional reasoning, where a solution must be assembled from reasoning steps that the model produces in separate, often failed, attempts but rarely produces together. To address this, we propose Tropical Reinforcement Learning, which rests on a simple change of algebra: instead of adding the probabilities of alternative solutions, we take their maximum, which yields the tropical semiring. The value of a state then becomes the log-probability of its most likely verified solution, together with an explicit path that can be replayed and reused. This enables true composition, since the best prefix and the best suffix meeting at a shared state can be joined even when they come from different rollouts. To put this into practice, we introduce TROPIC, a training algorithm for deterministic, resettable environments with verifiable outcomes. On four agentic tasks (Sokoban, Countdown, FrozenLake, WebShop), TROPIC outperforms the strongest on-policy baselines by up to 16 percentage points. Changing the algebra of reinforcement learning, not just its estimators, can thus substantially improve compositional reasoning in language models

AI.tldr: 将强化学习中的"求和"代数替换为"取最大"的tropical半环，提出TROPIC算法，在四个可验证智能体任务上超越最强on-policy基线最多16个百分点。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习最大化期望回报，即对所有成功轨迹的概率求和，只能反映模型策略成功的频率，无法指出哪个解真正有效；且由于概率归一化，强化一个解会导致模型遗忘另一个未被证明错误的解。期望回报不适合组合式推理，因为此类任务需要从多次（常是失败的）尝试中分别产生的推理步骤拼装出解，而模型很少一次性完整产生。
AI.method: 提出Tropical Reinforcement Learning：改变代数结构，不再对备选解的概率求和，而是取最大值，得到tropical半环。状态价值变为其最可能被验证解的对数概率，并附带一条可回放、可复用的显式路径。当最佳前缀与最佳后缀在共享状态相遇时，即使来自不同rollout也可拼接，从而实现真正的组合。据此提出TROPIC训练算法，面向确定性、可重置、结果可验证的环境。
AI.result: 在Sokoban、Countdown、FrozenLake、WebShop四个智能体任务上，TROPIC比最强的on-policy基线高出最多16个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 改变强化学习的代数（而非仅改进估计器），可以显著提升语言模型的组合式推理能力。

title: Containing the Autonomous Operator: A Defense-in-Depth Framework and Reference Architecture for Securing AI Agents on Kubernetes
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are moving from chat interfaces into infrastructure operations, where they read telemetry, call tools, generate and execute code, and change the state of production Kubernetes clusters. This collapses a boundary that conventional cloud-native security assumes: the boundary between data and control. Content that an agent merely reads (a log line, a ticket, a tool description) can redirect what it does. This paper argues that the model must not be treated as a security boundary and that agent safety on Kubernetes is therefore an infrastructure problem: every guarantee must continue to hold under the assumption that the agent is fully compromised by prompt injection. We contribute (i) a threat model and ten-class threat taxonomy for agents operating on and within Kubernetes, aligned with emerging OWASP guidance for agentic applications; (ii) nine design principles, centered on complete mediation at the tool boundary and on breaking the combination of untrusted input, sensitive access, and external egress; (iii) a seven-layer defense-in-depth framework that maps each principle to native or widely adopted Kubernetes mechanisms: workload identity, RBAC and ValidatingAdmissionPolicy, gVisor/Kata sandboxing via the SIG Apps Agent Sandbox project, FQDN-aware egress policy, an agent/MCP gateway with policy-as-code over tool arguments, and eBPF runtime enforcement; (iv) a reference architecture with concrete policy artifacts and per-layer bindings for Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service, and Google Kubernetes Engine; and (v) a qualitative evaluation comprising a threat-control coverage matrix and four attack walkthroughs, with a proposed empirical methodology. We report no measured attack-success or overhead figures; instead we identify residual risks and the measurements needed to validate the framework.

AI.tldr: 该论文主张LLM智能体不应被视为安全边界，Kubernetes上的智能体安全本质上是基础设施问题。作者提出威胁模型与十类威胁分类、九项设计原则、七层纵深防御框架，并给出跨EKS/AKS/GKE的参考架构与定性评估。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体正从聊天界面进入基础设施运维，能够读取遥测、调用工具、生成并执行代码、改变生产Kubernetes集群状态。这打破了传统云原生安全所假设的"数据与控制"边界：智能体仅"读取"的内容（日志行、工单、工具描述）即可重定向其行为，即提示注入。因此需要重新界定安全假设。
AI.method: 作者采取安全框架设计方法，而非实证测量。具体贡献包括：(i) 面向Kubernetes内外部运行智能体的威胁模型及十类威胁分类，对齐新兴的OWASP智能体应用指南；(ii) 九项设计原则，核心是工具边界的完全中介（complete mediation），以及打破"不可信输入+敏感访问+外部出口"三者组合；(iii) 七层纵深防御框架，将原则映射到原生或广泛采用的Kubernetes机制：工作负载身份、RBAC与ValidatingAdmissionPolicy、经SIG Apps Agent Sandbox项目的gVisor/Kata沙箱、FQDN感知出口策略、具备策略即代码（作用于工具参数）的智能体/MCP网关、eBPF运行时强制执行；(iv) 参考架构，含具体策略工件与各层在Amazon EKS、Azure Kubernetes Service、Google Kubernetes Engine上的绑定；(v) 定性评估，包括威胁-控制覆盖矩阵与四个攻击走查，以及一套拟议的实证方法。
AI.result: 论文未报告任何实测的攻击成功率或性能开销数据，而是给出定性评估结果：威胁-控制覆盖矩阵、四个攻击走查，以及为验证框架所需测量的清单，同时识别出残余风险。
AI.conclusion: 智能体安全不能依赖模型本身作为安全边界，必须假设智能体已被提示注入完全攻陷，所有保障仍须成立。作者呼吁以基础设施为中心、纵深防御的方式保障Kubernetes上的智能体安全，并指出后续需通过实证测量验证该框架。

title: EdgeAgent: Orchestrating On-Device LLM inference for End-User Multi-Agent Systems on CPU-GPU Unified Memory Architectures
summary:
Emerging multi-agent LLMs demand privacy-preserving edge deployment, yet current inference systems struggle with these collaborative workflows. Specifically, the memory-bound decode phase causes severe bus contention on unified memory architectures (UMA), paralyzing naive CPU-GPU co-execution. Furthermore, speculative decoding in multi-agent workloads faces extreme variance in drafting difficulty, alternating between complex reasoning and predictable structured generation. Compounded by frequent tool-induced stalls, this highly fragmented execution severely underutilizes hardware and defeats traditional static batching.
  We present EdgeAgent, a cross-layer inference system explicitly co-designed for edge UMA and multi-agent workloads. At the micro-architectural level, it bypasses rigid graph-compiler constraints to enable zero-copy UMA-aware tensor parallelism, utilizing asymmetric memory layouts to fully saturate both CPU and GPU compute units. At the scheduling level, it dynamically allocates draft budgets based on real-time sequence predictability to bound bandwidth waste. Concurrently, an asynchronous suspend-and-yield mechanism actively evicts stalled agents, ensuring continuous hardware saturation during unpredictable tool invocations.
  Extensive evaluations on an Apple M4 SoC demonstrate that the UMA-aware execution alone contributes a 1.29x speedup over batched speculative decoding. Adding the agent-aware scheduling lifts the full EdgeAgent system to a 1.77x speedup under extreme tool-use latencies.

AI.tldr: EdgeAgent 是一个面向边缘统一内存架构（UMA）与多智能体负载协同设计的跨层推理系统，通过零拷贝 UMA 感知张量并行、自适应草稿预算调度和异步挂起让出机制，在 Apple M4 上实现最高 1.77 倍加速。
AI.motivation: 多智能体 LLM 的隐私保护需求推动其向边缘部署，但现有推理系统难以支撑此类协同工作流：在 UMA 架构上，访存受限的解码阶段引发严重总线争用，使朴素的 CPU-GPU 协同执行失效；多智能体负载中的投机解码面临极大的草稿难度方差（复杂推理与可预测结构化生成交替出现）；叠加频繁的工具调用停顿，导致执行高度碎片化，硬件利用率低下，传统静态批处理策略失效。
AI.method: EdgeAgent 采用跨层协同设计。微架构层：绕过图编译器的刚性约束，实现零拷贝、UMA 感知的张量并行，并利用非对称内存布局同时打满 CPU 与 GPU 计算单元。调度层：依据实时序列可预测性动态分配草稿预算，以约束带宽浪费；同时引入异步挂起—让出机制，主动驱逐被阻塞的智能体，在工具调用不可预测时维持硬件持续饱和。
AI.result: 在 Apple M4 SoC 上的实验表明：仅 UMA 感知执行即可相比批量投机解码获得 1.29 倍加速；叠加智能体感知调度后，在极端工具调用延迟下，完整 EdgeAgent 系统达到 1.77 倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 跨层协同设计（微架构内存布局优化 + 智能体感知动态调度）可有效缓解边缘 UMA 上的总线争用与执行碎片化问题，显著提升多智能体 LLM 推理的硬件利用率与端到端性能。

title: Spatial Memory Intelligence: Endowing World Models with Understanding-Driven Long-Term Memory
summary: Long-video generation and world models have shown strong potential for interactive entertainment and embodied simulation by predicting future observations conditioned on user actions and historical memory. However, as memory sequences grow longer and their structures become increasingly complex, managing long-range spatial context becomes increasingly challenging, calling for a more intelligent and systematic memory-management strategy. Building on the advancing spatial reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and the broader vision of unified models, we propose Spatial Memory Intelligence (SMI), the first framework to systematically employ an understanding model for spatial-memory management in long-video world models. SMI introduces four coordinated atomic operations: spatial clustering, within-cluster sparsification, action-aware retrieval, and reliability-aware filtering. Extensive experiments across multiple baselines, benchmarks, and world-model backbones demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of SMI, achieving comprehensive improvements in memory sparsity, generation stability, and spatial consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出SMI框架，首次用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）进行长视频世界模型的空间记忆管理，通过四个原子操作提升记忆稀疏性、生成稳定性与空间一致性。
AI.motivation: 长视频生成与世界模型在交互娱乐和具身仿真中潜力巨大，但随记忆序列增长、结构复杂化，长程空间上下文管理日益困难，亟需更智能、系统的记忆管理策略。
AI.method: 基于MLLM的空间推理能力，提出Spatial Memory Intelligence（SMI）框架，首次系统地利用理解模型进行空间记忆管理，包含四个协同的原子操作：空间聚类、簇内稀疏化、动作感知检索、可靠性感知过滤。
AI.result: 在多个基线、基准和世界模型骨干上实验，证明SMI的有效性与泛化性，在记忆稀疏性、生成稳定性和空间一致性方面取得全面改进。
AI.conclusion: SMI为长视频世界模型的空间记忆管理提供了系统化方案，验证了理解模型赋能记忆管理的可行性，并具备良好的可扩展性与通用性。

title: TPBench: A Turning-Point Benchmark for Dialogue Compression
summary:
A compressor can keep the facts of a dialogue and still drop the turn that changed them. A user corrects a price, reverses a choice, or adds a constraint. We call this failure turning-point eviction. One overall retention score hides it, because that score mixes what the user first wanted with what the user wants now.
  We introduce TPBench, which evaluates three complementary information targets at shared nominal retention budgets. P1 asks for the user's initial goal. P2 asks for the current value of a slot the user revised. P3 asks for both, in dialogues with a late annotated slot update. The current-value answers come from the human dialogue-state annotations of MultiWOZ and SGD. The initial-goal answer is the first sentence of the first user turn. Neither requires new crowdsourcing.
  The probe-specific evaluations rank compression methods differently. On the joint probe at a retained fraction of 0.30, every tested compressed method remains below full context with the main Llama reader. Deleting the turn that carries the update sharply lowers current-value accuracy, while deleting one matched irrelevant turn leaves it unchanged. A Mistral reader repeats the P2/P3 rankings and the joint-probe gap. Current-value recovery is tested on an additional corpus, LongMemEval-KU, and on Chinese RiSAWOZ: full context has the highest accuracy, and recency has the highest compressed-method mean in both evaluations.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"转折点驱逐"（turning-point eviction）这一对话压缩失败模式，并构建TPBench基准，在共享名义保留预算下评测三类信息目标（P1初始目标、P2修订槽位的当前值、P3联合），揭示压缩方法在保留事实的同时可能丢弃改变事实的关键轮次。
AI.motivation: 现有对话压缩研究通常只报告一个整体保留分数，该分数将"用户最初想要什么"与"用户现在想要什么"混为一谈，从而掩盖了一类关键失败：压缩器可能保留了对话中的事实，却丢掉了改变这些事实的轮次（如用户更正价格、反转选择或新增约束）。作者将这一失败命名为"转折点驱逐"，并指出单一总分无法暴露它，因此需要一个能区分初始目标与当前值的评测框架。
AI.method: 提出TPBench，在共享的名义保留预算下评测三个互补信息目标：P1要求恢复用户初始目标（取第一轮用户话的首句）；P2要求恢复用户修订过的槽位当前值；P3要求在含晚期槽位更新的对话中同时给出两者。当前值答案来自MultiWOZ与SGD的人工对话状态标注，无需新众包。评测覆盖多种压缩方法，并设置对照实验（删除携带更新的轮次 vs. 删除一个匹配的无关轮次），同时用Llama与Mistral两种阅读器验证，并在LongMemEval-KU及中文RiSAWOZ语料上测试当前值恢复。
AI.result: 针对不同探针的评测对压缩方法给出不同排序。在保留比例0.30的联合探针（P3）上，所有被测压缩方法在主Llama阅读器下均低于全上下文。删除携带更新的轮次会显著降低当前值准确率，而删除一个匹配的无关轮次则使其保持不变。Mistral阅读器复现了P2/P3的排序及联合探针差距。当前值恢复在LongMemEval-KU和中文RiSAWOZ上的结果表明：全上下文准确率最高，且recency在两种评测中均为压缩方法均值最高者。
AI.conclusion: 单一整体保留分数会掩盖"转折点驱逐"这一失败，需按P1/P2/P3分别评测。TPBench证明现有压缩方法在联合探针上仍不及全上下文，且对携带更新的轮次高度敏感；recency在压缩方法中表现相对最好，但仍低于全上下文。该基准可复用现有人工标注、无需新众包，为对话压缩评测提供了针对"当前值"这一维度的诊断工具。

title: A Passive AI System for Verifying Physical State on Automated Liquid Handlers
summary: Automated liquid handlers execute digital protocols, but operators must assemble the deck and confirm that the physical setup matches the intended experiment. We present the Labware Setup Checker, a passive vision system that verifies deck preparation on an Opentrons Flex without modifying its hardware or firmware. A consumer webcam mounted outside the robot supplies images to a browser application. The checker segments the deck into slots, corrects slot assignments using the known deck geometry, classifies the labware, and compares the observed setup with a reference protocol library to report missing, misplaced, or unexpected labware. It operates independently of the robot controller and does not interrupt or gate a run. During SwabSeq Respiratory Viral Panel (RVP) pre-PCR deck preparation, the checker tracked a slot from empty to a base and then to the completed plate-and-base assembly, identifying the completed assembly in all 29 frames before robot motion. Across these frames, 95.1% of the 348 labware classifications for slots requiring exact matches agreed with the protocol reference. In 480 frames with partially occluded reservoirs, all 6,720 slot assignments were correct. Across three camera positions and two lighting conditions, slot assignment was 100% correct, and 97.73% of labware classifications matched the protocol reference. Median verification time was 2.10 s on a laptop using only its CPU and 4.24 s from frame capture to receipt of results during AWS deployment in the laboratory. These results show that an external camera and independent software can provide verification of deck setup against protocol requirements within seconds, allowing operators to review the physical setup before starting a run.

AI.tldr: 提出 Labware Setup Checker：一种无需改造 Opentrons Flex 硬件/固件的被动视觉系统，用外部普通摄像头与浏览器应用验证实验板准备，并在数秒内报告缺件、错位或多余耗材。
AI.motivation: 自动化液体处理器虽可执行数字协议，但操作员仍需人工组装台面并确认物理设置与实验意图一致，缺少独立、非侵入式的验证手段。
AI.method: 外部消费级摄像头采集图像；系统将台面分割为槽位，利用已知台面几何校正槽位分配，分类耗材，并将观测结果与参考协议库比对；独立于机器人控制器运行，不中断也不门控运行。
AI.result: 在 SwabSeq RVP 预 PCR 台面准备中，29 帧内全部识别完成装配，需精确匹配槽位的 348 次分类中 95.1% 与协议一致；480 帧部分遮挡储液槽场景中 6,720 次槽位分配全对；三种机位、两种光照下槽位分配 100% 正确，耗材分类 97.73% 与参考一致；笔记本 CPU 中位验证时间 2.10 s，AWS 部署下从采集到返回结果 4.24 s。
AI.conclusion: 外部摄像头与独立软件可在数秒内对照协议要求验证台面设置，使操作员可在启动运行前复核物理设置。

title: MuLoRA: Spectrally Balanced Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning
summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) provides a parameter-efficient approach to continual learning, but its nominal rank can conceal a loss of effective adaptation capacity. We identify \emph{spectral plasticity collapse}: during sequential adaptation, update energy becomes concentrated in a small subset of singular modes, leaving much of the available low-rank space underutilized. This exposes a limitation of interference avoidance alone: protecting historical representations does not ensure that the remaining adaptation capacity is responsive to new tasks or effectively utilized. To address this problem, we propose \texttt{MuLoRA}, which jointly controls capacity allocation and utilization. First, historical whitening identifies input directions with strong current-task response relative to accumulated historical response, yielding a task-adaptive basis that remains fixed during training. Second, approximate polar orthogonalization of momentum updates reduces spectral concentration within theselected space. An orthonormal basis connects these mechanisms by transferring the factor-update spectrum exactly tothe induced weight update. We establish a max--min characterization of exact subspace selection and derive cumulative spectral bounds under controlled cross-step anisotropy. Across five class-incremental benchmarks and eight incremental settings, \texttt{MuLoRA} achieves the highest mean accuracy in 15 of 16 reported metrics.

AI.tldr: 该文识别出LoRA持续学习中的"谱可塑性塌缩"问题，并提出MuLoRA，通过历史白化选择任务自适应子空间、对动量更新做近似极正交化以抑制谱集中，在多个类增量基准上取得最优平均精度。
AI.motivation: LoRA名义上的低秩并不等于有效的适应能力。序列适应过程中，更新能量集中于少数奇异模态，导致低秩空间大量未被利用，即"谱可塑性塌缩"。这表明仅靠避免干扰（保护历史表征）不足以保证剩余适应容量对新任务敏感并被有效利用，需要在容量分配与利用两方面联合控制。
AI.method: 提出MuLoRA，包含两个协同机制：(1) 历史白化：以当前任务响应相对于累积历史响应的强度识别输入方向，得到任务自适应基，训练中保持固定；(2) 对动量更新做近似极正交化，降低所选子空间内的谱集中。二者通过标准正交基连接，使因子更新谱精确传递到诱导的权重更新。理论上给出精确子空间选择的max–min刻画，并在受控的跨步各向异性下推导累积谱界。
AI.result: 在五个类增量基准、八种增量设置下，MuLoRA在16项报告指标中的15项取得最高平均精度。
AI.conclusion: MuLoRA通过联合控制适应容量的分配与利用，缓解LoRA持续学习中的谱可塑性塌缩，实证上优于现有方法，并具备子空间选择与谱界的理论支撑。

title: A Secure dToF LiDAR SoC with Dual-Domain Fingerprinting and Event-Driven AFE Circuit Achieving Sensor-Level Attack Resilience
summary: Recent studies have shown that most commercial direct time-of-flight (dToF) LiDARs can be spoofed by injecting high-frequency laser pulses into the receiver, which can erase pedestrians from the point cloud. This paper presents the first dToF LiDAR system-on-chip (SoC) with integrated sensor-level hardware security against spoofing attacks. We propose Dual-Domain Fingerprinting (DDF), which emits laser pulse pairs whose time interval and amplitude ratio are both randomized and authenticates received echoes in this two-dimensional space, so that spoofed signals are rejected before they corrupt the ranging result. An Event-Driven AFE (ED-AFE) activates the ADC only around pulse peaks: it digitizes three samples around each peak with a triggered ADC at 1-GHz sampling and applies parabolic interpolation, achieving 1-cm distance resolution with a 99% reduction in ADC power. A time-modulated laser driver controls the laser amplitude from 10% to 100% by modulating the charge time of a laser capacitor, providing the microsecond-order amplitude modulation required by DDF. A LiDAR system with a 16-channel 65-nm CMOS prototype SoC demonstrates up to 120-m ranging and an AFE power of 3.1 mW per channel, 60% lower than prior art. In a proof-of-concept experiment in which the dual-domain authentication is applied to measured sensor data, 73% of the point cloud is protected under spoofing attack, compared with 0% without DDF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个集成传感器级硬件安全的dToF LiDAR SoC，通过双域指纹（DDF）与事件驱动AFE等设计，在测距前拒绝欺骗信号，实现120 m测距、单通道3.1 mW AFE功耗，并在攻击下保护73%点云。
AI.motivation: 商用dToF LiDAR易受高频激光脉冲注入攻击而被欺骗，攻击者可借此从点云中"抹除"行人；现有方案缺乏传感器层面的硬件防护，需在回波污染测距结果之前完成认证与拒绝。
AI.method: 提出双域指纹（DDF）：发射时间间隔与幅度比均随机化的激光脉冲对，在"时间-幅度"二维空间对回波进行认证，欺骗信号在干扰测距前被拒绝；采用事件驱动AFE（ED-AFE），仅在脉冲峰值附近以触发式1-GHz ADC采样三点并做抛物线插值；采用时间调制激光驱动器，通过调制激光电容充电时间实现10%–100%幅度、微秒级调制。基于16通道65-nm CMOS原型SoC构建LiDAR系统。
AI.result: 实现最远120 m测距；AFE单通道功耗3.1 mW，较现有技术降低60%；ED-AFE以1-GHz采样实现1-cm距离分辨率，ADC功耗降低99%；在将双域认证应用于实测传感器数据的概念验证实验中，欺骗攻击下73%点云受到保护（无DDF时为0%）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次在dToF LiDAR SoC中实现传感器级硬件抗欺骗，DDF与ED-AFE、时间调制激光驱动协同，在保持低功耗与高分辨率测距的同时显著提升抗攻击能力，为LiDAR安全提供了可集成的硬件方案。

title: MEA: A Reward-Driven Multi-Agent System for Faithful Model Explanations
summary: Recent years have seen the employment of a plethora of machine learning (ML) models in high-stakes domains, but they remain largely opaque to the practitioners who act on their predictions. While post-hoc explanation methods offer a lens into this model behavior, wielding them effectively demands expertise most domain experts lack: navigating high-dimensional outputs, selecting the best explanations, and synthesizing evidence across disparate tools. To this end, we present MEA, a multi-agent framework that removes the explanation knowledge barrier entirely: a Proposer agent selects and configures explanation tools based on the question and modality, while an Actor agent is optimized end-to-end against faithfulness, transforming the outputs into natural language explanations grounded in model behavior across tabular, text, and vision modalities. Further, we introduce diverse question types spanning feature attribution, counterfactual reasoning, and spurious feature detection, each paired with a perturbation-based faithfulness metric. We find that frontier LLMs systematically produce unfaithful explanations. By optimizing against faithfulness rewards augmented with a modality-adaptive penalty, MEA consistently outperforms post hoc explainers, agentic, and closed-source baselines across six datasets, with reward-driven optimization yielding faithfulness gains of +28% (tabular), +21% (text), and +34% (vision) over the untrained backbone. More broadly, our findings suggest that AI agents themselves can serve as a scalable, adaptable interface to ML explainability, opening a path toward natural-language explainability that generalizes beyond the fixed, single-purpose tools that have long defined the field.

AI.tldr: 论文提出多智能体框架MEA，通过Proposer选择配置解释工具、Actor针对忠实性端到端优化，将模型行为转化为自然语言解释，在表格、文本、视觉三类模态六个数据集上超越多种基线。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型广泛用于高风险领域，但仍对实践者不透明。事后解释方法虽能揭示模型行为，却要求使用者具备导航高维输出、筛选最佳解释、跨工具综合证据等专业知识，而多数领域专家并不具备这些能力，构成"解释知识壁垒"。
AI.method: 提出MEA多智能体框架：Proposer智能体依据问题与模态选择并配置解释工具；Actor智能体以忠实性为奖励进行端到端优化，将工具输出转化为扎根于模型行为的自然语言解释，覆盖表格、文本、视觉模态。同时设计涵盖特征归因、反事实推理、虚假特征检测的多类问题，并为每类配备基于扰动的忠实性度量；优化目标为忠实性奖励并加入模态自适应惩罚项。
AI.result: 发现前沿大语言模型会系统性地产生不忠实解释。MEA在六个数据集上持续优于事后解释器、智能体方法与闭源基线；奖励驱动优化相比未训练骨干网络带来忠实性提升：表格+28%、文本+21%、视觉+34%。
AI.conclusion: AI智能体本身可作为可扩展、可适配的机器学习可解释性接口，推动自然语言可解释性超越传统固定单一用途工具，具有更广的泛化前景。

title: AgentTrap: Stateful Feedback Deception against Autonomous Penetration Testing Agents
summary:
Autonomous penetration testing agents conduct multi-step attacks by continuously adapting their plans and actions to target responses. As a common defense, honeypots can be deployed to divert these agents from real assets by presenting decoy services, while also supporting attack tracing and active counterattacks. However, conventional honeypots rely primarily on static artifacts and predefined responses, leaving them unable to adapt to the evolving attack strategies of autonomous penetration testing agents. To this end, we present AgentTrap, the first closed-loop honeypot tailored for autonomous penetration testing agents. AgentTrap uses sentinel endpoints to avoid benign interference, stateful deception grounded in the protected application, and behavior-guided escalation to sustain engagement and collect agent-side behavioral evidence with controlled disclosures.
  We evaluate AgentTrap against eight autonomous penetration-testing agents in a deployed web application containing a real application endpoint and a separate honeypot endpoint configured under three defense strategies. Compared with no defense, AgentTrap reduces the aggregate real-target attack success rate from 95.8% to 79.2% and successfully elicits attacker API keys in 18.8% of the runs, outperforming static deception and fixed escalation. Furthermore, trace analysis shows that resistance to such counterattacks depends jointly on model-level recognition of deceptive requests and architecture-level isolation of sensitive resources.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgentTrap——首个面向自主渗透测试智能体的闭环蜜罐，通过哨兵端点、基于受保护应用的状态化欺骗和行为引导升级，在真实Web应用中有效降低攻击成功率并诱捕攻击者行为证据。
AI.motivation: 自主渗透测试智能体能够持续调整计划与行动以适应目标响应，而传统蜜罐主要依赖静态诱饵与预定义响应，无法适应这类智能体不断演进的攻击策略，因此需要一种动态自适应的蜜罐防御机制。
AI.method: AgentTrap采用三项核心设计：哨兵端点以避免对正常流量的干扰；基于受保护应用的状态化欺骗；以及行为引导的升级机制，用以维持交互并受控地披露信息，从而收集智能体侧的行为证据。
AI.result: 在包含真实应用端点与独立蜜罐端点的部署Web应用中，针对八种自主渗透测试智能体、三种防御策略进行评估：相比无防御，AgentTrap将真实目标总体攻击成功率从95.8%降至79.2%，并在18.8%的运行中成功获取攻击者API密钥，优于静态欺骗与固定升级策略。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹分析表明，智能体对此类反制攻击的抵御能力同时取决于模型层面对欺骗性请求的识别能力与架构层面对敏感资源的隔离能力。

title: RailWave: Adaptive Spatial and Temporal Scheduling for Expert-Parallel Communication
summary: Irregular All-to-All communication is a major bottleneck in expert-parallel Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. Even with fixed expert routing and placement, uneven utilization of parallel network Rails and incast can limit communication performance. We present RailWave, a phase-adaptive communication layer built on DeepEP that addresses these bottlenecks below the routing layer through spatial and temporal traffic shaping. RailBalance redistributes source traffic across eligible Rails using source-local information, while a reusable, topology-derived permutation schedule limits concurrent senders per receiver without rebuilding demand-dependent schedules for each communication phase. A lightweight calibrated selector chooses an execution path according to each phase's traffic characteristics and offline profiling results. On training-derived communication workloads from the 106B GLM-4.5-Air model, RailWave delivers up to 5.84x speedup on H800 and 4.36x on H20 over Native. Code is available at https://github.com/CyberSecurityErial/RailWave-EP.

AI.tldr: RailWave：面向专家并行MoE的相位自适应通信层，通过时空流量整形缓解All-to-All瓶颈，在GLM-4.5-Air负载上相比Native实现最高5.84x（H800）和4.36x（H20）加速。
AI.motivation: 专家并行MoE中不规则的All-to-All通信是主要瓶颈；即使路由与专家放置固定，并行网络Rail利用率不均和incast仍制约通信性能。
AI.method: 基于DeepEP构建相位自适应通信层，在路由层之下做时空流量整形：RailBalance利用源端局部信息将源流量重分布到可用Rail；采用可复用、由拓扑推导的置换调度限制每个接收端的并发发送者，避免为每相位重建依赖需求的调度；轻量级标定选择器依据各相位流量特征与离线profiling结果选择执行路径。
AI.result: 在源自106B GLM-4.5-Air模型的训练通信负载上，相比Native，H800最高加速5.84x，H20最高加速4.36x。
AI.conclusion: RailWave通过在路由层之下进行空间与时间流量整形，有效缓解专家并行MoE的All-to-All通信瓶颈，性能提升显著且具备跨硬件可移植性，代码已开源。

title: Oracle headroom without signal: null-calibrated evaluation of candidate selection for thermal heart rate estimation
summary: Camera-based physiological monitoring can produce multiple estimates from several facial regions, extraction methods, and processing settings. Signal quality indices aim to select reliable estimates without a physiological reference, and their potential is often assessed with an oracle that selects the estimate closest to the reference in each window. This retrospective selection can reward chance agreement. We model the effect with order statistics. For K independent candidates unrelated to the reference, the expected oracle error decreases approximately as 1/K. We analyze thermal heart rate estimation on 96 iBVP recordings with 168 candidates per 10 s window. The oracle achieves a mean absolute error of 0.91 bpm, compared with 10.74 bpm for the best fixed configuration, 18.03 bpm for the best quality index, and 8.61 bpm for a constant predictor. With K = 24, a forehead signal from another recording matches the correct one, with 4.62 against 4.61 bpm. Oracle evaluations should report candidate count, valid coverage, and matched null controls.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有基于信号质量指标选择生理估计的评估常使用"事后预言机"（oracle）挑选最接近参考的候选，这会因顺序统计量效应而奖励偶然一致；作者用顺序统计建模，证明K个与参考无关的独立候选中预言机误差约按1/K下降，并在热成像心率估计实验（96个iBVP记录、每10秒168个候选）中验证该偏差，呼吁报告候选数、有效覆盖率和匹配的零对照。
AI.motivation: 基于摄像头的生理监测可从多个面部区域、提取方法和处理设置产生多个估计。信号质量指标旨在无需生理参考的情况下选择可靠估计，但其潜力常用oracle评估——在每个时间窗内选择最接近参考的估计。作者质疑这种回顾性选择可能奖励偶然一致，导致对质量指标潜力的高估。
AI.method: 用顺序统计量对oracle选择效应建模：对于K个与参考无关的独立候选，推导预言机期望误差随1/K近似下降。随后在热成像心率估计任务上实验：96个iBVP记录，每10秒窗口生成168个候选，比较oracle、最佳固定配置、最佳质量指标和常数预测器的平均绝对误差。
AI.result: oracle达到0.91 bpm的平均绝对误差，而最佳固定配置为10.74 bpm，最佳质量指标为18.03 bpm，常数预测器为8.61 bpm。当K=24时，来自另一记录的前额信号与正确信号表现相当（4.62 vs 4.61 bpm），说明oracle可在无真实生理相关性的情况下选出看似最优的候选。
AI.conclusion: oracle评估存在系统性偏差，会夸大信号质量指标的潜力。建议在报告oracle评估时同时给出候选数量、有效覆盖率以及匹配的零对照，以避免因偶然一致而得出误导性结论。

title: Beyond Correctness: Resolving Underspecification in Agentic Text-to-SQL
summary: Agentic Text-to-SQL systems can interact with users to clarify underspecified queries before generating SQL. However, a correct execution result does not necessarily imply that the agent has adequately resolved the underlying underspecification: the agent may silently make unverified assumptions that happen to match the intended answer. We show that this behavior is driven in part by premature clarification termination. Although forcing an agent to ask more questions improves execution accuracy, ambiguities are concentrated in earlier interactions, making brute-force questioning inefficient. More importantly, even when explicitly prompted to plan its clarification process, the agent frequently abandons questions that it has already identified as relevant. To address this failure mode, we introduce PlanPool, which externalizes the clarification plan as a mutable question pool. Every planned question must be explicitly asked or dropped before submission, while newly discovered ambiguities can be added during interaction. Across three benchmarks derived from BIRD-Interact and Spider, PlanPool consistently improves ambiguity coverage and reduces silent failures over unconstrained and prompt-based alternatives, while maintaining competitive execution accuracy. Our results highlight an important distinction in agentic reasoning: identifying missing information is not sufficient, and the agent must also reliably maintain and resolve it before committing to an answer.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究Agentic Text-to-SQL系统在澄清欠明确查询时的"过早终止澄清"问题，提出PlanPool方法，将澄清计划外化为可变问题池，强制每个计划问题被显式提问或放弃，从而提升歧义覆盖并减少静默失败。
AI.motivation: 现有Agentic Text-to-SQL系统虽可与用户交互澄清欠明确查询，但正确执行结果并不意味着歧义被真正解决——智能体可能默默做出未经核实的假设，恰好符合预期答案。作者指出这一行为部分源于"过早终止澄清"。虽然强制智能体多提问能提升执行准确率，但歧义集中在早期交互中，暴力提问效率低；更关键的是，即使被明确提示规划澄清过程，智能体仍频繁放弃已识别出的相关问题。因此需要一种机制保证已识别的歧义被可靠地维护和解决。
AI.method: 作者提出PlanPool，将澄清计划外化为一个可变的问题池（mutable question pool）。每个计划的问题在提交答案前必须被显式提问或显式丢弃；同时，交互过程中新发现的歧义可以动态加入问题池。该方法强制智能体对已识别的问题负责，而非默默放弃。
AI.result: 在基于BIRD-Interact和Spider构建的三个基准上，PlanPool相较于无约束方法和基于提示的方法，一致性地提升了歧义覆盖率、减少了静默失败，同时保持了有竞争力的执行准确率。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了Agentic推理中的一个重要区别：识别缺失信息并不充分，智能体还必须在给出答案前可靠地维护并解决这些信息。PlanPool通过外化问题池的方式有效缓解了过早终止澄清的失败模式。

title: DeltaWorld: Physically Consistent Interactive World Simulators via Action-Conditioned Latent Increment Learning
summary: Interactive world simulators can provide scalable environments for robot planning, policy training, and evaluation by predicting action consequences while reducing reliance on repeated physical rollouts. To serve these applications, they must generate future image sequences that respond faithfully to robot actions and preserve the dynamics of robot-object interactions over long horizons. However, existing world models typically predict the entire next latent state and often fail to capture subtle changes induced by robot actions. Such omissions can produce physically implausible outcomes, including object interpenetration and excessive deformation. To address this limitation, we propose DeltaWorld, a physically consistent interactive world simulator for robotic manipulation. Our method introduces the Delta Latent Transition Model (Delta-LTM), which predicts action-induced latent feature changes and adds them to the current latent state to obtain the next state, rather than predicting the next latent state directly. To mitigate object interpenetration and excessive deformation in predicted future frames, Interaction-aware Latent Alignment is introduced to construct counterfactual interaction regions and supervise interaction-related latent changes. DeltaWorld is evaluated on the IWS manipulation benchmark and a self-collected cross-robot dataset covering multiple robot embodiments and manipulation tasks. On the cross-robot dataset, DeltaWorld reduces FVD by 46.6% and LPIPS by 31.1% relative to the IWS baseline. These results highlight the potential of DeltaWorld for long-horizon action-conditioned video prediction in robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出DeltaWorld交互式世界模拟器，用Delta-LTM预测动作引起的潜在状态增量，并引入交互感知潜在对齐，提升机器人操作长时程预测的物理一致性。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模拟器可用于机器人规划、策略训练与评估，减少对物理实验的依赖。但现有世界模型通常直接预测完整下一潜在状态，难以捕捉机器人动作引起的细微变化，导致物体互穿、过度形变等物理不合理结果，长时程动态保持能力不足。
AI.method: 提出DeltaWorld，核心是Delta潜在转移模型（Delta-LTM）：预测动作诱导的潜在特征变化，并叠加到当前潜在状态得到下一状态，而非直接预测下一状态。同时引入交互感知潜在对齐，构建反事实交互区域并监督与交互相关的潜在变化，以缓解互穿和过度形变。
AI.result: 在IWS操作基准和自采集的跨机器人数据集（涵盖多种机器人本体与操作任务）上评估。跨机器人数据集上，相对IWS基线，FVD降低46.6%，LPIPS降低31.1%。
AI.conclusion: DeltaWorld在机器人操作的长时程、动作条件视频预测中具有潜力，能提升预测的物理一致性与动作响应准确性。

title: Effects of interpulse-interval variation on deep-learning classification of bat vocalizations
summary: Temporal context may aid automated bat-species classification, but the contribution of specific features remains unclear. We investigated whether variation in the interpulse interval (IPI)-the time between consecutive call onsets-provides species-discriminative information and whether transformer-based models are more sensitive to this information than convolutional neural networks. We created two matched datasets from European bat recordings: a natural-IPI condition retaining the original call timing and a normalized-IPI condition in which call onsets were spaced at 50-ms intervals. EfficientNet-B0 and PaSST were fine-tuned and evaluated within each condition. In an additional experiment, each architecture was trained separately on natural-IPI and normalized-IPI recordings, and evaluated on the same natural-IPI test set. Finally, the pretrained classifiers BatDetect2 and BAT were evaluated on both conditions. Within-condition IPI normalization had model-dependent effects. PaSST accuracy differed little between the natural-IPI ($71 \pm 2.3\%$) and normalized-IPI ($70 \pm 6.3\%$) conditions, whereas EfficientNet accuracy increased from $47 \pm 4.7\%$ to $57 \pm 3.9\%$. PaSST exceeded EfficientNet under both conditions. In the cross-condition evaluation, models trained on natural-IPI recordings outperformed those trained on normalized-IPI recordings on the natural-IPI test set: accuracy decreased from 54% to 50% for EfficientNet and from 65% to 57% for PaSST. BatDetect2 and BAT differed little between IPI conditions. Overall, we found limited support for the hypotheses that natural IPI variation contributes substantially to bat-species classification and that it is used more effectively by transformer-based than CNN-based models. Nevertheless, the cross-condition performance decrease shows that results obtained under normalized conditions may not transfer fully to natural recordings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了脉冲间隔(IPI)是否能提供蝙蝠物种判别信息，以及基于Transformer的模型是否比CNN更敏感于该信息。通过构建自然IPI与归一化IPI（50ms间隔）两组配对数据集，微调EfficientNet-B0与PaSST进行比较。
AI.motivation: 时间上下文可能有助于蝙蝠物种自动分类，但具体特征的贡献尚不清楚。作者希望明确IPI变异是否具有物种判别性，并检验Transformer模型是否比CNN更能利用这一时间信息。
AI.method: 基于欧洲蝙蝠录音构建两组配对数据集：保留原始呼叫时序的自然IPI条件，以及将呼叫起点归一化为50ms间隔的归一化IPI条件。微调EfficientNet-B0与PaSST并在各条件下评估；另设交叉条件实验，分别用两种条件训练后在自然IPI测试集评估；同时评估预训练分类器BatDetect2与BAT。
AI.result: 条件内IPI归一化效果依模型而异：PaSST在自然IPI(71±2.3%)与归一化IPI(70±6.3%)间差异很小，EfficientNet则从47±4.7%提升至57±3.9%，PaSST在两条件下均优于EfficientNet。交叉条件下，自然IPI训练的模型在自然IPI测试集上优于归一化IPI训练的模型（EfficientNet由54%降至50%，PaSST由65%降至57%）。BatDetect2与BAT在两条件间差异较小。
AI.conclusion: 总体而言，对"自然IPI变异对蝙蝠物种分类有实质贡献"及"Transformer比CNN更有效利用该信息"的假设支持有限。但交叉条件性能下降表明，归一化条件下获得的结果可能无法完全迁移到自然录音。

title: What Does a Token Cost? A Mixture-of-Agents Measurement of Sufficient Per-Token Compute
summary: Large language models spend the same amount of computation on every token they generate, regardless of how difficult each token is to produce. Methods such as speculative decoding and model routing are built on the premise that much of this computation is unnecessary, yet the computation an individual token actually requires has not been measured. We measure it through a Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) lens: a panel of fifteen language models of increasing capacity, drawn from three families, in which every agent attempts to reproduce a reference sequence token by token, conditioned on the correct preceding tokens. We define the inference cost of the smallest agent that succeeds as the token's sufficient compute, which upper-bounds what the token requires. On three core benchmarks, a 0.5B agent reproduces 92--95\% of reference tokens. Across Qwen, OLMo, and R1-distilled panels, the most expensive 10\% account for 64--80\% of estimated FLOPs. On all 500 MATH-500 problems, the MoA-derived map helps model routing reduce projected latency from 7.59 to 5.12 seconds while slightly improving accuracy, relative to the best confidence-routing baseline. The MoA-map helps drafting use 32.6\% fewer draft tokens and approximately 20\% lower projected latency than fixed-window drafting at similar accuracy. These comparisons reveal remaining allocation headroom, motivating controllers that exploit sufficient-compute structure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用Mixture-of-Agents（MoA）视角测量单个token的"充分计算量"（sufficient compute），发现token间计算需求高度不均（最贵10%占64–80% FLOPs），并将该映射用于模型路由与投机解码，显著降低延迟与草稿开销。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型对每个生成token都投入相同计算量，忽视了token难度差异；投机解码与模型路由虽假设大量计算冗余，但单个token实际所需计算量此前未被测量，因此缺少量化依据。
AI.method: 构建含15个不同规模模型（来自三个模型族）的Mixture-of-Agents面板，每个agent在给定正确前序token条件下逐token复现参考序列；将最小成功agent的推理成本定义为该token的"充分计算量"（sufficient compute），作为所需计算量的上界，并据此构建MoA计算量映射，用于模型路由与草稿生成。
AI.result: 在三个核心基准上，0.5B的agent可复现92–95%的参考token；在Qwen、OLMo、R1-distilled三个面板中，最昂贵的10% token占估计FLOPs的64–80%。在全部500道MATH-500题目上，基于MoA映射的路由将预计延迟从7.59秒降至5.12秒且精度略升；在草稿生成中，相比固定窗口草稿，使用草稿token减少32.6%、预计延迟约降低20%，精度相当。
AI.conclusion: token级计算需求存在显著结构性与可观的分配余量（allocation headroom），基于充分计算量结构的控制器可有效优化推理资源分配，为未来自适应计算控制提供方向。

title: Digital Twin-Assisted Mapping of ICS Telemetry to ATT&CK for ICS with Evidence-Driven Dependency Reasoning
summary: Reconstructing adversarial behavior from Industrial Control System (ICS) telemetry is difficult because process observations reveal physical changes more directly than the actions that produced them. This paper presents a Digital Twin (DT)-assisted framework that extracts synchronized state changes, converts them into evidence-preserving descriptions, maps them to ATT&CK for ICS through retrieval-augmented Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning, and constructs a typed dependency graph. Evaluation comprises a four-configuration ablation on nine held-out SWaT scenarios containing ten telemetry-evaluable ground-truth episodes, three independent generations of the principal mapping configurations, and external evaluation on BATADAL and WADI. Across the three SWaT generations, DT-enriched mapping produces fewer annotation-relative False Positive (FP) episodes in every run, with a mean per-run reduction of 34.1%. Both configurations obtain a mean recall of 0.633, although recall varies between 0.50 and 0.70 and DT enrichment does not improve F1 in every run. These observations are descriptive: the primary-run paired comparisons do not reach statistical significance, and the mapping advantage does not transfer to either external dataset. An exploratory positive-only dependency benchmark recovers eight of nine documented Co-occurrence relationships with DT context. A separate end-to-end benchmark containing one positive pair and 25 negative controls exposes propagation of mapping errors into unsupported edges. The findings identify both the potential and limitations of DT context for semantic security interpretation, without establishing reliable autonomous attribution, general causal reconstruction, or practical analyst benefit.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种数字孪生辅助框架，从ICS遥测中提取同步状态变化并通过检索增强LLM推理映射到ATT&CK for ICS，构建类型化依赖图；实验显示DT增强可降低假正例但整体效果有限且不具统计显著性和跨数据集泛化性。
AI.motivation: 从ICS遥测重建对抗行为困难，因为过程观测更直接反映物理变化而非产生该变化的攻击动作，语义归因与因果重建难以可靠实现。
AI.method: 框架包含四个环节：提取同步状态变化、转化为保留证据的描述、通过检索增强大语言模型（RAG-LLM）推理映射至ATT&CK for ICS、构建类型化依赖图。评估设计：SWaT九个留出场景的四配置消融（含十个可评估遥测的真值事件）、主映射配置三次独立生成，以及BATADAL和WADI的外部评估；另含仅正例依赖基准与端到端基准（1个正例对、25个负例对照）。
AI.result: 三次SWaT生成中，DT增强映射在每一轮均产生更少的标注相对假正例事件，平均每轮减少34.1%。两种配置平均召回率为0.633，但波动于0.50–0.70，且DT增强并非每轮都提升F1。主轮配对比较未达统计显著，映射优势未迁移至两个外部数据集。探索性仅正例依赖基准在DT上下文下恢复9条已记录共现关系中的8条；端到端基准暴露了映射错误向无支撑边传播的问题。
AI.conclusion: DT上下文对语义安全解释兼具潜力与局限：可用于降低假正例并辅助关系恢复，但尚不能建立可靠的自主归因、通用因果重建或实际分析收益，相关观察为描述性且需谨慎解读。

title: Cross-Facility LLM Pre-training on HPC: Elastic Aggregation, Data Leasing, and Queue-Aware Placement
summary: Academic compute is fragmented: allocations are granted per facility, and facilities differ in accelerators and software stacks, schedule jobs independently, and share neither a network nor a filesystem. We present a system that pools such allocations to pre-train a single language model across three supercomputers on two continents, up to 7,400km apart: Snellius (NVIDIA H100), LUMI and Frontier (both AMD MI250X). It combines (i) DiLoCo-style two-loop training with an elastic, token-weighted Nesterov outer step for which zero, one or many live sites are all normal states; (ii) DARL, a data-leasing protocol whose heartbeat-backed leases guarantee that, within an epoch, no sample is trained twice or lost under crashes, late joins and work stealing; and (iii) queue-aware placement driven by unprivileged sbatch --test-only probes. Training Qwen3-0.6B on C4 for 20,000 optimizer steps, the three-site run reaches a held-out perplexity of 34.7, against 28.2 for a centralised baseline. Per-round overhead (weight exchange and checkpointing) stays near 110 s regardless of the number of local steps H, so its share of wall-clock time falls from 32% at H=100 to 5.7% at H=1,000 and 3.1% at H=2,000. In a 23.8 h three-site run with four site departures, 1.2% of granted data blocks were reclaimed and none was duplicated or lost. In an idealized queue-model projection, queue-aware placement shortens time-to-target by 18-43% compared with waiting for all sites to be allocated. Cross-site pre-training is thus operational rather than competitive: it turns fragmented allocations into one training run at a measured cost.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个跨异构超级计算机池化分散算力预训练语言模型的系统，结合弹性双环训练、数据租赁协议与队列感知放置，在三大超算上成功训练Qwen3-0.6B，实现可运行的跨站点预训练。
AI.motivation: 学术算力高度碎片化：算力按设施分配，各设施在加速器、软件栈、调度、网络和文件系统上彼此独立。作者希望将这种分散的分配池化起来，共同预训练单一语言模型，使跨站点预训练从理论走向实际可运行。
AI.method: 系统由三部分组成：(i) DiLoCo风格的双环训练，配以弹性、按token加权的Nesterov外步，使零个、一个或多个活跃站点都成为正常状态；(ii) DARL数据租赁协议，通过心跳支持的租约保证在一个epoch内样本不重复训练、不丢失，可应对崩溃、迟到加入和窃取工作；(iii) 基于非特权sbatch --test-only探测的队列感知放置。
AI.result: 在三台超算（Snellius的H100、LUMI和Frontier的MI250X，跨两大洲最远7400km）上训练Qwen3-0.6B于C4数据集2万步，三站点运行留出困惑度为34.7，集中式基线为28.2。每轮开销（权重交换与检查点）约110s，与本地步数H无关，其墙钟占比从H=100的32%降至H=1000的5.7%、H=2000的3.1%。23.8小时三站点运行中有四次站点离开，仅1.2%已授予数据块被回收，无重复或丢失。理想队列模型下，队列感知放置比等待所有站点分配可缩短18-43%的达标时间。
AI.conclusion: 跨站点预训练是"可运行"而非"竞争性"的：它把碎片化算力转化为一次训练运行，代价可测量。该系统为学术算力池化提供了可行路径。

title: DAGS: Disentangled Appearance-and-Geometry Steering of a Frozen Image DiT for Temporally Stabilized Generative Rendering
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications
summary: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) generate high-fidelity images from text and image conditions, but their outputs carry large variance and their faithfulness to a desired target depends heavily on how the condition is supplied. We present DAGS, a lightweight, attention-free, disentangled appearance and geometry conditioning scheme that steers a frozen image DiT to produce high-fidelity, highly faithful, and independently controllable renders. Two small convolutional encoders compute conditioning features once per frame and inject them as a learned, per-layer, element-wise residual into the image tokens, avoiding the quadratic cost of stacking conditions through attention. Because control and temporal handling live outside the frozen backbone, we retain its vast pretrained prior and eliminate backbone-overfitting risk. We further add a small recurrent lighting stabilizer and a training-free temporal guidance term that, coupled with our conditioning, elevate a per-frame image model into a streaming renderer. DAGS produces controllable, high-quality renders at a fraction of the compute of path tracing; it is not real-time, trading compute for controllability and quality. On a matched 1-spp + G-buffer input, per-frame DAGS reconstructs +8.6 dB / +10.1 dB PSNR over the real-time denoiser Intel OIDN and the diffusion renderer RGB<->X while being 2.5-8x more temporally stable perceptually (temporal-LPIPS flicker).

AI.tldr: DAGS是一种轻量、无注意力机制的解耦外观与几何条件方案，通过将条件特征以逐层元素级残差注入冻结的DiT图像令牌，实现高保真、可控的渲染，并借助循环光照稳定器与免训练时序引导将其变为流式渲染器。
AI.motivation: DiT能从文本与图像条件生成高保真图像，但输出方差大，且对目标条件的保真度高度依赖条件的注入方式，需要一种能独立控制外观与几何、又保持骨干网络先验的轻量条件机制。
AI.method: DAGS使用两个小型卷积编码器逐帧计算条件特征，并以学习到的逐层元素级残差注入图像令牌，避免注意力堆叠条件的二次开销；控制与时序处理置于冻结骨干之外，保留预训练先验并消除过拟合风险。此外加入小型循环光照稳定器和免训练时序引导项，将逐帧图像模型提升为流式渲染器。
AI.result: 在匹配的1-spp + G-buffer输入下，逐帧DAGS相较实时降噪器Intel OIDN和扩散渲染器RGB<->X分别提升+8.6 dB / +10.1 dB PSNR，并在感知层面（temporal-LPIPS闪烁）实现2.5-8倍更好的时序稳定性；计算量仅为路径追踪的一小部分，但非实时。
AI.conclusion: DAGS以牺牲实时性换取可控性与质量，验证了解耦条件注入可在冻结DiT上实现高保真、独立可控的流式渲染。

title: EpiWorld: Grounding LLM Policy Agents in Epidemiological World Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 22 pages
summary: Epidemic intervention policies are textual artefacts that human decision-makers interpret, justify, and revise through natural language, making large language models a natural candidate for epidemic policy reasoning. A naive LLM, however, lacks the epidemic dynamics needed to project intervention consequences, the quantitative surveillance signals required to assess severity, and the institutional constraints that define admissible actions. We present EpiWorld, a closed-loop framework that grounds an LLM policy actor in a learned action-conditioned epidemiological world model and a tiered skill library of public-health protocols, surveillance tools, and adaptive lessons accumulated through after-action analysis. Given a candidate intervention, the world model predicts regional epidemic evolution and enables fast counterfactual rollouts that provide feedback for policy selection and refinement. Outcomes of simulated futures are distilled into reusable lessons while protocol constraints remain fixed, allowing the decision process to improve without sacrificing interpretability or controllability. We evaluate both the world model and the end-to-end framework on retrospective COVID-19 and Influenza datasets: the world model achieves the best out-of-distribution Peak-MAE among all forecasting baselines, and the closed-loop framework reduces cumulative hospitalisation by up to 59% across datasets and by an average of ~16% across six LLM backbones, outperforming reinforcement-learning and optimal-control policy baselines.

AI.tldr: EpiWorld：以学习到的动作条件流行病世界模型与分层技能库为LLM政策智能体提供闭环推理，实现更强的干预决策。
AI.motivation: 流行病干预政策本质上是以自然语言表述、由人类决策者解释与修订的文本产物，因此LLM天然适合用于政策推理。但朴素LLM缺少三样关键要素：预测干预后果所需的流行病动力学、评估严重程度所需的定量监测信号、以及界定可行动作的制度约束。
AI.method: 提出EpiWorld闭环框架：将LLM政策智能体锚定在一个学习到的动作条件流行病世界模型与分层技能库上，技能库包含公共卫生协议、监测工具及事后复盘积累的自适应经验。给定候选干预，世界模型预测区域流行病演化并进行快速反事实推演，为政策选择与优化提供反馈；模拟未来的结果被蒸馏为可复用经验，同时协议约束保持固定。
AI.result: 在回顾性COVID-19与Influenza数据集上评估：世界模型在所有预测基线中取得最优的分布外Peak-MAE；闭环框架在各数据集上最多降低59%累计住院人数，在六种LLM骨干上平均降低约16%，优于强化学习与最优控制政策基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过世界模型、技能库与固定协议约束的组合，决策过程可在不牺牲可解释性与可控性的前提下持续改进，验证了LLM作为流行病政策推理主体的可行性。

title: Who Went Where When on the Lunar Surface: Forensic Trajectory Analysis to Identify Byzantine Rovers
summary: Future planetary surface missions are likely to involve multiple independently operated rovers sharing the same deployment region, raising the need to verify compliance with operational constraints such as Lunar Safety Zones. Because continuous in-situ observability is rarely available, such verification requires post-hoc reconstruction of rover trajectories from sparse telemetry, including odometry, pose priors, and relative inter-rover detections. We introduce the problem of forensic trajectory analysis for non-cooperative planetary rovers in the presence of Byzantine agents: rovers that provide miscalibrated or deliberately falsified measurements to support an incorrect trajectory. We show that standard outlier-robust pose graph optimisation methods are vulnerable in this setting, because Byzantine rovers can generate measurements that are internally consistent and numerous enough to make truthful incriminating measurements appear as outliers. To address this, we propose an attribution-aware trajectory estimation method that reasons over rover credibility rather than individual measurement validity. The method evaluates candidate credible rover subsets by comparing the statistical consistency of their internal and boundary relative detections against provided priors, and then estimates trajectories using only measurements attributed to credible agents. Across synthetic simulations and real planetary-analogue trajectory data, the proposed method identifies Byzantine rovers and produces significantly more accurate trajectory estimates than existing robust pose graph optimisation baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"面向非合作行星巡视器的取证轨迹分析"问题，针对存在拜占庭代理（伪造/失准测量）的场景，指出传统鲁棒位姿图优化易被内部自洽的虚假测量欺骗，转而提出以"巡视器可信度"而非"单条测量有效性"为推理对象的归因感知轨迹估计方法。
AI.motivation: 未来行星表面任务可能由多个独立运行的巡视器共享同一部署区域，需要核查其是否遵守月面安全区等运行约束。但由于罕有连续在轨观测，只能依赖稀疏遥测（里程计、位姿先验、巡视器间相对观测）进行事后轨迹重建。此场景中可能存在拜占庭代理：通过失准或蓄意伪造测量来支持错误轨迹，使合规性核查被误导。
AI.method: 首先论证标准离群点鲁棒位姿图优化在该设定下存在脆弱性：拜占庭巡视器可生成数量足够多且内部自洽的测量，使真实且有罪证意义的测量反而被判为离群点。为此提出归因感知的轨迹估计方法：不判断单条测量是否有效，而是推断巡视器的可信度；通过比较候选可信巡视器子集的内部相对观测与边界相对观测相对于给定先验的统计一致性来评估子集，最终仅使用归属于可信代理的测量进行轨迹估计。
AI.result: 在合成仿真与真实行星类比轨迹数据上，所提方法能够识别出拜占庭巡视器，并且轨迹估计精度显著优于现有的鲁棒位姿图优化基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 将鲁棒性推理从"测量级"提升到"代理级"是应对非合作、含拜占庭代理的行星巡视器取证轨迹分析的有效途径，可支撑月面安全区等运行约束的事后合规核查。

title: Diffusion-Based Synthetic Data Pretraining for Enhancing Activity Recognition
summary: Human activity recognition (HAR) is increasingly important for healthcare, well-being, and daily monitoring ap- plications, for which detecting alimentary activities such as eating and drinking can provide actionable insight into dietary habits and chronic disease management. HAR systems, however, often underperform on subtle and underrepresented classes, limiting their utility in real-world dietary monitoring. This work builds upon CABiGRU, a convolutional architecture with Bidirectional GRU layers, multi-head attention, and residual connections, designed to capture discriminative temporal patterns from smart- watch accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer data. To improve CaBiGRU's generalization and reduce underfitting in the minority class, we leverage synthetic sensor data windows using a diffusion model and adopt a two-stage training strategy: pre-training CABiGRU on synthetic data, followed by fine-tuning on the real-world data. On the DEO (drinking/eating/other) dataset, the proposed pipeline achieves a balanced accuracy of 90.6%, improving over a strong supervised baseline and showing the benefits of diffusion-based synthetic pre-training for recognizing alimentary activities and representing a step forward dealing with unbalanced classes. These results suggest that combining diffusion-generated data with targeted fine-tuning enhances robust recognition of dietary behaviors, supporting more reliable deployment in healthcare and nutrition-monitoring settings.

AI.tldr: 本文在CABiGRU模型基础上，利用扩散模型生成合成传感器数据并采用两阶段训练（合成数据预训练+真实数据微调），在DEO数据集上实现90.6%的平衡准确率，有效缓解类别不平衡问题。
AI.motivation: 人类活动识别（HAR）在健康监测中日益重要，尤其是饮食活动（进食/饮水）的检测可为饮食习惯和慢病管理提供依据。然而现有HAR系统在细微动作和少数类（如饮水）上表现不佳，存在欠拟合，限制其在真实饮食监测中的应用。
AI.method: 基于CABiGRU（卷积架构+双向GRU+多头注意力+残差连接，处理智能手表加速度计、陀螺仪、磁力计数据）；使用扩散模型生成合成传感器数据窗口，并采用两阶段训练策略：先在合成数据上预训练CABiGRU，再在真实数据上微调。
AI.result: 在DEO（drinking/eating/other）数据集上取得90.6%的平衡准确率，优于强监督基线，验证了扩散合成预训练在饮食活动识别中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 扩散生成数据结合针对性微调可增强饮食行为的鲁棒识别，有助于在医疗和营养监测场景中实现更可靠的部署，是处理类别不平衡问题的一次进步。

title: Right Order, Wrong Scale: Auditing LLM Judges for Occupational AI Measurement
summary: LLM judges are increasingly used to assess whether AI outputs meet workplace requirements, but agreement on response rankings does not establish agreement on acceptance rates or occupational aggregates. We introduce O*NET-BENCH, an audit suite derived from an existing survey of 45,796 worker ratings, and evaluate 33 pre-existing judge configurations across six model families on 4,501 test ratings. Twenty-five configurations achieve tie-aware pair accuracy of at least 0.60, although a train-fitted response-only TF-IDF baseline nearly matches the strongest judge. Despite this ordering agreement, judges estimate that 3.0%-97.9% of responses are acceptable, compared with 61.1% for occupation-matched workers. In one fine-tuned lineage, changing from pointwise scoring to a bundled few-shot/listwise protocol improves response ordering while reducing agreement with worker means at the task and occupation levels; this reversal replicates on a task- and worker-disjoint validation split under prespecified criteria. Cross-validated calibration largely removes mean bias, but calibrated scores explain at most 8.5% of individual worker-rating variance. Prediction-assisted estimation yields at most small precision gains at the studied label budgets. These results show that ranking agreement alone is insufficient for occupational measurement. Judges should be validated against the acceptance rates and aggregates their scores will be used to estimate.

AI.tldr: 提出O*NET-BENCH审计套件，发现LLM评判模型在响应排序上与人类评分一致，但在接受率和职业聚合指标上存在严重偏差，排序一致不等于测量有效。
AI.motivation: LLM评判模型被越来越多用于评估AI输出是否满足工作场所要求，但排序一致性未必意味着在接受率或职业层面聚合指标上与人类一致，这一测量效度问题缺乏系统审计。
AI.method: 构建O*NET-BENCH审计套件，基于45,796条工人评分调查数据，在4,501条测试评分上评估33种预置评判配置（涵盖6个模型族），采用tie-aware配对准确率、与工人均值的一致性、交叉验证校准及预测辅助估计等指标进行比较。
AI.result: 25种配置的tie-aware配对准确率≥0.60，但仅用响应的TF-IDF基线几乎可媲美最强评判模型；评判模型估计的可接受率为3.0%–97.9%，而职业匹配工人的实际值为61.1%；某微调谱系中，从pointwise转为捆绑few-shot/listwise协议可改善排序，却降低与工人在任务和职业层面均值的一致性，且在预设标准下于任务与工人不相交的验证集上复现；交叉验证校准基本消除均值偏差，但校准分数最多仅解释8.5%的个体工人评分方差；预测辅助估计在既定标签预算下仅带来微小精度提升。
AI.conclusion: 排序一致性不足以支撑职业测量，LLM评判模型应针对其分数所要估计的接受率与聚合指标进行验证，而非仅以排序一致作为有效性依据。

title: Beyond Predefined Sinks: Security-Aware Dependency Analysis for LLM Agents
comment: 29 pages, 3 figures, including supplementary appendices. Preprint
summary:
Large language model (LLM)-based agents increasingly connect model-generated decisions to security-sensitive software capabilities such as command execution, filesystem access, network communication, browser control, and external tools. Existing analyses often use predefined sensitive operations as anchors, but operation identity alone is insufficient to determine security implications.
  We present AgentSecGraph, a security-aware static analysis framework that constructs a candidate-centered Security-Aware Agent Dependency Graph (Security-ADG) for each security-sensitive operation. It augments operation identity with agent relevance, source and dependency evidence, trust-boundary context, guard evidence, and external-effect semantics.
  We further introduce AgentSecBench, a corpus of 67 real-world LLM-agent repositories spanning 11 ecosystems and 37,542 source files. The current analyzer identifies 23,866 static security-sensitive operation candidates across 65 repositories and emits one Security-ADG artifact per candidate. Corpus-wide analysis recovers source-to-operation dependency evidence for 9,821 candidates (41.15%) and potential guard evidence for 3,075 (12.88%), completing in 50.8 minutes.
  Using a separate reproduction-backed evaluation layer, we establish 22 security-sensitive behaviors across 13 repositories: one confirmed vulnerability, one pending disclosure candidate, and 20 guarded behaviors. In nine held-out cases, Security-ADG preserves 91.1% of the reference context and all five observed guards, compared with 20.0% for a sink-only view and 40.0% for a simplified ADG. These results show that security-aware dependency and contextual evidence enable distinctions that cannot be recovered from sensitive-operation identity alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgentSecGraph——一个面向 LLM 智能体的安全感知静态分析框架，为每个安全敏感操作构建以候选为中心的 Security-ADG 依赖图，并配套发布 AgentSecBench 语料库。评估表明，依赖与上下文证据能提供仅凭操作身份无法获得的区分能力。
AI.motivation: 基于 LLM 的智能体将模型生成的决策连接到命令执行、文件系统访问、网络通信、浏览器控制、外部工具等安全敏感能力。现有分析多以预定义的敏感操作作为锚点，但仅凭操作身份不足以判定其安全影响，缺乏来源、依赖、信任边界与防护等上下文证据。
AI.method: 提出 AgentSecGraph 安全感知静态分析框架，为每个安全敏感操作构建以候选为中心的 Security-Aware Agent Dependency Graph（Security-ADG），在操作身份之上补充智能体相关性、来源与依赖证据、信任边界上下文、防护（guard）证据及外部效应语义。同时构建 AgentSecBench 语料库，包含跨 11 个生态、37,542 个源文件的 67 个真实 LLM 智能体仓库，并设置独立的复现支持型评测层。
AI.result: 分析器在 65 个仓库中识别出 23,866 个静态安全敏感操作候选，并为每个候选生成一个 Security-ADG 工件；语料库级分析为 9,821 个候选（41.15%）恢复来源到操作的依赖证据，为 3,075 个（12.88%）恢复潜在防护证据，总耗时 50.8 分钟。复现评测在 13 个仓库中确立 22 个安全敏感行为：1 个已确认漏洞、1 个待披露候选、20 个已防护行为。在 9 个留出案例中，Security-ADG 保留 91.1% 的参考上下文和全部 5 个观测到的防护，而仅看 sink 的视图为 20.0%，简化 ADG 为 40.0%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，安全感知的依赖与上下文证据能够实现仅凭敏感操作身份无法恢复的区分能力，说明操作身份之外的依赖与防护证据对 LLM 智能体安全分析至关重要。

title: Physical AI Smart Spaces: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Multi-Camera 3D Perception in Smart Spaces
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track (poster)
summary: Physical AI Smart Spaces is, to the best of our knowledge, the first benchmark to simultaneously provide large-scale, multi-class, and multi-camera 3D perception data for indoor smart spaces. It contains over 280 hours of synchronized 1080p footage captured by nearly 1,800 cameras in warehouses, hospitals, retail venues, and similar settings, together with automatic annotations for multi-camera identities, 2D bounding boxes, 3D bounding boxes, camera calibration, and depth where available. The benchmark spans Isaac Sim synthetic generation, Cosmos Transfer appearance augmentation, and real-world Sim2Real evaluation. For the real-world target, we include two warehouse deployments with time-synchronized streams, automatic VGGT-based calibration, and a 3D labeling interface that projects world-frame 3D boxes into each view for cross-camera verification. We describe the dataset scope, annotation and calibration schema, generation workflow, benchmark protocols, and official evaluation system, which standardizes submission format, and leaderboard reporting. A central contribution is a 3D instantiation of Higher Order Tracking Accuracy (HOTA), extending the usual 2D box-based tracking evaluation to 3D locations and 3D boxes. We further report empirical baselines from the AI City Challenge leaderboards, showing how methods evolve from person-only 3D location tracking to multi-class 3D box tracking under realistic smart-space constraints. The release is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/PhysicalAI-SmartSpaces.

AI.tldr: 提出Physical AI Smart Spaces基准，首个同时提供大规模、多类别、多相机3D感知数据的室内智能空间数据集，含280+小时同步1080p视频、近1800个相机，覆盖合成生成、外观增强与真实Sim2Real评测，并贡献3D版HOTA指标。
AI.motivation: 室内智能空间缺乏同时具备大规模、多类别与多相机的3D感知基准数据，现有评测多局限于2D框或仅行人跟踪，难以支撑真实智能空间约束下的多类别3D箱跟踪研究。
AI.method: 构建包含仓库、医院、零售等场景的同步1080p视频数据集（280+小时、近1800相机），提供多相机身份、2D/3D边界框、相机标定与深度等自动标注；流程涵盖Isaac Sim合成生成、Cosmos Transfer外观增强及真实世界Sim2Real评测。真实端含两个仓库部署、基于VGGT的自动标定与3D标注界面（将世界坐标系3D框投影至各视图做跨相机校验）。并提出3D版HOTA指标，统一提交格式与排行榜评测系统。
AI.result: 基于AI City Challenge排行榜报告经验基线，展示方法从仅行人3D位置跟踪演进到真实智能空间约束下的多类别3D箱跟踪。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为室内智能空间的多相机3D感知与跟踪提供统一数据、标注、标定、评测协议与排行榜，3D HOTA拓展了传统2D框跟踪评测维度，数据集已公开发布。

title: When History Fails to Become Experience: Action Calibration in Language Agents
summary: Language agents should draw on prior attempts and environmental feedback to improve subsequent decisions within the same task. However, providing additional interaction history can sometimes reduce task success, suggesting that agents do not consistently use this information effectively. To investigate this limitation, we examine how agents use history. We find that history improves task completion overall, yet much of this benefit persists even when past actions are shuffled. Disrupting the correspondence between actions and observations causes only a modest decline in task success. We therefore hypothesize that agents do not reliably connect past actions with their outcomes when deciding how to proceed. To test this hypothesis, we explicitly label each returned observation as the outcome of the preceding action. This simple annotation improves task success and reduces next-action repetition without introducing new environmental information. Building on this insight, we introduce a learned calibrator that explicitly reassesses past actions and selectively records experience to guide subsequent decisions, improving task success beyond outcome labeling alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语言智能体为何未能有效利用交互历史，发现其难以将过去动作与其结果关联，并通过结果标注与学习式校准器提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体本应借助先前尝试与环境反馈改进同一任务中的后续决策，但增加交互历史有时反而降低任务成功率，说明智能体未能一致、有效地利用这些信息。论文旨在探究这一局限的成因。
AI.method: 通过扰动实验考察智能体对历史的利用方式，包括打乱过去动作的顺序、破坏动作与观测之间的对应关系；随后显式标注每个返回观测为前一动作的结果；并在结果标注基础上引入学习式校准器（learned calibrator），显式重评估过去动作并选择性记录经验。
AI.result: 历史整体上提升任务完成度，但即使打乱过去动作，大部分收益仍保留；破坏动作与观测对应关系仅导致任务成功率小幅下降。显式结果标注可提升任务成功率并减少下一动作重复，且未引入新环境信息。学习式校准器在结果标注基础上进一步提升任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 智能体在决策时未能可靠地将过去动作与其结果相连接；通过显式标注动作—结果对应关系及引入选择性经验记录机制，可有效提升语言智能体对历史信息的利用效率与任务表现。

title: GeoScaffold: Learning Compact Geometric Latents via Reconstruction for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Recent vision-and-language navigation (VLN) systems increasingly adopt streaming Video-LLM policies that map egocentric RGB observations and instructions directly to low-level actions. Yet these policies inherit weak 3D geometric priors from 2D pretraining. Existing geometry-aware extensions charge a persistent inference-time price: depth sensors, 3D encoders, or per-step perception tool calls. We propose GeoScaffold, a geometric supervision framework that pays this price once, at training time, by internalizing geometry into the policy itself. It first learns a compact depth tokenizer on depth maps from the training trajectories and freezes it. It then fine-tunes the policy with a handful of learnable geometry query tokens, training their hidden states to reconstruct navigation-critical geometry such as depth, connectivity, and traversability. This supervision turns the query states into compact geometric latents for action decoding, and through the shared weights also internalizes geometry into the backbone's own representations. Like a scaffold, the tokenizer, target generators, and reconstruction heads are discarded after training, leaving the backbone and action interface unchanged. Extensive experiments show that GeoScaffold consistently outperforms leading vision-only navigators on continuous VLN benchmarks, offering a practical paradigm for lightweight edge deployment of spatially aware embodied navigation models.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoScaffold几何监督框架，在训练阶段一次性将3D几何先验内化进流式Video-LLM导航策略，推理时无需深度传感器、3D编码器或额外感知调用，在连续VLN基准上持续优于纯视觉导航器。
AI.motivation: 流式Video-LLM策略直接将自我中心RGB观测与指令映射为低层动作，但从2D预训练继承的3D几何先验薄弱。现有几何感知扩展需付出持续的推理代价（深度传感器、3D编码器或逐步感知工具调用），不利于轻量边缘部署。
AI.method: GeoScaffold在训练时先基于训练轨迹的深度图学习一个紧凑的深度tokenizer并冻结；随后用少量可学习的几何查询token微调策略，训练其隐状态重建导航关键几何（深度、连通性、可通行性）。该监督将查询状态转化为用于动作解码的紧凑几何隐变量，并通过共享权重把几何内化到主干表示中。训练后丢弃tokenizer、目标生成器与重建头，主干与动作接口保持不变。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，GeoScaffold在连续VLN基准上持续优于领先的纯视觉导航器，为空间感知具身导航模型的轻量边缘部署提供了实用范式。
AI.conclusion: 通过"训练期付费、推理期零开销"的脚手架式几何监督，可将几何先验内化进策略本身，在不改变主干与动作接口的前提下提升连续VLN性能。

title: $Ψ$-Resilience: Model-Free Feature Importance from 1D Topological Signals
summary: We introduce $Ψ$-Resilience, a model-free feature importance method that derives explanations directly from the data itself via 1D topological signals. Our method constructs a class-disagreement landscape by estimating class-conditional densities and taking their pointwise absolute difference along the feature axis. Then, the 0-dimensional persistence of this 1D signal defines a resilience functional that aggregates only those topological features that survive perturbations up to a robustness scale which is set by the user. This gives us a context-robust importance score that is inherently auditable via the underlying 1D landscapes and their persistence. We evaluate our method on both synthetic and real datasets. On synthetic generators with specified ground-truth importance, $Ψ$-Resilience recovers the ranking of features with high fidelity, achieving Spearman rank correlations up to 0.8 and performing competitively with multiple feature importance methods, including SHAP and mutual information. On real datasets with no known ground truth, our technique agrees with these methods, with correlations up to 0.9. These results show that $Ψ$-Resilience is a stable explanation method that enables rigorous, distribution-level auditing of feature importance without relying on a predictive model.

AI.tldr: 提出Ψ-Resilience，一种无需预测模型、基于1D拓扑信号的特征重要性方法，通过类条件密度差的0维持久性构造鲁棒性加权重要性分数，在合成与真实数据上表现与SHAP、互信息等方法相当。
AI.motivation: 现有特征重要性方法多依赖预测模型，解释结果受模型影响，且缺乏可审计性。作者希望直接从数据本身导出特征重要性，并具备分布层面的严格可审计性与对扰动的稳定性。
AI.method: 沿特征轴估计类条件密度并取逐点绝对差，构造"类不一致性景观"这一1D拓扑信号；对该信号计算0维持久性，定义resilience泛函，仅聚合在用户设定的鲁棒尺度内得以存活的拓扑特征，从而得到上下文鲁棒的重要性分数。
AI.result: 在具有指定真实重要性的合成数据上，方法高保真恢复特征排序，Spearman秩相关最高达0.8，与SHAP、互信息等方法竞争力相当；在无真实标签的真实数据集上，与这些方法结果一致，相关性最高达0.9。
AI.conclusion: Ψ-Resilience是一种稳定的解释方法，无需依赖预测模型即可实现严格的、分布层面可审计的特征重要性评估。

title: "I just assumed that it would translate": examining MT risk awareness among healthcare staff with abbreviations as a use case
comment: To appear in the proceedings of Convergence 2026 conference
summary: In the UK, public healthcare staff report turning to machine translation (MT) - predominantly Google Translate (GT) - to communicate with patients across language barriers. Though intended to support their duty of care, potentially uninformed reliance on MT in such contexts could have serious consequences for patient safety. Research nonetheless remains limited on staff awareness of the possible risks posed by higher-stakes MT use in general and with patient medical records in particular, most existing literature instead examining its use in interpersonal situations or with patient-oriented documentation. Moreover, medical abbreviations are well-documented as increasing patient risk even monolingually, with outcomes from their misuse and/or misinterpretation ranging from temporary harm to the death of the patient. Abbreviations were therefore selected as a use case for identifying the potential risks posed by their translation with MT. Contextualised French and Spanish data examples drawn from authoritative clinical corpora and translated via GT were presented during semi-structured interviews to 21 healthcare staff participants in diverse roles and specialties. The results were then subject to qualitative analysis and cross-analysis.

AI.tldr: 英国医护人员在跨语言沟通中常依赖机器翻译（尤以Google Translate为主），但对其在患者病历等高风险的医疗缩写翻译中潜在风险的认识尚缺乏研究。本文以医学术语缩写为用例，通过半结构化访谈探究医护人员对机器翻译风险的认知。
AI.motivation: 英国医护人员在跨语言患者沟通中普遍使用机器翻译，可能带来患者安全隐患。然而现有研究多关注其人际沟通或面向患者的文档使用，缺乏对医护人员在使用机器翻译（尤其是涉及患者病历等高危场景）时风险意识的了解。此外，医学缩写即便在单语环境下也已被证实会增加患者风险，因此被选为识别机器翻译潜在风险的用例。
AI.method: 从权威临床语料库中提取法语和西班牙语情境化数据示例，通过Google Translate进行翻译，并在21名不同岗位和专业领域的医护人员中开展半结构化访谈。所得结果采用定性分析和交叉分析。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果（研究设计与方法描述为止，未陈述分析发现）。
