AI.conclusion: 摘要未明确给出结论；研究旨在通过医学缩写翻译用例识别机器翻译在医疗高风险场景中的潜在风险，并揭示医护人员的相关认知。

title: SecJev: Bringing Security Expertise to System One Decision Models
summary: Security workflows need models that turn complex observations and explicit policies into decisions. System One models introduced by Jev return typed predictions and probabilities; security specialization supplies the domain expertise behind those predictions. We introduce SecJev, to our knowledge the first family of Jev-like decision models specialized for security, spanning 0.8B to 9B parameters. Built on Kev's single-pass candidate scorer, SecJev learns Boolean, choice, and ordered decisions from text, telemetry, and observation histories. We develop SecJev-Corpus to unify source-label prediction and explicit-policy evaluation across 14 tasks and eight sources. It covers tool outputs, traffic, federated updates, consensus, authentication, and vehicle messages. Scene-weighted training adapts the models across these domains while preserving a shared typed decision interface. Security specialization improves every model in the family; SecJev-0.8B outperforms general Kev-9B by 20.51 percentage points in task-macro accuracy. Comparisons with answer-only generative fine-tuning show close accuracy and latency with lower peak inference memory. Tests on new source groups reproduce gains over Kev in prompt-injection and traffic decisions, with capture-dependent false alarms. We release adapters, decision heads, SecJev-Corpus, and training and inference code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SecJev，首个面向安全领域的Jev式决策模型族（0.8B–9B参数），基于Kev单次候选打分器学习布尔、选择与有序决策，并配套构建SecJev-Corpus统一评测；安全领域特化显著提升性能，0.8B模型在任务宏平均准确率上超通用Kev-9B达20.51个百分点。
AI.motivation: 安全流程需要将复杂观测与显式策略转化为决策的模型。系统一（System One）模型可返回带类型的预测及概率，但缺少安全领域特化；作者希望把Jev式决策建模范式与安全领域专家知识结合，形成专用的决策模型族以处理安全场景中的文本、遥测与观测历史。
AI.method: 基于Kev的单次候选打分器（single-pass candidate scorer）构建SecJev，支持从文本、遥测和观测历史中学习布尔、选择（choice）与有序（ordered）决策。构建SecJev-Corpus，覆盖14个任务、8类来源，统一源标签预测与显式策略评估，涵盖工具输出、流量、联邦更新、共识、认证与车辆消息。采用场景加权训练（scene-weighted training）跨域适配，同时保持共享的带类型决策接口。
AI.result: 安全领域特化使族内每个模型均获提升；SecJev-0.8B在任务宏平均准确率上比通用Kev-9B高20.51个百分点。与仅答案的生成式微调相比，准确率与延迟接近，且峰值推理内存更低。在新来源组测试中，于提示注入与流量决策上相较Kev复现增益，但存在依赖捕获的误报。
AI.conclusion: 安全领域特化的Jev式决策模型可行且有效，小参数模型亦可超越更大通用模型并降低推理内存；作者开源适配器、决策头、SecJev-Corpus及训练与推理代码，为安全决策建模提供统一接口与基准。

title: GRAFT: Growing Agglomerative Foundation Models via Continual Teacher Distillation
summary: Vision foundation models such as DINOv2, SigLIP2, and MASt3R develop complementary capabilities from different pretraining objectives, yet their knowledge remains distributed across separate, specialized models. Multi-teacher knowledge distillation offers a path toward consolidating these capabilities into a single agglomerative backbone, but existing approaches assume a fixed set of teachers, and incorporating a new teacher requires repeating expensive joint distillation over the entire teacher set. We introduce GRAFT, a continual multi-teacher distillation framework that enables a unified backbone to progressively acquire capabilities from an open-ended sequence of foundation models. When a new teacher arrives, GRAFT treats the previously distilled model as a teacher for preserving learned capabilities, while the current student jointly learns from both the previous model and the incoming teacher. Furthermore, to reconcile the incompatible representation geometries of heterogeneous teachers, we introduce Teacher Specific Readout Tokens, which grant each teacher an independent read-out of the shared encoder, together with Geometry Agnostic Relational Loss that aligns a vision-language teacher by matching image-text similarity structures rather than raw feature values. We provide GRAFT model, which is a single, continually extensible backbone that unifies five domains, including image understanding, 2D dense prediction, 3D human pose estimation, 3D vision, and vision-language, delivering strong performance across all of them while acquiring each new capability at the cost of a single distillation rather than a full re-distillation.

AI.tldr: GRAFT：面向开放式教师序列的持续多教师蒸馏框架，将多个视觉基础模型能力渐进整合进单一可扩展骨干网络。
AI.motivation: DINOv2、SigLIP2、MASt3R等视觉基础模型因预训练目标不同而具备互补能力，但知识分散于各自独立的专用模型中。多教师知识蒸馏可将这些能力整合到单一骨干网络，然而现有方法假设教师集合固定，新增教师需对整个教师集合重新进行代价高昂的联合蒸馏。
AI.method: 提出GRAFT持续多教师蒸馏框架：新教师到来时，将此前蒸馏得到的模型作为教师以保留已学能力，当前学生同时从旧模型和新教师学习。为调和异构教师间不相容的表示几何，引入教师专属读出Token（Teacher Specific Readout Tokens），为每位教师提供对共享编码器的独立读出；并提出几何无关关系损失（Geometry Agnostic Relational Loss），通过匹配图文相似度结构而非原始特征值来对齐视觉-语言教师。
AI.result: GRAFT模型为单一且可持续扩展的骨干网络，统一了图像理解、2D密集预测、3D人体姿态估计、3D视觉和视觉-语言五个领域，在各领域均取得强劲性能，且获取每项新能力的代价仅为一次蒸馏，而非完整重蒸馏。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT实现了从开放式基础模型序列中渐进获取能力的统一骨干，避免了固定教师集合假设下的重复联合蒸馏开销，验证了持续多教师蒸馏在整合异构视觉基础模型能力方面的有效性。

title: AptMQL-Bench: From Text-to-SQL to Text-to-MQL via Access-Pattern Schema Design and Data-Preserving Migration
summary: Document databases such as MongoDB are core infrastructure for modern applications, and natural-language interfaces to them---text-to-MQL---would let non-experts query complex, semi-structured data without mastering the query language. Progress on this task depends on high-quality benchmarks, which are most practically obtained by converting an existing text-to-SQL benchmark to the document setting. Unfortunately, existing efforts rely on heuristics for mechanical conversion: the document schema mirrors the relational foreign-key graph, and each query mirrors its source SQL. As a result in our experiments, these approaches fail to migrate 6 of 21 BIRD databases outright, silently drop up to 25.9\% of rows on others, and yield schemas whose ground-truth queries run over an order of magnitude slower as the data scales. We instead propose a conversion pipeline, driven by coding agents with human-in-the-loop verification, that designs each document schema from expected access patterns and rewrites queries to be MongoDB-native. Applying it to BIRD, we build an access-pattern-based text-to-MQL benchmark (AptMQL-Bench). It includes 21 document-oriented databases, 3,186 natural-language requests, and their associated MQL queries---whose databases are migrated from SQLite without data loss and scale efficiently. The strongest model, Claude Opus 4.5, achieves only 57.38\% accuracy without external knowledge evidence and 70.34\% with it. This indicates that realistic text-to-MQL generation remains challenging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于编码智能体与人工验证的转换流程，将BIRD text-to-SQL基准转换为文档型数据库的text-to-MQL基准AptMQL-Bench，包含21个数据库、3186条自然语言请求及对应MQL查询，最强模型Claude Opus 4.5准确率仅57.38%（无外部知识）和70.34%（有外部知识）。
AI.motivation: 文档数据库（如MongoDB）是现代应用的核心基础设施，text-to-MQL自然语言接口可让非专家查询复杂半结构化数据。该任务进展依赖高质量基准，最实际的做法是将现有text-to-SQL基准转换为文档场景。但现有工作依赖启发式机械转换：文档schema照搬关系外键图、查询照搬源SQL，导致实验中出现无法迁移6/21个BIRD数据库、静默丢失最多25.9%行、schema随数据规模增长使ground-truth查询运行慢一个数量级等问题。
AI.method: 提出一种由编码智能体驱动、带人工在环验证的转换流程：从预期访问模式设计每个文档schema，并将查询重写为MongoDB原生形式，而非机械照搬关系结构与SQL。将其应用于BIRD，构建基于访问模式的text-to-MQL基准AptMQL-Bench。
AI.result: AptMQL-Bench包含21个面向文档的数据库、3186条自然语言请求及对应MQL查询；数据库从SQLite迁移无数据丢失且可高效扩展。最强模型Claude Opus 4.5无外部知识证据时准确率仅57.38%，提供外部知识证据时为70.34%。
AI.conclusion: 现实场景下的text-to-MQL生成仍具挑战性，AptMQL-Bench为文档数据库自然语言接口研究提供了更真实、可扩展的基准。

title: AdaTempo: Learning Shared Relative Tempo from Demonstrations for Faster Robot Manipulation
summary: Visuomotor policies trained via imitation learning often inherit the unnecessarily slow timing of teleoperated demonstrations. Yet uniform speedup is unreliable because different phases of a manipulation task tolerate acceleration differently. In this work, we introduce AdaTempo, a self-supervised method that accelerates visuomotor policies by exploiting shared relative-tempo structure in demonstrations. AdaTempo establishes phase correspondence, aggregates the aligned relative tempo into a consensus, and maps it to a continuous speedup profile used to resample demonstrations into accelerated training trajectories. Training standard policies such as ACT or Diffusion Policy on these resampled trajectories directly embeds the desired tempo in the learned behavior, without runtime tempo selection or online retiming. Extensive evaluations show that AdaTempo achieves up to a $3.57\times$ speedup and yields a stronger success--speed trade-off than the original policies and representative acceleration baselines.

AI.tldr: AdaTempo：一种自监督方法，通过挖掘演示中共享的相对节奏结构来加速视觉运动策略，实现最高3.57倍加速并改善成功率-速度权衡。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习训练的视觉运动策略往往继承遥操作演示中不必要的缓慢节奏；但统一加速不可靠，因为操作任务的不同阶段对加速的容忍度不同。
AI.method: AdaTempo建立阶段对应关系，将对齐后的相对节奏聚合为共识，并映射为连续加速曲线，用其重采样演示生成加速后的训练轨迹；再用ACT或Diffusion Policy等标准策略直接在该轨迹上训练，将节奏嵌入学习行为中，无需运行时节奏选择或在线重定时。
AI.result: 大量评估显示AdaTempo可实现最高3.57倍加速，并相较原始策略与代表性加速基线取得更强的成功率-速度权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过自监督挖掘演示中的相对节奏结构并重采样训练轨迹，AdaTempo能在无需在线重定时的情况下有效加速视觉运动策略，并优于统一加速及现有加速基线。

title: PowerBench: Measuring Language Model Bias in Power-shifting Requests
summary: Language models increasingly assist people with power-related requests, so systematic differences in whom they help could shift the distribution of power at scale, or be exploited by users who learn which identities are refused less. We introduce PowerBench, an evaluation of power-shifting requests that distinguishes self-empowerment, disempowerment, and power grabbing, plus a control of refusal-inducing requests that shift no power. We build, curate, and open-source a dataset of such requests varying the power domain, the context, the scale of the affected party, and the prior power standing of the user, and evaluate 24 models (12 from US and 12 from Chinese developers) under three experimental conditions: reciprocal nationalities of user and affected party, an AI agent as the user, and 8 request languages. Models refuse power grabbing more than disempowerment, and disempowerment more than self-empowerment. Refusal of power grabbing rises with the scale of the affected party, from an individual to a society. Models are biased toward helping others take power from the US and against helping US users take power from others, but favor the US when it gains power and nobody loses it. When the user is an AI agent, refusal of power-shifting requests increases, especially in power grabbing against an individual. Finally, language biases refusal, but in model-specific ways that largely cancel on average. We release PowerBench to make these asymmetries measurable in current and future models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PowerBench基准，用于评估语言模型在处理涉及权力转移请求时的系统差异，覆盖自我赋权、去赋权、权力攫取及无权力转移的控制请求，并对24个中美模型在多种实验条件下进行评测。
AI.motivation: 语言模型日益协助人们处理与权力相关的请求，模型在“帮助谁”上的系统性差异可能大规模改变权力分布，或被用户利用来规避拒绝。因此需要一套可量化的评估框架来揭示并测量这些不对称性。
AI.method: 构建并开源一个请求数据集，变化维度包括权力领域、情境、受影响方的规模、用户原有权力地位；区分自我赋权、去赋权、权力攫取及无权力转移的拒绝诱导控制请求；评测24个模型（12个美国开发者、12个中国开发者），在三种实验条件下测试：用户与受影响方国籍的互惠性、以AI智能体为用户、以及8种请求语言。
AI.result: 模型对权力攫取的拒绝高于去赋权，对去赋权的拒绝高于自我赋权；对权力攫取的拒绝率随受影响方规模（从个人到社会）上升而升高。模型偏向帮助他人从美国夺取权力，而不利于美国用户从他人处夺权，但当美国获益且无人受损时会偏向美国。当用户为AI智能体时，对权力转移请求的拒绝增加，尤其在针对个人的权力攫取上。语言会影响拒绝行为，但影响因模型而异，平均而言大致相互抵消。
AI.conclusion: 作者发布PowerBench，使当前及未来模型中的这些权力相关不对称性可被测量，为相关研究与治理提供工具。

title: HXAI: Hierarchical Privacy-Preserving Explainable AI in Distributed Energy Systems
summary: Balancing electricity demand and supply is increasingly difficult due to the inherent intermittency of renewable power generation and the stochastic power consumption. Grid operators require fine-grained, decision-relevant insights into household energy consumption to manage peak loads and design responsive tariffs, but increased transparency at this level raises significant privacy concerns. Traditional methods for explainable AI (XAI) can reveal sensitive information, while standard privacy techniques often reduce the usefulness of explanations. To address this issue, we introduce HXAI, a hierarchical framework that preserves privacy while enabling reasonable explainable analysis for grid-level demand management. HXAI consists of two main components: (1) a local model that generates fine-grained explanations within a secure, private environment, and (2) a zonal model that aggregates these explanations to support grid-level analysis while enforcing privacy through flexible privacy-budget management. We explicitly limit cumulative privacy exposure under repeated operator queries and show that the proposed framework preserves decision-relevant information without compromising household privacy. Experiments on both simulated and real-world energy datasets demonstrate that HXAI provides useful insights for zonal load management while ensuring that appliance-level consumption remains local and is never transmitted to grid operators. Our results show that preserving the semantic structure of explanations, rather than minimizing numerical error, is the key to XAI under differential privacy. This framework provides a way to achieve both privacy and explainability in energy management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HXAI——一个分层可解释AI框架，在差分隐私约束下为电网级需求管理提供细粒度解释，兼顾家庭隐私保护与决策相关性。
AI.motivation: 可再生能源出力间歇性与用电随机性使电力供需平衡愈发困难，电网运营商需要细粒度、与决策相关的家庭能耗洞察以管理峰荷和设计响应性电价；但此类透明度会引发严重隐私问题。传统可解释AI（XAI）可能泄露敏感信息，而标准隐私技术又常削弱解释的可用性，二者存在矛盾。
AI.method: HXAI包含两个核心组件：(1) 本地模型，在安全、私密的环境中生成细粒度解释；(2) 区域（zonal）模型，聚合这些解释以支持电网级分析，并通过灵活隐私预算管理实施隐私保护。此外，框架显式限制重复运营商查询下的累积隐私暴露。
AI.result: 在模拟与真实能源数据集上的实验表明，HXAI能为区域负荷管理提供有价值的洞察，同时确保电器级能耗保持本地、绝不传输给电网运营商。结果还显示：在差分隐私下实现XAI的关键在于保留解释的语义结构，而非最小化数值误差。
AI.conclusion: HXAI为能源管理中同时实现隐私与可解释性提供了可行路径，证明在不牺牲家庭隐私的前提下可保留决策相关信息。

title: Securing Computer-Use Agents Against Branch Steering Attacks
comment: 16 pages, including 2 figures. To be presented at the "Agents in the Wild" Workshop at the NeurIPS 2026 Conference
summary: Modern Computer Use Agents (CUAs) directly interact with graphical user interfaces and execute third-party web tools, exposing them to indirect prompt injection across every rendered page and tool response. While the Dual-LLM pattern is the primary system-level architecture offering formal security guarantees - using an isolated Planner LLM (P-LLM) to fix execution paths before processing untrusted inputs via a Quarantined LLM (Q-LLM) - these guarantees break down in graphical environments. Because CUA interaction is inherently dynamic, plans cannot remain data-independent; they must branch based on anticipated runtime web content - covering all possible cases the agent may encounter. This exposes agents to branch steering attacks, where an adversary crafts untrusted data to coerce a CUA down a hazardous, pre-approved branch without injecting explicit instructions. We systematically study branch steering attacks and introduce STEER-Bench (101 tasks across 9 domains), showing high attack success against both standard (94.4%) and vanilla Dual-LLM (89.5%) CUAs. We then propose COBRA, an architecture that pairs trusted branching plans with ahead-of-time capability constraints, strictly bounding the parameters and destinations each branch may execute. On STEER-Bench, COBRA reduces attack success to 0% while retaining 97% benign utility.

AI.tldr: 论文提出分支引导攻击（Branch Steering），并给出STEER-Bench基准及防御架构COBRA，将攻击成功率从89.5%降至0%且保持97%正常效用。
AI.motivation: 现代计算机使用代理（CUA）直接操作图形界面并调用第三方网页工具，暴露于间接提示注入风险。Dual-LLM模式虽在系统层提供形式化安全保证（由P-LLM固定执行路径、Q-LLM处理不可信输入），但在图形环境中原有的保证失效：CUA交互具有动态性，计划必须依据运行时网页内容分支，无法保持数据无关，从而为分支引导攻击留下空间——攻击者无需注入显式指令，仅通过构造不可信数据即可迫使代理走入预先批准的危害分支。
AI.method: 系统研究分支引导攻击，构建STEER-Bench（9个领域、101个任务）；提出COBRA架构，将可信分支计划与事前（ahead-of-time）能力约束相结合，对每个分支可执行的参数与目标进行严格限定。
AI.result: STEER-Bench上，标准CUA攻击成功率达94.4%，原版Dual-LLM CUA为89.5%；COBRA将攻击成功率降至0%，同时保留97%的正常效用。
AI.conclusion: 动态分支需求是Dual-LLM安全保证在图形环境中失效的根源，分支引导是一类高危且易被忽视的攻击面；通过可信分支计划与事前能力约束，可在几乎不损失效用的前提下实现完全防御。

title: D2K-Bench: Can LLM Agents Turn Expert Designs into Efficient GPU Kernels?
summary: GPU kernels generated by large language model (LLM) agents can remain less efficient than expert implementations, but runtime alone does not reveal how the gap relates to design discovery and implementation. We introduce D2K-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 26 tasks and 85 workloads that measures how effectively agents translate expert design guidance into efficient GPU kernels. The guidance covers L1: high-level algorithmic insights, L2: dataflow design, and L3: low-level optimization tricks, including dependencies among these levels. Pairwise runs with and without guidance share task descriptions, workloads, tools, hardware, and a 350-turn budget. Complementary assessments examine independently proposed designs and the design properties implemented in generated code. Across five models on NVIDIA B200 GPUs, guidance raises correctness over 130 model-task pairs from 93.1% to 98.5% and increases the Performance Score over all 26 tasks from 1.46 to 1.95. For the three frontier models with correct submissions on all 26 tasks in both runs (GPT-6-Astra, Claude-Opus-4.8, and GPT-5.6-Sol), geometric mean speedup increases from $1.69\times$ to $2.49\times$. Across all five models, the mean combined implementation score increases from 57 to 70 out of 100. These results show the value of expert design guidance while identifying design properties that remain unimplemented.

AI.tldr: 提出 D2K-Bench 诊断基准，含 26 任务 85 工作负载，评估 LLM 智能体将分层专家设计指导（L1 算法洞见、L2 数据流、L3 底层优化）转化为高效 GPU kernel 的能力；加指导后正确率由 93.1% 升至 98.5%，性能得分由 1.46 升至 1.95。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体生成的 GPU kernel 效率常低于专家实现，但仅凭运行时间无法揭示性能差距与"设计探索"和"实现落地"之间的关系，缺乏可诊断的评估手段。
AI.method: 构建 D2K-Bench 基准：26 个任务、85 个工作负载；设计三级指导体系（L1 高层算法洞见、L2 数据流设计、L3 底层优化技巧）并刻画层级间依赖；采用有/无指导的成对运行，统一任务描述、工作负载、工具、硬件与 350 轮预算；辅以对独立提出的设计方案及生成代码中实际实现的设计属性的评估，在 NVIDIA B200 上测试五个模型。
AI.result: 130 个模型-任务对正确率由 93.1% 提升至 98.5%；26 任务总体性能得分由 1.46 提升至 1.95；三个在两次运行中全部任务均正确的模型（GPT-6-Astra、Claude-Opus-4.8、GPT-5.6-Sol）几何平均加速比由 1.69× 升至 2.49×；五个模型平均综合实现得分由 57 升至 70（满分 100）。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明专家设计指导具有明确价值，同时揭示出一批仍未被实现的"设计属性"，为后续智能体在设计与实现之间的能力缺口提供诊断方向。

title: Imagine the Future, Internalize the Gist: Efficient VLA Reasoning via Internalized Spatiotemporal Imagination
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly incorporate intermediate reasoning to improve robotic manipulation, yet existing approaches primarily reason about observed states without explicitly anticipating future scene evolution. Extending such reasoning to explicit future rollouts at every inference step, however, introduces substantial computational overhead. We propose IG-VLA, a VLA reasoning framework that enables models to imagine the future and internalize the gist. Our Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning learns to imagine task-relevant future scene evolution directly in visual representation space, guiding action prediction without costly pixel-level video generation. To further reduce inference overhead, we introduce Scene Gist Memory, which internalizes reasoning-derived scene-behavior associations into a compact Scene Gist Token, preserving the benefits of future reasoning while bypassing explicit future imagination at inference. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and VLABench demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of IG-VLA. On the LIBERO-Plus Language suite, both the reasoning and gist policies outperform the strongest baseline by nearly 6% in success rate. The gist policy also achieves up to 6.38x speedup over baselines, reducing inference latency from 1081ms to 169.5ms per action chunk on a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU. These results demonstrate that future spatiotemporal reasoning can be effectively internalized for efficient VLA deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出IG-VLA框架，通过潜在时空推理与场景要点记忆，使VLA模型能在表征空间想象未来场景演化并将其内化为紧凑token，在提升操作成功率的同时大幅降低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型虽引入中间推理以改进机器人操作，但主要对已观测状态进行推理，缺乏对未来场景演化的显式预测；而每一步都做显式未来rollout会带来巨大的计算开销。
AI.method: 包含两个核心组件：（1）Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning，在视觉表征空间直接想象任务相关的未来场景演化以指导动作预测，避免像素级视频生成；（2）Scene Gist Memory，将推理得到的场景-行为关联内化为紧凑的Scene Gist Token，在推理时跳过显式的未来想象。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和VLABench上验证了有效性与效率。LIBERO-Plus Language套件上，推理策略与要点策略的成功率均比最强基线高近6%；要点策略实现最高6.38倍加速，单张NVIDIA A6000上每个动作块延迟从1081ms降至169.5ms。
AI.conclusion: 未来时空推理可被有效内化，从而实现高效VLA部署。

title: Improving Atomic-Fact Recall via Focused Views in Unstructured Knowledge Editing
comment: The first two authors contributed equally
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly serve as general-purpose interfaces to factual knowledge, but their parameters do not automatically reflect information that changes after pretraining. Knowledge editing (KE) provides a targeted alternative to costly retraining by modifying selected knowledge and preserving unrelated knowledge and general capabilities. Conventional KE uses structured factual triples, whereas unstructured KE (UKE) uses free-form passages containing multiple facts. Nonetheless, existing UKE editors exhibit a failure mode known as context reliance: edited LLMs can often reproduce the editing passage but fail to reliably recall its individual facts without the original passage context. We identify context-induced difficulty underestimation under the standard passage-level editing objective: later facts receive increasingly rich ground-truth context and consequently incur lower initial losses, making them appear easier to learn. In response, we propose FOVEATED, a plug-and-play framework that constructs focused views of each sentence by randomly shifting the Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) positions assigned to the keys of its preceding context. The perturbation is applied during editing and removed afterward, leaving the model's native positional encoding unchanged at inference time. We instantiate FOVEATED for both direct-optimization and locate-then-edit editors. We theoretically analyze how FOVEATED counteracts context-induced difficulty underestimation and empirically demonstrate consistent improvements across five KE editors, two LLM backbones, and three benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 FOVEATED 框架，通过随机扰动上下文键的 RoPE 位置构造句子级聚焦视图，缓解无结构化知识编辑中的上下文依赖失败模式。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型参数无法自动反映预训练后变化的信息，知识编辑（KE）提供了替代重训练的目标化方案。无结构化知识编辑（UKE）使用含多事实的自由文段。现有 UKE 编辑器存在"上下文依赖"失败模式：编辑后的模型能复述编辑文段，却在无原文上下文时无法可靠召回其中单个事实。
AI.method: 作者识别出"上下文诱导的难度低估"问题：在标准文段级编辑目标下，靠后的事实获得越来越丰富的真实上下文，初始损失更低，显得更易学习。为此提出 FOVEATED，一种即插即用框架，通过随机平移某句子前序上下文的键所分配的 RoPE 位置，为该句构造聚焦视图。扰动仅在编辑时施加，编辑后移除，推理时保持模型原生位置编码。该框架实例化于直接优化与定位再编辑两类编辑器。
AI.result: 理论上分析了 FOVEATED 如何抵消上下文诱导的难度低估；实验在五种 KE 编辑器、两种 LLM 骨干和三个基准上取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: FOVEATED 通过编辑期上下文位置扰动实现句子级聚焦学习，有效缓解 UKE 的上下文依赖问题，且不改变推理时的位置编码，具备即插即用与广泛适用性。

title: RoboChemGym: A Protocol-Driven Generative Simulation Framework for Long-Horizon Chemical Manipulation
summary: Wet-lab experimentation serves as the gold standard for hypothesis verification in scientific discovery; yet it is inherently labor-intensive, costly, and safety-critical. Embodied agents hold the promise of automating these tedious workflows, but their development is hindered by the scarcity of real-world training data. While simulation offers a scalable alternative for producing demonstrations, current methods primarily target relatively short-horizon tasks with loosely structured interactions, failing to meet the strict procedural constraints and fine-grained manipulation demands of chemical experiments. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{RoboChemGym}, a framework that autonomously generates high-fidelity manipulation demonstrations aligned with real-world experiment protocols, featuring a \textit{self-improving task synthesis} mechanism to iteratively refine task execution and scene configurations, enabling the reliable generation of expert trajectories for complex, multi-object protocols exceeding 10 interaction steps. Furthermore, we introduce a hierarchical benchmark that systematically assesses performance across varying granularities, spanning from atomic operations to full-cycle experimental workflows. RoboChemGym sets a scalable paradigm for the automated data synthesis and capability evaluation of embodied agents in intricate chemical tasks, serving as a critical stepping stone toward fully intelligent laboratories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoboChemGym框架，可自主生成符合真实实验规程的高保真化学实验操作演示，并配套层级化基准评测具身智能体。
AI.motivation: 湿实验是科学发现中假设验证的金标准，但劳动密集、成本高且具有安全风险。具身智能体有望自动化这些流程，然而真实世界训练数据的稀缺制约其发展。现有仿真方法多面向短时程、弱结构化任务，难以满足化学实验严格的流程约束与细粒度操作要求。
AI.method: 提出RoboChemGym框架：自主生成与真实实验协议一致的高保真操作演示，包含“自改进任务合成”机制，迭代优化任务执行与场景配置，从而为超过10步交互的复杂多物体流程可靠生成专家轨迹；同时构建层级化基准，从原子操作到全周期实验流程进行多粒度系统评估。
AI.result: 能够为超过10个交互步骤的复杂多物体实验协议可靠生成专家轨迹，并支持从原子操作到全周期实验工作流的跨粒度性能评估。
AI.conclusion: RoboChemGym为复杂化学任务中具身智能体的自动化数据合成与能力评估建立了可扩展范式，是迈向全智能实验室的关键一步。

title: Slow-Fast Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Capability Preservation
summary: Foundation multimodal large language models are designed to support a broad spectrum of capabilities across diverse domains. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) provides an effective framework for consolidating domain-specific expertise into a single student model. However, MOPD training gradually drives the student away from its initialization model, and general capabilities decline as the displacement grows, resulting in capability interference. A direct remedy is constraining the student toward its initialization, but this suppresses the acquisition of domain expertise as well. We propose Slow-Fast Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (SF-MOPD), which couples a fast model, the current student updated directly by each teacher, with a slow model, an exponential moving average of the student. The slow model absorbs the learning signal gradually, serving as a moving capability reference that fuses the general foundation with confirmed domain expertise. For each teacher, SF-MOPD computes the teacher-induced update in log-probability space and removes only the component that pushes the fast model further away from the slow model, while retaining aligned and orthogonal components. Experiments across multiple model scales demonstrate that SF-MOPD effectively mitigates capability interference, enhances specialized multimodal capabilities, and reduces the average degradation on general-capability benchmarks, consistently outperforming vanilla MOPD.

AI.tldr: 提出SF-MOPD方法，通过快慢双模型耦合缓解多教师在线策略蒸馏中的能力干扰问题。
AI.motivation: 多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）在整合多领域专家能力时，会使学生模型逐渐偏离初始化状态，导致通用能力随偏移增大而下降，产生能力干扰。直接约束学生靠近初始模型又会抑制领域专长的习得，需要一种兼顾两者的方案。
AI.method: 提出慢-快多教师在线策略蒸馏（SF-MOPD）：设置快模型（由各教师直接更新的当前学生）与慢模型（学生的指数移动平均）。慢模型逐步吸收学习信号，作为融合通用基础与已确认领域专长的动态能力参照。对每个教师，在对数概率空间中计算教师诱导的更新，并仅移除使快模型进一步远离慢模型的分量，保留对齐与正交分量。
AI.result: 在多个模型规模上实验表明，SF-MOPD有效缓解能力干扰，增强专业多模态能力，并降低通用能力基准上的平均退化，持续优于原生MOPD。
AI.conclusion: SF-MOPD通过快慢模型耦合与分量选择性去除，在知识获取与通用能力保持间取得平衡，是优于MOPD的多教师蒸馏方案。

title: World Action Modeling with Progressive Visual Planning
summary: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic control by jointly predicting future visual dynamics and actions from an initial observation and instruction. However, existing WAMs struggle with long-horizon prediction, as generating dense video rollouts is highly inefficient. Some recent WAMs address this by predicting a single future frame without generating the full video, but this approach neglects how to progress toward the goal. We present ProWAM, a progressive world action model that jointly predicts actions and an ordered sequence of sparse visual sub-goals, providing explicit visual guidance to anchor action generation throughout task execution. This design scales naturally, as sub-goal prediction can be learned from large-scale action-free videos, allowing the video backbone to offload complex visual planning from the action policy. For efficient action generation, ProWAM executes a single video-backbone forward pass to cache sparse sub-goal features, eliminating iterative full-video generation and requiring only lightweight action denoising during replanning. Across extensive evaluations, ProWAM achieves superior out-of-distribution robustness. On simulation benchmarks, it sets new state-of-the-art results on LIBERO-Plus (85.8%) and randomized RoboTwin (75.7%), outperforming the strongest baseline with relative gains of up to +35.9%. On RoboCasa365, ProWAM achieves a 48.1% success rate and 18.2% on the challenging Composite-Unseen split, ranking 4th overall. Crucially, in zero-shot real-world experiments, ProWAM achieves 70.0% success, outperforming the strongest baseline by +15.0 (from 55.0% to 70.0%, a +27.3% relative gain) in novel scenes. These results demonstrate the value of progress-indexed visual foresight for closed-loop control. Our program is in https://sii-ferenas.github.io/ProWAM-page.

AI.tldr: ProWAM 是一种渐进式世界动作模型，通过联合预测动作与有序稀疏视觉子目标，实现显式视觉引导与高效动作生成，在多个仿真与真实场景基准上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）难以进行长时程预测：生成稠密视频推演效率极低；而仅预测单帧未来图像的方法又缺乏如何逐步逼近目标的指引。因此需要一种兼顾效率与目标导向视觉引导的新范式。
AI.method: ProWAM 联合预测动作与有序的稀疏视觉子目标序列，为动作生成提供显式视觉锚点。子目标预测可从大规模无动作视频中学习，使视频主干网络分担复杂视觉规划。执行时仅需一次视频主干前向传播缓存稀疏子目标特征，避免迭代式全视频生成，重规划阶段只需轻量级动作去噪。
AI.result: 在仿真基准上，LIBERO-Plus 达 85.8%，随机化 RoboTwin 达 75.7%，较最强基线相对提升最高 +35.9%；RoboCasa365 成功率 48.1%，Composite-Unseen 分项 18.2%，总排名第 4。零样本真实场景实验中成功率 70.0%，较最强基线 +15.0（55.0%→70.0%，相对提升 +27.3%）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，进度索引的视觉前瞻（progress-indexed visual foresight）对闭环控制具有显著价值，ProWAM 在分布外鲁棒性上表现优越。

title: The Fragility of Trigger-Tag Mechanisms for Misuse Detection in Open-Weight LLMs
summary: Open-weight language models can be downloaded, modified, and deployed beyond their developers' control, limiting the effectiveness of centrally enforced safeguards. Recent work has therefore proposed \emph{trigger-tag} mechanisms that produce a detectable signal when a model is used under a target condition, such as generating phishing contents. Although these mechanisms borrow from established techniques, their use for conditional misuse detection in open-weight LLMs is relatively new. Therefore, existing research works have not systematically studied the robustness of trigger-tag mechanisms under adversarial attacks. To close this gap, (i)~we formalize trigger-tags and distinguish \emph{token-level trigger-tags}, which introduce watermark-inspired signals during decoding, from \emph{weight-level trigger-tags}, which learn backdoor-inspired associations between target conditions and detectable model behavior. Furthermore, (ii)~we introduce \Untag, a unified attack framework that organizes their mechanism-specific attack surfaces into a common taxonomy. We evaluate representative token-level and weight-level trigger-tags using phishing as a case study. We find that while trigger-tags may provide useful evidence in controlled settings, our attacks render the existing trigger-tag mechanisms to be entirely ineffective. Consequently, we argue that these mechanisms should not be treated as robust misuse detectors when attackers can transform outputs or modify open weights.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究开源权重LLM中触发器标签机制在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性，提出形式化分类与统一攻击框架Untag。
AI.motivation: 开源权重模型可被下载、修改并脱离开发者控制部署，集中式安全防护效果有限。近期提出的触发器标签机制可在模型被用于特定条件（如生成钓鱼内容）时产生可检测信号，但相关研究尚未系统评估其对抗攻击下的鲁棒性，存在研究空白。
AI.method: 作者(1)形式化触发器标签，区分token级触发器标签（解码时引入水印式信号）与权重级触发器标签（学习目标条件与可检测模型行为之间的后门式关联）；(2)提出统一攻击框架Untag，将机制特定的攻击面组织为统一分类法；以钓鱼内容为案例，对代表性token级和权重级触发器标签进行评估。
AI.result: 触发器标签在受控环境下可能提供有用证据，但在所提出的攻击下，现有触发器标签机制完全失效。
AI.conclusion: 当攻击者能够变换输出或修改开放权重时，触发器标签机制不应被视为鲁棒的滥用检测器。

title: A Path Integral Surrogate for Multi-Step Gradient Inversion in Federated Learning
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
summary: Federated learning lets many clients train a shared model together without ever sending their private data to a central server. Each client shares only a model update, and this update should reveal far less about the client than its raw training examples would. This premise is what protects the privacy of the clients. Gradient inversion attacks challenge it directly by trying to reconstruct a client's private input images from the single update it shared. Under FedAvg, a client's update accumulates several local training steps, so the server sees only the two endpoints of a hidden weight trajectory. Recent gradient inversion attacks fit a surrogate model along the path between these two endpoints but they still read its gradient at a single point. We propose the Path-Integral Surrogate Model Extension (PI-SME) which treats the accumulated update as a path integral of the gradient field and approximates it by Gauss--Legendre quadrature over several nodes along a learnable Bézier path. On CIFAR-100 and FEMNIST images across a range of trajectory lengths and class-restricted batches PI-SME reconstructs the private inputs more faithfully than the strongest surrogate baseline on several inversion metrics and the matching loss.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PI-SME，将联邦学习中累积的模型更新视为梯度场上的路径积分，用高斯-勒让德求积在可学习贝塞尔路径的多个节点上逼近该积分，从而更准确地从单次更新中反演客户端私有图像，在CIFAR-100和FEMNIST上优于最强代理模型基线。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习依赖“客户端仅共享模型更新、不上传原始数据”来保护隐私。梯度反演攻击直接挑战这一前提：尝试从单次共享更新中重建客户端私有训练图像。在FedAvg下，客户端更新累积了多步本地训练，服务器只能看到隐藏权重轨迹的两个端点；现有梯度反演攻击虽沿两端点之间路径拟合代理模型，却仅在单点读取梯度，信息利用不充分。
AI.method: 提出路径积分代理模型扩展（PI-SME）。核心思想是把累积更新建模为梯度场沿轨迹的路径积分，并采用高斯-勒让德求积（Gauss-Legendre quadrature）在可学习贝塞尔路径上的多个节点处近似该积分，替代以往单点梯度读取方式，从而更充分地刻画隐藏的权重轨迹。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100和FEMNIST图像上，覆盖多种轨迹长度与类别受限批次设置，PI-SME在多个反演指标以及匹配损失上均比最强代理模型基线重建出更忠实的私有输入。
AI.conclusion: 将累积更新表述为路径积分并在多节点上求积，可显著提升梯度反演对联邦学习私有数据的重建效果，表明FedAvg的多步本地更新并非安全，反而提供了更丰富的可利用信息。

title: Capturing Dynamics: The 4D Facial Expression Intensity Dataset
summary: The estimation and analysis of facial expression intensity play a crucial role in affective communication and human-computer interaction. Previous research has primarily focused on detecting and estimating facial expression intensity from frame-level 2D representations. However, this limitation restricts a comprehensive understanding of real-world facial expressions, as they are inherently 3D and temporally continuous. This paper investigates the perception of facial expression intensity by introducing the 4D Facial Expression Intensity Dataset (4DFEID). We employ a parametric face model and compile a total of 2,869 mesh sequences with controlled geometric variations, generating 4D data instances with diverse peak intensities and identity attributes. Using a Likert scale, we collect more than 90,000 subjective intensity perception ratings via a crowdsourcing platform. We explore various architectures and aggregation methods to establish baselines for episode intensity estimation on the new dataset, revealing that spatial-temporal graph models consistently outperform traditional frame-aggregation methods. In contrast to existing datasets that rely on 2D static imagery, the proposed 4D-FEID dataset provides the community with a unique and vital resource for investigating the perception of facial expression intensity through the use of dynamic 3D stimuli. By offering high-fidelity, spatio-temporally coherent facial data, 4D-FEID establishes a new foundation for research into more nuanced and naturalistic expression analysis, thereby addressing a gap in the current landscape of affective computing and human-computer interaction studies. The dataset is available at link.

AI.tldr: 本文发布4D面部表情强度数据集4DFEID，包含2,869个网格序列与9万余条主观强度评分，并建立基线揭示时空图模型优于传统帧聚合方法。
AI.motivation: 现有面部表情强度研究多基于帧级2D表征，而真实表情本质上是3D且时间连续的，这种限制难以全面理解真实场景中的表情强度感知，因此需要动态3D刺激的数据资源。
AI.method: 采用参数化人脸模型构建2,869个具有受控几何变化的网格序列，生成具备不同峰值强度和身份属性的4D数据实例；通过众包平台以Likert量表收集超过90,000条主观强度感知评分；并探索多种架构与聚合方法建立情节强度估计基线。
AI.result: 构建了4DFEID数据集并获得超过90,000条主观评分；基线实验表明时空图模型在情节强度估计上 consistently 优于传统帧聚合方法。
AI.conclusion: 4DFEID以高保真、时空连贯的4D面部数据，为通过动态3D刺激研究表情强度感知提供了独特资源，弥补了情感计算与人机交互研究中的空白。

title: Automatic Evaluation of Mental Health Stigma in Online Communication
summary: Mental health stigma has profoundly harmful impacts but its complexity makes it difficult to evaluate. Stigma may involve explicit derogation, but also subtler forms of blame, fear, paternalistic pity, social distancing, structural exclusion, and discrimination. We introduce a theory-grounded benchmark for automatic evaluation of mental health stigma in online communication, consisting of naturally occurring online news and social media text annotated with a fine-grained taxonomy of stigma across multiple mental health conditions. Our annotation framework comprises a binary stigma-detection task and a multi-level taxonomy covering (i) stigma mode, (ii) domain, and (iii) specific components of certain forms of stigma. We apply this framework to texts mentioning six mental health conditions and evaluate large language models alongside stigma-related classifiers for detecting sentiment, toxicity, and hate speech. Results show that mental health stigma is not well captured by models trained to detect these neighboring constructs, and that LLMs often overpredict stigma unless given explicit operational rules - mirroring the importance of decision rules in human annotation. We release the publicly available part of benchmark, annotations, prototypical exemplars of stigma and code at: https://github.com/jemimakang/mh_stigma.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了首个基于理论的精神健康污名自动评估基准，包含细粒度标注体系，并评估了LLM与相关分类器的表现。
AI.motivation: 精神健康污名危害深远但结构复杂，既包括显性贬损，也包括责备、恐惧、家长式怜悯、社交疏离、结构性排斥与歧视等隐性形式，难以评估。现有针对情感、毒性、仇恨言论的模型可能无法准确捕捉污名这一邻近但不同的构念。
AI.method: 提出一个基于理论的基准，由真实在线新闻与社交媒体文本构成，覆盖七种精神健康状态的细粒度污名分类标注。标注框架包括二分类污名检测任务，以及多层级分类体系，涵盖（i）污名模式、（ii）领域、（iii）特定污名形式的具体成分。基于该框架评估大语言模型及针对情感、毒性、仇恨言论的污名相关分类器。
AI.result: 实验表明，针对邻近构念（情感、毒性、仇恨言论）训练的模型无法很好地捕捉精神健康污名；大语言模型在缺乏明确操作规则时往往过度预测污名，说明明确的判定规则对模型和人工标注同样重要。
AI.conclusion: 精神健康污名需要专门的、细粒度的评估框架，邻近构念模型不足以替代。公开了基准的公开部分、标注、典型污名样例及代码。

title: RoboBridge: A Self-Evolving Embodied Agent Framework for Sim-to-Real Transfer
summary: A key challenge in bringing embodied intelligence into the real world is transferring capabilities from simulation to reality and enabling agents to continually adapt after deployment. End-to-end vision-language-action policies provide strong manipulation capabilities, but their transfer to physical environments typically relies on calibrating simulated visual and dynamical conditions, collecting additional target-domain demonstrations, and optimizing the policy through further training. Tool-using embodied agents offer flexible task orchestration, yet existing systems primarily emphasize task execution and experience reuse within a given environment, with limited support for transferring procedural knowledge and continuously adapting it across simulation and reality. We propose RoboBridge, a framework that treats sim-to-real transfer as the continued adaptation of executable task skills. The agent represents task knowledge as procedures connecting task intent, observations, tool operations, and outcome verification. Interaction feedback is used to generate candidate skill revisions, which are evaluated before being persisted or rejected. A pretrained vision-language-action policy is exposed as a reusable action tool and enhanced with inference-time guidance, enabling fine-grained execution without retraining the underlying policy. RoboBridge grounds transferable skills in task semantics and interaction interfaces shared across simulation and reality. This representation preserves reusable task structure while allowing environment-dependent operations to be selectively revised through real-world execution feedback. We evaluate the framework on LIBERO-PRO and corresponding physical tasks, studying both skill evolution and post-transfer adaptation. Our framework provides a route from one-shot policy deployment to continual procedural learning across environments.

AI.tldr: RoboBridge将仿真到现实迁移视为可执行任务技能的持续自适应过程，通过程序化知识表示、交互反馈驱动的技能修订与VLA策略的工具化封装，实现无需重训练策略的跨环境持续学习。
AI.motivation: 具身智能落地的关键挑战是仿真到现实的迁移及部署后的持续适应。端到端视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略迁移通常依赖视觉与动力学条件校准、额外目标域示范收集及再训练；现有工具型具身智能体侧重单环境内任务执行与经验复用，缺乏跨仿真与现实的过程性知识迁移与持续自适应支持。
AI.method: 提出RoboBridge框架，将sim-to-real迁移建模为可执行任务技能的持续适配。智能体以"过程"表示任务知识，连接任务意图、观测、工具操作与结果验证；利用交互反馈生成候选技能修订，经评估后决定持久化或拒绝。预训练VLA策略被封装为可复用的动作工具，并通过推理时引导增强，从而在无需重训练底层策略的情况下实现精细执行。技能锚定于仿真与现实共享的任务语义与交互接口，保留可复用任务结构，同时允许环境相关操作依据真实执行反馈被选择性修订。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-PRO及对应物理任务上进行评估，研究了技能演化与迁移后自适应两方面表现。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一条从一次性策略部署走向跨环境持续过程性学习的路径。

title: Drive vs. Decay: On the Training Dynamics of Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Main Track). 57 pages, 10 pages of main text; appendices and the NeurIPS paper checklist included. Code: https://github.com/jose-melo/drive-vs-decay
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are prone to representation collapse, typically mitigated through empirical heuristics. We develop an early-training stability theory that unifies these heuristics. Linearising the coupled JEPA gradient flow around the trivial fixed point reveals two competing effects: a driving force ($γ$) and a decay effect ($σ$). Under approximate spectral decoupling, a per-mode stability ratio $μ_i = γ_i / σ_i$ factorises into independent data-side and predictor-side terms and the count of unstable modes tracks the rank of representations that can emerge. The framework predicts a phase boundary, which we confirm empirically across more than 800 Tabular-JEPA configurations. It also unifies predictor scaling, masking ratio, and EMA as distinct mechanisms for shifting $μ$. Guided by this analysis, we introduce ResidualPred, a transformer predictor whose attention is biased toward the identity at initialisation; it improves both effective rank and downstream accuracy on tabular benchmarks and in I-JEPA pretraining on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, STL-10, and ImageNet. Our framework connects empirical collapse-avoidance heuristics to an explicit dynamical picture, yielding theory-driven stabilizers. Code is available at https://github.com/jose-melo/drive-vs-decay.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JEPA早期训练稳定性理论，将表示坍塌的经验性规避策略统一为驱动-衰减竞争机制，并据此设计ResidualPred预测器。
AI.motivation: JEPA类联合嵌入预测架构易发生表示坍塌，现有缓解手段多为经验性启发式规则，缺乏统一的理论解释，难以指导稳定器的设计。
AI.method: 在平凡不动点附近对耦合的JEPA梯度流做线性化，得到驱动项γ与衰减项σ；在近似谱解耦下定义逐模态稳定性比率μ_i=γ_i/σ_i，可分解为数据侧与预测器侧独立项，不稳定模态数刻画可涌现表示的秩；由μ导出相变边界，并统一解释预测器缩放、掩码比例与EMA的作用。据此提出ResidualPred——初始化时注意力偏向恒等映射的Transformer预测器。
AI.result: 相变边界在800余组Tabular-JEPA配置上得到验证；ResidualPred在表格基准以及CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、STL-10、ImageNet的I-JEPA预训练中同时提升有效秩与下游准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将经验性防坍塌策略与显式动力学图像相联系，实现了理论驱动的稳定器设计；代码已开源。

title: On-Premises Multi-Course RAG Tutoring for Business Education: Hardware-Software Trade-offs in a Campus AI Tutor
summary: Campus AI tutors based on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) must ground answers in assigned course materials while keeping textbooks and student dialogue on institutional infrastructure. We present CourseChat, an on-premises, multi-course RAG tutor for undergraduate business education, deployed behind a campus web gateway and intended for use embedded in Moodle. Six isolated course offerings, each keyed by its own course reference number (CRN), share twin-edge AI hosts running a FastAPI service, a local vector database, and a local large language model (LLM) served by Ollama. We report two generation-model bake-off rounds, a separate fixed-evidence source-fidelity comparison, and conversation and quiz audits. Several larger models failed the classroom speed gate, but a 12B model and a 7B alternative passed. A separate mixture-of-experts candidate improved some corrections while introducing new factual and continuity errors. We therefore retain the 8B production model pending a demonstrated overall improvement, rather than claiming that 8B is universally optimal. Software changes improved follow-up topic resolution while preserving course scope; 435 prebuilt questions across 65 modules decouple practice from live generation. The results support treating model choice, evidence selection, serving compatibility, and product design as a joint engineering decision. They do not establish learning gains: faculty ratings, peak-load capacity, and complete public-gateway acceptance remain separate evaluation needs.

AI.tldr: CourseChat 是一个本地部署、多课程隔离的校园 RAG 辅导系统，服务本科商科教学。论文报告了生成模型选型的两轮评测、固定证据来源保真度比较，以及对话与测验审计，主张将模型选择、证据选取、服务兼容性与产品设计视为联合工程决策。
AI.motivation: 校园 AI 辅导系统需在机构自有基础设施上运行，既要将答案锚定于指定课程材料，又要保障教材与学生对话数据不出校园，因此需面向本地化部署与课程范围约束进行实证性工程选型。
AI.method: 部署于校园 Web 网关之后、面向 Moodle 嵌入使用；六个相互隔离的课程实例各由 CRN 标识，共享双边缘 AI 主机，运行 FastAPI 服务、本地向量数据库与由 Ollama 提供服务的本地 LLM。开展两轮生成模型 bake-off、独立的固定证据来源保真度对比，以及对话与测验审计；并包含软件层面改进后续话题解析的评估。
AI.result: 若干较大模型未通过课堂速度门槛，12B 模型与 7B 备选通过；一个混合专家（MoE）候选改善了部分纠错，但引入新的事实性与连贯性错误；8B 生产模型得以保留，等待整体改进的实证依据。软件改进提升了后续话题解析能力并保持课程范围；65 个模块的 435 道预置题使练习与实时生成解耦。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择、证据选取、服务兼容性与产品设计应作为联合工程决策处理；本研究不构成学习成效证据，教师评分、峰值负载容量与完整公共网关验收仍需单独评估。

title: EvoRiskBench: An Evolving Benchmark for Runtime Security Risks in Workspace Agents
summary: Workspace agents combine large language models with execution harnesses to perform stateful, multi-step tasks that access or modify external resources. Existing benchmarks leave gaps in executable coverage of their runtime security risks, while evolving model capabilities, harnesses, tools, and threats motivate benchmark evolution. We introduce EvoRiskBench, an evolving benchmark organized around the EP-Path-EF framework, which links an initial risk entry point to a one-hop technical effect through an agent-mediated risk path. The framework defines nine entry-point categories and five effect categories; a 20-participant study supports their interpretability and classification consistency on representative cases. Guided by this framework, an automated end-to-end workflow constructs and executes risk cases in isolated environments and independently verifies outcomes using runtime traces and environment states. The benchmark provides a reproducible dataset of 450 adversarial tasks across six scenarios. We evaluate nine model-harness configurations spanning three models (GPT-5.6 Sol, DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, and Claude Opus 5) and three harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw). Our results reveal substantial vulnerabilities across systems. The most vulnerable configuration, Codex with DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, reaches a 68.44% attack success rate (ASR), indicating that configuration of workspace agent is insufficient to ensure secure autonomous execution. ASR varies more across models than harnesses, and harness differences depend on the model. The benchmark cases and evaluation platform will be released after completion of artifact safety and reproducibility checks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 EvoRiskBench，一个围绕 EP-Path-EF 框架构建的可演化基准，用于评估工作区代理的运行时安全风险。基准包含 450 个对抗任务、六大场景，覆盖 9 种模型-执行框架配置。结果显示最脆弱配置（Codex + DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813）攻击成功率达 68.44%，说明仅靠配置工作区代理不足以保障自主执行安全。
AI.motivation: 工作区代理将大语言模型与执行框架结合，能执行有状态、多步骤任务并访问或修改外部资源，但其运行时安全风险缺乏可执行覆盖。现有基准在运行时风险的可执行覆盖上存在空白；同时模型能力、执行框架、工具与威胁持续演化，要求基准同步演化。
AI.method: 提出 EvoRiskBench 可演化基准，围绕 EP-Path-EF 框架组织：将初始风险入口点经由代理中介的风险路径连接到一个单跳技术效应。框架定义 9 类入口点和 5 类效应，并通过 20 人研究验证其可解释性与分类一致性。基于该框架，构建自动化端到端工作流，在隔离环境中构造并执行风险案例，并用运行时轨迹与环境状态独立验证结果。基准提供跨六场景、450 个对抗任务的可复现数据集。
AI.result: 评估了 9 种模型-执行框架配置，涵盖 3 个模型（GPT-5.6 Sol、DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813、Claude Opus 5）与 3 个执行框架（Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw）。结果显示系统普遍存在显著漏洞：最脆弱配置 Codex + DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 的攻击成功率（ASR）达 68.44%。ASR 在模型间的差异大于执行框架间的差异，且执行框架差异依赖于所配模型。
AI.conclusion: 配置工作区代理不足以确保安全的自主执行。基准案例与评估平台将在完成工件安全性与可复现性检查后发布。

title: SpectralCache: Accelerating Diffusion-Based World Models via Spectral Feature Caching
summary: Diffusion-based world models enable high-quality interactive environment generation but suffer from substantial inference overhead due to repeated Transformer evaluations during denoising. Existing caching methods mainly exploit temporal redundancy at the feature or token level, leaving the underlying mathematical structure of diffusion features largely unexplored. In this work, we reveal that world-model features exhibit highly stable singular subspaces across nearby denoising steps, while their singular values follow predictable evolution patterns. Building on this observation, we propose SpectralCache, a training-free spectral caching framework that reuses stable singular subspaces and estimates only low-dimensional singular values through linear extrapolation. We further exploit the spectral consistency between neighboring full-computation features to skip selected expensive backbone evaluations via singular value scaling. Extensive experiments on representative world models demonstrate that SpectralCache consistently improves inference efficiency while preserving generation quality. On HunyuanWorld-Voyager-13B, SpectralCache achieves 5.22x acceleration while maintaining a WorldScore of 65.90 for static scenes, substantially outperforming existing training-free caching methods in inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出 SpectralCache，一种免训练的谱缓存框架，通过复用稳定的奇异子空间并线性外推低维奇异值，加速扩散式世界模型推理。
AI.motivation: 扩散式世界模型虽能生成高质量交互环境，但去噪过程中反复的 Transformer 评估带来巨大推理开销；现有缓存方法仅在特征或 token 层面利用时间冗余，未挖掘扩散特征的数学结构。
AI.method: 基于观察到的世界模型特征在相邻去噪步间具有高度稳定的奇异子空间、且奇异值呈可预测演化规律，SpectralCache 复用稳定奇异子空间，仅通过线性外推估计低维奇异值；并利用相邻全计算特征间的谱一致性，通过奇异值缩放跳过部分昂贵的骨干网络评估；全程无需训练。
AI.result: 在代表性世界模型上持续提升推理效率并保持生成质量；在 HunyuanWorld-Voyager-13B 上实现 5.22 倍加速，静态场景 WorldScore 达 65.90，推理效率显著优于现有免训练缓存方法。
AI.conclusion: 从扩散特征谱结构出发的缓存策略能有效加速世界模型推理，兼顾效率与质量。

title: Text-Centric Post-Training for Omni-Modal Reasoning
summary: Improving joint audio-visual reasoning in Omni Large Language Models typically incurs substantial data construction and training costs. Our diagnostics reveal multi-hop reasoning difficulties despite correct answers to all corresponding single-hop questions and suggest partial decoupling in the local optimization of perception and reasoning objectives. This motivates post-training with different emphases on these capabilities. Text-only reasoning training yields gains across data sources, model scales, and families. With the best-performing text-only configuration, supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning (RL) raises Qwen2.5-Omni-7B's geometric mean of nine reasoning scores by 25.83% over the base model, outperforming the complete native audio-visual route with 56.6% fewer GPU-hours. Training on data synthesized entirely by a text-only LLM raises this geometric mean by 21.01% without audio-visual data in construction or training. However, text-only training degrades perception. We therefore propose a text-centric post-training paradigm: text-only training provides the main reasoning optimization, and reduced-data native audio-visual RL then refines perception. Refinement uses about 90% fewer input tokens than full-data audio-visual RL, restores perception above the base level, and retains 93.5% of the best-performing text-only pipeline's reasoning gain.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现全模态大模型存在多跳推理困难与感知-推理目标部分解耦，提出以文本为中心的后训练范式：文本训练主导推理优化，少量原生音视频强化学习精修感知。
AI.motivation: 提升全模态大模型的联合音视频推理通常需要大量数据构建与训练开销。诊断发现，模型虽能正确回答所有对应的单跳问题，却仍存在多跳推理困难，说明感知与推理目标的局部优化存在部分解耦，因此有必要对这两类能力采用不同侧重的后训练策略。
AI.method: 提出文本中心的后训练范式：第一阶段用纯文本训练（监督微调后接强化学习）作为主要推理优化手段，甚至可使用纯文本LLM合成的数据；第二阶段用缩减数据的原生音视频强化学习精修感知。
AI.result: 最优纯文本配置使Qwen2.5-Omni-7B在九项推理得分的几何平均上较基座模型提升25.83%，优于完整原生音视频路线且GPU时数减少56.6%；纯文本LLM合成数据训练提升21.01%。但纯文本训练会削弱感知。精修阶段输入token比全数据音视频RL少约90%，将感知恢复到基座水平以上，并保留最优纯文本流程93.5%的推理增益。
AI.conclusion: 感知与推理目标存在部分解耦，文本中心的解耦式后训练可在显著降低数据与算力成本的同时兼顾推理提升与感知保持，为全模态大模型高效后训练提供了可行路径。

title: Around the World: Unified Learned Locomotion on a 270 g Continuous-Rotation Quadruped
summary: Closed-loop learned locomotion is established on commercial quadrupeds but remains uncommon at the sub-kilogram scale. Continuous-rotation legs give MiNI-Q, a 270 g quadruped, access to supporting configurations on either side of the body. We exploit this range with a single posture-conditioned reinforcement-learning policy that runs entirely onboard. A continuous joint-space reference on the torus $T^8$ and its gravity-conditioned transformation connect upright walking, inverted walking, and landing recovery without state machines or phase switching. Coordinated posture and release curricula train this behavior family; identified actuation, cross-engine validation, and embedded execution support hardware transfer. The same sub-100k-parameter network tracks forward velocity with RMSE of 0.037 m/s upright and 0.050 m/s inverted, resumes walking in 24 of 30 release trials, and operates with four interchangeable foot geometries across four indoor surfaces. Hardware experiments and simulation ablations connect these capabilities to the representation, conditioning, and training choices that exploit the platform's motion range. Demonstration videos and supplementary material are available on the project website: https://submissionreview.github.io/around-the-world/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MiNI-Q——一款270克级小型四足机器人，利用可连续旋转的腿部结构结合单一姿态条件化强化学习策略，实现直立行走、倒立行走与落地恢复的统一控制，并完全在嵌入式端运行。
AI.motivation: 闭环学习式运动控制已在商用四足机器人上得到验证，但在亚千克（sub-kilogram）尺度上仍不常见，主要受限于小型平台的执行器特性、算力约束与状态表示难题。
AI.method: 以环面 T^8 上的连续关节空间参考及其重力条件化变换作为统一表示，避免状态机与相位切换；采用单一姿态条件化强化学习策略，并设计姿态协调课程与释放（release）课程进行训练；结合执行器辨识、跨引擎验证与嵌入式部署实现硬件迁移。网络参数量小于10万。
AI.result: 该策略在直立状态下速度跟踪RMSE为0.037 m/s，倒立状态下为0.050 m/s；在30次释放试验中有24次成功恢复行走；可在四种可互换足部几何与四种室内地面上运行。
AI.conclusion: 硬件实验与仿真消融表明，所提能力源自环面参考表示、重力条件化与训练课程等设计选择对平台运动范围的有效利用，验证了亚千克级四足机器人统一闭环学习运动控制的可行性。

title: Mitigating Convergence Collapse in Fixed-Target Anomaly Detectors via Kernel-Anchored Locality Regularization
summary: A family of tabular anomaly detectors trains a neural map toward a fixed target under squared-error loss and scores anomalies by the test-time residual; contraction matching, one-step rectified flow, and reconstruction autoencoders all fit this template. We characterize a convergence collapse: better optimization makes the detector worse. At convergence, the learned map tracks the target even off-distribution, so the residual signal vanishes on anomalies as well as on normal data. These detectors therefore rely on implicit non-convergence (early stopping, capacity caps) to retain signal. We argue this is structural: effective anomaly detection requires a locality constraint that blocks unconstrained extrapolation. Classical detectors (kNN, KDE, isolation forests, LOF) enforce locality explicitly; fixed-target neural detectors do not. We formalize the connection by showing that the kernel-regression analog of a fixed-target detector is a finite-bandwidth Nadaraya-Watson smoother, which we call Kernel Contraction Matching (KCM). KCM is closed-form, training-free, and CPU-efficient, yet matches established neural baselines on ADBench. Building on this bridge, we introduce the Kernel-Anchored Regularizer (KAR), which penalizes deviation of the neural prediction from a kernel-weighted average of training targets. Across collapse-prone ADBench datasets and three backbones, KAR mitigates collapse and improves AUROC under prolonged training.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示固定目标表格异常检测器存在"收敛崩塌"：优化越充分，测试残差在异常与正常样本上同时消失，检测性能反而下降；作者指出有效检测需要局部性约束，并提出无训练的核收缩匹配(KCM)与核锚定正则(KAR)来缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 一类表格异常检测方法（收缩匹配、一步rectified flow、重构自编码器）均训练神经网络映射逼近固定目标，用平方误差损失，并以测试时残差作为异常分数。作者发现这类方法存在结构性缺陷：当优化充分收敛时，学习到的映射在分布外区域也跟随目标，导致残差在异常样本上同样消失，异常信号丢失。现有方法只能依靠早停、容量限制等隐式非收敛手段保留信号，缺乏对这一问题本质的分析与解决方案。
AI.method: 1. 形式化"收敛崩塌"现象，论证有效异常检测需要阻止无约束外推的局部性约束，并对比经典检测器(kNN、KDE、孤立森林、LOF)显式施加局部性而固定目标神经检测器缺失该约束。2. 建立核回归桥梁：证明固定目标检测器的核回归类比为有限带宽的Nadaraya-Watson平滑器，命名为Kernel Contraction Matching (KCM)，其为闭式解、无需训练、CPU高效。3. 基于该桥梁提出Kernel-Anchored Regularizer (KAR)，通过惩罚神经预测与训练目标核加权平均之间的偏差来注入局部性约束。
AI.result: KCM在ADBench上与既有神经基线相当，且具备闭式、免训练、CPU高效的优点。KAR在易发生崩塌的ADBench数据集与三种骨干网络上，有效缓解收敛崩塌，并在延长训练时提升AUROC。
AI.conclusion: 固定目标神经异常检测器的性能依赖隐式非收敛，收敛崩塌是其结构性缺陷，根源在于缺乏局部性约束。通过核回归类比可自然引入局部性：KCM提供免训练强基线，KAR作为通用正则项缓解崩塌、提升长期训练下的检测性能，为设计更稳健的异常检测器提供了理论与方法基础。

title: Hypothesis-guided discovery of cognitive algorithms via program refinement
summary: Developing cognitive models of algorithmic reasoning from behavioral data is a central problem in cognitive science that challenges current methods. Traditional approaches to cognitive modeling are interpretable and benefit from human expertise, but lack flexibility and scalability. Emerging techniques using large language models (LLMs) for de novo generation of cognitive models are scalable and flexible, but lack a role for human expertise and have mostly been applied to simpler tasks than algorithm recovery. We propose a hybrid system that treats discovery of cognitive algorithms as a program refinement problem. Human-created cognitive models are expressed as probabilistic programs and provided to a system of LLM agents with a mandate to: identify mismatches between model and behavior; propose code-level modifications within researcher-specified constraints; and verify structural fidelity. Revisions propagate to a probabilistic inference module that performs inference for latent variables and data likelihood computations. We evaluate the pipeline on human behavior in a problem-solving paradigm that exposes a variety of cognitive algorithms. Revised models consistently improve model fit relative to ancestral models and reveal a small set of recurring innovations that capture meaningful behavioral variability in this task.

AI.tldr: 提出一种混合系统，把认知算法发现视为程序精化问题：将人类编写的认知模型表示为概率程序，由LLM智能体在研究者约束下诊断模型与行为的失配、提出代码级修改并验证结构保真度，修改传播至概率推断模块进行潜变量推断与似然计算；在问题解决任务的人类行为数据上，精化后的模型一致优于祖先模型，并揭示出少量反复出现的创新。
AI.motivation: 传统认知建模方法可解释、依赖人类专家知识，但缺乏灵活性与可扩展性；基于大语言模型的端到端生成方法可扩展、灵活，却缺少人类专业知识的参与，且多用于较简单任务，难以用于算法层面的恢复。因此需要一种兼顾二者优势的方案。
AI.method: 将认知算法发现建模为程序精化问题，构建人机混合系统：1）研究者以概率程序形式给出人类创建的认知模型；2）一组LLM智能体被赋予任务：识别模型与行为间的失配、在研究者指定约束内提出代码级修改、验证结构保真度；3）修订结果传播到概率推断模块，用于潜变量推断与数据似然计算。在暴露多种认知算法的问题解决范式的人类行为数据上评估该流程。
AI.result: 修改后的模型相较其祖先模型一致地改善了模型拟合，并揭示出一小组反复出现的创新，这些创新捕捉了该任务中具有意义的行为变异。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM智能体嵌入以人类概率程序为先验的程序精化回路，可在保留研究者约束与可解释结构的前提下，兼顾可扩展性与灵活性，有效支持认知算法的发现与模型改进。

title: LiBRA: Detection-Aware Image Watermark Removal via Bidirectional Latent Optimization
summary: Digital watermarking supports source attribution for AI-generated images, but its reliability depends on resistance to removal attacks. Some attacks attempt to remove watermarks by forcing the decoded watermark to differ from the original. However, this can produce an inverted watermark that remains detectable, causing removal to fail, while further attempts to alter the watermark may unnecessarily degrade image quality. To address these limitations, we present LiBRA (Latent In-band Bidirectional Removal Attack), which aims to make watermarks undetectable while preserving image quality. Instead of continually pushing the watermark toward inversion, LiBRA adjusts the image to conceal the watermark without encouraging further changes that could degrade image quality. Some attacks keep pushing decoded bits away from the original watermark, even when further changes preserve detectability and damage image quality. With access to the watermark key and decoder, LiBRA makes bounded changes in a public autoencoder's latent space. Unlike inversion-driven objectives that cannot correct excessive inversion, LiBRA guides average decoding confidence toward random guessing from either direction. This helps avoid an inverted but detectable watermark. Leaving individual bits flexible allows image-quality constraints to favor less damaging changes, while an optional frequency-guided mask limits their location. We verify removal using an exact two-sided binomial test rather than assuming the confidence target guarantees success.

AI.tldr: 提出LiBRA，一种潜空间带内双向移除攻击，通过将水印解码置信度从任意方向引导至随机猜测水平，使AI生成图像中的水印不可检测，同时保持图像质量。
AI.motivation: 数字水印用于AI生成图像的来源归属，但其可靠性取决于抗移除能力。现有移除攻击多通过强制解码水印与原始水印不同来移除，但这可能产生仍可检测的"反转水印"导致移除失败；继续改变水印又会不必要地降低图像质量。因此需要一种既能实现不可检测、又能保持图像质量的方法。
AI.method: LiBRA（Latent In-band Bidirectional Removal Attack）在公开自编码器的潜空间中进行有界修改。与无法纠正过度反转的"反转驱动"目标不同，LiBRA从任一方向将平均解码置信度引导至随机猜测水平，避免产生反转但可检测的水印。其保持个体比特灵活，使图像质量约束倾向于损害更小的改动，并可选地用频率引导掩码限制改动位置。移除效果通过精确的双侧二项检验验证，而非假定置信度目标必然保证成功。
AI.result: LiBRA能够使水印不可检测，同时保留图像质量；通过精确双侧二项检验验证移除成功，避免了反转但仍可检测的水印问题，并减少了不必要的图像质量退化。
AI.conclusion: 在拥有水印密钥与解码器的前提下，LiBRA通过在潜空间实施双向、有界的置信度引导，在保持图像质量的同时实现更可靠的水印移除，为水印抗移除鲁棒性评估提供了新视角。

title: CHASE-VLA: Post-Training Quantization Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models with Chunk-Aware Scale Estimation
comment: Accepted at ACCV 2026. 22 pages, including references and supplementary material
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions to continuous robot actions, but a diffusion-based action expert (AE) poses a key challenge for low-bit post-training quantization (PTQ). The AE is repeatedly invoked across denoising steps and policy queries, where fixed calibration scales can be mismatched with activation ranges that vary with denoising progress and intended motion. We propose CHASE-VLA, a chunk-aware PTQ method that exploits a VLA-specific signal readily available from the policy: the generated action chunk, including its unexecuted future suffix. Rather than relying only on static scale matching for AE layers, CHASE-VLA combines the previously generated chunk as causal action context with denoising step group information to adapt AE activation scales. This enables W4A4 quantization of both MLP and attention projections in the repeated AE without modifying the pretrained policy. On LIBERO, CHASE-VLA achieves 97.3% average success rate on $π_{0.5}$ when both MLP and attention projections in the AE are quantized to W4A4, restoring FP16-level performance. CHASE-VLA also reduces the weight storage of the quantized AE linear layers by 73.4% and their single-chunk memory traffic by 70.9% and 71.2% on $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.6, respectively, with a predictor overhead of at most 1.26% of the saved storage.

AI.tldr: CHASE-VLA：面向VLA扩散动作专家的分块感知W4A4训练后量化方法
AI.motivation: VLA模型中基于扩散的动作专家（AE）在去噪步与策略查询中被反复调用，固定校准尺度难以匹配随去噪进度与目标运动变化的激活分布，导致低比特PTQ困难。
AI.method: 利用策略可得的VLA特有信号——生成的action chunk（含未执行的未来后缀），将其作为因果动作上下文，与去噪步分组信息结合，自适应调整AE激活尺度，实现AE中MLP与注意力投影的W4A4量化，且不修改预训练策略。
AI.result: LIBERO上，π0.5在AE的MLP与注意力投影均W4A4量化时平均成功率达97.3%，恢复FP16水平；量化后AE线性层权存储减少73.4%，单chunk访存分别降低70.9%（π0.5）与71.2%（GR00T N1.6），预测器开销至多为节省存储的1.26%。
AI.conclusion: 分块感知的自适应尺度量化可在不微调策略的前提下实现扩散动作专家的W4A4 PTQ，兼顾精度与显存/访存效率。

title: Clinical Concept Centers in LLMs
summary: Large language models are increasingly used in clinical settings. However, research into the reliability and performance of these models has focused almost entirely on the language substrate, scoring what the model says. Mechanistic interpretability has found that the latent space carries a higher fidelity of representation than the text: internal representations not only encode substantially more than the output verbalizes, but the stated reasoning also systematically omits features that causally drive the answer. An evaluation of model behavior in terms of mechanistic interpretability has not been explored in clinical decision support. In this work, we extend behavioral evaluation into the latent space and ask whether clinical concepts exist as locatable, causally used representations inside open-weight LLMs. We find dedicated clinical concept centers in the latent space of all eleven open models we test. These concept centers are interpretable, firing only on their aligned clinical narratives, and meaningfully and causally drive model behavior in both constrained and open-ended settings. They are not just analytical representations, but circuits that can be utilized in clinical practice, and we explore their use from the perspective of both evaluation and performance. From the evaluation standpoint, models stay internally coherent and keep using the relevant concept centers even under adversarial role-based priming, while aligned priming improves downstream clinical performance. From a performance perspective, we simulate realistic deployment settings and find that steering models along these centers leads to meaningful downstream improvements. Finally, we conduct a blinded clinician validation and find the activation and usage of these concept centers predicts clinicians preferences.

AI.tldr: 该研究将临床大模型评估从"语言表层"扩展到"潜在空间"，发现11个开源模型中均存在可定位、可解释、因果驱动行为的"临床概念中心"，并验证其在对抗性角色提示下仍保持内部一致、可用于评估与性能提升，且其激活能预测临床医生偏好。
AI.motivation: 现有临床大模型研究几乎只评估"模型说了什么"这一语言表层（language substrate），而机制可解释性研究表明潜在空间对特征的编码保真度更高，且显式推理会系统性遗漏因果驱动答案的特征。然而，尚无人从机制可解释性角度评估临床决策支持模型的内部行为，即临床概念是否以可定位、被因果使用的表征形式存在于开放权重LLM内部。
AI.method: 将行为评估扩展到潜在空间：在11个开放权重LLM中定位临床概念中心（concept centers），检验其可解释性（是否仅对被对齐的临床叙事激活）与因果性（在受限与开放式设定下是否驱动行为）；开展对抗性/对齐性角色提示实验以观察内部一致性与下游表现；在模拟真实部署条件下对模型沿概念中心进行steering；并进行盲法临床医生验证。
AI.result: 在所有11个开放模型中均发现专门的临床概念中心；这些中心具有可解释性，仅对其对应的临床叙事激活，并在受限与开放式设定下均有意义且因果地驱动模型行为。面对对抗性角色式提示时，模型仍保持内部连贯并持续使用相关概念中心；对齐式提示可改善下游临床性能。模拟部署中沿这些中心进行steering带来显著的下游改进。盲法临床医生验证显示，这些概念中心的激活与使用可预测临床医生的偏好。
AI.conclusion: 临床概念中心不只是分析性表征，而是可用于临床实践的"回路"（circuits），兼具评估与性能两方面用途：既可作为评估模型内部行为的稳健指标（抗对抗性提示、预测医生偏好），也可作为提升临床性能的干预手段（steering）。该工作将机制可解释性引入临床决策支持的行为评估。

title: CSIR: Contextually and Socially Informed Robots for Efficient Person Goal Navigation
summary: We address the Person Goal Navigation (PersonNav) problem, enabling robots to search for people under realistic constraints on information accessibility and language uncertainty. This tackles the current solutions revolving around rigid person finding systems requiring exact knowledge of the individual for item-delivery in indoor settings. While the focus in literature is on learned methods using unavailable public or sparse data due to human privacy. We propose a planning framework that combines distance and semantic information about the recipient (habits and intent) weighted by the trust of the user-provided information. A synthetic benchmark of scenarios is also developed including actors, items, and requests to evaluate performance before real-world deployment aiming to simulate natural language human-robot interactions. Results show our informed search outperforms classical distance-based graph baselines, while semantics alone lead to ungrounded, sporadic search. Our method achieves strong gains over baselines, with an LLM-based variant performing comparably, and its explicit belief representation naturally supports future Bayesian filtering. Hardware tests demonstrate our method supports real-world embodiment able to leverage between semantic and distance information in a real setting. This work moves toward more intelligent mobile service agents capable of human-like, informed search in realistic environments to be leveraged in day-to-day use. https://anonymous.4open.science/r/personnavsite-4ED2/index.html.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PersonNav（人物目标导航）问题并提出融合距离与语义信息的规划框架，在信息受限与语言不确定条件下指导机器人搜索人物。
AI.motivation: 现有寻找人物方案依赖刚性系统，需精确获知目标个体信息，且研究多基于不可获取的公开或稀疏数据，受人类隐私限制，难以在真实场景中部署。
AI.method: 提出规划框架，融合关于接收者的距离信息与语义信息（习惯与意图），并按用户提供信息的信任度加权；构建包含角色、物品、请求的合成基准场景以评估自然语言人机交互性能；还给出基于LLM的变体。
AI.result: 所提知情搜索优于经典基于距离的图基线，仅用语义会导致无根据、零散的搜索；方法相对基线取得显著提升，LLM变体性能相当；硬件测试表明支持真实具身，可在真实环境权衡语义与距离信息。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推动面向日常使用的智能移动服务代理发展，使其能在真实环境中进行类人、知情式搜索。

title: From Behavior to Provenance: Attributing Tabular Foundation Models to Synthetic Pretraining Data
summary: Training-data attribution aims to identify which training examples shape model behavior, yet validating such claims is difficult because causal training influence is rarely observable. We argue that controlled synthetic pretraining makes attribution experimentally testable. Using O'PRIOR, a provenance-rich synthetic task generator for tabular foundation models, we construct a testbed in which every pretraining task carries explicit lineage over structural mechanisms, missingness, confounding, shortcuts, and distribution shift. We combine behavior-conditioned attribution with counterfactual retraining and provenance-aware interventions to test both task-level faithfulness and mechanism-level consistency. On held-out real tasks, removing the top-attributed 5% of synthetic tasks decreases mean ROC-AUC by 0.013, compared with 0.002$\pm$0.004 under random removal, while removing bottom-attributed tasks improves performance by 0.003. Within shortcut-provenance tasks, targeted removal yields an effect of 0.043 versus 0.016 for matched random removal. Provenance discrimination is more modest by ranking AUROC (0.55-0.62), despite substantial top-k enrichment, revealing that provenance association and interventional faithfulness need not coincide. Our results establish synthetic provenance as a controlled setting for verifiable contributive attribution

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用受控合成预训练数据（O'PRIOR）使训练数据归因可实验验证，通过行为条件归因、反事实重训与溯源干预检验归因的任务级忠实度与机制级一致性。
AI.motivation: 训练数据归因旨在识别哪些训练样本塑造了模型行为，但因果性训练影响难以观测，导致归因结论难以验证。作者认为受控的合成预训练可以让归因变得可实验检验。
AI.method: 构建 O'PRIOR——面向表格基础模型的溯源丰富合成任务生成器，使每个预训练任务对结构机制、缺失机制、混杂、捷径与分布偏移携带显式谱系；结合行为条件归因（behavior-conditioned attribution）、反事实重训（counterfactual retraining）与溯源感知干预（provenance-aware interventions），同时检验任务级忠实度与机制级一致性。
AI.result: 在留出真实任务上，移除归因得分最高5%的合成任务使平均 ROC-AUC 下降0.013，随机移除仅下降0.002±0.004；移除最低归因任务反而提升性能0.003。在捷径溯源任务中，定向移除效应为0.043，匹配随机移除为0.016。但溯源判别能力较弱，排序 AUROC 仅0.55–0.62，尽管 top-k 富集显著，说明溯源关联性与干预忠实度并不必然一致。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明合成溯源可作为可验证的贡献性归因的受控实验环境，并揭示溯源关联与干预忠实度是两类不同性质的证据。

title: Learning What to Investigate Next: Meta-Reasoning for Long-Horizon Research Agents
summary: Long-horizon research agents must decide both how to investigate and what to investigate next as evidence accumulates. This is hard to learn because such decisions are sparse in long execution traces, and their consequences may emerge several investigations later. We introduce Meta-reasoning for Iterative Research Agents (MIRA), a hierarchical architecture separating research allocation from execution. An outer-loop meta-reasoner curates context from a persistent research record, then writes a work order for the next investigation or ends the episode. A fresh inner-loop executor carries out each work order, making execution part of the transition between meta-reasoning actions. Without policy training, MIRA improves long-horizon inference and allocates additional compute more effectively in theorem proving and open-ended neural-architecture research. Its decision boundaries also provide natural units for credit assignment. At each boundary, we train a generative critic to forecast expected remaining return from partial states, outperforming token-level alternatives. Cross-environment pretraining improves forecasting and adaptation, yielding a transferable prior for valuing partial progress. We use this prior to initialize MIRA-AC, a generative actor-critic jointly trained to forecast remaining return and choose the next investigation, without a separate critic model. MIRA-AC concentrates policy optimization on meta-reasoning decisions, enabling efficient long-horizon reinforcement learning without directly optimizing the longer execution traces they initiate. Training MIRA-AC on the model's own proxy hill-climbing signals improves gold performance across four autoresearch environments; the actor transfers with cross-environment value initialization. Together, these results show that meta-reasoning can be learned as an explicit policy for directing long-horizon autonomous research.

AI.tldr: 提出MIRA层次化架构，将研究决策分为元推理（外层，决定下一步调查什么）与执行（内层），无需策略训练即可提升长时程推理；并进一步训练生成式actor-critic（MIRA-AC）实现元推理策略学习，可跨环境迁移。
AI.motivation: 长时程研究智能体需在证据累积过程中决定"如何调查"和"下一步调查什么"。这类决策在长执行轨迹中极为稀疏，且其后果可能要在多次调查之后才显现，因此难以学习。如何为这类稀疏、延迟的元决策提供有效信用分配与先验，是核心难题。
AI.method: MIRA采用层次化架构，将研究分配与执行解耦：外层元推理器从持久化研究记录中整理（curate）上下文，写出下一项调查的工作单（work order）或终止回合；内层执行器每次以全新实例执行单项工作单，使执行成为元推理动作之间的状态转移。决策边界自然构成信用分配单元，在每个边界训练生成式critic预测部分状态的期望剩余回报（优于token级方案）。跨环境预训练提升预测与适应能力，形成可迁移的"部分进展价值"先验，用于初始化MIRA-AC——一个联合训练预测剩余回报与选择下一项调查的生成式actor-critic（无需独立critic模型），使策略优化集中于元推理决策，避免直接优化其引发的长执行轨迹。
AI.result: 无需策略训练，MIRA即提升长时程推理并在定理证明与开放式神经网络架构研究中更有效地分配额外算力；边界级生成式critic在剩余回报预测上优于token级替代方案；跨环境预训练改善预测与适应，形成价值先验。在四个自动研究（autoresearch）环境中，用模型自身代理爬山（proxy hill-climbing）信号训练MIRA-AC提升gold表现，actor可借助跨环境价值初始化迁移。
AI.conclusion: 元推理可作为显式策略来学习，用于指挥长时程自主研究；通过层次化结构、决策边界信用分配与可迁移的价值先验，实现了高效的长时程强化学习与跨环境迁移。

title: Reversing the Clock: Layout-Aware Recovery of Design Intent from Clock Distribution Networks
comment: Accepted at the IEEE International Conference on Physical Assurance and Inspection of Electronics (PAINE) 2026
summary: Hardware reverse engineering supports competitive analysis and hardware assurance by recovering information about an integrated circuit (IC) from its physical implementation. While existing techniques primarily recover the gate-level netlist, which represents logical functionality, they often overlook physical design decisions such as placement, routing, delay insertion, and interconnect optimization. The clock distribution network encapsulates many of these decisions; however, no prior published work has recovered this network from a fabricated IC to infer design intent. We present a layout-aware methodology that recovers and analyzes the clock distribution network by integrating a recovered gate-level netlist with layout information extracted from scanning electron microscope imagery. Our four-phase pipeline recovers clock-tree topology, buffering, gating and switching, interconnect delay, and crosstalk-mitigation measures. We demonstrate our methodology on a commercial 450 nm IC, recovering a global H-tree backbone with local X-tree-like branching, identifying an independent clock tree and global clock gating, quantifying latency, skew, and routing lengths, and confirming the absence of dedicated crosstalk mitigation. Together, these findings let us reason about the designer's intent. To encourage further research and support reproducibility, we release our clock tree recovery algorithm as open source.

AI.tldr: 提出一种版图感知方法，结合恢复的门级网表与SEM图像提取的版图信息，四阶段恢复并分析IC时钟分布网络，在450nm商用芯片上验证并开源算法。
AI.motivation: 现有硬件逆向工程主要恢复门级网表（逻辑功能），忽视布局、布线、延迟插入和互连优化等物理设计决策；时钟分布网络集中体现这些决策，但此前无公开工作从成品IC中恢复该网络以推断设计意图。
AI.method: 将恢复的门级网表与扫描电子显微镜（SEM）图像提取的版图信息集成，构建版图感知的四阶段流水线：恢复时钟树拓扑、缓冲、门控与开关、互连延迟以及串扰抑制措施。
AI.result: 在商用450 nm IC上验证：恢复出带局部X树状分支的全局H树骨干，识别出独立时钟树与全局时钟门控，量化了延迟、偏斜和布线长度，并确认无专用串扰抑制措施。
AI.conclusion: 该研究可从时钟网络恢复结果推断设计者意图；为促进后续研究与可复现性，已将时钟树恢复算法开源。

title: Revisiting Visual Representation Enhancement of VLMs via Kernel Canonical Correlation Analysis
summary: Vision-language models such as CLIP exhibit strong semantic generalization, but remain limited in fine-grained visual perception. A recent work named KUEA presents a natural remedy by finetuning the image encoder under the supervision of the vision-centric DINOv2 to align their kernel matrices element-wisely, while regularizing the embeddings to remain close to the pretrained visual encoder for preserving image-text semantics in CLIP. However, we show that diminishing the role of the alignment loss to DINOv2 does not necessarily degrade its fine-grained visual performance, suggesting that the kernel-matrix discrepancy may be insufficient for further visual representation enhancement, motivating us to revisit the alignment formulation. In this work, we present a novel perspective to characterize representation alignment on feature subspaces through Kernel Canonical Correlation Analysis (KCCA), which maximizes the projection correlations. In optimization, we derive an efficient end-to-end training scheme upon KKT conditions, avoiding the eigenvalue problem in KCCA. Further, we extend our method into a 3-view formulation, i.e., 3vKCCA, in which the projections from the pretrained text encoder are also incorporated under a unified optimization framework for joint alignment. With CLIP ViT-L/14 on ImageNet-1K, our 3vKCCA improves the MMVP-VLM accuracy from 17.8 to 25.9, substantially outperforming the existing methods, and meanwhile maintains zero-shot image--text retrieval performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于核典型相关分析（KCCA）的特征子空间对齐方法，并扩展为三视图公式3vKCCA，在CLIP ViT-L/14上显著提升细粒度视觉感知且保持零样本检索性能。
AI.motivation: CLIP等视觉-语言模型语义泛化能力强，但细粒度视觉感知不足。已有工作KUEA通过在以DINOv2监督下微调图像编码器、逐元素对齐核矩阵来缓解该问题，然而作者发现减弱对DINOv2对齐损失的权重并不必然降低细粒度视觉性能，说明核矩阵差异可能不足以进一步改进视觉表征，因此有必要重新审视对齐公式。
AI.method: 从特征子空间视角刻画表征对齐，采用KCCA最大化投影相关性；在优化上基于KKT条件推导高效端到端训练方案，避免求解KCCA的特征值问题；进一步扩展到三视图形式3vKCCA，将预训练文本编码器的投影纳入统一优化框架进行联合对齐。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K上使用CLIP ViT-L/14，3vKCCA将MMVP-VLM准确率从17.8提升至25.9，显著优于现有方法，同时保持零样本图像-文本检索性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于KCCA的特征子空间对齐（尤其三视图3vKCCA）是提升视觉-语言模型细粒度视觉感知的有效途径，可在不牺牲图文语义与检索能力的前提下实现视觉表征增强。

title: How Robust Is Multimodal Claim Verification to LLM Rewriting?
summary: LLMs are known to introduce stylistic changes into generated text, yet how these stylistic shifts affect model decisions on scientific tasks remains underexplored. In this paper, we focus on multimodal claim verification, where the goal is to determine whether a textual claim is grounded in a given piece of evidence. We apply two rewriting strategies: natural rewriting, which simulates how researchers routinely use LLMs to polish academic text, and controlled injection, which inserts a single LLM-associated word to isolate the effect of vocabulary choice. We evaluate 11 open-weight models spanning five VLM families and ranging from 2B to 38B parameters. We find that models are robust to these modifications: most show no significant drop in accuracy, and compared to prior work on review-score manipulation, verification appears far more stable. However, consistent probability shifts do occur. Hedging-oriented conditions produce significant shifts across nearly all models, while boosting conditions show a weaker effect and general polishing conditions (e.g., grammar correction, fluency improvement) have little effect.

AI.tldr: 研究考察LLM风格性改写对多模态主张验证的影响，发现模型准确率总体稳健，但存在一致的概率偏移，尤以对冲类改写最显著。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的文本常带有风格变化，但这类风格偏移如何影响模型在科学任务上的判断尚缺乏系统研究，尤其在与科学证据验证相关的多模态场景中。
AI.method: 针对多模态主张验证任务（判断文本主张是否被给定证据支持），采用两种改写策略：自然改写（模拟研究者用LLM润色学术文本）与受控注入（插入单个LLM关联词以隔离词汇选择效应）；评测11个开放权重模型，覆盖5个VLM家族，参数规模2B至38B。
AI.result: 模型对改写总体稳健：多数模型准确率无显著下降，相较以往关于审稿评分操纵的研究，验证任务稳定性更高；但仍出现一致的概率偏移。对冲导向条件在几乎所有模型上产生显著偏移，提升条件效应较弱，通用润色条件（如语法纠正、流畅度提升）影响甚微。
AI.conclusion: 多模态主张验证对LLM风格改写具有较强鲁棒性，但并非完全免疫：风格因素主要影响模型置信度/概率分布而非最终判定；其中对冲类语言是引发系统性偏移的关键因素，提示在评估与部署中需关注词汇层面的风格敏感性。

title: Proprioceptive Sketches as Long-Horizon Intent for Generative Action Policies
summary: Generative robot policies predict short action chunks but lack explicit long-horizon intent. Recent methods expose longer-horizon structure through language plans, subgoal images, or video forecasts, which are costly to generate and still need to be translated into robot motion. Predicting future robot motions avoids this translation, but a dense, time-indexed trajectory requires numerous parameters to cover the full remaining task, and over a short horizon it largely repeats the action chunk and adds little guidance for action generation. We propose Proprioceptive Action Models (PAM), which jointly generate a compact, timing-free sketch of the robot's remaining joint-space path and a dense executable action chunk within a single transformer denoiser. The sketch parameterizes the path by arc length rather than time, capturing geometric intent invariant to execution timing. Block-causal attention and a staggered denoising schedule maintain directed sketch-to-action dependence, ensuring the action tokens condition on a progressively cleaner sketch throughout sampling. In simulation, PAM improves over its action-only counterparts on Push-T and LIBERO-Long; on four real-world bimanual tasks, it raises success from 47.5% to 75.0%. Project page: https://nicehiro.github.io/pam_dp/

AI.tldr: 本文提出本体感受动作模型（PAM），在单一transformer去噪器中联合生成机器人剩余关节空间路径的紧凑、无时间索引的草图与稠密可执行动作块，从而以低成本方式引入长时程意图。
AI.motivation: 生成式机器人策略只预测短动作块，缺乏显式长时程意图。现有方法用语言规划、子目标图像或视频预测暴露长时程结构，但生成成本高且仍需翻译为机器人运动。直接预测未来机器人运动可省去翻译，但稠密、按时间索引的轨迹需要大量参数覆盖剩余任务，且短时程上基本重复动作块，对动作生成指导有限。
AI.method: PAM在单个transformer去噪器中联合生成两部分：机器人剩余关节空间路径的紧凑、无时间（timing-free）草图，以及稠密可执行动作块。草图以弧长而非时间参数化路径，捕捉与执行时序无关的几何意图。采用块因果注意力（block-causal attention）与错开去噪调度（staggered denoising schedule），维持从草图到动作的有向依赖，使动作token在整个采样过程中条件于逐步变清晰的草图。
AI.result: 在仿真中，PAM在Push-T与LIBERO-Long上优于仅动作的对照方法；在四个真实世界双臂任务上，成功率从47.5%提升至75.0%。
AI.conclusion: 以弧长参数化的无时间草图作为长时程意图表示，并与稠密动作块联合去噪生成，是一种有效且低成本的机器人策略增强方式，可显著提升长时程操作任务的成功率。

title: Does Every User Need a Private LoRA? Decoupling Personalization from Per-User Adaptation
comment: 10 pages main content, 36 pages total including appendix, 7 figures
summary: Personalized large language models often require a complete adaptation state for each user. However, this paradigm scales poorly as the user population grows. We revisit this design through the lens of personalization capacity allocation: how much adaptation capacity can be shared across users, how the shared capacity should be composed, and how much must remain user-specific. We answer them through three complementary empirical analyses.
