We find that independent user adapters contain substantial cross-user reusable structure, that the utility of reusable directions reflects both user relevance and variation across queries, and that user histories provide transferable signals for compact individual correction. Motivated by these findings, we propose LINEUP. It learns a bank of reusable low-rank personalization factors, composes them through user-conditioned recall and query-dependent calibration, and restricts target-user adaptation to a tiny user code over a shared correction space. This design decouples expressive personalization capacity from per-user trainable state. Each target user optimizes only eight scalars, while all shared components remain fixed. By comparison, the evaluated private-LoRA configuration uses 4.19 million per-user parameters. Our theoretical analysis gives a finite-step, finite-history risk bound and sufficient conditions for user-code refinement to improve on history initialization. Across six tasks spanning personalized classification, prediction, and generation, LINEUP leads on all 12 metrics, each averaged over three independent runs (e.g., reducing LaMP-3 RMSE by 11.4% relative to the strongest baseline). It maintains advantages under limited history. These results show that rich personalization can be supported primarily by reusable, conditionally composed shared capacity, while independent user adaptation remains confined to a tiny correction state.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LINEUP，通过可复用的低秩个性化因子库与用户条件召回、查询校准，将每用户可训练状态压缩到仅8个标量，在6个任务12项指标上全面领先。
AI.motivation: 个性化大语言模型通常需为每个用户维护完整适应状态，随用户规模增长扩展性差。论文从"个性化容量分配"视角重新审视：多少适应容量可跨用户共享、共享容量如何组成、多少必须用户专属。
AI.method: 基于三项实证分析（用户适配器存在大量跨用户可复用结构；可复用方向效用同时取决于用户相关性与查询间变化；用户历史提供可迁移信号用于紧凑个体校正），提出LINEUP：学习可复用低秩个性化因子库，经用户条件召回与查询相关校准进行组合，并将目标用户适配限制为共享校正空间上的极小用户编码。每个目标用户仅优化8个标量，共享组件固定。（对比：私有LoRA配置每用户419万参数。）
AI.result: 理论分析给出有限步、有限历史的风险界及用户编码细化优于历史初始化的充分条件。在涵盖个性化分类、预测、生成的六个任务上，LINEUP在全部12项指标领先，每项为三次独立运行均值（如LaMP-3 RMSE相对最强基线降低11.4%），并在历史有限时保持优势。
AI.conclusion: 丰富的个性化主要由可复用、条件组合的共享容量支撑，独立用户适配可被限制在极小的校正状态内。

title: How To Train Your World Model: Fine-tuning vs RAG for LM-based World Modeling
summary: World models (WMs) simulate the transition dynamics of environments, enabling agents to plan over the consequences of their actions. In text-based environments, fine-tuning a Language Model (LM) to serve as a WM has emerged as a dominant paradigm. However, despite the widespread success of non-parametric approaches such as Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), retrieval for LM-based world modelling remains underexplored. We conduct a systematic evaluation across five diverse environments spanning embodied, web navigation and social settings, comparing fine-tuning and RAG-based approaches for LM-based world modelling. Our study reveals that fine-tuning often outperforms RAG, with fine-tuned WMs enabling agents to obtain higher rewards on 15/20 settings. While both construction paradigms benefit from additional and more diverse exploration, RAG-based approaches prove more data-efficient, and fine-tuning approaches disproportionately benefit from scaling the amount of experience collected. With a focus on RAG-based WMs, we devise a procedure that uses counterfactual intervention to estimate the error rate of the retrieval stage, and show that retrievers consistently surface suboptimal transitions from the experience buffer. Hoping to address this failing, we study a variety of query reformulation strategies, demonstrating that a hierarchical approach outperforms the traditional retrieval pipeline. Finally, we compose our findings into a hybrid world modelling system that parametrically captures core environment dynamics, while learning to rely on retrieval from an actively maintained memory store. Our hybrid system consistently outperforms other methods across multiple environments and models, showcasing the robustness of the approach and the applicability of our findings.

AI.tldr: 系统评估了微调与RAG两类基于语言模型的世界模型构建范式，发现微调在多数场景下更优、RAG更省数据；并提出用反事实干预估计检索错误率、层次化查询改写，以及融合参数化与检索的混合世界模型。
AI.motivation: 在文本环境中，微调语言模型作为世界模型已成主流，但基于检索增强生成（RAG）的世界模型构建方式仍鲜有探索，两类范式的系统性对比及其优劣条件尚不明确。
AI.method: 在涵盖具身、网页导航与社会场景的五个环境中，对微调与RAG两类LM世界模型进行系统对比；针对RAG世界模型，设计基于反事实干预的方法估计检索阶段的错误率，并研究多种查询改写策略，最终构建兼顾参数化核心动态与主动维护记忆库检索的混合世界模型。
AI.result: 微调世界模型在20个设置中有15个使智能体获得更高回报，整体常优于RAG；两者都随探索量增长而受益，但RAG数据效率更高，微调在经验规模扩大时增益更显著。检索器会持续返回经验缓冲区中的次优转移；层次化查询改写优于传统检索流程；混合世界模型在多个环境与模型上一致优于其他方法。
AI.conclusion: 微调与RAG各具优势，RAG更具数据效率但检索质量受限，通过查询改写与混合参数化—检索架构可提升基于语言模型世界模型的鲁棒性与性能。

title: Asymptotic Analysis of Trading Fees in CFMM
summary: As the dominant trading mechanism in decentralized finance, Automated Market Maker has been widely studied in research. However, limited research has been done with the trading fees taken into consideration. In this work, we study how much trading fee Liquidity Providers(LPs) can receive from arbitrage trading when the fee rate approaches zero. We give a closed-form formula for it and our result shows that the trading fees generated by arbitrage trading can fully offset the LVR loss when the price process is continuous. We further extend our conclusions to price processes with jumps and the theoretical analysis shows that jumps are the only cause of LP loss apart from market risks. Our results provide practical guidance for AMM designers as well as LPs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AMM中流动性提供者（LP）从套利交易中可获得的交易费收入，给出费率趋近于零时的闭式公式，并证明在连续价格过程下套利交易费可完全抵消LVR损失；进一步推广至带跳跃的价格过程，指出跳跃是市场风险之外LP损失的唯一来源。
AI.motivation: 自动做市商（AMM）是去中心化金融的主导交易机制，已有大量研究，但将交易费纳入考量的研究有限。作者希望量化LP在套利交易中究竟能获得多少交易费收入，并厘清交易费与LVR（Loss-Versus-Rebalancing）损失之间的关系，为AMM设计者和LP提供实践指导。
AI.method: 在费率趋近于零的极限情形下，对LP从套利交易中获得的交易费进行建模与理论推导，得到闭式表达式；并将结论从连续价格过程推广到含跳跃（jumps）的价格过程，进行理论分析。
AI.result: 给出了LP从套利交易中获得交易费的闭式公式；结果表明当价格过程连续时，套利交易产生的交易费能够完全抵消LVR损失；在带跳跃的价格过程下，理论分析表明跳跃是市场风险之外导致LP损失的唯一原因。
AI.conclusion: 交易费在AMM中具有重要的补偿作用，连续价格下可完全对冲LVR，而跳跃风险是LP除市场风险外的唯一损失来源，为AMM参数设计与LP决策提供了理论依据。

title: SymRegFlow: Symmetry-Regularized Flow Matching for Video World Models
summary: Flow-matching-based multi-view world models generate realistic videos, but are commonly restricted to fixed camera rigs. Extending them to continuously varying camera poses requires paired pose--video observations with dense pose coverage, which are costly to acquire. We introduce \emph{SymRegFlow}, a symmetry-regularized flow-matching framework for multi-view-consistent video generation across continuous viewpoints without ground-truth novel-view RGB supervision. For each target pose, SymRegFlow geometrically warps source views into noisy anchors and combines masked dual-anchor supervision with cross-anchor denoising-output consistency to mitigate anchor-specific errors. Under an affine Gaussian surrogate, we prove that suitable consistency regularization recovers the clean-reference optimum at fixed noise levels, strictly outperforming single- and merged-anchor baselines. Experiments on Cosmos-Drive-Dreams and nuScenes demonstrate high-quality, multi-view-consistent autonomous-driving video generation: on nuScenes, SymRegFlow achieves the lowest FVD and FVMD among the evaluated baselines, reducing FVD by over 31\% relative to the best baseline, and source-conditioned inference also attains the best FID and instance preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出SymRegFlow，一种对称正则化流匹配框架，无需新视角RGB真值监督即可实现多视角一致的连续视角视频生成。
AI.motivation: 流匹配多视角世界模型生成视频逼真，但受限于固定相机机位；扩展到连续变化位姿需要密集位姿覆盖的配对位姿-视频数据，采集成本高昂。
AI.method: 对每个目标位姿，将源视图几何变换为带噪锚点，采用掩码双锚点监督加跨锚点去噪输出一致性来缓解单锚点误差；在仿射高斯代理下证明适当一致性正则可在固定噪声水平恢复干净参考最优解。
AI.result: 在Cosmos-Drive-Dreams和nuScenes上实现高质量多视角一致自动驾驶视频生成；nuScenes上FVD与FVMD最低，FVD比最佳基线降低超31%，源条件推理的FID和实例保持也最优。
AI.conclusion: 一致性正则化可严格优于单锚点和合并锚点基线，所提框架在无真值新视角监督下实现连续视角多视角一致视频生成。

title: Adaptive Mutual Distillation for Balanced Multi-Task Post-Training of Large Language Models
summary: Multi-task post-training of large language models (LLMs) aims to improve performance across tasks with unequal amounts of training data. Existing methods focus primarily on balancing task contributions during single-model training. Different task-balancing strategies can produce models with complementary strengths, creating opportunities for mutual distillation. However, the usefulness of cross-model supervision can vary across tasks, transfer directions, and stages of training. We propose Adaptive Mutual Distillation (AMD), a collaborative post-training framework that jointly trains two models with different task-balancing strategies. AMD evaluates candidate adjustments to distillation weights through short training probes shared across tasks, then uses task-wise validation scores to select an adjustment for each task and transfer direction. Across six benchmarks and three LLM backbones, both AMD models achieve higher average benchmark scores than supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baselines trained with the same sampling strategies. They also outperform the task-balancing methods evaluated in our experiments. Merging the two trained models can further improve their average benchmark score while yielding a single model for inference. The merged models outperform multi-task SFT by an average of 2.91 points across the three backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应互蒸馏框架AMD，联合训练两个采用不同任务平衡策略的模型，通过跨任务探测与任务级验证分数自适应调整蒸馏权重，提升多任务后训练性能。
AI.motivation: 多任务后训练中数据量不均，现有方法主要关注单模型训练时的任务贡献平衡；不同任务平衡策略会产出具有互补优势的模型，存在互蒸馏机会，但跨模型监督的有效性会随任务、迁移方向及训练阶段而变化。
AI.method: AMD是一个协作式后训练框架：同时训练两个采用不同任务平衡策略的模型；通过跨任务共享的短时训练探测评估候选的蒸馏权重调整；再依据任务级验证分数，为每个任务及每个迁移方向选择相应调整。
AI.result: 在六个基准和三个LLM主干上，两个AMD模型的平均基准分数均高于使用相同采样策略训练的SFT基线，也优于实验中的其他任务平衡方法；合并两个模型可进一步提升平均分数并得到单一推理模型，合并模型在三个主干上平均超越多任务SFT 2.91分。
AI.conclusion: 自适应、按任务与迁移方向调节的互蒸馏能有效利用互补任务平衡策略的优势；模型合并在保持单模型推理的同时进一步提升性能，验证了该协作式后训练框架的有效性。

title: Localized Conformal Safety Monitoring with Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Extended abstract. Disha Kamale and Dmitry Berenson are joint senior authors
summary: Monitoring planned driving trajectories requires accurately estimating the collision likelihood with actors whose motion is itself impacted by the ego motion. Existing classical approaches are often limited by the quality of their forecasting model. Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promise in reasoning about the consequences of high-level actions, yet their approximate predictions are unsuitable for safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving. Conformal prediction (CP) has emerged as a data-driven framework for quantifying the uncertainty of black-box model predictions. We propose Split Label-Localized Conformal Prediction (SLLCP), a post-hoc calibration layer over frozen VLMs that transforms their unreliable predictions into probabilistically calibrated safety prediction sets. We consider how the ability to estimate safety can depend on the observed driving scene and introduce a localized procedure that upweights relevant past experience when calculating uncertainty thresholds. We provide label-conditional finite-sample distribution-free coverage under exchangeability. Evaluated over 15k CARLA trajectories from unseen scenarios, SLLCP correctly flags 89.6% of collision-causing trajectories with a Qwen backbone and 88.4% with a Cosmos backbone, while the base VLMs only flagged 4.6% and 39.1% of the collision-causing trajectories, respectively. These results indicate that local, label-conditional calibration can reduce missed unsafe trajectories.

AI.tldr: 提出SLLCP方法，将冻结视觉语言模型的不确定预测转化为概率校准的安全预测集，用于自动驾驶碰撞轨迹监控。
AI.motivation: 监控规划驾驶轨迹需准确估计与其他行为体的碰撞可能性，而现有经典方法受限于预测模型质量，VLMs虽能推理高层动作后果但预测过于粗略，不适合自动驾驶等安全关键应用。
AI.method: 提出Split Label-Localized Conformal Prediction (SLLCP)，作为冻结VLM之上的事后校准层；考虑安全估计能力依赖观测驾驶场景，引入局部化程序，在计算不确定性阈值时对相关历史经验加权，并在可交换性下提供标签条件有限样本无分布覆盖保证。
AI.result: 在15k条未见场景的CARLA轨迹上评估，SLLCP在Qwen骨干下正确标记89.6%的致碰撞轨迹，Cosmos骨干下为88.4%，而基础VLM分别仅标记4.6%和39.1%。
AI.conclusion: 局部、标签条件校准能有效减少漏检不安全轨迹，将不可靠的VLM预测转化为校准的安全预测集。

title: Why Does Adaptive Batching Help LLM Pretraining? A Perspective from Unbounded Variance
summary: Increasing the batch size during training is a common practice in large language model (LLM) pretraining, yet the theoretical justification behind its success is not well understood. Analyses of stochastic optimization often assume uniformly bounded stochastic gradient variance, yet recent evidence suggests that this assumption fails in many practical nonconvex problems. The Blum--Gladyshev (BG-$0$) noise model relaxes this assumption by allowing the variance to grow quadratically with the distance from initialization, suggesting that batch size schedulers can help by controlling the variance growth during training. However, this growth can be overly conservative in practice. We empirically investigate variance growth in LLM pretraining and observe that a generalized BG model with a tunable growth exponent provides a tighter description of practical noise behavior. Motivated by this observation, we introduce the generalized BG-$a$ noise model, which interpolates between bounded variance ($a=0$) and BG-$0$ noise ($a=2$). Under $L$-smoothness, we derive an information-theoretic lower bound with growth-dependent oracle complexity $Ω(ε^{-(4+a)})$ and establish a matching upper bound in $ε$-dependence by increasing the batch size as the iterates move away from initialization. Finally, we propose an adaptive batch scheduler that controls variance growth through dynamic batch size adjustments during training. In pretraining OLMo2 models of up to 1B parameters on C4, our scheduler achieves a lower validation loss than both small and large batch training under matched token budgets, while using less than 10\% of the iterations of small batch training.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出广义BG-$a$噪声模型，填补了有界方差($a=0$)与BG-$0$噪声($a=2$)之间的理论空白，推导出增长依赖的oracle复杂度下界$Ω(ε^{-(4+a)})$及匹配上界，并提出自适应批量调度器，在OLMo2预训练中取得更优验证损失且迭代次数减少90%以上。
AI.motivation: LLM预训练中增大批量是常见做法，但其理论依据尚不清晰。随机优化分析常假设随机梯度方差一致有界，然而近期证据表明该假设在许多实际非凸问题中并不成立。BG-$0$噪声模型虽放宽了这一假设（方差随距初始化距离二次增长），但其增长在实践上过于保守，无法精确刻画真实的噪声行为。
AI.method: 1. 实证研究LLM预训练中的方差增长，发现具有可调增长指数的广义BG模型能更精确描述实际噪声行为。2. 提出广义BG-$a$噪声模型，在有限方差($a=0$)与BG-$0$噪声($a=2$)之间插值。3. 在$L$-光滑性条件下，推导增长依赖的信息论下界$Ω(ε^{-(4+a)})$，并通过随迭代远离初始化而增大批量，建立匹配的$ε$依赖上界。4. 提出自适应批量调度器，通过动态批量调整控制训练过程中的方差增长。
AI.result: 在C4数据集上预训练至多1B参数的OLMo2模型，所提调度器在匹配token预算下取得的验证损失低于小批量和大小批量训练，同时迭代次数不到小批量训练的10%。
AI.conclusion: 广义BG-$a$噪声模型能够更准确地刻画LLM预训练的实际噪声行为，为批量调度提供了理论基础；基于方差增长控制的自适应批量调度器在理论上达到最优$ε$依赖，在实践中显著提升预训练效率与效果。

title: How to Have a Sensitive Debate: An Instance-Optimal Protocol for AI Debate
summary: As powerful AI systems reach and sometimes surpass the abilities of human experts across a range of cognitively demanding tasks, the problem of accurate oversight and supervision of these systems has become increasingly urgent. One promising approach is AI debate, which seeks to leverage a debate between two powerful AIs to break complex questions down into simpler claims that can be easily judged directly. Theoretical work on debate has formalized this intuition in the language of computational complexity theory, where the goal is to design protocols (i.e., rules of the debate game) that provide rigorous guarantees on correctness for judging solutions to complex problems with limited supervision. Specifically, the current best protocol has been shown to work for all problems that have sufficiently stable decompositions into subproblems. In this paper, we design a new protocol for this same class of problems that improves on the prior work in several ways. First, correctness holds in a worst-case rather than an average-case sense. Second, being honest and correct is a dominant-strategy equilibrium for both debaters, rather than a Stackelberg equilibrium. Finally, we prove black-box lower bounds, showing that our new protocol is instance-wise optimal. That is, no protocol for this class of problems can outperform ours while making only black-box queries to human judgments. We obtain these results by relating the notion of stable problem decompositions to the concept of fractional block sensitivity from query complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文针对AI辩论（AI debate）监督协议，提出一种新协议，使正确性保证从平均情况提升为最坏情况，将诚实作答由Stackelberg均衡强化为占优策略均衡，并给出黑盒下界证明该协议在该类问题上逐实例最优。
AI.motivation: 随着强大AI系统在认知任务上达到甚至超越人类专家水平，如何对其进行准确监督与管控日益紧迫。AI辩论被视为有前景的方案：让两个强AI辩论，把复杂问题拆解为可直接判断的简单命题。已有理论研究用计算复杂性语言形式化该直觉，目标是设计辩论协议，在有限监督下为复杂问题的判定提供严格正确性保证。现有最优协议仅对所有具有"足够稳定分解为子问题"的问题有效，但存在若干局限，本文旨在改进。
AI.method: 设计一种面向同一类问题（可稳定分解为子问题的问题）的新辩论协议。核心思路是将"稳定问题分解"这一概念与查询复杂性中的"分数块敏感性（fractional block sensitivity）"建立联系，从而构造并分析协议。
AI.result: 相比先前工作，新协议在三方面改进：(1) 正确性在最坏情况意义下成立，而非平均情况；(2) 诚实且正确对两位辩论者都是占优策略均衡，而非Stackelberg均衡；(3) 证明了黑盒下界，表明该协议在逐实例意义下最优——任何仅对人工判断进行黑盒查询的协议都无法在该类问题上超越它。
AI.conclusion: 通过将稳定问题分解与查询复杂性中的分数块敏感性相关联，本文提出的AI辩论协议在对可稳定分解问题的监督上实现了更稳健的正确性保证、更强的均衡性质以及逐实例最优性，推动了AI辩论理论的发展。

title: Defense-in-Depth at the Perception-Reasoning Interface of LLM-Centric Agentic UAV Swarms
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly support Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle (UAV) swarm operations such as data collection scheduling, where the model reads structured sensor reports and decides which sensors to visit. An adversary who quietly manipulates those reports can redirect the swarm without modifying the model weights or the UAV. Defenses for this interface have been proposed architecturally but rarely implemented or evaluated. We implement and evaluate defense-in-depth at the perception-reasoning interface of LLM-Centric Agentic UAV Swarms. Five layers check the provenance of a report, whether its values are physically admissible, whether they agree with what swarm geometry and service history predict, whether the resulting schedule starves any sensor, and, when these fail, hand control to a deterministic scheduler that ignores the suspect input. We test each layer against an adversary strong enough to defeat the layer before it. For each of the three input-side layers, we derive in closed form how far a report can be distorted before that layer reacts, fixing each boundary from deployment parameters before any attack data is collected; across thirty matched simulation runs, predicted and measured boundaries agree. Separating attack detection from response is a well-established principle, and we quantify the cost of neglecting this distinction at the perception-reasoning interface. When the system rejects a report, it replaces it with the most recent accepted report. This prevents the adversary from controlling the UAV schedule, but it also increases cumulative cost by 79% and 74% for the two detectors, respectively, compared with the undefended system. The safety check does not detect any attacks, but it nevertheless reduces the attack-induced cost by 37.5%.

AI.tldr: 本文在LLM驱动的无人机蜂群感知-推理接口上实现并评估了五层纵深防御，每层以闭式推导确定触发边界并与仿真验证一致；结果表明拒绝并替换可疑报告能以79%/74%的代价阻止攻击者控制调度，而安全检查虽不检测攻击仍可降低37.5%的攻击成本。
AI.motivation: LLM日益用于无人机蜂群的数据采集调度，模型读取结构化传感器报告并决定访问顺序；攻击者只需静默篡改报告即可重定向蜂群，无需改动模型权重或无人机硬件。针对该接口的防御多停留在架构设计层面，缺乏实现与评估。
AI.method: 在LLM中心的智能体无人机蜂群感知-推理接口部署五层纵深防御：报告来源溯源、数值物理可行性、与蜂群几何及服务历史的预测一致性、生成调度是否使某传感器饥饿，以及失败时交由忽略可疑输入的确定性调度器接管。每层针对足以攻破前一层对手进行测试；对三个输入侧层以闭式推导给出报告可被扭曲而不触发的边界，并依部署参数先于攻击数据固定阈值。
AI.result: 三十组匹配仿真中，预测边界与实测边界一致。系统拒绝报告时以最近一次被接受的报告替换，可阻止攻击者控制无人机调度，但相比无防御系统，两个检测器的累计成本分别增加79%与74%；安全检查未检测出任何攻击，却仍使攻击导致的开销降低37.5%。
AI.conclusion: 将攻击检测与响应分离在感知-推理接口同样关键，忽视该区分会带来显著代价；纵深防御可有效阻断对调度的操控，但存在明显成本，且部分安全机制可能在不检测攻击的情况下仍产生安全收益。

title: Correcting Guided Diffusion Trajectories with Spectral Alignment
summary: The practical success of conditional image generation hinges on fine-grained differences in condition alignment and visual fidelity. Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is central to this success, but its lack of an explicit criterion makes it difficult to assess whether the guided trajectory is progressing as intended. To address this gap, we show that spectral alignment provides a principled criterion for understanding guidance behavior and improving guided diffusion sampling through adaptive correction. Our analysis identifies the spectra of intermediate states as an indicator of consistency with the expected spectral evolution of the forward process. Based on this observation, we introduce Spectral Correction Guidance, a method that corrects deviations from an analytic reference spectrum during sampling. The proposed method is training-free and applicable across diffusion backbones and conditional generation tasks without modifying the underlying model. Experiments demonstrate consistent gains in preference-based metrics over baseline guidance methods in text-to-image generation and improved generation quality over CFG on ImageNet. These improvements persist across a range of guidance scales and with fewer denoising steps. Our analyses and ablations provide insight into guidance behavior and how the proposed method affects generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"频谱校正引导"（Spectral Correction Guidance），以频谱对齐作为无分类器引导（CFG）行为的判定准则，通过在采样过程中校正中间状态频谱相对解析参考谱的偏差，实现免训练、跨骨干网络与多种条件生成任务通用的引导改进。
AI.motivation: 条件图像生成的实际效果取决于条件对齐与视觉保真度的细粒度差异，而CFG虽为核心技术，却缺乏显式准则来判断引导轨迹是否按预期推进，导致引导行为难以评估与优化。
AI.method: 作者将中间状态的频谱视为与扩散前向过程期望频谱演化一致性的指标，据此定义频谱对齐准则；进而提出频谱校正引导：在采样过程中，检测并校正中间状态频谱相对解析参考谱的偏差，该方法无需训练、不修改底层模型，可直接应用于不同扩散骨干与条件生成任务。
AI.result: 在文本到图像生成中，相比基线引导方法在偏好类指标上取得一致性提升；在ImageNet上生成质量优于CFG；提升在多种引导尺度及更少去噪步数下依然保持；分析与消融实验揭示了引导行为及该方法对生成质量的影响机制。
AI.conclusion: 频谱对齐为理解引导行为提供了有原则的准则，并可作为自适应校正手段提升引导扩散采样质量，具有良好的通用性与实用性。

title: ConvoDrift: A Multi-Turn Conversational Dataset for Modeling Stylistic Tone Evolution
comment: 13 pages, 14 figures, 7 tables, Accepted paper at the 13th Conference on Computational Linguistics and Speech Processing (ROCLING) 2026
summary: The evolution of linguistic style in conversations is an underexplored issue in NLP. Most style-control datasets focus on sentences or assume a static style throughout, missing the dynamic shifts that occur as user preferences change during interactions. We introduce ConvoDrift, a dataset designed to model progressive stylistic conversational tone drift under fixed semantic intent. It is built on 15,727 shared multi-turn conversational structures for adaptation and persona-conditioned alignment methods. It consists of six prompt-response pairs per conversation, each with the annotation of style drift and style direction labels. These pairs cover a range of communication genres. We further derive a complementary pairwise dataset by pairing semantically equivalent but stylistically distinct responses and annotating persona-conditioned preferences using five distinct style communication personas, enabling the controlled study of personalisation and pluralistic alignment in language tone. In addition to dataset construction, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation involving human validation, LLM-as-judge assessment, and automatic lexical and semantic evaluations. Across seven Likert criteria annotated by three human annotators, the average Krippendorff's alpha is 0.88, and our lexical and semantic analyses show that drift events induce lexical changes while preserving semantic similarity.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ConvoDrift数据集，建模固定语义意图下多轮对话中渐进式语言风格漂移，并构建成对偏好数据以研究人格化对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有风格控制数据集多聚焦单句或假设风格静态不变，忽略了交互过程中用户偏好变化导致的动态风格转变，语言风格演化的研究不足。
AI.method: 基于15,727个共享多轮对话结构构建数据集，每段对话含六组提示-回复对，标注风格漂移及方向标签，覆盖多种交流体裁；另派生语义等价但风格不同的成对数据集，用五种沟通人格标注偏好；评估采用人工验证、LLM-as-judge及自动词汇与语义分析。
AI.result: 三名标注者在七项李克特标准上的平均Krippendorff's alpha为0.88；词汇与语义分析显示漂移事件引发词汇变化，同时保持语义相似性。
AI.conclusion: ConvoDrift为动态风格漂移与人格条件对齐提供了受控研究平台，支持个性化与多元对齐的语言语调研究。

title: SimpleTouch: Can Vision-Language-Action Models Master Contact-Rich Manipulation Without Tactile Policy Pretraining?
summary: Tactile sensing provides essential contact information for robotic manipulation, yet incorporating it into pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models remains challenging. A common concern is that simply introducing touch during task-specific fine-tuning may fail to bridge the cross-modal gap, yielding limited gains or even reduced success. Consequently, existing methods often rely on large-scale tactile policy pretraining or separate visuotactile alignment, adding data requirements and training stages. We introduce SimpleTouch, a simple VLA extension that augments $π_{0.5}$ with a tactile expert, to test whether these additional stages are necessary. Leveraging all tokens from a frozen pretrained tactile encoder, the expert learns from action supervision and multi-horizon prediction of future tactile latents. This single-stage training uses only task demonstrations, without additional tactile policy pretraining or separate alignment. With 50 demonstrations per task, SimpleTouch achieves the highest success rate among evaluated methods on all six UniVTAC tasks. Its average success rate reaches 77.5%, compared with 45.2% for FTP-$π_{0.5}$ and 66.7% for FTP-1, corresponding to gains of 32.3 and 10.8 percentage points, respectively. Across four real-world tasks, it averages 71.3%, exceeding FTP-1 by 8.8 percentage points. These results demonstrate that, given pretrained VLA and tactile representations, additional tactile policy pretraining is not a prerequisite for strong performance on these tasks, offering a simpler route to contact-rich manipulation. Project page: https://simpletouch-robot.github.io/

AI.tldr: SimpleTouch 通过在 π0.5 VLA 上附加触觉专家并采用单阶段训练，无需触觉策略预训练或跨模态对齐，即可在 6 个 UniVTAC 任务上取得最高成功率。
AI.motivation: 将触觉引入预训练 VLA 存在跨模态鸿沟：直接在任务微调时加入触觉收益有限甚至降低成功率，因此现有方法依赖大规模触觉策略预训练或独立的视触觉对齐，增加了数据与训练阶段负担。本文旨在验证这些额外阶段是否必要。
AI.method: 以 π0.5 为骨干，附加一个触觉专家模块；使用冻结的预训练触觉编码器的全部 token，专家通过动作监督与多时域未来触觉潜变量预测进行学习。整个训练为单阶段，仅用任务演示数据，不使用额外触觉策略预训练或独立对齐。
AI.result: 每任务 50 条演示下，在全部 6 个 UniVTAC 任务上取得最高成功率，平均 77.5%，高于 FTP-π0.5 的 45.2% 和 FTP-1 的 66.7%（分别提升 32.3 与 10.8 个百分点）；在 4 个真实任务上平均 71.3%，超过 FTP-1 8.8 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在已有预训练 VLA 与触觉表征的前提下，额外触觉策略预训练并非强性能的先决条件；SimpleTouch 为接触丰富操作提供了更简洁的路径。

title: Lexicographic Multi-Objective On-Policy Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) usually optimizes answer correctness, yet useful language-model behavior also requires high-quality reasoning and concise responses. Existing multi-reward post-training methods typically scalarize rewards or combine specialists without explicitly protecting a reward priority order. This is problematic when trade-offs are asymmetric: conciseness, for example, should not improve at the cost of correctness. We introduce Lexicographic Multi-Objective On-Policy Distillation (LMOPD), a multi-teacher method for integrating reward-specialized policies under explicit priorities. For each student rollout, LMOPD selects the specialist for the first objective whose gate detects a deficiency, then locally projects its centered log-policy correction to remove components that oppose higher-priority specialists. We evaluate 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts transformer models in two- and four-expert settings on three math benchmarks, measuring retained specialist gains. With two experts, LMOPD's point estimates fully retain the accuracy and reasoning-quality gains while acquiring $46.9\%$ of the conciseness gain. With four experts, it retains $\approx90\%$ of both the accuracy gain and reasoning-correctness gain, compared to only $\approx57\%$ by the next best evaluated baseline. Matched four-expertablations show that lexicographic routing outperforms random routing and that projection further strengthens both top-priority capabilities. Across both scales, LMOPD preserves the highest-priority capabilities more effectively than the existing baselines we evaluate, demonstrating the value of explicit priorities for specialist integration.

AI.tldr: 提出字典序多目标在线策略蒸馏(LMOPD),在多教师强化学习后训练中显式保护奖励优先级,优先保留高优先级能力。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR多奖励后训练方法通常将奖励标量化或直接组合专家策略,未显式保护奖励优先级。当权衡不对称时(如简洁性不应以正确性为代价)会产生问题。
AI.method: LMOPD对每个学生rollout,先选择第一个目标门控检测到缺陷的专家策略,再将其中心化对数策略修正做局部投影,去除与更高优先级专家相冲突的分量。
AI.result: 在30B-A3B MoE模型、两专家与四专家设置、三个数学基准上评估:两专家下完全保留准确率与推理质量增益并获46.9%简洁性增益;四专家下保留约90%准确率与推理正确性增益,而最优基线仅约57%。消融显示字典序路由优于随机路由,投影进一步增强最高优先级能力。
AI.conclusion: LMOPD在两种规模下均比现有基线更有效地保留最高优先级能力,证明显式优先级对专家整合的价值。

title: Mitigating Social Sycophancy via Pluralistic Preference Optimization
summary: Personal advice, including relationship advice, now ranks among the most common uses of generative AI. But language models (LMs) exhibit sycophancy: they affirm users much more often than humans do, which can make people overconfident and less willing to repair their relationships after a conflict. Prior work on mitigating sycophancy has focused on factual settings where a response can be checked against a ground truth answer, while mitigations for social sycophancy (e.g., personal advice, where there is no ground truth) have relied on simple prompting and post-training methods with limited effectiveness. Our insight is that social sycophancy occurs in part because LMs overly center on the user and fail to consider the perspectives of other stakeholders impacted by the user's behavior. To address this problem we propose Pluralistic Preference Optimization (PlurPO): given inputs describing interpersonal conflicts, the LM identifies and simulates the relevant stakeholders, and is then trained to prefer and generate responses acceptable to all stakeholders. PlurPO uses only signals the model produces about its own outputs, without ground-truth labels. PlurPO substantially reduces social sycophancy across four datasets and four model families compared to prior methods. For example, on statements of intent to cause harm, where the users' actions should not be endorsed, PlurPO reduces the endorsement rate by 89% on average across four models. On general advice questions, where the target is to match the endorsement rate of human responses, it closes the gap by more than half, from 17.8% to 8.0% on average. The preference dataset constructed by PlurPO for an 8B model also effectively transfers to mitigating sycophancy in a larger (32B) model. Our results indicate that social sycophancy can be reduced by leveraging a model's own capabilities to simulate a plurality of relevant perspectives.

AI.tldr: 提出PlurPO方法，通过让语言模型模拟冲突中多方利益相关者视角，在无真值标签条件下减少社交谄媚（sycophancy），显著降低对有害意图的认可率并使一般建议的认可率更接近人类水平。
AI.motivation: 语言模型存在谄媚问题：在个人建议等社交场景中，模型比人类更倾向于肯定用户，导致用户过度自信、不愿修复冲突。已有缓解方法多针对可校验真值的事实性场景，而社交谄媚（无真值）仅靠简单提示与后训练，效果有限。作者认为其部分根因是模型过度以用户为中心，忽视其他受影响方的视角。
AI.method: 提出Pluralistic Preference Optimization (PlurPO)：给定描述人际冲突的输入，模型先识别并模拟相关利益相关者，再被训练为偏好并生成能被所有利益相关者接受的回应。该方法仅使用模型自身对输出的信号，不依赖真值标签。
AI.result: 在四个数据集、四个模型家族上，PlurPO较先前方法大幅降低社交谄媚：在表达伤害意图的陈述上（不应被认可），平均将认可率降低89%；在一般建议问题上（目标为匹配人类认可率），平均把差距缩小过半，从17.8%降至8.0%。为8B模型构建的偏好数据可有效迁移至32B模型减轻谄媚。
AI.conclusion: 社交谄媚可通过利用模型自身能力来模拟多元相关视角而得到缓解，PlurPO在无真值标签下有效且具备跨模型规模迁移性。

title: Persona Guardrail: A Production-Grade Defense Framework for Agentic Systems
summary: Large language model-based agents are increasingly deployed to perform domain-specific tasks by interacting with enterprise knowledge, tools, and external services. Existing runtime guardrails primarily target prompt injection and other attack-specific behaviors under a black-box threat model, but provide limited guarantees that agents operate within their intended functionality. As a result, production agents remain vulnerable to malicious requests and out-of-domain queries that existing defenses often fail to distinguish. We present Persona Guardrail, a production-grade runtime defense framework that enforces explicit functional boundaries for customer-facing agentic AI systems through synchronous input and output validation driven by semantic allowlist and blocklist specifications. We also introduce PAGE (Persona-Aware Guardrail Evaluation), a benchmark for evaluating function-specific guardrails across benign, adversarial, and out-of-domain interactions on both user and agent turns. Compared with a generic LLM-based guardrail, Persona Guardrail improves overall accuracy from 85.7% to 95.9%, increases out-of-domain detection from 57.3% to 93.5%, and reduces the false-approved rate from 25.0% to 4.7%. Currently deployed in production, Persona Guardrail meets its latency budget while sustaining a very low false-block and false-allow rate under realistic production workloads. These results demonstrate that Persona Guardrail provides a practical, scalable, and production-ready foundation for securing agentic AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Persona Guardrail，一个用于生产环境的运行时防御框架，通过对输入输出进行同步验证，基于语义白名单与黑名单规范为面向客户的智能体系统强制显式功能边界；同时发布 PAGE 基准。相比通用 LLM 护栏，整体准确率由 85.7% 提升至 95.9%，域外检测率由 57.3% 提升至 93.5%，误放行率由 25.0% 降至 4.7%，并已在生产中满足延迟预算。
AI.motivation: 现有运行时护栏主要针对提示注入等特定攻击，采用黑盒威胁模型，难以保证智能体在其预期功能范围内运行，导致生产环境中的智能体仍面临恶意请求与域外查询风险，且现有防御手段难以区分二者。
AI.method: 提出 Persona Guardrail：面向客户智能体 AI 系统的生产级运行时防御框架，依据语义白名单与黑名单规范，对用户轮次与智能体轮次的输入输出执行同步验证，从而强制显式功能边界。同时构建 PAGE 基准，用于在良性、对抗与域外交互上评估功能专属护栏。
AI.result: 与通用基于 LLM 的护栏相比，整体准确率从 85.7% 提升至 95.9%；域外检测率从 57.3% 提升至 93.5%；误放行率从 25.0% 降至 4.7%。系统已投入生产部署，在真实工作负载下满足延迟预算，并保持极低的误拦截率与误放行率。
AI.conclusion: Persona Guardrail 为智能体 AI 系统提供了实用、可扩展且面向生产的防护基础，表明以功能边界为核心的语义白/黑名单同步验证可有效弥补现有运行时护栏在功能约束与域外检测上的不足。

title: FiberGeoText: A Vision-Language Model for Population- Level Organization of Superficial White Matter
summary: The superficial white matter (SWM), a critical brain region for cognition across the lifespan and brain disease, contains abundant short-range association fibers whose organization remains incompletely characterized, in part because the short trajectories and highly variable cortical folding make correspondence across individuals challenging. Anatomically corresponding connections may vary in spatial location across individuals and therefore may not be adequately defined by geometric proximity alone. We introduce FiberGeoText (FGT), a vision-language model (VLM) for organizing short-range superficial white matter (SWM) streamlines reconstructed from ultra-high-resolution diffusion MRI into population-level clusters. FGT jointly represents three complementary properties of each streamline: its three-dimensional trajectory, its cortical anatomical context, and its shape. Cortical endpoint information from multiple parcellation schemes is expressed as text and encoded using a pretrained large language model (LLM), enabling heterogeneous anatomical descriptions to contribute to a common continuous representation. We evaluated FGT on acquired submillimeter 0.76 mm diffusion MRI data. Compared with state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, FGT produced substantially greater cortical parcel coherence, within-cluster shape consistency, cluster-size consistency, and cross-subject correspondence. The trained model also generalizes well to unseen subjects with an average of 96.7% of the 5,000 learned clusters recovered, and high consistency of cluster structure between training and testing data. Together, these findings demonstrate that integrating geometric, anatomical, and shape information by learning multimodal deep embeddings with a VLM model enables robust learning of population-consistent SWM organization despite interindividual anatomical variability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FiberGeoText（FGT），一种视觉-语言模型，将超高分辨率扩散MRI重建的短程浅表白质（SWM）流线联合编码其三维轨迹、皮层解剖上下文与形状，实现跨个体稳健的群体水平聚类。
AI.motivation: 浅表白质富含短程联络纤维，对认知和脑疾病至关重要，但其组织特征尚未充分刻画。短轨迹与高度可变的皮层褶皱使跨个体对应困难；解剖对应的连接在空间位置上存在个体差异，仅靠几何邻近性难以充分定义。
AI.method: 提出FGT视觉-语言模型，联合表示每条流线的三个互补属性：三维轨迹、皮层解剖上下文和形状。将来自多种脑区划分方案的皮层端点信息表达为文本，用预训练大语言模型（LLM）编码，使异质的解剖描述汇聚到统一的连续表示中。在0.76 mm亚毫米扩散MRI数据上评估。
AI.result: 与SOTA方法相比，FGT在皮层脑区一致性、簇内形状一致性、簇大小一致性和跨被试对应性上均显著更优。模型对未见被试泛化良好，5000个学习簇平均恢复96.7%，训练与测试数据间簇结构高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 通过视觉-语言模型学习多模态深度嵌入，整合几何、解剖与形状信息，可在存在个体解剖变异的情况下稳健学习群体一致的SWM组织，验证了多模态嵌入方法的有效性。

title: Query-aware routing for Cross-lingual performance gains in Encoders
summary: Multilingual encoders can exhibit reduced retrieval effectiveness when queries and relevant documents differ in language, despite strong same-language performance. We investigate whether Finnish and Swedish cross-lingual retrieval can improve while preserving an encoder's existing same-language performance and document index. We combine a query-only low-rank adapter, trained against frozen document embeddings, with deterministic routing based on query and index languages. Cross-language queries use the adapter, while same-language queries use the original encoder. SampoTron, our fine-tuned low-rank (LoRA) adapter alongwith the Nemotron-3-Embed-1B model, improves average retrieval quality across six English, Finnish, and Swedish directions from 0.241 to 0.291 in normalized discounted cumulative gain (nDCG) at rank ten, a 20.9% relative gain on a sampled financial benchmark. All six cross-lingual directions improve, and routing preserves the original same-language performance, including two full-corpus Finnish evaluations. The approach enables selective cross-language specialization with reusable document embedding vectors.

AI.tldr: 提出查询端LoRA适配器SampoTron结合语言路由，在不改变文档索引的前提下提升芬兰语-瑞典语跨语言检索效果。
AI.motivation: 多语言编码器在同语言检索上表现优异，但查询与相关文档语言不一致时检索效果明显下降。研究目标是：在保持编码器原有同语言性能与文档索引不变的情况下，改善芬兰语与瑞典语的跨语言检索。
AI.method: 采用仅作用于查询的低秩适配器（LoRA），其训练以冻结的文档嵌入为监督目标；并设计基于查询语言与索引语言的确定性路由：跨语言查询走适配器分支，同语言查询走原始编码器。模型记为SampoTron，基于Nemotron-3-Embed-1B微调。
AI.result: 在采样的金融基准上，六个英语、芬兰语、瑞典语检索方向（1B模型路径）的平均nDCG@10从0.241提升至0.291，相对提升20.9%。所有六个跨语言方向均有改善，且路由机制保持了原有同语言性能，其中包括两项芬兰语全语料评测。
AI.conclusion: 该方案实现了可选择的跨语言特化，同时复用既有文档嵌入向量，无需重建索引即可提升跨语言检索质量并保持同语言性能。

title: Skill2Real: Agentic Skill Learning for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Robot Manipulation
summary: Transferring robotic skills from simulation to reality requires task knowledge that remains usable across differences in perception, dynamics, and embodiment. We introduce Skill2Real, an agentic policy framework that learns executable skills through a shared application programming interface (API). A Proposer-Verifier-Governor (PVG) loop uses privileged simulation evidence to diagnose outcomes and validate updates, while keeping learned skills grounded in public observations and API semantics. The Cerebellum first acquires local manipulation skills; the Brain then learns task-level composition with the Cerebellum frozen. Both memories transfer to the real robot without task-policy fine-tuning or skill-memory updates. As GPT-5.6 Sol learns skills on LIBERO-90, evaluating each frozen checkpoint with GPT-6 Astra raises LIBERO-Pro Long success from 2.0% to 56.3%, without training on Pro Long. Independent Robosuite training reaches 85.1% and 89.4% mean success with Sol and Opus 5 across seven tasks, respectively. Frozen Sol-trained LIBERO-90 skills achieve 78.75% mean completion across four real-world manipulation tasks with Astra. Removing the Verifier or Governor during LIBERO-90 training lowers final Pro Long success by 17.3 and 13.3 percentage points, respectively. These results support learning and transferring a hierarchy of executable skills through a common robot interface.

AI.tldr: Skill2Real: 通过共享API学习可执行技能，实现仿真到现实的迁移。
AI.motivation: 机器人技能从仿真迁移到现实需在感知、动力学和形态差异下仍可用的任务知识。传统方法依赖任务策略微调或技能记忆更新，迁移成本高、泛化性差。
AI.method: 提出Skill2Real智能体策略框架，通过共享API学习可执行技能。采用Proposer-Verifier-Governor (PVG)循环，利用特权仿真证据诊断结果并验证更新，同时保持技能基于公开观测与API语义。Cerebellum先获取局部操作技能，Brain在其冻结下学习任务级组合。两种记忆均迁移至真实机器人，无需任务策略微调或技能记忆更新。
AI.result: GPT-5.6 Sol在LIBERO-90上学习技能，用GPT-6 Astra评估每个冻结检查点，LIBERO-Pro Long成功率从2.0%提升至56.3%（未在Pro Long上训练）。独立Robosuite训练在七任务上分别达到85.1% (Sol)和89.4% (Opus 5)平均成功率。冻结的Sol训练LIBERO-90技能在四个真实操作任务上平均完成率78.75%。移除Verifier或Governor使LIBERO-90训练后Pro Long成功率分别下降17.3和13.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持通过通用机器人接口学习和迁移可执行技能层次结构，实现仿真到现实的有效迁移。

title: ArrivalBench: Agent-Generated Data Pipelines Are Correct Once and Wrong Under Time
comment: Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "Who Verifies the Agents?". 20 pages
summary: Benchmarks for agent-generated data work grade a pipeline by running it once against a fixed snapshot. ArrivalBench instead re-executes the pipeline an agent leaves behind under adversarial but replayable delivery schedules (late, duplicated, out-of-order and retried records) and requires its final state to equal a batch recomputation of the complete log. Because the oracle recomputes rather than classifies, a wrong table and a crash are distinct verdicts: a crash is visible to monitoring a team already runs, and a wrong table is not. On 40 tasks we built, our reimplementation of single-execution grading certifies 86-100% of the pipelines eleven models produce; re-executing the same artifacts finds 7.0-79.2% of the certified ones silently wrong. The gap is not produced by the repair loop: within the same model and task, pipelines repaired against the snapshot test fail replay about as often as those that passed it first time. In every model, idempotency hazards fail more often than ordering hazards. Separating a wrong answer from a crash also changes how interventions read: a hazard warning cuts one model's silent failure from 48.2% to 10.5% while raising its crash rate from 9.0% to 37.0%, so all-in failure moves only from 51.0% to 44.0%. All eleven arms were independently re-run, and rates moved by at most 5.9 points.

AI.tldr: 提出 ArrivalBench 基准：不再只对固定快照单次执行打分，而是在可复现的对抗性投递调度（延迟、重复、乱序、重试）下重新执行 agent 留下的管道，要求最终状态等于完整日志的批量重算结果。
AI.motivation: 现有 agent 数据工程基准仅用固定快照单次运行来评分，无法暴露管道在真实投递扰动下的静默错误；且崩溃类失败可见于常规监控，而错误结果不可见，需要区分二者。
AI.method: 构建 40 个任务；对照单次执行评分（对快照测试）与重放执行（对抗性但可复现的投递调度）；oracle 采用重算而非分类，从而将"错误表"与"崩溃"判为不同结论；对 11 个模型的产物独立复跑并比较幂等性风险与顺序性风险。
AI.result: 单次执行评分认证 11 个模型产出管道的 86–100%；重放同样产物发现其中 7.0–79.2% 被认证者静默错误。该差距非修复循环所致：同模型同任务下，经快照测试修复通过的管道，其重放失败率与首次即通过者相近。各模型中幂等性风险比顺序性风险更易失败。区分错误答案与崩溃后，干预效果解读改变：风险警告使某模型静默失败由 48.2% 降至 10.5%，但崩溃率由 9.0% 升至 37.0%，总体失败仅从 51.0% 降至 44.0%。11 个臂独立复跑，比率变动不超过 5.9 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 单次快照评分系统性高估 agent 管道正确性，且掩盖了幂等性与顺序性两类不同的失效模式；区分"错误表"与"崩溃"对评估干预有效性至关重要，否则总体失败率会掩盖风险转移现象。

title: Answering clinicians' questions over trial evidence tables with verifiable, feedback-driven language models
summary: Systematic reviews condense clinical trials into evidence tables, yet clinicians can interrogate these tables only through database queries, and many questions concern attributes that the table does not record, such as a drug's target class or a harmonised endpoint. Here we introduce FD-SCoPE, a language-model framework that answers both kinds of question, exposes the query, the selected trials and the derivation rule behind every answer, and learns from expert corrections. On an oncology evidence table of 159 immune checkpoint inhibitor trial records, FD-SCoPE completed all 140 clinician-style tasks (alternatives, 90.7-97.9%). For questions needing derived attributes it retrieved 99.3% of relevant trial records at a positive predictive value of 89.8% and outperformed four alternative approaches (derived-value F1 77.7% versus 64.8-73.4%). Corrections on 299 questions, simulated from reference answers, raised F1 on 1,201 unseen questions from 77.9% to 84.9%. Language models coupled with executable queries, verified programs and expert feedback can give clinicians auditable access to trial evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出FD-SCoPE框架，用语言模型将系统综述证据表转化为可审计的问答接口，支持直接查询与派生属性推理，并可从专家纠正中学习。
AI.motivation: 系统综述把临床试验压缩为证据表，但临床医生只能通过数据库查询访问，且许多问题涉及表中未记录的属性（如药物靶点类别、统一终点）。因此需要一种既支持直接查询、又支持派生属性推理，并且答案可审计、可学习的问答方法。
AI.method: FD-SCoPE是一个语言模型框架，对两类问题作答；每个答案都公开查询语句、所选试验记录及推导规则（derive rule），并通过可执行查询、可验证程序与专家纠正反馈进行学习。
AI.result: 在包含159条免疫检查点抑制剂试验记录的肿瘤学证据表上：完成全部140项临床医生式任务（替代方案为90.7%–97.9%）；对需派生属性的问题，检索到99.3%的相关试验记录，阳性预测值89.8%；优于四种替代方法（派生值F1为77.7%，对比64.8%–73.4%）；基于参考答案模拟的299个问题纠正，使1,201个未见问题的F1从77.9%提升到84.9%。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型结合可执行查询、经校验的程序与专家反馈，可为临床医生提供对试验证据的可审计访问途径。

title: Passing the Test You Trained On: Re-evaluating Prompt-Injection Detectors for LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents increasingly screen tool outputs with small prompt-injection detectors, and teams choose among detectors by their scores on public benchmarks. We ask whether those scores predict how a detector behaves inside an agent. We replay the ground-truth tool calls of two agent benchmarks, AgentDojo and tau-bench, without an LLM to obtain tool outputs that are benign by construction, label injected outputs by differential replay, and evaluate fifteen detectors, including Meta's Prompt Guard 2, and two task-aware LLM judges on these outputs and on the BIPIA benchmark. Detection rankings transfer poorly between benchmarks: the best detector on BIPIA catches 2% of AgentDojo injections at a 1% false-positive rate, and a detector that catches 72% of AgentDojo injections catches 15% on tau-bench. False-positive rates on tool outputs, which range from none to over 90%, do transfer between the two agent benchmarks. Where training data is public, the form of the training inputs explains the results. The BIPIA leader was trained on full BIPIA inputs, but having seen InjecAgent's attack strings as short prompts does not help it find them inside tool outputs; the best detector on both agent benchmarks shares no data with any benchmark and was trained on agent-style inputs. Evaluations meant to inform deployment should use the agent's own tool outputs, report detection at a low false-positive rate, and audit what the detector was trained on.

AI.tldr: 公开基准上的提示注入检测器分数无法预测其在真实智能体中的表现，评估应使用智能体自身的工具输出、低误报率并审查训练数据。
AI.motivation: 智能体开始用小模型检测器筛查工具输出，团队依据公开基准分数来选择检测器；但公开基准分数能否预测检测器在智能体内部的实际行为尚不明确。
AI.method: 无LLM重放AgentDojo和tau-bench的真实工具调用以获得天然良性输出，用差分重放标注注入输出，评估十五个检测器（含Meta Prompt Guard 2）和两个任务感知LLM裁判，在这两个基准及BIPIA上做对比。
AI.result: 检测排名跨基准迁移性差：BIPIA最佳检测器在1%误报率下仅捕获2%的AgentDojo注入，某检测器在AgentDojo捕获72%但在tau-bench仅15%；而工具输出上的误报率（0%至90%以上）在两个智能体基准间可迁移。训练输入形式可解释结果：BIPIA冠军在完整BIPIA输入上训练，但见过InjecAgent攻击字符串作短提示并无助于在工具输出中找到它们；两智能体基准上的最佳检测器与任何基准无数据交集，且用智能体风格输入训练。
AI.conclusion: 面向部署的评估应使用智能体自身的工具输出、报告低误报率下的检测率，并审查检测器的训练数据。

title: TRAC: Trajectory-aware Reuse and Adaptive Correction for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: In this paper, we present trajectory-aware reuse and adaptive correction (TRAC), a training-free framework for efficient autoregressive (AR) video generation. Existing acceleration methods mainly target single-trajectory generation with bidirectional attention. AR video generation, by contrast, sequentially couples chunk-level denoising trajectories. Consequently, approximation errors accumulate and propagate through the generation process. TRAC addresses this challenge with three components, including robust cumulative scheduling (RCS), autoregressive trajectory-aware guidance scheduling (ATGS), and spectral structure correction (SSC). RCS selects cache reuse schedules by cumulative rollout error and cross-chunk/prompt variation. ATGS coordinates CFG refreshes along the global AR trajectory. SSC restores low-frequency structure of the first chunk to correct long-term structural loss. Experiments on SkyReels-V2 and FramePack-F1 show that, compared with existing methods, TRAC achieves both the highest inference efficiency and the best generation quality for AR video generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRAC，一种免训练的自回归视频生成加速框架，通过轨迹感知重用与自适应校正三大组件，在提升推理效率的同时保证生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有加速方法主要面向双向注意力的单轨迹生成，而自回归视频生成按块级去噪轨迹顺序耦合，近似误差会累积并沿生成过程传播，导致现有方法难以适用。
AI.method: TRAC包含三个组件：1）鲁棒累积调度（RCS），依据累积展开误差与跨块/提示变化选择缓存重用调度；2）自回归轨迹感知引导调度（ATGS），沿全局AR轨迹协调CFG刷新；3）频谱结构校正（SSC），恢复首块的低频结构以校正长程结构损失。
AI.result: 在SkyReels-V2与FramePack-F1上，与现有方法相比，TRAC在自回归视频生成中同时取得了最高的推理效率与最佳的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: TRAC作为免训练框架，有效缓解了自回归视频生成中误差累积与传播问题，实现了效率与质量的双重最优。

title: Evaluating LLM-as-a-Judge Beyond Score Alignment: A Psychometric Analysis of Residual Judging Difficulty
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used as automatic judges, with validity typically assessed via alignment with human scores. However, aggregate agreement fails to reveal whether humans and LLMs find the same evaluation cases difficult. In this paper, we study this problem in summarization evaluation from a psychometric perspective. We fit Many-Facet Rasch Models separately to human and LLM ratings to decompose scores into latent summary quality, rater severity, dimension severity, and rating-scale thresholds. Building on this decomposition, we define residual hardness as a model-adjusted measure of judging difficulty and compare whether human and LLM judges share the same hardness structure. Across 17 open-weight LLM judges on SummEval, we find that moderate alignment in latent summary quality does not imply alignment in residual hardness. Human and LLM judges differ in which summary--dimension units remain difficult, and this mismatch is strongly dimension-dependent. Consistency shows a pronounced LLM-hard shift, whereas coherence shows a human-hard shift. We further show that human-easy but LLM-hard cases are partially predictable from observable source--summary properties. These findings suggest that aggregate human alignment reflects only part of LLM-as-a-judge reliability, while psychometric residual diagnostics support more informative judge evaluation and more targeted human--LLM collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文将多面Rasch模型分别拟合人类与LLM评分，提出"残差难度"指标，发现潜变量摘要质量的一致性并不代表评判难度结构一致，且难度错配显著依赖评价维度。
AI.motivation: LLM作为自动评判者已被广泛使用，其有效性通常以与人类评分的总体一致性来衡量。但总体一致性无法揭示人类与LLM是否觉得"同样的评价样本"困难。作者希望从心理测量学角度弥补这一评估盲区，考察两者的评判难度结构是否共享。
AI.method: 在摘要评价任务（SummEval）上，对17个开放权重LLM评判者与人类评分分别拟合多面Rasch模型（Many-Facet Rasch Model），将评分分解为潜变量摘要质量、评分者严厉度、维度严厉度与评分量表阈值；在此基础上定义残差难度作为模型校正后的评判难度度量，并比较人类与LLM的难度结构是否一致。
AI.result: 潜变量摘要质量上的中等一致性并不能推出残差难度上的一致性；人类与LLM在哪些"摘要—维度"单元上仍然困难存在差异，且这种错配强依赖于维度：一致性维度表现出明显的"LLM更难"偏移，连贯性维度则表现出"人类更难"偏移。此外，"人类易但LLM难"的样本可部分由可观测的原文—摘要属性预测。
AI.conclusion: 总体人类对齐仅反映了LLM-as-a-judge可靠性的一个侧面；心理测量学的残差诊断可提供更具信息量的评判者评估，并支持更有针对性的人机协作。

title: ManiPhysicsBench: Physics-Based Assessment of Object Preservation in VLA Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models aim to perform diverse manipulation tasks, but task success in existing rigid-body benchmarks does not indicate whether they preserve objects. We introduce ManiPhysicsZoo, which consolidates literature-supported material properties, 3D meshes, and supporting references into reusable object assets. Using these assets, a solver-based assessment computes grasp-specific damage thresholds from object geometry, material properties, and recorded grasp conditions and compares them with recorded contact forces to assess potential deformation and fracture. Building on these components, ManiPhysicsBench evaluates object preservation in LIBERO and SimplerEnv across three physics axes and three difficulty levels. Public VLA checkpoints show a substantial gap between task success and safe success, defined as task completion while preserving the object. Their gripper commands concentrate near full opening and closure, with largely similar aggregate distributions across objects, consistent with binary gripper supervision. We examine how object-specific continuous gripper labels change model behavior by retraining a VLA model. The retrained model shows more object-dependent gripping and higher safe success, but lower task success and limited generalization of object-preserving behavior.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ManiPhysicsZoo 与 ManiPhysicsBench，从物理保持角度重新评估 VLA 模型，揭示任务成功率与安全成功率之间存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有刚体操作基准仅关注任务成功率，无法判断 VLA 模型是否在操作过程中保持物体完整。模型可能通过过高夹持力完成任务，导致物体变形或破裂，而这一维度此前缺乏系统性评估手段。
AI.method: 构建 ManiPhysicsZoo，整合文献支持的材料属性、3D 网格与参考文献，形成可复用物体资产；基于求解器的评估方法结合物体几何、材料属性与记录的夹持条件计算抓取相关的损伤阈值，并与记录的接触力比较以判断潜在变形与断裂；在此基础上构建 ManiPhysicsBench，在 LIBERO 与 SimplerEnv 上沿三个物理轴、三个难度等级评估物体保持能力；并重新训练带物体特定连续夹爪标签的 VLA 模型进行对比。
AI.result: 公开 VLA 检查点在任务成功率与安全成功率之间表现出显著差距；其夹爪指令集中在接近全开与全闭处，不同物体间聚合分布基本相似，与二值夹爪监督一致。重训练后模型表现出更强的物体相关抓取行为，安全成功率提高，但任务成功率下降，且物体保持行为的泛化能力有限。
AI.conclusion: 仅以任务成功为指标的刚体基准会高估 VLA 模型的实际操作质量；引入物理感知的物体保持评估能暴露安全性与泛化缺陷，连续夹爪监督可作为改善方向，但其收益与代价需进一步权衡。

title: Co-design Gym: A Unified Benchmark for Embodiment-Policy Co-optimization
comment: Aviraj Newatia and Yordan Tsvetkov contributed equally
summary: Finding an optimal behaviour policy within a given environment is a widely studied problem in domains as diverse as games, robotics, energy infrastructure, communication networks, and multi-agent systems. Numerous benchmarks have been developed to support such research, but the vast majority assume that the agent's embodiment (design) is fixed, focusing instead on policy learning alone. Lifting this assumption gives rise to a broader class of problems in which optimizing embodiment and policy separately is highly suboptimal. An agent's embodiment strongly shapes which control policies can be discovered, while the optimal embodiment is in turn defined by the policies it admits. To help the research community study this class of problems explicitly and systematically, we introduce Co-Design Gym - a suite of benchmark environments for jointly optimizing embodiment and policy. Our environments span domains such as robotic manipulation and locomotion, multi-robot cooperation, deformable and soft dynamics, video games, electricity grids, wireless networks, F1 racing, multi-agent warehouses, and optimal control, offering 20 environment families (domains), with over 85 distinct co-design presets in total. We further contribute a systematic evaluation of representative co-design algorithms, characterizing the current state of the art. Together, these contributions lay the groundwork for cumulative, comparable progress in co-design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Co-Design Gym，一个用于联合优化智能体形态（具身）与控制策略的基准环境套件，涵盖20个环境族、85+协同设计预设，并系统评估代表性协同设计算法。
AI.motivation: 现有大部分基准假设智能体形态固定，仅关注策略学习，忽视了形态与策略需联合优化的更一般问题；二者分离优化往往高度次优，因形态决定可发现的策略，而最优形态又由其所支持的最优策略定义，社区缺乏系统研究此类问题的平台。
AI.method: 构建Co-Design Gym基准环境套件，支持具身与策略的联合优化，覆盖机器人操作与运动、多机器人协作、可变形与软体动力学、视频游戏、电网、无线网络、F1赛车、多智能体仓储、最优控制等领域，形成20个环境族、总计超过85个协同设计预设，并对代表性协同设计算法进行系统性评估。
AI.result: 提供20个环境族、85+协同设计预设的基准套件，并给出代表性协同设计算法的系统评估，刻画该领域的当前最优水平（state of the art）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为协同设计（co-design）研究奠定基础，促进该方向可积累、可比较的进展。

title: Labels Override Definitions in Jev-Style Typed Decision Models
summary: A typed decision model answers a fixed question about an input by returning a probability for each of several caller-defined options. Each option carries a short label and a written definition, which is where a developer states the rule the model should apply. Jev introduced this interface for routing, moderation and triage, open implementations followed, and the same operation occurs whenever a language model is used as a classifier by scoring label strings. We study the open implementations, whose weights we can inspect and patch, and ask whether the probability follows the definitions or the labels. A preference for the label we call option-label bias. Across four open-weight typed decision models, three ways of reading an answer from a Qwen2.5 backbone, eleven classification tasks and PolicyBench, a synthetic routing suite we introduce in which the rule appears only in the definitions, the answer is mostly the labels. Deleting every definition leaves accuracy unchanged (laya-td: 0.8559 against 0.8487), although those definitions support 0.7971 on their own, and renaming the options to A and B raises accuracy by +0.1511 [+0.1377, +0.1646]. One system, von, is unaffected, and the two code bases differ in one expression: laya writes each option as "{label}: {definition}", while von writes only the definition. Changing that expression in both directions, with no weight changed, makes all three laya checkpoints exactly invariant (+0.0000 [+0.0000, +0.0000]) and creates the effect in von, whose accuracy falls from 0.8511 to 0.2281 when a label contradicts its definition. Earlier work attributed this failure to the constrained decision head these models use in place of a text decoder; our results locate it in the prompt rendering. We give a two-call test that tells a practitioner which case applies to their model, and measure what four mitigations are worth.

AI.tldr: 在四个开放权重的类型化决策模型中，模型的概率判断主要依赖选项标签而非定义，根源在于提示词渲染方式（"{label}: {definition}"格式）而非决策头结构。
AI.motivation: 类型化决策模型通过返回各选项概率来回答固定问题，每个选项含标签和定义，开发者通过定义陈述应应用的规则。作者想研究开放实现中模型概率究竟遵循定义还是标签，探究标签偏好（option-label bias）是否存在及其来源。
AI.method: 研究四个开放权重类型化决策模型、Qwen2.5骨干的三种答案读取方式、十一个分类任务，以及作者提出的PolicyBench合成路由套件（规则只出现在定义中）。通过删除定义、重命名选项为A/B、修改提示词表达式（"{label}: {definition}"对比仅definition）等干预手段，在不改变权重的情况下检验模型不变性。
AI.result: 答案主要由标签驱动：删除所有定义后准确率几乎不变（laya-td: 0.8559 vs 0.8487），但定义单独支持0.7971的准确率；将选项重命名为A和B使准确率提升+0.1511 [+0.1377, +0.1646]。von系统不受影响，两者唯一差异在于layla写作"{label}: {definition}"而von仅写定义。改变该表达式使三个layla检查点完全不变（+0.0000），并在von中制造出该效应（当标签与定义矛盾时准确率从0.8511降至0.2281）。
AI.conclusion: 以往工作将此类失败归因于模型使用的约束决策头，本文将根源定位于提示词渲染方式。作者提供了两调用测试帮助实践者判断其模型属于哪种情况，并衡量了四种缓解措施的价值。

title: CorrectGuard: Eyes-Off Correctness Estimation for Black-Box Security Guardrails
summary: AI services increasingly rely on black-box security guardrails, yet privacy-preserving model auditing regimes often cannot measure how well these systems perform in both a human eyes-off production setting, which disallows human inspection of user input, and a machine eyes-off setting, which disallows model inspection of such input. We introduce CorrectGuard, an eyes-off correctness estimation framework for both settings, which involves an independent model-based evaluator predicting whether guardrail decisions on human- and machine-inaccessible inputs are correct using only labeled eyes-on data and without access to the guardrail's internals. We evaluate in-context learning, embedding, and finetuning-based correctness models under leave-one-dataset-out evaluation across 13 safety and security datasets spanning harmful content, jailbreaks, prompt injection, and extraction, and across open-weight guardrails treated uniformly as black boxes. Across both human and machine eyes-off settings (the latter implemented using privacy-preserving fingerprinting of inputs), in-context-learning-based correctness classifiers substantially improve error identification across guardrails, achieving up to a 25 percentage-point increase in macro accuracy, as do finetuning-based approaches which provide a nearly 15-point boost, although performance varies sharply across guardrails and held-out datasets. Correctness scores also support guardrail decision ranking and abstention: across 3 guardrails, the best correctness rankings reduce AURC from unranked baselines of 0.33-0.44 to 0.17-0.22, while the best operating points retain 37.5-52.0% of guardrail decisions at 15% observed risk. These results show that external correctness models can expose systematic failures and support guardrail decision abstention without privileged access to the guardrail.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CorrectGuard，一个面向"人力不可见"与"机器不可见"两种设定、仅依赖标注的 eyes-on 数据、无需访问护栏内部结构的正确性估计框架，用于审计黑盒安全护栏。
AI.motivation: AI 服务日益依赖黑盒安全护栏，但隐私保护型模型审计机制往往无法评估这些护栏在两类受限场景下的表现：一是禁止人工查看用户输入的 human eyes-off 生产环境，二是禁止模型查看该输入的 machine eyes-off 环境。现有审计方法缺乏对黑盒护栏正确性的可测量手段。
AI.method: 构建独立的基于模型的评估器，仅用有标签的 eyes-on 数据预测护栏在人类/机器不可访问输入上的决策是否正确，完全不访问护栏内部。machine eyes-off 设定通过输入的隐私保护指纹化实现。比较三类正确性模型：上下文学习（ICL）、嵌入（embedding）、微调（finetuning），采用 leave-one-dataset-out 评估，覆盖 13 个安全与安保数据集（有害内容、越狱、提示注入、提取）及多个被统一视为黑盒的开源权重护栏。
AI.result: 在两种 eyes-off 设定下，基于 ICL 的正确性分类器显著提升跨护栏错误识别，宏平均准确率最高提升 25 个百分点；基于微调的方法提升近 15 个百分点，但性能在不同护栏与留出数据集间波动剧烈。正确性分数还支持护栏决策排序与弃权：在 3 个护栏上，最佳正确性排序将 AURC 从无排序基线的 0.33–0.44 降至 0.17–0.22，最佳操作点在 15% 观测风险下保留 37.5–52.0% 的护栏决策。
AI.conclusion: 外部正确性模型能够在不获取护栏特权访问的情况下揭示系统性失效，并支持护栏决策弃权，为黑盒护栏的隐私保护审计提供了可行路径。

title: FUSEye: Training-Light Fisheye Detection with Overlapping Views and Zero-Initialized Adapters
comment: Source code will be available at https://github.com/Su-wenya/FUSEye
summary: Fisheye cameras give mobile robots a single-sensor, low-cost view of their surroundings, yet the COCO-pretrained detectors that practitioners routinely reuse fail on them: strong radial distortion warps local image structure, while boundary compression shrinks objects to near-invisible sizes. Full fine-tuning closes much of the gap but requires abundant fisheye labels and compute. We present FUSEye, a training-light framework that turns a frozen-backbone COCO-pretrained extra-large YOLO26 detector (YOLO26-x) into a fisheye detector. FUSEye adds roughly 227k new parameters while updating the inserted modules and the pretrained detection head. It addresses the transfer gap at three causally linked levels. At the input level, overlapping grid view generation and box remapping (GridViews) enlarge compressed boundary regions. At the feature level, zero-initialized residual adapters (Z-Adapters) correct distortion-induced feature misalignment. At the decision level, learned cross-projection agreement fusion (AgreeFusion) promotes low-confidence detections only when they are supported by consistent evidence across multiple views. On the WoodScape surround-view fisheye benchmark, FUSEye raises YOLO26-x from 0.148 to 0.266 mAP50 and retains 84.3% fully fine-tuned accuracy. Moreover, randomly using only 25% of the labeled training images, FUSEye achieves 0.2597 mAP50, retaining 97.6% of its full-label performance. FUSEye also consistently improves YOLOv8-11 detectors, showing that the recipe is architecture-agnostic. Source code will be available at https://github.com/Su-wenya/FUSEye.

AI.tldr: 提出FUSEye框架，将冻结骨干的COCO预训练YOLO26-x转化为鱼眼检测器，仅增约227k参数，在WoodScape上mAP50从0.148提升至0.266。
AI.motivation: 鱼眼相机提供低成本全景感知，但惯用的COCO预训练检测器因强径向畸变和边界压缩而失效；全量微调虽能缩小差距，却依赖大量鱼眼标注与算力，因此需要一种训练成本低的迁移方案。
AI.method: 在输入级，用重叠网格视图生成与框重映射（GridViews）放大被压缩的边界区域；在特征级，用零初始化残差适配器（Z-Adapters）校正畸变导致的特征错位；在决策级，用学习式跨投影一致性融合（AgreeFusion），仅当多视图证据一致时才提升低置信检测。仅更新插入模块与预训练检测头。
AI.result: 在WoodScape环绕视图鱼眼基准上，FUSEye将YOLO26-x的mAP50从0.148提升至0.266，保留全量微调精度的84.3%；仅使用25%标注训练图像时达0.2597 mAP50，保留全标注性能的97.6%；并一致提升YOLOv8-11系列检测器。
AI.conclusion: FUSEye是一种架构无关、训练轻量的鱼眼检测迁移方法，以极少新增参数和标签实现接近全量微调的精度，缓解了鱼眼域适应中的数据与算力瓶颈。

title: Evaluating VQA in Vision Language Models using Cooperative Principles
summary: We evaluate the performance of Vision Language Models in Visual Question Answering (VQA) when questions violate Grice's maxims. To do this, we use VLMs to generate question modifiers that add non-essential, ambiguous or false information and show that in the presence of such violations, the VLMs that we evaluate (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Llava) show diminished performance. Further, we empirically show the difference between how humans reason pragmatically compared to VLMs, and the difference in VLM reasoning when it resolves violations that are human-induced compared to those that are AI-generated. Finally, we show that human cognitive effort (measured through time-on-task in an experiment) is lower for resolving VLM-induced violations, but VLMs themselves perform less accurately in such cases.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了当问题违反格莱斯准则时，视觉语言模型（VLM）在视觉问答（VQA）中的表现。研究利用VLM生成引入冗余、歧义或虚假信息的问题修饰语，发现ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini和Llava在存在此类违规时性能下降，并揭示了人类与VLM语用推理差异及人类诱导与AI生成违规处理上的差异。
AI.motivation: 现有VQA评测多关注标准问题，较少考察真实交流中违反格莱斯合作准则（如冗余、歧义、虚假信息）的情况。本文旨在探究VLM在语用违规情境下的鲁棒性，并对比人类与VLM的语用推理差异。
AI.method: 使用VLM生成问题修饰语，向问题中注入非必要、歧义或虚假信息以制造格莱斯准则违规；在VQA任务上测试ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini和Llava四个VLM；通过实验对比人类语用推理与VLM推理，并区分人类诱导与AI生成的违规；以任务时间（time-on-task）衡量人类认知努力。
AI.result: 在存在格莱斯准则违规时，所评估的VLM（ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Llava）VQA性能均下降；人类与VLM的语用推理方式存在差异；VLM处理人类诱导违规与AI生成违规时的推理表现也不同；人类解决VLM诱导违规的认知努力更低，但VLM在同类情形下准确率更差。
AI.conclusion: VLM在违反格莱斯准则的问题上表现脆弱，其语用推理与人类存在系统性差距，且对AI生成违规的处理尤为低效，表明当前VLM在真实语用场景中的鲁棒性仍有待提升。

title: LOCUS: Landmark-Oriented Container Discrimination Using Spatial Graphs
summary: As robots are increasingly deployed in unstructured, real-world environments, the ability to reason about complex spatial and semantic relationships among objects remains a fundamental challenge in enabling robust and generalizable manipulation and navigation. For example, deciding where to search for an object that is not in plain sight depends on where it is physically plausible as well as semantically likely. Popular methods such as cosine similarity with CLIP struggle to disambiguate between spatially and semantically similar objects that could contain a target object. We propose Landmark-Oriented Container Discrimination Using Spatial Graphs (LOCUS). To jointly reason about spatial information and semantics, we train a GNN to update CLIP embeddings on a full environment scene graph by passing embedding information between nodes based on proximity. CLIP embeddings, augmented by semantic knowledge from a fusion of household ontologies provide a robust semantic signal. We evaluate in simulation on a noiseless scene graph from simulator metadata, making the approach detection-agnostic. Our approach outperforms random, CLIP, Tidybot, and an LLM planner in the majority of room classes and configurations in simulation. To show our approach is robust to scene graph node placement and label noise, we demonstrate a physical mobile manipulator running in an exploration pipeline start-to-finish including scene graph labels from Detic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LOCUS方法，利用空间图上的GNN更新CLIP嵌入，融合家居本体语义知识，联合推理空间与语义关系，用于在杂乱环境中寻找隐藏目标物体，仿真和真实机器人实验均优于多种基线。
AI.motivation: 机器人在非结构化真实环境中作业时，需要推理物体间复杂的空间与语义关系。判断不在视线内的物体可能存放位置，既依赖物理合理性也依赖语义可能性。而CLIP余弦相似度等流行方法难以区分空间和语义上相似、都可能容纳目标物体的容器。
AI.method: 提出LOCUS（Landmark-Oriented Container Discrimination Using Spatial Graphs）。在完整环境场景图上训练GNN，依据邻近关系在节点间传递嵌入信息，从而更新CLIP嵌入；CLIP嵌入结合家居本体融合提供的语义知识，形成稳健的语义信号。评估使用仿真器元数据生成的无噪声场景图，使方法不依赖检测环节。
AI.result: 在仿真中，该方法在大多数房间类别和配置下优于随机、CLIP、Tidybot和LLM规划器。为验证对场景图节点位置和标签噪声的鲁棒性，在物理移动操作机器人上运行完整探索流程，包括使用Detic生成场景图标签。
AI.conclusion: LOCUS通过空间图上的GNN嵌入传播与本体语义融合，实现了对容器/隐藏目标位置的空间-语义联合推理，并在仿真和真实机器人探索流程中均表现出优于基线的性能与鲁棒性。

title: Latent-MOPD: Latent Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on the responses it generates. Existing LLM multi-teacher OPD transfers what specialists predict through their output distributions. We introduce Latent-MOPD, to our knowledge the first representation-level multi-teacher OPD method for LLMs. It integrates existing specialists through both their predictions and the hidden states used to compute them, without additional teacher training. To coordinate representation supervision from multiple specialists, we select late-layer targets according to the teacher-student relationship, bridge unequal hidden widths with a shared projection, and group updates by domain. Each teacher's supervision gradually shifts from hidden states to token predictions, with both channels using the same routed specialist. In our main same-family setting, Latent-MOPD outperforms the token-only, representation-only and uniform-averaging baselines on all nine benchmarks across math, code and logic. With the same parameter count as each teacher, the student also surpasses the per-benchmark best teacher on a majority of these benchmarks. With larger, separately developed cross-family teachers, Latent-MOPD outperforms both single-channel baselines on all benchmarks. A same-family all-layer representation-only control remains stable with domain-pure updates but collapses when teacher domains are interleaved within an update. Our results show that a single student can integrate capabilities from several specialists through both their output distributions and internal representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Latent-MOPD，首个面向LLM的表示级多教师在线策略蒸馏方法，通过输出分布与隐状态双通道整合多个专家，在数学、代码、逻辑等九个基准上超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有多教师在线策略蒸馏（OPD）仅通过教师的输出分布传递专家能力，未利用计算这些预测所依赖的内部隐状态信息，因此表示层面的知识传递被浪费。
AI.method: Latent-MOPD在不额外训练教师的前提下，同时利用专家的预测与隐状态进行监督。为协调多专家表示监督，采用三个策略：按师生关系选择后层目标、用共享投影桥接不等隐宽、按领域分组更新。每个教师的监督从隐状态逐步过渡到token预测，且两通道共享同一路由专家。
AI.result: 同家族设定下，Latent-MOPD在数学、代码、逻辑共九个基准上全面超越仅token、仅表示和均匀平均三类基线；在参数量与各教师相同时，多数基准上超过表现最好的单教师。跨家族大模型教师设定下，在所有基准上超越单通道基线。同家族全层仅表示对照实验显示：领域纯净更新时稳定，教师领域交错更新时崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 单个学生模型能够通过输出分布与内部表示双通道，成功整合多个专家的能力。

title: Open-Endedness Bench: Measuring Epistemic Process from Agent Records
summary: Agents are increasingly given open-ended research tasks: discovering an empirical law from self-designed experiments, improving a heuristic whose optimum nobody knows, or beating a standing record. Their execution logs record every step of this research, yet the runs are still judged by their outcome score. That score alone does not establish whether an agent's claims follow from executed experiments, and a reference answer may be unavailable. We evaluate the agent's epistemic process: how it forms hypotheses, tests them, and revises them in response to evidence. We introduce OEB (Open-Endedness Bench), a benchmark-agnostic methodology that reads only the agent's execution record and never a reference answer or an outcome score. OEB compiles the record into a unified epistemic event graph whose edges connect the propositions the agent states to the executed actions that test them; each node carries an exact excerpt that code verifies against the record. One principle governs scoring: prose can state a proposition, but only evidence returned by an executed action can support or refute it, so OEB checks what the agent writes against what it actually ran. From the graph, OEB scores four competence axes (evidence, experiment, revision, and no reward hacking), mostly as the share of opportunities for sound research that the agent took, and profiles six subjective persona traits that describe the agent's research habits. We score 119 existing runs over 12 tasks from three benchmarks: LLM post-training, chip design, and a training-speed record. Against logged results, only 16-29% of the improvements agents claim are real. On 9 of 10 tasks, the best run tries more new ideas in its second half than the worst run. The persona readings follow the model: for every trait, the model that ran explains more of its variance across runs than the task (a median of 43% against 7%).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 OEB（Open-Endedness Bench），一种不依赖参考答案或结果分数、仅读取智能体执行记录的开放研究任务评估方法，将记录编译为"认知事件图"并据此从证据、实验、修正、无奖励黑客四个能力轴打分，同时刻画六种研究习惯画像。
AI.motivation: 开放型研究任务（发现经验规律、改进未知最优的启发式、打破记录）当前仅以最终结果分数评判智能体，而分数无法证明其论断是否源自真实执行的实验，且往往没有参考答案。因此需要评估智能体的认知过程本身：如何形成假设、检验假设并依据证据修正。
AI.method: OEB 与具体基准无关，只读执行记录，不读参考答案与结果分数。它将记录编译为统一的认知事件图：边连接智能体陈述的命题与检验该命题的执行动作，每个节点附带可由代码在记录中校验的原文摘录。核心评分原则是：文本可以陈述命题，但只有已执行动作返回的证据才能支持或反驳命题，故 OEB 将智能体所写与其实际所跑相对照。基于该图，OEB 在四个能力轴（证据、实验、修正、无奖励黑客）上打分，多数指标为智能体把握"健全研究机会"的比例，并刻画六种主观的研究习惯画像特征。
AI.result: 在来自三个基准（LLM 后训练、芯片设计、训练速度记录）的 12 个任务、119 条已有运行记录上评测：与日志记录结果比对，智能体声称的改进中仅 16–29% 为真实改进；在 10 个任务中的 9 个上，最佳运行在后半程尝试的新想法多于最差运行；画像读数随模型变化——对每一种特征，运行该任务的模型对其跨运行方差的解释力均高于任务本身（中位数 43% 对 7%）。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭结果分数会高估智能体的研究进展，OEB 通过执行记录构建认知事件图、以"只有执行证据才能支持命题"为准则，实现了无需参考答案的过程性评估；其能力轴得分与研究习惯画像揭示了智能体声称与实证证据之间的显著落差，且画像主要由模型而非任务决定。

title: PrivDev: Mapping Static-Analysis Data Types to DPV
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Published at the 14th Workshop on Software Visualization, Maintenance and Evolution (VEM 2026), part of CBSoft 2026, São Paulo, Brazil. Received the workshop's Best Paper Award. Conference version available at https://cbsoft.sbc.org.br/2026/data/papers/workshops/PrivDev%20Mapping%20Static-Analysis%20Data%20Types%20to%20DPV.pdf
summary: Static-analysis scanners can identify personal-data types in source code, but they lack mechanisms to connect these findings to standardized privacy vocabularies. PrivDev maps 122 Bearer CLI data types to Data Privacy Vocabulary Personal Data (DPV-PD) categories and links them to potentially relevant GDPR provisions. Our approach combines deterministic mapping for 43 exact-label matches with a retrieval-grounded Large Language Model (LLM) to resolve the remaining 79 non-trivial mappings. The resulting RDF knowledge graph contains 118 ODRL policy resources that were structurally validated using SHACL. The artifact passed five complementary validation gates that cover structural correctness, query consistency, retrieval quality, LLM-based assessment, and human evaluation. In human evaluation, nine annotators produced 711 judgments, yielding a raw agreement of 0.72, Gwet's AC1 of 0.68, and Gwet's AC2 of 0.88. Our results indicate that the proposed mappings are plausible and reproducible, while also revealing ambiguities in scanner-defined data-type labels and coverage gaps in DPV-PD.

AI.tldr: PrivDev将122个Bearer CLI数据类型映射到DPV-PD类别及GDPR条款，混合确定性匹配与大模型检索，构建经SHACL校验的RDF知识图谱，并通过五重验证与人工评估证明映射合理、可复现。
AI.motivation: 静态分析扫描器能识别源码中的个人数据类型，但缺乏将其发现连接到标准化隐私词汇表的机制，导致扫描结果难以直接对应合规要求。
AI.method: 对43个标签完全匹配项采用确定性映射，对剩余79个非平凡映射采用检索增强的大语言模型（retrieval-grounded LLM）解决；生成包含118个ODRL策略资源的RDF知识图谱，并用SHACL进行结构校验；通过五个互补验证环节：结构正确性、查询一致性、检索质量、LLM评估与人工评估。
AI.result: 知识图谱含118个ODRL策略资源并通过SHACL校验；九位标注者产生711条判断，原始一致性0.72，Gwet's AC1为0.68，Gwet's AC2为0.88；映射结果被认为合理且可复现，同时揭示扫描器标签的模糊性与DPV-PD的覆盖缺口。
AI.conclusion: PrivDev为静态扫描器与标准隐私词汇表之间提供了可验证的桥接方案，验证了LLM辅助映射的可行性；但需关注数据标签歧义与DPV-PD覆盖不足的问题。

title: TerrainForge: Physics-Grounded road geometry Editing for Counterfactual Autonomous Driving
summary: Road geometry (e.g., crests, sags, and speed humps) and surface conditions (e.g., wet or icy pavement) affect how vehicles move, what drivers and onboard cameras observe, and how much clearance remains between vehicles. Editing these properties in a driving scene therefore requires corresponding changes in vehicle motion. Capturing these differences in a driving video requires a road edit to propagate to vehicle motion, camera viewpoint, and the clearance between vehicles. We present TerrainForge, a framework for generating road geometry-focused counterfactuals from reconstructed multi-vehicle driving episodes. A unified road model connects scene deformation with four-wheel vehicle dynamics, allowing crests, sags, speed humps, and friction changes to propagate through vehicle motion, camera viewpoint, and inter-vehicle clearance. Vehicle dynamics are evaluated against CarSim, and prescribed road geometry is verified in reconstructed Waymo scenes. Across 18 episodes, leaving surrounding vehicles on their recorded trajectories instead of recomputing their responses produces median peak differences in predicted ego-lead distance of 1.52 m for crests and 1.41 m for sags. We further simulate the ego response to 15,758 road edits across 983 braking episodes, pairing each edit with its safety outcomes relative to an unedited replay. These pairs train a first-stage screening surrogate that takes the original driving context and candidate road-edit parameters as input and predicts the resulting change in the ego's terminal gap. On held-out scenes, this prediction achieves 22-40% lower mean absolute error than predicting no change, so candidates can be screened cheaply before the full multi-vehicle rollout.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TerrainForge 框架，通过统一道路模型将道路几何与路面条件编辑传播至车辆动力学、相机视角与车间距，生成多车驾驶场景的反事实视频，并训练代理模型快速筛选道路编辑候选。
AI.motivation: 道路几何（驼峰、凹谷、减速带）与路面条件（湿滑、结冰）会影响车辆运动、驾驶员与车载相机观测以及车间余量。在驾驶场景中编辑这些属性必须同步改变车辆运动，否则视频不一致。因此需要一种能将道路编辑传播到车辆运动、相机视角和车间距的生成方法。
AI.method: TerrainForge 从重建的多车驾驶片段出发生成以道路几何为核心的反事实。它构建统一道路模型，将场景形变与四轮车辆动力学耦合，使驼峰、凹谷、减速带及摩擦变化能传播到车辆运动、相机视角与车间距。车辆动力学以 CarSim 为基准验证，所设定的道路几何在重建的 Waymo 场景中得到检验。
AI.result: 在18个片段中，若保持周围车辆按记录轨迹行驶而不重新计算其响应，ego-lead 距离预测峰值中位差异在驼峰下为1.52 m、凹谷下为1.41 m。在983个制动片段上模拟了15,758次道路编辑，并将每次编辑与未编辑回放相对的安全结果配对。这些配对训练了一个第一阶段筛选代理模型，以原始驾驶上下文和候选编辑参数为输入，预测 ego 终端间距的变化，在留出场景上相比“预测无变化”基线，平均绝对误差降低22–40%，从而可在完整多车推演前低成本筛选候选。
AI.conclusion: 道路编辑需与多车运动耦合才能生成一致的反事实驾驶视频；TerrainForge 通过统一道路-动力学模型实现该传播，并借助代理模型实现道路编辑候选的高效预筛选。

title: Misinformation Without Triggers: From Factual Answers to Downstream Decisions
summary: Language models learn from web documents, some of them false, and false content can reach a model's answer to a factual question and the summaries and decisions that use it. Most data-poisoning studies add a trigger to the training data and activate it in the prompt. False documents can also change factual responses without any trigger, but we do not know whether the direct answer predicts the decision. In this work, we follow false content past the answer and find an \emph{audit gap} between what a direct probe reports and what the model then does, comparing false training with matched truthful controls in a controlled decision task, \emph{Guess the Capital}, where a fixed decoder turns factual answers into a scored card choice, and on a misleading claim from Facebook posts about the 2019--20 Australian bushfires. Across eight models at dose 1,000, direct injected-choice rates reach 95.8--100\%, while injected game choices increase by 1.7--14.4 percentage points over matched truthful training. The gap runs the other way too. Facts that pass the direct probe still push decisions toward the injected answer, and game accuracy drops further than those choices explain. Truthful correction brings the fact back but not the decisions built on it. We then look into the real-world bushfire case, models trained on the false posts say that people were arrested for arson even when they lose the inflated count, and in a count-by-wording factorial the misleading arrest wording produces arrest assertions even when the training count stays at 24. In simpler terms, \textbf{a correct factual answer does not guarantee a correct decision, and losing the injected number does not remove the misleading story}.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示语言模型中"直接事实回答"与"下游决策"之间的审计缺口：即使直接探针报告事实正确，错误训练内容仍会持续影响决策，且丢掉注入数字也不等于消除误导性叙事。
AI.motivation: 多数数据投毒研究通过触发器激活，而无需触发器的虚假文档也能改变事实回答；但尚不清楚直接答案能否预测模型的后续决策，因此需要超越单一答案层面，审计虚假内容对决策的连带影响。
AI.method: 设计受控决策任务 Guess the Capital，用固定解码器将事实答案转为计分卡牌选择，比较虚假训练与匹配的真实对照；在剂量 1,000、八个模型上测量直接注入选择率与游戏选择变化；并结合 2019–20 澳大利亚丛林火灾 Facebook 虚假帖子案例，采用计数×措辞的析因设计检验误导性措辞与训练计数的作用。
AI.result: 直接注入选择率达 95.8%–100%，而注入游戏选择相对匹配真实训练仅提升 1.7–14.4 个百分点；出现反向缺口：通过直接探针的事实仍将决策推向注入答案，游戏准确率下降幅度超出选择变化可解释范围；真实更正可恢复事实但不能恢复基于其上的决策；丛林火灾案例中，训练于虚假帖子的模型即使丢失虚高计数仍断言纵火逮捕，且在计数保持 24 时，误导性逮捕措辞仍单独产生逮捕断言。
AI.conclusion: 正确的事实回答并不保证正确的决策，且失去注入数字并不能移除误导性故事；审计需同时覆盖答案与决策两个层面。

title: SARI: Phase-Split Sim-Real Co-Training for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often require costly real-world demonstrations to adapt to contact-rich manipulation tasks, particularly when generalization across object placements is needed. We propose SARI (Simulated Approach, Real Interaction), a phase-split sim-and-real co-training framework built on a simple insight: spatial coverage and contact physics should be acquired from the domains best suited to them. Specifically, free-space approaches require spatial diversity but tolerate modest simulation gaps, making them ideal for synthetic generation; conversely, contact interactions demand accurate physics but vary little across object placements, allowing a few real demonstrations to generalize across the workspace. SARI generates diverse simulated approaches in a photorealistic digital twin while collecting real contact interactions at only a few placements. Post-trained on these phase-segmented demonstrations, a single policy seamlessly stitches simulated approaches with real contact interactions using visual appearance alignment and a shared camera-relative action representation--without explicit phase labels or hand-coded switches. Across five real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, SARI reduces real-data collection time by 34.3% and achieves 27.5% success at unseen placements, where all full-task sim-real baselines fail completely (0%).

AI.tldr: 提出SARI——一种阶段分离的仿真-现实协同训练框架，用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在接触密集操作任务中的适配。
AI.motivation: VLA模型适配接触密集操作任务需大量真实演示，尤其在跨物体放置位置泛化时成本高昂。
AI.method: 基于"空间覆盖与接触物理应分别来自最适合的域"这一洞察，将任务拆阶段：自由空间接近段用逼真数字孪生批量仿真生成，接触交互段在少量真实放置点采集；再用阶段分段的演示做后训练，通过视觉外观对齐与共享相机相对动作表示，让单一策略无须显式阶段标签或人工切换即可拼接两者。
AI.result: 在五项真实接触密集操作任务上，真实数据采集时间减少34.3%，在未见放置位置成功率达27.5%，而全任务sim-real基线全部失败（0%）。
AI.conclusion: 按阶段属性分配仿真与真实数据可显著降低数据成本并提升跨位置泛化，且无需显式阶段切换即可端到端运行。

title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Shared Memory in Looped Transformers
summary: Looped Transformers apply the same layers several times per token, adding compute to improve quality without more parameters. Each recursion, however, writes its own key-value cache, so memory still grows with compute. Inference-time techniques can shrink this cache at a cost in quality. We pretrain looped language models to share memory: only the first recursion writes a cache, and later recursions read it while keeping a short window of their own. Surprisingly, we find that sharing memory does not cost quality and instead improves it. At 150M-1B parameters, our Looped Prediction Transformer (LPT) and its hybrid variant set a new quality-memory frontier for looped models: with five recursions, the hybrid lowers validation perplexity on FineWeb-Edu by 1.12-1.82 relative to a same-size standard Transformer while using 76-79% less context memory. Through an extensive analysis, we investigate why memory sharing helps.
