AI.tldr: 提出HyperThink，用文本到参数的方法将长链推理计算摊销为一次查询条件下的参数更新：轻量超网络读取问题并预测基础LLM少量参数的更新，向量量化解码器将其约束为有限可复用模式，测试时无需长推理轨迹即可生成简洁解答。
AI.motivation: 长链思维轨迹能提升LLM多步推理性能，但推理开销高，延迟主要由顺序解码主导，需要在不牺牲推理能力的前提下降低延迟。
AI.method: HyperThink：轻量超网络读取问题，预测基础LLM少量参数的更新；向量量化解码器将更新约束为有限的可复用模式以提升鲁棒性与迁移性；基于基础模型自身输出进行端到端训练。
AI.result: 测试时消除长推理轨迹，经一次超网络前向传播后，适配模型直接生成简洁的分步解答和最终答案，使用远少token且保持强推理性能；在数学与通用推理任务上改善准确率-延迟权衡的低延迟区域，非思考（near-non-thinking）区间增益最强。
AI.conclusion: HyperThink通过将推理计算摊销为参数更新，有效降低推理延迟和token消耗，在低延迟区间提升推理性能，为高效LLM推理提供新思路。

title: MixVLA: Adaptive Mixing of Non-Invariant Information for Generalizable Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved remarkable advances in robotic manipulation, yet their zero-shot generalization under out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions remains limited. These models often entangle task-relevant invariant structure with environment-specific non-invariant factors, causing policies to rely on spurious appearance cues during action prediction. In this work, we propose \textbf{MixVLA}, a model-agnostic training framework that improves the generalization of VLA models without requiring additional OOD data or architectural modifications. The key component of MixVLA is \textbf{Adaptive Mixing of Non-Invariant Information (AMI)}. AMI stochastically mixes non-invariant representations to regularize distribution-specific variability while preserving complementary predictive cues. The mixed non-invariant features are then fused with invariant representations for final action prediction, resulting in improved robustness without sacrificing policy expressiveness. Extensive experiments across challenging manipulation settings, including LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, the RoboTwin perturbation suite, and real-world tasks, demonstrate that MixVLA improves overall zero-shot robustness while retaining strong in-domain performance.

AI.tldr: 提出MixVLA，一种模型无关的训练框架，通过自适应混合非不变信息（AMI）正则化分布特异变异，提升VLA模型在OOD条件下的零样本泛化能力，且无需额外OOD数据或改架构。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在机器人操作上进展显著，但其OOD零样本泛化能力有限。模型常将任务相关的不变结构与环境特异的非不变因素纠缠在一起，导致策略在动作预测时依赖虚假的外观线索。
AI.method: 核心组件为自适应非不变信息混合（AMI）：随机混合非不变表征，以正则化分布特异的变异性，同时保留互补的预测线索；随后将混合后的非不变特征与不变表征融合，用于最终动作预测。该框架模型无关，不需额外OOD数据，也不需修改架构。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin扰动套件及真实世界任务等挑战性操作设置上的大量实验表明，MixVLA在提升整体零样本鲁棒性的同时，保持了较强的域内性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过在训练中解耦并正则化非不变信息，MixVLA在不牺牲策略表达力的前提下增强VLA模型的零样本OOD鲁棒性，是一种通用、易集成的训练框架。

title: Prompted to Discriminate: Generalizing Malicious-Input Probes in the Wild
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond
summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on activation probes as runtime monitors for prompt injection, jailbreaks, and unsafe requests, reading the model's own hidden state to catch a harmful input before the agent acts on it. A cheap, increasingly common move, borrowed from LLM-as-judge prompting, is to append a short classification instruction after the user's turn and read the probe at that point, to sharpen it: the instruction asks the model to represent the incoming request as a class, concentrating the signal the probe must separate, at negligible serving cost. But does the wording of that suffix matter, and does its benefit hold in the wild, on attack types the probe never saw in training, the regime a deployed monitor faces? We test this with a controlled ladder of post-user suffixes under strict leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) evaluation across 13 safety benchmarks (jailbreak, injection, and benign chat) and three open-weight model families (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma-4-12B). On a single-position probe, a classification suffix consistently improves out-of-distribution detection over no suffix (up to ~4 AUC points); yet which suffix matters: prompting the model to classify the input, even into content-free labels, reliably wins; an off-topic or merely-attentive suffix helps little. The gain comes from the classification format, not the named criterion: a content-free suffix matches the real malicious/benign one, with the criterion adding precision only at strict thresholds. This is not an artifact of the single-position read: the benefit carries to the multi-position pooling probes used in production (attention, multi-max, MLP), though the best-performing suffix there is readout-dependent. Served through a KV-cache fork, it is a cheap drop-in for any activation-probe monitor, though not an automatic win: which suffix helps, and by how much, depends on the model and the readout.

AI.tldr: 在13个安全基准、3个开源模型上以LODO协议测试，发现对激活探针追加"分类式"后缀可稳定提升分布外检测（最高约+4 AUC），其增益源于分类格式本身而非具体判定标准，且该结论可迁移至生产中的多位置池化探针。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体越来越多地把激活探针当作运行时监控器，用于在行动前拦截提示注入、越狱和不安全请求。借鉴LLM-as-judge，一种廉价做法是在用户轮次后追加简短分类指令并读取探针。但该后缀的措辞是否有影响、其收益在部署所面临的未见攻击类型上是否成立，此前未被系统检验，本文旨在回答这两个问题。
AI.method: 构建从中性到分类式的"后缀阶梯"，在严格的留一数据集（LODO）协议下评估，覆盖13个安全基准（越狱、注入、良性对话）和三个开源权重模型族（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma-4-12B）。对比单位置探针与生产常用的多位置池化探针（attention、multi-max、MLP），并以KV-cache fork方式部署，检验分类后缀、离题后缀、仅"注意式"后缀三类条件的效果差异。
AI.result: 单位置探针上，分类后缀一致提升分布外检测，较无后缀最高约+4 AUC；而离题或仅具注意性的后缀帮助甚微。增益来自"分类格式"而非"命名标准"：内容无关（content-free）后缀与真实的恶意/良性后缀效果相当，判定标准仅在严格阈值下带来精度增益。该收益并非单位置读取的假象，可延续到注意力、multi-max、MLP等多位置池化探针，但在这些探针上最优后缀依赖读出方式。经KV-cache fork部署后，它是即插即用的低成本方案，但并非自动获胜：哪个后缀有效、提升多少，取决于模型与读出方式。
AI.conclusion: 分类式后缀是激活探针监控器的一种低成本、可即插即用的增强手段，其核心机制是让模型进入"分类表征格式"而非依赖具体判定标准；但收益具有模型与读出依赖性，实际部署需按监控器具体情况选择后缀，不能视为通用自动增益。

title: Coherence-Driven Belief Formation and Population Dynamics of Contagion in LLM Agents
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundations of Agentic Systems Theory (FAST)
summary: Models of social contagion usually assume how individuals adopt beliefs and derive population behavior from it. We instead empirically measure belief adoption in language model agents, quantifying the probability an agent adopts a claim given how many peers endorse it. We find this adoption kernel to be sigmoid, a characteristic of complex contagion, with a threshold that is sensitive to three sources: the claim's plausibility, the source's reliability, and the agent's disposition. These three dimensions are well approximated by a single effective dimension which we propose can be understood as the coherence of the incoming belief with the LLM agent's prior beliefs. Further, we observe a characteristic of complex contagion in the collective dynamics of belief adoption in a system of AI agents: further spread on clustered than random networks. These systems also exhibit a bifurcating cascade window, and self-sustaining hysteretic consensus which lead to consensus being far harder to remove than to establish.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过语言模型智能体实验测量信念采纳概率，发现其采纳核呈S型（复杂传染特征），阈值受主张可信度、来源可靠性与智能体倾向影响，可归结为单一有效维度——信念与先验的一致性；集体动力学中呈现聚簇网络上传播更快、分叉级联窗口及自持滞后共识。
AI.motivation: 传统社会传染模型通常先假设个体如何采纳信念，再由此推导群体行为，缺乏对信念采纳机制的直接实证测量。本文希望以语言模型智能体为对象，直接测量信念采纳行为，从而更扎实地刻画社会传染的微观基础。
AI.method: 在语言模型智能体上开展实证测量，量化智能体在给定有多少同伴支持某主张时采纳该主张的概率，从而得到“采纳核”；考察该核的形状及其阈值对主张可信度、来源可靠性和智能体倾向三个因素的敏感性；并在AI智能体系统中观察集体动力学，比较聚簇网络与随机网络上的传播，分析级联窗口与共识滞后现象。
AI.result: 采纳核呈S型（sigmoid），即复杂传染的典型特征；其阈值受主张可信度、来源可靠性和智能体倾向三方面影响，且这三个维度可被单一有效维度很好近似，作者提出该有效维度可理解为“传入信念与LLM智能体先验信念的一致性”。集体层面，聚簇网络上的传播强于随机网络，系统呈现分叉的级联窗口以及自持的滞后共识——共识一旦形成就比建立时更难被移除。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型智能体中的信念采纳符合复杂传染而非简单传染的图景，其微观采纳规则可压缩为一致性这一有效维度，且在集体层面复现了聚簇增强传播、分叉级联窗口与滞后共识等复杂传染特征，表明AI智能体系统可作为研究社会传染的可测量实验平台。

title: Inner Momentum for Differentially Private Muon
summary: Differentially private training clips each per-example gradient before adding noise. This clipping is radial for each example, yet unequal clipping factors can distort the relative singular-vector geometry of their average. Muon is particularly exposed to this effect, since its update is an approximate polar factor UV^T that depends only on the singular vectors that clipping can shift. To curb this degradation, we propose averaging each sampled example's Muon gradient over the current model and a short history of recent models before clipping. The clipped batch matrix then separates into a common rescaling and a covariance residual R between sampled gradients and clipping values, with ||R||_F <= sigma_lambda sigma_G, bounding the clipping-induced distortion directly. We further show that a finite Newton-Schulz iteration preserves the polar factor of its input under these spectral conditions, confirming that our correction survives orthogonalization. In private GPT-2 fine-tuning on E2E and DART at epsilon in {1, 2, 4, 8}, DP-Muon-IM improves BLEU and ROUGE-L over DP-Muon in every seed-matched comparison, and non-private diagnostics show 2-4% lower pre-noise polar error.

AI.tldr: 提出DP-Muon-IM：在裁剪前将每个样本的Muon梯度在当前模型与近期模型历史上做平均，抑制差分隐私裁剪带来的奇异向量几何畸变。
AI.motivation: 差分隐私训练对每个样本梯度做径向裁剪，但每样本裁剪因子不同，会扭曲其平均梯度的奇异向量相对几何。Muon的更新是近似的极因子UV^T，仅依赖奇异向量，因此对裁剪造成的奇异向量偏移高度敏感，性能退化明显。
AI.method: 在裁剪前，把每个采样样本的Muon梯度在当前模型和一小段近期模型历史上取平均后再裁剪；推导得到裁剪后的批次矩阵可分解为公共重缩放与采样梯度-裁剪值之间的协方差残差R，并给出||R||_F <= sigma_lambda sigma_G的畸变上界；进一步证明在这些谱条件下，有限步Newton-Schulz迭代保持输入的极因子不变，从而说明该修正能通过正交化步骤保留。
AI.result: 在隐私GPT-2微调任务E2E与DART上，epsilon取{1,2,4,8}时，DP-Muon-IM在每个同种子对比中均优于DP-Muon的BLEU与ROUGE-L；非隐私诊断显示加噪声前的极误差降低2-4%。
AI.conclusion: 通过历史平均构造一致性裁剪，可在理论上界定并减弱裁剪引起的奇异向量畸变，且该修正与Newton-Schulz正交化兼容，在DP-Muon微调中带来稳定一致的生成质量提升。

title: TerraVis: Towards Evaluation of World-Grounded Visual Consistency in Text-to-Image Generation via MLLM Workflows
summary: Recent text-to-image models have made substantial progress in photorealism, aesthetics, and text-image alignment. Yet visually appealing images can still violate real-world plausibility, exhibiting malformed object structures, impossible anatomy, physically implausible interactions, or inconsistent spatial relationships. Such failures are not well captured by existing fidelity, aesthetics, preference, or alignment metrics. To address this gap, we introduce TerraVis, a framework for evaluating world-grounded visual consistency in generated images. TerraVis defines a structured taxonomy of world-consistency violations spanning object-, interaction-, and scene-level failures, and employs a multi-stage evaluation framework to identify and quantify them. Given an image, TerraVis first uses an MLLM to assess its eligibility for evaluation, then detects violations across 18 taxonomy-defined types and classifies them as minor or major to derive an overall world-consistency score. Across diverse open-source and proprietary text-to-image models on two widely used benchmarks, TerraVis achieves the strongest correlation with human judgments of world consistency among existing metrics. Our benchmark results further show that models that achieve strong performance on conventional metrics can still exhibit substantial world-consistency failures. These findings highlight world consistency as a complementary evaluation dimension and demonstrate that TerraVis enables systematic quantification, diagnosis, and comparison of such failures. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/ShyFoo/TerraVis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TerraVis，一个评估生成图像"世界一致性"（world-grounded visual consistency）的框架，包含违规分类体系与多阶段评测方法，与人类判断的相关性优于现有指标。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图模型在真实感、美学和文本-图像对齐上进展显著，但生成图像仍可能出现物体结构畸形、解剖错误、物理不合理交互、空间关系不一致等违反现实世界合理性的问题。现有保真度、美学、偏好与对齐指标难以刻画这类失败，因此需要一个针对"世界一致性"的评测维度。
AI.method: TerraVis 首先定义了一个结构化的世界一致性违规分类体系，覆盖物体级、交互级和场景级失败；随后采用多阶段评测框架：给定图像，先用 MLLM 判断其是否适合评测，再检测 18 种分类体系定义的违规类型，并将其分为轻微（minor）或严重（major），据此计算总体世界一致性得分。
AI.result: 在两类广泛使用的基准上，对多种开源与闭源文生图模型进行评测，TerraVis 与人类世界一致性判断的相关性在现有指标中最强。基准结果还显示，在传统指标上表现优异的模型仍可能存在显著的世界一致性失败。
AI.conclusion: 世界一致性是一个互补的评测维度；TerraVis 能够系统性地量化、诊断和比较此类失败。代码已公开于 https://github.com/ShyFoo/TerraVis。

title: The Geometry of Knowledge Accessibility in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) contain broad knowledge, but they cannot access all of it reliably. We study this problem through knowledge accessibility, which describes whether the knowledge needed for a query can be recalled from the model. We find that knowledge accessibility has a simple geometric structure in the model's representation of the query alone, before any generation. More accessible queries are closer to a center in the representation space, while less accessible queries are farther away. This geometry reveals a knowledge boundary that separates more accessible queries from less accessible ones. Accessibility consistently decreases with distance from the center, and this distance-based ordering transfers across datasets even when the centers differ. Controlled experiments further show that the centered geometry is more closely related to knowledge accessibility than to reasoning difficulty. The geometry also reveals when different interventions are useful. Query rewriting helps more for accessible queries, chain-of-thought reasoning helps more near the boundary, and retrieval gives larger gains beyond the boundary. These findings not only provide a new geometric view of how knowledge is organized in language models, but also suggest a useful pre-generation signal for adaptive inference.

AI.tldr: 论文发现大语言模型对查询知识的可访问性在表示空间中呈简单几何结构：可访问的查询更靠近表示中心，不可访问的查询更远离中心，该距离构成"知识边界"，并可用于预测推理干预的有效性。
AI.motivation: LLM虽蕴含广泛知识，却无法可靠调用全部知识。作者希望在生成之前就能判断某个查询所需求的知识能否被模型召回，为自适应推理提供前置信号。
AI.method: 以"知识可访问性"为研究对象，在模型对查询本身的表示（生成之前）上分析几何结构；度量查询表示到表示空间中心的距离，考察其与可访问性的关系及跨数据集迁移性；并通过受控实验比较距离与推理难度的关联；最后对比查询重写、思维链推理与检索三类干预在不同距离区间的效果。
AI.result: 可访问性随离中心距离的增加而单调下降；基于距离的可访问性排序在中心不同的情况下仍能跨数据集迁移；该中心化几何比推理难度更能解释可访问性；不同干预呈现分区效应——查询重写对可访问查询更有效，思维链在边界附近更有帮助，检索在边界之外收益最大。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了语言模型内部知识组织的几何视角，并表明查询表示到中心的距离可作为生成前的有效信号，用于自适应选择推理策略。

title: From Language Priors to Field Adaptation: Preference Learning for Traversability Estimation
summary: Image-based traversability estimation is inherently dependent on the robot platform, deployment domain, and mission preferences, which limits the applicability of purpose-trained models. To facilitate domain adaptation, this work aims to reduce the number of required annotations in the target domain using sample-efficient preference learning. Our method represents traversability through von Mises-Fisher mixture prototypes in a frozen vision-language feature space. Relative natural-language rules provide a commonsense prior, while sparse relative image annotations adapt the prototype directions and utilities to a target domain through computationally and sample-efficient fine-tuning. Experiments on WayFAST demonstrate accuracy competitive with end-to-end trained estimators while enabling sample-efficient image-based adaptation. Qualitative experiments further demonstrate the language prior's zero shot applicability and the fine-tuned estimator's improved dense prediction on semantic maps. Evaluation is complemented via semantic interpretation of learned prototypes by dissecting semantically close natural language prompts. Code and trained estimators available at https://resireg.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出基于von Mises-Fisher混合原型与相对自然语言规则的通过性估计方法，在冻结视觉-语言特征空间中实现样本高效的域适应。
AI.motivation: 图像通过性估计高度依赖机器人平台、部署域和任务偏好，使专用训练模型难以泛化；目标域标注成本高，需减少所需标注量并实现域适应。
AI.method: 在冻结的视觉-语言特征空间中以von Mises-Fisher混合原型表示通过性；用相对自然语言规则提供常识先验，再用稀疏的相对图像标注通过计算与样本高效的微调来调整原型方向和效用，实现目标域适应。
AI.result: 在WayFAST上精度与端到端训练估计器相当，同时实现样本高效的图像域适应；定性实验显示语言先验的零样本适用性及微调估计器在语义地图上更优的密集预测；通过剖析语义相近的自然语言提示对学习到的原型进行语义解释。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过语言先验与稀疏相对标注的结合，实现了样本高效、可解释的通过性估计域适应，代码与训练模型已开源。

title: The AI Theorist reveals excitonic structure in $α$-RuCl$_3$
summary: Advances in experimental instrumentation and automation generate increasingly rich datasets, but turning experimental observations into microscopic understanding remains a bottleneck in scientific discovery. To accelerate this process, we introduce AI Theorist, a system of artificial intelligence (AI) agents for autonomous discovery of physical models through hypothesis generation, first-principles calculations and evidence-driven refinement. We apply the framework to $α$-RuCl$_3$, a leading candidate material for realizing a Kitaev quantum spin liquid, to investigate its electronic structure through optical spectra. AI Theorist develops a new interpretation of the optical and photocurrent observations, identifying distinct excitonic states with contrasting optical selection rules and real-space distributions. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of an AI system autonomously developing a physical model to explain previously unpublished experimental observations in a quantum material, utilizing first-principles electronic-structure and many-body calculations. Our results establish a route to autonomous theoretical discovery in materials science, in which AI agents use first-principles calculations to turn experimental observations into physical models and testable predictions.

AI.tldr: 提出AI Theorist系统，利用AI智能体自主完成物理模型发现，并在α-RuCl₃光学谱研究中首次实现AI自主发展物理解释。
AI.motivation: 实验仪器与自动化产生日益丰富的数据集，但将实验观测转化为微观物理理解仍是科学发现的瓶颈，亟需加速这一过程。
AI.method: 构建AI Theorist：一类AI智能体系统，通过假设生成、第一性原理计算与证据驱动的迭代精修，自主发现物理模型；应用于Kitaev量子自旋液体候选材料α-RuCl₃，结合第一性原理电子结构与多体计算分析其光学谱与光电流观测。
AI.result: AI Theorist提出对光学与光电流观测的新解释，识别出具有对比性光学选择定则与实空间分布的不同激子态；首次展示AI系统自主建立物理模型解释量子材料中此前未发表的实验观测。
AI.conclusion: 确立了材料科学中自主理论发现的路径：AI智能体可借助第一性原理计算，将实验观测转化为物理模型与可检验预测。

title: A GHOST in Long-Horizon Agents: Governance Hazard from Overlooked Safety Constraints across Turns
summary: Long-horizon agents are now playing an increasingly significant role in assisting humans with complex problem-solving. However, it is exactly their extended interaction history that introduces an underexplored execution-safety concern. Under benign interaction conditions, an agent may execute an action that violates a safety constraint specified many turns earlier. We term this failure mode Governance Hazard from Overlooked Safety Constraints across Turns (GHOST), which may cause irreversible damage. Our experiments reveal that GHOST events are not isolated cases: this failure mode, occurring precisely under benign interaction conditions, yields an occurrence rate of 11.5% on GPT-5.5. Furthermore, we theoretically show that if the residual conditional violation hazard along each safe prefix is bounded below by a non-summable sequence, the execution enters the hazard region almost surely. Leveraging this theoretical insight, we further propose STAR-Guard, a two-layer defense coupling historical semantic safety constraint restoration with pre-execution audit. STAR-Guard restores applicable safety constraints to reduce unsafe proposals, while its deterministic audit layer prevents residual violations from reaching the environment. Consistent with this two-layer design, we observe no GHOST events in our experiments under the GPT-5.5 setup.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示长时程智能体在良性交互下会违反多轮之前指定的安全约束（GHOST），实验显示GPT-5.5上发生率为11.5%，并从理论上给出近乎必然进入危险区的条件，提出双层防御STAR-Guard使实验中不再出现GHOST。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体承担复杂任务时交互历史很长，早期轮次给定的安全约束容易被遗忘或忽视；即使在良性交互条件下，智能体也可能执行违反多轮前安全约束的动作，造成不可逆损害。这一"执行安全"问题此前未被充分研究。
AI.method: 作者将该失效模式定义为GHOST（Governance Hazard from Overlooked Safety Constraints across Turns）。通过实验测量其发生率，并从理论上分析：若每个安全前缀上的残余条件违反风险下界为一个不可求和的序列，则执行几乎必然进入危险区域。基于该理论提出STAR-Guard双层防御：第一层为历史语义安全约束恢复，减少不安全动作提议；第二层为执行前确定性审计，阻止残余违规动作作用于环境。
AI.result: GHOST并非孤立事件：在良性交互条件下，GPT-5.5上的发生率为11.5%。理论分析表明，当残余条件违反风险下界不可求和时，几乎必然进入危险区。采用STAR-Guard后，在GPT-5.5设置下的实验中未观察到GHOST事件。
AI.conclusion: 长时程智能体存在被忽视的跨轮安全约束违反风险，且该风险在良性条件下即可频繁发生并具有近乎必然累积的理论性质；通过约束恢复与执行前确定性审计相结合的双层防御，可有效消除该类违规，验证了STAR-Guard设计的有效性。

title: Frequency Is Not Sensitivity Identifying Safety-Sensitive Experts in Sparse MoE LLM
summary: Suppressing a small set of routed experts can weaken the safety behavior of a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model without retraining. Which experts to suppress is therefore a security question, and the usual answer is activation frequency, but frequency measures use, not influence. We test an alternative: router-gradient sensitivity, the sensitivity of the sequence loss to the gate weights that select an expert. Across five MoE architectures, we rank experts by each signal on 500 benign and 500 malicious prompts and measure refusal on 100 held-out malicious prompts under two budgets: equal expert counts and equal nominal malicious routing traffic (1%-5%). Under each of the two budgets, router-gradient selection reduces refusals more than activation in 24 of 25 conditions, and more than a ten-trial random mean in all 25. The largest effect is in OLMoE, where refusals fall from 34 to 9 of 100 prompts (73.53% relative) with no degraded outputs, indicating substantive compliance rather than broken generation. After matching expert counts in every layer, gradient selection still produces greater refusal reduction than activation in 23 of 25 conditions, with two ties. An exploratory cross-model analysis links larger malicious-versus-benign concentration gaps to greater peak gradient effects (rho = 0.90; exact two-sided p = 0.083, n = 5). Together, the results support gradient selection under the tested budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用「路由器梯度敏感度」替代通用激活频率来定位稀疏 MoE 模型中与安全行为相关的专家：在五种架构、两种预算设置下，梯度选择法在25个条件中有24个比激活频率法更能降低拒答率，在OLMoE上拒答率从34/100降至9/100且输出质量未下降。
AI.motivation: 抑制少量被路由的专家即可在不重训练的情况下削弱稀疏 MoE 语言模型的安全行为，因此「该抑制哪些专家」本身是一个安全问题。当前主流做法是按激活频率排序，但频率只衡量专家的「使用程度」，并不衡量其对模型输出的「影响程度」，二者可能并不等价。
AI.method: 将「路由器梯度敏感度」定义为序列损失对选择某专家的门控权重的敏感度，并以此对专家排序。在五种 MoE 架构上，基于500条良性提示与500条恶意提示分别用两种信号对专家排序，并在100条留出恶意提示上测拒答率；设置两种预算：等专家数量预算与等名义恶意路由流量预算（1%–5%）。此外进行层级专家数量匹配的对照实验，以及跨模型的探索性相关分析。
AI.result: 在两种预算下，路由器梯度选择在25个条件中有24个比激活频率法带来更大的拒答下降，在全部25个条件中均优于十次随机试验的均值。最大效应出现在 OLMoE：拒答率从34/100降至9/100（相对下降73.53%），且未出现输出退化，说明是实质性顺从而非生成崩溃。按层匹配专家数量后，梯度选择在25个条件中有23个仍优于激活频率，2个持平。探索性跨模型分析显示，恶意与良性路由集中度差距越大，峰值梯度效应越强（rho = 0.90；双侧精确 p = 0.083，n = 5）。
AI.conclusion: 在所测试的预算范围内，结果支持使用路由器梯度敏感度而非激活频率来筛选需抑制的专家；该信号更能刻画专家对安全行为的真实影响。样本量有限（n = 5）使跨模型相关分析仅为探索性，需更大规模验证。

title: Post-Training Frontier Text-to-Image Models by Composing Preference and Rubric Rewards
summary: Recent text-to-image generation models have achieved remarkable visual quality, but improving them through post-training remains challenging because no single reward signal captures the full range of human preference. In this work, we develop a simple and effective post-training recipe for open-domain text-to-image generation based on the composition of complementary reward signals. Our reward system consists of two main components: a preference reward, trained on large-scale human preference data using a Bradley-Terry objective to capture overall human aesthetic and perceptual preferences, and rubric-based rewards, which explicitly evaluate prompt faithfulness and other desirable properties while providing safeguards against reward hacking. A key challenge is how to combine these heterogeneous reward signals. We show that a naive weighted average leads to suboptimal optimization behavior, and propose a simple reward composition strategy that more effectively balances preference optimization with rubric satisfaction. In the Arena text-to-image leaderboard (https://arena.ai/), our RL-trained Flux2dev achieves an Elo rating 69 points above the base model, and our post-trained Ideogram-4 surpasses every open-source model on the leaderboard, reaching an Elo of 1223.5. (Claims of state-of-the-art performance are based on the Arena leaderboard snapshot as of September 4, 2026.) Our results suggest that effective rewards for frontier generative-model training require broad coverage of user intent and robustness to exploitation under optimization. To support reproducible research, we release Arena-T2I-Training, a 1K subset of training data that recovers some gains of full-scale training, providing a resource that we hope will facilitate future work on post-training for text-to-image models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于互补奖励组合的文生图后训练方法，结合偏好奖励与评分规则奖励，使Flux2dev的Elo提升69分，后训练Ideogram-4达到Elo 1223.5，超越所有开源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图模型视觉质量已很高，但后训练受限于单一奖励信号无法全面刻画人类偏好，因此需要组合互补的奖励信号来提升优化效果。
AI.method: 奖励系统包含两部分：基于Bradley-Terry目标在大规模人类偏好数据上训练的偏好奖励，用于捕捉整体美学与感知偏好；以及显式评估提示词忠实度等属性的评分规则奖励，并提供防奖励破解的保障。针对异构信号融合难题，指出朴素加权平均会导致次优优化行为，提出一种简单有效的奖励组合策略，以更好平衡偏好优化与规则满足。
AI.result: 在Arena文生图排行榜上，经RL训练的Flux2dev相比基座模型Elo提升69分；后训练的Ideogram-4超越排行榜上所有开源模型，Elo达1223.5（以2026年9月4日排行榜快照为准）。同时发布Arena-T2I-Training，1K训练数据子集可复现部分全量训练收益。
AI.conclusion: 前沿生成模型训练的有效奖励需要广泛覆盖用户意图并具备抗优化利用的鲁棒性；所提方法为文生图后训练提供了可行路线与可复现资源。

title: HARPO: Hallucination-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Faithful and Creative Language Generation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are prone to generating hallucinated content, which compromises their reliability in knowledge-intensive tasks. To address this challenge without sacrificing creativity, we propose HARPO, a reinforcement learning framework designed to jointly optimize faithfulness and creativity. HARPO incorporates a Hallucination-Aware Generative Reward Model (HA-GRM), trained via verifiable feedback, to assess both faithfulness and writing quality. A Selective Activation Mechanism (SAM) activates writing rewards only for outputs judged hallucination-free by HA-GRM, while a data curriculum progressively shifts training from creative writing to hallucination-centric tasks. On RAGTruth, our Qwen3-4B-based HA-GRM achieves a response-level F1 score of 78.08%, compared with 66.37% for the supervised fine-tuning baseline. Experiments on Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 models from 1.7B to 8B parameters show improvements in both faithful generation and writing quality. On Qwen3-4B, HARPO reduces the HA-GRM-judged hallucination rate on MultiHopRAG from 3.29% to 1.02%, while increasing the Arena-Hard-v2.0 creative-writing score from 16.95% to 27.54%.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出HARPO强化学习框架，通过幻觉感知生成奖励模型（HA-GRM）与选择性激活机制（SAM），联合优化大语言模型的忠实性与创造力，在抑制幻觉的同时提升写作质量。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在知识密集型任务中易产生幻觉内容，损害其可靠性；但单纯抑制幻觉往往会牺牲模型的创造力，因此需要一种能兼顾忠实性与创造力的方法。
AI.method: 提出HARPO强化学习框架：(1) 训练幻觉感知生成奖励模型HA-GRM，基于可验证反馈评估忠实性与写作质量；(2) 选择性激活机制SAM，仅在HA-GRM判定输出无幻觉时才激活写作奖励；(3) 数据课程策略，使训练从创造性写作逐步过渡到以幻觉为中心的任务。
AI.result: 在RAGTruth上，基于Qwen3-4B的HA-GRM达到78.08%的响应级F1，优于监督微调基线的66.37%；在Qwen2.5与Qwen3（1.7B至8B）上，忠实生成与写作质量均有提升。Qwen3-4B上，MultiHopRAG的幻觉率由3.29%降至1.02%，Arena-Hard-v2.0创意写作得分由16.95%提升至27.54%。
AI.conclusion: HARPO能够在多个模型规模上同时提升忠实性与创造力，验证了联合优化幻觉抑制与写作质量的可行性与有效性。

title: On Representational Alignment among Embodied Agents
summary: Embodied agents interacting with the same physical process may maintain heterogeneous, asynchronous, and observer-relative representations. Rather than assuming that such representations should always be globally aligned, we investigate which distinctions among them must actually be resolved for coherent interaction. We formalize this question through relational sufficiency: an interaction-specific relational-evidence map defines the representational ambiguity left unresolved by comparison, and sufficiency holds when each residual ambiguity fiber lies within an interaction-equivalence class. When this condition fails, additional sensorimotor anchors must separate precisely the ambiguities that can change the interaction-relevant outcome. For smooth systems, we derive a local first-order lower bound on the number of inde- pendent scalar anchors required, given by the dimension of directions that are invisible to relational evidence but visible to the interaction-relevant map. We instantiate the theory in two variants of an asynchronous hand-off scenario that share the same observer agents, representations, transports, and relational evidence. Relative synchronization requires no additional anchor, whereas hand-off at an absolute time requires exactly one. The analysis there- fore provides a task-relative stopping condition for representational alignment: residual disagreement need not be eliminated when it is invariant with respect to the interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"关系充分性"(relational sufficiency)框架，用以判定具身智能体间异构、异步、观察者相对的表征在何种条件下无需全局对齐即可支撑有效交互，并给出所需额外感知运动锚点的局部一阶下界。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体与同一物理过程交互时，各自的表征往往异构、异步且依赖于观察者视角。已有工作多默认表征应全局对齐，但作者质疑这种假设的必要性：真正需要被消解的差异，只是那些会改变交互相关结果的区别。因此需要一个交互特定的判据，说明残差分歧何时可以保留、何时必须消解。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为关系充分性：以交互特定的关系证据映射刻画比较后仍未消解的表征歧义，当每个残差歧义纤维完全落入某一交互等价类时即满足充分性。充分性失效时，须引入额外感知运动锚点以分离那些能改变交互相关结果的歧义。针对光滑系统，通过"对关系证据不可见但被交互相关映射可见"的方向维数，导出所需独立标量锚点数的局部一阶下界。
AI.result: 在一异步交接(hand-off)场景的两个变体中验证该理论，两变体共享相同的观察者智能体、表征、传输与关系证据：仅需相对同步的变体无需额外锚点，而要求在绝对时间完成交接的变体恰需一个锚点。锚点需求的下界与实际差别精确吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该分析给出了表征对齐的任务相对停止条件：当残差分歧关于交互不变量保持不变量时，无须予以消除；只有会影响交互相关结果的歧义才需用数量由局部一阶下界决定的最小锚点集加以分离。

title: Geometry-Aware Time Reparameterization for Flow-Map Distillation
summary: Flow-map distillation enables one- and few-step generation by learning finite-time transitions of a pretrained generative ODE. We investigate whether changing the teacher's time parameterization can make these transitions easier to learn. Motivated by the hypothesis that trajectory segments with large normal acceleration are harder to distill, we propose a geometry-aware time reparameterization that allocates more student time to these regions while preserving the teacher's geometric paths and terminal distribution. We derive a shared clock that equalizes a population normal-acceleration statistic under suitable assumptions, and construct a practical approximation from robust, regularized estimates across teacher trajectories. We incorporate this clock into Lagrangian flow-map distillation, using the transformed time coordinate to condition the student. The clock is estimated once before distillation and requires neither teacher retraining nor additional student parameters or inference-time network evaluations. Experiments on synthetic data, CIFAR-10, and CelebA-64 show improved sample quality over identity-time distillation at matched inference budgets, including improvements in one- and two-step image generation. The gains in one-step generation, where no intermediate sampling times can be adjusted, highlight the benefits of time reparameterization during distillation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种几何感知的时间重参数化方法（共享时钟），将更多学生时间分配给法向加速度大的轨迹段，用于提升流映射蒸馏的一步/少步生成质量，无需重训教师或增加学生参数。
AI.motivation: 流映射蒸馏通过让学生学习预训练生成ODE在有限时间内的跃迁，实现一步或几步生成。论文假设轨迹段法向加速度越大越难蒸馏，因此希望通过改变教师的时间参数化，使这些难学区域获得更多学生时间，从而降低蒸馏难度。
AI.method: 1) 提出几何感知的时间重参数化，保持教师几何路径与终端分布不变，仅在时间轴上重新分配学生时间；2) 在适当假设下推导一个共享时钟，使群体的法向加速度统计量被均衡化；3) 基于教师轨迹的稳健、正则化估计构建可实现的近似时钟；4) 将该时钟引入拉格朗日流映射蒸馏，用变换后的时间坐标对学生网络进行条件化；5) 时钟在蒸馏前一次性估计，无需教师重训、不增加学生参数或推理期网络评估。
AI.result: 在合成数据、CIFAR-10和CelebA-64上的实验表明，在相同推理预算下，相比恒等时间蒸馏，样本质量均有提升，包括一步和两步图像生成的改进。
AI.conclusion: 一步生成中无法调整中间采样时间，其性能提升尤其能说明蒸馏过程中时间重参数化的价值。

title: Spend Teacher Tokens Where They Matter: Success-Referenced On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) combines student-generated rollouts with dense token-level supervision from a teacher, but providing such supervision for every rollout requires substantial teacher computation. We introduce Success-Referenced On-Policy Distillation (SR-OPD), which reduces this cost by selecting which prompts and rollouts receive teacher supervision. When the student produces both successful and failed rollouts for the same prompt, a successful rollout can serve as a natural reference for selecting failed rollouts. SR-OPD therefore focuses on such prompts and prioritizes failed rollouts whose hidden-state trajectories show sustained divergence from a successful reference, while accounting for estimated teacher-input cost. Across three teacher-student pairs and six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SR-OPD uses only 3.46-5.02% of the teacher-input tokens required by Vanilla OPD in the one-pass setting while maintaining comparable reasoning performance. Under a controlled setting matched to 5% of Vanilla OPD's teacher-input budget, further experiments support both key design choices: focusing supervision on prompts with both successful and failed rollouts, and using successful rollouts to guide failure selection. These results indicate that a student's own successful behavior can serve as a useful reference for allocating teacher supervision under a fixed teacher-input budget.

AI.tldr: SR-OPD 通过筛选提示与 rollout 来降低 on-policy distillation 的教师监督成本：只对同时存在成功与失败 rollout 的提示进行监督，并以成功 rollout 为参考，优先选择隐藏状态轨迹持续偏离成功参考的失败 rollout。在三个师生对和六个数学推理基准上，仅用 Vanilla OPD 3.46–5.02% 的教师输入 token 即可保持相当推理性能。
AI.motivation: On-policy distillation 虽结合了学生 rollout 与教师 token 级密集监督，但对每个 rollout 都提供监督需要大量教师计算，成本过高。因此需要一种在固定教师输入预算下更高效地分配监督的方法。
AI.method: 提出 Success-Referenced On-Policy Distillation（SR-OPD）。当学生对同一提示产生成功与失败 rollout 时，成功 rollout 可作为自然参考。SR-OPD 聚焦此类提示，并优先选择隐藏状态轨迹相对成功参考持续偏离的失败 rollout，同时考虑估计的教师输入成本。
AI.result: 在三个师生对、六个数学推理基准上，单遍设置中 SR-OPD 仅使用 Vanilla OPD 所需教师输入 token 的 3.46–5.02%，推理性能相当。在匹配 Vanilla OPD 教师输入预算 5% 的受控设置下，进一步实验支持两项关键设计：聚焦同时含成功与失败 rollout 的提示，以及用成功 rollout 指导失败选择。
AI.conclusion: 学生自身的成功行为可作为有用参考，在固定教师输入预算下指导教师监督的分配，从而在显著降低教师计算成本的同时保持推理性能。

title: Certified Mechanistic Edits: Behavioral Guarantees for Skill Removal and Preservation
summary: Mechanistic edits (ablations, weight edits, activation steering) are the standard tools for unlearning a harmful capability from a neural network while preserving useful ones. Current approaches validate their effects only by testing, which can never cover an entire continuous region of inputs. Prior work at the interpretability-verification boundary certifies descriptions of a model: what a circuit computes, or whether it faithfully explains the whole. We instead certify the behavioral effect of an edit: that disabling a circuit removes one skill and provably preserves another, for every input in a region; a feature non-interference guarantee in the information-flow-security sense. We demonstrate such certified edits from toy ReLU networks up to a standard softmax + LayerNorm transformer, proving removal and preservation over continuous embedding-space regions and reaching roughly 9x the input-perturbation dimension an exact solver can handle by switching to sound bound propagation. Furthermore, we prove that no finite deterministic black-box test can certify removal, exhibiting an edit that passes exhaustive testing yet provably fails on a survivor pocket that can be made arbitrarily small. Guarantees hold on small, standard-architecture networks and, like any removal claim, presuppose that the target skill admits a decidable specification, a property which real-world harms may not have.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对机制编辑的"行为效应"进行认证：证明在连续输入区域内禁用某电路可移除一项能力且保持另一项能力，实现信息流安全意义上的特征非干扰保证，并证明有限黑盒测试无法认证移除。
AI.motivation: 现有机制编辑（消融、权重编辑、激活引导）仅靠测试验证效果，无法覆盖连续输入区域的全部输入；已有可解释性-验证工作只认证模型描述（电路计算内容或解释保真度），而非编辑的行为效应。
AI.method: 将编辑效应形式化为特征非干扰保证：在连续嵌入空间区域内证明移除与保持；对玩具 ReLU 网络直至标准 softmax+LayerNorm Transformer 进行认证；用可靠的界传播（bound propagation）替代精确求解器以扩展可处理维度；并用构造性反例证明不存在有限确定性黑盒测试能认证移除。
AI.result: 在连续嵌入空间区域上证明了移除与保持，输入扰动维度约为精确求解器可处理规模的 9 倍；构造出一个能通过穷举测试却在任意小"幸存者口袋"上必然失败的编辑；保证在小规模标准架构网络上成立。
AI.conclusion: 认证机制编辑的行为效应可行且强于测试，但任何移除声明都预设目标能力具有可判定规范，真实世界危害可能不具备该性质。

title: Rethinking Fixed Temporal Grids: Frequency-Disentangled Motion Generation
summary: Most human motion generation methods encode motion as tokens on a uniform temporal grid, where every token spans the same fixed time window. Human motion, however, is temporally heterogeneous: slowly evolving global trajectories coexist with rapid transient events such as foot contacts and joint impulses. Forcing such multi-scale dynamics onto tokens of identical temporal resolution entangles motion frequencies, leaving slow regions redundant while smoothing out the rapid details that distinguish realistic motion. We propose \textbf{FreqMo}, a scale-adaptive motion representation that decomposes motion into wavelet frequency bands, separating dynamics across temporal scales while preserving temporal localization and exact reconstruction. Unified Frequency Residual Quantization (UFRQ) then encodes all bands within a single shared codebook, compressing the token sequence threefold and enabling stable single-stage generation. Experiments show FreqMo attains SOTA fidelity with substantially improved high-frequency preservation, and the same decomposition transfers to continuous diffusion backbones.

AI.tldr: FreqMo 提出一种尺度自适应的人体运动表示，利用小波频带分解将运动按时间尺度分离，并用统一频率残差量化（UFRQ）在单一共享码本中编码所有频带，实现三倍token压缩与稳定的单阶段生成，在高频细节保真度上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有运动生成方法将运动编码为均匀时间网格上的token，每个token覆盖相同固定时间窗口。但人体运动在时间上是异质的：缓慢演化的全局轨迹与快速瞬态事件（如足部接触、关节冲击）并存。将这种多尺度动态强行映射到相同时间分辨率的token上，会造成运动频率纠缠，使缓慢区域冗余，同时抹平区分真实运动的高频快速细节。
AI.method: 提出 FreqMo，一种尺度自适应的运动表示，将运动分解为小波频带，在时间尺度上分离动态，同时保持时间局部化与精确重建。随后使用统一频率残差量化（UFRQ），在单一共享码本中编码所有频带。
AI.result: UFRQ 将token序列压缩三倍，并支持稳定的单阶段生成。实验表明 FreqMo 达到SOTA保真度，高频保持能力显著提升，且该分解可迁移到连续扩散骨干网络。
AI.conclusion: FreqMo 通过小波频带分解与统一残差量化，解决了均匀时间网格token对多尺度运动动态的频率纠缠问题，在高频细节保真度上取得SOTA，并具备向扩散模型等不同骨干的通用迁移能力。

title: Unmasking Propaganda: A Comparative Analysis of Masked and Causal Language Models
summary: Propaganda detection is an essential task in natural language processing (NLP), particularly in the context of manipulative political communications. However, identifying specific propaganda techniques presents a significant challenge due to their often subtle nature and reliance on context, making them difficult to distinguish from legitimate persuasive language. Propaganda often involves highlighting certain facts while downplaying or ignoring others to create a desired perception. This biased communication aims to influence attitudes, beliefs, or behaviors towards a particular cause or position. This paper explores advances in detecting propaganda techniques through a comparative analysis of modern language models, using the SemEval-2020 Task 11 dataset. We evaluated both masked language models (based on XLM-RoBERTa or DeBERTa V3) and causal models (from OpenAI, Google, Mistral, Anthropic and Meta), employing two prompting strategies: base and chain-of-thought prompting. Our results demonstrate improvements over state-of-the-art models, with the best-performing MLM achieving an F1 score of 63.18 in technique classification and the best causal model achieving 63.62. We also observed that certain models excel in specific techniques, such as loaded language and name-calling, while struggling with others like bandwagon and black-and-white fallacy. These findings suggest that fine-tuning, ensemble modeling, and the use of larger datasets can further enhance propaganda detection capabilities.

AI.tldr: 该论文基于SemEval-2020 Task 11数据集，对比评估了掩码语言模型（XLM-RoBERTa、DeBERTa V3）与因果模型（OpenAI、Google、Mistral、Anthropic、Meta），采用基础提示与思维链提示两种策略，在宣传技巧检测上取得优于现有SOTA的结果。
AI.motivation: 宣传检测在操纵性政治传播中至关重要，但具体宣传技巧的识别因手法隐蔽且高度依赖语境，难以与合法的说服性语言区分，因此需要探索有效的检测方法。
AI.method: 使用SemEval-2020 Task 11数据集，对现代语言模型进行对比分析：一类是掩码语言模型（基于XLM-RoBERTa或DeBERTa V3），另一类是因果模型（来自OpenAI、Google、Mistral、Anthropic和Meta），并采用基础提示与思维链（chain-of-thought）两种提示策略。
AI.result: 结果优于当前最先进模型：表现最佳的掩码语言模型在技巧分类上F1为63.18，最佳因果模型为63.62。此外，模型在某些技巧（如loaded language、name-calling）上表现优异，而在另一些技巧（如bandwagon、black-and-white fallacy）上表现较差。
AI.conclusion: 微调、集成建模以及使用更大规模的数据集可进一步提升宣传检测能力。

title: Subject-Specific Predictive Musculoskeletal Simulations of Lower-Limb Exoskeleton Assistance: Metabolic and Biomechanical Effects of Joint Assistance Strategies
summary: Lower-limb exoskeletons have made considerable progress in reducing energy expenditure during walking. However, designing optimal assistance strategies remains challenging, particularly given inter-individual variability in anthropometry and biomechanics. This study explores energy-optimal lower-limb joint-assistance strategies using predictive simulations with musculoskeletal models. Subject-specific models of six able-bodied subjects, with BMI-based muscle strength scaling, were used in predictive simulations to generate gait at self-selected walking speeds. Ideal actuators were incorporated to simulate various combinations of joint assistance at peak levels of 25 Nm and 50 Nm to examine the effects of assistance on gait and metabolic savings. The effects of each assistance configuration were assessed through cost of transport (COT), joint kinematics, muscle activations, assistive torques, and joint-level power metrics to characterize the biomechanical and energetic impacts of different assistance strategies. At 50 Nm, combined H+K+A (hip-knee-ankle) assistance resulted in the greatest mean COT reduction of 48.50 +/- 4.55%, with individual reductions ranging from 42.22% to 54.65% across the subjects. Among single-joint conditions, assisting the hip was most effective, reducing COT by 31.77 +/- 5.21%; the knee and ankle produced smaller, comparable reductions (19.17% and 17.02%). H+A (hip-ankle) assistance (44.60 +/- 7.08%) emerged as the most effective two-joint assistive configuration. Increasing the torque bound increased positive assistive power primarily at the hip and ankle, while knee assistance showed little sensitivity and delivered positive power near pre-swing. These results support H+A assistance as an efficient two-actuator target, while identifying the knee's atypical pre-swing power strategy as a candidate for targeted experimental validation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过肌肉骨骼模型预测仿真，系统评估了不同下肢关节助力组合对步行能耗的影响，发现50 Nm下髋-膝-踝联合助力节能最优，双关节中髋-踝助力最高效。
AI.motivation: 下肢外骨骼在降低步行能耗方面已有进展，但受个体间人体测量学与生物力学差异影响，最优助力策略设计仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 采用六名健全受试者的个体化肌肉骨骼模型（基于BMI进行肌力缩放），通过预测仿真生成自选步速步态；引入理想作动器，在25 Nm与50 Nm峰值下模拟多种关节助力组合，以COT、关节运动学、肌肉激活、助力力矩及关节功率指标评估各配置效果。
AI.result: 50 Nm下，H+K+A联合助力平均COT降低最多，为48.50±4.55%（个体范围42.22%–54.65%）；单关节中髋助力最有效（31.77±5.21%），膝与踝相近且较低（19.17%和17.02%）；双关节中H+A最佳（44.60±7.08%）。增大扭矩上限主要提升髋与踝的正助力功率，膝助力敏感性低，正功率集中于预摆动期。
AI.conclusion: H+A助力是高效的双作动器目标方案，而膝关节在预摆动期的非典型功率策略值得开展针对性实验验证。

title: CRISP: A Framework for Clause-Reconstructed Interpretable NeuroSymbolic Propositions
comment: Preprint for an accepted paper at International Symposium of the Tsetlin Machine (ISTM) 2026 Conference
summary: Deep neural networks achieve high accuracy through layered numerical transformations, yet their decisions remain difficult to audit because decision evidence is encoded in hidden activations rather than explicit rules. This paper introduces CRISP, a framework that reconstructs the last-layer activation vector (LLAV) of binary neural teachers as Tsetlin Machine (TM) clauses. CRISP sign-binarizes the teacher's penultimate pre-logit activations, and assigns one Individual TM (ITM) to each LLAV neuron. Each reconstructed hidden bit is represented by propositional clauses over Booleanized input features, which gives a direct symbolic trace from named input thresholds to a named teacher neuron. CRISP is evaluated on MNIST, KMNIST, FashionMNIST (FMNIST), SVHN, and CIFAR10 using a BinaryConnect convolutional neural network (BCCNN) teacher and a fully binary neural network (BNN) teacher, with an additional study on binary thresholding, thermometer encoding, and quartile binning at multiple bit depths. The results show that LLAV sign-binarization does not reduce teacher-head accuracy in the tested BNN setting, while ITM reconstruction error is the main limiting factor. Quartile one-bit Booleanization gives the strongest reconstruction fidelity on SVHN at 87.52% test fidelity and is competitive on CIFAR10, and the reconstructed LLAV preserves 78.41% teacher-head accuracy on FMNIST. Pooled clause-evidence visualizations show that the learned ITM literals concentrate on the object region in centered benchmarks. CRISP therefore provides a clause-level route for inspecting the final hidden representation of binary neural teachers.

AI.tldr: CRISP 将二值神经网络教师的最后一层激活向量（LLAV）逐神经元重建为 Tsetlin Machine 子句，提供从输入阈值到教师神经元的符号化追溯路径。
AI.motivation: 深度网络的决策证据编码在隐层激活中而非显式规则里，导致其决策难以审计；本文试图为二值神经教师提供可审计的规则级解释。
AI.method: 对教师网络倒数第二层（pre-logit）激活进行符号二值化得到 LLAV；为每个 LLAV 神经元分配一个 Individual TM（ITM）；每个重建隐位用基于布尔化输入特征的命题子句表示；在 MNIST、KMNIST、FMNIST、SVHN、CIFAR10 上以 BCCNN 和全二值 BNN 为教师进行评估，并对比二值阈值化、温度计编码与四分位分箱等多种位深方案。
AI.result: LLAV 符号二值化在测试的 BNN 设定下不降低教师头部精度，ITM 重建误差为主要限制因素；四分位一比特布尔化在 SVHN 上取得最佳重建保真度 87.52% 测试保真度，在 CIFAR10 上亦具竞争力；重建 LLAV 在 FMNIST 上保留 78.41% 教师头部精度；池化子句证据可视化显示所学 ITM 文字集中于居中基准数据集的目标区域。
AI.conclusion: CRISP 为检视二值神经教师的最终隐层表示提供了一条子句级的可解释路线。

title: DataWeave: Deploying Human-LLM Analytics for Exploratory Structured Data Analysis
summary: Data journalism, the practice of using data analysis to surface newsworthy stories, depends increasingly on the ability of reporters and investigative journalists to uncover trends, disparities, and accountability narratives. In practice, exploring large structured datasets remains slow and brittle: journalists must navigate hundreds of variables across many datasets over years, understand data coding conventions, and write non-trivial analysis code while hypotheses evolve. Although LLMs are often touted as "ask in English, get SQL/answers," real newsroom workflows expose recurring failures, e.g., schema mismatches and drift, misread domain semantics and units, and silent assumptions. We present DataWeave, a system that addresses these needs by combining conversational interaction, schema grounding, analytical planning, and executable query generation to support exploratory analysis over structured data. Rather than treating LLMs as autonomous answer engines, DataWeave frames them as interactive partners whose outputs can be inspected, corrected, and steered as hypotheses shift. We present a case study with professional journalists using our system to analyze the U.S. Department of Education's Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS), a high-stakes public dataset with substantial domain semantics and frequent schema updates. We also report how deployment experience and iterative refinement shaped the current DataWeave architecture and its analytical workflow. Our findings distill design principles and deployment lessons for trustworthy human-LLM collaboration in structured data analysis.

AI.tldr: DataWeave通过结合对话交互、模式接地、分析规划和可执行查询生成，支持结构化数据的探索式分析，并以美国教育部IPEDS数据集的记者案例研究为验证，提炼出人机协作的设计原则与部署经验。
AI.motivation: 数据新闻依赖记者对大型结构化数据集进行趋势、差异与问责叙事的挖掘，但现实中探索过程缓慢且脆弱：记者需跨多年、多数据集处理上百个变量，理解数据编码约定，并在假设不断演变时编写非平凡的代码。尽管LLM常被宣传为"用英语提问即可获得SQL/答案"，但真实新闻编辑室工作流暴露了模式不匹配与漂移、领域语义与单位误读、隐性假设等反复出现的失败。
AI.method: 提出DataWeave系统，融合对话交互、模式接地（schema grounding）、分析规划与可执行查询生成。不将LLM视为自主答案引擎，而是作为可检查、可纠正、可随假设变化而引导的交互伙伴。以专业记者使用该系统分析美国教育部IPEDS数据集为案例，并报告部署经验与迭代改进如何塑造当前架构及分析工作流。
AI.result: 案例研究展示了专业记者在IPEDS这一高利害、领域语义丰富且模式频繁更新的公共数据集上的分析实践；部署经验与迭代优化明确了DataWeave的架构构成与工作流形态。
AI.conclusion: 研究提炼出面向结构化数据分析中可信人-LLM协作的设计原则与部署经验，强调将LLM定位为可交互、可验证的协作伙伴而非自动答案生成器。

title: Reasoning Models Are Accurate but Unsound on Identification
summary: A reasoning model asked whether a causal effect is recoverable from observational data can fail in two ways: it refuses an identifiable query or answers a nonidentifiable one. The latter is more consequential, as no observational data can validate the claimed formula. Measuring this failure requires queries that are provably non-identifiable, which prior evaluations lack, and grading that accepts correct formulas in any equivalent form, which string matching cannot provide. We build CERTID, a formal identification pipeline that addresses both limitations. CERTID uses the sound and complete causal identification algorithm ID to certify whether an effect is identifiable from a given graph and query, and verifies returned formulas against structural causal models whose interventional distributions are known exactly. CERTID further develops theoretical results to mitigate structural leakage, repair non-identifiable queries, and establish grading guarantees. We evaluate three frontier reasoning models (Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and GPT5.5) on 1,200 certified instances spanning 4 to 50 vertices. Accuracy proves a poor proxy for soundness: on identical instances, the false-claim rate on non-identifiable queries varies by seventeen-fold across models. We also find that models decide identifiability with 97-100% accuracy on graphs generated after the strongest model's training snapshot. Instances, the certification procedure, the verifier, and per-instance records are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/certid-D718.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CERTID，一个基于ID算法与已知干预分布的结构因果模型来认证因果效应可识别性并验证公式等价性的形式化评估流水线，用于评测推理模型的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 推理模型在回答“因果效应能否从观测数据中恢复”时有两种失败：拒绝可识别查询、或对不可识别查询给出断言。后者更严重，因为没有任何观测数据能验证其给出的公式。而既有评测缺少可证明不可识别的查询，也无法在公式任意等价形式下打分（字符串匹配无法实现）。
AI.method: CERTID 使用可靠且完备的因果识别算法 ID，在给定图和查询下判定效应是否可识别；并将模型返回的公式与干预分布已知的结构因果模型进行验证。此外发展了理论结果以缓解结构泄漏、修复不可识别查询，并建立评分保证。
AI.result: 在 1,200 个认证实例（4 到 50 个顶点）上评测三个前沿推理模型（Gemini Flash、Gemini Pro、GPT5.5）：准确率是可靠性的糟糕代理指标——在相同实例上，不可识别查询的虚假断言率跨模型相差十七倍；同时模型在最强模型训练快照之后生成的图上仍以 97–100% 准确率判断可识别性。
AI.conclusion: 准确率不能反映模型在非可识别查询上的可靠性，需要基于可证明不可识别实例与等价公式认证的评测；CERTID 提供了相应实例、认证流程、验证器及逐实例记录。

title: RYOPO: Bringing End-to-End Category-Level Object Pose Estimation into Real Time
summary: Category-level object pose estimation predicts the rotation, translation, and metric size of unseen instances within known categories. Many accurate RGB-D methods rely on external instance segmentation and crop-based pose estimation, introducing separate stages and object-dependent processing costs that hinder real-time inference. To bring accurate pose estimation into real time, we present \ours{}, an end-to-end trainable query-based RGB-D set predictor. It jointly detects and segments objects and estimates their \mbox{9-DoF} poses without explicit CAD-derived shape priors or a separately trained instance segmentor. Shared image and scene encoding avoids repeated per-object crop encoding. A query-conditioned geometry pathway associates observed 3D points and RGB features with object queries and incorporates shared scene context. Object-centric refinement uses the resulting point descriptors to update an explicit pose state through pose-conditioned cross-attention and recurrent residual corrections. On NOCS, \ours{} substantially improves on published RGB-D joint detection and pose estimation results. It achieves competitive performance compared with two-stage methods under all-object evaluation on REAL275 and HouseCat6D, while enabling real-time full-frame pose estimation at $31.8$ FPS on an RTX~A6000. Project page: https://yopo-series.github.io/RYOPO-project-page/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RYOPO，一种端到端可训练的查询式RGB-D集合预测器，联合完成目标检测、分割与9-DoF位姿估计，实现实时全帧类别级位姿估计（RTX A6000上31.8 FPS）。
AI.motivation: 现有高精度RGB-D位姿估计方法依赖外部实例分割与基于裁剪的位姿估计，引入分离阶段和与目标数量相关的处理开销，难以实现实时推理。作者希望将高精度位姿估计带入实时场景。
AI.method: 提出端到端可训练的查询式RGB-D集合预测器RYOPO：无需显式CAD形状先验和单独训练的实例分割器；采用共享图像与场景编码避免逐目标重复裁剪编码；设计查询条件几何通路，将观测3D点与RGB特征关联到目标查询并融合共享场景上下文；通过目标中心精化，利用所得点描述子，经位姿条件交叉注意力和循环残差修正更新显式位姿状态。
AI.result: 在NOCS上显著优于已发表的RGB-D联合检测与位姿估计结果；在REAL275和HouseCat6D的全部目标评测下与两阶段方法相比具有竞争力，同时在RTX A6000上以31.8 FPS实现实时全帧位姿估计。
AI.conclusion: RYOPO通过端到端查询式框架统一检测、分割与位姿估计，消除外部实例分割与裁剪依赖，在保持竞争性精度的同时实现实时全帧类别级位姿估计。

title: An automated pipeline for standardised speech-unit annotation in spontaneous dialogue
summary: Quantifying conversational dynamics requires reliable identification of interactional units and their temporal boundaries, but speech activity alone does not distinguish conversational turns from listener feedback or within-turn pauses. We present an automated pipeline for extracting turns and backchannels from separate-channel recordings of spontaneous dyadic conversation, designed to provide a consistent first-pass annotation for subsequent human review. The pipeline combines voice activity detection, channel-energy filtering, temporal merging, automatic speech recognition, and context-based post-processing. We evaluated the pipeline on 99 ten-minute Danish conversations from 33 dyads using segment-level detection reliability and temporal boundary error. Conversations were recorded under both normal and asymmetric listening conditions. In the latter, speech-shaped noise was delivered to one participant through bone-conduction headphones. Overall detection reliability was F1=0.621, with similar performance for turns F1=0.624 and backchannels F1=0.618. For successfully matched segments, median absolute onset and offset errors were 0.150 and 0.160s for turns and 0.130 and 0.180s for backchannels, respectively. Mean errors were substantially larger for turn boundaries, indicating a smaller number of large boundary mismatches. Performance did not differ significantly across the two experimental listening conditions. In a four-conversation case study, pipeline-human agreement was lower and more variable than human inter-annotator agreement and varied across parameter settings. These results support the pipeline as an automated first pass within a semi-automated annotation workflow, providing a consistent basis for more standardised and reproducible annotation of conversational dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出一个自动化流程，从分通道双人对话录音中提取话轮（turns）与反馈语（backchannels），用于半自动标注的初筛。在99段10分钟丹麦语对话上评估，整体F1=0.621，边界中位误差约0.13–0.18秒，两种听音条件下无显著差异。
AI.motivation: 量化会话动态需要可靠识别互动单元及其时间边界，但仅靠语音活动无法区分话轮、听话人反馈（backchannel）与话轮内停顿。该研究旨在提供一个一致的自动化初筛标注，以支持后续人工复核，推动会话动态标注的标准化与可重复性。
AI.method: 构建自动化流程，组合语音活动检测（VAD）、通道能量过滤、时间合并、自动语音识别（ASR）与基于上下文的后处理，从分通道自发双人对话录音中提取话轮与反馈语。在33组被试的99段10分钟丹麦语对话上评估，采用片段级检测可靠性与时间边界误差指标；对话在正常与非对称听音两种条件下录制（后者通过骨导耳机向一名参与者播放语音型噪声）。另对4段对话进行流程与人工标注一致性案例研究。
AI.result: 整体检测可靠性F1=0.621，话轮F1=0.624，反馈语F1=0.618。对成功匹配的片段，话轮起止中位绝对误差为0.150秒与0.160秒，反馈语为0.130秒与0.180秒；话轮边界的平均误差明显更大，表明存在少量较大边界错配。两种实验听音条件间性能无显著差异。案例研究中，流程与人工的一致性低于且波动大于人工标注者间一致性，并随参数设置变化。
AI.conclusion: 该流程适合作为半自动标注工作流中的自动化初筛，为更标准化、可重复的会话动态标注提供一致基础。检测可靠性中等、边界精度较高但仍存在少量大误差，且与人工标注的一致性尚未达到人工间一致性水平，因此仍需人工复核。

title: Safe Streaming Flow Planning by Aligning Sampling Dynamics with Execution Dynamics
comment: Accepted to the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026). Project page: https://jang-seunghwan.github.io/SafeStreamingFlowPlanning/
summary: Generative planners based on diffusion/flow matching can learn to synthesize long-horizon trajectories from demonstrations. However, real-world deployment requires (i) enforcing safety constraints during execution and (ii) tight online replanning at fast execution rates. Prior safe diffusion/flow planners generate the agent's full trajectory at once, while repeatedly perturbing intermediate states to satisfy safety constraints. This approach is not only computationally intensive, but also introduces distribution shift since the learned sampling dynamics is distinct from the system's execution dynamics. We propose SafeStreamingFlow, a goal-conditioned planner that aligns flow sampling dynamics with execution dynamics by sequentially integrating a learned state vector field with hierarchical state prediction. Importantly, we need to enforce safety constraints only for the executed step via high order control barrier functions. Across navigation, racing, and locomotion benchmarks, SafeStreamingFlow reduces planning latency and improves safety compared to existing methods, while maintaining competitive goal-reaching success.

AI.tldr: SafeStreamingFlow：一种目标条件流匹配规划器，通过将流采样动力学与执行动力学对齐，实现安全约束下的快速在线重规划。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散/流匹配的生成式规划器能从示教中学习长时域轨迹，但实际部署需要（i）执行时施加安全约束，（ii）以快速执行速率进行紧密的在线重规划。先前安全扩散/流规划器一次性生成完整轨迹并反复扰动中间状态以满足安全约束，不仅计算量大，还因采样动力学与执行动力学不同而引入分布偏移。
AI.method: 提出SafeStreamingFlow：目标条件规划器，通过顺序积分学习到的状态向量场并结合分层状态预测，将流采样动力学与执行动力学对齐；仅对实际执行的那一步，利用高阶控制屏障函数（HOCBF）施加安全约束。
AI.result: 在导航、竞速与运动（locomotion）基准上，相比现有方法，SafeStreamingFlow降低了规划延迟、提升了安全性，同时保持有竞争力的目标到达成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过流采样与执行动力学的对齐以及仅对执行步施加HOCBF安全约束，可在安全性与规划效率上同时获益，适用于实时安全规划。

title: Are you Synthesizing or Recalling? Evaluating LLMs on Algorithmic Code Retrieval
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in code generation, where success depends on both recalling relevant algorithmic knowledge and reasoning about how to apply it. However, existing LLM pipelines are opaque, with no explicit separation between these two components. We argue that for well-known algorithms whose canonical implementations are widely accessible in pretraining corpora, code generation is better measured as \textit{parametric code retrieval}: reproducing a named algorithm from internalised knowledge rather than synthesizing a novel one. We introduce AlgoREval, a benchmark of 599 problems spanning classical 77 algorithms across 14 domains, 7 programming languages, and 4 graph-input representations to evaluate this capability in isolation, and assess 15 models (7B--34B parameters) in a zero-shot setting. We find substantial variation in retrieval accuracy across languages and input representations, even for widely documented algorithms and show that prompt augmentation with retrieved code snippets or structured algorithmic hints improve accuracy on complex algorithms, while SFT achieves broader language gains and GRPO achieves larger per-language gains on specific languages. Together, our results establish parametric code retrieval as a distinct, measurable capability and caution against deploying AI-generated algorithmic code without systematic validation.\footnote{Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Nickil21/AlgoREval

AI.tldr: 论文提出将知名算法的代码生成重新定义为"参数化代码检索"能力，并构建AlgoREval基准（599题、77种算法、14领域、7语言、4种图输入表示），评估15个模型后发现检索准确率因语言与输入表示而异，检索增强提示、SFT与GRPO各有增益，呼吁对AI生成算法代码进行系统验证。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代码生成流水线不透明，未显式区分"回忆相关算法知识"与"推理如何应用"两个环节。作者主张：对于预训练语料中广泛存在规范实现的知名算法，代码生成应被视为"参数化代码检索"——即从内部知识中复现具名算法，而非合成新算法，需要单独度量这一能力。
AI.method: 提出AlgoREval基准，包含599道题，覆盖14个领域的77种经典算法、7种编程语言、4种图输入表示；以零样本设置评估15个模型（7B–34B参数）；并对比检索代码片段提示、结构化算法提示、SFT和GRPO等增强/训练手段的效果。
AI.result: 即使对文档充分的算法，检索准确率在不同语言和输入表示间仍存在显著差异；用检索代码片段或结构化算法提示增强可提升复杂算法上的准确率；SFT带来更广泛的语言增益，GRPO在特定语言上获得更大单语言增益。
AI.conclusion: 参数化代码检索是一种独立且可度量的能力；不应在缺乏系统验证的情况下部署AI生成的算法代码。

title: Large language models exhibit unreliable updating of clinical judgment as patient evidence evolves
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for clinical reasoning, but whether they appropriately revise judgments as patient evidence evolves remains unclear. We evaluated longitudinal belief updating using matched intensive-care trajectories from electronic health records. Across diverse LLMs, conditioning on a preceding judgment more often increased than reduced prediction error when estimates changed, replicated for a second endpoint. Controlled interventions revealed two failure modes. First, with preceding assessment fixed, models responded more strongly to worsening than matched improving respiratory evidence; this asymmetry persisted after headroom normalization at moderate and strong evidence levels. Second, with current evidence fixed, increasing prior risk from 10% to 90% shifted estimates by 26.2 percentage points, demonstrating causal influence of prior model beliefs. Prompting did not restore reliable updating. Evidence-Validated Longitudinal Update (EVLU) identified fewer, more reliable revisions, revealing a reliability-coverage trade-off. These findings establish longitudinal belief updating as a distinct dimension of LLM reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过匹配的ICU电子病历轨迹评估大语言模型的纵向信念更新能力，发现模型在证据演化时条件于先前判断反而增加预测误差，并揭示恶化-改善反应不对称与先验信念因果影响两种失效模式。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型日益被探索用于临床推理，但模型能否随患者证据的演化而恰当地修正判断尚不明确，纵向信念更新可能构成LLM可靠性的一个独立维度。
AI.method: 使用来自电子健康记录的匹配重症监护轨迹进行纵向信念更新评估；跨多种LLM复制第二个终点；通过控制性干预（固定先前评估、固定当前证据）分离两类失效模式；进行headroom归一化；并引入Evidence-Validated Longitudinal Update（EVLU）方法。
AI.result: 条件于先前判断在估计变化时更常增加而非降低预测误差；模型对恶化证据的反应强于匹配的改善证据，该不对称在中强证据水平headroom归一化后仍存在；当前证据固定时，先验风险从10%升至90%使估计偏移26.2个百分点；提示工程无法恢复可靠更新；EVLU识别出更少但更可靠的修正，呈现可靠性-覆盖权衡。
AI.conclusion: 纵向信念更新是大语言模型可靠性的一个独特维度；模型存在系统性的更新失效，单纯提示无法修复，需借助EVLU等证据验证机制在可靠性与覆盖度之间取舍。

title: OmniAct3D: Leveraging Foundation Geometry and Evidence-Grounded Reasoning for Panoramic 3D Detection
summary: Accurate 3D detection is essential for mobile embodied agents, while Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) offer transferable visual and geometric priors. Yet existing VFM-based 3D detectors rely on narrow-view monocular images or discrete perspective views, limiting coherent surround perception; equirectangular projection (ERP) instead encodes a continuous 360 scene in a single image. Direct transfer remains difficult because ERP organizes geometry and visual information differently, making object-relevant cues hard to model, localize, and preserve. We propose OmniAct3D, a framework that adapts perspective-trained VFM detectors to ERP while preserving transferable VFM priors. To resolve geometric mismatch, the ERP-Ray Geometry Adapter (ERGA-Ray) models spherical viewing rays and periodic spatial structure. To localize evidence in scene-wide context, the Visual-Action Reasoning Chain (VARC) grounds each hypothesis in relevant panoramic evidence and converts it into a structured geometric action. To recover local cues lost under fixed token budgets, the Appearance-Guided Heading Expert (AGHE) re-encodes object regions at higher resolution for heading estimation. Experiments show that OmniAct3D improves over the previous best 3D detector by 2.96 NDS points on Spheriverse and over the unadapted VFM baseline by 24.87 mAP points on PanoMMOcc. With target-specific geometry adaptation, VARC retains 95--98% of the same-configuration mAP, indicating reusable object-level 3D reasoning across sensing configurations. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/FeiT-FeiTeng/OmniAct3D.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OmniAct3D，将透视图像预训练的视觉基础模型（VFM）检测器适配到等距柱状投影（ERP）全景图像上，实现连续 360° 环绕 3D 检测，并保持 VFM 的可迁移先验。
AI.motivation: 精确的 3D 检测对移动具身智能体至关重要，VFM 能提供可迁移的视觉与几何先验。但现有基于 VFM 的 3D 检测器依赖窄视场单目图像或离散透视视图，无法实现连贯的环绕感知；而 ERP 虽能在单张图像中编码连续 360° 场景，却因几何与视觉信息的组织方式差异，导致直接迁移困难：物体相关线索难以建模、定位与保留。
AI.method: 提出 OmniAct3D 框架，包含三个核心模块：(1) ERP-Ray Geometry Adapter（ERGA-Ray），通过建模球面视线与周期性空间结构解决几何失配；(2) Visual-Action Reasoning Chain（VARC），在场景级上下文中将每个假设锚定到相关全景证据并转化为结构化几何动作以定位证据；(3) Appearance-Guided Heading Expert（AGHE），在固定 token 预算下对物体区域进行高分辨率重编码以恢复局部线索并估计朝向。
AI.result: 在 Spheriverse 数据集上较此前最佳 3D 检测器提升 2.96 NDS；在 PanoMMOcc 上较未适配的 VFM 基线提升 24.87 mAP。在目标特定的几何适配下，VARC 保持同配置 95–98% 的 mAP，表明物体级 3D 推理可跨传感配置复用。
AI.conclusion: OmniAct3D 成功将透视预训练的 VFM 检测器适配到 ERP 全景 3D 检测，兼顾几何一致性与可迁移先验，验证了物体级 3D 推理在不同传感配置间的可复用性，源代码将公开。

title: Ask, Relax, or Act? Evaluating Actionable Indeterminacy in LLM Preference Reasoning
summary: An LLM agent can recognize uncertainty yet still choose the wrong next step: asking when action is already justified, or seeking clarification when the constraints must change. We formalize actionable indeterminacy: act when an accepted action is shared across all admissible preferences or objectives, clarify when each possibility is feasible but no action is shared, and propose a minimum-cost permitted constraint repair when the request is infeasible. We construct a solver-grounded benchmark spanning object allocation, meeting scheduling, apartment choice, and stable matching. Matched pairs retain the same source while changing whether intervention is necessary, and evaluation separates decision correctness, matched-pair reliability, and fully correct responses. Our findings reveal a recurring difficulty in recognizing when intervention is unnecessary: models can identify situations requiring clarification or repair yet still intervene when a justified action already exists. Correct decision labels also fail to guarantee usable actions, questions, or repairs. Crucially, response requirements shape not only how decisions are expressed but also which decisions are made. Making the required content explicit substantially improves fully correct responses and can change intervention decisions, even when outputs are already parseable. These findings highlight that reliable agency requires more than recognizing uncertainty: it requires intervening only when necessary and translating the chosen next step into a verifiable response.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化"可行动不确定性"（actionable indeterminacy），构建跨四类任务的可求解基准，将决策正确性、匹配对可靠性与完全正确响应分开评估。结果表明：模型能识别需要澄清或修复的情形，却往往在已有正当行动时过度干预；决策标签正确不保证输出可用；显式规定响应内容要求可显著提升完全正确率，并可能改变干预决策。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体虽能识别不确定性，却未必能选择正确的下一步：在行动已被证成时仍发问，或在约束必须变更时才去澄清。现有评估往往只看"是否承认不确定"，未区分"该不该干预"与"能否把选定的下一步转化为可验证的响应"，因此无法衡量可靠能动性所需的这一关键能力。
AI.method: 形式化"可行动不确定性"三类判定：当某一被接受的动作在所有可容许偏好/目标下共享时应当行动；当各可能性均可行但无共享动作时应当澄清；当请求不可行时提出最小代价的容许约束修复。据此构建求解器锚定的基准，覆盖对象分配、会议排期、公寓选择与稳定匹配四类任务；采用匹配对设计（同源场景、仅改变干预必要性），评估协议分离三个层面：(1) 决策正确性，(2) 匹配对可靠性，(3) 完全正确响应（决策+可用的动作/问题/修复）。
AI.result: 发现一个反复出现的困难：识别"无需干预"尤其困难——模型能判别需要澄清或修复的场景，却仍在存在正当动作时进行干预。决策标签正确并不能保证产生可用的动作、问题或修复。此外，响应要求（需输出的内容）不仅影响决策的表达方式，还会影响实际做出的决策：即便输出已可解析，显式规定必需内容也能大幅提升完全正确响应率，并可能改变干预决策本身。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的能动性不止于识别不确定性，还要求在必要时才干预，并将选定的下一步转化为可验证的响应。未来评估与训练应同时约束"何时干预"与"输出何种可验证内容"，而非仅以不确定性识别或决策标签正确率作为代理指标。

title: Beyond Reward Hacking: Proxy Divergence Across Four Layers of a Staged Humanoid Learning Pipeline
summary: A reinforcement-learning (RL) pipeline for a legged robot is assembled from proxies. A reward stands in for intended behaviour, a curriculum gate stands in for competence, an evaluation statistic stands in for robustness, and a reference motion stands in for an achievable skill. The traditional view treats only the first of these as optimised against, and so locates specification failure (reward hacking) in the reward alone. I argue that all four are proxies in the same formal sense, that each has a characteristic divergence mechanism, and that each admits a reformulation that closes it. For every layer I state the traditional formulation, derive the condition under which it diverges from its target, and give the alternative: first-order (L1) costs where quadratic kernels are flat, peak and outcome statistics where curriculum gates average, gate reachability and information checks, deterministic and phase-desynchronised evaluation, curriculum state treated as part of the model, feasibility-first reference design with residual feed-forward, and function-preserving input widening that lets one policy grow instead of being retrained. The arguments are illustrated by measurements from one continuous lineage of a PPO policy for a simulated 1.91 m humanoid, grown over four stages and 13,500 iterations on a single laptop GPU. Among them, a curriculum gate built on averaged error advanced at its rate limit on every check while the skill it gated was absent, and a batched push test whose synchronised resets aliased the gait phase ranked a 0.5 m/s push as more dangerous than a 2.0 m/s one.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出，腿足机器人强化学习流程中的奖励、课程门控、评估统计与参考运动本质上都是"代理"，各有特征性偏离机制，并针对每一层给出可闭合偏离的替代表述，用单个笔记本GPU上13,500次迭代的四阶段人形机器人PPO实验予以验证。
AI.motivation: 传统观点只把奖励视为被优化对象，因而将规范失效（奖励黑客）仅归因于奖励本身，忽视了课程门控、评估统计与参考运动同样存在代理偏离，导致训练流程中的失效无法被系统定位与修正。
AI.method: 将RL流程的四层统一视为形式意义上的代理，逐层说明传统表述、推导其偏离目标的条件并给出替代方案：用一阶(L1)代价替代平坦的二次核；用峰值与结果统计替代课程门控的平均；引入门控可达性与信息检查；采用确定性与相位去同步评估；将课程状态纳入模型；以可行性优先的参考设计与残差前馈；以及函数保持的输入加宽使单一策略可增长而非重训。
AI.result: 在单个笔记本GPU上对1.91 m仿真人形机器人进行四阶段、13,500次迭代的连续PPO策略训练中，基于平均误差的课程门控在每次检查时均以速率上限推进，而其所门控的技能实际并不存在；批量推力测试因同步重置与步态相位混叠，将0.5 m/s推力误判为比2.0 m/s更危险。
AI.conclusion: 规范失效不止源于奖励，而是分布于RL流程的四个代理层，每层都有可识别的偏离机制与对应的闭合式重构；实验表明忽视这些代理偏离会导致课程门控失效与评估排序错误，因此应将奖励、课程、评估与参考运动作为统一的代理体系协同设计与校正。

title: A Generative Model of Complex Networks Using Graphons and Neural Inverse Operators
summary: Generative graph models are central to understanding and simulating complex networks. However, existing approaches have complementary strengths and limitations. Mechanistic models offer interpretability but rely on instance-specific estimation methods. Deep generative models, on the other hand, offer amortized inference at the cost of interpretability and are largely limited to graph sizes seen during training. Scientific applications motivate a framework that retains the strengths of both paradigms. We bridge them by formulating both the generative model and parameter recovery in function space. A multifractal step graphon extends standard step graphons with a recursive construction that compactly parameterizes complex networks. This formulation admits a neural inverse operator to recover its parameters, enabling inference on unseen graph sizes. We evaluate our model, trained only on synthetic multifractal step graphon realizations, against both paradigms. Against a graph foundation model pretrained on empirical networks, our method achieves the best average performance on three of four metrics in a zero-shot graph-generation benchmark, indicating that the model transfers to real-world graphs. We also apply our method to single-observation networks, a regime largely inaccessible to deep models that require training corpora, where it performs comparably to an instance-specific method that optimizes on each graph. In a multi-subject EEG case study, the inferred parameters track a reversible change in brain state more sensitively than traditional network statistics. Together, these results indicate that mechanistic interpretability and amortized inference can be effectively unified in a generative graph model to enhance our understanding of complex networks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出在函数空间中统一生成模型与参数恢复，用多重分形阶梯图子（multifractal step graphon）紧凑参数化复杂网络，并训练神经逆算子实现参数推断，从而兼顾机制可解释性与摊销推断，且可泛化到未见图规模。
AI.motivation: 生成图模型对理解和模拟复杂网络至关重要，但现有方法各有权衡：机制模型可解释却依赖逐实例估计；深度生成模型虽能摊销推断，却牺牲可解释性且受限于训练时的图规模。科学应用需要同时保留两种范式优势的框架。
AI.method: 将生成模型与参数恢复统一到函数空间中。提出多重分形阶梯图子，通过递归构造扩展标准阶梯图子，紧凑地参数化复杂网络；该表述支持神经逆算子以恢复其参数，从而可对未见图规模进行推断。模型仅在合成多重分形阶梯图子实现上训练。
AI.result: 在零样本图生成基准中，与在经验网络上预训练的图基础模型相比，本方法在四项指标中的三项取得最佳平均性能，表明可迁移到真实图。在单观测网络上表现与逐图优化的实例特定方法相当。在多被试EEG案例中，推断参数比传统网络统计量更敏感地追踪脑状态的可逆变化。
AI.conclusion: 机制可解释性与摊销推断可在生成图模型中有效统一，从而增强对复杂网络的理解。

title: Decoupling Memory from Context: Structured Memory for Token-Efficient Test-Time Continual Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in enterprise, scientific, and medical applications, where agents must incorporate domain-specific knowledge and adapt from experience. Context engineering offers a practical alternative to weight updates by improving model behavior through instructions, strategies, and evidence supplied at inference time. However, adapting context online typically requires a costly trial-and-error process, while queries are often processed independently, preventing useful experience from carrying forward. Memory systems address this limitation by retaining information across interactions, but approaches that continually append information to a shared context face increasing token costs, context-window limits, and performance degradation as the context expands. We introduce a unified formulation of context optimization and show that an agent memory system update can be interpreted as an optimization update procedure over the model's context. This perspective attempts to provide a principled framework for studying memory design and its efficiency. We then propose GraphMemory, a lightweight graph-based memory that accumulates, refines, organizes, and connects reusable strategies. For each query, GraphMemory retrieves only the relevant subgraph, enabling online context adaptation without exposing the model to the entire memory. Under bounded retrieval, the amount of retrieved memory remains constant as the number of processed examples grows. Experiments show that GraphMemory achieves competitive downstream performance while using approximately 81-85% fewer memory-construction tokens than our baselines.

AI.tldr: 该文将智能体记忆更新统一形式化为对模型上下文的优化过程，并提出轻量图式记忆系统 GraphMemory，通过仅检索相关子图实现有界在线上下文自适应，在保持竞争力的下游性能同时减少约 81-85% 的记忆构建 token 消耗。
AI.motivation: LLM 在企业、科研与医疗等场景需融入领域知识并从经验中自适应。上下文工程是权重更新的实用替代方案，但在线调整上下文通常依赖高成本试错，且查询多被独立处理，经验难以累积。持续向共享上下文追加信息的记忆系统又会面临 token 成本增长、上下文窗口限制与性能退化问题，因此需要一种更高效、可累积经验的记忆机制与理论框架。
AI.method: 作者首先提出上下文优化（context optimization）的统一形式化表述，论证智能体记忆系统的更新可被解释为对模型上下文的优化更新过程，从而为记忆设计与效率分析提供原则性框架。在此基础上提出 GraphMemory：一种轻量级图式记忆，用于累积、精炼、组织并连接可复用策略；针对每个查询仅检索相关子图，使模型无需接触全部记忆即可完成在线上下文自适应。在有界检索条件下，检索到的记忆规模随已处理样本数增长保持恒定。
AI.result: 实验表明，GraphMemory 在取得具有竞争力的下游性能的同时，其记忆构建所消耗的 token 相比基线减少约 81-85%。
AI.conclusion: GraphMemory 验证了将记忆更新视为上下文优化的可行性，通过图结构组织可复用策略与有界子图检索，可在控制上下文长度与构建成本的前提下实现在线自适应，为高效智能体记忆设计提供了理论与实证支持。

title: ReSCUE: Re-translation with Sentence Commitment for Unsegmented Long-Form Simultaneous Sign Language Translation
summary: Simultaneous Sign Language Translation (SLT) is critical for real-time communication, yet existing methods remain largely confined to sentence-level, offline settings that assume pre-segmented inputs. These assumptions hinder deployment in realistic scenarios involving continuous, unsegmented video streams. We present ReSCUE, a unified framework for simultaneous SLT on unsegmented long-form sign language videos that aligns training and inference with realistic streaming conditions. ReSCUE combines inference-aware training to handle partial inputs, non-signing pauses, and multi-sentence contexts, stabilized re-translation to enable low-latency yet revisable predictions with reduced output flicker, and a sentence commitment mechanism for online segmentation and memory management. Experiments on standard sentence-level benchmarks show that ReSCUE achieves lower latency and the best translation quality under low-latency settings. On long-form unsegmented datasets, ReSCUE approaches the translation quality of oracle offline systems that use ground-truth sentence boundaries, while operating at substantially lower latency, demonstrating its practicality for real-world streaming scenarios.

AI.tldr: ReSCUE 提出统一框架，实现面向未分割长视频流的同步手语翻译，在低延迟下兼具翻译质量与可修订性。
AI.motivation: 现有同步手语翻译方法多局限于句级、离线设定，默认输入已预分割，难以适用于连续、未分割的视频流等真实场景。
AI.method: ReSCUE 对齐训练与推理的流式条件，融合三项机制：推理感知训练以处理部分输入、非手语停顿及多句上下文；稳定重翻译以实现低延迟且可修订的预测并减少输出闪烁；句子提交机制用于在线分割与内存管理。
AI.result: 在标准句级基准上，ReSCUE 在低延迟设定下实现更低延迟与最优翻译质量；在长视频未分割数据集上，其翻译质量接近使用真实句边界的离线 oracle 系统，同时延迟显著更低。
AI.conclusion: ReSCUE 证明了面向真实流式场景的同步手语翻译的实用性，缩小了与离线系统之间的差距。

title: Emergent Structure in the Marginal Attention Space of Language Models
summary: While representation similarity across independently trained language models is well-documented, how internal mechanics such as attention behave across models remains far less characterized. Inspired by this gap, we examine the structure of post-softmax attention weights by marginalizing over query positions, mapping them into a joint token-head "marginal attention space". Evaluating across 60+ diverse LLMs, we find that different properties emerge when reducing this space along its token and head axes. When reduced token-wise, marginal attention yields a text-intrinsic signal robustly conserved across models. To explain this property, we empirically connect marginal attention to the input-output Jacobian of the network, and prove theoretically that under a smoothness assumption, models with similar next-token distributions are guaranteed to have similar input-output Jacobian statistics. When reduced head-wise, it forms a model-private signature conserved across documents. Practically, this provides a natural way to estimate a per-head budget for key-value (KV) cache eviction, effectively decoupling model-specific budget allocation from text-intrinsic token scoring. On standard eviction benchmarks, a per-head budget precomputed offline on pretraining text, combined with a training-free token score, shows competitive performance with methods that recompute the budget on every document or train it per target. Code available at https://github.com/Flegyas/marginal-attention

AI.tldr: 论文研究后softmax注意力权重经查询位置边缘化后形成的"边缘注意力空间"，发现token维还原产生跨模型稳健的文本内在信号，head维还原形成模型私有签名，并据此设计离线预计算的per-head KV cache预算分配方法。
AI.motivation: 独立训练的语言模型间表示相似性已被广泛记录，但注意力等内部机制在不同模型间如何表现仍少有刻画，这一空白驱动了对注意力结构的跨模型分析。
AI.method: 对后softmax注意力权重沿query位置边缘化，映射到token-head联合"边缘注意力空间"，在60+个多样LLM上评估。沿token轴归约时将边缘注意力与网络输入-输出Jacobian实证关联，并在平滑性假设下理论证明：下一token分布相似的模型必然具有相似的输入-输出Jacobian统计量；沿head轴归约则得到跨文档保持的模型私有签名。基于此提出用离线在预训练文本上预计算per-head预算，结合免训练token评分进行KV cache逐出。
AI.result: token维归约得到跨模型稳健保守的文本内在信号，head维归约得到跨文档保守的模型私有签名；在标准逐出基准上，离线预计算per-head预算加免训练token评分，性能与需逐文档重算预算或按目标训练的方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 边缘注意力空间揭示了注意力的双重结构：文本内在信号与模型私有签名，二者解耦可实现高效的per-head KV cache预算分配，无需在线重算或训练。

title: DexJoCo-X: Benchmarking Action Representations for Multi-Hand Dexterous Manipulation
summary: As dexterous hands proliferate, collecting data and training policies separately for every morphology becomes increasingly impractical. Scalable cross-embodiment learning therefore requires a unified representation that captures shared manipulation structure while preserving morphology-specific control. Differences in hands, tasks, datasets, and control interfaces prevent existing studies from isolating the effects of representation, pretraining, and architecture. We introduce DexJoCo-X, a benchmark and toolkit for controlled comparison across seven representative dexterous hands, six single-arm and bimanual tasks, and 2,100 balanced demonstrations. DexJoCo-X provides a matched multi-hand, multi-task protocol with common scenes, success criteria, and execution interfaces, redesigned glove-to-hand mappings, and an automated pipeline that expands reviewed demonstrations across randomized scenes. Using $π_{0.5}$, Ego-Pi, and Being-H0.5, we examine whether a shared action interface is sufficient for multi-hand learning. Expanding $π_{0.5}$ to an 80-dimensional bimanual output yields near-zero success. Ego-Pi preserves the pretrained action head through interleaved prediction and supports per-hand multi-task learning, but remains ineffective for seven-hand joint training. By contrast, Being-H0.5 combines cross-embodiment pretraining, a unified action space, and embodiment-aware experts, enabling one policy to control all seven hands. Within this architecture, function-aligned action slots achieve 47.7% mean success, compared with 47.0% for native coordinates and 33.1% for DexLatent. These results show that cross-embodiment representation depends on the entire learning system: action coordinates, pretraining, and architecture must jointly separate shared manipulation structure from embodiment-specific control.

AI.tldr: 提出DexJoCo-X跨本体灵巧手基准（7种手、6项任务、2100条示范），通过受控对比发现：跨本体表征效果取决于动作坐标、预训练与架构的整体协同，统一动作空间与本体感知专家结合才能使单策略控制全部7种手。
AI.motivation: 灵巧手形态日益多样，逐形态采集数据与训练策略不可扩展，需要能同时捕捉共享操作结构与形态特异控制的统一表征。但现有研究在手、任务、数据集和控制接口上不一致，无法分离表征、预训练与架构的各自作用，缺乏受控对比平台。
AI.method: 构建DexJoCo-X基准与工具包：覆盖7种代表性灵巧手、6项单臂与双臂任务、2100条均衡示范；提供匹配的多手多任务协议（统一场景、成功判据与执行接口）、重新设计的手套-手映射，以及可将经审核示范自动扩展到随机场景的流水线。基于π₀.₅、Ego-Pi、Being-H0.5三种方法，检验共享动作接口是否足以支撑多手学习。
AI.result: π₀.₅扩展至80维双臂输出后成功率接近零；Ego-Pi通过交错预测保留预训练动作头并支持逐手多任务学习，但七手联合训练仍无效；Being-H0.5结合跨本体预训练、统一动作空间与本体感知专家，实现单一策略控制全部7种手。在其架构内，功能对齐动作槽平均成功率47.7%，原生坐标47.0%，DexLatent仅33.1%。
AI.conclusion: 跨本体表征并非仅由共享动作接口决定，而依赖整个学习系统：动作坐标、预训练与架构必须协同，才能将共享操作结构与本体特异控制有效解耦。DexJoCo-X为受控的跨形态灵巧操作研究提供了可复现平台。

title: Bandits via Additive Quantized Representations
comment: 40 pages, 16 figures, 12 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Contextual bandits require balancing nonlinear reward modeling with online efficiency. Tree ensembles and neural methods capture nonlinearities but require periodic retraining and large replay buffers. Linear models update efficiently per observation with O(1) memory, but are fundamentally restricted to linear reward structures. We propose Residual Quantization (RQ) as a representation layer to bridge this gap. An offline-trained RQ codebook maps continuous contexts into discrete centroid assignments across multiple levels, set dynamically through a shadow mechanism. This enables a spectrum of additive bandit algorithms that achieve nonlinear expressivity with strictly bounded memory. Across 13 datasets, RQ variants beat their non-RQ counterparts on 11 of 13 datasets, often by wide margins, while matching doubling-retrain XGBoost and neural baselines using up to 1000 times less memory.

AI.tldr: 提出Residual Quantization (RQ)作为表示层，将连续上下文映射为多层级离散质心分配，从而让线性/加性bandit算法在极低内存下获得非线性表达能力。
AI.motivation: Contextual bandit需要在非线性奖励建模与在线效率之间权衡：树集成与神经网络能捕捉非线性，但需周期性重训练与大replay buffer；线性模型更新高效、内存O(1)，却受限于线性奖励结构。作者希望弥合这一矛盾。
AI.method: 离线训练RQ码本，将连续context映射为多层级离散质心分配，并通过shadow机制动态设定层级；在此基础上构建一系列加性bandit算法（additive bandit algorithms），在保持严格有界内存的同时获得非线性表达力。
AI.result: 在13个数据集上，RQ变体在11个数据集上优于对应的非RQ版本，且常常优势明显；同时以最多少1000倍的内存匹配需要doubling-retrain的XGBoost与神经网络基线。
AI.conclusion: RQ作为表示层能有效桥接线性bandit的效率与非线性模型的表达力，在内存受限的在线场景中提供了一种兼顾性能与效率的通用方案。

title: Learning to Revise Reasoning with Segment-wise On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves large language model reasoning by training students on their own rollouts with dense token-wise supervision from the teacher. However, token-wise OPD does not explicitly provide a coherent alternative reasoning step showing how the student's step could be revised to improve subsequent reasoning.
