Furthermore, this paradigm can become less effective when the student produces a degenerate reasoning prefix, as subsequent teacher supervision remains conditioned on that prefix and may reinforce poor reasoning patterns. In this work, we focus on learning reasoning revision with segment-wise OPD to rework intermediate reasoning steps and better support subsequent reasoning. Through controlled reasoning interventions, we find that replacing student segments with teacher redrafts improves subsequent reasoning accuracy. Therefore, we address the problem of turning teacher redrafts into explicit supervision for learning to revise reasoning. We propose Segment-wise On-Policy Distillation (Seg-OPD), which selects student segments based on an uncertainty metric and obtains corresponding teacher redrafts. Seg-OPD trains the student to prefer teacher redrafts over their paired student segments while retaining dense token-wise OPD supervision. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and competitive programming tasks show that Seg-OPD-trained students achieve higher revision success rates than baselines. Seg-OPD consistently outperforms the compared state-of-the-art baselines in reasoning accuracy with an average relative improvement of 5.22% across diverse models and tasks. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Seg-OPD.

AI.tldr: 提出分段式在线策略蒸馏（Seg-OPD），将教师改写的推理片段转化为显式监督信号以学习推理修正，在数学推理与竞赛编程任务上平均相对提升5.22%。
AI.motivation: 现有token级在线策略蒸馏（OPD）存在两个不足：一是不显式提供连贯的替代推理步骤来展示学生某一步应如何修正以改善后续推理；二是当学生产生退化推理前缀时，后续教师监督仍以该前缀为条件，可能强化劣质推理模式。
AI.method: 通过受控推理干预实验验证用教师改写片段替换学生片段可提升后续推理准确率；据此提出Seg-OPD，基于不确定性度量选择学生片段并获取对应教师改写，训练学生在保留密集token级OPD监督的同时偏好教师改写而非配对的学生片段。
AI.result: 在数学推理与竞赛编程任务上，Seg-OPD训练的学生修正成功率高于基线；推理准确率持续优于对比的SOTA基线，在多种模型与任务上平均相对提升5.22%。
AI.conclusion: 将教师改写作为片段级显式监督是学习推理修正的有效途径，Seg-OPD可显著提升学生模型的推理修正能力与整体推理准确率。

title: CrowdOcc: Monocular Semantic Scene Completion for Quadruped Robots in Crowded Indoor Environments
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2027
summary: Monocular semantic scene completion (SSC) for quadruped robots remains underexplored in real crowded indoor environments, where human-scene occlusion disrupts static geometry and human occupancy predictions are often incomplete or spatially misplaced. We present CrowdOcc, an RGB-D dataset and monocular SSC framework for this setting. CrowdOcc contains 25.1K frames from 11 indoor scenes, with semantic occupancy annotations constructed through static dynamic decoupling. Our framework combines: (i) Normal Guided Scene Geometry Fusion (NGSGF) to complement depth-aware lifting with surface-normal cues for occlusion robust geometry; and (ii) Human-Centric Sparse Interaction (HCSI) to selectively model human-human and local human scene relations in 3D. Our method achieves state-of-the-art SSC performance on CrowdOcc's scene-disjoint test set, reaching 15.80 IoU, 11.40 mIoU, and 46.23 Human IoU, demonstrating generalization to unseen indoor scenes.

AI.tldr: CrowdOcc：面向四足机器人在拥挤室内环境的单目语义场景补全RGB-D数据集与框架，通过法向量引导几何融合与以人为中心的稀疏交互建模，在场景分离测试集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 四足机器人在真实拥挤室内场景下的单目语义场景补全（SSC）研究不足：人-场景遮挡破坏静态几何结构，且人体占位预测常不完整或空间错位，现有方法与数据均难以应对。
AI.method: 构建CrowdOcc数据集（11个室内场景、25.1K帧），通过静动态解耦生成语义占位标注；提出单目SSC框架，包含：(i) 法向量引导场景几何融合（NGSGF），以表面法向线索补充深度感知提升，实现遮挡鲁棒的几何建模；(ii) 以人为中心的稀疏交互（HCSI），在3D空间中选择性建模人与人及局部人与场景的关系。
AI.result: 在CrowdOcc场景分离测试集上达到SOTA：15.80 IoU、11.40 mIoU、46.23 Human IoU，并展现出对未见室内场景的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: CrowdOcc数据集与框架有效缓解拥挤室内环境中的遮挡与人体占位预测问题，提升单目SSC在四足机器人场景下的性能与泛化性。

title: Ontological Instability and Statistical Amplification: The Paradox of "Humanizing" LLM-Generated Text
summary: Supervised AI-text detectors report high benchmark accuracy, but it is not clear what their decisions are based on. We analyze a RoBERTa-based detector under semantic, structural, and tokenizer-level perturbations, using the M4 dataset (N = 10,000) and controlled generations (N = 300). When Mistral-7B-Instruct was asked to make machine text sound more human, Verb Diversity rose from 0.77 to 0.92 and the outputs became easier to detect. Detection scores appear to track statistical complexity, which also leads to a 76.3% false-positive rate on formal human writing. As a control, we evaluate event-based Latent Space detection. Paraphrasing changed 87% of its event sequences (Jaccard = 0.067), and homoglyphs altered 70% of the extracted verbs even though extraction still ran (Jaccard = 0.30). Its best domain AUC was 0.577. RoBERTa's robustness seems specific to the features it uses, and structural abstraction did not make detection more robust.

AI.tldr: 分析表明RoBERTa检测器的高准确率依赖表面统计复杂度特征而非稳健的语义信号，在结构抽象与事件级潜在空间检测下均不稳健。
AI.motivation: 监督式AI文本检测器虽在基准上表现优异，但其决策依据不明，需厘清其依赖的特征及在扰动下的稳健性。
AI.method: 用M4数据集(N=10,000)与受控生成(N=300)，对基于RoBERTa的检测器施加语义、结构和分词器级扰动；并以事件级潜在空间检测作为对照。
AI.result: 让Mistral-7B-Instruct改写得更像人类写作后，动词多样性从0.77升至0.92反而更易被检测；检测分数似追踪统计复杂度，对正式人类写作误报率达76.3%。对照方法中，改写改变87%事件序列(Jaccard=0.067)，同形字符改变70%抽取动词(Jaccard=0.30)，最佳域AUC仅0.577。
AI.conclusion: RoBERTa的稳健性仅对其特定特征成立，结构抽象并不能提升检测稳健性；检测器捕捉的是统计复杂度而非真正的机器写作痕迹。

title: HexVIO: Towards All-Day Stereo-Inertial Tracking Through Commodity DSPs
summary: The ability of a device to localize itself within its surroundings is a fundamental prerequisite for spatial computing. Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) has proven to be a cost-effective and accurate solution for this task. Robots, wearables, XR devices, and drones can benefit significantly from efficient implementations of VIO since they allow for cooler, lighter, and cheaper devices with longer battery life and a better user experience. In this work, we propose to enhance the efficiency of a VIO system by leveraging the Hexagon DSP, a commodity co-processor present in many modern smartphones and XR devices. Our approach offloads the visual frontend of a stereo-inertial odometry system to the DSP while keeping the backend on the main CPU. By optimizing the implementation for the DSP architecture, we achieve significant reductions in power consumption and latency compared to CPU-only execution. Our system, HexVIO, demonstrates a 67% reduction in power consumption or an 86% increase in throughput on a commodity smartphone, with the ability to sustain long-term real-time 30 fps tracking for 0.83 W, corresponding to ~18 hours of tracking on the testing device. These results highlight the potential of commodity DSPs for enabling all-day visual-inertial tracking in robotics and mobile devices.

AI.tldr: 提出HexVIO系统，将双目惯性里程计的视觉前端卸载至Hexagon DSP、后端保留于CPU，在手机上实现功耗降低67%或吞吐提升86%，以0.83 W维持30 fps实时跟踪约18小时。
AI.motivation: 视觉惯性里程计（VIO）是空间计算的基础能力，但高效实现可让机器人、可穿戴设备、XR与无人机更轻、更凉、更便宜、续航更久、体验更好。现代智能手机和XR设备中普遍存在的Hexagon DSP为提升VIO能效提供了机会。
AI.method: 利用商用Hexagon DSP加速VIO：将双目惯性里程计的视觉前端卸载到DSP，后端保留在主CPU；并针对DSP架构对实现进行优化。
AI.result: 相比仅用CPU执行，HexVIO在商用手机上实现功耗降低67%或吞吐提升86%，能够以0.83 W持续长时间实时30 fps跟踪，在测试设备上约合18小时跟踪。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，商用DSP有潜力在机器人和移动设备上实现全天候视觉惯性跟踪。

title: AI-driven Thermal-aware Data Center Capacity Planning
summary: The emerging of large language models (LLMs) has posed significant challenges to the thermal management of data center. Intense GPU computation for LLMs results in localized hotspots. Moreover, spiking thermal loads during training and inference bursts make real-time cooling response more difficult to predict and control. Thermal-aware capacity planning of data center requires massive expensive high-fidelity CFD simulations. AI models can perform real-time prediction for unseen designs. However, existing works either have large prediction error, or have over-simplified assumptions for data center operations. This work presents an AI-driven framework that can perform thermal-aware capacity planning for a real-world data center in seconds. The embedded AI model learns from numerous key parameters (rack power, server power, server placement, HVAC settings etc.), and provides temperature prediction within milliseconds. This AI model is tested against high-fidelity CFD simulations, and results show that for unseen data center designs, model can achieve high accuracy with 10000X speedup. Driven by the AI model, the authors design the thermal-aware capacity planning framework. This framework can help data center designers and operators instantaneously optimize both workload distribution and HVAC cooling efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出AI驱动的数据中心热感知容量规划框架，嵌入的AI模型可在毫秒级完成温度预测，相对高保真CFD仿真实现10000倍加速且保持高精度，支持即时优化工作负载分布与HVAC冷却效率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）的兴起给数据中心热管理带来巨大挑战：GPU密集计算产生局部热点，训练与推理突发时的热负载尖峰使实时冷却响应更难预测与控制；而传统热感知容量规划依赖大量昂贵的高保真CFD仿真，现有AI方法要么预测误差大，要么对数据中心运行假设过度简化。
AI.method: 构建AI驱动的热感知容量规划框架。所嵌入的AI模型以多类关键参数为输入进行学习，包括机架功率、服务器功率、服务器布局、HVAC设置等，输出毫秒级温度预测；并以高保真CFD仿真作为基准对模型进行验证。
AI.result: 对未见过的数据中心设计，模型可达到高精度预测，并相对高保真CFD仿真实现10000倍加速；框架支持秒级完成真实数据中心的容量规划。
AI.conclusion: 该AI驱动框架可帮助数据中心设计者与运维人员即时协同优化工作负载分布与HVAC冷却效率，为真实数据中心的热感知容量规划提供高效、准确的解决方案。

title: Label-Efficient Time Series Classification at Scale: A Dual-Stream OSSE-LSTM with Counterfactual Attribution
summary: Time series are produced continuously at enormous scale by industrial equipment, wearables, power grids, and clinical monitors, yet annotation remains manual, expensive, and expert-dependent. The binding constraint in large-scale time series analytics is therefore not data volume but label volume, and the question facing a practitioner is concrete: how many examples per class must be labeled before a classifier becomes usable? We study this question directly, in a regime where the label space is fixed and known in advance and the decision rule must be constructed from only K labeled examples per class. We propose Dual-Stream OSSE-LSTM, an episodic metric-learning framework that pairs an Omni-Scale CNN with Squeeze-and-Excitation recalibration, for multi-scale motif extraction without per-dataset kernel tuning, with a Bidirectional LSTM for global temporal context. The two streams are independently normalized and fused into a prototype-oriented embedding. Because decisions taken from a few labels must also be explainable, we introduce Counterfactual Integrated Gradients (C-IG), which attributes the prototype margin between target and opposing classes rather than an isolated classifier logit, and reuses the resulting maps as soft masks for test-time prototype refinement without updating the encoder. On 19 univariate UCR datasets, OSSE-LSTM attains the highest average accuracy and per-dataset win count at every support size, and its accuracy remains within a 0.36-point band (96.36-96.72%) across that range. Its weakest configuration still exceeding the best result any compared baseline achieves at any K (93.99%).

AI.tldr: 提出 Dual-Stream OSSE-LSTM 的小样本时序分类框架，在每类仅 K 个标注样本下实现高精度与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 大规模时序数据持续产生，但标注依赖人工且昂贵、需专家参与。真正的瓶颈是标签量而非数据量，实践者关心的问题具体为：每类需要标注多少样本，分类器才可用。因此需在标签空间固定且已知、仅用每类 K 个标注样本构建决策规则的设定下研究该问题。
AI.method: 提出 Dual-Stream OSSE-LSTM 的 episodic 度量学习框架：一路为 Omni-Scale CNN 结合 Squeeze-and-Excitation 重校准，实现无需逐数据集调核的多尺度 motif 提取；另一路为双向 LSTM 捕获全局时序上下文。两路独立归一化后融合为面向原型的嵌入。同时提出 Counterfactual Integrated Gradients（C-IG），对目标类与对立类之间的原型 margin 而非孤立分类器 logit 进行归因，并将生成的热图作为软掩码用于测试时原型细化，且不更新编码器。
AI.result: 在 19 个单变量 UCR 数据集上，OSSE-LSTM 在每种支持集大小下均取得最高平均精度和最多逐数据集胜出次数；在该范围内精度波动仅 0.36 个百分点（96.36–96.72%）；其最弱配置（93.99%）仍超过所有对比基线在任何 K 下的最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: Dual-Stream OSSE-LSTM 在极少标注样本条件下实现稳定且领先的时序分类性能，并通过 C-IG 提供可解释性且将其用于测试时原型细化，说明有限标签下的决策既可高精度也可解释。

title: Parasitic Co-Denoising: Unlocking 3D Human Motion Generation in a Frozen Video Diffusion Model
summary: Despite never being supervised on explicit 3D motion, large-scale text-to-video diffusion models synthesize realistic human motion in their generated videos. We ask whether this implicit knowledge can be turned into explicit 3D motion generation, without training a separate motion model. Probing a frozen Wan2.1 reveals that a recoverable motion signal is present in its intermediate states across the entire denoising schedule, not confined to the clean output. Motivated by this, we introduce parasitic co-denoising, a paradigm in which motion is decoded from the host model along its denoising schedule rather than produced by an independent generator. We instantiate it as the Parasitic Motion Decoder (PMD), an efficient flow-matching decoder that shares the host's noise schedule and reads its intermediate features through a $σ$-adaptive multi-layer fusion, leaving the host unmodified. Drawing its coverage from the host rather than from motion data, PMD leads dedicated motion generators on text-motion alignment at a small fraction of their trainable parameters, while producing paired video and motion in a single pass that motion-only baselines cannot match.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"寄生式协同去噪"范式及寄生运动解码器PMD，从冻结的Wan2.1视频扩散模型的中间特征中直接解码3D运动，无需训练独立运动模型，在少量可训练参数下实现优于专用运动生成器的文本-运动对齐。
AI.motivation: 大规模文本到视频扩散模型虽未接受显式3D运动监督，却能生成逼真的人体运动，表明其内部隐式蕴含运动知识。作者希望将这种隐式知识转化为显式3D运动生成能力，且不额外训练独立的运动生成模型。
AI.method: 作者首先对冻结的Wan2.1进行探针分析，发现可恢复的运动信号存在于整个去噪过程各阶段的中间状态中，而非仅限最终干净输出。据此提出"寄生式协同去噪"（parasitic co-denoising）范式：运动从宿主模型沿其去噪调度过程中被解码，而非由独立生成器产生。具体实现为寄生运动解码器（PMD），一种高效的流匹配（flow-matching）解码器，与宿主共享噪声调度，并通过σ自适应的多层融合读取宿主中间特征，且不修改宿主模型本身。
AI.result: 由于运动覆盖能力来自宿主模型而非运动数据，PMD仅用极少比例的可训练参数便在文本-运动对齐指标上超过专用运动生成器；同时可在单次前向中同时生成配对的视频与运动，这是仅运动基线无法做到的。
AI.conclusion: 视频扩散模型内部隐式编码了可提取的3D运动信息，通过寄生式解码可高效复用该能力，实现参数高效、视频与运动联合生成的3D运动生成新路径。

title: Building Interpretable Feature Representations for Resume-Vacancy Matching by Distilling Production LLM Signals
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026; 13 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables
summary: Matching candidates to vacancies is central to recruitment, and a recruiter needs to see why a candidate fits, not only a single opaque relevance score. We provide this evidence as named, interpretable matching dimensions recruiters can act on - eight in our current deployment. We propose a two-part approach. The first is an LLM-based labeler whose prompts and feature definitions were refined from recruiter feedback while it served as an earlier production matching stage. In the current architecture, it is used only for offline labeling and is not called on online requests. The second is a feature bi-encoder distilled from it: a LoRA-adapted embedding backbone with compact per-dimension heads that runs on CPU and serves all online requests. Both parts keep improving: prompts are revised as feedback arrives, and the bi-encoder is retrained on the updated labels. The model is trained on 168,772 labeled vacancy-resume pairs (17,921 vacancies and 180,030 resumes). Recruiters using the service can confirm or revise surfaced feature predictions. On 927 recruiter-recorded values from this selected production-feedback subset, the deployed student agrees with the recorded decisions in 888 cases (95.79%). This is operational, non-blinded agreement rather than an independent human evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种"教师-学生"两阶段候选人-职位匹配方案：用LLM标注器产出八个可解释匹配维度标签，再蒸馏为可在CPU上服务的特征双编码器，部署后与招聘人员记录决策的一致率为95.79%。
AI.motivation: 招聘匹配不能只给出单一不透明的相关性分数，招聘人员需要知道"候选人为什么合适"。因此系统需要提供具名、可解释、可据以行动的匹配维度，同时还要满足在线服务的算力与延迟约束。
AI.method: 方法分两部分：其一为基于LLM的标注器，其提示词与特征定义由招聘人员反馈迭代打磨，曾作为早期生产匹配阶段，现仅用于离线标注、不参与在线请求；其二为从中蒸馏出的特征双编码器（feature bi-encoder），由LoRA适配的嵌入骨干加紧凑的按维度预测头组成，在CPU上运行并承载全部在线请求。两部分持续迭代：提示词随反馈修订，双编码器在更新后的标签上重训。训练数据为168,772对已标注的职位-简历对（17,921个职位、180,030份简历）。
AI.result: 在来自该生产反馈子集的927个招聘人员记录值上，部署的学生模型与记录决策一致888例，一致率95.79%。需强调这是运营场景下的非盲一致性，而非独立的人工评估。
AI.conclusion: 该方案以可解释的多维度匹配替代单一相关性分数，并通过LLM标注器到CPU双编码器的蒸馏实现可规模化的在线部署，实践上获得较高的一致率；其评估基于招聘人员实际使用中的记录反馈，属于运营性证据，仍需独立人工评测进一步验证。

title: Equivariant Visual-Tactile Diffusion Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation
comment: 21 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026)
summary: Imitation learning for contact-rich manipulation requires high-quality expert data that is expensive to obtain. This makes learning a sample-efficient policy a key issue. To address this, we propose VISTA, a workspace-level equivariant visuotactile diffusion policy for data-efficient contact-rich imitation learning. VISTA projects visual and tactile observations into spherical tokens, injects tactile contact cues into visual spherical directions through permutation-equivariant spherical fusion, and rotates the fused harmonic representation using the end-effector orientation. The resulting representation conditions an equivariant diffusion policy to predict spatially consistent actions. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world robotic settings show that VISTA substantially improves data efficiency over strong visuotactile imitation learning baselines. Project website: https://vista-paper.github.io/

AI.tldr: VISTA是一种工作空间等变的视触觉扩散策略，通过球面token化和触觉线索融合提升接触密集操作的样本效率。
AI.motivation: 接触密集操作的模仿学习依赖昂贵的高质量专家数据，因此学习样本高效的策略是关键问题。
AI.method: 将视觉与触觉观测投影为球面token；通过置换等变球面融合将触觉接触线索注入视觉球面方向；利用末端执行器姿态旋转融合后的调和表示；以该表示条件化等变扩散策略，预测空间一致的動作。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实机器人环境的大量实验中，VISTA相较强视触觉模仿学习基线显著提升了数据效率。
AI.conclusion: VISTA通过工作空间级等变表示与视触觉融合，有效缓解接触密集模仿学习的数据稀缺问题。

title: A Composable AI-Accelerated Iterative Solver for 3D-IC Thermal Modeling
summary: Accurate thermal analysis of heterogeneous 2.5D/3D-IC packages is essential yet computationally prohibitive. A single full-package FEM simulation can take hours, while AI-based surrogates treat the entire stack as a monolithic prediction target and must be retrained whenever the die count or topology changes. To address this limitation, this work proposes Domain-Decomposed AI-Accelerated Iterative Solver for Thermal Analysis (DAIST), a composable thermal solver that decomposes the global package simulation into block-level subdomain problems, replaces subdomain solvers with neural operators, and couples them through iterative exchanges of interfacial temperature and heat flux. This local-to-global architecture eliminates the topology lock-in of monolithic models: block-level neural operators can be directly reused in unseen package assemblies without retraining. The iterative coupling strategy further provides a controllable accuracy-runtime tradeoff, where the iteration budget can be adjusted to trade accuracy for runtime. Evaluated on a multi-chiplet system and an advanced packaging system, DAIST achieves up to $178\times$ speedup over traditional FEM solvers with mean temperature errors of 0.068% and 0.323%, respectively, while demonstrating cross-topology reuse of block-level models across structurally distinct package assemblies.

AI.tldr: 提出DAIST，一种域分解的AI加速迭代热求解器，将全局封装仿真拆分为块级子域并用神经算子求解、迭代耦合，实现跨拓扑复用与最高178倍加速。
AI.motivation: 异构2.5D/3D-IC封装的精确热分析计算代价高昂，单次全封装FEM仿真需数小时；现有AI代理模型将整个堆叠视为单一预测目标，存在拓扑锁定问题，芯片数量或拓扑变化即需重新训练。
AI.method: DAIST将全局封装仿真分解为块级子域问题，用神经算子替代子域求解器，并通过界面温度与热流的迭代交换进行耦合；该局部到全局架构消除单体模型的拓扑锁定，块级神经算子可直接复用于未见封装组合，且迭代预算可调节精度与运行时权衡。
AI.result: 在多芯片系统与先进封装系统上评估，相比传统FEM求解器最高取得178倍加速，平均温度误差分别为0.068%与0.323%，并展示了块级模型在结构不同封装组合间的跨拓扑复用。
AI.conclusion: DAIST通过域分解与神经算子耦合，实现可组合、可复用的热求解，兼顾高精度与显著加速，为异构封装热分析提供可扩展方案。

title: Ego2World: Compiling Egocentric Cooking Videos into Executable Worlds for Belief-State Planning
summary: Egocentric videos capture how people carry out everyday activities, yet testing an agent requires evaluating the consequences of actions it chooses itself. We introduce Ego2World, a benchmark that turns annotated cooking activities into executable planning environments under partial observation. Its compiler links source steps and objects to symbolic action rules, persistent world states, and explicit task conditions, so researchers can execute an agent's proposed actions and check their outcomes. World state and agent belief are maintained separately, enabling controlled studies of planning and information reuse across continuing tasks. Evaluating six planners on 105 tasks shows that accepted operations often leave task goals unmet. Execution traces and condition checks distinguish interrupted runs, partial attainment, and completed execution without goal attainment. In a separate paired Qwen-Plus study, persistent belief improves action validity by 4.15 percentage points and reduces visual-query attempts by 90.27%, with higher token use and no detected completion gain. Ego2World provides a reusable testbed for tracing how planning and memory choices affect execution, observation demand, and task attainment, connecting recorded human activity to the development and evaluation of interactive agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Ego2World，一个将带标注的烹饪活动转化为部分可观测下可执行规划环境的基准，通过编译器把源步骤与物体映射为符号动作规则、持久世界状态和显式任务条件，并区分世界状态与智能体信念；在 105 个任务上评测六种规划器，发现被接受的操作常无法达成任务目标，并给出中断、部分达成与完成执行但未达成目标的区分。配对 Qwen-Plus 实验中，持久信念将动作有效性提升 4.15 个百分点、视觉查询尝试减少 90.27%，但 token 消耗更高且未检测到完成度增益。
AI.motivation: 第一人称视频记录了人们如何完成日常活动，但要测试智能体，必须评估其自行选择动作所带来的后果。现有基准缺乏可执行、部分可观测且能核查动作结果的环境，也难以区分规划与记忆选择对执行、观测需求和任务达成的影响。
AI.method: 构建 Ego2World 基准：其编译器将带标注的烹饪活动中的源步骤与物体链接为符号动作规则、持久世界状态和显式任务条件；智能体提出动作后可执行并检查结果。世界状态与智能体信念分别维护，以支持持续任务中规划与信息复用的受控研究。实验在 105 个任务上评测六种规划器，并另做配对 Qwen-Plus 研究考察持久信念的作用。
AI.result: 六种规划器在 105 个任务上的评测显示，被接受的操作往往仍使任务目标未达成；执行轨迹与条件检查可区分中断运行、部分达成和完成执行但未达成目标。在配对 Qwen-Plus 研究中，持久信念使动作有效性提升 4.15 个百分点，视觉查询尝试减少 90.27%，同时 token 使用更高，且未检测到完成度增益。
AI.conclusion: Ego2World 提供了一个可复用的测试平台，用于追踪规划与记忆选择如何影响执行、观测需求和任务达成，从而将记录的人类活动与交互式智能体的开发与评测连接起来。

title: BeeWhere: Segmenting Bumble Bee Colonies to Quantify Behavioral Effects
comment: Preprint. Accepted to ECCV 2026 Computer Vision for Ecology Workshop Proceedings. Proceedings DOI pending
summary: Social bees are important pollinators that support biodiversity and crop pollination globally and serve as important model systems for collective behavior, but scalable measurement of individual- and colony-level behavior remains difficult in dense, occluded nest environments. Existing monitoring workflows use fiducial tags (e.g., ArUco) to preserve individual identity, yet tag-based tracking can fail when markers are obscured and provide limited information about body extent, spatial context, and untagged individuals. We present BeeWhere, an AI-assisted annotation and analysis workflow that combines ArUco detections with deep-learnt instance segmentations to quantify bumble bee behavior from high-resolution colony images and videos. Using bumble bee (Bombus impatiens) microcolonies as a test case, we annotate 483 frames containing 8,443 bee instances. We additionally annotate pollen balls, nest structures, and chamber boundaries, and train YOLO instance segmentation models for downstream behavioral analysis. Instance segmentations enable quantification of important behavioral metrics based on body contours, including nearest-neighbor distance, proximity to nest structures, spatial occupancy within the nest, and detection counts over time. We apply the BeeWhere models to tag-based tracking in an exploratory validation study assessing the behavioral impacts of neonicotinoid pesticide exposure. BeeWhere increased detection rates compared to tag-based tracking, particularly when bees were partially obscured or under challenging imaging conditions, and also captured treatment-associated changes in bee spatial organization not captured using tag-based tracking alone. These results suggest that instance segmentation can complement fiducial-marker tracking by recovering behaviorally meaningful signals under challenging colony conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出BeeWhere工作流，结合ArUco标记检测与深度学习实例分割，从高分辨率蜂群图像/视频中量化熊蜂个体与群体行为，检测率优于纯标记跟踪。
AI.motivation: 社会性蜂类是重要传粉者与集体行为模型，但密集、遮挡严重的巢内环境难以实现可扩展的行为测量。现有基于基准标记（如ArUco）的监测可保持个体身份，却在标记被遮挡时跟踪失败，且缺乏身体轮廓、空间背景及未标记个体的信息。
AI.method: 构建BeeWhere，AI辅助标注与分析工作流，将ArUco检测与深度学习实例分割结合。以Bombus impatiens微型蜂群为测试对象，标注483帧、8,443个蜜蜂实例，并标注花粉球、巢结构与巢室边界，训练YOLO实例分割模型。基于身体轮廓计算近邻距离、与巢结构接近度、巢内空间占据及随时间检测计数等行为指标。在评估新烟碱类农药暴露行为影响的探索性验证研究中，将BeeWhere模型应用于基于标记的跟踪。
AI.result: BeeWhere相比基于标记的跟踪提高了检测率，尤其在蜜蜂被部分遮挡或成像条件困难时；并捕捉到仅靠标记跟踪无法发现的、与处理相关的蜜蜂空间组织变化。
AI.conclusion: 实例分割可补充基准标记跟踪，在困难的蜂群条件下恢复具有行为意义的信息。

title: Investigating the Role of Reasoning-Language Alignment in Monolingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Open Reasoning Across Cultures & Languages at EMNLP 2026
summary: Reasoning traces improve large language models (LLMs), but current models are trained to reason mostly in English. It has been shown that forcing a model to reason in another language degrades accuracy, even when the reasoning language matches the language of the prompt -- but only for a setting where the model reasons over a short prompt. Here, we ask whether the same holds for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), where the model must read and integrate a large amount of retrieved evidence in the target language. To study this, we build a fully monolingual German RAG question-answering testbed over the fictional world of the tabletop role-playing game The Dark Eye, a domain that is richly documented in German but too niche for the model to answer from memory, so that it has to rely on retrieval. Varying the forced reasoning language of an agentic RAG system on this testbed, we find that aligning the reasoning language with the language of the query and the retrieved documents helps. Forced German reasoning outperforms forced French, although the model benchmarks higher in French, so the benefit comes from alignment and not from language proficiency. The advantage grows when the retrieved context is richer and structure-aware. However, forced German only reaches the level of the model's native, unconstrained English reasoning without surpassing it, showing that native multilingual reasoning is needed. We publicly release the testbed and QA benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在RAG场景下强制模型使用非英语（德语）推理是否影响准确率，构建了全德语RAG问答测试床，发现推理语言与查询和检索文档语言对齐能提升性能，但无法超越模型原生英语推理。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明，强制模型用非英语语言推理会降低准确率（即使在短提示场景下推理语言与提示语言一致时也是如此）。作者想探究这一结论是否同样适用于检索增强生成（RAG）场景——即模型必须在目标语言下阅读并整合大量检索证据。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个完全单一语言的德语RAG问答测试床，基于桌面角色扮演游戏《黑暗之眼》（The Dark Eye）的虚构世界，该领域有丰富的德语文献但对模型而言太小众，无法凭记忆回答，必须依赖检索。在此测试床上，作者改变agentic RAG系统强制使用的推理语言进行对比实验。
AI.result: 将推理语言与查询及检索文档语言对齐有助于性能提升：强制德语推理优于强制法语推理，尽管模型在法语上的基准表现更高，说明收益来自语言对齐而非语言熟练度。当检索上下文更丰富且结构感知时，优势更明显。但强制德语仅能达到模型原生、不受约束的英语推理水平，未能超越。
AI.conclusion: 在RAG场景中，强制推理语言与查询和检索文档对齐可带来性能提升，但上限为模型原生英语推理水平，表明仍需要原生的多语言推理能力。作者公开了测试床和问答基准。

title: KungfuAthleteBot: learning high-dynamic humanoid motion from video with unified robust recovery
summary: Video is an abundant, inexpensive source of human motion data that is rich in extreme athletic behaviors. Making it usable for humanoid robots, however, is not a matter of simply retargeting a reconstructed trajectory: video-derived motion is physically inconsistent, devoid of actuation information, and says nothing about failure or recovery. We present KungfuAthleteBot (KAB), a framework that treats learning high-dynamic motion from video as the central problem and resolves each of these three failure modes in turn. (C1) We build the KungfuAthlete dataset from videos of national-level martial artists and introduce a physics-guided parabolic trajectory correction that removes height floating, ground penetration, and high-frequency jitter from reconstructed aerial and landing phases. (C2) Because video carries no force information, strict tracking of a reconstructed trajectory is dynamically infeasible, and error-driven initialization keeps re-launching the policy from infeasible aerial poses. We introduce physics-driven pseudo-low-kinetic-energy (LKE) sampling, our central mechanism for making such references learnable: it biases initialization towards dynamically feasible states, letting the policy discover feasible actuation patterns instead of imitating infeasible ones. (C3) Finally, we introduce a direct training paradigm in which disturbance rejection and fall recovery are learned inside the same policy that tracks the video motion, requiring no recovery reference data and no manual mode switching. On a humanoid robot, KAB learns dynamic skills from video and recovers from arbitrary falls in about 0.7 s, the fastest reported recovery for a unified policy. Ablations on the unified policy confirm the necessity of its components, supporting the view that repairing and compensating video data, rather than only collecting more of it, is what unlocks high-dynamic humanoid skills.

AI.tldr: KungfuAthleteBot (KAB) 将视频学习高动态人形机器人运动视为核心问题，针对视频数据物理不一致、无驱动力信息、缺乏失败恢复三类缺陷逐一解决，实现约0.7秒的最快统一策略跌倒恢复。
AI.motivation: 视频是丰富廉价的人体运动数据源，富含极端运动行为，但直接重定向重建轨迹无法用于人形机器人，原因有三：视频推导的运动物理不一致、缺乏驱动力信息、不包含失败与恢复信息。作者认为关键不在于收集更多数据，而在于修复和补偿视频数据。
AI.method: 提出三个组件：(C1) 构建 KungfuAthlete 数据集（国家级武术运动员视频），引入物理引导的抛物轨迹修正，消除腾空与落地阶段的高度漂浮、穿地和抖动；(C2) 提出物理驱动的伪低动能(LKE)采样，偏向动力学可行状态初始化，使策略发现可行驱动力模式而非模仿不可行轨迹；(C3) 引入直接训练范式，在同一策略内学习抗扰与跌倒恢复，无需恢复参考数据和手动模式切换。
AI.result: 在人形机器人上，KAB 从视频学习动态技能，并能在约0.7秒内从任意跌倒中恢复，为统一策略中报告的最快恢复速度。统一策略的消融实验确认了各组件的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 修复与补偿视频数据（而非仅收集更多数据）是解锁高动态人形机器人技能的关键，支持该观点。

title: Capability Scaling-Down Laws for LLM Compression
summary: LLM compression reduces inference costs and memory requirements, but selecting a method and configuration remains largely empirical because comparable resource reductions can produce different capability losses. We systematically investigate capability scaling-down laws for LLM compression across pruning, quantization, and distillation. Our framework measures capability loss in mathematics, code generation, and question answering, and relates these measurements to model size, training stage, compression settings, data availability, and training exposure. We develop simple predictive relations and evaluate their accuracy, measurement efficiency, and generalization to unseen configurations and model states. Sharing the density response across pruning levels halves the configuration measurements needed to fit a pruning predictor: on new Pythia states, on pre-registered OLMo-2 test states and under Wanda pruning, the compact relation matches a regression fitted with all measurements on math and code to within 0.020 nats per token, with coefficients refitted for each setting. Controlled distillation experiments show that the cost of heavy data reuse recurs across question-answering distributions, while the net benefit depends on the evaluation distribution. We further evaluate the decision value of these predictions by comparing numerical selection with configuration medians and fixed method priorities. Independent evaluations across two model families show that selection captures most of the available cross-method benefit for question answering within the tested candidate sets, where a fixed method priority attains the same regret, with smaller opportunities for mathematics and code. These results clarify the predictive scope of capability scaling-down laws and their use in compression method selection. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/LabRAI/scaling_down_law.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究LLM压缩（剪枝、量化、蒸馏）的能力缩减（scaling-down）规律，建立可预测能力损失的简单关系，并评估其在压缩方法选择中的决策价值。
AI.motivation: LLM压缩可降低推理成本与内存需求，但方法及配置选择多为经验性：相同的资源削减可能导致不同的能力损失，缺乏可预测的规律指导配置选择。
AI.method: 构建统一框架，在数学、代码生成与问答任务上测量能力损失，并将其与模型规模、训练阶段、压缩设置、数据可用性及训练曝光量关联；推导简洁预测关系，评估其准确性、测量效率及对未见配置与模型状态的泛化；通过对比数值选择、配置中位数与固定方法优先级评估预测的决策价值。
AI.result: 跨剪枝级别共享密度响应可将拟合剪枝预测器所需的配置测量量减半：在Pythia新状态、预注册的OLMo-2测试状态及Wanda剪枝下，紧凑关系在每个设置重新拟合系数后，在数学与代码上的误差可控制在0.020 nats/token以内。蒸馏实验显示重度数据复用的代价在多个问答分布上一致，但净收益取决于评估分布。在两个模型族上的独立评估中，选择策略在问答上捕获了大部分跨方法收益，但固定方法优先级达到相同遗憾值，数学与代码的改进空间较小。
AI.conclusion: 结果澄清了能力缩减规律的预测范围及其在压缩方法选择中的应用价值；代码已公开于https://github.com/LabRAI/scaling_down_law。

title: On the Chain-of-Thought Monitorability of Looped Language Models
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring provides a promising approach for detecting undesirable model behavior. Looped language models (LoopLMs) repeatedly apply shared transformer layers, increasing effective computational depth and enabling additional latent computation without increasing model size. However, the effect of looped architectures on CoT monitorability remains largely unexplored. In this work, we provide the first systematic evaluation of CoT monitorability in LoopLMs. We study two complementary settings: (1) varying the loop depth within the same LoopLM family to isolate the effect of additional recurrent computation, and (2) comparing LoopLMs with non-looped language models matched by parameter size, transformer-layer count, or effective depth to study whether LoopLMs are less monitorable. Across eight tasks from MonitorBench and both standard and stress-test settings, we observe task-dependent reductions in CoT monitorability under stress tests on specific Logic/Science/Engineering \texttt{Cue Answer} tasks, while other tasks exhibit weaker or qualitatively different trends. Our diagnosis suggests that these declines are not fully explained by task difficulty, verification pass rate, or generated token length; qualitative examples further suggest changes in how deeper-loop models explicitly use or attribute provided cues. Our cross-model comparison finds no evidence that LoopLMs are systematically less monitorable than non-looped language models matched on size or depth. Overall, our results suggest that deeper loop depth can reduce CoT monitorability in some tasks under stress tests, but looped transformer architecture alone does not necessarily imply lower monitorability.

AI.tldr: 首次系统评估循环语言模型（LoopLM）的思维链（CoT）可监控性：更深循环深度在部分任务的压力测试下会降低可监控性，但循环架构本身并不意味着可监控性更低。
AI.motivation: CoT监控是检测模型不良行为的有效手段；LoopLM通过重复使用共享Transformer层提升有效计算深度而不增大模型规模，但其循环结构对CoT可监控性的影响尚缺乏研究。
AI.method: 设置两个互补实验：（1）在同一LoopLM家族内改变循环深度，分离额外循环计算的影响；（2）将LoopLM与参数量、Transformer层数或有效深度匹配的非循环模型对比，检验LoopLM是否更难以监控。在MonitorBench的8个任务上，于标准与压力测试两种设置下进行评估。
AI.result: 在压力测试下，特定逻辑/科学/工程类Cue Answer任务出现任务相关的CoT可监控性下降，其他任务趋势较弱或性质不同；该下降无法完全用任务难度、验证通过率或生成token长度解释，定性样例提示深层循环模型对给定线索的使用与归因方式发生改变。跨模型对比未发现LoopLM在规模或深度匹配下系统性更难以监控的证据。
AI.conclusion: 更深循环深度在部分任务的压力测试下可能降低CoT可监控性，但仅凭循环Transformer架构并不必然导致可监控性下降。

title: Where to Look Is Not How to Fix: Pre-Denoising Diagnostics and Modality-Dependent Control in Diffusion Composition
summary: Understanding compositional failures in text-to-image diffusion requires identifying both where stress is detectable and how intervention changes the output. We study these questions through a controlled anchor--stress protocol that jointly evaluates text-encoder diagnostics and denoiser interventions. We introduce a text-only Compositional Stress Index (CSI), which separates common from rare compositions across SD1.5, SDXL, and the SD3 text path and provides an upstream diagnostic coordinate. A matched six-prompt localization study links intervention location to distinct outcomes: residual-minimizing embedding adapters improve representation fit, while downstream cross-attention intervention increases color hit rate (CHR) by 0.0272. Across SD1.5 and SDXL denoiser blocks, the largest positive signed diagnostic-accessibility mean occurs at the deep encoder, whereas selective boost has its largest positive mean CHR response at decoder blocks. Selective subtraction and broad ablation reveal further modality- and architecture-dependent responses, including a substantial CHR decrease when SDXL decoder cross-attention is broadly ablated. We find a diagnosis-control dissociation under our controlled attribute-object composition setting: compositional defects are diagnosable before denoising, but the representation coordinate that exposes risk is not necessarily the coordinate or modality that improves generation.

AI.tldr: 该文通过受控的“锚点-压力”协议，联合评估文本编码器诊断与去噪器干预，揭示组合失败的诊断位置与有效干预位置之间存在“诊断-控制解离”。
AI.motivation: 理解文生图扩散模型的组合失败，需同时回答两个问题：压力在何处可被检测，以及干预如何改变生成输出。既有研究往往分别考察文本编码或去噪过程，缺乏将诊断坐标与干预效果对应起来的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出锚点-压力受控协议，同时评估文本编码器诊断与去噪器干预。引入纯文本的“组合压力指数（CSI）”，在SD1.5、SDXL与SD3文本路径上区分常见与罕见组合，作为上游诊断坐标；并开展匹配的六提示定位研究，比较残差最小化嵌入适配器与下游交叉注意力干预的效果；在SD1.5与SDXL去噪块上分析有符号诊断可达性均值与选择性增强的CHR响应，并做选择性减法与广泛消融。
AI.result: 残差最小化嵌入适配器改善表示拟合；下游交叉注意力干预将颜色命中率（CHR）提升0.0272。SD1.5与SDXL中，最大正的有符号诊断可达性均值出现在深层编码器，而选择性增强的最大正CHR响应出现在解码器块。选择性减法与广泛消融显示出模态与架构依赖的响应，SDXL解码器交叉注意力被广泛消融时CHR显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 在受控的属性-对象组合设定下，存在诊断-控制解离：组合缺陷在去噪前即可诊断，但暴露风险的表示坐标并不必然是改善生成所应干预的坐标或模态。

title: Predicting Steering Vectors and Adapter Weights for Few-Shot Author-Style Transfer
summary: Adapting large language models to an individual author's style from a few examples is challenging, and scientific writing sharpens the difficulty: formal conventions leave little surface variation, and authors write about their own topics, so extracted ``style'' easily entangles with content. We study style-conditioned abstract generation from a few example abstracts per author and propose three methods: (1) contrastive activation steering, (2) a network that predicts steering vectors, and (3) a hypernetwork that predicts LoRA adapters. We find a consistent trade-off between style imitation and output quality: fine-tuning buys most of the available style signal but forfeits fluency, while the hypernetwork achieves the best trade-off on both seen and unseen authors. Our steering operates at author level, contrasting an author's abstracts against style-neutral generations for the same content. This holds topic fixed, removes the need for a predefined style inventory, and outperforms inventory-based steering. % [EDIT 1a] softened "no single optimal axis" claim Moreover, our analyses demonstrate that manually extracted and predicted steering vectors are near-orthogonal yet score comparably, indicating that style conditioning here can admit at least two unrelated directions rather than requiring one particular axis.

AI.tldr: 本文研究少样本条件下的作者风格化摘要生成，提出对比激活引导、引导向量预测网络与预测LoRA适配器的超网络三种方法，发现风格模仿与输出质量间存在权衡，超网络在已见与未见作者上取得最佳折衷。
AI.motivation: 将大语言模型适配到单个作者的写作风格本身困难，而科学写作进一步加剧难度：形式规范限制了表层变化，且作者书写自身主题，使提取的“风格”易与内容纠缠。此外，基于预定义风格清单的方法需要事先设定风格维度，缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: 以每位作者的少量示例摘要为条件进行风格化摘要生成，提出三种方法：（1）对比激活引导；（2）预测引导向量的网络；（3）预测LoRA适配器的超网络。引导在作者层面操作，将作者摘要与相同内容的风格中立生成结果进行对比，从而固定主题、无需预定义风格清单。
AI.result: 风格模仿与输出质量之间存在一致的权衡：微调获取了大部分可用风格信号但牺牲了流畅性；超网络在已见和未见作者上均实现最佳权衡。作者层面的引导优于基于风格清单的引导。分析显示，人工提取与预测的引导向量近似正交但评分相当。
AI.conclusion: 科学写作中的风格条件化可不依赖单一特定轴，至少存在两种互不相关的方向可实现相当效果，支持无需预定义风格清单的作者层面引导范式。

title: I2CD: Direct Image-to-Convex Decomposition for Simulation-Ready Collision Geometry
summary: Physics simulators and motion planners require convex collision geometry, yet image-to-3D generative models output dense, frequently non-manifold visual meshes. Bridging the two today takes a slow, brittle reconstruct-then-decompose pipeline of repair, decimation, and approximate convex decomposition. We present I2CD, which predicts a convex decomposition directly from a single RGB image. Rather than train a new image-to-3D model, I2CD freezes the pretrained Hunyuan3D-2 image-conditioned diffusion transformer and shape decoder and trains only a lightweight cross-attention head (38M parameters, under ten GPU-hours) whose learned "convex-slot" tokens emit the halfplane parameters of $K$ convex polytopes. The output is compact, convex by construction, and loads into physics engines without any post-processing, in ${\sim}0.5$s per image. On $227$ held-out OmniObject3D and Google Scanned Objects instances, I2CD attains the highest volumetric IoU among eight reconstruct-then-decompose pipelines while running $6$-$37\times$ faster end-to-end. In a cross-simulator study in MuJoCo, PyBullet, Genesis, and Isaac Sim, every engine uses I2CD geometry as delivered, whereas raw generated meshes "load" everywhere but are silently replaced by a different collision shape in most cases or need seconds to minutes of per-object preprocessing. On a physical xArm7, I2CD produces planner-ready geometry for a $20$-object cluttered scene in $11$s versus $328$s for the strongest baseline, at comparable pick-and-place execution success ($85$ vs. $90$ of $100$ trials).

AI.tldr: I2CD 直接从单张 RGB 图像预测凸分解，冻结预训练 Hunyuan3D-2 扩散 Transformer 与形状解码器，仅训练一个 38M 参数的轻量跨注意力头，输出 K 个凸多面体的半平面参数，无需后处理即可载入物理引擎。
AI.motivation: 物理模拟器与运动规划需要凸碰撞几何，而图像到 3D 生成模型输出的是稠密、常为非流形的视觉网格；现有"先重建再分解"的流程需修复、简化与近似凸分解，速度慢且脆弱。
AI.method: 冻结预训练的 Hunyuan3D-2 图像条件扩散 Transformer 和形状解码器，仅训练轻量跨注意力头（38M 参数，少于 10 GPU 小时），其学习的"凸槽"（convex-slot）token 输出 K 个凸多面体的半平面参数；结果紧凑、构造上即凸、无需后处理，单图约 0.5 秒。
AI.result: 在 227 个留出的 OmniObject3D 与 Google Scanned Objects 实例上，I2CD 在八种"先重建再分解"流程中体积 IoU 最高，端到端快 6–37 倍；MuJoCo、PyBullet、Genesis、Isaac Sim 跨模拟器研究中各引擎可直接使用其几何；xArm7 实物上 20 物体杂乱场景生成规划就绪几何仅 11 秒（最强基线 328 秒），抓放成功率相当（100 次试验 85 对 90）。
AI.conclusion: I2CD 通过直接图像到凸分解的范式，绕过缓慢脆弱的重建-分解流水线，在精度、速度与跨模拟器/实物可用性上均优于现有基线，为物理仿真与运动规划提供即用型凸碰撞几何。

title: Threshold-Aware Conformal Routing
summary: High-fidelity simulations are essential to scientific and engineering design, but can be expensive to run repeatedly. Learned surrogates offer a faster alternative, yet their higher errors may alter downstream decisions. This accuracy-speed tradeoff creates a need to determine whether a surrogate can be used or the full simulator remains necessary. We study decisions determined by whether a scalar quantity of interest lies above or below a fixed threshold. For each input, we use the surrogate when its conformal interval lies entirely on one side of the threshold and route the input to simulation when the interval intersects it. Standard conformal prediction constructs intervals without reference to the downstream decision threshold: even a narrow interval near the threshold can cross it and trigger simulation, whereas a wider interval farther away can remain entirely on one side and require no simulation. We introduce Threshold-Aware Conformal Routing (TACR), which learns an input-dependent scale using a threshold-aware objective that concentrates interval tightness near the decision boundary. Exact split-conformal calibration on held-out data preserves distribution-free marginal coverage, which also upper-bounds the probability of an incorrect threshold decision that is not routed. Across various scientific and engineering datasets, TACR reduces simulator deferrals by 14-75% relative to standard conformal prediction at the same coverage target. Against a variant without threshold-local weighting but with similar predictor accuracy, TACR further reduces deferrals by 10-24% on four datasets. These results show that optimizing interval allocation for routing can reduce simulator calls without weakening the standard conformal guarantee.

AI.tldr: 提出TACR方法，利用阈值感知的共形预测自适应分配区间宽度，在保持共形覆盖保证的前提下减少对高保真模拟器的调用次数。
AI.motivation: 高保真模拟在科学与工程设计中不可或缺但重复运行代价高昂。学习型代理模型虽快，但误差可能改变下游决策。在精度–速度权衡下，需要判断何时可用代理、何时必须调用完整模拟器。标准共形预测构建区间时不考虑下游决策阈值，导致靠近阈值的窄区间也可能跨越阈值触发模拟，而远离阈值的宽区间反而无需模拟，效率低下。
AI.method: 研究由标量关注量是否高于或低于固定阈值所决定的决策问题。对每个输入，若代理的共形区间完全位于阈值一侧则使用代理，若区间与阈值相交则路由到模拟。提出阈值感知共形路由（TACR）：通过学习输入相关的尺度，采用阈值感知目标函数，使区间紧致性集中于决策边界附近。在留出数据上使用精确的拆分共形校准，保持无分布假设的边缘覆盖保证。
AI.result: 在多个科学与工程数据集上，相同覆盖目标下TACR相对标准共形预测将模拟器延迟率降低14%–75%。在与TACR预测器精度相近但无阈值局部加权的变体对比中，TACR在四个数据集上进一步减少10%–24%的延迟。
AI.conclusion: 针对路由任务优化区间分配可在不削弱标准共形保证的情况下减少模拟器调用，表明阈值感知的区间紧致性分配能有效提升代理–模拟器路由效率。

title: Dynamic LLM Routers are Often Misguided
comment: 8 pages, 15 figures, under review at NAACL
summary: Dynamic LLM routers promise to cut inference costs by sending each query to the cheapest model that can answer it correctly. We analyze six commercial routers across 14 settings on a diverse benchmark spanning eight task categories, finding that none of them outperforms a router that randomly selects between two well-chosen models at matched cost. Some underperform by more than 10 percentage points. We trace this gap to four patterns prevalent across routers: difficulty blindness, length reversal, semantic matching, and roster suboptimality. We show that the first three are what the standard objective rewards: cost-accuracy Pareto efficiency on realized costs favors escalating moderately hard queries over the hardest ones, shorter queries over longer ones, and routing by a query's source over its difficulty. We also argue that the two assumptions that would justify large rosters, model granularity and model specialization, do not hold empirically. We propose an alternative evaluation methodology that does not reward these patterns, and as a proof of concept, we design a simple two-model router that avoids all four. Nevertheless, its gain over random routing is limited, because a well-chosen roster leaves little to route.

AI.tldr: 对六款商用LLM路由器的系统评测表明，它们均不优于在成本匹配下随机选择两个合适模型的简单路由，部分甚至低10个百分点以上；作者将差距归因于四种普遍模式，并指出现有评估目标本身在奖励其中三种模式。
AI.motivation: LLM路由器承诺通过把每个查询发给能正确回答它的最便宜模型来降低推理成本，但其实际有效性缺乏系统性检验。作者希望验证商用路由器是否真正优于简单基线，并找出其失效的根源。
AI.method: 在涵盖八个任务类别的多样化基准上，跨14种设置分析六款商用路由器，并与成本匹配下随机选择两个合适模型的基线对比；进一步将性能差距归因于四种模式（难度盲视、长度反转、语义匹配、模型集次优），并从标准优化目标（基于实际成本的成本-准确率帕累托效率）和两个隐含假设（模型粒度、模型专精）两方面进行理论分析；最后提出替代评估方法，并设计一个规避全部四种模式的简单双模型路由器作为概念验证。
AI.result: 没有任何一款商用路由器优于成本匹配的随机双模型路由基线，部分路由器性能低超过10个百分点。四种模式中，难度盲视、长度反转和语义匹配恰是标准目标所奖励的：在该目标下，成本-准确率帕累托效率倾向于对中等难度而非最难查询升级，偏好更短查询，并按查询来源而非难度进行路由。同时，支撑大规模模型集的模型粒度与模型专精两个假设在实证中不成立。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM路由器的评估目标存在系统性偏差，会奖励上述不良模式，因此需要采用不奖励这些模式的替代评估方法。概念验证的双模型路由器虽能规避全部四种模式，但其相对随机路由的增益有限，原因在于一个选择得当的模型集本身几乎没有多少可供路由的空间。

title: NegT2IBench: When Negation Changes the Picture. A Polarity Benchmark for Text-to-Image Models
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models are judged by benchmarks that measure whether requested content appears, but these benchmarks largely overlook the complementary ability to satisfy negated constraints, for example, generating "a non-red cup." Measuring negation raises challenges not faced by affirmation-based benchmarks and requires careful prompt and evaluation design. We introduce NegT2IBench, a benchmark of 4,800 prompts covering two attribute types and four relation categories. Prompts are organized by polarity: the number of positive statements that must hold and negated statements that must not, each ranging from 0 to 2. Varying the two independently separates the effect of negation from the effect of prompt complexity. Our detector-based scoring is reproducible, auditable, and pinpoints which requirement failed. On 600 images with three-annotator labels, it agrees with humans as closely as vision-language judges up to 30x larger, while using only a fraction of their GPU memory. Across eleven T2I models and 211,200 images, nine score lower on a single negated statement than on a single positive one. Per-statement scoring reveals that the loss is largest for color and near zero for proximity, and that 41.5% of failed statements render exactly what the prompt forbids. Rendering what a prompt asks for and withholding what it forbids are distinct capabilities that an aggregate compositional score cannot distinguish. NegT2IBench measures the latter directly, providing a controlled testbed for diagnosing negation failures and developing methods to overcome them.

AI.tldr: 提出 NegT2IBench 基准（4,800 条提示），通过独立控制肯定/否定陈述数量，直接评测 T2I 模型的否定约束满足能力，并结合可复现的检测器评分定位失败项。
AI.motivation: 现有 T2I 基准只衡量"请求内容是否出现"，忽视了"是否满足否定约束"（如生成"非红色杯子"）；否定评测在提示设计与评估设计上都有特殊挑战，需要专门的受控基准。
AI.method: 构建 NegT2IBench：4,800 条提示，覆盖 2 种属性类型与 4 类关系；按极性组织，必须成立的肯定陈述数与必须不成立的否定陈述数各取 0–2，二者独立变化以解耦否定效应与提示复杂度效应。采用基于检测器的评分，可复现、可审计，并能定位具体失败的需求项。
AI.result: 在 600 张由三名标注者标注的图像上，该评分与人类的一致性接近最多大 30 倍的 VLM 评判器，而 GPU 显存占用仅为其一小部分。在 11 个 T2I 模型、共 211,200 张图像上，9 个模型在单条否定陈述上的得分低于单条肯定陈述；逐陈述评分显示颜色维度损失最大、邻近关系近乎为零，且 41.5% 的失败陈述实际渲染了提示所禁止的内容。
AI.conclusion: "渲染所要求的内容"与"抑制所禁止的内容"是两种不同能力，聚合式组合得分无法区分。NegT2IBench 直接测量后者，为诊断否定失败并开发改进方法提供受控测试平台。

title: Hindsight-Guided Rationale Distillation for Rare Disease Diagnosis
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, Github: https://github.com/joetheguide2/hindsight, Accepted at AACL-IJCNLP SRW 2026
summary: We study hindsight-guided distillation for rare disease diagnosis on ZebraMap: a 1.5B student is fine-tuned on chain-of-thought traces from a 8B teacher that observes the ground-truth diagnosis during generation. Absolute accuracy remains low for all models - the task is hard at this scale - but within this ceiling a filtered variant (StudentF) achieves a small, statistically significant accuracy advantage over the teacher (p < 0.001), concentrated in better-represented diseases. The unfiltered student does not significantly outperform the teacher (p = 0.129), establishing that contamination filtering - not hindsight distillation alone - drives the gain. The gap traces to an artifact we term GT hallucination. Label-visible generation causes the teacher to embed "ground truth is X" phrases in its reasoning chain; SFT copies the pattern. At inference, the unfiltered student reproduces the phrase in 33.9% of cases, with severe accuracy degradation when the hallucinated label is wrong. A regex filter removing these slots reduces contamination to near-zero, producing the observed gain - though the effect remains small. We precisely quantify this gain-cost tradeoff, document frequency-dependent knowledge transfer absent from the RL-trained teacher, and characterize a calibration gap that SFT does not close - identifying both as directions for future work.

AI.tldr: 在ZebraMap罕见病诊断任务上，研究"事后指导蒸馏"（教师可见金标准生成思维链，学生模仿）。绝对准确率均偏低，但经正则过滤去除"GT幻觉"句子后，学生F取得对教师的小幅显著优势（p<0.001），证明增益来自污染过滤而非事后蒸馏本身。
AI.motivation: 探索在罕见病诊断这一困难任务上，能否通过让教师模型在生成思维链时看到金标准答案（hindsight-guided distillation），将知识蒸馏给较小学生模型，并厘清增益的真正来源。
AI.method: 在ZebraMap数据集上，用8B教师生成思维链，微调1.5B学生；设置过滤与未过滤两个学生变体（正则过滤去除包含"ground truth is X"的句子）。通过显著性检验比较学生与教师的准确率，并统计幻觉句出现率及其对正确率的影响。
AI.result: 所有模型绝对准确率均低。过滤版学生F相对教师有统计显著的小幅提升（p<0.001），且集中于数据充足的疾病；未过滤学生不显著优于教师（p=0.129）。未过滤学生推理中33.9%复现"金标准是X"句式，幻觉标签错误时准确率严重下降。过滤后污染近乎为零。
AI.conclusion: 增益源于对GT幻觉的过滤，而非事后蒸馏本身；该效应虽小但可精确量化。作者记录了频率依赖的知识迁移（RL训练教师不具备）与SFT未能消除的校准差距，作为未来工作方向。

title: MobiAgent: Dual-Loop Recursive Policy Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
comment: Accepted at the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026. Project page: https://kaiknower.github.io/mobiagent
summary: Long-horizon mobile manipulation presents significant challenges due to compounding execution errors and capacity interference between locomotion and arm control. While recent Vision-Language-Action models excel at short-horizon tasks, they lack the hierarchical reasoning required for multi-stage objectives. Furthermore, existing hierarchical agents suffer from rigid sub-task mapping, inflexible replanning, and a lack of continuous learning. To address these limitations, we introduce MobiAgent, a dual-loop agentic framework that bridges robust deployment execution and recursive policy self-improvement. During deployment, the Inner Loop decouples high-level reasoning from low-level control through highly composable atomic skills. It employs Vision-Language models for receding-horizon planning and visual reflection, dynamically composing skills to ensure robust error recovery. These skills are executed by specialized flow-matching experts that share a unified VLM backbone, maximizing reusability while mitigating capacity interference. Concurrently, the Outer Loop drives automated lifelong learning by autonomously segmenting and verifying deployment rollouts, clustering them to discover atomic skills, and continuously fine-tuning the skill library without human annotations. Evaluations on RoboCasa, BEHAVIOR-1K, and real-world tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of MobiAgent. It outperforms $π_{0.5}$-TA by 22.5 percentage points on BEHAVIOR-1K and enables robust recovery from execution failures. Through autonomous data recycling, success improves from 7.50% to 27.50% on RoboCasa and from 32.5% to 57.5% on Astribot S1.

AI.tldr: 提出MobiAgent双环智能体框架，通过内环分层规划与外环自监督终身学习，显著提升长时程移动操作任务的成功率与纠错能力。
AI.motivation: 长时程移动操作面临执行误差累积以及移动与机械臂控制之间的容量干扰问题。现有VLA模型擅长短时程任务，缺乏多阶段目标所需的层级推理能力；已有分层智能体存在子任务映射僵化、重规划不灵活、无法持续学习等缺陷。
AI.method: 提出双环智能体框架MobiAgent。内环将高层推理与底层控制解耦，基于高度可组合的原子技能，利用视觉语言模型进行滚动时域规划与视觉反思，动态组合技能以实现鲁棒纠错；技能由共享统一VLM骨干的专用流匹配专家执行，兼顾复用性与容量干扰抑制。外环实现自动化终身学习，自主分割并验证部署轨迹，通过聚类发现原子技能并持续微调技能库，无需人工标注。
AI.result: 在RoboCasa、BEHAVIOR-1K及真实世界任务上验证有效。在BEHAVIOR-1K上较π0.5-TA提升22.5个百分点，并具备从执行失败中恢复的鲁棒性。通过自主数据回收，RoboCasa成功率由7.50%提升至27.50%，Astribot S1由32.5%提升至57.5%。
AI.conclusion: MobiAgent通过内环分层灵活部署与外环自监督持续学习的双环协同，有效缓解长时程移动操作中的误差累积与容量干扰，实现更强的鲁棒纠错与持续性能提升。

title: Harnessing LLMs as Agents: What Does It Cost?
summary: Language-model agents increasingly rely on harnesses that manage bounded context, persistent memory, tools, verification, and repeated execution, yet existing notions of model capability do not quantify the computational resources these mechanisms consume. We introduce the Language Model Agent Machine (LAM), a resource-bounded abstraction that fixes the underlying semantic model while explicitly charging harness-level resources. We establish four classes of results. Communication: LAM execution is instancewise equivalent to red--blue pebbling under simultaneous call--transfer budgets, transferring classical I/O lower bounds to context--memory traffic. Access: memory interfaces induce asymptotic separations, including a $Θ(n)$ gap between random and non-speculative sequential access on pointer chasing. Recomputation: bit-reversal DAGs require $Θ(n^2/(C+S)+n)$ model calls with context capacity $C$ and persistent-memory capacity $S$, quantifying when stored intermediate state avoids repeated semantic computation. Reliability: we derive tight stage-local sampling bounds, exact imperfect-verification costs, and a Young--Daly-type checkpoint law with a closed-form optimal verification interval. Controlled and held-out experiments on GPT-6 Astra test communication and reliability predictions, including checkpoint optima, policy selection under programmatic checking, and tradeoffs among call granularity, logical input traffic, and reliability on chained MATH tasks. Together, these results provide a resource theory for the computational cost of language-model agent harnesses.

AI.tldr: 论文提出语言模型智能体机（LAM），一种资源受限抽象，固定语义模型并显式计费harness层资源，建立通信、访问、重计算、可靠性四类理论结果并实验验证。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体日益依赖管理有界上下文、持久记忆、工具、验证与重复执行的harness，但现有模型能力概念未量化这些机制消耗的计算资源，缺乏相应的资源理论。
AI.method: 提出LAM资源受限抽象：固定底层语义模型，显式计入harness层资源；将LAM执行归约为带同时调用-传输预算的红蓝鹅卵石游戏，推导I/O下界；分析记忆接口的渐近分离；对位反转DAG分析重计算代价；推导可靠性界限与检查点定律；进行受控与留出实验验证。
AI.result: 通信上LAM执行与带同时调用-传输预算的红蓝鹅卵石实例等价，将经典I/O下界迁移到上下文-记忆流量；访问上记忆接口产生渐近分离，指针追逐中随机与非推测顺序访问存在Θ(n)差距；重计算上位反转DAG需Θ(n²/(C+S)+n)次模型调用；可靠性上得到紧的阶段性采样界、精确非完美验证代价及Young-Daly型检查点定律与闭式最优验证间隔；GPT-6 Astra实验验证了通信与可靠性预测，包括检查点最优、程序化检查下的策略选择及调用粒度、逻辑输入流量与可靠性的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为语言模型智能体harness的计算成本提供了资源理论，统一刻画了上下文-记忆通信、访问、重计算与可靠性代价。

title: Law And Order: Tax Law Autoformalization
summary: Legal systems are increasingly implemented through software, yet scalable methods for translating legal texts into accurate symbolic representations remain underdeveloped. We study this problem through tax law, where forms and filing instructions define large computational structures involving arithmetic, branching, recursion, and tabular reasoning. We propose Law&Order, a neuro-symbolic framework for automatically formalizing tax forms and instructions into executable symbolic programs. Our approach establishes two forms of correspondence between law and logic: structural correspondence, which aligns legal and symbolic components such as cells and schedules, and denotational correspondence, which requires symbolic components to implement the computations specified by their legal counterparts. We combine large language model synthesis with cell-level verification and iterative localized error repair using human-written OpenTaxSolver tax returns. We then evaluate the resulting formalizations on independently authored, held-out TaxCalcBench returns, that are never exposed during generation or repair. Although the most advanced LLM achieves only 66% accuracy, Law&Order achieves 100% cell-level and form-level accuracy on 51 held-out returns, demonstrating the effectiveness of combining LLM-based synthesis with symbolic verification for scalable and verifiable large-scale legal autoformalization compared with using an LLM alone.

AI.tldr: 提出神经符号框架 Law&Order，将税法表格与填写说明自动形式化为可执行符号程序，在留出的 TaxCalcBench 报税表上实现 100% 单元格级与表格级准确率。
AI.motivation: 法律系统日益以软件实现，但将法律文本可扩展地翻译为准确符号表示的方法仍不成熟；税法（表格与填写说明）包含算术、分支、递归与表格推理，构成大规模计算结构，是研究该问题的合适载体。
AI.method: Law&Order 基于神经符号方法，建立法律与逻辑的两种对应关系：结构对应（对齐单元格、附表等法律与符号组件）与指称对应（符号组件须实现其法律对应物所规定的计算）。方法结合大语言模型合成、单元格级验证，以及利用人工编写的 OpenTaxSolver 报税表进行迭代式局部错误修复。
AI.result: 在生成与修复阶段均未接触的、独立编写的留出集 TaxCalcBench 报税表上评估：最先进 LLM 仅达 66% 准确率，而 Law&Order 在 51 份留出报税表上取得 100% 单元格级和表格级准确率。
AI.conclusion: 将基于 LLM 的合成与符号验证相结合，相比单用 LLM，能更有效、可验证地实现大规模法律自动形式化。

title: Beyond Single Videos: Benchmarking and Active Evidence Seeking for E-Commerce Cross-Video Reasoning
summary: E-commerce videos are information-dense and frequently compared by consumers evaluating products and merchants assessing marketing strategies. However, existing multimodal models mainly focus on single-video understanding and have limited ability to compare information across videos. We introduce AdsCVR, the first e-commerce cross-video reasoning benchmark, containing 2,483 videos and 6,110 question-answer pairs across six reasoning dimensions. Cross- video reasoning requires models to locate fine-grained evidence among many redundant frames and integrate visual details, speech, and on-screen text. We therefore propose AdSeek, an agentic framework that dynamically selects visual and audio tools during multi-turn exploration, replacing static uniform sampling with active evidence acquisition. To address the sparse credit assignment of reinforcement learning, we develop an offline trajectory rectification mechanism that identifies reasoning errors and missing multimodal evidence in RL-generated trajectories. The corrected trajectories provide supervised fine-tuning signals that reduce biases learned during RL. This mechanism supports a rectified bootstrapping pipeline in which initial RL exposes reasoning bottlenecks, supervised fine-tuning corrects them, and a final RL stage further improves the policy. AdSeek achieves 74.30 percent accuracy on the AdsCVR test split, outperforming its Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct backbone by 27.90 percentage points. It also generalizes to the open- domain CrossVid benchmark, demonstrating effective active evidence gathering.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出首个电商跨视频推理基准AdsCVR（2,483个视频、6,110个问答对，涵盖六个推理维度），并设计智能体框架AdSeek，通过多轮探索中动态调用视觉与音频工具实现主动证据获取，配合离线轨迹矫正机制缓解强化学习的稀疏信用分配问题。AdSeek在AdsCVR测试集取得74.30%准确率，较Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct骨干提升27.90个百分点，并在开放域CrossVid基准上展现良好泛化性。
AI.motivation: 电商视频信息密度高，消费者与商家常需跨视频对比，但现有多模态模型主要聚焦单视频理解，跨视频信息比较能力有限，且缺乏相应评测基准。同时，跨视频推理需在大量冗余帧中定位细粒度证据并整合视觉细节、语音与屏幕文字，静态均匀采样效率低；强化学习在长程多轮探索中面临信用分配稀疏的难题。
AI.method: 1) 构建AdsCVR基准：含2,483个视频、6,110个问答对，覆盖六个推理维度；2) 提出AdSeek智能体框架：在多轮探索中动态选择视觉与音频工具，以主动证据获取替代静态均匀采样；3) 设计离线轨迹矫正机制：识别RL生成轨迹中的推理错误与缺失的多模态证据，用矫正后的轨迹提供监督微调信号，抑制RL习得的偏差，并形成"RL暴露瓶颈—SFT矫正—再RL提升策略"的矫正式自举训练流程。
AI.result: AdSeek在AdsCVR测试集上达到74.30%准确率，相比其Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct骨干模型提升27.90个百分点；在开放域CrossVid基准上同样取得有效表现，验证了主动证据收集的可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 跨视频推理是现有多模态模型的能力短板，主动式证据获取结合轨迹矫正的自举训练范式能显著提升模型在电商跨视频场景下的推理性能，且具备向开放域任务泛化的潜力。

title: Not Until the Evidence Says So: Teaching LLM Investigators When to Close a Case
comment: 23 pages. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/etigerstudio/Nautil ; Models: https://huggingface.co/etigerstudio/Nautil-SFT , https://huggingface.co/etigerstudio/Nautil-RLVR ; Demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/etigerstudio/Nautil-Demo ; Code: https://github.com/etigerstudio/Nautil
summary: Accident, defect and outage investigations end with a decision that ordinary question answering never faces: whether the evidence gathered so far is enough to close the case. We study this decision for LLM investigators, which request evidence from a case file, revise their hypotheses, and either close the case with a conclusion grounded in what they read or leave it open and name what is missing. This judgment does not come with capability: an untrained 9B model overstates its evidence in 97% of its answers, and a frontier model that identifies the right cause in 84% of cases still overstates in 91% and closes 17 of the 41 cases whose official finding is "cause undetermined". Measuring it is also non-trivial: the source of a case largely predicts its label, and a rule that reads only the source reaches 83.0 balanced accuracy on our test cases. We therefore evaluate closure with three tests: closure accuracy, reported against this rule and within each source; evidence dependence, which removes the grounds of a conclusion and checks whether the model stops closing; and conclusion and gap quality, a judged checklist of what the model asserts and what it says is missing. We build Nautil, 731 audited cases from aviation, rail, maritime, chemical-safety and vehicle-defect reports and production server incidents, with teacher trajectories, an out-of-distribution test set and counterfactual evidence versions. Fine-tuning a 9B model on these trajectories makes its closures follow the evidence: removing the grounds lowers its closure rate by 26 points relative to a matched control, overstatement falls from 97% to 35%, and correct, non-overstated conclusions rise from 3% to 43%. Reinforcement learning that rewards only the closure decision then raises balanced accuracy from 69.2 to 83.3, on par with the teacher, and within-source accuracy from 60.4 to 74.1, at some cost in evidence dependence.

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM调查员在事故、缺陷与故障调查中的"结案判断"（证据是否足够结案），提出Nautil数据集（731个审计案例）与三项评测指标，并证明微调可使9B模型的结案决策真正依赖证据，而仅奖励结案决策的强化学习可进一步提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 事故、缺陷与停电调查的终点是一个普通问答系统从未面对的决策：迄今收集的证据是否足以结案。这一判断并不随能力自然获得——未经训练的9B模型在97%的回答中高估自身证据；即使能正确识别原因（84%）的前沿模型，仍有91%高估证据，并在官方结论为"原因未定"的41个案例中错误地结案了17个。该能力难以测量：案例来源本身在很大程度上决定其标签，仅依据来源的规则即可在测试集上达到83.0的平衡准确率。
AI.method: 构建Nautil数据集：731个经审计的案例，覆盖航空、铁路、海事、化学品安全、车辆缺陷报告及生产服务器事故，包含教师轨迹、分布外测试集与反事实证据版本。提出三项评测：①结案准确率（对照来源规则及按来源内评估）；②证据依赖性（移除结论依据后检验模型是否停止结案）；③结论与缺口质量（对模型断言内容与所指出缺失项的评审清单）。训练方法：先以教师轨迹微调9B模型；再以仅奖励结案决策的强化学习进一步优化。
AI.result: 微调9B模型后，其结案行为开始遵循证据：相对于匹配对照组，移除依据使结案率下降26个百分点，高估证据从97%降至35%，正确且未高估的结论从3%升至43%。仅奖励结案决策的强化学习将平衡准确率从69.2提升至83.3（与教师相当），来源内准确率从60.4提升至74.1，但在证据依赖性上有一定代价。
AI.conclusion: LLM调查员的"证据是否足以结案"判断需要专门的数据与训练才能获得，而非随通用能力自然涌现。Nautil数据集与三项评测（结案准确率、证据依赖性、结论与缺口质量）可有效衡量该能力；基于教师轨迹的监督微调能让结案决策真正依赖证据，而仅奖励结案决策的强化学习可进一步逼近教师水平，但会牺牲部分证据依赖性。

title: Detect and Suppress: A Mechanistic Defense against Adversarial Patches in VLA Models
summary: Adversarial patches can disrupt Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by manipulating visual observations, leading to failures in robot control. However, it remains poorly understood which internal mechanisms underlie these failures and how targeted interventions can mitigate them. In this work, we mechanistically analyze VLA representations using a sparse autoencoder (SAE) and identify a feature whose activation strongly correlates with the presence of an adversarial patch. Based on this analysis, we suppress the identified feature at inference time only when a linear probe detects an attack. This intervention improves robustness without the cost of fine-tuning the VLA. We evaluate our method against VLA adversarial patch attacks on LIBERO-10. Conditional intervention improves success rate under intermittent attacks, whereas continuously applying the same intervention substantially degrades policy performance. These results show that attack-related internal representations can provide useful targets for VLA adversarial defense and that controlling when to intervene is important for limiting disruption to nominal policy behavior.

AI.tldr: 利用稀疏自编码器定位与对抗补丁强相关的VLA内部特征,并在检测到攻击时对该特征进行条件式抑制,可在不微调的情况下提升鲁棒性,且干预需适时进行。
AI.motivation: 对抗补丁可通过操纵视觉观测破坏VLA模型,导致机器人控制失败,但其内部机制及针对性干预方法尚不明确。
AI.method: 用稀疏自编码器(SAE)对VLA表征进行机制分析,识别出激活与对抗补丁存在强相关的特征;推理时仅在线性探针检测到攻击时抑制该特征。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-10上针对VLA对抗补丁攻击进行评估,条件干预在间歇性攻击下提升成功率,而持续施加同样干预会显著降低策略性能。
AI.conclusion: 与攻击相关的内部表征可为VLA对抗防御提供有效靶点,且控制干预时机对减少对正常策略行为的干扰至关重要。

title: LiteEMG-FM: An Efficient and Deployable Foundation Model for Robust EMG Sensing
summary: Electromyography (EMG) signals vary substantially across individuals, body regions, recording sessions, and sensing hardware, limiting the generalization of models for assistive devices and human-computer interaction. Existing time-series foundation models are also computationally expensive for real-time wearable deployment and often fail to capture EMG-specific time-frequency characteristics. We present LiteEMG-FM, an efficient hybrid CNN-Transformer foundation model for practical EMG sensing. Pretrained on 16 diverse upper- and lower-limb EMG datasets, LiteEMG-FM learns representations that generalize across users and datasets. For resource-constrained deployment, we implement a hierarchical wake-up architecture in which a lightweight, always-on 1D-CNN filters rest and non-target activity and activates LiteEMG-FM only for valid gestures. We evaluate full inference offloading, split inference, and full on-device processing, characterizing their trade-offs in latency, power consumption, and memory footprint. Across diverse evaluation settings, LiteEMG-FM outperforms state-of-the-art time-series foundation models and supervised baselines, particularly under zero-calibration cross-participant and data-scarce conditions. These results demonstrate that LiteEMG-FM is an effective, efficient, and deployable foundation model for EMG applications.

AI.tldr: 提出LiteEMG-FM——一种高效的混合CNN-Transformer肌电基础模型，通过16个上下肢EMG数据集预训练，并结合分层唤醒架构实现跨用户/跨数据集泛化与资源受限下的可部署性。
AI.motivation: EMG信号在个体、身体部位、记录会话和传感硬件间差异显著，导致辅助设备与人机交互模型泛化性差；现有时间序列基础模型在实时可穿戴部署上计算开销大，且难以捕捉EMG特有的时频特征。
AI.method: 1) 构建高效混合CNN-Transformer基础模型LiteEMG-FM，在16个多样化的上、下肢EMG数据集上进行预训练；2) 设计分层唤醒架构：常驻轻量1D-CNN先过滤静息与非目标活动，仅在检测到有效手势时激活LiteEMG-FM；3) 评估完全推理卸载、拆分推理与完全端侧处理三种部署方案。
AI.result: 在多种评估设置下，LiteEMG-FM优于当前最先进的时间序列基础模型和有监督基线，尤其在零校准跨受试者和数据稀缺条件下表现突出；同时刻画了三种部署方案在延迟、功耗与内存占用上的权衡。
AI.conclusion: LiteEMG-FM是一种有效、高效且可部署的EMG基础模型，能够在实际可穿戴/辅助设备场景中实现良好的泛化与资源约束下的运行。

title: PAPER2LLM++: Continual Self-Evolution of LLMs from Research Papers
summary: Research on LLMs continually uncovers model limitations, their causes, and potential solutions. Yet these human discoveries remain largely disconnected from model evolution: an LLM does not automatically learn from new research about its own failures. We introduce PAPER2LLM++, a framework for continual self-evolution of LLMs from research papers. Rather than treating papers merely as knowledge to retrieve, PAPER2LLM++ uses the growing literature as a stream of evidence and supervision for model improvement. For each incoming paper, it extracts evidence-grounded findings, tests whether the reported limitation persists in the current model, and, when needed, converts the findings into candidate learning signals. A try-evaluate-commit procedure integrates an update only when it improves the targeted behavior without substantially forgetting prior improvements or degrading general capabilities. Across a sequential stream of research-discovered LLM failures, we show that models can progressively incorporate new findings while retaining earlier gains. PAPER2LLM++ thus takes a step toward closing the loop between human discovery and model evolution, enabling models to continually learn from research about their own limitations and improvements.

AI.tldr: 提出 PAPER2LLM++ 框架，让 LLM 以研究论文为证据与监督信号，实现持续自我进化：抽取发现、验证局限、生成学习信号，并通过 try-evaluate-commit 增量整合更新。
AI.motivation: 关于 LLM 局限、成因与解决方案的研究不断涌现，但这些人类发现与模型进化基本脱节——模型不会自动从针对自身失败的新研究中学习。作者希望把不断增长的文献从"检索知识"转变为"改进模型的证据与监督流"，从而闭合人类发现与模型进化之间的循环。
AI.method: PAPER2LLM++ 将论文视为改进模型的证据与监督流。对每篇新论文：抽取有证据支撑的发现（evidence-grounded findings）；检验所报告的局限是否在当前模型中仍存在；如有需要，将发现转化为候选学习信号（candidate learning signals）。采用 try-evaluate-commit 流程，仅当更新能改善目标行为、且不显著遗忘既有改进或损害通用能力时，才将其整合进模型。
AI.result: 在连续的研究发现的 LLM 失败序列上，模型能够逐步吸收新发现，同时保留此前的改进。
AI.conclusion: PAPER2LLM++ 向"闭合人类发现与模型进化之间循环"迈出一步，使模型能够持续从关于自身局限与改进的研究中学习。

title: A Benchmark for Spatially Grounded Gesture Generation
comment: 13 pages, 9 figures. Benchmark of the Referential Gesture Challenge at the HSI Workshop, ECCV 2026. Data and video: https://huggingface.co/datasets/hsi-workshop/referential-gesture-challenge
summary: Communication in shared space interweaves verbal and non-verbal signals, and pointing gestures anchor language to the environment: "put the cup on that one" is uninterpretable without the gesture that fixes the referent. Yet no common framework exists for evaluating whether generated gestures indicate their intended referent; distributional metrics reward a gesture aimed at the wrong object as long as it looks natural. We introduce a benchmark for spatially grounded gesture generation, comprising ~2K pointing-annotated clips from naturalistic VR dialogue with ground-truth 3D referents, a task in which systems must decide when, how and where to point within conversational speech, and a protocol that separates temporal alignment, spatial grounding and perceived naturalness. We also provide a flow-matching baseline, MM-Conv-Flow. Evaluating it alongside an independent retrieval-based system and captured human motion, we find that geometric grounding can exceed that of human pointing without any gain in perceived naturalness, showing that referential gesture quality must be measured along separate dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向空间锚定手势生成的基准，包含约2K个带指向标注的自然VR对话片段与3D指代物真值，并设计分离时间对齐、空间锚定与感知自然度的评测协议，还给出流匹配基线MM-Conv-Flow。
AI.motivation: 共同空间中的交流融合言语与非言语信号，指向手势将语言锚定到环境（如"把杯子放在那个上"离开手势便无法确定指代对象）。然而目前缺乏统一框架来评估生成手势是否指向其意图指代物：分布度量只要手势看起来自然，即使指向错误对象也会给予奖励。
AI.method: 构建带指向标注的基准：约2K个来自自然VR对话的片段，含真值3D指代物；定义任务要求系统决定在会话语音中何时、如何以及指向何处；提出分离时间对齐、空间锚定和感知自然度的评测协议；并提供流匹配基线MM-Conv-Flow，与独立的检索式系统及采集的人类动作进行对比评估。
AI.result: 评估显示，几何锚定（空间指代准确度）可以超过人类指向水平，但感知自然度并未随之提升，说明指代手势质量必须沿不同维度分别衡量。
AI.conclusion: 指代手势的质量评估需按时间对齐、空间锚定与自然度等相互独立的维度进行，单一分布度量不足以反映生成手势是否真正指向意图指代物。

title: Source Preference in the Wild: How LLM Agents Favor Items by Source, and How to Reduce It
summary: As LLM agents decide on users' behalf which product to buy, which hotel to book, or which paper to cite, a preference for items from certain sources (the sites or services they come from) shapes what users receive and which sources are selected. We study source preference in end-to-end search with 12 agent models across three domains. Comparing items from different sources that satisfy the same requirements at the same position, we find that each model prefers some sources and avoids others in every domain, largely agreeing on which. This preference can outweigh how well items satisfy the request: an item satisfying one requirement fewer is selected about two-thirds of the time when it comes from a preferred source and the better one from a dispreferred source, but almost never in the reverse case. The information identifying an item's source affects selection by itself: hiding it weakens the preference, and relabeling an item with a preferred source raises its selection rate. We test two routes to this preference: training that rewards better items can make a source a shortcut for requirement satisfaction, and missing information can trigger preconceptions about the source. Supplying missing information or a prompt countering these preconceptions reduces source preference.

AI.tldr: 研究跨12个LLM agent、3个领域的"来源偏好"：同源同位置同满足度的商品/酒店/论文被系统性区别对待，偏好可压过需求满足度；隐去来源信息可削弱偏好，错标为偏好来源则提升选中率；偏好来自训练捷径与信息缺失触发的先入之见，补充信息或反偏见提示可缓解。
AI.motivation: LLM agent 替用户做购买、预订、引用等决策时，来自不同来源（站点/服务）的物品会被系统性区别对待，这种来源偏好会影响用户所得与来源被选中的分布，但此前缺乏对端到端搜索中来源偏好的系统刻画与成因分析。
AI.method: 在三个领域、12个agent模型上开展端到端搜索实验；控制物品来源、位置与需求满足度，比较"同位置、同满足条件"的不同来源物品的选择差异；通过隐藏来源信息、将物品重标为偏好来源来检验来源标识本身的作用；并检验两条成因路径——奖励更优物品的训练使来源成为需求满足的捷径，以及信息缺失触发对来源的先入之见；最后测试补充缺失信息与反先入之见提示的干预效果。
AI.result: 每个模型在每个领域都偏好某些来源、规避另一些，且模型间对哪些来源受偏好大体一致；当来自偏好来源的物品少满足一项需求、而更优物品来自不偏好来源时，前者约三分之二的概率被选中，反向情形则几乎从不发生；隐藏来源信息削弱偏好，重标为偏好来源提高选中率；补充缺失信息或给出反先入之见的提示可降低来源偏好。
AI.conclusion: 来源偏好是LLM agent端到端搜索中稳定、跨模型一致且强度可压过需求满足度的行为偏差，由训练捷径与信息缺失引发的先入之见两条路径形成，且可通过信息补全与提示干预部分缓解。

title: XGenAct: Geometry-Enhanced World Action Models through Cross-Task Generation
summary: World action models (WAMs) have advanced robot control by predicting how observations and actions evolve over time. Despite this progress, RGB and action based future prediction does not explicitly address the spatial understanding needed for robot manipulation. Existing efforts often add a limited set of spatial prediction tasks through specialized heads or branches, leaving both the range of spatial supervision and the model architecture fragmented. We introduce XGenAct, a world action model that represents RGB observations, robot actions, metric depth, surface normals, and functional role segmentation as RGB videos through deterministic codecs. By sampling perception and action tasks during training, XGenAct uses one video diffusion transformer and one objective to learn temporal prediction across these spaces without modality specific learned heads. On held out RLBench tasks, structured perception training improves average closed loop success over RGB only training, and XGenAct achieves 52% success in the five task external comparison, versus 26% for the strongest evaluated baselines. It also predicts future depth and segmentation more accurately than the evaluated pipelines that generate RGB first and then apply a frozen perception expert.

AI.tldr: 本文提出XGenAct，一种世界动作模型（WAM），通过确定性编解码器将RGB观测、机器人动作、度量深度、表面法线和功能角色分割统一表示为RGB视频，并仅用一个视频扩散Transformer和一个目标函数在训练中采样感知与动作任务，无需模态专属学习头。在RLBench留出任务上，结构化感知训练相比仅RGB训练提升了闭环成功率，外部比较中五任务平均成功率达52%，最强基线为26%，且未来深度与分割预测精度优于"先生成RGB再应用冻结感知专家"的流水线。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型虽能预测观测与动作的时序演化，但基于RGB与动作的未来预测未显式建模机器人操作所需的**空间理解**。已有工作多通过专用头或分支加入有限的空间预测任务，导致空间监督范围受限、模型架构碎片化。作者希望以统一架构覆盖更广的空间监督。
AI.method: 将RGB观测、机器人动作、度量深度、表面法线、功能角色分割等通过**确定性编解码器**统一编码为RGB视频表示；在训练阶段对感知与动作任务进行**采样**；使用**单一视频扩散Transformer**与**单一目标函数**学习跨这些空间的时序预测，不引入模态专属的可学习头。
AI.result: 在RLBench留出任务上：结构化感知训练相比仅RGB训练提高了平均闭环成功率；在五任务外部比较中，XGenAct取得**52%**成功率，而评估的最强基线为**26%**；在预测未来深度与分割方面，也比"先生成RGB再应用冻结感知专家"的流水线更准确。
AI.conclusion: 统一的视频扩散世界动作模型可在不引入模态专属头的前提下，将多类空间感知监督与动作预测整合进同一目标，从而提升机器人操作的闭环成功率与空间预测精度。

title: Multi-Fidelity Policy Gradients Stabilize Data-Scarce Reinforcement Learning
summary: Policy gradient methods for on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) can become unstable when expensive, scarce target-domain data yield noisy gradient estimates. We address this challenge by complementing limited high-fidelity (HF) target-domain data with abundant, cheap, but biased low-fidelity (LF) data, e.g., from a simplified simulator. Most existing methods directly optimize biased objectives based on LF data. In contrast, the recently introduced multi-fidelity policy gradient (MFPG) framework uses LF data solely to construct a control variate that reduces variance and improves HF data efficiency without biasing the policy gradient estimator. However, published work on MFPG is limited to REINFORCE on small-scale simulation tasks. We develop MFPG for modern actor-critic learning in GPU-parallel simulation and on a physical robot. Our analysis and experiments show that naive extensions to proximal policy optimization (PPO) can lose cross-fidelity correlation or inflate variance. Our MFPG-PPO addresses these failures by redesigning the sampling, advantage estimation, and control variate construction to preserve cross-fidelity correlation, and by monitoring estimator uncertainty to prevent variance inflation. We also introduce a budget-aware MFPG-PPO to divide a fixed sampling budget among high- and low-fidelity data sources. Across simulated robot locomotion tasks of varying LF-to-HF transfer difficulty and HF data budgets, MFPG-PPO improves upon PPO trained on HF data alone in nearly all settings, and consistently matches the performance of PPO trained with 16x more HF data on the hardest task at the smallest HF budgets. In contrast, most baselines that use LF data perform well only where direct LF-to-HF transfer succeeds. MFPG-PPO enables stable learning on a physical Franka arm using only 4 real-robot episodes per update and no human demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 本文将多保真策略梯度(MFPG)框架从REINFORCE扩展到现代actor-critic学习,提出MFPG-PPO及其预算感知变体,通过重新设计采样、优势估计与控制变量构造保持跨保真相关性并抑制方差膨胀,在仿真机器人运动任务与真实Franka机械臂上验证了其高保真数据效率。
AI.motivation: on-policy强化学习中,昂贵稀缺的目标域高保真(HF)数据会导致梯度估计噪声大、训练不稳定。现有方法多直接用低保真(LF)数据优化有偏目标;MFPG框架虽用LF仅作控制变量以无偏降方差,但已发表工作仅限于小规模仿真上的REINFORCE,未适配现代actor-critic与GPU并行仿真及真实机器人场景。
AI.method: 针对PPO的朴素扩展会丢失跨保真相关性或放大方差的问题,提出MFPG-PPO:重新设计采样策略、优势估计与控制变量构造以保持HF-LF跨保真相关性,并通过监控估计器不确定性防止方差膨胀;进一步提出预算感知(budget-aware)MFPG-PPO,在固定采样预算下在高保真与低保真数据源之间分配采样量。
AI.result: 在不同LF-to-HF迁移难度与HF数据预算的仿真机器人运动任务中,MFPG-PPO在几乎所有设置下优于仅用HF训练的PPO;在最难任务、最小HF预算下,其表现稳定匹配使用16倍HF数据的PPO。多数使用LF数据的基线仅在直接LF-to-HF迁移成功的场景下表现良好。真实Franka机械臂上,仅每次更新4个真实机器人回合且无人类演示即可稳定学习。
AI.conclusion: MFPG-PPO成功将MFPG扩展至现代actor-critic与GPU并行仿真,并实现真实机器人稳定学习,显著提升高保真数据效率;其关键设计在于保持跨保真相关性、抑制方差膨胀以及预算感知的采样分配。

title: Modeling Shared and Individual Structure for Cross-Subject Continuous Affect Regression from EEG-fNIRS
summary: Continuous, second-by-second valence-arousal estimation from physiological signals is typically studied in a subject-dependent setting, where the model sees labeled data from the same person it is later evaluated on. We study the harder zero-shot cross-subject variant on a synchronized EEG-fNIRS dataset: predict raw-scale ([1, 255]) valence and arousal trajectories for subjects whose labels the model never observes, given only their unlabeled EEG/fNIRS recordings while watching the same video stimuli as a disjoint set of training subjects. We decompose the affect trajectory into a structure shared across subjects who watch the same stimuli and an individual structure estimated for each test subject from a label-free EEG marker (alpha-band cross-channel synchrony), which rescales the shared trajectory around the scale midpoint. We validate the per-subject calibration mechanism on four independent axes: leave-one-subject-out correlation between the marker and each subject's true optimal gain, a functional-form comparison against non-linear alternatives, a repeated leave-4-out component ablation isolating each part of the pipeline's contribution, and a ceiling analysis bounding the remaining headroom for per-subject scaling. On held-out subjects, the model reaches an overall MAE of 25.96 / 22.80 across two evaluation batches (valence 21.94 / 19.6, arousal 29.98 / 26.0), well below EEGNet and ASAC-Net baselines reported for the same subject-independent split (raw scale score 60.6 and 55.0 respectively). We further report a systematic negative-result search across model architectures, feature representations, and prediction targets that found no signal able to improve on the single alpha-synchrony marker.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究零样本跨被试的连续效价-唤醒度估计，在同步EEG-fNIRS数据集上仅用测试被试的无标签信号进行原始尺度预测，通过将情感轨迹分解为刺激共享结构与被试个体结构（由alpha频段跨通道同步性估计）实现校准，MAE显著优于EEGNet和ASAC-Net基线。
AI.motivation: 现有连续情感估计多在被试依赖（subject-dependent）设定下研究，即模型见过被测对象的标注数据，泛化性存疑；本文致力于更难的零样本跨被试（zero-shot cross-subject）场景，在完全不观测测试被试标签的条件下预测其效价与唤醒度轨迹。
AI.method: 将情感轨迹分解为两部分：(1) 观看相同视频刺激的被试间共享结构；(2) 由无标签EEG标记（alpha频段跨通道同步性）为每个测试被试估计的个体结构，用于围绕量表中点对共享轨迹进行重缩放。通过四条独立轴验证该逐被试校准机制：留一被试的标记与真实最优增益相关性、与非线性替代形式的功能形式比较、重复leave-4-out的组件消融、以及限定被试级缩放剩余空间的ceiling分析。此外还进行了跨模型架构、特征表示与预测目标的系统性负结果搜索。
AI.result: 在留出被试上，模型在两个评估批次取得总体MAE 25.96 / 22.80（效价21.94 / 19.6，唤醒度29.98 / 26.0），远优于同一被试独立划分下EEGNet和ASAC-Net基线的原始尺度得分60.6与55.0。系统搜索未发现任何能改进单一alpha同步性标记的信号。
AI.conclusion: 单一alpha跨通道同步性标记可有效实现零样本跨被试的逐被试增益校准，显著降低连续效价-唤醒度估计误差，且系统性负结果搜索表明该标记在现有架构、特征与目标空间中已具代表性，难以被进一步超越。

title: In-Distribution Forcing for Long Video Generation at Test Time
summary: Modern autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models excel at short-horizon video generation, yet generating long videos remains challenging due to drifting, where colors and textures shift, and motion dynamics decay. Existing works primarily rely on KV conditioning, which selects or modifies cached key-value (KV) entries to mitigate drifting. However, we observe that KV conditioning alone is insufficient as it assumes cached KV entries remain in-distribution. This assumption fails beyond the training horizon: nothing constrains the construction of KV entries during rollout, giving rise to the KV-provenance problem where cached entries themselves become out-of-distribution (OOD). To address this, we propose In-Distribution Forcing (ID-Forcing), a test-time framework that aligns both KV caching and KV conditioning with training configurations. Its key mechanism, self-caching, prevents OOD KV entries at their source. Each chunk is cached without attending to prior KV entry, keeping the rolling window exactly in-distribution. Consequently, ID-Forcing seamlessly extends short-horizon models to minute-scale video generation.
