Extensive evaluations show that our method remains competitive on standard video generation benchmark while substantially outperforming prior work in mitigating drifting, as validated by both our drift metrics and a user study.

AI.tldr: 提出 ID-Forcing，一种测试时框架，通过 self-caching 让 KV 缓存与条件化对齐训练配置，缓解自回归视频扩散长视频生成中的漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 现代自回归视频扩散模型擅长短时程生成，但长视频生成面临漂移：颜色纹理偏移、运动动态衰减。现有工作主要依赖 KV conditioning（选择或修改缓存 KV 条目）来缓解漂移，但论文观察到仅靠 KV conditioning 不够，因为它假设缓存 KV 条目保持分布内。该假设在训练时程之外失效：rollout 过程中没有任何机制约束 KV 条目的构造，导致 KV 条目本身变为分布外（OOD），即 KV-provenance 问题。
AI.method: ID-Forcing 为测试时框架，核心是使 KV 缓存与 KV conditioning 均与训练配置对齐。其关键机制为 self-caching：每个 chunk 在缓存时不关注先前的 KV 条目，使滚动窗口严格保持分布内，从源头防止 OOD KV 条目的产生。
AI.result: 在标准视频生成基准上保持竞争力，同时在缓解漂移方面显著优于先前工作，并通过自研漂移指标与用户研究验证。
AI.conclusion: ID-Forcing 可无缝将短时程模型扩展至分钟级视频生成，指向 KV-provenance 这一被忽视的问题，验证了从源头保证 KV 分布内对齐的有效性。

title: StanceEval 2026: The Second Stance Detection Shared Task
comment: 14 pages total (8 pages main paper + 6 pages appendix), 5 tables in the main paper, excluding the appendix
summary: StanceEval 2026 is the second edition of the StanceEval shared task series on stance detection in Arabic social media text. Stance detection aims to identify a writer's stance toward a given topic. Given a tweet and a target, participating systems must determine whether the writer's stance is Favor, Against, or None. This edition focuses on cross-target generalization across two distinct evaluation tracks: Track 1 evaluates thematically related cross-target transfer (testing on Women Driving, related to Women Empowerment from training data), while Track 2 evaluates cross-domain transfer to completely unseen targets (E-Cars and Trimester System). The shared task attracted 80 registered teams from 12 countries. During the evaluation phase, 30 unique teams submitted entries, with 21 teams officially ranked in Track 1 and 13 in Track 2 following validation filtering, and 20 teams submitting system-description papers. Participating teams employed diverse methodologies, including fine-tuned pretrained language models, prompt-based and retrieval-augmented large language models (LLMs), fine-tuned LLMs, and hybrid cascades. Top systems achieved impressive $F_{avg2}$ scores of 0.8994 on Track 1 and 0.9400 on Track 2, substantially outperforming the strongest baselines (0.7366 and 0.7475, respectively), where $F_{avg2}$ denotes the macro-averaged F1 score over the Favor and Against classes. Counterintuitively, performance on the unseen targets was higher than on the related target, a disparity could be driven by extreme target polarization, class imbalance, and dialectal or sarcastic nuance across topics.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了StanceEval 2026阿拉伯语社交媒体立场检测共享任务的第二届概况，涵盖两个跨目标泛化评测赛道、参赛情况、方法及结果。
AI.motivation: 立场检测旨在识别作者对特定主题的立场。本届任务聚焦于跨目标泛化能力，考察系统在主题相关目标（Track 1）和完全未见目标（Track 2）上的迁移表现，以推动阿拉伯语立场检测模型在真实场景中的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 任务给定推文与目标，要求判定立场为Favor、Against或None。设置两个赛道：Track 1评估主题相关的跨目标迁移（训练于Women Empowerment，测试于Women Driving）；Track 2评估向完全未见目标的跨域迁移（E-Cars与Trimester System）。参赛系统采用微调预训练语言模型、基于提示与检索增强的大语言模型、微调LLM以及混合级联等方法。
AI.result: 共吸引12个国家80支团队注册，评测阶段30支团队提交，经校验后Track 1有21支、Track 2有13支团队正式排名，20支团队提交系统描述论文。最优系统在Track 1取得F_avg2为0.8994，Track 2为0.9400，显著优于最强基线（分别为0.7366和0.7475）。
AI.conclusion: 参赛系统大幅超越基线，但出现反直觉现象：未见目标上的性能高于相关目标，可能源于极端目标极化、类别不平衡以及主题间的方言或讽刺细微差异。

title: DR-IPC: Disturbance-Resilient Integrated Planning and Control for LiDAR-Based Quadrotor Navigation
summary: LiDAR-based quadrotor navigation in cluttered environments remains challenging under external disturbances, particularly when obstacle-aware motion generation and disturbance-rejection control are handled in separate layers. This article presents disturbance-resilient integrated planning and control (DR-IPC), which combines lightweight path guidance with nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) to directly generate angular velocity and thrust. An interconnected extended Kalman filter and nonlinear disturbance observer jointly provide filtered state estimates and reconstructed disturbances for NMPC prediction. The resulting formulation unifies nonlinear quadrotor dynamics, actuator constraints, local motion generation, and penalised safe-flight-corridor residuals without requiring a separate trajectory-optimization stage. Gazebo and MARSIM simulations, together with indoor and outdoor experiments, validate DR-IPC under wind, suspended payloads, narrow passages, ball impacts and reactive avoidance of a dynamic obstacle. In multi-goal navigation with disturbances, DR-IPC increases the number of completed missions from 1/10 to 9/10 in Gazebo and reduces the altitude RMSE from 0.34 to 0.01 m in experiments. The complete system operates onboard at 100 Hz. Supplementary videos are available on the project page https://drpp316.github.io/DR-IPC-Page/, and the source code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出DR-IPC框架，将轻量路径引导与NMPC统一集成，结合EKF与非线性扰动观测器，实现抗扰动四旋翼导航。
AI.motivation: LiDAR四旋翼在杂乱环境中的导航受外部扰动影响大，尤其当障碍感知运动生成与抗扰动控制分层处理时性能受限。现有方法将轨迹优化与控制分离，导致抗扰能力不足。
AI.method: DR-IPC融合轻量路径引导与NMPC，直接输出角速度与推力；采用互联的扩展卡尔曼滤波器与非线性扰动观测器，联合提供滤波状态估计与重构扰动用于NMPC预测；统一建模非线性动力学、执行器约束、局部运动生成及惩罚性安全飞行走廊残差，无需独立轨迹优化阶段。
AI.result: Gazebo与MARSIM仿真及室内外实验验证了在风扰、悬挂负载、狭窄通道、球体撞击及动态障碍反应式避障下的有效性。多目标导航中，Gazebo任务完成数由1/10提升至9/10；实验高度RMSE由0.34降至0.01 m；全系统机载运行达100 Hz。
AI.conclusion: DR-IPC通过规划与控制一体化及扰动观测融合，显著提升LiDAR四旋翼在扰动下的导航鲁棒性与精度，并可机载实时运行。

title: Post-Training Quantization of Autoregressive Weather Models
summary: Advancements in high-resolution numerical weather prediction (NWP) and data assimilation (DA) have shaped the developments in deep learning (DL) architectures emulating atmospheric dynamics. Emulators for weather forecasting exhibit forecast quality comparable to physics based models at forecast horizon scaling from few days to subseasonal time scales. The emulators are driven by hardware-accelerated matrix multiplication in autoregressive inferences, significantly reducing the computation time and resources required for NWP. Optimization of the matrix multiplication processes in GPU architectures provides opportunities to scale towards high-resolution domain, and offers implementation of out of the box solutions. Post-training quantization (PTQ) has been demonstrated across multiple DL architectures to accelerate and increase the number of computations in unit time while consuming less power, enabling applications on edge hardware. In this study, we investigate the effect of PTQ on pre-trained AI emulators for global-scale weather forecasting. We implement PTQ algorithms in Deep Learning Weather Prediction (DLWP) and FourCastNet (FCN) models as a proof of concept for geophysical fluid dynamics applications. We systematically investigate the effect of PTQ on emulator inferences over short-range forecast horizons. Evaluation of PTQ configurations using simulated quantization hints at qualitatively meaningful forecasts over short-time horizons. These results provide a first benchmark of PTQ for autoregressive weather emulators and a basis for quantization-based optimization of DL models for dynamical systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究将训练后量化（PTQ）应用于全球天气预报的深度学习仿真器（DLWP与FourCastNet），系统评估其在短期预报中的推理效果，首次为自回归天气仿真器提供PTQ基准。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率数值天气预报（NWP）与数据同化（DA）推动了深度学习（DL）大气动力学仿真器的发展，但其推理依赖GPU硬件加速的矩阵乘法，计算资源需求大。PTQ可在多种DL架构中加速推理、降低功耗并支持边缘硬件部署，但尚未针对地球物理流体动力学应用中的天气仿真器进行系统研究。
AI.method: 在预训练的全球天气预报AI仿真器DLWP和FourCastNet（FCN）中实现PTQ算法，作为地球物理流体动力学应用的概念验证；利用模拟量化（simulated quantization）配置，系统研究PTQ对短程预报时域内仿真器推理的影响。
AI.result: 基于模拟量化的PTQ配置评估显示，在短时预报时域内可获得定性上有意义的预报结果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次为自回归天气仿真器提供PTQ基准，为动力系统DL模型的量化优化奠定基础。

title: BitNest: Bit-Nested Speculative Decoding for Memory-Efficient LLM Inference Acceleration
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by using a lightweight draft to propose multiple tokens for parallel verification. However, existing methods often require an additional draft model or weight representation, introducing non-negligible memory overhead on resource-constrained devices. Self-speculative approaches reduce this overhead, yet still face trade-offs between draft quality, target quality, and storage efficiency. We propose BitNest, a bit-nested speculative decoding framework that embeds a low-precision draft directly into the higher-precision target representation. Instead of deriving a draft from a predefined target, BitNest first constructs a strong low-precision base and then recovers the higher-precision target through residual refinement, enabling both models to share a single physical weight representation. BitNest further extends this progressive-precision design to the KV cache for long-context inference. Across multiple 7B--8B edge-friendly LLMs and diverse workloads, BitNest achieves an average speculative acceptance rate of 95.2% while closely preserving higher-precision model quality, and delivers 1.48--1.61x end-to-end speedup over FP16 autoregressive decoding. On the LLaMA models supported by all representative self-speculative baselines, BitNest also achieves consistently competitive or higher decoding speedup.

AI.tldr: BitNest提出位嵌套投机解码框架，将低精度草稿模型嵌入高精度目标模型表示中，通过残差精炼恢复高精度权重，并扩展至KV缓存，实现单份物理权重共享，端到端加速1.48–1.61倍。
AI.motivation: 现有投机解码方法通常需要额外的草稿模型或权重表示，在资源受限设备上带来不可忽视的内存开销；自投机方法虽降低开销，但在草稿质量、目标质量与存储效率之间存在权衡。
AI.method: BitNest首先构建强低精度基础模型，再通过残差精炼恢复高精度目标模型，使两者共享单一物理权重表示；并将该渐进精度设计扩展至KV缓存以支持长上下文推理。
AI.result: 在多个7B–8B边缘友好LLM及多样化负载上，BitNest平均投机接受率达95.2%，同时较好保持高精度模型质量，较FP16自回归解码实现1.48–1.61倍端到端加速；在所有代表性自投机基线支持的LLaMA模型上，也取得一致具有竞争力或更高的解码加速。
AI.conclusion: BitNest通过位嵌套与残差精炼实现草稿与目标模型的权重共享，在降低内存开销的同时兼顾草稿质量和目标质量，并在边缘LLM推理中展现稳定加速效果。

title: Foresight: planning future perception in streaming VLMs without retraining
summary: Existing streaming vision-language models (VLMs) continuously perceive and reason over visual streams, but their computational pathways remain fixed throughout inference. Consequently, they cannot adapt computation to evolving scene dynamics, where different future events demand different levels and forms of perception. We show that streaming VLMs inherently possess the ability to anticipate the immediate future, and leverage this capability to dynamically configure future computation in a training-free manner. Realizing such anticipatory computation, however, is very challenging: future anticipation must be sufficiently reliable to guide computation, planning must run concurrently with streaming inference, and online reconfiguration must incur negligible overhead. To address these challenges, we introduce FORESIGHT, a dual-stream architecture comprising two Siamese LLMs with shared weights, input encoders, and KV cache. The first LLM continuously processes incoming tokens, while the second runs ahead of the stream to anticipate future context, plan future computation, and generate task responses without interrupting streaming inference. Each plan decides when to reason next, what to check then, and how densely to sample, keeping transient evidence separate from persistent control. The resulting computation plan is executed online through an efficient reconfiguration protocol with schemaguided decoding and lightweight diff-based updates, enabling dynamic adaptation with low overhead. With a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, FORESIGHT achieves 23.0 mean joint F1 on OmniPro Online evaluation beating strongest trained baseline by 9.5%, while improving the backbone by 6.7 on StreamingBench and 15.4 on OVO-Bench, with the largest gain of 18.7 when evidence arrives later in the video stream. Our source code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 FORESIGHT，一种双流 Siamese LLM 架构，利用流式 VLM 自身的未来预判能力，以免训练方式动态配置未来计算，实现自适应流式推理且开销极低。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视觉-语言模型（VLM）在推理全程使用固定计算路径，无法根据场景动态变化调整计算——不同未来事件需要不同层级与形式的感知。作者发现流式 VLM 本身具备预判即时未来的能力，希望借此以免训练方式动态配置后续计算。
AI.method: 核心挑战在于：预判需足够可靠以指导计算、规划需与流式推理并行、在线重配置开销需可忽略。为此提出 FORESIGHT：双流架构，由两个共享权重、输入编码器与 KV cache 的 Siamese LLM 组成。第一个 LLM 持续处理流入 token；第二个 LLM 跑在流的前方，预判未来上下文、规划未来计算并生成任务响应，且不打断流式推理。每个规划决定何时再次推理、届时检查什么、采样密度多高，并将瞬态证据与持续控制分离。计算计划通过高效重配置协议在线执行，包含 schema 引导解码与轻量 diff 更新，从而实现低开销动态适应。
AI.result: 基于冻结的 Qwen3-VL-8B 骨干，FORESIGHT 在 OmniPro Online 评测上取得 23.0 平均联合 F1，超过最强已训练基线 9.5%；在 StreamingBench 上较骨干提升 6.7，在 OVO-Bench 上提升 15.4；当证据在视频流中较晚出现时增益最大，达 18.7。
AI.conclusion: 流式 VLM 内生的未来预判能力可用于免训练地动态配置计算；双流 Siamese 架构配合 schema 引导解码与 diff 更新，在低开销下显著提升在线流式理解性能，尤其在证据延迟到达场景。

title: Collective Bias Mitigation via Model Routing and Collaboration
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in public health, finance, and governance, requiring both accuracy and societal value alignment. Despite recent advances, LLMs often perpetuate or amplify bias embedded in their training data, posing challenges to fairness. While self-debiasing encourages an LLM to identify and correct its own biases, relying on a single model's intrinsic knowledge may be insufficient to address deeply ingrained stereotypes. To address this limitation, we introduce Collective Bias Mitigation (CBM), a framework that alleviates bias by learning fine-grained model behavior and fostering knowledge sharing among diverse LLMs. This work is the first to systematically explore the effective selection and organization of distinct LLMs to cultivate fairer LLM responses. Experiments show CBM substantially outperforms standalone baselines (e.g., in the top-7 setting, Committee lowers the age bias score from 0.25 to 0.10). Our Debating and Committee topologies achieve substantial bias reduction, with the latter balancing mitigation effectiveness and inference cost, highlighting the potential of CBM for fairer LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出集体偏见缓解框架CBM，通过多LLM知识共享与细粒度行为学习降低偏见，实验显示Committee拓扑在年龄偏见指标上从0.25降至0.10，兼顾效果与推理成本。
AI.motivation: LLM广泛应用于公共卫生、金融与治理，需兼顾准确性与社会价值对齐。但模型会延续或放大训练数据中的偏见，而单模型自去偏见依赖自身内在知识，难以纠正根深蒂固的刻板印象。
AI.method: CBM框架：学习细粒度模型行为，并在多个异构LLM之间进行知识共享；系统探索不同模型的选择与组织方式，构建Debating（辩论）与Committee（委员会）等协作拓扑以生成更公平的响应。
AI.result: CBM显著优于单模型基线。例如在top-7设置下，Committee将年龄偏见分数从0.25降至0.10；Debating与Committee拓扑均实现明显偏见降低，其中Committee在缓解效果与推理成本间取得较好平衡。
AI.conclusion: CBM是首个系统探究多LLM选择与组织以提升公平性的工作，验证了集体协作去偏见的有效性与可行性，为构建更公平的LLM提供了新路径。

title: Autonomous Robotic Navigation for Endovascular Brain-Computer Interface Access
summary: Endovascular brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) avoid craniotomy but require precise device delivery through anatomically variable cerebral veins. This work presents the first demonstration of in vitro autonomous robotic navigation for endovascular BCI access in the cerebral venous system. Soft Actor-Critic controllers were trained in silico for two sequential tasks spanning the right internal jugular vein to the superior sagittal sinus, using geometric augmentation of one training anatomy. Navigation was evaluated in a training anatomy and an anatomically unseen hold-out model over 250 in silico episodes and five fluoroscopy-guided in vitro robotic runs per task-anatomy condition, comprising 1,000 simulated episodes and 20 physical runs overall. Task recurrent predictors were also evaluated for online identification of impending navigation failure. In silico success rates for Tasks A and B were 85.6% and 98.4% in the training anatomy and 42.0% and 91.6% in the hold-out anatomy, respectively. Fourteen of 20 physical runs were successful (70% overall), including 80% success for Task B in the hold-out phantom. In silico the predictors detected 99.3-100.0% of failures with false-alarm rates of 0.8-6.7%. During in vitro evaluation, predicted risk increased before failed episodes, but elevated probabilities during some successful runs showed reduced calibration after transfer. These results demonstrate the feasibility of autonomous cerebral venous access and show how online failure prediction could support human oversight, while also identifying anatomical generalization and sim-to-real calibration as priorities before preclinical translation.

AI.tldr: 首次展示血管内脑机接口的体外自主机器人导航，采用SAC控制器穿越脑静脉系统，并结合在线失败预测支持人工监督，指出解剖泛化与仿真到现实迁移校准是临床前转化的关键。
AI.motivation: 血管内脑机接口可避免开颅手术，但需在解剖结构变异较大的脑静脉中实现精准器械递送，因此需要自主导航能力及对导航失败的实时预判以支持人工监督。
AI.method: 在仿真环境中用单一训练解剖的几何增强数据训练Soft Actor-Critic控制器，完成从右颈内静脉到上矢状窦的两项序贯任务；在训练解剖与未见过的留出解剖模型中评估导航，开展250个仿真回合/条件与5次荧光透视引导的体外机器人运行/任务-解剖条件（共1000仿真回合、20次实物运行）；同时评估任务循环预测器对即将发生的导航失败的在线识别能力。
AI.result: 仿真成功率：任务A、B在训练解剖分别为85.6%和98.4%，在留出解剖分别为42.0%和91.6%；20次实物运行中14次成功（总体70%），留出体模中任务B成功率达80%。仿真中预测器检出99.3-100.0%的失败，误报率0.8-6.7%；体外评估中失败前预测风险升高，但部分成功运行也出现高概率，显示迁移后校准下降。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明自主脑静脉通路导航可行，在线失败预测可辅助人工监督，但解剖泛化与仿真到现实的校准问题需在临床前转化前优先解决。

title: Student-Guided Teacher Distillation for Efficient LLM Task Routing: Positioning Against Jev-Style System-1 Classifiers
summary: Zero-shot classifiers are useful for routing user requests to specialized LLM tasks, but scoring every request against a large candidate set is expensive: a zero-shot NLI classifier must evaluate one premise-hypothesis pair per label, so cost scales linearly with taxonomy size. We study a student-guided teacher distillation pipeline for a fixed taxonomy of 60 LLM task categories: a compact ModernBERT classifier predicts the full category distribution in one forward pass and retrieves a small top-k candidate set, and a larger DeBERTa-v3 zero-shot NLI classifier reranks only those candidates rather than all 60 labels; the resulting teacher labels iteratively improve the student, which produces sharper candidates for the next round. Unlike generic embedding retrieval or clustering-derived shortlists used in extreme multi-label classification, our candidate generator is trained end-to-end on the target taxonomy and is the same model serving production traffic, distinguishing it from LLM-routing work that routes between candidate models, and from concurrent System-1 encoder-classifier proposals (e.g. TypeSafe AI's Jev and the open-source Laya project) whose training methodology is undocumented or RL-based. Our best student checkpoint reaches 77.5% teacher agreement on a 200-example evaluation set, and preliminary coverage measurements show Coverage@16 of 91-100%, suggesting top-k sets retain most of the teacher's decision-relevant information. We further show truncated top-k teacher scores should not be treated as full 60-class soft targets for KL distillation: zeroing untruncated classes destroys the dark knowledge soft-label distillation depends on, introducing systematic bias rather than a harmless sparse approximation. A complete evaluation, including coverage at multiple k on a held-out set, an embedding-retrieval baseline, and a larger human-reviewed test set, remains in progress.

AI.tldr: 提出学生引导的教师蒸馏流水线：ModernBERT学生一次前向预测60类分布并检索top-k候选，DeBERTa-v3零样本NLI教师仅对候选重排，迭代互相强化；学生最优检查点达77.5%教师一致率，Coverage@16为91-100%。
AI.motivation: 零样本分类器用于将用户请求路由到专用LLM任务时，需对每个候选标签逐一评估前提-假设对，成本随分类体系规模线性增长；在60类固定taxonomy下全量评分代价过高，亟需降低教师评分成本同时保留决策信息。
AI.method: 固定60类LLM任务体系的师生蒸馏流水线：紧凑ModernBERT学生单次前向输出全类分布并检索小规模top-k候选集，较大的DeBERTa-v3零样本NLI教师仅对候选重排而非全部60标签；教师标签迭代改进学生，学生生成更锐利候选供下一轮。学生端到端在目标taxonomy上训练，且为线上服务同一模型，区别于通用嵌入检索、聚类短名单、LLM路由及训练方法未公开或基于RL的并发System-1编码器提案。
AI.result: 最优学生检查点在200样本评测集上达到77.5%教师一致率；初步覆盖率测量显示Coverage@16为91-100%，表明top-k集合保留教师大部分决策相关信息。同时发现截断top-k教师分数不应作为完整60类软目标用于KL蒸馏：将未截断类置零会破坏软标签蒸馏依赖的暗知识，引入系统性偏差而非无害稀疏近似。
AI.conclusion: 学生引导的top-k教师重排可在大幅降低零样本评分成本的同时保持较高教师一致性与候选覆盖率；截断soft target用于KL蒸馏需谨慎，应以完整分布或专门处理未截断类。完整评测（多k覆盖率、留出集、嵌入检索基线、更大规模人工审核测试集）仍在进行中。

title: VIGOR: Zero-Shot Visual Generalization via Latent-Space Consistency in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) achieves strong sample efficiency by planning within learned latent dynamics, yet its performance degrades substantially under unseen visual distractions such as background variations, lighting changes, or camera shifts. Unlike model-free RL, where encoder perturbations affect only single-step predictions, MBRL suffers from a two-level vulnerability: visual distractions first push encoder outputs out of distribution, and these errors then compound through recursive latent rollouts over the planning horizon. We propose visual generalization via latent-space consistency in model-based RL (VIGOR), a framework that enables zero-shot generalization to unseen visual distractions while retaining the sample efficiency of its MBRL backbone. VIGOR integrates three interdependent components: (i) asymmetric weak-to-strong augmentation, which pairs weak-only and weak-to-strong latent views within a single batch; (ii) dynamics-level consistency, which enforces augmentation-invariant transition predictions through direct latent regression; and (iii) encoder-level stabilization, which prevents encoder drift under the cross-augmentation supervision imposed by dynamics-level consistency. Evaluations on the DeepMind Control Suite (DMC) and Robosuite show that VIGOR outperforms state-of-the-art model-free and model-based baselines, surpassing the second-best baseline by 3.4% on DMC and 43.6% on Robosuite. Ablations further show that VIGOR's robustness is augmentation-agnostic: replacing the default augmentation with alternatives from distinct perturbation families preserves strong generalization, confirming that latent-space consistency, not the augmentation choice, drives robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出 VIGOR：通过在潜空间施加动力学级一致性与编码器级稳定，使基于模型的强化学习对未见视觉干扰实现零样本泛化，同时保持样本效率。
AI.motivation: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）依靠在学到的潜在动力学中规划来获得高样本效率，但在背景变化、光照改变、相机偏移等未见视觉干扰下性能显著下降。与无模型 RL 中编码器扰动只影响单步预测不同，MBRL 存在“两级脆弱性”：视觉干扰先使编码器输出偏离分布，误差再在规划时域的递归潜在推演中不断累积放大。
AI.method: VIGOR 框架包含三个相互依赖的组件：(i) 非对称弱到强增强，在同一批次内配对“仅弱增强”与“弱到强增强”的潜在视图；(ii) 动力学级一致性，通过直接潜在回归强制转移预测对增强不变；(iii) 编码器级稳定，防止在动力学级一致性所施加的跨增强监督下编码器发生漂移。
AI.result: 在 DeepMind Control Suite（DMC）与 Robosuite 上，VIGOR 优于当前最优的无模型与基于模型基线，在 DMC 上超第二优基线 3.4%，在 Robosuite 上超 43.6%。消融实验表明其鲁棒性与增强方式无关：将默认增强替换为来自不同扰动族的其他增强仍能保持强泛化，说明驱动鲁棒性的是潜空间一致性而非增强选择。
AI.conclusion: VIGOR 通过潜空间一致性有效缓解 MBRL 在视觉干扰下的两级脆弱性，实现零样本视觉泛化并保留 MBRL 的样本效率，且鲁棒性来源于一致性机制本身，方法具有较强的增强无关性。

title: Behavior Pack Optimization for Video MLLM Post-Training
summary: Video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) keep climbing video question answering benchmarks, yet shuffling the frames, masking the segment that supports the answer, or occluding the target object barely changes their predictions. The accuracy rests on appearance and language priors, not on the temporal evidence the question asks for. We trace this to the unit of post-training: rewards are computed on a single response to the original clip, so the model is never asked to behave consistently across views. We propose Behavior Pack Optimization (BPO), which replaces the single response with a behavior pack of outputs across counterfactual views chosen by question type, scored jointly. The pack reward asks for stability when the intervention is irrelevant, sensitivity when key evidence is removed, and abstention when no evidence remains. To keep this objective stable at small pack sizes, BPO uses an anchor-relative advantage: the response on the original view serves as a per-prompt reference instead of a group mean over mixed views. On TempCompass, MVBench, and NExT-QA, BPO improves the macro accuracy of Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct by 4.7 pp, the temporal-hard subset by 7.8 pp, and abstention F1 by 20.0 pp over a budget-matched vanilla GRPO baseline from the same SFT checkpoint. The gains transfer to Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and to LLaVA-Video-7B; ablations confirm they follow the view sets, not the rollout count. We hope this pack-level perspective offers a useful starting point for the video MLLM and multimodal post-training community as the field moves toward evidence-grounded video reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Behavior Pack Optimization（BPO），将后训练中的单响应奖励替换为跨反事实视图的行为包联合奖励，提升视频多模态大模型的时序证据依赖能力。
AI.motivation: 视频多模态大语言模型在视频问答基准上分数持续提升，但打乱帧序、遮蔽支撑答案的片段或遮挡目标物体几乎不改变其预测，说明准确率依赖外观与语言先验，而非问题所需的时序证据。作者追溯到后训练的基本单元：奖励只在原始片段的单个响应上计算，模型从未被要求在不同视图间保持一致行为。
AI.method: 提出 Behavior Pack Optimization（BPO），用按问题类型选择的反事实视图下的一组输出（行为包）替代单响应，并联合打分。包奖励要求：干预无关时保持稳定、关键证据被移除时敏感、证据完全缺失时拒答。为在小包规模下稳定该目标，BPO 采用锚点相对优势：以原始视图上的响应作为每个提示的参考，而非混合视图上的组均值。
AI.result: 在 TempCompass、MVBench、NExT-QA 上，相比同一 SFT 检查点、预算匹配的 vanilla GRPO 基线，BPO 将 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 的宏平均准确率提升 4.7 个百分点，时序困难子集提升 7.8 个百分点，拒答 F1 提升 20.0 个百分点。增益可迁移到 Video-MME、LongVideoBench 及 LLaVA-Video-7B；消融实验证实增益来自视图集合而非 rollout 数量。
AI.conclusion: BPO 以包级视角为视频 MLLM 与多模态后训练提供起点，推动领域迈向证据落地的视频推理。

title: Shrome at Touché: Soft-Vote Ensembling and Counter-Causal Augmentation for Causality Extraction
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Both authors contributed equally. Working notes of Touché at CLEF 2026 (Conference and Labs of the Evaluation Forum), 21-24 September 2026, Jena, Germany
summary: Touché 2026 extends causality extraction to counter-causal claims: news sentences whose surface form appears causal but whose meaning denies the causation, as in "It is falsely believed that X caused Y." A system that relies on surface cues such as "caused" or "led to" will accept such a sentence as causal and give it the wrong polarity. On the Countercausal News Corpus (CCNC), the task has three subtasks: deciding whether a sentence is causal (detection), locating its cause and effect spans (extraction), and labeling its polarity as procausal, counter-causal, or uncausal. We build one model per subtask. Detection is a fine-tuned classifier with a single cross-task rule that uses the extracted spans to remove false positives. For extraction, we ensemble three RoBERTa-large BILOU+CRF taggers by averaging their token-level scores before decoding, rather than voting on the spans each tagger produces. For polarity, where labeled counter-causal examples are scarcest, we add training sentences generated by a large language model prompted with nine patterns of counter-causal expression adapted from Hagen et al., keeping only those that pass automatic structural checks. On the held-out CCNC test set, the system reaches F1 0.869 on detection and macro-F1 0.817 on polarity, and in the organizers' final causal-only evaluation of extraction it scores granularity-adjusted F1 0.728, the highest extraction score among all submissions including the organizers' baseline. The development split is used only for component selection and the ablations reported in the paper.

AI.tldr: 该文针对 Touché 2026 的反因果主张抽取任务，按子任务分别建模：检测用微调分类器加跨任务规则，抽取用三个 RoBERTa-large BILOU+CRF 标注器的分数级集成，极性用大语言模型按九种反因果表达模式生成数据补充稀缺样本。
AI.motivation: 反因果句表面呈因果形式但语义否定因果（如"人们错误地认为 X 导致 Y"），仅依赖"caused""led to"等表面线索的系统会将其误判为因果并给出错误极性，因此需要区分检测、抽取与极性判定。
AI.method: 在 CCNC 语料上为三个子任务各建一个模型：检测为微调分类器，并引入一条跨任务规则，用抽取出的 span 剔除假阳性；抽取集成三个 RoBERTa-large BILOU+CRF 标注器，在解码前对 token 级分数取平均，而非对各标注器输出的 span 投票；极性任务中标注的反因果样本最稀缺，故引入由大语言模型按 Hagen 等人九种反因果表达模式提示生成、并通过自动结构校验的句子作为训练数据。开发集仅用于组件选择与消融。
AI.result: 在留出的 CCNC 测试集上，检测 F1 为 0.869，极性 macro-F1 为 0.817；在组织者最终的仅因果抽取评测中，粒度调整后 F1 为 0.728，为所有提交（含组织者基线）中抽取最高分。
AI.conclusion: 按子任务分建模型并结合跨任务规则、分数级集成与模式提示生成数据，可有效处理反因果句的检测、抽取与极性判定，在检测、极性和抽取三项上均取得较强表现，抽取成绩优于全部提交及组织者基线。

title: RATE: Risk-Aware Tactile Encoding for Contact-rich Robotic Manipulation
summary: Tactile sensing is particularly valuable for contact-rich robotic manipulation. Recent work has made substantial progress in tactile representation learning for robotic manipulation. However, similar tactile observations can arise from interaction conditions with very different task-risk implications, such as sensor noise, task-necessary variations, and emerging undesirable contact. Without context-grounded risk information, these cases can be ambiguous to downstream policies, leading to unnecessary corrections to benign variations or delayed responses to genuinely risky contact. To address this limitation, we propose Risk-Aware Tactile Encoding (RATE), which learns tactile representations that encode task-conditioned interaction risk. Specifically, history-conditioned prediction captures interaction context, while alert supervision associates this context with task-conditioned risk. The learned risk-aware representation complements conventional tactile features through a lightweight residual adapter. Experiments in both simulation and the real world demonstrate substantial improvements in task success, with controlled ablations confirming the complementary benefits of alert-guided learning and predictive temporal modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出Risk-Aware Tactile Encoding（RATE），学习任务条件化的交互风险触觉表征，通过“历史条件预测+警觉监督”并配合轻量残差适配器补充常规触觉特征；仿真与真机实验显示任务成功率显著提升，消融验证了两部分的互补增益。
AI.motivation: 触觉对接触丰富的机器人操作至关重要，现有触觉表征学习虽进展显著，但相似的触觉观测可能来自风险含义截然不同的交互条件（传感器噪声、任务必要变异、正在出现的非期望接触）。缺乏上下文风险信息会使下游策略产生歧义：对良性变异做多余纠正，或对真正风险接触响应滞后。
AI.method: RATE：1）以历史条件化预测捕获交互上下文；2）用警觉监督（alert supervision）将该上下文与任务条件化风险关联；3）学习到的风险感知表征通过轻量残差适配器与常规触觉特征互补融合。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界中均带来任务成功率的显著提升；受控消融实验证实警觉引导学习与预测式时序建模具有互补收益。
AI.conclusion: 将任务条件化风险显式编码进触觉表征，可缓解相似观测下的风险歧义，且作为轻量补充模块与现有触觉特征协同有效。

title: Learning the Latent Structure: A Feature-Centric Approach to Graph Data Augmentation
summary: Graph-structured data plays a pivotal role in modeling complex relationships. However, real-world graphs are often incomplete due to data collection and observational constraints, severely limiting the effectiveness of modern graph learning pipelines. While existing Graph Data Augmentation (GDA) methods attempt to refine graph structures for improved downstream performance, they are typically label-dependent, computationally expensive, and inherently transductive, limiting their applicability in practical scenarios. In this work, we present a novel feature-centric graph data augmentation framework that bypasses explicit structure modeling by operating directly in the embedding space. Through a self-supervised inverse masking process, our method captures latent ties between observed and complete graphs, enabling recovery of unobserved structural signals through refined node representations. To enhance robustness under noisy and sparse supervision, we introduce a message regularizer and a bootstrap strategy for effective training and generalization. Evaluated on ten graph datasets spanning multiple domains, our approach, SelfAug, consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both accuracy and efficiency across inductive and cold-start settings, highlighting its potential as a scalable and generalizable solution for real-world graph learning scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种以特征为中心的自监督图数据增强框架 SelfAug，通过"逆掩码"过程在嵌入空间直接建模，并结合消息正则化器与 bootstrap 策略，在十个图数据集上于归纳与冷启动场景中兼顾精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 现实图数据常因采集与观测限制而不完整，严重制约图学习效果。现有图数据增强（GDA）方法虽试图优化图结构以提升下游性能，但普遍依赖标签、计算开销大且本质上是直推式（transductive），难以适用于实际场景。
AI.method: 提出以特征为中心的图数据增强框架，绕过显式结构建模，直接在嵌入空间操作。采用自监督"逆掩码"（inverse masking）过程捕获观测图与完整图之间的潜在关联，借助精炼后的节点表示恢复未观测结构信号；并引入消息正则化器（message regularizer）与 bootstrap 策略，以增强在噪声与稀疏监督下的鲁棒性及泛化能力。
AI.result: 在覆盖多领域的十个图数据集上进行评估，SelfAug 在归纳（inductive）与冷启动（cold-start）设置下，于准确率和效率两方面均持续优于当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: SelfAug 具备可扩展性与泛化性，有望成为面向真实世界图学习场景的有效解决方案。

title: ROUTEAUDIT: Interaction-Aware Identification for Budgeted Multi-Verifier Routing
summary: Adaptive multi-verifier systems are commonly compared through endpoint quality-cost gaps, even when the verifier catalog, availability, accounting, information filtration, or scorer changes with the policy. We formulate verifier routing as a contract-conditioned identification problem. The contract records request support, verifier catalog, realized availability, resource accounting, online filtration, and post-trace scoring; a matched route contrast changes only the policy coordinate. ROUTEAUDIT adds three measurable objects to this contract. A contract lattice averages coordinate increments over every admissible bridge order and reports the resulting attribution together with its path sensitivity. A policy-independent response tape identifies paired sequential contrasts when adaptive policies reveal different observations. For incomplete matching, request-level bounds use whichever potential outcome remains observed and give a sharp finite-population interval. The protocol commits paid observations and ledger events before the oracle join and returns an attribution certificate for each comparison. On two held-out raw-tail caches, matched static SF+SA equals the cascade, assigning the apparent gains of 0.1797 and 0.1250 over full static to the verifier-set edge. On 1,319 held-out task requests, the learned and RLVR studies report quality 0.9522 and 0.9553 versus 0.9484 for matched static; the RLVR-static paired difference is +0.0068 with a request-paired interval $[0.0015,0.0122]$ and a training-seed-by-request hierarchical interval $[0.0006,0.0131]$. Controlled attribution recovery yields route mean absolute error 0.0011 and endpoint reconstruction error 0.0004. Factorial, bridge-order, and stochastic-provider studies evaluate the certificate interface; RLVR supplies a learned-policy stress test under the same identification contract.

AI.tldr: 本文将验证器路由形式化为"契约条件下的识别问题"，提出ROUTEAUDIT协议，通过契约格、策略无关响应磁带与请求级界限实现可证伪的归因，并在实验中将表面增益归因于验证器集合边界而非策略本身。
AI.motivation: 自适应多验证器系统通常仅以端点质量–成本差距进行比较，但验证器目录、可用性、计费、信息过滤或评分器会随策略变化，导致"策略效应"与"契约效应"混淆；现有对比缺少对这类混杂量的显式记录与可测归因，难以判断增益来源。
AI.method: 将验证器路由建模为契约条件下的识别问题：契约记录请求支撑、验证器目录、实际可用性、资源计费、在线过滤与事后评分，匹配路由对比仅改变策略坐标。ROUTEAUDIT在此基础上加入三个可测对象：(1) 契约格，对所有容许桥接顺序求坐标增量的平均，并报告归因及其路径敏感性；(2) 策略无关响应磁带，用于在自适应策略揭示不同观测时识别配对序贯对比；(3) 不完整匹配下的请求级界限，利用仍可观测的潜在结果给出尖锐的有限总体区间。协议在oracle join之前提交付费观测与台账事件，并为每次比较返回归因证书。
AI.result: 在两个留出raw-tail缓存上，匹配的静态SF+SA等于级联方法，将全静态上0.1797与0.1250的表观增益归因于验证器集合边界。在1,319条留出任务请求上，学习策略与RLVR研究分别报告质量0.9522与0.9553，匹配静态为0.9484；RLVR–静态配对差为+0.0068，请求配对区间[0.0015,0.0122]，训练种子×请求分层区间[0.0006,0.0131]。受控归因恢复的路由平均绝对误差0.0011，端点重构误差0.0004；因子、桥接顺序与随机提供者研究评估证书接口，RLVR提供同一识别契约下的学习策略压力测试。
AI.conclusion: 匹配对比表明，部分自适应多验证器系统的表面增益实际来自验证器集合差异而非策略优势；契约条件化的识别框架与ROUTEAUDIT证书为这类比较提供可测、可证伪的归因，并在学习策略与随机提供者等情形下保持稳定。

title: CalCErt: Bin-wise Certification of Confidence Calibration in Medical Image Classification
summary: Deep neural networks remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, which can distort not only predictions but also confidence scores, undermining uncertainty calibration. While existing certification methods focus on preserving the predicted category, providing guarantees on how calibration behaves under adversarial attacks remains overlooked. In this work, we introduce CalCErt, a simple and efficient post-hoc strategy that certifies bin-wise confidence calibration for any pretrained differentiable classifier. Our approach combines empirical calibration estimates, statistical concentration bounds, and local Lipschitz estimates of the confidence function to derive data-dependent upper bounds on worst-case miscalibration within an $ell_2$-ball of radius R. We evaluate CalCErt across 11 medical image classification tasks and multiple adversarial perturbations, demonstrating substantially higher certified coverage than baseline strategies while maintaining competitive tightness. Our code is available at https://github.com/leofillioux/calcert.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CalCErt，一种简单高效的事后策略，可为任意预训练可微分类器认证分箱置信度校准。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络对对抗扰动敏感，扰动不仅会改变预测，还会扭曲置信度分数，破坏不确定性校准。现有认证方法主要关注保持预测类别，而对对抗攻击下校准行为能否提供保证仍被忽视。
AI.method: CalCErt 结合经验校准估计、统计集中不等式以及置信度函数的局部 Lipschitz 估计，推导出在 ℓ2 半径 R 球内最坏情况误校准的数据依赖上界。
AI.result: 在 11 个医学图像分类任务和多种对抗扰动上进行评估，CalCErt 相比基线策略显著提高了认证覆盖率，同时保持有竞争力的紧致度。
AI.conclusion: CalCErt 为对抗扰动下的置信度校准提供了可认证保证，扩展了认证方法从预测类别到校准行为的范围，并在医学图像任务中验证了有效性。

title: To Jev or Not? Evaluating the Accuracy and Efficiency of Structured Decision Models for Hate-Speech Moderation
summary: The scale of online content makes hate-speech moderation challenging, while Large Language Models (LLMs) enable harmful material to be produced and adapted more easily. Moderation therefore requires efficient classifiers that can accommodate different definitions of hate speech. Recent structured decision models accept natural-language criteria and select among specified answers, raising the question of whether they can meet these requirements without task-specific training. We present HATEDECIDE, an evaluation of six decision-model configurations on four hate-speech datasets against specialized moderation, zero-shot, commercial, and supervised baselines. We examine whether supplying a dataset's definition, or decomposing it into multiple questions, improves classification, and we measure their latency and cost. We find that commercial LLMs significantly outperform all decision models on only one dataset. Supplying definitions changes up to 28\% of predictions without consistently improving classification, and decomposition significantly improves performance in only 20\% of the comparisons. On a diagnostic set of test cases, the best hosted decision model comes within 1.6 macro-F1 points of the best commercial LLM at approximately 97\% lower inference cost. These results identify opportunities for inexpensive moderation, while showing that explicit criteria and additional questions do not reliably improve classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HATEDECIDE，系统评估六种“决策模型”配置在四个仇恨言论数据集上的表现，并与专用审核模型、零样本、商用及监督基线对比，检验提供定义或问题分解是否提升分类效果，并测量时延与成本。
AI.motivation: 在线内容规模巨大，仇恨言论审核困难；大语言模型又使有害内容更易生成和改写。审核需要能适配不同仇恨言论定义的高效分类器。近期结构化决策模型可接受自然语言准则并在给定答案中选择，本文考察其能否在无需任务特定训练的情况下满足上述需求。
AI.method: 在四个仇恨言论数据集上评估六种决策模型配置，对比专用审核模型、零样本、商用 LLM 与监督基线；实验检验两种干预：向模型提供该数据集的定义，以及将判定分解为多个问题；同时测量推理时延与成本，并在诊断性测试集上比较最佳托管决策模型与最佳商用 LLM。
AI.result: 商用 LLM 仅在其中一个数据集上显著优于所有决策模型。提供定义最多改变 28% 的预测，但并未稳定提升分类效果；问题分解仅在 20% 的对比中带来显著提升。在诊断性测试集上，最佳托管决策模型与最佳商用 LLM 的 macro-F1 相差 1.6 个百分点，而推理成本约低 97%。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明存在低成本审核的机会，但显式准则与额外提问并不能可靠地改善分类。决策模型在特定条件下可接近商用 LLM 的效果，同时大幅降低推理成本。

title: A Unified Framework for Empowerment and Predictive Control
summary: Sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) is a powerful approach to trajectory optimization, but its performance depends on an informative cost function that often requires substantial domain knowledge to design. An alternative is to derive objectives directly from the system dynamics. Empowerment, defined as the channel capacity between an agent's inputs and its future state, provides such a goal-agnostic objective and has been shown to produce useful behaviors across a range of domains. However, existing empowerment-based controllers have two key limitations: empowerment is estimated using a virtual probing policy distinct from the executed control policy, obscuring its connection to the resulting behavior; and its computation typically requires second-order derivatives of the dynamics, limiting compatibility with standard MPC methods. We formulate empowerment using a single policy for both probing and acting, directly linking the empowerment objective to the executed behavior. The resulting objective requires only first-order derivatives and can be optimized with standard MPC solvers, either alone or in combination with a task-specific cost. We evaluate the proposed approach on classical control tasks and show that combining empowerment with task costs matches or exceeds the success rate achieved by either objective alone. Our formulation provides a practical bridge between standard MPC and intrinsically motivated control.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种仅用单一策略同时进行探测与执行的empowerment目标，只需一阶导数即可优化，可与标准MPC求解器及任务代价结合，在经典控制任务上表现不劣于或优于单独使用任一代价。
AI.motivation: 基于采样的MPC性能依赖信息量丰富的代价函数，而设计此类函数通常需要大量领域知识；empowerment作为一种无需具体目标、从系统动力学导出的内在动机目标，可提供替代方案。但既有empowerment控制器存在两点不足：一是empowerment用与执行策略不同的虚拟探测策略估计，削弱其与实际行为的联系；二是其计算通常需要动力学的二阶导数，限制其与标准MPC方法的兼容性。
AI.method: 作者将empowerment形式化为用同一策略同时完成探测与执行，使empowerment目标与所执行行为直接关联。由此得到的优化目标仅需一阶导数，可用标准MPC求解器优化，既可单独使用，也可与任务特定的代价函数组合。
AI.result: 在经典控制任务上的评估表明，将empowerment与任务代价相结合，其成功率可匹配或超过单独使用任一目标时的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 该形式化为标准MPC与内在动机控制之间提供了一座实用桥梁，在保持标准MPC求解兼容性的同时引入了无需目标设定的empowerment行为。

title: Instance-Dependent Regret for CMDPs with Step-Wise Constraints
summary: We study online learning in episodic tabular constrained Markov decision processes with step-wise safety constraints. In such a setting, the constraints induce a safe subgraph that shapes the variance of cumulative rewards under feasible policies and, consequently, the difficulty of learning. Exploiting this structure, however, requires learning which actions are safe while controlling constraint violations. We propose Safe Variance-Adaptive Exploration (SVAE), an efficient algorithm that learns candidate safe subgraphs and performs variance-adaptive optimistic planning within them. With high probability, SVAE achieves cumulative regret of order $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{SAH\min\{\mathbb{V}_Σ,K\mathrm{Var}^{\star}\}}+S\sqrt{AH^3\min\{K,\mathcal{C}\}}+S^2AH^2)$ over $K$ episodes, where $H$ is the horizon of a single episode, while $S$ and $A$ are the numbers of states and actions, respectively. Here, $\mathrm{Var}^{\star}$ is the maximum return variance among safe policies, $\mathbb{V}_Σ$ is the variance accumulated before the first unsafe action is encountered, and $\mathcal{C}$ captures the statistical complexity of eliminating actions incorrectly considered potentially safe. SVAE additionally attains $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(H\sqrt{SAK}+S^2AH^2)$ step-wise constraint violation and a gap-dependent violation bound that is polylogarithmic in $K$. Finally, we establish a lower bound showing that dependence on these instance-specific quantities is unavoidable.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带逐步安全约束的episodic tabular约束MDP在线学习问题，提出SVAE算法，通过学习候选安全子图并在其中执行方差自适应乐观规划，实现近最优regret、约束违反界，并给出下界证明。
AI.motivation: 在该设定中，安全约束诱导出一个安全子图，塑造了可行策略下累积回报的方差，进而影响学习难度。利用这一结构需要同时学习哪些动作安全并控制约束违反，这构成了核心挑战。
AI.method: 提出Safe Variance-Adaptive Exploration (SVAE)算法：学习候选安全子图，并在其内部执行方差自适应的乐观规划。
AI.result: 以高概率实现累积regret为Õ(√(SAH min{V_Σ, K Var*}) + S√(AH³ min{K, C}) + S²AH²)，同时达到Õ(H√(SAK)+S²AH²)的逐步约束违反界，以及gap-dependent的多对数违反界；并建立下界证明对这些实例相关量的依赖不可避免。
AI.conclusion: SVAE在带逐步安全约束的episodic tabular CMDP中实现了高效学习，其regret与约束违反均达到近最优，且下界表明对实例特定量的依赖是不可避免的。

title: iS-KV: Online Low-Rank KV Cache Compression via Block-Incremental SVD
summary: Long chain-of-thought reasoning substantially increases KV-cache memory during autoregressive decoding, as every generated token introduces new key and value states and causes the cache to grow linearly with decoding length. Existing KV-cache compression methods typically control this growth through token eviction, but irreversible deletion can remove historical states that later reasoning may need to revisit. SVD-based low-rank compression provides an alternative by retaining all positions with a more compact representation. However, extending it from a fixed prompt cache to online decoding is non-trivial. Through our investigation, we find that if the basis is updated for new tokens while old tokens keep their coordinates in the old basis, the stored history drifts substantially. Based on this observation, we propose iS-KV, an online low-rank KV-cache compression method for long-horizon reasoning. iS-KV keeps a recent window exact while incrementally folding older states into bounded-rank representations. As the low-rank basis evolves, it synchronizes historical coordinates with the updated basis to maintain representation consistency. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, iS-KV achieves 82.6% accuracy at 4.06-fold persistent-KV compression, close to the original model's 83.6%. On Qwen3-8B, it achieves 89.2% accuracy at 5.64-fold compression. Under matched memory budgets, iS-KV consistently outperforms token-eviction baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 iS-KV，一种用于长链思维推理的在线低秩 KV-cache 压缩方法，在保持近原始精度的同时实现 4–5.6 倍持续 KV 压缩。
AI.motivation: 长链思维推理在自回归解码中使 KV-cache 随解码长度线性增长，显存开销巨大；现有 token 驱逐方法会不可逆删除历史状态，可能损害后续推理对历史信息的回访需求。基于 SVD 的低秩压缩虽能保留全部位置，但从固定 prompt cache 扩展到在线解码十分困难。
AI.method: 作者发现：若为新 token 更新低秩基而旧 token 保留旧基坐标，会导致存储历史产生显著漂移。据此提出 iS-KV：保留最近窗口的精确 KV，将较旧状态增量折叠进有界秩表示；当低秩基演化时，同步更新历史坐标以维持表示一致性。
AI.result: 在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B 上，iS-KV 在 4.06 倍持续 KV 压缩下达到 82.6% 准确率，接近原始模型的 83.6%；在 Qwen3-8B 上，5.64 倍压缩下达到 89.2% 准确率。在相同显存预算下，iS-KV 持续优于 token 驱逐基线。
AI.conclusion: iS-KV 通过在线低秩压缩与历史坐标同步机制，有效解决了长链推理中 KV-cache 线性增长问题，在保持表示一致性的同时实现高压缩比与高精度，优于 token 驱逐类方法。

title: Does Physics Live in the Activations? Localizing Physical Quantities in Video Diffusion Models
summary: Video generation models produce strikingly realistic sequences and are increasingly proposed as world models, yet recent benchmarks reveal pronounced deficits in their physical reasoning. This raises the question of whether these models internalize physical principles or merely reproduce familiar motion patterns. We address this by probing internal representations of video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for simulator-derived ground-truth physical quantities spanning kinematic motion and rigid-body dynamics under gravity and contact. We find that these quantities are linearly decodable with high accuracy early in the denoising process, substantially outperforming a baseline decoded directly from the model's own noised latents, indicating that the relevant physical information is actively constructed during denoising rather than already present in the input. Additionally, we show that activations at on-object tokens carry the relevant physical information and that quantities defined over multiple frames are readable from single latent frames. Hence, information is sharply localized within the token sequence and is computed globally but stored locally. The probes further show partial extrapolation, transferring to scene variations and object configurations outside their training regime, so what they read is not simply a correlate of the scenes they were fit on. When fitted directly in the full-resolution activation space, the probing directions can serve as steering vectors to change the model's output.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过线性探针方法研究视频扩散Transformer（DiT）内部是否真正编码了物理量。结果显示，运动学与刚体动力学量可在去噪早期从内部激活中高精度线性解码，且信息定位于物体token、全局计算但局部存储，并具备一定外推能力，甚至可作为引导向量改变生成输出。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型日益被视为世界模型，但基准测试揭示其物理推理存在明显缺陷。核心疑问是：这些模型是内化了物理原理，还是仅在复现熟悉的运动模式。作者希望通过探测内部表征来回答这一问题。
AI.method: 使用由仿真器导出的物理真值量（涵盖运动学运动，以及重力与接触下的刚体动力学），对视频扩散Transformer（DiT）的内部表征进行线性探针分析。与直接从模型自身加噪潜变量解码的基线进行对比，并考察激活在token序列中的定位、跨帧量从单帧潜变量读取的能力以及外推性能。进一步在全分辨率激活空间拟合探针方向，用作引导向量。
AI.result: 这些物理量在去噪过程早期即可被高精度线性解码，显著优于从模型自身加噪潜变量解码的基线，表明相关物理信息是在去噪中被主动构建而非预先存在于输入。物体token处的激活携带相关物理信息，跨多帧定义的量可从单帧潜变量读出，说明信息在token序列中高度定位于局部、但计算是全局的。探针还表现出部分外推能力，可迁移到训练分布之外的场景变化与物体配置。在全分辨率激活空间拟合的探针方向可作为引导向量改变模型输出。
AI.conclusion: 视频DiT在去噪过程中主动构建了可线性解码的物理表征，而非仅复现运动模式；这些表征信息高度定位于物体token并局部存储，且具备一定外推性与可操控性，可作为引导向量干预生成结果，为评估视频生成模型的物理理解提供了机制性证据。

title: SyntaxBench: A Statistical Diagnostic Framework for Character-Level Reasoning in Large Language Models
comment: 32 pages, 17 figures. The first two authors contributed equally. The code will be released soon
summary:
Large language models are increasingly used where small syntactic errors matter, yet character-level reasoning is still evaluated mostly through isolated probes and aggregate accuracy. We introduce SyntaxBench, a diagnostic benchmark and statistical evaluation framework for character-level reasoning. It contains five core tasks, character counting, letter containment, palindrome detection, edit distance, and longest-string selection, plus index_to_span, a harder substring-extraction stress test. The five core tasks use paired English and character-length-matched random-string inputs. index_to_span documents share a 200-500 word band and are not character-length matched. All six tasks use zero-, one-, and four-shot prompts.
  We evaluate eight open-weight models from 2B to 32B parameters across 11 reasoning-mode configurations. The framework reports exact-match and relaxed accuracy, Cohen's kappa, paired McNemar tests with odds ratios, bootstrap confidence intervals, Kendall's tau, class-conditional metrics, tokenization analysis, and multiple-comparison-corrected tests. Three findings stand out. First, tokenization shapes accuracy: random strings are more character-visible than English strings (1.892 vs. 3.169 characters per token), and character-counting accuracy falls as English words occupy more tokens. Second, reasoning mode is not uniformly helpful: Gemma4-31B is nearly unchanged across modes on the near-saturated tasks, while Qwen3.6-27B is worse with thinking on palindrome detection (0.952 non-thinking vs. 0.886 thinking at four-shot). Third, index_to_span remains largely unsolved; the best four-shot exact-match accuracy is 6.75%.
  Character-level evaluation needs controlled inputs, paired tests, and analyses of tokenization and reasoning mode rather than aggregate accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SyntaxBench，一个面向字符级推理的诊断基准与统计评估框架，包含六个任务，评估八款 2B–32B 开源模型在 11 种推理模式配置下的表现，发现分词方式、推理模式影响显著，且子串抽取任务仍基本未被解决。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多应用于对细微语法错误敏感的场景，但字符级推理目前主要通过孤立探针和聚合准确率来评估，缺乏受控输入、配对检验以及对分词与推理模式的系统分析。
AI.method: 构建 SyntaxBench 基准与统计评估框架：包含五个核心任务（字符计数、字母包含、回文检测、编辑距离、最长字符串选择）以及更难的子串抽取压力测试 index_to_span。五个核心任务使用配对英文与字符长度匹配的随机字符串输入；index_to_span 文档为 200–500 词区间且不做字符长度匹配。全部六个任务使用 zero-shot、one-shot、four-shot 提示。评估八款 2B–32B 开源权重模型、11 种推理模式配置。报告指标包括精确匹配与宽松准确率、Cohen's kappa、配对 McNemar 检验及优势比、bootstrap 置信区间、Kendall's tau、类别条件指标、分词分析及多重比较校正检验。
AI.result: 三项主要发现：一，分词影响准确率，随机字符串字符可见性高于英文（1.892 vs. 3.169 字符/词元），英文单词占用词元越多字符计数准确率越低；二，推理模式并非普遍有益，Gemma4-31B 在接近饱和任务上各模式几乎不变，而 Qwen3.6-27B 在回文检测上开启思考反而更差（four-shot：非思考 0.952 vs. 思考 0.886）；三，index_to_span 基本未被解决，最佳 four-shot 精确匹配准确率仅 6.75%。
AI.conclusion: 字符级评估需要受控输入、配对检验以及对分词和推理模式的分析，而不能仅依赖聚合准确率。

title: AVL-JEPA: Preventing Causal Dynamics Information Collapse In Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture World Models
summary: Joint embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) predict future latent representations without reconstructing observations, enabling world models to focus on high-level semantic dynamics. However, a JEPA can preserve high dimensional visual information while discarding information about the physical consequences of actions. We call this failure mode causal dynamics information collapse and propose action-grounded vision-invariance latent (AVL) to prevent this collapse. We first use the executed action as an auxiliary dynamics anchor that encourages the model to preserve dynamics information, and then use a vision-invariance pathway which aligns perturbed and clean latent predictions without discarding dynamics information, forcing the model to fully understand and utilize causal dynamics information. We validate AVL on four robotic control tasks (TwoRoom, PushT, OGBench Cube, and Reacher), showing that it substantially improves success rates under visual perturbations while preserving clean-environment performance. We further evaluate physical consequence alignment, clean-noisy dynamics consistency, and the causal effect of targeted transition subspace erasure. Collectively, these results indicate that dynamic information causally relevant to planning is preserved from collapse under AVL.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"因果动态信息坍缩"这一失效模式，并给出AVL方法来防止该坍缩，在四个机器人控制任务上提升了视觉扰动下的成功率。
AI.motivation: JEPA在不重建观测的情况下预测未来隐表征，使世界模型聚焦高层语义动态。但JEPA可能在保留高维视觉信息的同时丢弃动作的物理后果信息，即"因果动态信息坍缩"，导致规划所需动态信息缺失。
AI.method: AVL包含两部分：1）以实际执行动作为辅助动态锚点，促使模型保留动态信息；2）视觉不变性通路，在不丢弃动态信息的前提下对齐扰动与干净隐预测，迫使模型充分利用因果动态信息。
AI.result: 在TwoRoom、PushT、OGBench Cube、Reacher四个机器人控制任务上，AVL在视觉扰动下显著提升成功率，同时保持干净环境性能；并通过物理后果对齐、干净-噪声动态一致性及定向转移子空间擦除的因果效应三项评估进行验证。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，AVL能够防止与规划因果相关的动态信息发生坍缩，使JEPA在视觉扰动下保留规划所需的动态信息。

title: BaCP: Backbone Contrastive Pruning for Preserving Representations in Extremely Sparse Neural Networks
summary: Unstructured pruning at extreme sparsity often suffers from representational collapse, causing sharp drops in accuracy. To address this, we study Backbone Contrastive Pruning (BaCP), which regularizes the sparse network's embedding space by aligning it with pretrained, fine-tuned, and historical snapshot models. Building on the contrastive decomposition of the CAP framework (Xu et al., 2022), we provide a rigorous matched-budget characterization of this approach across multiple pruning criteria. Evaluated across 90 settings, BaCP improves accuracy substantially in extreme sparsity regimes where standard pruning fails, and is close to baseline where representations remain intact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Backbone Contrastive Pruning (BaCP)，通过对齐预训练、微调及历史快照模型的嵌入空间，缓解极端稀疏下的表征崩溃，并在90个设置中显著提升精度。
AI.motivation: 极端稀疏的非结构化剪枝常导致表征崩溃，使精度骤降，标准剪枝方法在此情形下失效。
AI.method: 基于 CAP 框架（Xu et al., 2022）的对比分解，提出 BaCP，将稀疏网络的嵌入空间与预训练模型、微调模型及历史快照模型对齐，并在多种剪枝准则下进行匹配预算的严格刻画。
AI.result: 在90个设置中评估，BaCP 在标准剪枝失效的极端稀疏区间显著提升精度，而在表征保持完整时接近基线表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过骨干对比正则化对齐嵌入空间，可有效缓解极端稀疏剪枝的表征崩溃问题，是一种通用且有效的改进方案。

title: MetaRubric: Learning to Reward for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning extends reward-driven optimization to open-ended tasks by assigning partial credit to individual response requirements. However, rubric judges can assign a high criterion score even when the information or action it requires is absent from the response, a failure mode we term Vacuous Credit. Such awards persist after the required information is removed and can reverse the sign of a response's GRPO advantage. To address this problem, we introduce MetaRubric, which alternates evidence-aware policy optimization with response-guided rubric adaptation. We construct counterfactual counterparts by changing one task-relevant fact in each prompt. During policy optimization, credit is assigned only when the response contains sufficient evidence to satisfy the required rubric criterion. After each policy-optimization stage, current policy responses guide revisions to original and counterfactual criteria while preserving the meaning of the original prompt's initial rubric as interpreted under each prompt's facts. We also adapt criterion weights at stage boundaries to better address observed policy errors. Across multiple backbones, MetaRubric improves PubMedQA accuracy by 6.00--20.40 percentage points over static-judge GRPO, with further gains on HealthBench-Hard and two multimodal medical benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MetaRubric，通过证据感知的策略优化与响应引导的评分标准自适应交替进行，解决评分标准式强化学习中的"空泛得分"问题，在多个医学基准上显著优于静态评判的 GRPO。
AI.motivation: 基于评分标准的强化学习可将奖励驱动优化扩展到开放式任务，通过对响应中的各项要求给予部分分数来提供反馈。但评分标准评判器存在一种失效模式（作者称之为 Vacuous Credit，即空泛得分）：即使响应中缺少某条标准所要求的信息或动作，评判器仍可能给出高分。这种得分在所需信息被移除后依然存在，甚至会逆转某条响应 GRPO 优势函数的符号，从而破坏优化信号的有效性。
AI.method: MetaRubric 在证据感知的策略优化与响应引导的评分标准自适应之间交替进行。具体地：通过在每个提示中改变一个任务相关事实来构造反事实对照提示；在策略优化阶段，仅当响应包含满足所需评分标准要求的充分证据时才授予分数；每个策略优化阶段结束后，由当前策略的响应引导对原始标准与反事实标准进行修订，同时保持原始提示初始评分标准在各提示事实下所解读含义不变；此外在阶段边界自适应调整标准权重，以更好地应对观察到的策略错误。
AI.result: 在多个主干模型上，MetaRubric 相比静态评判的 GRPO 将 PubMedQA 准确率提升 6.00–20.40 个百分点，并在 HealthBench-Hard 以及两个多模态医学基准上取得进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将证据充分性纳入评分标准式奖励并动态修订评分标准与权重，MetaRubric 有效缓解了空泛得分问题，提升了开放式医学任务中强化学习优化信号的可靠性与最终性能。

title: Geometry-Aligned Semantic Matching for Cross-Modal Planar Image Registration
summary: Cross-modal image matching establishes stable and accurate geometric correspondences across modalities for planar registration. Existing semantic representations provide cross-modal consistency, but semantic similarity does not necessarily imply geometric correspondence. Meanwhile, fine-grained CNN features provide accurate local details but lack global cross-modal semantic guidance for stable refinement. To address these issues, we propose CDPM, which first establishes geometrically consistent semantic representations and then preserves their dominant role in correspondence estimation during fine-grained localization. Specifically, we progressively adapt DINOv3 using geometrically consistent cross-modal patch pairs, enabling feature similarity to better reflect true cross-modal spatial correspondences. We then construct a DINO-Centric Feature Pyramid, where multi-scale DINO representations maintain stable cross-modal correspondences, while a lightweight CNN branch provides auxiliary structural details for precise local refinement. Extensive experiments on three cross-modal datasets demonstrate the superior performance of CDPM. On VIS-IR, compared with the dense matcher RoMa, CDPM improves AUC@3/5/10/20 by 7.36, 13.40, 13.75, and 10.42 percentage points, respectively, and reduces mACE from 5.83 to 2.78 pixels. It also outperforms RoMa v2 across all metrics while requiring 45.6% fewer FLOPs. The online demo and dataset are available, and the code will be released on our project page at https://warren-wzw.github.io/CDPM/.

AI.tldr: 提出CDPM跨模态图像匹配方法：先建立几何一致的语义表征，再在细粒度定位中保持其主导作用，通过渐进适配DINOv3并构建以DINO为中心的特征金字塔，在三个跨模态数据集上超越RoMa及RoMa v2。
AI.motivation: 现有语义表征虽具跨模态一致性，但语义相似不等同于几何对应；而细粒度CNN特征定位精确却缺乏全局跨模态语义引导，难以稳定细化。二者互补但未有效结合。
AI.method: 1) 用几何一致的跨模态patch对渐进适配DINOv3，使特征相似度更好反映真实跨模态空间对应；2) 构建DINO-Centric Feature Pyramid，多尺度DINO表征维持稳定跨模态对应，轻量CNN分支提供辅助结构细节做局部精细化。
AI.result: 在三个跨模态数据集上验证优越性。VIS-IR上相比密集匹配器RoMa，AUC@3/5/10/20分别提升7.36、13.40、13.75、10.42个百分点，mACE从5.83降至2.78像素；所有指标超过RoMa v2，且FLOPs减少45.6%。
AI.conclusion: 语义对应与几何对应需解耦并协同：让几何一致的语义表征主导匹配估计，CNN仅作辅助细化，可在提升精度的同时降低计算量，为跨模态匹配提供有效范式。

title: CLIMB: Confidence-Guided Complementary Evidence for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong visual reasoning abilities, but knowledge-intensive visual question answering often requires external textual evidence beyond the image and the model's parametric knowledge. Existing multimodal RAG systems commonly rely on Top-$K$ retrieval or reranking, which may return redundant passages and provide limited control over whether an answer update is sufficiently supported by the retrieved evidence. We propose \textit{CLIMB}, a training-free inference-time framework for multimodal RAG. CLIMB first constructs a compact complementary evidence pool using an MMR-style objective that balances query relevance and passage-level redundancy. It then performs confidence-controlled refinement within this fixed pool: an R/E/C critic scores passages by relevance, evidence specificity, and cross-modal alignment, while an evidence-grounded confidence estimator accepts an updated answer only when the estimated confidence increases. This design provides a simple stopping criterion and reduces unnecessary refinement without modifying the underlying retriever or MLLM. Experiments on Encyclopedic-VQA and InfoSeek show that CLIMB consistently improves over retrieval-augmented multimodal baselines. Ablations further indicate that complementary pooling, critic-based scoring, and iterative confidence-controlled refinement each contribute to the final performance.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的多模态RAG推理框架CLIMB，通过互补证据池构建与置信度控制精化，在Encyclopedic-VQA和InfoSeek上稳定优于检索增强基线。
AI.motivation: 知识密集型视觉问答需要图像与参数知识之外的文本证据；现有多模态RAG依赖Top-K检索或重排序，易返回冗余段落，且对"答案更新是否被证据充分支持"缺乏控制。
AI.method: CLIMB为免训练推理期框架：首先用MMR式目标构建紧凑的互补证据池，兼顾查询相关性与段落级冗余；随后在固定池内进行置信度控制的精化——R/E/C批评器从相关性、证据特异性、跨模态对齐三方面为段落打分，证据接地的置信度估计器仅当估计置信度提升时才接受更新答案，从而提供简单停止准则，且不修改检索器或MLLM。
AI.result: 在Encyclopedic-VQA与InfoSeek上，CLIMB持续优于检索增强的多模态基线；消融表明互补池化、批评器打分与迭代置信度控制精化各自均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 通过互补证据选择与受控迭代精化，可在不训练、不改动底层模型的前提下提升多模态RAG的答案可靠性并减少无谓精化。

title: World Action Learning via Interaction-Centric Spectral Latent Guidance
summary: Learning general-purpose robot policies requires large-scale real-world interaction data, yet collecting robot demonstrations remains expensive and difficult to scale. Egocentric videos offer abundant human interaction experience with task-relevant semantics for robotic manipulation, but direct transfer is challenging for two reasons: latent actions inferred from frame reconstruction can be dominated by nuisance variation such as ego-camera motion, and human and robot behaviors often exhibit different temporal dynamics. We propose WING (World Action Learning via INteraction-Centric Spectral Latent Guidance), a framework for transferring interaction knowledge from egocentric videos to robot policies. WING first separates observer-induced motion from hand-object interaction and distills the interaction-centric component into latent actions. It then exploits the observation that cross-embodiment task semantics are concentrated in slowly varying temporal structures, identifying shared low-frequency components between egocentric latent actions and robot behaviors in the spectral domain and using them to guide action generation. WING achieves average success rates of 99.20% on LIBERO, 93.80% on RoboTwin 2.0, and 57.7% on RoboCasa-GR1, and also performs strongly across four real-world manipulation tasks under diverse generalization settings. These results show that interaction-centric spectral guidance provides an effective and scalable way to transfer physical interaction knowledge from human egocentric video to robot control. Project page: https://mikuz12.github.io/wing/

AI.tldr: WING提出以"交互为中心"的谱域潜动作引导框架，从第一人称人类视频中提取可迁移的交互知识用于机器人操作策略学习。
AI.motivation: 机器人策略学习依赖大规模真实交互数据，但机器人示教采集成本高、难扩展。第一人称（egocentric）视频蕴含丰富的、与操作任务语义相关的人类交互经验，是潜在的低成本数据源。然而直接迁移存在两大障碍：一是从帧重建中推断的潜动作易被自我相机运动等无关干扰变主导；二是人类与机器人的行为在时序动态上存在差异。
AI.method: WING（World Action Learning via INteraction-Centric Spectral Latent Guidance）分两步：第一，将观察者引起的相机运动与手-物交互运动解耦，仅把"交互为中心"的成分蒸馏为潜动作（latent action），从而去除干扰；第二，基于跨具身（cross-embodiment）任务语义集中于缓慢变化的时序结构这一观察，在谱域中识别第一人称潜动作与机器人行为之间共享的低频成分，并用其引导动作生成。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上平均成功率达99.20%，RoboTwin 2.0上为93.80%，RoboCasa-GR1上为57.7%；同时在四类真实世界操作任务及多种泛化设定下表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 以交互为中心的谱域引导是一种有效且可扩展的方式，可将人类第一人称视频中的物理交互知识迁移到机器人控制。

title: Autoregressive Differentiable Method for Integer Programming
summary: We introduce an autoregressive differentiable method to solve 0-1 integer programs. We fix an arbitrary order of the binary variables and we train a transformer to predict the next bit while remaining in the feasible set. Our method is first trained on feasible incumbents provided by any solver, thus allowing us to initialize the transformer in the feasible set. Our procedure then implements a Lagrangian penalty to penalize infeasible solutions, and the transformer is further trained to explore the feasible set using Gumbel-softmax activations on the relaxed objective. We have tested our method on non-convex instances of quadratic knapsack problem and demonstrated consistent improvement upon state-of-the-art open-source solvers for dense problems up to 10,000 binary variables. In particular, we empirically demonstrate a phenomenon akin to a tunneling effect where the effective change of variables from binary variable to the continuous weights of the transformer that the method implements enables crossing barriers in the relaxed objective landscape.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自回归可微方法求解0-1整数规划：训练Transformer在保持可行域的前提下逐位预测变量，并结合拉格朗日惩罚与Gumbel-softmax探索可行域，在稠密二次背包问题上优于开源求解器。
AI.motivation: 0-1整数规划（如非凸二次背包问题）在变量规模大且稠密时，传统求解器效果受限，需要一种可扩展且能有效探索可行域的连续化求解方法。
AI.method: 固定二元变量顺序，训练Transformer自回归预测下一位并保持在可行集内；先用任意求解器提供的可行解（incumbents）进行初始化训练，使模型初始点落在可行域；随后引入拉格朗日惩罚项惩罚不可行解，并在松弛目标上使用Gumbel-softmax激活，进一步训练Transformer探索可行域。
AI.result: 在非凸二次背包问题的实例上进行测试，对高达10,000个二元变量的稠密问题相比最优开源求解器取得一致提升；实验观察到类似量子隧穿效应的现象，即由二元变量到Transformer连续权重的有效变量替换，能够跨越松弛目标景观中的势垒。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过可微自回归生成+拉格朗日惩罚+Gumbel-softmax，为大规稠密非凸0-1整数规划提供了一种有效且可扩展的求解思路。

title: Scaling Trajectories for Complex Tasks through Recursive Self-Rewrite
summary: Successful trajectories on difficult tasks provide valuable supervision for model improvement, but specialized harnesses introduce interventions that may be unavailable during deployment. We propose Recursive Self-Rewrite (RSR), a framework that uses one base model, Qwen-3.8-27B, to discover successful solutions under diverse harnesses and reconstruct them as training trajectories under a general harness. A planner extracts procedures into runbooks, a critic screens for verifier and solution leakage and guides recursive revision, and an executor follows qualified runbooks in fresh sandboxes. Across approximately 3K self-curated terminal tasks, three harnesses jointly solve 759 tasks, 34.3% more than the strongest individual harness in the recorded pool. RSR expands 2,001 successful source trajectories into 11,094 rewritten trajectories for supervised finetuning. Training on these trajectories outperforms both the base model and direct trajectory SFT. Compared with the base model, pass@3 increases from 57.0% to 74.2% on Terminal-Bench 2, from 1.5% to 9.1% on Terminal-Bench 4, from 39.0% to 63.0% on our self-curated Terminal-Bench Hard, and from 3.0% to 6.0% on our Software Terminal-Bench. Process reward on Long-Horizon Terminal-Bench rises from 0.21 to 0.29. These results show how diverse harness-assisted experiences can be reconstructed into reusable capabilities for a model operating under a general harness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出递归自改写（RSR）框架：用同一基座模型在多种专用harness下发现成功解，再将其重构为通用harness下的训练轨迹。基于约3K自建终端任务，三种harness联合解出759个任务（比最强单一harness多34.3%），将2,001条成功源轨迹扩展为11,094条改写轨迹用于SFT，在多个Terminal-Bench上显著提升pass@3与过程奖励。
AI.motivation: 困难任务上的成功轨迹对模型改进具有重要监督价值，但专用harness引入的干预手段在部署时往往不可用，导致这些经验难以直接迁移到通用场景。因此需要一种方法，把harness辅助下获得的成功经验重构为在通用harness下可复用的能力。
AI.method: RSR使用单一基座模型Qwen-3.8-27B，在多样化harness下发现成功解，并重构为通用harness下的训练轨迹。框架由三部分组成：planner将过程抽取为runbooks；critic筛查验证器与解法泄漏（verifier and solution leakage）并指导递归修订；executor在全新沙箱中按合格runbook执行。最终在约3K自建终端任务上生成大规模改写轨迹用于监督微调。
AI.result: 三种harness联合解出759个任务，比记录池中最强单一harness多34.3%；2,001条成功源轨迹被扩展为11,094条改写轨迹。相比基座模型，pass@3在Terminal-Bench 2上由57.0%提升至74.2%，Terminal-Bench 4由1.5%提升至9.1%，自建Terminal-Bench Hard由39.0%提升至63.0%，Software Terminal-Bench由3.0%提升至6.0%；Long-Horizon Terminal-Bench上的过程奖励由0.21升至0.29。同时优于基座模型与直接轨迹SFT。
AI.conclusion: 多样化的harness辅助经验可以被重构为可复用能力，使模型在通用harness下运行时依然受益。RSR为利用专用工具环境中的成功经验、并将其迁移到部署时的通用条件提供了一条可行路径。

title: PocketSplat: Mobile Gaussian Reconstruction via World-Space Latent Allocatio
summary: Mobile Gaussian reconstruction must satisfy two requirements: the reconstruction model must execute within a device resource envelope, and the resulting Gaussian asset must expose a representation size suited to downstream mobile use. Existing feed-forward Gaussian reconstructors commonly decode dense, image-aligned candidates whose final cardinality is implicitly determined by the input resolution and number of views. We present PocketSplat, a feed-forward framework for budgeted mobile Gaussian asset construction. Given a prescribed output budget, PocketSplat organizes dense geometry-aware latent candidates in predicted world space, allocates exact integer capacity across local latent cells, and decodes complete Gaussian attributes only for retained candidates. Cell-conditioned latent fusion aggregates repeated multi-view evidence before decoding, while spatial responsibility decoding adapts Gaussian support after local sparsification. Experiments on DL3DV and out-of-distribution benchmarks establish a strong quality--budget trade-off against feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction baselines. On Mip-NeRF 360, PocketSplat executes directly on a target iPhone and constructs compact, higher-quality Gaussian assets substantially faster than a deployable streamed MVSplat variant; native MVSplat and DepthSplat exceed the device memory budget.

AI.tldr: PocketSplat：面向移动端的预算化前馈高斯资产构建框架，实现质量-预算权衡与端侧部署。
AI.motivation: 移动端高斯重建需同时满足两项约束：模型须在设备资源包络内运行，且生成的高斯资产须具备适配下游移动使用的表示规模。现有前馈高斯重建器通常解码密集的、与图像对齐的候选，其最终基数隐式由输入分辨率和视角数量决定，难以控制预算。
AI.method: 提出PocketSplat前馈框架：给定预设输出预算，在预测世界空间中组织密集的几何感知隐式候选，在局部隐式单元间分配精确的整数容量，仅对保留下来的候选解码完整高斯属性；采用单元条件隐式融合在解码前聚合重复的多视角证据，并通过空间责任解码在局部稀疏化后自适应调整高斯支撑。
AI.result: 在DL3DV及分布外基准上，相较前馈高斯重建基线建立了强质量-预算权衡；在Mip-NeRF 360上可直接在目标iPhone上执行，构建紧凑、更高质量的高斯资产，速度显著快于可部署的流式MVSplat变体；原生MVSplat与DepthSplat超出设备内存预算。
AI.conclusion: PocketSplat通过预算化的前馈设计实现了移动端可执行、紧凑且高质量的高斯资产构建，兼顾设备资源约束与下游可用性。

title: Single-Pass Uncertainty Heads for Claim-Level Hallucination Detection in Persian Medical Language Models
summary: Hallucination detection is particularly important for medical language models, but repeated-sampling approaches are expensive and existing uncertainty-head resources do not directly transfer to a new backbone and language. We adapt the LLM Uncertainty Head (LUH) framework to Aya-Expanse-8B-based Persian medical models, using Gaokerena-V and Gaokerena-R as two previously developed backbones. We first examine response variability on a 168-question Iranian medical entrance examination and observe substantially lower five-run consistency for Gaokerena-V than for Aya-Expanse-8B, whereas Gaokerena-R is comparable to Aya-Expanse-8B. We then construct two paired claim-level hallucination datasets directly in Persian, containing 1,600 responses for each backbone, and train lightweight claim-level heads on frozen backbone attention maps and token probabilities. On held-out test splits, the heads obtain PR-AUCs of 0.4820 and 0.4652, corresponding to 2.30 and 2.66 times their respective random baselines, and ROC-AUCs of 0.7852 and 0.7810. The heads require neither retrieval nor repeated sampling at inference time. These results provide an initial study of single-pass claim-level uncertainty estimation for Persian medical language models; the test splits are small and the labels are automatically generated.

AI.tldr: 该文将LLM不确定性头框架适配到波斯语医学模型Gaokerena-V和Gaokerena-R，构建声称级幻觉数据集并训练轻量级不确定性头，实现单次推理的幻觉检测。
AI.motivation: 幻觉检测对医学语言模型至关重要，但重复采样方法开销大，且现有不确定性头资源无法直接迁移到新的骨干网络和语言。
AI.method: 基于Aya-Expanse-8B的波斯语医学模型（Gaokerena-V和Gaokerena-R），先分析168题伊朗医学入学考试上的回答变异性，再构建两个波斯语声称级配对幻觉数据集（每个骨干1600条回答），在冻结的注意力图和token概率上训练轻量级声称级不确定性头。
AI.result: 在测试集上PR-AUC为0.4820和0.4652，分别是随机基线的2.30和2.66倍；ROC-AUC为0.7852和0.7810；推理时无需检索或重复采样。
AI.conclusion: 该研究初步实现了波斯语医学模型的单次声称级不确定性估计，但测试集规模小且标签为自动生成，需进一步验证。

title: Bridging Frontier Reasoning and Robot Execution: From Autonomous Demonstration Generation to Dense Language Supervision
summary: Recent advances in frontier models enable robot manipulation from only a few demonstrations, but high inference latency limits their use for real-time robot control. To bridge this gap, we study two complementary approaches that connect frontier reasoning with low-latency local execution. First, we use a frontier model to autonomously generate demonstrations that supplement human demonstrations for training a fast local policy. We augment its in-context examples with corrective demonstration segments that show how to recover from physical errors, improving generation reliability. Generation time and cost decrease as successful examples accumulate in context, suggesting a path toward more efficient data collection. At deployment, a harness combines frontier-generated instructions with a fast local policy, enabling efficient execution while preserving the frontier model's ability to guide and correct actions. With low-latency execution delegated to the local policy, the bottleneck shifts to its capacity to reliably follow the frontier model's diverse instructions. Our second bridge introduces dense language supervision across three nested granularities---primitive, atomic, and composite---with multi-aspect descriptions at each level. Across long-horizon tasks in RoboCasa 365 and BEHAVIOR-1K, where instructions change as execution progresses, the combined supervision achieves the highest performance under both oracle and frontier-model instructors, demonstrating more reliable instruction following through the policy's language interface. Finally, we evaluate both bridges together on a crossword task that combines semantic planning and manipulation within a fixed time budget. These results support autonomous demonstration generation and dense language supervision as complementary components for connecting frontier reasoning to low-latency local execution.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究两种互补方法，将前沿模型的高层推理与低延迟本地执行的机器人操作策略相连接：一是用前沿模型自主生成（含纠错段）的演示数据补充人类演示以训练快速本地策略，并在部署时以执行框架协调两者；二是引入原始、原子、复合三种嵌套粒度的密集语言监督。二者结合在RoboCasa 365与BEHAVIOR-1K长时程任务上取得最高性能，并在填字任务中验证了协同效果。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型已能用少量演示实现机器人操作，但推理延迟高，无法满足实时机器人控制需求。因此需要弥合"前沿模型推理"与"低延迟本地执行"之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 两种互补方法：（1）自主演示生成——用前沿模型生成演示补足人类演示以训练快速本地策略，并以上下文中的纠错演示段提升生成可靠性；部署时用执行框架（harness）将前沿模型指令与本地策略结合。（2）密集语言监督——在原始、原子、复合三种嵌套粒度上提供多侧面描述的密集监督，增强策略的语言接口指令跟随能力。
AI.result: 演示生成的时间与成本随上下文中成功示例的累积而下降；在指令随执行过程变化的长时程任务RoboCasa 365和BEHAVIOR-1K中，组合监督在oracle与前沿模型指令两种设定下均取得最高性能；在同时涉及语义规划与操作的填字任务中（固定时间预算），两种方法联合验证有效。
AI.conclusion: 自主演示生成与密集语言监督是互补组件，可有效连接前沿模型推理与低延迟本地执行；低延迟执行交给本地策略后，瓶颈转向策略可靠跟随前沿模型多样指令的能力。

title: Reward Inflation: A Healthy Stimulus for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reward serves as the primary learning signal in reinforcement learning (RL). However, while reward magnitudes are typically held fixed throughout training, their temporal modulation remains underexplored. In this paper, we propose reward inflation, a gradual scaling of rewards over the course of training, and show that it can act as a healthy stimulus for RL. Theoretically, reward inflation induces an implicit recency weighting that upweights recent transitions during policy updates, enabling faster adaptation. We further show that, by sustaining gradient signals as the policy saturates, reward inflation suppresses the emergence of dormant neurons and helps preserve plasticity. Empirical results on ALE games and MuJoCo tasks corroborate these findings, showing that an appropriate level of reward inflation benefits a broad range of tasks. Finally, we introduce Fed, an adaptive variant that adjusts the inflation level on the fly, and find that it often improves upon fixed inflation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"奖励膨胀"（reward inflation）——在训练过程中逐步放大奖励幅度，并证明其可作为强化学习的良性刺激信号，通过隐式近因加权和维持梯度信号来加速适应、抑制休眠神经元并保持可塑性。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中奖励作为主要学习信号，其幅度通常在训练全程固定，而奖励的时间调制（随时序变化）尚未被充分探索。作者希望探究对奖励进行时序缩放是否能作为有益的学习刺激，从而改善策略更新效率与网络可塑性。
AI.method: 提出 reward inflation，即随训练进程逐渐缩放奖励幅度。理论上分析其诱导隐式近因加权（recency weighting），使策略更新更侧重近期转移；并说明其在策略饱和时维持梯度信号。实验在 ALE 游戏与 MuJoCo 任务上验证。进一步提出自适应变体 Fed，动态调整膨胀水平。
AI.result: 实验表明，适当程度的奖励膨胀在广泛任务上带来收益；奖励膨胀能加速适应并抑制休眠神经元、保持可塑性；自适应方法 Fed 通常优于固定膨胀水平。
AI.conclusion: 奖励的时序调制是一个被忽视但有效的方向，奖励膨胀可作为健康的学习刺激，兼顾加速适应与保持可塑性，自适应调节（Fed）进一步提升了效果。

title: MLCommons Jailbreak Benchmark v1.0
summary: Modern AI systems are designed to refuse hazardous requests. A jailbreak is a prompt crafted to bypass those safeguards and elicit outputs that the system would normally refuse to provide. The MLCommons Jailbreak Benchmark v1.0 provides an end-to-end methodology for evaluating the robustness of large language models to single-turn, text-based jailbreak attacks. It combines criteria-driven system and attack selection, paired baseline and adversarial evaluation, human annotation, automated evaluator calibration, scoring, grading, and risk-calibrated disclosure within a single benchmarking pipeline. The benchmark evaluates eight open-weight systems using 264 seed prompts spanning eleven hazard categories and representative attacks drawn from the MLCommons Jailbreak Taxonomy. Responses are assessed using the AILuminate Assessment Standard v1.4, and robustness is measured through the Resilience Gap: the change in safety performance between baseline and adversarial conditions. Across all evaluated systems and attacks, the unsafe-response rate increased from 11.08% under baseline conditions to 18.65% under jailbreak conditions, producing an average Resilience Gap of 7.57%. Accessible systems showed a larger mean gap, while attack effectiveness varied substantially across attack categories and hazards. The benchmark also examines evaluator reliability and sources of measurement error. Beyond reporting results, Jailbreak Benchmark v1.0 establishes a reproducible methodological foundation for comparative jailbreak evaluation and for future expansion across systems, attacks, hazards, and evaluation methods.

AI.tldr: MLCommons 提出 Jailbreak Benchmark v1.0，一个用于评估大语言模型对单轮文本越狱攻击鲁棒性的端到端基准方法，并引入"韧性差距"（Resilience Gap）指标；在8个开放权重系统上测得平均韧性差距为7.57%。
AI.motivation: 现代AI系统被设计为拒绝危险请求，但越狱提示可绕过这些防护机制并诱导其输出本应拒绝的内容。因此，需要一个可复现、端到端的方法论来量化模型对越狱攻击的鲁棒性，弥补现有评估在流程标准化、指标统一性和可比较性上的不足。
AI.method: 该基准构建了完整的评估流水线，包括：基于标准的系统与攻击选择、成对的基线与对抗评估、人工标注、自动化评估器校准、评分、分级以及风险校准的披露。评估对象为8个开放权重系统，使用264条种子提示，覆盖11个危害类别及取自MLCommons越狱分类体系的代表性攻击；响应用AILuminate Assessment Standard v1.4评估，鲁棒性通过"韧性差距"（基线与对抗条件下安全性能的变化量）衡量，并分析评估器可靠性与测量误差来源。
AI.result: 在所有被评估系统与攻击中，不安全响应率从基线条件下的11.08%上升至越狱条件下的18.65%，平均韧性差距为7.57%。可访问系统（accessible systems）表现出更大的平均差距；攻击有效性在不同攻击类别与危害类别之间差异显著。
AI.conclusion: Jailbreak Benchmark v1.0 不仅报告评估结果，还建立了可复现的越狱评估方法论基础，为跨系统、攻击、危害类别及评估方法的比较性研究与未来扩展提供支撑。

title: Bridging Research and Practice: A Systematic Evaluation of Generalist and Dermatology-Specific Models in Clinical Skin Lesion Classification
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables, approved at MICCAI 2026
summary: The application of machine learning to dermatology has grown substantially in recent years, moving beyond proof-of-concept studies toward potential applications. However, clinical dermatology remains a challenging and still open problem. Diagnostic assessment is often ambiguous, and skin lesions exhibit high variability, compounded by differences in acquisition modality, device quality, and patient demographics. These factors hinder the development of robust models suitable for safe and equitable clinical use. To support translation into practice, it is essential to systematically evaluate how contemporary models generalize across heterogeneous data sources. In this work, we benchmark a diverse set of architectures on recent dermatology datasets, spanning dermoscopic images and smartphone-based clinical photographs. We assess the robustness of recent general-purpose and medical vision-language models, as well as foundation models, and compare them against task-specific dermatology classifiers, including embedding-based approaches and convolutional neural networks. Our study provides an evaluation of model performance under distribution shifts, modality changes, and demographic variability. By quantifying the gap between current state-of-the-art models and the requirements of clinical deployment, we aim to contribute to the development of reliable, accessible, and clinically applicable AI systems for dermatology.

AI.tldr: 本文对皮肤科影像任务进行了系统性基准测试，比较通用视觉语言模型、医学视觉语言模型、基础模型与任务专用分类器（含嵌入方法与CNN）在多来源数据集（皮肤镜与手机临床照片）上的泛化能力，评估其在分布偏移、模态变化与人群差异下的鲁棒性，量化当前最优模型与临床部署需求间的差距。
AI.motivation: 皮肤科机器学习已从概念验证走向应用探索，但临床诊断模糊、皮损形态差异大，且采集模态、设备质量与人群构成各异，导致模型鲁棒性与公平性不足，难以安全、公平地落地。为支持临床转化，需系统评估当代模型在异构数据源间的泛化表现。
AI.method: 在近期皮肤科数据集（涵盖皮肤镜图像与智能手机临床照片）上对多类架构进行基准测试：评估通用视觉语言模型、医学视觉语言模型与基础模型的鲁棒性，并与任务专用皮肤科分类器（基于嵌入的方法与卷积神经网络）进行对比，考察分布偏移、模态变化与人口统计学变异条件下的性能。
AI.result: 该研究提供了模型在分布偏移、模态变化与人群差异条件下的性能评估，量化了当前最先进模型与临床部署要求之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统基准测试与差距量化，研究旨在推动可靠、可及且临床可用的皮肤科AI系统发展，为模型的稳健性与公平性评估提供参考。

title: Learning from Repaired Reasoning: Root-Cause-Guided On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses reference solutions as privileged hindsight to supervise student-generated reasoning trajectories. However, reference-based guidance may explain a correct solution without addressing why the student's own reasoning fails. This reasoning mismatch between the guidance provided and the correction needed can encourage the student to borrow correct conclusions while leaving its reasoning errors unresolved. Moreover, applying the same hindsight throughout the trajectory risks a distillation trap, where unnecessary constraints on valid reasoning compete with correction of substantive errors. To address these issues, we propose Root-Cause-Guided On-Policy Distillation (RC-OPD), which uses repairs of the student's own reasoning to provide guidance that addresses its specific errors while building on valid progress. For each failed attempt, RC-OPD locates the earliest substantive error, develops a local correction, and uses the corrected intermediate result as an anchor for the valid prefix. An iterative diagnosis--repair--continuation process tests the repairs through student continuation, identifying further errors within a fixed repair budget. For repair chains that reach a correct answer, root--cause--guided distillation uses failure diagnoses and corrective goals to supervise the erroneous segments, while anchor-guided distillation supports the corresponding valid prefixes with reasoning chains leading to the repaired intermediate results. We evaluate RC-OPD across multiple datasets and model scales. Extensive experiments and analyses show that it mitigates reasoning mismatch and the distillation trap, yielding substantial performance gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出根因引导的在线策略蒸馏（RC-OPD），通过修复学生自身推理中的具体错误来提供指导，缓解推理不匹配与蒸馏陷阱问题，在多个数据集和模型规模上取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 基于参考解答的在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）将参考解作为特权后见之明来监督学生的推理轨迹，但存在两个问题：1）参考指导解释了正确解法，却未针对学生自身推理失败的原因，导致"推理不匹配"，学生可能借用正确结论而推理错误未被纠正；2）全程施加同一后见之明会造成"蒸馏陷阱"，即对有效推理的不必要约束与实质性错误的纠正相互竞争。
