AI.result: 在数学推理和事实问答上，TTCL跨多种模型与任务持续提升准确率与校准。基座模型在八个基准上平均相对准确率提升+40.13%，ECE降低+70.80%；在数学到事实问答迁移设置中，平均相对准确率提升+20.35%，ECE降低+53.83%。
AI.conclusion: TTCL提供了一种无需标签的测试时校准学习方案，可同时改善准确率与校准，并在域偏移（尤其源域校准迁移不佳）时进一步提升已校准模型的表现。

title: Safeguarding Mutual Correction in Source-Free Domain Adaptation via Cut Statistics
summary: Source-Free Domain Adaptation (SFDA) aims to adapt a source-pretrained model to an unlabeled target domain without access to the original source domain. While early single-model approaches rely on self-refinement, they are inherently susceptible to confirmation bias and struggle to correct their own systematic errors. To overcome this limitation, recent methods introduce Vision-Language (ViL) models as external knowledge sources. However, these approaches operate in a largely unidirectional paradigm, using the ViL model primarily to supervise the source-pretrained model. This overlooks a key structural property: the two models exhibit distinct failure modes -- where one produces an incorrect prediction, the other may produce a correct one, creating a natural opportunity for mutual correction within the target domain. Yet, without ground-truth labels, identifying which model is correct on any given sample is non-trivial, and naively exchanging predictions risks propagating errors across models. To address this challenge, we propose SafeCut, a novel approach that leverages the cut statistic as a label-free measure of prediction reliability to gate cross-model supervision. Our approach dynamically controls both the direction and strength of supervision based on relative reliability, selectively amplifying true corrections while suppressing miscorrections on a per-sample basis. We further provide theoretical justification showing that this reliability-gated mechanism guarantees a net-positive correction signal. Extensive experiments across diverse SFDA benchmarks demonstrate that SafeCut achieves state-of-the-art performance, highlighting the effectiveness of safeguarding mutual correction in SFDA via cut statistics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SafeCut，用cut统计量作为无标签可靠性度量，门控视觉语言模型与源预训练模型之间的双向互相监督，实现源无关域适应中的安全互相校正。
AI.motivation: 早期源无关域适应（SFDA）依赖单模型自精炼，易受确认偏差影响、难以纠正系统性错误；近期引入视觉语言（ViL）模型作为外部知识，但呈单向监督范式，忽略了源预训练模型与ViL模型具有不同失效模式、可互补校正的结构特性。难点在于无真实标签时无法判断哪个模型正确，直接交换预测会导致错误跨模型传播。
AI.method: 提出SafeCut：利用cut统计量作为无标签的预测可靠性度量，据此对跨模型监督进行门控；基于两模型相对可靠性动态控制监督的方向与强度，逐样本选择性地放大真实校正、抑制误校正；并给出理论证明，说明该可靠性门控机制可保证净正向的校正信号。
AI.result: 在多个SFDA基准上取得状态最优（state-of-the-art）性能，验证了通过cut统计量保障互相校正的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SafeCut以cut统计量门控的双向互相校正机制，克服了SFDA中单向监督与错误传播的局限，为安全利用ViL模型互补性提供了有效且具理论保障的方案。

title: ChromaGS: Text-Driven Semantic Editing of 4D Gaussian Avatars
summary: We present ChromaGS, a method for real-time, language-guided color editing of animatable 3D Gaussian head avatars. Given a trained animatable avatar, users can instantly modify the color of semantic regions through natural language, with edits applied at render time and no retraining required. Our key insight is to augment each Gaussian primitive with learned soft assignments to semantic regions and decompose colors into region-level base colors and Gaussian-level residuals. This decomposition enables coherent color transfer: modifying a region's base color propagates naturally through all associated Gaussians while preserving fine appearance details encoded in residuals. A two-stage language pipeline translates text instructions into target colors, supporting both absolute specifications and relative adjustments. Unlike generative editing methods that may introduce unintended modifications, our approach provides deterministic, precisely localized semantic control. Experiments demonstrate faithful appearance preservation and intuitive interaction across diverse subjects. Project page and code are available at: https://a-canela.github.io/chromags/

AI.tldr: ChromaGS 提出一种无需重训练的实时语言引导颜色编辑方法，用于可动画 3D 高斯头部头像。其核心是通过高斯原语的语义软分配与颜色分解实现连贯的颜色迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式编辑方法容易引入非预期的修改，难以在保持外观细节的同时实现精确、局部的语义颜色控制，且往往需要重训练或无法实时交互。
AI.method: 为每个高斯原语引入对语义区域的软分配，将颜色分解为区域级基色与高斯级残差；修改区域基色可自然传播至相关高斯，同时残差保留细粒度外观细节；采用两阶段语言流程将文本指令转为目标颜色，支持绝对指定与相对调整；编辑在渲染时应用。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在多样主体上均能忠实保持外观，并提供直观的交互体验；具有确定性、精确定位的语义控制能力。
AI.conclusion: ChromaGS 实现了实时、语言引导的可动画 3D 高斯头部头像颜色编辑，无需重训练且避免生成式编辑的非预期修改，兼顾语义可控性与外观保真度。

title: UniIntervene++: An Adaptive Intervention Agent for Efficient Real-World Reinforcement Learning
comment: Yudong Lin and Haoyuan Deng contributed equally. Ziwei Wang is the corresponding author. Code is available in our \href{https://github.com/dannyyudong/An-Adaptive-Intervention-Agent-for-Efficient-Real-World-Reinforcement-Learning}{GitHub repository}
summary: Online reinforcement learning (RL) enables robot policies to improve through physical interaction, but the assistance they require changes as their competence evolves. Existing intervention strategies based on offline estimates or fixed decision rules can therefore become mismatched to the current policy. To address this, we propose UniIntervene++, an adaptive intervention agent that learns to allocate control between autonomous execution and heterogeneous assisted behaviors during online RL. Specifically, UniIntervene++ first formulates the evolving RL policy, trajectory correction, and a task-structured CodePolicy as Options in a unified semi-Markov decision process and learns their relative values online. Building on this, competence-adaptive intervention periodically probes the RL policy through unassisted execution, keeping control allocation responsive to its evolving capability. Finally, coupled experience learning allows assisted behaviors to improve the RL policy, whose evolving outcomes in turn reshape future intervention decisions. In this way, UniIntervene++ jointly determines when to intervene, how to intervene, and when to return control as the RL policy improves. Across five real-world manipulation tasks, UniIntervene++ achieves an average success rate of 89.67%, outperforming all baselines by at least 6 percentage points, while reducing human intervention to 0.77%, a relative reduction of at least 94.6% from the best baseline. Code is available in our \href{https://github.com/dannyyudong/An-Adaptive-Intervention-Agent-for-Efficient-Real-World-Reinforcement-Learning}{GitHub repository}.

AI.tldr: 提出 UniIntervene++，一种自适应干预智能体，在在线强化学习中动态分配自主执行与多种辅助行为之间的控制权，在五项真实操作任务上平均成功率达 89.67%，人工干预降至 0.77%。
AI.motivation: 在线强化学习依赖物理交互提升机器人策略，而策略能力随训练演进，所需辅助程度也在变化。基于离线估计或固定决策规则的现有干预策略易与当前策略能力失配，导致干预过度或不足。
AI.method: 将演进的 RL 策略、轨迹修正与任务结构化的 CodePolicy 统一建模为半马尔可夫决策过程中的 Options，并在线学习其相对价值；在此基础上提出能力自适应干预，通过无辅助执行周期性探测 RL 策略，使控制分配随其能力变化而调整；同时采用耦合经验学习，使辅助行为改进 RL 策略、策略的演进结果又反过来重塑未来干预决策，从而联合决定何时干预、如何干预以及何时交还控制权。
AI.result: 在五项真实世界操作任务上平均成功率达 89.67%，较所有基线至少高出 6 个百分点；人工干预率降至 0.77%，相较最优基线相对降低至少 94.6%。
AI.conclusion: UniIntervene++ 通过在统一半马尔可夫决策框架下在线学习干预价值，并结合能力自适应探测与耦合经验学习，实现了与策略能力相匹配的动态干预，显著提升真实操作任务的成功率并大幅降低人工干预，验证了自适应干预在真实世界在线 RL 中的有效性。代码已开源。

title: Learning from Evolving Errors: Adaptive Iterative Repair for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) supplies dense token-level feedback on trajectories sampled from the student's own policy, a richer training signal than the outcome-level rewards of reinforcement learning. This feedback comes from a teacher conditioned on a full reference solution unavailable to the student. The reference solution specifies the target but not how to move from the student's current error toward it, creating a solution-conditioned shortcut risk. We introduce AIR-OPD, an adaptive iterative repair framework for on-policy distillation that provides error-to-repair supervision. Given a failed response, a guidance generator synthesizes repair guidance for the current error. The student samples an on-policy retry with this guidance. If the retry remains incorrect, the generator produces new repair guidance for the newly observed error. At each round, a fixed teacher receives the guidance as privileged context and supervises the student on an error-aligned region of its latest failed response. Outcome-aware stage weighting favors early repair stages and credits stages whose immediate retry passes verification. We train AIR-OPD on the DAPO-Math-17K dataset and evaluate on AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25, alongside out-of-distribution tests on MMLU-Pro and GPQA. We examine two guidance sources, self-guidance from the current student policy and external guidance from a larger model. For both Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, AIR-OPD attains the best mathematical-reasoning averages, improving over the strongest baseline by up to 3.6 points, while preserving base-model performance on the out-of-distribution benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出AIR-OPD自适应迭代修复框架，通过错误到修复的引导监督解决on-policy自蒸馏的解条件捷径风险，在数学推理上平均提升最高3.6分且保持OOD性能。
AI.motivation: on-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）在student自身策略采样轨迹上提供密集的token级反馈，比RL的结果级奖励信号更丰富。但该反馈来自以完整参考解为条件的teacher，而参考解对学生不可得。参考解只指定目标，不说明如何从student当前错误移动到目标，因此产生"解条件捷径"（solution-conditioned shortcut）风险，即学生可能直接拟合参考解而跳过真正的纠错推理过程。
AI.method: 提出AIR-OPD（adaptive iterative repair on-policy distillation）框架，提供错误到修复的监督。给定失败响应，引导生成器针对当前错误合成修复引导；student基于该引导进行on-policy重试；若仍错误，生成器针对新观察到的错误再生成新引导，迭代进行。每轮中固定teacher将引导作为特权上下文，在student最新失败响应的错误对齐区域上进行监督。采用结果感知的阶段加权，偏好早期修复阶段，并对即时重试通过验证的阶段给予信用。引导来源考察两种：student策略的自引导与更大模型的外部引导。
AI.result: 在DAPO-Math-17K上训练，在AIME24、AIME25、HMMT25评测，并在MMLU-Pro与GPQA上做分布外测试。对Qwen3-4B与Qwen3-8B，AIR-OPD均取得最佳数学推理平均成绩，较最强基线提升最高3.6分，同时保持基模型在OOD基准上的性能。
AI.conclusion: AIR-OPD通过错误到修复的迭代引导监督，有效缓解解条件捷径问题，在Qwen3-4B/8B上实现数学推理的稳定提升，且不损害分布外泛化能力。

title: PLCWorld: Benchmarking LLM-Generated PLC Programs in Closed-Loop Plant Simulation
summary: Programmable logic controllers (PLCs) coordinate industrial equipment by reading sensor inputs and issuing control commands. Evaluating whether large language model (LLM)-generated PLC programs satisfy task requirements and safety constraints requires observing how their commands affect device and workpiece states. We introduce PLCWorld, a common closed-loop execution environment and benchmark that couples Structured Text (ST) execution with simulated plant responses and sensor feedback. Grounded in control relations identified in industrial PLC programs and engineering documentation, PLCWorld contains 100 synthetic tasks and 473 registered task-condition pairs across Motion Control and Material Handling, with difficulty defined by control-dependency scope. A common protocol reports Task Success and Safety Violation separately. Validation combines practitioner review, reference and alternative programs, targeted counterexamples, specification-evaluator alignment checks, and comparisons with independent ST runtimes. Reference and alternative programs satisfy their applicable cases, while all 542 targeted counterexamples activate their designated evaluator rules under at least one registered condition. Execution Gap relates submission-profile acceptance to subsequent task failure or observed Safety Violation. Across the constructed task groups, direct GPT-5.5 achieves 82.70% Task Success on Easy cases but 25.10% on Hard cases. Evaluations of six LLMs and four adapted generation-and-verification workflows further expose differences between completion, safety, and generation cost. Our code, simulation environment, benchmark tasks, and baseline implementations are publicly available at https://yunji0516.github.io/PLCWorld/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PLCWorld——一个将结构化文本（ST）执行与仿真被控对象响应及传感器反馈耦合的闭环执行环境与基准，用于评估 LLM 生成 PLC 程序的任务成功与安全性。
AI.motivation: 评估 LLM 生成的 PLC 程序是否满足任务需求与安全约束，需要观察其控制指令如何影响设备与工件状态；现有评测缺乏闭环执行、状态反馈与安全指标的统一定义。
AI.method: 基于工业 PLC 程序与工程文档中的控制关系构建 PLCWorld，包含 100 个合成任务、473 个已注册的任务-条件对，覆盖运动控制与物料搬运两类，难度由控制依赖范围定义；采用统一协议分别报告任务成功与安全违规；验证手段包括从业者评审、参考与替代程序、定向反例、规范-评估器一致性检查，以及与独立 ST 运行时的对比。
AI.result: 参考与替代程序均满足其适用用例；全部 542 个定向反例在至少一个注册条件下触发其指定评估器规则；提出 Execution Gap 指标关联提交合格性与后续任务失败或安全违规。在构建的任务组上，直接使用 GPT-5.5 在 Easy 上任务成功率为 82.70%，Hard 上为 25.10%；对 6 个 LLM 与 4 种改造后的生成-验证流程的评测揭示了完成度、安全性与生成成本之间的差异。
AI.conclusion: PLCWorld 提供了可复现的闭环 PLC 评测基础设施，代码、仿真环境、基准任务与基线实现已公开，可用于系统刻画 LLM 在工业控制代码生成中的能力与安全边界。

title: Corrupted but Correct: Why Vision-Language Models Lie to Themselves Internally
comment: Accepted at the VLM4RWD Workshop (Grounded and Faithful Vision-Language Models for Real-World Deployment), NeurIPS 2026. 8 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: A targeted adversarial perturbation can drive a vision-language model's (VLM's) teacher-forced training loss for a fixed target caption to near zero, yet the same model, allowed to generate freely, produces the original, correct description with no trace of the target. We call this dissociation the train/inference gap, and give it a precise mechanistic account on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct using a controlled two-stage PGD attack on 200 held-out COCO images. First, we show that image-level pixel statistics, including a correctly re-implemented, texture-based attackability measure from the CNN robustness literature, have essentially no predictive power over which images are corrupted (best predictor r=-0.050, p=0.484; ridge regression R^2=0.069). Second, using the logit lens, we localise the gap to a single autoregressive step: the rank of the target token, conditioned on the correct first token already being generated, is fixed at exactly 3,488 out of 152,064 vocabulary entries for every image and every condition, with zero variance. Third, tracking target-token rank across all 28 LLM decoder layers reveals that the visual encoder corrupts every image's representation by a comparable margin regardless of eventual outcome, but the language model decoder then differentially arbitrates: amplifying the corrupted signal for susceptible images and actively suppressing it, past its clean-image baseline, for resistant ones (p<0.001, rank-biserial r=0.579). A linear probe on the merger hidden state separates these two outcomes with AUC=0.858, though we flag a circularity concern in this estimate. Together these results argue that adversarial robustness in autoregressive VLMs is substantially a property of the language decoder's prior, not the visual encoder, with direct implications for where faithfulness evaluations and defenses for deployed VLM systems should be targeted.

AI.tldr: 对Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct的两阶段PGD攻击揭示了VLM的train/inference gap：教师强制损失可被压至近零，但自由生成仍输出正确描述；该差距定位于单个自回归步，且主要由语言解码器而非视觉编码器决定。
AI.motivation: 作者注意到一个反常现象：定向对抗扰动可使VLM在教师强制下的训练损失对固定目标caption降至近零，但同一模型自由生成时却给出原本正确的描述，完全不含目标痕迹。作者将此现象命名为train/inference gap，并试图给出精确的机制性解释，同时回答对抗鲁棒性究竟源于视觉编码器还是语言解码器这一问题。
AI.method: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct上，对200张留出的COCO图像实施可控的两阶段PGD攻击。分析手段包括：(1)检验图像级像素统计量与基于纹理的可攻击性度量对哪些图像被污染的预测力（含正确复现的CNN鲁棒性文献度量、岭回归）；(2)使用logit lens将差距定位到具体自回归步，考察给定正确首token条件下目标token的排名；(3)跨全部28层LLM解码器追踪目标token排名，比较视觉编码器与语言解码器的差异化仲裁；(4)在merger隐状态上训练线性探针区分两种结果。
AI.result: (1)像素统计量几乎无预测力：最佳预测因子r=-0.050, p=0.484；岭回归R^2=0.069。(2)差距可定位到单个自回归步：在已生成正确首token的条件下，目标token排名对所有图像、所有条件恒为152,064词表中的第3,488位，方差为零。(3)视觉编码器对所有图像的表示造成相近程度的破坏（与最终结果无关），而语言解码器进行差异化仲裁：对易感图像放大被破坏的信号，对抵抗图像则将其主动压制至低于干净图像基线（p<0.001, rank-biserial r=0.579）。(4)merger隐状态上的线性探针以AUC=0.858区分两种结果，但作者提示该估计存在循环性隐患。
AI.conclusion: 自回归VLM的对抗鲁棒性在很大程度上是语言解码器先验的性质，而非视觉编码器的性质。这对部署型VLM系统的忠实性评估与防御应针对何处具有直接启示。

title: Less Decoder is More Encoder: Geometric Representation Learning from Novel View Synthesis
summary: This paper examines the role of Novel View Synthesis (NVS) in geometric representation learning. In principle, NVS should reason about 3D scene structure, thereby enabling transferable multi-view geometric representations. Yet, existing encoder-based NVS methods yield poor representations. This is not because of a lack of supervisory signal, but rather due to inconspicuous architectural choices: \textit{spatially expressive decoders} that dilute representational capabilities of the scene encoder, and \textit{low-level pixel-space targets} that hinder feature learning. We present SNAP, a self-supervised encoder-decoder transformer that addresses both through a pose-conditioned local decoder and a latent-space reconstruction objective. SNAP is task agnostic, and we show that it is competitive with special-purpose geometry-supervised methods. SNAP also performs competitively against self-supervised representations across five tasks: visual localization, pose estimation, point correspondence, depth estimation, and robot manipulation. Remarkably, SNAP's patch features exhibit emergent viewpoint invariance that approaches heavily supervised models despite lower compute and data budgets. Under camera shifts where standard 2D representations collapse, SNAP degrades more gracefully, revealing that restricting decoder expressivity actively prevents the suppression of transferable geometric structure. https://snap-nvs.github.io

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SNAP，一个自监督编码器-解码器 Transformer，通过姿态条件局部解码器与潜空间重建目标改进新视角合成中的几何表示学习，在多项任务上达到与专用几何监督方法相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 新视角合成（NVS）原则上应推理 3D 场景结构，从而获得可迁移的多视角几何表示，但现有基于编码器的 NVS 方法学到的表示很差。作者指出原因并非监督信号不足，而是架构选择问题：空间表达能力过强的解码器削弱了场景编码器的表示能力，以及低层次像素空间目标阻碍了特征学习。
AI.method: 提出 SNAP，一种自监督编码器-解码器 Transformer，包含两个关键设计：一是姿态条件局部解码器（pose-conditioned local decoder），限制解码器空间表达能力；二是潜空间重建目标（latent-space reconstruction objective），替代像素空间目标。方法任务无关。
AI.result: SNAP 与专用几何监督方法具有竞争力，并在五个任务（视觉定位、姿态估计、点对应、深度估计、机器人操作）上优于/媲美自监督表示方法。其 patch 特征展现出涌现的视角不变性，接近重监督模型，尽管计算和数据预算更低；在相机位移下，标准 2D 表示崩溃时 SNAP 退化更平缓。
AI.conclusion: 限制解码器表达能力能够主动防止可迁移几何结构被抑制，说明 NVS 中表示质量差主要源于架构与目标设计而非监督信号缺失。

title: Conditional Capacity and Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Particle Transformers
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to the ML4PS 2026 workshop
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models can increase parameter capacity without proportionally increasing active computation, but it is unclear how this trade-off behaves in particle-physics transformers. We study dense and MoE Particle Transformers on 188-class JetClass-II, varying expert count, routing capacity, top-K, and auxiliary loss. We find that, when token dropping is avoided, top-1 MoE models improve over the dense baseline at nearly unchanged nominal forward compute, while further increasing the number of stored experts produces little additional accuracy gain. Activating multiple experts per token yields additional predictive improvements at higher computational cost. Routing analyses show that expert assignments become more strongly associated with particle identity and kinematics in some configurations, but this structure does not increase monotonically with classification performance. These results highlight the need to distinguish stored parameter capacity, active computation, routing capacity, and routing organization when evaluating sparse expert models for jet classification. Code and experiment configurations are available at https://github.com/kpendiyala/MPT.

AI.tldr: 在JetClass-II上对比稠密与MoE Particle Transformer，发现避免token dropping时top-1 MoE以几乎不变的标称前向计算量超过稠密基线，继续增加存储专家数收益甚微；多专家激活可进一步提升预测性能但计算开销更高；路由结构与分类性能并非单调相关。
AI.motivation: MoE可在不按比例增加激活计算量的前提下扩大参数量，但这一权衡在粒子物理Transformer中的具体表现尚不明确，因此需要系统研究稠密与MoE Particle Transformer在喷注分类任务上的行为。
AI.method: 在188类的JetClass-II数据集上研究稠密与MoE Particle Transformer，系统变化专家数量、路由容量、top-K以及辅助损失等配置，并进行路由分析，考察专家分配与粒子身份及运动学特征的关联。
AI.result: 避免token dropping时，top-1 MoE在标称前向计算量几乎不变的情况下优于稠密基线；进一步增加存储专家数带来的精度提升很小；每token激活多个专家可在更高计算成本下获得额外预测提升；专家分配在某些配置下与粒子身份和运动学关联更强，但这种结构并不随分类性能单调增强。
AI.conclusion: 评估用于喷注分类的稀疏专家模型时，需要区分存储参数容量、激活计算量、路由容量与路由组织这四个维度；代码与实验配置已公开。

title: Personalized Automatic Speech Recognition for a Dysarthric and Tracheostomic Speaker using Artificial Conversations
comment: 8 pages, three figures, to be published in IEEE Speech Language Technology workshop 2026
summary: This work presents an automatic speech recognition (ASR) system personalized for a Czech speaker with a permanent tracheal stoma and severe dysarthria rendering their speech unintelligible to untrained listeners. We release a public dataset containing 33 annotated hours of the speaker's speech, collected using a novel "artificial conversation" protocol designed for high engagement and dialogue realism. We propose a multi-stage training pipeline based on Whisper Base: fine-tuning on standard Czech speech, acoustically simulated tracheostomic speech, and the speaker's data. We evaluate the system across three near real-time scenarios: scripted conversations, question answering, and spontaneous dialogue, achieving a 50\% relative reduction in Character Error Rate compared to Whisper Base baseline and surpassing the average recognition accuracy of their assistants in acoustic recognition of isolated utterances. We demonstrate that even for severely impeded speech, a helpful ASR is achievable, as evidenced by the quantitative results and the feedback from the speaker.

AI.tldr: 该工作为一名带有永久气管造口、严重构音障碍的捷克语使用者构建了个性化ASR系统，公开33小时标注数据，并基于Whisper Base提出多阶段训练流程，在近实时场景下CER相对降低50%，超越其人工助手对孤立话语的平均识别准确率。
AI.motivation: 严重构音障碍伴随气管造口使语音对未训练听者完全不可懂，现有通用ASR难以适用；同时缺乏针对该类语音的公开标注数据，因此需要一个可个性化、近实时可用且能真正帮助该使用者的ASR系统。
AI.method: 发布33小时标注的说话人语音数据集，采集自新型"人工对话"协议以保证参与度与对话真实性；基于Whisper Base提出多阶段训练流程：先在标准捷克语语音上微调，再在声学模拟的气管造口语音上微调，最后在该说话人数据上微调；在脚本对话、问答和自发对话三种近实时场景下评估。
AI.result: 相比Whisper Base基线，字符错误率（CER）相对降低50%；在孤立话语的声学识别上，超过其人工助手的平均识别准确率；说话人反馈亦为正面。
AI.conclusion: 即使对于严重受损的语音，通过个性化数据与分阶段微调也能实现有实用价值的ASR，定量结果与使用者反馈共同支持这一结论。

title: Preserving Anatomical Continuity: Three-Stage Pipeline for Colon Segmentation in 3D Abdominal CT Scans
summary: Accurate colon segmentation from CT images is essential for colorectal disease analysis, yet deep learning based methods often produce disconnected predictions due to complex anatomy. This study introduces a three-stage, topology-preserving segmentation pipeline to address this issue. The first stage performs initial deep learning-based segmentation, followed by centreline bridging to reconnect disjoint regions and a reconstruction stage to refine continuity. Evaluations on TotalSegmentator and RAOS datasets using overlap, distance and topology-based metrics demonstrate improved structural consistency while maintaining segmentation accuracy. The proposed method enhances topological integrity, enabling more reliable colon segmentation for clinical and research applications.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种三阶段、保持拓扑结构的结肠CT分割流程，通过深度学习初分割、中心线桥接与重建，解决预测结果断裂问题，实现更可靠的结肠分割。
AI.motivation: 从CT图像中准确分割结肠对结直肠疾病分析至关重要，但复杂解剖结构导致基于深度学习的方法常产生不连通的预测结果，拓扑完整性不足。
AI.method: 提出三阶段、保持拓扑的分割流程：第一阶段进行基于深度学习的初始分割；随后采用中心线桥接重新连接不连通区域；最后通过重建阶段细化连续性。
AI.result: 在TotalSegmentator和RAOS数据集上，使用重叠度、距离及拓扑类指标进行评估，结果显示结构一致性得到改善，同时保持了分割精度。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法提升了拓扑完整性，使结肠分割在临床与研究应用中更加可靠。

title: MuonIO: Principled Norm-Aware Descent for Embedding Tables and Language Model Heads
summary: The Muon optimizer derives its update rule for hidden linear layers by solving a local linearization of the loss penalized by the spectral norm, motivated by an RMS-stability argument for dense linear layers. Standard Muon implementations, however, exclude the input (embedding table) and output (language model head) layers from this principled treatment, for which they use AdamW instead. We present MuonIO, a single Muon-style update for both of these layers. For the language model head $\mathbf{L} \in \mathbb{R}^{V \times d}$, we motivate the use of the $2\to\infty$ operator norm, due to the Lipschitz continuity of the softmax output geometry, while for the embedding table $\mathbf{E} \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times V}$, we draw on the $1 \to 2$ operator norm, based on the one-hot input geometry identified by Bernstein & Newhouse (2025). The identity $\lVert\mathbf{L}\rVert_{2\to\infty}=\lVert\mathbf{L}^\top\rVert_{1\to2}$ then puts both matrices in the same vocabulary-oriented geometry: MuonIO applies a single normalized-vector rule, which appears as column normalization for $\mathbf{E}$ and row normalization for $\mathbf{L}$. Empirical evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, with MuonIO reducing I/O optimizer state memory by 50% and I/O update FLOPs by $\sim$46% compared to Muon for 1B LLaMA pretraining on C4, while also improving validation perplexity.

AI.tldr: MuonIO 为 Muon 优化器提出统一的输入/输出层更新规则，对输出头采用 2→∞ 算子范数、对嵌入表采用 1→2 算子范数，并利用范数恒等式统一为向量归一化规则，在 1B LLaMA 预训练中减少 I/O 优化器状态内存 50%、更新 FLOPs 约 46%，同时改善验证困惑度。
AI.motivation: 标准 Muon 仅对隐藏线性层使用其基于谱范数惩罚损失局部线性化的原理性更新，而输入嵌入层和输出语言模型头仍使用 AdamW，缺乏理论一致性，且 AdamW 对这两层会带来较大的优化器状态内存与计算开销。
AI.method: 针对语言模型头 L∈R^{V×d}，基于 softmax 输出几何的 Lipschitz 连续性引入 2→∞ 算子范数；针对嵌入表 E∈R^{d×V}，基于 one-hot 输入几何引入 1→2 算子范数。利用恒等式 ‖L‖_{2→∞}=‖L^T‖_{1→2}，将二者统一到面向词表的同一几何，从而用单一归一化向量规则实现：对 E 作列归一化，对 L 作行归一化。
AI.result: 在 C4 上进行 1B LLaMA 预训练时，MuonIO 相比 Muon 将 I/O 优化器状态内存降低 50%，I/O 更新 FLOPs 减少约 46%，同时提升了验证困惑度。
AI.conclusion: MuonIO 将 Muon 的原理性更新扩展到输入与输出层，用统一算子范数几何取代 AdamW，在保持甚至提升性能的同时显著降低内存与计算开销，为 Muon 提供了更一致的端到端优化方案。

title: DyadMem: A Long-Term Memory Benchmark of How Agents Work with Users
summary: Long-term agents must remember not only what is true about a user, but also how a particular agent should work with that user as their shared history evolves. Existing benchmarks primarily supervise user facts and preferences or experience reusable across users, leaving this relationship-specific agent memory implicit. Additionally, most prior works measure the model solely with final-answer QA over long interaction histories, making the assessment still incomplete and unreliable. To this end, we introduce DyadMem with the proposed new definition User-conditioned Relational Agent Memory (URAM). DyadMem jointly annotates user-side memory and URAM along the same multi-session trajectories, resulting in 6 memory categories. To summarize, it includes 3,065 episodes, 50,961 sessions, and 61,210 QA instances, with extensive session-level Capture and Update gold annotations, query-level Recall support, and two QA settings: Gold-Memory and Full-Pipeline. Across 16 open-weight and 4 proprietary models, Gold-Memory QA is consistently strong, yet Full-Pipeline QA drops sharply. Such a gap explicitly supports our fine-grained evaluation design. Additionally, several quantitative results further reveal low Capture recall, incomplete Recall, and unsafe-deletion issues arising from even the frontier LLMs. We further conduct a rigorous experiment to validate the effectiveness of our URAM and observe the positive effects for all 20 models. In summary, DyadMem is a dual-domain, full-pipeline memory benchmark with extensive annotation efforts for advancing the domain's development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DyadMem，一个面向长期智能体的双域、全流程记忆基准，并定义新概念 User-conditioned Relational Agent Memory (URAM)，同时标注用户侧记忆与关系侧记忆，配套 Capture、Update、Recall 及两种 QA 设置的细粒度评测。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要监督用户事实与偏好，或跨用户可复用的经验，导致"特定智能体应如何与该用户协作"的关系型记忆被隐含处理；同时多数工作仅用长历史下的最终答案 QA 进行评估，评价不完整且不可靠。
AI.method: 提出 URAM 定义并构建 DyadMem：在同一多会话轨迹上联合标注用户侧记忆与关系型智能体记忆，共 6 类记忆；包含 3,065 个 episode、50,961 个 session、61,210 条 QA，具备 session 级 Capture 与 Update 金标、query 级 Recall 支持，以及 Gold-Memory 与 Full-Pipeline 两种 QA 设置。在 16 个开源权重模型与 4 个专有模型上评测，并做严谨实验验证 URAM 有效性。
AI.result: Gold-Memory QA 表现稳定强劲，但 Full-Pipeline QA 显著下降，说明细粒度评估设计的必要性；量化结果显示即使是前沿 LLM 也存在 Capture 召回低、Recall 不完整与不安全删除问题。URAM 的有效性实验在全部 20 个模型上均观察到正向效果。
AI.conclusion: DyadMem 是一个双域、全流程的记忆基准，凭借充分的标注工作推动长期智能体记忆领域发展。

title: A Vision-Language Model (VLM)-based Pipeline for End-to-End Procedural Modeling of Field-Grown Maize from Point Clouds
summary: Editable 3D models of field-grown crops support high-throughput phenotyping and in silico breeding trials, but building them from scanned point clouds requires organ-level segmentation and fitting. Procedural generators can turn an organ-level parameter set into an analysis-suitable 3D model, but obtaining that set requires hours of manual tuning per plant or segmentation models trained on species-specific labels. We present an automated pipeline that reconstructs procedural maize models from raw 3D point clouds without manual tuning or species-specific training data. A multimodal vision-language model (VLM) annotates leaf midlines in rendered orthographic views. Deterministic geometric algorithms back-project the annotations onto the point cloud, merge them into 3D leaves by cross-view consensus, and grow the midlines to full blades on an orientation-weighted surface graph. Measured organ parameters populate a plant descriptor for a Non-Uniform Rational B-Spline (NURBS)-based procedural model generator. Each leaf surface is then refined against its scan points by differentiable NURBS fitting. The pipeline reached a median whole-plant Chamfer distance of 5.4 mm on 100 genotypically diverse field-grown maize plants from the MaizeField3D dataset. The reconstructions were closer to the scans than those of an earlier semi-automated pipeline based on manual annotations. The pipeline recovered 1,017 of 1,023 (99.4%) curated reference leaves at an intersection-over-union of at least 0.5 without using those labels as input. These results show that VLM annotations become usable organ-level measurements when downstream geometric stages can correct them. This makes automated generation of editable 3D plant assets feasible at the scale of modern phenotyping experiments.

AI.tldr: 提出全自动流程，从原始3D点云重建玉米程序化3D模型，无需人工调参或物种特定训练数据；在100株田间玉米上实现5.4 mm中位整株Chamfer距离，并恢复99.4%参考叶片。
AI.motivation: 可编辑的田间作物3D模型对高通量表型与计算机育种试验至关重要，但从扫描点云构建需器官级分割与拟合。程序化生成器可将器官级参数集转为可分析模型，而获取该参数集需每株数小时人工调参，或依赖物种特定标注训练的模型。
AI.method: 多模态视觉语言模型（VLM）在正交渲染视图中标注叶中线；确定性几何算法将标注反投影到点云，经跨视图一致性合并为3D叶片，并在方向加权表面图上将中线生长为完整叶面；测得器官参数构建植物描述符，驱动基于NURBS的程序化模型生成器；最后通过可微NURBS拟合将每片叶面相对扫描点细化。
AI.result: 在MaizeField3D数据集100株基因型多样田间玉米上，整株Chamfer距离中位数5.4 mm，优于早期基于人工标注的半自动流程；在未使用参考标签作为输入的情况下，以IoU≥0.5恢复1,017/1,023（99.4%）精选参考叶片。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，当下游几何阶段能校正标注时，VLM标注可转化为可用的器官级测量，使可编辑3D植物资产的自动生成在现代表型实验规模上可行。

title: OPD Before RL: Warm-Starting Rubric-Based RL with On-Policy Distillation
summary: Many useful language-model tasks cannot be evaluated by exact outcome verification. Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) addresses this issue by scoring open-ended responses against explicit criteria. However, because the reward is assigned after the complete response, the training signal does not directly identify which individual decisions contributed to the final score. We propose a two-stage training framework that uses rubrics first as privileged teacher context for dense token-level supervision, then as rewards for further RL. In the first stage, rubric-privileged on-policy distillation (RP-OPD), a student without access to the rubric matches a rubric-aware teacher's next-token distributions at student-generated prefixes. In the second stage, RL directly optimizes the rubric reward and improves beyond the observed distillation plateau. We evaluate the framework on health and science tasks using open-weight models. Across HealthBench, ResearchQA, and RubricHub Science, we compare post-training methods and vary the amount of SFT or RP-OPD training before RL, finding that our two-stage framework achieves the highest scores among the methods evaluated. RP-OPD + RL shows limited signs of reward hacking on RubricHub Science, whereas the SFT + RL baseline increasingly receives high rewards for claims of rubric compliance without providing the required content. These findings support using rubrics to guide on-policy distillation before applying rubric-based RL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两阶段训练框架：先用评分标准作为特权教师上下文进行密集的token级监督（RP-OPD），再用评分标准作为奖励进行强化学习（RL），在健康与科学任务上取得所评估方法中的最高分且奖励作弊现象有限。
AI.motivation: 开放式语言模型任务难以通过精确的结果验证来评估。基于评分标准（rubric）的强化学习虽可用显式标准打分，但奖励在完整回答之后才给出，训练信号无法直接指出哪些具体决策影响了最终得分，监督信号稀疏。
AI.method: 两阶段框架。第一阶段RP-OPD（rubric-privileged on-policy distillation）：以评分标准作为特权教师上下文，让无评分标准访问的学生模型在学生自生成的prefix上匹配具备评分标准感知能力的教师的下一token分布，实现密集token级监督。第二阶段：直接用评分标准奖励进行RL，突破蒸馏平台期。在HealthBench、ResearchQA、RubricHub Science上，使用开放权重模型比较不同后训练方法，并改变RL前的SFT或RP-OPD训练量。
AI.result: 该两阶段框架在所评估方法中得分最高；RP-OPD + RL在RubricHub Science上奖励作弊迹象有限，而SFT + RL基线越来越多地因声称符合评分标准却未提供所需内容而获得高奖励。
AI.conclusion: 支持在应用基于评分标准的RL之前，先用评分标准引导on-policy蒸馏，以缓解奖励作弊并提升开放任务的训练效果。

title: Verifiable, Articulable, and Tacit Components of Preference
comment: 15 pages main text, 14 pages of references, 107-page appendix (136 pages total); 15 figures, 48 tables; 213 references
summary: What makes a short story gripping; a news article newsworthy; or a math proof elegant? These constructs resist articulation or verification; their meaning is at least partially tacit. However, modern AI models are improved primarily via articulated constitutions, rubrics and verifiers (i.e. in RLAIF and RLVR); tacit components of preferences are typically understudied. We introduce a large, labeled preference dataset CreativePreferences, containing 2.8M texts labeled by 317M human preference judgments across 7 creative domains, with 42 benchmark tasks. We model these labels with executable programs, rubric banks and densely trained models (V, A and VAT, respectively). We observe robust articulability gaps, VAT-VA; and verifiability gaps, VAT-V; we estimate upper and lower bounds for each gap with a novel measurement approach that discovers articulable and verifiable metrics, identifies spurious variables and estimates the value of undiscovered metrics using capture-recapture. These gaps occur across all domains, even in domains traditionally treated as fully verifiable: correctness-centered domains (i.e. mathematics and software engineering) and claim- and novelty-centric domains (i.e. news, patents, peer review). The size of the gap varies based on domain (e.g. peer review and creative writing have the largest articulability gaps) and widens as more people take part in the judgment, consistent with Collins' collective tacit knowledge. We show two consequences: (1) on human generations, the full model more closely matches human preferences, often in disagreement with articulated criteria, and (2) in an analogy to Goodhart's law, articulating preference shifts it away from the tacit dimension. Articulability and verifiability gaps are consequential; we give recommendations on when tasks can be prompted; how learning mechanisms might improve; and when to leave judgments with humans.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了含280万文本、3.17亿人类偏好判断的创意偏好数据集CreativePreferences，覆盖7个创意领域、42个基准任务，并发现普遍存在"可表述性差距"（VAT-VA）与"可验证性差距"（VAT-V），二者随参与判断人数增加而扩大，且表述偏好会使其偏离隐性维度（类似Goodhart定律）。
AI.motivation: 现代AI模型主要通过显式化的宪法、评分细则与验证器（如RLAIF、RLVR）改进，但偏好中"只可意会不可言传"的隐性成分（如故事吸引力、新闻价值、证明优雅性）难以被表述或验证，且长期缺乏系统研究。作者希望量化这类隐性偏好与显式标准之间的差距及其后果。
AI.method: 1) 构建大规模标注偏好数据集CreativePreferences（2.8M文本、317M人类偏好判断、7个创意领域、42个任务）；2) 用可执行程序、评分细则库和稠密训练模型分别建模，记为V、A、VAT；3) 定义并测量可表述性差距（VAT-VA）与可验证性差距（VAT-V）；4) 提出新测量方法：发现可表述/可验证指标、识别伪变量、用捕获-再捕获法估计未发现指标的价值，从而给出差距上下界。
AI.result: 两类差距在所有领域均出现，包括传统上被视为完全可验证的领域（数学、软件工程等以正确性为中心的领域，以及新闻、专利、同行评审等以主张与新颖性为中心的领域）；差距大小随领域变化（同行评审与创意写作的可表述性差距最大）；参与判断人数越多，差距越大，符合Collins的集体隐性知识理论。此外：(1) 在人类生成文本上，完整模型VAT更贴近人类偏好，且常与显式标准相悖；(2) 类比Goodhart定律，显式表述偏好会使其偏离隐性维度。
AI.conclusion: 可表述性与可验证性差距具有实质影响：作者据此给出建议——何时可用提示完成任务、学习机制应如何改进、以及何时应将判断保留给人类。

title: UniDynamics: Event-RGB Fusion for Unified Future 4D Dynamic Scene Generation
summary: We propose UniDynamics, a diffusion-based framework for future 4D dynamic scenes (RGB, depth, and optical flow) generation from a single event-RGB pair, without requiring long histories or control priors as in existing methods, while explicitly modeling future motion fields. The core idea is to leverage event streams to offer an alternative motion prior for single-RGB extrapolation, and to enforce geometric and motion constraints throughout generation via multimodal modeling. Specifically, we design an Event Latent Enhancement (ELE) module to align and enhance event latents into diffusion-injectable conditioning features, providing robust initial motion priors and reliable texture/structure cues. We further introduce a Perceptual Dynamics Space (PDS) embedded in the multi-scale U-Net, which decouples and adaptively interacts depth and flow while continuously feeding back constraints to appearance features, improving geometric-motion consistency for physically plausible and spatiotemporally coherent prediction. Experiments on VKitti2 and DSEC demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, producing high-quality, temporally coherent, and 4D-consistent future predictions, especially under challenging high-speed motion blur.

AI.tldr: UniDynamics：基于扩散的框架，从单对事件-RGB输入生成未来4D动态场景（RGB、深度、光流），无需长历史或控制先验，并显式建模未来运动场。
AI.motivation: 现有方法生成未来动态场景依赖长历史序列或控制先验，单RGB外推场景下运动先验不足、几何与运动一致性难以保证。
AI.method: 核心思想是利用事件流为单RGB外推提供替代运动先验，并通过多模态建模在生成过程中施加几何与运动约束。具体设计两个模块：(1) Event Latent Enhancement (ELE)，将事件潜变量对齐并增强为可注入扩散模型的条件特征，提供鲁棒初始运动先验与纹理/结构线索；(2) Perceptual Dynamics Space (PDS)，嵌入多尺度U-Net，解耦并自适应交互深度与光流，同时持续向外观特征反馈约束。
AI.result: 在VKitti2和DSEC数据集上取得state-of-the-art性能，生成高质量、时间一致、4D一致的未来预测，尤其在高速度运动模糊等挑战场景下表现优异。
AI.conclusion: UniDynamics通过事件先验与多模态几何-运动约束的扩散建模，实现了无需长历史和控制先验的单RGB 4D动态场景预测，验证了事件流作为运动先验的有效性。

title: Structural-Functional Brain Connectivity Generation via Multimodal Hypergraph-based Flow Matching
summary: Structural connectivity (SC) and functional connectivity (FC) provide complementary information on interactions between brain regions and are widely used in neuroimaging studies of neuropsychiatric disorders. Generative modelling can alleviate the scarcity of large-scale paired SC-FC data, but existing approaches typically use pairwise graphs that capture only dyadic interactions and often generate SC and FC independently, limiting preservation of higher-order structure-function relationships. We propose a Multimodal Hypergraph Flow Matching (MHG-FM) framework for joint SC-FC connectivity generation and cross-modal translation. MHG-FM constructs modality-specific hypergraphs, learns higher-order representations with Hypergraph Neural Network (HGNN) encoders, and performs bidirectional cross-modal fusion using Dual Cross-Attention (DCA). A variational autoencoder maps the fused representations to a compact latent space, where conditional flow matching enables connectivity synthesis and multimodal translation via latent transport. Experiments on the Human Connectome Project Young Adult (HCP-YA) dataset show that MHG-FM outperforms several state-of-the-art baselines in reconstruction quality, topology preservation, distributional similarity, and SC-FC coupling, while achieving approximately 8x faster sampling than a matched diffusion backbone.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态超图流匹配（MHG-FM）框架，实现结构连接（SC）与功能连接（FC）的联合生成与跨模态翻译。
AI.motivation: 大规模配对SC-FC数据稀缺，现有生成方法多基于成对图、仅刻画二元交互，且SC与FC独立生成，难以保留高阶结构与功能关系。
AI.method: 构建模态特定的超图，用超图神经网络（HGNN）编码器学习高阶表示，并通过双交叉注意力（DCA）进行双向跨模态融合；再由变分自编码器将融合表示映射到紧凑隐空间，在隐空间内用条件流匹配实现连接合成与多模态翻译。
AI.result: 在HCP-YA数据集上，MHG-FM在重建质量、拓扑保持、分布相似性和SC-FC耦合上优于多个SOTA基线，采样速度较匹配的扩散骨干快约8倍。
AI.conclusion: MHG-FM通过超图高阶建模与跨模态融合结合条件流匹配，为SC-FC联合生成与跨模态翻译提供了高效且性能优越的框架。

title: SoftGene: Protein Language Model-Enhanced Soft Prompting for Interpretable Gene Set Annotation
summary: Gene set analysis is a cornerstone of functional genomics, yet it remains labor-intensive and heavily dependent on manual curation and expert biological interpretation. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for genomic reasoning and annotation, most existing approaches rely on symbolic gene names and fail to capture domain-specific biological structure, particularly protein sequence information that governs molecular activity, interactions, and downstream gene function. In this work, we propose SoftGene, a novel framework for LLM-based gene set annotation that leverages the hierarchical structure of gene sets. First, we use a hierarchical attention-based encoder built on ESM, a protein language model, to represent each gene set using protein-level amino acid sequence information. Second, we construct a hybrid prompting scheme that combines soft prompts derived from gene set embeddings with hard prompts containing auxiliary context generated by an LLM, and feed the resulting prompt into a local LLM for annotation. We evaluate our framework on two benchmark datasets: Gene Ontology (GO) and the Molecular Signatures Database (MSigDB). Our results show that integrating protein-sequence representations with textual context improves gene set annotation overall, while per-domain analyses reveal that the contribution of protein embeddings varies across biological domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SoftGene框架，利用蛋白质语言模型ESM构建基因集的层次注意力编码，结合软提示与硬提示输入本地LLM进行基因集注释，在GO与MSigDB基准上验证了蛋白序列信息与文本上下文融合的有效性。
AI.motivation: 基因集分析是功能基因组学的基石，但现有流程劳动密集，高度依赖人工整理与专家生物学解读。尽管LLM已被用于基因组推理与注释，但多数方法依赖符号化基因名称，无法捕捉领域特有的生物学结构，尤其是决定分子活性、相互作用及下游基因功能的蛋白质序列信息。
AI.method: 提出SoftGene框架，利用基因集的层次结构。首先，基于蛋白质语言模型ESM构建层次注意力编码器，用蛋白层面的氨基酸序列信息表示每个基因集；其次，设计混合提示方案，将由基因集嵌入得到的软提示与由LLM生成的辅助上下文构成的硬提示相结合，输入本地LLM完成注释。
AI.result: 在Gene Ontology（GO）和Molecular Signatures Database（MSigDB）两个基准数据集上评估。结果表明，融合蛋白序列表示与文本上下文可整体提升基因集注释效果；分域分析显示，蛋白嵌入的贡献因生物学域而异。
AI.conclusion: 将蛋白序列层面的表示与文本上下文结合，可有效增强基于LLM的基因集注释，但蛋白嵌入的作用具有域依赖性，提示未来应针对不同生物学域设计自适应融合策略。

title: Fed-ADApt: Federated Anytime Depth Adaptation for Resource-Aware Medical Image Segmentation
comment: Accepted to The 4th International Conference on Federated Learning Technologies and Applications (FLTA 2026)
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative training of medical image segmentation models without sharing raw patient data, yet existing approaches assume a homogeneous compute budget across institutions, limiting participation of low-resource sites. We propose Fed-ADApt, a depth-adaptive federated framework for UNet-based segmentation that jointly addresses low-compute training and inference. Fed-ADApt integrates multi-depth supervision with hierarchical depth-wise aggregation, allowing each site to train according to its local compute budget while contributing to a global model that supports dynamic depth selection at deployment. We evaluated Fed-ADApt on multi-site 2D retinal fundus disc segmentation and 3D brain tumor segmentation. Across both tasks, federated collaboration substantially improves robustness under domain shift. Fed-ADApt matched the full-resource FedAvg performance in 3D and achieved competitive 2D performance with a 4.7% average Dice reduction, while reducing average inference cost by 19.5% in 3D and 34.5% in 2D and substantially reducing training cost by 98% at the most constrained sites. Importantly, Fed-ADApt enables low-resource institutions that cannot train full-capacity models to participate in federations while maintaining competitive global performance under a favorable accuracy to efficiency trade-off. By considering training and inference compute budgets, Fed-ADApt provides a practical and equitable solution for federated medical image segmentation across heterogeneous clinical and edge-enabled imaging environments.

AI.tldr: 提出Fed-ADApt——一种基于UNet的深度自适应联邦分割框架，通过多深度监督与分层深度聚合，让不同算力站点按本地预算参与训练，并支持部署时动态深度选择。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦学习方法假设各机构算力预算同质，导致低资源站点难以参与；同时低算力场景下的训练与推理效率问题未被联合考虑。
AI.method: Fed-ADApt在UNet上集成多深度监督（multi-depth supervision）与分层逐深度聚合（hierarchical depth-wise aggregation），各站点按本地算力预算训练不同深度子网络，聚合为支持动态深度选择的全局模型，兼顾训练与推理算力约束。
AI.result: 在多站点2D视网膜眼底视盘分割与3D脑肿瘤分割任务上，联邦协作显著提升域偏移下的鲁棒性。3D任务中Fed-ADApt达到全资源FedAvg的性能，2D任务平均Dice仅下降4.7%；推理成本3D降低19.5%、2D降低34.5%，最受限站点训练成本降低约98%。
AI.conclusion: Fed-ADApt使无法训练全容量模型的低资源机构也能参与联邦并保持有竞争力的全局性能，在精度-效率权衡上表现良好，为异构临床与边缘成像环境下的联邦医学图像分割提供了实用且公平的解决方案。

title: Bellman Error Minimization Via Linear Programming Normalization
summary: This paper proposes a new functional approximation approach to reduce Bellman error in high-dimensional dynamic programming and Reinforcement Learning problems. Using a classic dynamic programming problem (network capacity control in revenue management) as the motivational example, the paper illustrates that deep neural networks and linear programming approximation algorithms can be combined to derive approximate solutions to dynamic programming problems. Simulation results show the proposed approximation algorithms achieves competitive performance when compared with benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的函数逼近方法，将深度神经网络与线性规划逼近相结合，以降低高维动态规划与强化学习中的Bellman误差，并以收益管理中的网络容量控制问题作为动机示例验证其竞争性表现。
AI.motivation: 高维动态规划与强化学习问题中普遍存在Bellman误差偏大、近似解质量不足的问题，需要更有效的函数逼近手段来提升近似精度。
AI.method: 提出一种新的函数逼近框架，将深度神经网络与线性规划逼近算法相结合，用于求解动态规划问题的近似解；以收益管理中的网络容量控制这一经典动态规划问题作为动机示例进行说明。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提出的逼近算法在与基准方法的比较中取得了具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 深度神经网络与线性规划逼近的结合能够为高维动态规划问题提供有效的近似求解途径，并在网络容量控制等场景下展现出与基准方法相当的性能。

title: When Numbers Start Talking: Numerical Signalling and Strategic Behaviour Among LLMs
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents increasingly operate in multi-agent systems (MAS) characterised by strategic interaction. However, little is known about whether, and to what extent, different types of messages affect the outcomes of strategic games. By investigating AI agents based on four popular LLMs, playing four games with different cooperation equilibria, we study whether messages of different kinds (natural language, numerical signals, or random sequences) significantly modify the levels of cooperation in each game, also depending on the agents' assigned personalities. We observe that structured messages alter the final payoffs for most games and LLMs, but without a predictable pattern; this challenges the assumption that AI agents can converge to stable equilibria regardless of additional capabilities. Moreover, we observe that agent-generated numerical messages depart from randomness, most strongly and consistently when agents are explicitly instructed to communicate; however, they introduce an additional interpretability challenge, as their symbol distributions are mostly associated with the payoff structure and typically become more concentrated with repetition, but are overall difficult for humans to interpret. Monitoring for coordination of AI agents through restricted channels should thus prioritise message-level fingerprints, which generalise across models, over behavioural decisions, which do not.

AI.tldr: 通过4种LLM智能体在4类合作均衡不同的博弈中的实验，发现结构化消息会改变最终收益但无规律，智能体生成的数值消息偏离随机且难以解释；建议以消息层面的"指纹"而非行为决策作为监测多智能体协调的优先指标。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体日益在具有策略互动的多智能体系统中运作，但关于不同类型的消息是否、以及在多大程度上影响策略博弈结果，目前知之甚少；同时AI智能体能否在具备额外通信能力时仍收敛至稳定均衡这一假设也缺乏检验。
AI.method: 以基于4种主流LLM的AI智能体为对象，让其参与4个具有不同合作均衡的博弈；向智能体注入不同种类的消息（自然语言、数值信号、随机序列），并结合分配给智能体的不同人格特质，考察这些因素对每个博弈中合作水平的影响。
AI.result: 结构化消息在多数博弈和多数LLM中改变了最终收益，但不存在可预测的模式；智能体生成的数值消息偏离随机性，在明确指示其进行通信时这一偏离最强且最一致；这些数值消息的符号分布多与收益结构相关，并随重复而趋于集中，但整体上难以被人类解释，带来额外的可解释性挑战。
AI.conclusion: AI智能体未必能在具备额外通信能力的情况下收敛到稳定均衡；监测受限信道中的AI智能体协调，应优先关注可跨模型泛化的消息层面"指纹"，而非无法跨模型泛化的行为决策。

title: Weave Forcing: Compositional Memory Routing for Interactive Long Video Generation
summary: Recent advances in autoregressive video generation have improved temporal consistency over extended durations, yet interactive storytelling requires more than continuous scene extension: a new shot may combine characters and backgrounds from different historical shots. Whole prompt retrieval can overlook the distinct reference needs of individual components, while directly combining all historical memories may introduce unrelated visual content. To address these problems, we present Weave Forcing, a training-free framework for compositional memory reuse in interactive long video generation. First, we use an LLM for semantic slot routing to decompose user prompts into character and background descriptions and explicitly select suitable historical references for each component. To isolate the required content, masked memory weaving uses contrasting attention maps conditioned on semantic slots to construct refined semantic masks, selectively exposing relevant tokens from compressed historical KV memories to guide the generation of the current shot. We further introduce coverage adaptive RoPE to adjust temporal offsets and memory retention according to no, partial, or full reference coverage, addressing visual artifacts observed when incomplete historical references are positioned close to the current generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Weave Forcing improves cross-shot subject and background consistency while maintaining competitive visual quality and text alignment.

AI.tldr: Weave Forcing：一种免训练的组合式记忆复用框架，通过语义槽路由、掩码记忆编织与覆盖自适应RoPE，实现交互式长视频生成中的跨镜头角色与背景一致性。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频生成虽提升了长时段时序一致性，但交互式叙事需要新镜头组合不同历史镜头的角色与背景。整体提示检索忽略各组件独立的参考需求，而直接拼接全部历史记忆又会引入无关视觉内容。
AI.method: 1) 用LLM进行语义槽路由，将用户提示分解为角色与背景描述，并为每个组件显式选择合适的历史参考；2) 掩码记忆编织，基于语义槽条件生成对比注意力图以构造精细语义掩码，选择性地从压缩的历史KV记忆中暴露相关token引导当前镜头生成；3) 覆盖自适应RoPE，依据无、部分、完整参考覆盖情况调整时间偏移与记忆保留。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Weave Forcing在保持有竞争力的视觉质量与文本对齐的同时，提升了跨镜头的角色主体与背景一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过组合式记忆复用与细粒度语义选择，无需训练即可有效解决交互式长视频生成中跨镜头一致性问题。

title: hacktrace: behavior-supervised detection of reward hacking during code generation
summary: A coding agent can earn a passing grade by fixing its code, or by deleting the test that exposes the bug. Detecting such reward hacking requires recognizing attempted shortcuts, including those that fail. We release 173,561 annotated multi-turn coding trajectories from Qwen3-8B and show that supervising shortcut behavior independently of exploit success substantially improves detection. We introduce HACKTRACE, a behavior-supervised monitor that reads the internal states the agent already computes while generating code. Reusing these states enables monitoring before a turn is complete, without additional language-model tokens or passes. Combining this evidence with static features of the final files achieves a mean per-problem AUC of 0.997 with 8 ms of monitoring overhead, improving both accuracy and latency over monitors that run the model again on an honesty question and answer. The same generation states also provide an inexpensive monitoring signal for reinforcement learning. With strong GRPO penalties, HACKTRACE reduces the cheating share of passing solutions from 82-91% to 1-5%, while retaining honest, correct solutions and maintaining high detection accuracy as the policy evolves. Our results show that both the supervision target and the source of monitoring evidence matter for turning accurate detection into a useful training signal.

AI.tldr: 论文发布173,561条多轮编码轨迹，提出HACKTRACE行为监督监控器，直接读取Agent生成代码时的内部状态，在每轮完成前即可检测作弊行为（含失败尝试），AUC达0.997、监控开销仅8ms；作为RL信号时可将通过解中作弊比例从82-91%降至1-5%。
AI.motivation: 编码Agent可通过修复代码或删除暴露Bug的测试来获得及格，后者属于奖励作弊（reward hacking）。检测此类作弊需要识别包括失败尝试在内的捷径行为；而既有监控方式（如让模型重新回答诚实性问答）在准确性与时延上均不够理想。作者认为监督目标与监控证据来源二者都需重新设计。
AI.method: 1) 构建并发布173,561条带标注的多轮编码轨迹数据集（由Qwen3-8B产生），将“捷径行为”与“作弊是否成功”解耦监督；2) 提出HACKTRACE行为监督监控器，复用Agent生成代码时已计算的内部状态（隐状态），从而在回合尚未完成时即可监控，无需额外LM token或前向推理；3) 将内部状态证据与最终文件的静态特征相结合。
AI.result: 平均每问题AUC为0.997，监控开销约8ms，在准确率和时延上均优于“让模型重新回答诚实性问题”的监控器；作为RL监控信号时，在强GRPO惩罚下，将通过解中的作弊占比从82-91%降至1-5%，同时保留诚实且正确的解，并在策略演化过程中保持较高检测精度。
AI.conclusion: 监督目标（行为而非成功结果）与监控证据来源（复用生成时内部状态而非额外推理）二者对将准确检测转化为有用训练信号均至关重要。

title: ProgressNet: Sketching and Prompting with a Frozen Text-to-Image Model
summary: Humans draw progressively: a few strokes, a look at the result, a stroke erased, a prompt revised. Image generators do not work this way. They typically take a finished sketch and produce the image in a single pass, so every edit starts the picture again, and the models that do keep state across turns are driven by text, cannot take a stroke, and are too slow to draw with. We present ProgressNet, a training-free framework that lets a frozen text-to-image model follow a drawing session as it unfolds: strokes are added and erased, the prompt is revised, and the image keeps up at about a second per turn. It needs no new parameters because the frozen model already has what a progressive generator needs, a pathway through which the previous turn can be remembered, layers that can carry appearance forward without freezing structure, and an internal signal of how far to trust an unfinished sketch; three inference-time mechanisms (Previous-Concept Memory, Layer-Selective K/V Injection and Banded Adaptive Control) use each in turn. As a sketch fills in, every existing method degrades, the FID of the FLUX+ControlNet baseline doubling between 10% and 100% completion on FS-COCO, while ProgressNet's barely moves; it maintains strong fidelity and progressive coherence across three sketch domains and is preferred by users over five competitors, most widely on erasure.

AI.tldr: ProgressNet：一种免训练框架，使冻结的文本到图像模型能够跟随绘画过程（笔画增删、提示词修改），每轮约1秒，无需新参数。
AI.motivation: 人类绘画是渐进式的（几笔、看结果、擦除、改提示），而图像生成器通常一次性从完成草图生成图像，每次编辑都重新开始；能跨轮保持状态的模型由文本驱动、无法接受笔画输入且速度过慢。
AI.method: 基于冻结的文本到图像模型，利用其已有能力，通过三个推理时机制实现：Previous-Concept Memory（前一轮概念记忆）、Layer-Selective K/V Injection（层选择性K/V注入）和Banded Adaptive Control（分带自适应控制）。
AI.result: 在FS-COCO上，FLUX+ControlNet基线的FID在10%到100%完成度之间翻倍，而ProgressNet几乎不变；在三个草图领域保持强保真度与渐进一致性，用户偏好度超过五个竞品，尤其在擦除操作上。
AI.conclusion: ProgressNet 提供了一种无需额外训练、支持交互式渐进绘画的生成方案，在保真度、一致性和用户偏好上优于现有方法。

title: To Explore The Strange New World Beyond Data Distribution: System Behavior, Causality Tax, and Non-causal Base Model
summary: We show that the causality of language models (LMs) may not be necessary nor optimal. This is the case when system behavior (denoted as $S$) is incorporated as a first-principle Bayesian feature. Here, $S$ refers to extra dominant factors beyond the data space, and they involve coupled effects. Despite being the de facto foundation of modern architecture, recent studies indicate persistent mismatches and contradictions with causality. These issues largely stem from system behavior rather than the data distribution. We therefore propose the SBD framework, which incorporates $S$ as an irreducible component of the evidence lower bound (ELBO). SBD theoretically reveals a counter-intuitive Causality Tax phenomenon, where causality emerges as a suboptimal approximation with an additional structural error, due to the obliviousness to $S$. To address the challenge of latent variable analysis, we validate the SBD-predicted impact of $S$ via implicit measurements, theoretical-bound-guided controls, and Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) evaluations. In particular, we construct Green Shell (GSH) to show the possibility of reducing Causality Tax. GSH is a non-causal variational family, and it replaces the sequential dependency chain of $S$ components with a divide-and-conquer partition. NTK spectra in the lazy-training regime confirm that GSH always achieves significantly tighter error bounds than causality, with $7dB+$ improvement in signal-to-noise ratio. In the relatively later stage of lazy-training, GSH further leads to superior generalization (up to $20\%$ richer multi-scale fitting capabilities). Taken together, SBD establishes system behavior as a complementary theoretical abstraction besides causality and distribution fitting, opening new research avenues such as designing and optimizing LM base models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SBD框架，将系统行为S作为第一性原理贝叶斯特征纳入ELBO，揭示"因果税"现象，并构造非因果变分族GSH以降低因果税、提升误差界与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 语言模型以因果性为事实上的架构基础，但近期研究显示其与因果性存在持续的失配与矛盾，这些问题的根源更多来自系统行为而非数据分布。作者希望质疑因果性在LM中的必要性与最优性，探索在数据空间之外的支配性因素S的作用。
AI.method: 提出SBD框架，将系统行为S作为证据下界（ELBO）中不可约的组成部分；从理论上推导"因果税"现象，说明因果性是忽视S后带有额外结构误差的次优近似。通过隐式测量、理论界引导的控制实验以及神经正切核（NTK）评估来验证S的预测影响。构造Green Shell（GSH）非因果变分族，用分治划分替代S各分量的序列依赖链。
AI.result: 在懒惰训练机制下的NTK谱证实，GSH的误差界始终显著紧于因果性，信噪比提升7dB以上；在懒惰训练较后阶段，GSH进一步带来更优的泛化能力，多尺度拟合能力提升最高达20%。
AI.conclusion: SBD将系统行为确立为独立于因果性与分布拟合之外的补充性理论抽象，为LM基础模型的设计与优化开辟了新研究方向。

title: Prospective Hindsight: Self-Calibrating Reinforcement Learning via Prediction-Reality Gaps
summary: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents relies on purely retrospective training signals: credit is assigned only after observing environmental consequences, leaving the agent's belief at action time invisible to the gradient. We introduce Prospective Hindsight (PH), a self-calibrating training principle that augments any retrospective base method with a signal derived from the gap between the agent's prospective prediction (before feedback) and the retrospective evaluation (after feedback). This per-rollout surprise identifies samples where the agent's self-model is most inaccurate and amplifies their gradient contribution through a stop-gradient surprise-weighted advantage. Since the prospective predictor shares parameters with the policy, the two co-evolve, progressively shifting focus to the agent's remaining blind spots. We connect this principle to a privileged-information gap and show that minimizing the surprise residual provides a descent pathway on the agent's miscalibration rate; calibration thus emerges as a byproduct of optimization rather than from an added objective. On single-turn verifiable tasks and a multi-turn personal-agent task (under GRPO, on-policy distillation, and their combination), PH improves both task performance and calibration, with consistent gains across model scales. Notably, the dominant miscalibration mode shifts structurally between regimes, overconfident failures in single-turn, underconfident successes in multi-turn, yet the same training principle addresses both successfully.

AI.tldr: 提出"前瞻性事后视角"（PH）训练原则，利用前瞻预测与事后评估的差距（surprise）来加权优势函数，让智能体在优化过程中自动校准并提升长程任务表现。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体的强化学习仅依赖事后回传的信用分配信号，动作时刻的信念对梯度不可见，导致智能体自模型不准、校准性差，且传统方法无法针对性地纠正这些盲点。
AI.method: PH在任意事后基础方法上，加入"前瞻预测（反馈前）"与"事后评估（反馈后）"之间的差距作为信号；该per-rollout surprise识别自模型最不准确的样本，并通过stop-gradient的surprise加权优势放大其梯度贡献；前瞻预测器与策略共享参数，二者协同演化，使关注点逐步转移到剩余盲区。
AI.result: 在单轮可验证任务与多轮个人智能体任务上（GRPO、on-policy蒸馏及两者结合），PH同时提升任务性能与校准性，且跨模型规模一致增益；主导失校准模式在不同场景下结构性变化——单轮为过度自信的失败，多轮为自信不足的成功——同一原则均可应对。
AI.conclusion: PH将校准从附加目标转变为优化的副产品：最小化surprise残差为降低误校准率提供下降路径，并可与特权信息差距建立联系；该原则能统一处理不同结构性失校准模式。

title: MOF-VERIFY: A Failure-Aware Agentic Harness for MOF Hypothesis Verification
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshops XAI4Science and AI4Mat
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as reasoning components in AI-driven materials Co-Scientists, yet the reliability of the resulting verification pipeline remains unclear. Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) provide a particularly challenging setting because structures may appear under different identifiers, synthesis outcomes depend strongly on experimental conditions, evidence is distributed across heterogeneous sources, and some hypotheses require computation rather than literature alone. We introduce a diagnostic benchmark with four task families covering structural grounding, synthesis-condition verification, evidence-sufficiency verification, and MLIP-based computational verification. T-MOF-1-3 are evaluated under closed-book, retrieval-enabled, and oracle-evidence settings to localize failures in knowledge access, evidence acquisition, and reasoning, while T-MOF-4 separately evaluates computational verification. Guided by these diagnosed failure modes, we develop MOF-Verify, a failure-aware agentic harness that targets structural, literature, evidence-sufficiency, and computational bottlenecks before producing a final verdict. Across multiple backbone LLMs, MOF-Verify substantially improves hypothesis-verification performance over direct inference and retrieval-based baselines. Benchmark datasets are released at https://github.com/IMMS-Ewha/MOF-Verify-Benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MOF假设验证的诊断基准（含结构定位、合成条件、证据充分性、MLIP计算验证四类任务）与失败感知型智能体框架MOF-Verify，显著提升多模型验证性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型日益作为AI材料学Co-Scientist的推理组件，但其验证流程的可靠性尚不明确；MOF场景尤为困难（同一结构存在多种标识符、合成结果依赖实验条件、证据分散于异构来源、部分假设需计算而非文献支撑），亟需诊断失败模式并据此改进验证。
AI.method: 构建覆盖四类任务的诊断基准：T-MOF-1~3分别在闭卷、检索增强与oracle-evidence设置下评估，以定位知识获取、证据获取与推理环节的失败；T-MOF-4单独评估基于MLIP的计算验证。基于诊断出的失败模式，设计失败感知的智能体框架MOF-Verify，在输出最终判定前分别针对结构、文献、证据充分性与计算瓶颈进行干预。
AI.result: 在多个骨干LLM上，MOF-Verify的假设验证性能显著优于直接推理与基于检索的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过诊断基准明确MOF假设验证的失败环节，并证明失败感知的智能体化流程可有效提升验证可靠性；基准数据集已在GitHub公开。

title: Feedforward Novel View Synthesis for Heterogeneous Cameras
summary: Feed-forward novel view synthesis has recently shown promising results from sparse posed images, but most existing methods assume that context and target views share a fixed camera family. This homogeneous-camera assumption breaks in practical multi-sensor systems, where perspective, fisheye, and panoramic cameras may coexist and where the target projection may be unseen during training. We study feed-forward NVS across heterogeneous central cameras and identify a key ambiguity introduced by tokenization: a visual token aggregates a projection-dependent bundle of pixel rays, while existing camera encodings mainly expose absolute rays or token-center relations. To address this, we combine token-center relative Camera Positional Encodings and proposed local raymaps, a token-level representation that explicitly describes the intra-patch ray distribution summarized by each token. We further propose projection-aware 2D RoPE, which replaces raw image-grid coordinates with ray-induced angular coordinates so that relative positional reasoning is aligned across camera projections. Together, these components treat diverse cameras as calibrated samplings of a shared ray space rather than separate visual domains. On ScanNet++ with heterogeneous-camera system, our method improves over camera-conditioned baselines under mixed-camera evaluation and demonstrates zero-shot generalization to panoramic views.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究异构中心相机下的前馈新视角合成（NVS），通过token中心相对相机位置编码、局部raymap与投影感知2D RoPE，将多种相机统一为共享光线空间的校准采样。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈NVS方法普遍假设上下文与目标视图属于同一相机族（homogeneous-camera assumption）。但在实际多传感器系统中，透视、鱼眼、全景相机可能共存，且目标投影可能在训练时未出现，这一同质假设失效。论文进一步指出tokenization引入的关键歧义：视觉token聚合的是依赖投影的像素光线束，而现有相机编码主要暴露绝对光线或token中心关系，无法刻画token内部的局部光线分布。
AI.method: 提出三项互补组件：（1）token中心相对相机位置编码（token-center relative Camera Positional Encodings），建模token间相对关系；（2）局部raymap（local raymaps），一种token级表示，显式描述每个token所汇总的patch内光线分布；（3）投影感知2D RoPE（projection-aware 2D RoPE），用光线诱导的角度坐标替代原始图像网格坐标，使相对位置推理在不同相机投影间保持对齐。三者共同将异构相机视为共享光线空间的校准采样，而非彼此独立的视觉域。
AI.result: 在ScanNet++异构相机系统上，方法在混合相机评测中优于相机条件化基线，并展现对全景视图的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一光线空间的建模范式，可有效缓解同质相机假设带来的局限，实现跨异构中心相机的前馈新视角合成，并具备向未见投影（如全景）的零样本泛化潜力。

title: Probe the Harness: Setup Checks for Stale-Data RL Comparisons in Language Models
summary: Methods for training language models on stale samples are judged by comparisons against importance-corrected baselines. We show that details of the experimental harness can reverse the observed ranking of methods, and we introduce PTH (Probe The Harness), a set of checks that makes the harness visible. Our case is a comparison between SAN, a behaviour-free method, and truncated importance sampling (TIS) on verl and in a single-GPU trainer, in which SAN first finished ahead in both stacks. Four details of the harness changed this comparison: the PPO ratio was taken against the learner's own recomputed probabilities, the data seed did not reach the TIS arm, the replay queue reused its first batch for 33 updates, and two loss normalisers differed from their description. In each case the logged quantity looked consistent with a working setup, while the quantity that defines the comparison went unchecked. With the harness checked, TIS matches SAN on verl, and in the trainer TIS learns steadily while SAN keeps a margin. We contribute the signature of each detail and its effect on the comparison, reference results for TIS and uncorrected GRPO under sampler lag, and the PTH checklist.

AI.tldr: 论文指出，在陈旧样本上训练语言模型的方法比较高度依赖实验装置细节，并据此提出 PTH 检查清单，使这些隐藏细节显性化。
AI.motivation: 现有方法优劣通常通过对比重要性校正基线来判定，但实验装置（harness）的细节可能改变方法排序，导致结论不可靠，而日志中的数值看似正常、真正决定比较的量却被忽视。
AI.method: 以 SAN（无行为校正方法）与截断重要性采样 TIS 在 verl 及单 GPU 训练器上的比较为案例，提出 PTH（Probe The Harness）检查集，逐项定位并验证影响比较的四个装置细节：PPO 比率是否对学习器自身重算概率计算、数据种子未传入 TIS 分支、回放队列首批被复用 33 次更新、两个损失归一化器与描述不符。
AI.result: 检查装置前，SAN 在两个平台上均先取得优势；修正上述细节后，TIS 在 verl 上与 SAN 持平，在单 GPU 训练器中 TIS 稳定学习而 SAN 保持一定优势。
AI.conclusion: 研究贡献包括每个装置细节的特征及其对比较结果的影响、采样滞后下 TIS 与未校正 GRPO 的参考结果，以及 PTH 检查清单。

title: Jumping up and down: Denoiser diffusion models for discrete ordinal data
summary: Diffusion models are highly developed in continuous spaces for image and video domains. Recently, major advances have been made for discrete diffusion models for categorical data, specifically in the language domain. In contrast, diffusion models for discrete integer-valued data are less developed, despite the prevalence of this modality, ranging from images and music to gene counts. We introduce Jumping Up and Down (JUD)---a new family of denoiser-based diffusion models for discrete ordinal data. This is the first family of diffusion models for ordinal data which centers around training denoisers, which at the same time allows for bi-directional (up and down) perturbations of the data. The simplicity of the training objective, combined with the flexibility of bi-directional perturbations, leads us to obtain competitive results across different data modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JUD（Jumping Up and Down），一种面向离散序数数据的去噪器扩散模型族，是首个以训练去噪器为核心、支持双向扰动（升/降）的序数数据扩散模型，在多种数据模态上取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.motivation: 连续空间（图像、视频）扩散模型已高度成熟，类别型离散数据的扩散模型在语言领域也取得重大进展；但取值位于离散整数、具有序数性质的模态（如图像、音乐、基因计数）的扩散模型发展不足。现有方法缺乏面向序数数据的、基于去噪器的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出JUD（Jumping Up and Down）扩散模型族：基于去噪器（denoiser-based）的训练范式，针对离散序数数据设计；其核心是支持双向（向上与向下）的数据扰动，而非单向加噪；训练目标形式简洁。
AI.result: 得益于简洁的训练目标与双向扰动的灵活性，JUD在多种不同数据模态上均取得具有竞争力的实验结果。
AI.conclusion: JUD填补了离散序数数据扩散建模的空白，证明了以去噪器为核心、结合双向扰动的扩散框架在该类数据上的有效性与通用性。

title: RIFAR: Reliability and Forgetting-Aware Replay for Continual Robot Learning
summary: Genuine embodied agency requires robots to turn continuous real-world experience into lasting, transferable skills. This demands continual learning that integrates new capabilities without eroding prior knowledge as tasks and environments evolve. Experience replay mitigates forgetting, but storing complete demonstrations becomes costly as tasks accumulate. World-action models offer a generative alternative, reconstructing past experience through joint predictions of actions and future observations. However, visually coherent rollouts may contain actions that cannot realize the predicted transitions, while new-task adaptation can disrupt previously learned behavior. RIFAR therefore combines reliability screening with drift-aware replay selection. It reconstructs trajectories from compact demonstration prefixes and uses a frozen inverse-dynamics model to assess action-visual consistency. Training first combines current demonstrations with the highest-quality screened trajectories. RIFAR then compares action predictions before and after this adaptation on identical historical inputs, reselecting trajectories with larger normalized drift from the same screened pool for continued training. Across three LIBERO suites and real-world experiments, RIFAR surpasses the previous state of the art in WAM-based generative replay. On LIBERO-Goal, it achieves 90.97 AUC while retaining only 320 historical time steps per task, approximately 4.9% of the steps retained using 50-demonstration replay.

AI.tldr: RIFAR提出一种可靠性筛选与漂移感知回放选择相结合的世界-动作模型(WAM)生成式经验回放方法，在持续学习中兼顾新任务适应与旧知识保持。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体需要持续学习以在不遗忘旧知识的前提下整合新技能。经验回放可缓解遗忘，但存储完整演示代价随任务累积而增大。世界-动作模型通过联合预测动作与未来观测来重建历史经验，是生成式替代方案；但视觉上连贯的推演可能包含无法真正实现所预测状态转移的动作，且新任务适应会破坏已学行为。
AI.method: RIFAR将可靠性筛选与漂移感知回放选择结合。首先从紧凑的演示前缀重建轨迹，并用冻结的逆动力学模型评估动作-视觉一致性以筛选高质量轨迹。训练阶段先用当前演示与筛选出的最高质量轨迹联合训练；随后在相同历史输入上比较适应前后的动作预测，从同一筛选池中重选归一化漂移更大的轨迹继续训练。
AI.result: 在三个LIBERO套件及真实世界实验中，RIFAR优于先前基于WAM的生成式回放SOTA方法。在LIBERO-Goal上取得90.97 AUC，同时每个任务仅保留320个历史时间步，约为使用50条演示回放所保留步数的4.9%。
AI.conclusion: RIFAR通过可靠性筛选与漂移感知重选机制，有效提升了生成式经验回放在具身持续学习中的稳定性与效率，以极少的历史存储量实现了领先性能。

title: DuoMatching: Joint-Marginal Distribution Matching for Few-Step Video Generation
summary: Streaming video generation has benefited from distribution matching distillation (DMD), which matches the joint distribution of video frames to a video teacher's approximation of the real video distribution. Although this joint matching mitigates drift during autoregressive rollouts, limitations remain in visual quality and semantic alignment. To address these limitations, we propose DuoMatching, a distribution matching framework that approximates the real video distribution through a unified joint-marginal formulation. On top of existing joint matching formulations, the additional marginal matching objective provides dedicated frame-level supervision from an image generator, transferring complementary visual and semantic priors from it. To apply this frame-level supervision in video generation, we introduce LatentBridge to resolve the latent representation mismatch between the video student and the image teacher. Latent Variation Sampling further distributes such frame-level supervision across distinct temporal segments, reducing redundancy. Experiments demonstrate that DuoMatching improves visual quality, composition, and semantic alignment while largely preserving motion dynamics. Human evaluations show overall preference rates above 80% against all evaluated baselines. The project page is available at https://johnzhan2023.github.io/DuoMatching/.

AI.tldr: 提出DuoMatching，一种联合-边缘分布匹配框架，通过引入图像生成器的帧级监督来提升流式视频生成的视觉质量与语义对齐，并保持运动动态。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频生成依赖分布匹配蒸馏（DMD），通过匹配视频帧的联合分布逼近视频教师模型所近似的真实视频分布。该联合匹配虽能缓解自回归展开中的漂移，但在视觉质量和语义对齐方面仍存在不足。
AI.method: 在已有联合匹配的基础上，额外引入边缘匹配目标，从图像生成器获取帧级监督，迁移互补的视觉与语义先验。为将该帧级监督用于视频生成，提出LatentBridge解决视频学生与图像教师之间的潜表示不匹配问题；并通过Latent Variation Sampling将帧级监督分布到不同时间段以降低冗余。
AI.result: 实验表明DuoMatching在提升视觉质量、构图和语义对齐的同时基本保持运动动态。人类评估显示，相对所有对比基线总体偏好率超过80%。
AI.conclusion: DuoMatching通过统一的联合-边缘分布匹配框架，有效融合图像生成器的帧级先验，显著改善流式视频生成的质量与语义一致性，是一种有效的视频蒸馏方法。

title: A Two-Stage Cascade for Near-Real-Time Forest Anomaly Detection from Sentinel-1 SAR Time Series
summary: Tropical forest monitoring is essential for global climate stability and biodiversity preservation. To address the urgent need for rapid, reliable detection of forest loss which is essential for timely intervention against illegal logging, supply chain transparency, land-use governance and carbon market standards, we introduce a two-stage statistics-encoder cascade for near-real-time anomaly detection using Sentinel-1 time series. Our system is designed to overcome two fundamental challenges in remote sensing: the cloud-cover limitations that restrict optical monitoring and seasonal backscatter variation that causes SAR systems to mistake natural moisture changes for forest loss. The architecture integrates two distinct analytical engines to ensure high-fidelity detection: (1) an adaptive, robust-statistics z-score test on co-registered Sentinel-1 VH backscatter, same-season historical baseline and (2) a learned confirmation gate based on the latent-space structural similarity (SSIM) of a convolutional autoencoder trained on stable-forest patches. A candidate disturbance is confirmed as an alert only when both stages agree, and is assigned a confidence score and a Low/Medium/High risk tier from its repeat-occurrence history. The system produces per-alert auditable confidence scores and area-in-hectares estimates directly compatible with Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) workflows, sustainable forestry management, operational field checks and environmental risk assessments. Beyond its primary application, the model's flexibility allows for critical environmental applications ranging from selective logging to large-scale agricultural encroachment mapping, flood mapping and so on.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种两阶段“统计+编码器”级联的近实时热带森林损失异常检测系统，基于Sentinel-1时序数据，融合鲁棒统计z检验与卷积自编码器潜空间SSIM确认门，输出可审计置信度与面积估算，兼容MRV流程。
AI.motivation: 热带森林监测对全球气候稳定与生物多样性保护至关重要，非法采伐、供应链透明、土地利用治理和碳市场标准都亟需快速可靠的森林损失检测。然而遥感监测面临两大挑战：光学监测受云层覆盖限制，SAR系统又易将自然湿度变化引起的季节性后向散射波动误判为森林损失。
AI.method: 采用两阶段统计-编码器级联架构。第一阶段：对配准后的Sentinel-1 VH后向散射与同季节历史基线进行自适应鲁棒统计z-score检验，生成候选扰动。第二阶段：基于在稳定森林斑块上训练的卷积自编码器，计算潜空间结构相似性（SSIM）作为学习式确认门。仅当两阶段结果一致时才确认警报，并依据重复发生历史赋予置信度分数和低/中/高三级风险等级。
AI.result: 系统输出每条警报可审计的置信度分数及以公顷为单位的面积估算，直接兼容监测、报告与核查（MRV）工作流、可持续林业管理、实地核查与环境风险评估。模型具备灵活性，可扩展至选择性采伐、大规模农业侵占制图、洪水制图等环境应用。
AI.conclusion: 该两阶段级联方法通过统计检验与深度学习确认门的互补设计，有效缓解云层限制与季节性后向散射误判问题，实现高保真、近实时的森林损失检测，并提供可直接用于碳市场与治理决策的可审计输出。

title: Peer Influence across Heterogeneous AI Models
summary: When two AI agents disagree, who persuades whom? As multi-agent systems increasingly combine language models of different families and sizes, the answer can determine which judgments survive interaction. Measuring persuasion as the probabilistic shift in an agent's decision after a single exchange with a dissenting peer, we test seven open-weight models across three language understanding tasks. We find that persuasion is strong: when models disagree, receivers often abandon their initial judgment after seeing a peer's answer and explanation. Surprisingly, however, neither standalone certainty nor model scale reliably predicts persuasion dynamics. Models producing almost perfectly consistent decisions in isolation can be among the most susceptible to persuasion, and small models can match larger ones as persuaders and resist their influence just as effectively. Furthermore, we show that the size of the shift depends more on the susceptibility of the listener than on the persuasiveness of the speaker. Persuasion patterns are therefore specific to each model pairing, with heterogeneity amplifying persuasion in some combinations and suppressing it in others, allowing a dissenting agent running a small model to overturn the judgments of a much larger one. These findings show that the behavior of interacting models cannot be inferred from their individual properties but must be evaluated in the combinations in which they will operate.

AI.tldr: 在三个语言理解任务上测量七个开源模型两两交互的说服效应，发现说服力强且不可由单模型属性（确定性、规模）预测，主要取决于听者的易受影响程度及具体配对组合。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统日益混合不同家族与规模的语言模型，当两个AI代理意见分歧时谁能说服谁，决定了交互后哪种判断得以保留，因此需要量化模型间说服动态及其影响因素。
AI.method: 将说服定义为一次交流后代理决策概率的偏移量；让七个开源权重模型在三个语言理解任务上进行配对交互，接收方观察持异议同伴的答案及解释，比较单模型独立确定性与模型规模对说服效应的预测能力，并区分说话者说服力与听者易感性的贡献。
AI.result: 说服效应显著：分歧时接收方常在看到同伴答案与解释后放弃原判断。单模型确定性与模型规模均无法可靠预测说服动态；独立状态下决策近乎完全一致的模型可能最易被说服；小模型作为说服者可与大模型匹敌，抵抗影响的能力亦相当。偏移幅度更多取决于听者易感性而非说话者说服力。说服模式具有配对特异性，异质性在某些组合中放大、在另一些组合中抑制说服，使运行小模型的异议代理能推翻大得多的模型的判断。
AI.conclusion: 交互模型的行为无法由其个体属性推断，必须在实际部署的组合中加以评估。

title: Rethinking What to Cache in Few-Step Diffusion Transformers: Solver-Aware Target Selection
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) can generate high-quality images and videos, but generating each sample requires multiple costly DiT forward passes. Two common ways to accelerate DiT sampling are step distillation, which reduces the number of sampling steps, and caching, which skips some DiT evaluations by reusing a tensor computed at an earlier step. Most caching methods decide in advance which tensor to reuse. After distillation, adjacent sampling steps are farther apart. Reusing a tensor across this larger gap introduces more error, so choosing what to cache becomes especially important. We therefore introduce AutoTarget, a method that chooses the cached tensor for a given model, solver, and reuse schedule. AutoTarget uses a small set of runs without cache reuse to measure the error caused by reusing each candidate tensor, then selects the candidate with the lowest error. We also analyze how an error at one reuse step affects the final sample. For Euler sampling, we identify cache targets that produce the same trajectory and show why a stored solver update may not. Experiments on distilled image and video DiTs show that the best cache target changes with the model, image resolution, and solver. AutoTarget reduces DiT evaluations and retained cache storage. Generation quality remains close to the corresponding uncached run. On the tested PixArt-LCM and FLUX.1-schnell settings, its calibration ranking matches the ranking from held-out cached runs. To help others reproduce the method, we provide its core implementation on GitHub at https://github.com/wali1024-offical/AutoTarget.

AI.tldr: AutoTarget通过少量无缓存复用运行测量各候选张量复用误差，自动选择误差最低的缓存目标，从而在蒸馏DiT采样中减少评估次数和缓存存储且保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: DiT生成需多次昂贵前向；步数蒸馏与缓存是两类加速手段，但步数蒸馏后相邻采样步间隔变大，跨大步复用张量误差增大，因此"缓存什么"尤为关键，而多数缓存方法预先固定复用张量。
AI.method: AutoTarget针对给定模型、求解器和复用调度选择缓存张量：用少量无缓存复用的运行测量复用各候选张量引起的误差，选误差最低者；并分析单步复用误差对最终样本的影响，对Euler采样识别产生相同轨迹的缓存目标，说明为何存储的solver update可能不适用。
AI.result: 在蒸馏图像与视频DiT上，最佳缓存目标随模型、图像分辨率和求解器变化；AutoTarget减少了DiT评估次数与缓存存储，生成质量接近对应无缓存运行；在PixArt-LCM和FLUX.1-schnell设置上，其校准排序与留出缓存运行的排序一致。
AI.conclusion: 缓存目标需按模型、分辨率与求解器自适应选择，AutoTarget以低成本校准实现该选择，兼顾加速与质量，并提供GitHub核心实现以便复现。

title: Understanding Trajectory Heterogeneity in Federated World Model Learning
summary: World models learn state evolution from trajectories, making access to temporal context a central training requirement. Federated learning can use distributed records, while ownership boundaries within a trajectory restrict the examples each client can construct. Our study benchmarks this cross-time setting through hourly action-conditioned clinical prediction on eight MIMIC-IV disease cohorts, comprising 40.87 million transition memberships. We specify severity-based client ownership, patient-separated construction, local history and future-window rules, and paired rollout evaluation from one to 32 hours. A matrix of ten federated algorithms covers 32 disease--partition configurations under five rounds of ten-percent participation. Three findings emerge from existing results and training logs. First, client ownership and participation jointly restrict long-window coverage: only 7.55\%--21.36\% of pooled-available 32-step windows have a locally complete anchor visited during training, averaged across diseases. Second, finer severity partitions accompany higher FedAvg error in 15 of 16 paired comparisons, while algorithm gains are small and horizon-dependent: FedProx reduces mean error by 0.56\%, with no consistent improvement at 32 steps. Third, algorithm labels conceal distinct update behavior, including inactive extrapolation and orders-of-magnitude differences in update scale. Cached-update performance also varies strongly across trajectory partitions under the same benchmark protocol. These results establish temporal access, participation coverage, optimization behavior, and horizon-resolved prediction as complementary dimensions for evaluating federated clinical world models.

AI.tldr: 该研究在MIMIC-IV八个疾病队列上构建跨时间联邦学习基准，用4087万转移样本评估十种联邦算法在1–32小时动作条件临床预测中的表现，揭示客户端归属与参与度对时间上下文覆盖的限制、划分粒度与误差关系，以及算法标签掩盖的更新行为差异。
AI.motivation: 世界模型需从轨迹中学习状态演化，时间上下文是训练的核心需求；联邦学习可利用分布式记录，但轨迹内的所有权边界限制了每个客户端可构造的样本。因此需要系统评估这种跨时间场景下的联邦临床世界模型。
AI.method: 在MIMIC-IV八个疾病队列上进行逐小时动作条件临床预测，包含4087万转移成员；设定基于严重程度的客户端归属、患者分离构造、本地历史与未来窗口规则，并采用1至32小时的配对rollout评估；矩阵覆盖十种联邦算法、32种疾病–划分配置，进行五轮10%参与率训练。
AI.result: 第一，客户端归属与参与度共同限制长窗口覆盖：各疾病平均仅7.55%–21.36%的池化可用32步窗口在训练中被本地完整锚点访问；第二，更细的严重度划分在16组配对比较中有15组伴随更高的FedAvg误差，算法增益小且依赖预测时程，FedProx平均误差降低0.56%，但在32步处无一致改善；第三，算法标签掩盖了不同的更新行为，包括非活跃外推和更新尺度的数量级差异；相同基准协议下缓存更新性能也随轨迹划分强烈变化。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果确立了时间可及性、参与覆盖、优化行为和时程分辨预测是评估联邦临床世界模型的互补维度。

title: A Controlled Audit of Personal AI Memory for Rating Prediction
summary: In structured rating prediction, does a personal AI use historical item-rating associations, or mainly the user's rating tendencies? We audit this distinction by permuting historical ratings within each user while preserving the exact rating distribution, item support, and metadata. We combine this control with full history, native memory extraction, and matched numerical readers in a publicly frozen evaluation of 400 held-out user profiles and 6,160 target ratings across Coat and MovieLens. On Coat, the tested Qwen-written Mem0 pipeline increases user-macro mean absolute error relative to full history by 0.084 for Qwen and 0.149 for Phi; both family-adjusted bootstrap intervals exclude zero. Correct historical assignments help both readers on Coat, but the corresponding MovieLens effects are smaller and inconclusive after adjustment. A history-only ridge reader outperforms Qwen in both domains and Phi on MovieLens, while the Coat Phi comparison is unresolved. All 2,800 reader calls, including 150 invalid outputs, are retained under a fixed fallback rule. A separate implementation verifies inputs, metrics, and all ten primary contrasts. The contribution is a reproducible diagnostic study showing why extraction, association use, output reliability, and reader choice require separate evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过在同一用户内置换历史评分（保持评分分布、物品支持度与元数据不变）的诊断性实验，检验结构化评分预测中个性化AI究竟依赖"历史物品-评分关联"还是"用户评分倾向"；在Coat与MovieLens的400个用户档案/6,160个目标评分上发现：Mem0式记忆提取在Coat上反而显著增加MAE，说明提取、关联利用、输出可靠性与读者选择需分别评估。
