AI.motivation: 结构化评分预测中，个性化AI（如带记忆提取的LLM流水线）看似利用了用户的历史行为，但其预测增益究竟来自真实的"历史物品-评分关联"，还是仅来自"用户总体评分倾向/评分分布"这一更浅层的统计特征，此前缺乏严格的因果式审计。作者希望通过可控扰动把这两类信息源分离，以判断记忆/提取类方法是否真正捕捉了关联结构。
AI.method: 采用用户内历史评分置换（within-user permutation）作为控制：在保持每名用户的评分分布、物品支持度与元数据完全不变的前提下打乱历史评分的配对关系。将这一控制与三种条件组合——完整历史、原生记忆提取（Qwen写的Mem0流水线）、匹配的数值读者（reader）——在公开冻结的评测上进行对比，覆盖Coat与MovieLens两个数据集，共400个留出用户档案与6,160个目标评分。使用用户宏平均绝对误差（user-macro MAE）作为主指标，并采用家庭调整的自助法（family-adjusted bootstrap）区间与"仅历史"岭回归读者作为基线。同时保留全部2,800次读者调用（含150次无效输出）并施加固定回退规则，另由独立实现复核输入、指标与全部10个主对比。
AI.result: 在Coat上，Qwen写的Mem0流水线相对完整历史使user-macro MAE分别上升0.084（Qwen读者）与0.149（Phi读者），两者的家庭调整自助区间均排除零，说明正确历史配对确实有帮助，置换则造成显著退化；MovieLens上对应效应更小，调整后不具结论性。"仅历史"岭回归读者在两个域上均优于Qwen，并在MovieLens上优于Phi，而Coat上Phi与岭回归的比较尚无定论。全部2,800次调用（含150次无效输出）均按固定回退规则纳入。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明当前记忆提取式个性化AI在结构化评分预测中未必有效利用历史物品-评分关联，甚至可能因提取质量或输出不可靠而损害性能；跨数据集效应不一致也说明收益并不稳健。因此，记忆提取、关联利用、输出可靠性与下游读者选择是彼此独立的评估维度，必须分别测量；该工作提供了一个可复现的诊断范式而非单一的性能提升主张。

title: Predictor-Guided Latent Space Codon Optimization for Maximizing Protein Expression
summary: Codon optimization, the process of selecting synonymous codons to improve mRNA translation efficiency and protein expression, is central to therapeutic protein production and mRNA vaccines, yet it remains a hard problem. The design space is discrete and combinatorially large, precluding gradient-based methods, and existing tools rely on heuristic proxies (e.g., Codon Adaptation Index or GC-content) that poorly capture true expression. We introduce Latent-Space Codon Optimization (LSCO), which recasts this discrete problem as a continuous one by mapping sequences into the latent space of a pretrained mRNA language model, enabling efficient gradient-based search. LSCO combines four components: a data-driven expression objective from an uncertainty-aware predictor, a Minimum-Free-Energy regularizer for structural stability, a naturalness prior from a protein-to-codon back-translation model, and constrained decoding for protein fidelity. On a real-world, wet-lab antibody expression dataset, LSCO outperforms simple frequency-based, as well as modern deep generative baselines in predicted expression, while retaining suitable biophysical properties.

AI.tldr: LSCO 将密码子优化重铸为预训练 mRNA 语言模型潜空间中的连续优化问题，结合表达预测目标、最小自由能正则、自然度先验与约束解码，在湿实验抗体数据上优于频率法与现代深度生成基线。
AI.motivation: 密码子优化对治疗性蛋白生产与 mRNA 疫苗至关重要，但其设计空间离散且组合爆炸，无法使用梯度方法；现有工具依赖 CAI、GC 含量等启发式代理指标，难以真实反映表达水平。
AI.method: 提出 Latent-Space Codon Optimization (LSCO)：借助预训练 mRNA 语言模型将序列映射到潜空间，把离散优化转为连续梯度搜索。方法由四部分构成：(1) 来自不确定性感知预测器的数据驱动表达目标；(2) 用于结构稳定性的最小自由能正则项；(3) 来自蛋白到密码子回译模型的自然度先验；(4) 保证蛋白序列保真度的约束解码。
AI.result: 在真实湿实验抗体表达数据集上，LSCO 的预测表达量优于简单的频率基线与现代深度生成基线，同时保持了合理的生物物理性质。
AI.conclusion: 将密码子优化从离散组合搜索转为语言模型潜空间的连续优化是可行且有效的，能够兼顾表达效率与结构、自然度及蛋白保真度等多重约束。

title: ManifoldSplat: Language-Guided Semantic Shape Editing of 3D Gaussian Head Avatars
summary: High-fidelity 3D head avatars have reached near-photorealistic quality. While recent methods enable text-driven manipulation, they struggle to provide fine-grained localized control, often entangling features or lacking geometric consistency. Modifying geometry through natural language currently requires slow per-prompt optimization or compromises identity and rigging. We present ManifoldSplat, the first end-toend framework for language-guided semantic shape editing of animatable 3D Gaussian Splatting avatars reconstructed from monocular videos. By performing edits within the structured FLAME manifold rather than directly optimizing an unstructured Gaussian cloud, we strictly preserve identity and animation. We introduce DeltaRegion, a per-region disentangled Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) delivering feedforward shape deltas, alongside a refining stage to recover view-consistent details. ManifoldSplat reconstructs and edits an avatar in ~90 seconds on a consumer GPU, rendering at ~800 FPS. Extensive evaluations demonstrate our approach sets a new state-of-the-art in localized prompt alignment, geometric coherence, and identity preservation. Project page and code: https://a-canela.github.io/manifoldsplat/

AI.tldr: ManifoldSplat是一个端到端框架，可在FLAME流形内进行语言引导的语义形状编辑，实现可动画3D高斯头像的快速局部编辑，兼顾身份与动画一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动方法难以提供细粒度局部控制，常纠缠特征或缺乏几何一致性；通过自然语言修改几何要么需要缓慢的逐提示优化，要么损害身份与骨骼绑定。
AI.method: 在结构化FLAME流形内执行编辑，而非直接优化非结构化高斯云；提出DeltaRegion，即逐区域解耦的条件变分自编码器（CVAE）提供前馈形状增量，并配合精炼阶段恢复视角一致细节。
AI.result: 在消费级GPU上约90秒完成重建与编辑，渲染约800 FPS；大量评测显示在局部提示对齐、几何一致性和身份保持上达到新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: ManifoldSplat是首个面向单目视频重建可动画3DGS头像的语言引导语义形状编辑端到端框架，实现高质量局部编辑与实时渲染。

title: Sentry: Learning to Recover from LLM Agent Failures at Test Time
summary: LLM agents often fail mid-task due to invalid tool calls, repeated actions, or poorly grounded reasoning, and learning from these failures is a path to reliability. We find that how failure knowledge reaches the agent matters as much as what it contains. Failure lessons are conditional: kept in the agent's context, they misfire when their failure is absent, and removing them from an evolving playbook improves performance. Runtime interventions, in contrast, act only when a failure occurs but do not learn from their repairs. We argue that failure knowledge is conditional knowledge and should be conditionally exposed, and instantiate this principle in Sentry, a failure-management layer that runs alongside the agent. When Sentry detects a failure, it retrieves matching lessons from an external playbook to guide recovery, verifies without access to task rewards whether the agent recovered, and stores a new lesson only if it did; the full playbook never enters the agent's context. Across multiple agentic benchmarks, Sentry outperforms the strongest runtime-intervention baseline on every benchmark, by 37\% on average, and the strongest context-evolution baseline by 39\% on the two benchmarks where both are evaluated; combining Sentry with context evolution yields further gains. Learned lessons transfer to held-out tasks, and controlled experiments show that exposing the full playbook to the agent lowers performance even when relevant lessons remain available on demand.

AI.tldr: 失败知识是"条件性知识"，应按需暴露：Sentry 作为独立于智能体的失败管理层，仅在检测到失败时检索匹配教训指导恢复、验证恢复后写入新教训，全程不将完整 playbook 注入智能体上下文，在多个基准上大幅优于最强基线。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体常因无效工具调用、重复动作或推理缺乏依据而在任务中途失败，从失败中学习是提升可靠性的路径。但作者发现"失败知识如何到达智能体"与"包含什么内容"同样重要：教训是条件性的，常驻上下文会在此类失败不存在时误触发，从演化 playbook 中移除反而提升性能；而运行时干预仅在失败发生时起作用，却不从修复中学习。因此需要一种按条件暴露失败知识的机制。
AI.method: 提出原则——失败知识是条件性知识，应被条件性暴露——并在 Sentry 中实例化。Sentry 是与智能体并行运行的失败管理层：检测到失败时，从外部 playbook 中检索匹配教训以指导恢复；在无法访问任务奖励的条件下验证智能体是否真正恢复；仅在确认恢复后才存储新教训；完整 playbook 始终不进入智能体上下文。
AI.result: 在多个智能体基准上，Sentry 在每个基准上均超越最强运行时干预基线，平均提升 37%；在两个共同评估的基准上，超越最强上下文演化基线 39%；与上下文演化结合还能带来进一步增益。学到的教训可迁移到留出任务。受控实验表明，即使相关教训仍可按需获取，将完整 playbook 暴露给智能体会降低性能。
AI.conclusion: 失败知识应被视为条件性知识并按需暴露；将失败管理外置为独立层（Sentry）比常驻上下文或纯运行时修复更有效，且与上下文演化方法互补，教训具备可迁移性。

title: Exact Memory-Time Optimization for Prefix-Cached Language Model Serving
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures. Code and reproducibility artifacts: https://github.com/shi1720/prefix-certificate-retention
summary: Retaining language-model prefix states trades recomputation against storage time. Optimizing each cached block independently can overcount savings: a resident block is usable only when the required preceding prefix is also available. We introduce Prefix-Certificate Retention (PCR), an exact finite-trace formulation for static, grouped, reset-on-access timeouts. Usable-prefix rewards become nodes whose prerequisites are timeout thresholds and preceding hit certificates. The resulting maximum-weight closure reduces to one minimum cut, with graph size linear in the number of block lookups and timeout choices. A breakpoint theorem extends the construction to all nonnegative timeouts without discretization error. We also derive a linear-time-in-grid-size dynamic program for ordered timeouts and bounds that certify the cost of this restriction. Exhaustive small-instance checks and chronological replay of 39,632 public Mooncake requests validate the formulation. On the fixed grid, ordered timeouts attain the unrestricted training optimum in 118 of 120 trace-grouping-price cases. Heterogeneous retention improves several held-out memory-time tradeoffs, but finer training optimization does not uniformly improve transfer. The contribution is a tractable optimization model and an auditable benchmark for retention policies; the experiments measure usable prefix blocks and storage time, not GPU latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出前缀证书保留（PCR）模型，将语言模型前缀缓存的静态/分组/重置超时保留问题化为精确有限轨迹优化，证明其可归约为单次最小割求解，并给出有序超时的线性动态规划与转移性基准评测。
AI.motivation: 保留语言模型前缀状态需要在重计算与存储时间之间权衡。独立优化每个缓存块的节省量会高估收益，因为一个常驻块只有在所需的前置前缀同样可用时才能真正可用；因此需要显式刻画块之间的前置依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出 Prefix-Certificate Retention（PCR）：针对静态、分组、访问即重置超时的精确有限轨迹形式化。将可用前缀收益建模为节点，其前置条件是超时阈值与前序命中证书，从而把最大权闭合问题归约为一次最小割，图规模与块查询次数及超时选择数呈线性。用断点定理将构造扩展到所有非负超时且无离散化误差；针对有序超时给出网格规模线性的动态规划，并给出界定该限制代价的界。用穷举小实例与 39,632 条公开 Mooncake 请求的时间序回放进行验证。
AI.result: 在固定网格上，有序超时在 120 个轨迹-分组-价格情形中的 118 个达到无限制训练最优；异质保留改善了若干留出集上的内存-时间权衡，但更精细的训练优化并不一致地提升迁移效果。穷举小实例检查与时间序回放验证了该形式化。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献是一个可处理的优化模型与可审计的保留策略基准。需注意实验衡量的是可用前缀块数量与存储时间，而非 GPU 延迟。

title: Trading Strategy Optimization via Textual Gradient
summary: Quantitative trading strategy design aims to discover trading programs from historical data that remain effective in future markets, which can be viewed as a black-box program optimization problem. LLM-based textual gradients offer a promising approach by providing explicit optimization directions for iterative strategy refinement. However, directly applying textual gradients faces two challenges: (1) optimization is myopic, underutilizing experience from previous evaluations; and (2) aggregate backtest feedback overlooks temporal robustness, potentially favoring strategies that perform well only in specific market periods. To address these challenges, we propose TradeGrad, an experience-guided textual-gradient framework for robust trading strategy optimization. TradeGrad leverages accumulated optimization experience to estimate textual gradients and employs multi-scale revisions for both strategy exploration and refinement. It further introduces the Cross-Period Robust Objective (CPRO), which emphasizes performance in unfavorable historical periods to promote temporal robustness. Experiments on cross-sectional and time-series strategy design in Chinese A-share and U.S. equity markets show that TradeGrad achieves the best in-sample and out-of-sample performance across all four settings. Notably, its Chinese cross-sectional strategy achieves 27.99% annualized return, 12.19% maximum drawdown, and a Sharpe ratio of 1.63, approximately 68% higher than the CSI 300 benchmark. Further analyses validate the proposed components and show consistent improvements in both in-sample and out-of-sample performance throughout optimization. The code is available at https://github.com/transcend-0/TradeGrad.

AI.tldr: 提出TradeGrad框架，用经验引导的文本梯度优化量化交易策略，并引入跨周期稳健目标（CPRO）提升时序稳健性，在A股与美股的四类策略设计中均取得最优样本内外表现。
AI.motivation: 量化交易策略设计可视为黑盒程序优化问题。基于LLM的文本梯度能提供显式优化方向以迭代改进策略，但直接应用存在两个问题：一是优化短视，未充分利用历史评估经验；二是聚合回测反馈忽视时序稳健性，可能偏向仅在特定市场阶段有效的策略。因此需要一种兼顾经验积累与时序稳健性的优化框架。
AI.method: TradeGrad是一个经验引导的文本梯度框架。它利用累积的优化经验来估计文本梯度，并采用多尺度修订进行策略探索与精炼；同时提出跨周期稳健目标（CPRO），强调在不利历史时期的表现，以促进时序稳健性。
AI.result: 在中国A股和美国股票市场的截面与时间序列策略设计共四种设置中，TradeGrad均取得最优的样本内与样本外表现。其中中国截面策略实现27.99%年化收益、12.19%最大回撤、Sharpe比率1.63，较沪深300基准高约68%。进一步分析验证了各组件有效性，并显示优化全程样本内外表现持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 经验引导的文本梯度结合跨周期稳健目标，可有效缓解优化短视与时序稳健性不足问题，为稳健量化交易策略优化提供可行方案，并在多市场多策略类型中验证了有效性与一致性。

title: DEPICT: Scoring Text-to-Image Alignment by Answer Agreement
summary: Image-text alignment is a core problem in computer vision with applications in caption evaluation, hallucination detection, data curation, and the benchmarking of text-to-image (T2I) generators. As T2I models improve, benchmarking has become demanding, requiring metrics capable of finding a series of issues like missing objects, swapped attributes, miscounts, and ignored negations. Recent work addresses this by fine-tuning evaluators on preference data or by prompting a vision-language model, either holistically with the caption or with decomposed verification questions. However, existing approaches fall short: fine-tuned metrics remain bound to one backbone and training distribution; holistic metrics miss fine-grained details; and decomposed metrics rely on a fixed-YES assumption that penalizes faithful images whenever that assumption fails. In contrast, we propose DEPICT, a training-free metric that replaces fixed reference answers with expected agreement between image-based and caption-only answers, weighting questions by how decisively the caption determines them. By replacing fixed references, our agreement rule increases negation accuracy from 19% to 88%. To recover the context lost during decomposition, DEPICT merges this agreement score with a holistic score. We evaluate DEPICT on five benchmarks and eleven backbones from three model families and find that it surpasses all training-free metrics and exceeds fine-tuned evaluators on two out of three human-correlation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 DEPICT，一种无需训练的图文对齐评价指标，用"图像答案与纯文本答案的期望一致性"替代固定参考答案，并与整体性得分融合。
AI.motivation: 图文对齐评价是 caption 评估、幻觉检测、数据筛选和 T2I 生成器基准测试的核心问题。随着 T2I 模型能力提升，评价需要能发现缺失物体、属性错配、计数错误、忽略否定等细粒度问题，但现有方法均有缺陷：微调类指标受限于单一骨干和训练分布；整体式指标丢失细粒度信息；分解式指标依赖"固定为 YES"的假设，一旦该假设不成立就会错误惩罚忠实的图像。
AI.method: DEPICT 是免训练指标。它把分解式验证问题中的固定参考答案替换为"基于图像的答案"与"仅基于 caption 的答案"之间的期望一致性，并按 caption 对该问题的决定程度对问题加权。为弥补分解造成的上下文丢失，将该一致性得分与一个整体性得分融合。评估覆盖 5 个基准、3 个模型家族共 11 个骨干。
AI.result: 替换固定参考答案后，否定（negation）准确率从 19% 提升至 88%。DEPICT 在评估中超过所有免训练指标，并在三个人工相关性基准中的两个上超过微调式评价器。
AI.conclusion: 用期望一致性替代固定参考、并融合整体得分，可同时兼得细粒度判别力与上下文完整性，且无需训练、跨骨干通用，说明免训练指标在图文对齐评价上可以达到甚至超越微调方法。

title: No-Free-Graph: Learning When Multimodal Data Should Be Graphified
summary: Multimodal graph learning has recently emerged as an effective paradigm for in corporating inter-entity relationships into multimodal representations. Existing studies have made substantial progress on how to construct and optimize graphs, but rarely consider a more fundamental question: whether additional relational structures should be introduced for a given dataset and task. Through empirical studies across diverse datasets, tasks, and graph constructors, we reveal that graphification is not consistently beneficial: introducing relational structures can provide substantial improvements in some cases, while offering limited or even negative gains. This observation motivates a new perspective that graph construction should be treated as a selective decision based on its expected utility rather than a default preprocessing step. To address this issue, we propose MAG-SCOUT, a pre-construction graph assessment framework that estimates whether introducing graph structures is beneficial before generating the complete topology. MAG-SCOUT collects limited relational evidence, analyzes its potential taskspecific contribution, and estimates the expected utility of graphification together with construction cost to make a build-or-skip decision. Extensive experiments across six multimodal datasets, three downstream tasks, and diverse graph constructors demonstrate that MAG-SCOUT effectively identifies when graph structures should be introduced, saving 33.1% of task-macro graph work while retaining 96.7% of held-out positive-gain mass under the pre-registered floor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出图化决策框架MAG-SCOUT，在构建完整图拓扑前评估引入关系结构的期望效用，实现"构建或跳过"的自适应决策。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态图学习研究聚焦于图的构建与优化，却忽略了更根本的问题：对给定数据集和任务，是否应当引入额外的关系结构。实证表明图化并非总有益，有时提升有限甚至为负，因此图构建应被视为基于期望效用的选择性决策，而非默认的预处理步骤。
AI.method: 提出MAG-SCOUT预构建图评估框架：在生成完整拓扑之前，采集有限的关系证据，分析其任务特定的潜在贡献，并联合估计图化的期望效用与构建成本，据此做出构建或跳过的决策。
AI.result: 在六个多模态数据集、三个下游任务和多种图构建器上的实验表明，MAG-SCOUT能有效识别何时应引入图结构，在预注册下限约束下节省33.1%的任务级宏平均图工作量，同时保留96.7%的留存正收益质量。
AI.conclusion: 图构建应作为基于期望效用的选择性决策而非默认步骤；MAG-SCOUT通过在完整拓扑构建前进行低成本评估，可有效避免无益的图化开销，为多模态图学习提供了新的决策视角与实用框架。

title: Keeping JEPA World Models Plannable When Little of the Frame Moves
summary: Specifying a goal in language rather than as a goal frame is a natural interface for planning with a latent world model, but testing it needs scenes in which language must discriminate between several objects. We build SLIM, a pushing benchmark with several small objects and paired visual and language goals on identical scenes. On SLIM a LeWM world model that solves PushT succeeds on under 1% of trials, although a scripted controller with simulator state solves every tier. Probes locate the failure in the encoder: its latent is nearly action-insensitive, neither pusher nor object positions can be decoded from it, and rollouts are no better than copying the current latent forward. One inverse-dynamics auxiliary loss, applied to encoder latents and to predicted latents through a shared head discarded at test time, restores every probe and raises success from 0.003 to 0.35 (0.16 on the hard pushing tier, where a goal-agnostic policy scores zero), and improves PushT at twice the trained horizon. Controls attribute the repair to the gradient into the encoder, and a response sweep shows that the vanilla model plans once enough of the frame responds to actions. A cheap action-sensitivity probe, computable without environment access, acts as an empirical necessary condition: all configurations below its threshold failed to plan. On the repaired latent, a small language-goal head plans from sentences without retraining the world model: it reaches 0.84 on navigation (visual-goal oracle 1.00), follows the named zone when it is swapped with a decoy, and degrades gracefully to unseen nouns. A single goal sentence rarely completes a push, but given the push as a sequence of stage sentences the head raises success on the medium and hard pushing tiers from 0.04 to 0.25, on par with the goal-frame oracle, also when the switch between stages is read from the latent alone.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SLIM推物基准（含配对视觉与语言目标），发现LeWM世界模型在PushT上成功但在SLIM上成功率不足1%，问题源于编码器潜表示对动作不敏感；引入逆动力学辅助损失后修复探针并将成功率从0.003提升至0.35，且可支持语言目标规划。
AI.motivation: 用语言而非目标帧作为规划接口更自然，但需要能区分多个物体的场景来检验语言接口。现有基准（如PushT）无法区分编码器是否真正学到语言可区分的潜表示，因此需要构建含多个小物体、视觉与语言目标配对的推物基准（SLIM）来暴露潜在世界模型的失败点。
AI.method: 构建SLIM基准：多个小物体、相同场景下配对视觉和语言目标，含多难度层级。诊断：用探针分析LeWM编码器潜表示（动作敏感性、位置可解码性、rollout质量）。修复：在编码器潜表示及预测潜表示上施加逆动力学辅助损失，通过共享头实现（测试时丢弃该头）。评估：动作敏感性探针（无需环境访问）作为必要条件；在修复后的潜表示上训练小型语言目标头进行语言规划，包括将推物分解为阶段句子序列。
AI.result: LeWM在SLIM上成功率低于1%（脚本控制器在仿真状态下全层级成功）；探针显示潜表示几乎不随动作变化、无法解码推杆或物体位置、rollout不如直接复制当前潜表示。逆动力学辅助损失恢复所有探针，成功率从0.003升至0.35（难推物层级0.16，而目标无关策略为零），并在两倍训练时域上改善PushT。对照实验将修复归因于进入编码器的梯度；响应扫描表明当足够大比例的画面响应动作时，原始模型可规划。动作敏感性探针作为经验必要条件：所有低于阈值的配置均规划失败。语言目标头在导航上达0.84（视觉目标oracle为1.00），在目标与干扰物互换时仍跟随命名区域，对未见名词优雅退化。单句目标很少完成推物，但按阶段句子序列可将中难层级从0.04提升至0.25，与目标帧oracle相当，且阶段切换可仅从潜表示读出。
AI.conclusion: 编码器的动作敏感性是语言目标规划的关键瓶颈；逆动力学辅助损失可低成本修复潜表示，使其支持语言目标规划。所提动作敏感性探针可作为无需环境访问的经验必要条件。语言目标头无需重训世界模型即可实现语言规划，阶段化语言序列能显著提升复杂推物任务成功率。

title: World Embedding Benchmark
summary: Physical fidelity has received increasing attention in world models and video generation, yet how video representations encode physical information remains less understood. We introduce the World Embedding Benchmark, comprising 8,000 controlled simulation cases from 80 families spanning fluid mechanics, solid mechanics, dynamics, and optics & electromagnetism. Each case pairs a rendered video with simulation-derived physical annotations, supporting three complementary tasks: text-video retrieval, physical-property regression, and multiple-choice video-description pair classification. We use these tasks to distinguish cross-modal physical alignment from the recoverability of quantitative physical information. Evaluated pre-trained omnimodal embedding models show weak retrieval and near-chance within-family pair classification, while lightweight probes recover useful physical information from frozen video embeddings. Continual contrastive training with physics-specific video-text pairs improves retrieval and pair classification but degrades physical-property regression, revealing a trade-off between alignment and quantitative information recoverability. Finally, we use the embeddings to retrieve reference videos for retrieval-augmented generation with MiniMax-H3. Retrieved references improve the physical fidelity of generated videos, with stronger retrieval models yielding larger gains in our experiments. Together, these findings highlight the need to evaluate physical alignment and property recoverability jointly, and demonstrate the utility of physical representations for improving video generation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 World Embedding Benchmark（含 8,000 个受控仿真案例，覆盖 80 个物理族与四大领域），通过检索、回归、配对分类三项任务，区分"跨模态物理对齐"与"定量物理信息可恢复性"，并揭示两者之间的权衡，最终用于检索增强的物理逼真视频生成。
AI.motivation: 物理逼真度在世界模型与视频生成中日益重要，但视频表征如何编码物理信息仍缺乏理解，且现有评测难以区分"对齐"与"信息可恢复性"。
AI.method: 构建 World Embedding Benchmark：8,000 个受控仿真案例、80 个物理族，涵盖流体力学、固体力学、动力学、光学与电磁学；每例将渲染视频与仿真导出的物理标注配对，设计文本-视频检索、物理属性回归、视频-描述配对多选题三项任务。评估预训练全模态嵌入模型，并用轻量探针、物理专用视频-文本对的持续对比训练，以及基于 MiniMax-H3 的检索增强生成进行实验。
AI.result: 预训练全模态嵌入模型检索弱、族内配对分类接近随机；轻量探针可从冻结视频嵌入中恢复有效物理信息；物理对比训练提升检索与配对分类，但降低属性回归性能；检索到的参考视频提升生成视频的物理逼真度，检索模型越强增益越大。
AI.conclusion: 物理对齐与属性可恢复性需联合评测；物理表征可用于提升视频生成质量，同时二者存在对齐与定量信息可恢复性的权衡。

title: Nearly Optimal Fixed-Confidence Best-Arm Identification with 1-Bit Feedback
comment: To appear in Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 39 (NeurIPS 2026, Spotlight)
summary: We study fixed-confidence best-arm identification under strict 1-bit feedback constraints. At each round, the learner selects an arm and a query set, and receives only a single bit indicating whether the sampled reward belongs to that set. We consider a distribution-free finite-variance setting with arm-wise localization, where direct empirical mean estimation is no longer available and clipping becomes unavoidable. We first formulate a time-uniform 1-bit mean-estimation primitive based on randomized threshold queries and a clipped tail-integral identity. We then embed this primitive into candidate-challenger best-arm identification algorithms. A fixed-clipping algorithm gives a simple anytime $(ε,δ)$-PAC guarantee, while a phased adaptive-clipping algorithm matches the clipping level to the current resolution and yields a gap-adaptive sample complexity. We also prove a $K$-arm worst-case information-theoretic lower bound showing that the logarithmic penalty caused by finite-variance 1-bit feedback is intrinsic. This bound matches the leading dependence of the phased algorithm up to lower-order $\log\log$ factors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究严格1-bit反馈下的固定置信度最优臂识别问题，提出基于随机阈值查询与截断尾积分恒等式的时间一致1-bit均值估计原语，并嵌入候选-挑战者算法，给出固定截断与分阶段自适应截断两种算法及匹配的K臂最坏情况下界。
AI.motivation: 在严格1-bit反馈下，学习者每轮只能获得样本奖励是否属于查询集的单个比特，无法直接进行经验均值估计，且有限方差设定下截断不可避免，现有均值估计与最优臂识别方法不再适用，因此需要构造适配1-bit反馈的估计原语与识别算法，并厘清有限方差1-bit反馈所带来对数惩罚的内在性。
AI.method: 首先基于随机化阈值查询和截断尾积分恒等式，构造时间一致的1-bit均值估计原语；随后将该原语嵌入候选-挑战者式最优臂识别框架，提出固定截断算法以获得简洁的anytime (ε,δ)-PAC保证，并提出分阶段自适应截断算法，将截断水平与当前分辨率匹配以获得间隙自适应样本复杂度；最后证明K臂最坏情况下的信息论下界。
AI.result: 固定截断算法给出简单的anytime (ε,δ)-PAC保证；分阶段自适应截断算法实现间隙自适应样本复杂度；所证K臂最坏情况信息论下界表明有限方差1-bit反馈导致的对数惩罚是内在的，且该下界与分阶段算法的主导依赖相匹配（仅相差低阶loglog因子）。
AI.conclusion: 在严格1-bit、有限方差且臂级局部化的分布无关设定下，通过随机阈值查询与截断尾积分实现时间一致均值估计，并据此设计候选-挑战者最优臂识别算法，可在固定置信度下达到间隙自适应复杂度；同时有限方差1-bit反馈的对数惩罚不可消除，分阶段算法在主导阶上达到最优（至loglog因子）。

title: Gains and Collapse in On-Policy Distillation:A Reinforcement Learning Perspective
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become an important approach to language model post-training. However, despite its performance gains, OPD can also collapse into excessively long and repetitive generation, and the mechanism underlying these divergent outcomes remains poorly understood. We explain these outcomes through a reinforcement learning perspective: the teacher implicitly rewards student behaviors, even those it rarely exhibits itself. From this perspective, our experiments show that OPD improves performance without expanding the student's capabilities. When the implicit reward model is reliable, OPD makes correct responses easier to sample. In contrast, when the preference misaligns with quality, reward hacking happens: the implicit reward model amplifies overlong, repetitive student rollouts, even though it rarely generates such text itself. Guided by this diagnosis, we find that masking unhealthy responses during training and using SFT initialization can each effectively mitigate the collapse. Together, these findings show that OPD amplifies student behaviors favored by the teacher's implicit feedback, shifting the focus from how well the teacher generates to how reliably it evaluates student rollouts. Our code is available at https://github.com/HancCui/opd_hacking.

AI.tldr: 该论文从强化学习视角解释on-policy distillation (OPD)中的性能提升与崩溃现象：教师模型隐式奖励学生行为，导致OPD仅放大已有能力而非扩展能力，并可通过掩码不健康响应与SFT初始化缓解崩溃。
AI.motivation: OPD已成为语言模型后训练的重要方法，但存在性能提升与过度冗长、重复生成崩溃的分歧结果，且其内在机制尚不清楚，因此需要从理论上解释这些分歧结果。
AI.method: 将OPD解释为强化学习过程，其中教师模型隐式地奖励学生行为（即使教师自身很少展示这些行为）；通过实验观察OPD对学生能力的影响，分析隐式奖励模型可靠性、偏好与质量错配等情形，并测试掩码不健康响应与SFT初始化等干预手段。
AI.result: 实验表明OPD在不扩展学生能力的情况下提升性能：当隐式奖励模型可靠时，OPD使正确响应更易被采样；当偏好与质量错配时，发生reward hacking，隐式奖励模型放大过度冗长、重复的学生rollout（尽管教师自身很少生成此类文本）。训练中掩码不健康响应与使用SFT初始化均能有效缓解崩溃。
AI.conclusion: OPD放大了教师隐式反馈所偏好的学生行为，因此关注点应从教师生成质量转向其对学生rollout的评估可靠性。

title: LoGo: Local-Global Rewards for Consistent Long-Horizon Video Generation
summary: Camera-controlled video models are rapidly advancing toward long generation horizons and complex camera control. A key failure mode is 3D inconsistency: as the camera moves, objects lose permanence and scene structures shift. Existing post-training techniques, which assign a single scalar reward to the entire generation, are poorly suited to correcting these inconsistencies over long horizons. We introduce LoGo, which blends global and spatially localized rewards for camera-controlled video models. The local reward provides fine-grained credit assignment, which substantially improves 3D consistency, while the global reward preserves camera following and video quality. Across three base models, LoGo shows a clear advantage on DL3DV and TrajectoryBench, a new benchmark for long-horizon, complex-camera-control generation that current evaluations lack. LoGo effectively reduces local object shifts, artifacts, and global scene changes, illustrating the importance of credit assignment in post-training video models. Project website: https://ziqi-ma.github.io/logo-website/

AI.tldr: 本文提出LoGo，一种将全局奖励与空间局部奖励相结合的后训练方法，用于提升相机控制视频模型的长时程3D一致性。
AI.motivation: 相机控制视频模型正朝向长生成时程与复杂相机控制发展，但存在3D不一致这一关键失败模式：相机移动时物体失去恒常性、场景结构发生漂移。现有后训练技术为整段生成分配单一标量奖励，难以在长时程上定位并修正这些不一致。
AI.method: LoGo混合全局奖励与空间局部奖励：局部奖励提供细粒度信用分配以显著提升3D一致性，全局奖励则维持相机跟随能力与视频质量。
AI.result: 在三个基础模型上，LoGo在DL3DV与TrajectoryBench（面向长时程、复杂相机控制生成的新基准）上均表现出明显优势，有效减少了局部物体偏移、伪影与全局场景变化。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明信用分配在视频模型后训练中具有重要作用，LoGo为长时程相机控制视频生成的一致性提升提供了有效方案。

title: LatticeSMC: Where to Spend Inference-Time Compute in Chunked Sequence Generators
summary: Long-form generators for music, motion and video produce sequences chunk by chunk, with each chunk generated by iterative denoising while rewards are defined over the full sequence. Existing inference-time steering methods typically act on one axis at a time: best-of-N at the end, Feynman-Kac steering across denoising steps, or streaming pruning across chunks, and are often compared under unmatched compute or different return rules. We introduce budget-matched chunked steering and propose LatticeSMC, a sampler derived from a Feynman-Kac model on the two-dimensional lattice of chunk index and denoising step. Two telescoping results make its design exact: for chunk-additive rewards, the two axes induce identical weights, so resampling should occur where lookahead is cheapest; for terminal rewards, any prefix score defines an exact intermediate potential, making prefix-evaluable rewards twists with no estimation or extra denoiser calls. LatticeSMC resamples on these potentials at chunk boundaries and, when scoring is free, within chunks, returning either a weighted draw or the best particle. Under matched compute, on music-to-dance diffusion and 40-second text-to-music generation, it raises beat alignment from 0.234 to 0.441 (best-of-N: 0.354) and prompt adherence from 0.470 to 0.560 at 32 particles, while preserving held-out quality. It also retains its advantage on long-range rewards and is preferred by human raters in 60-77 percent of pairwise comparisons. Finally, we show that commitment strength should follow the information in the current potential, while the value of lookahead is predicted by the within-set predictability of future reward.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出预算匹配的分块引导框架与LatticeSMC采样器，在"块索引×去噪步"二维格上构建Feynman-Kac模型，通过两个telescoping结论确定重采样位置与中间势函数，在音乐、舞蹈、视频长序列生成中于同等算力下显著提升奖励指标并保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: 长序列生成器（音乐、动作、视频）逐块生成、块内迭代去噪，而奖励定义在完整序列上。现有推理期引导方法（末端best-of-N、跨去噪步的Feynman-Kac引导、跨块的流式剪枝）通常只作用于单一维度，且比较时算力不匹配、回报规则不一致，导致无法公平评估引导策略的真实收益。
AI.method: 提出"预算匹配的分块引导"评测框架，并给出LatticeSMC：在块索引与去噪步构成的二维格上定义Feynman-Kac模型。两个telescoping结果支撑其设计的精确性：(1)对块可加奖励，两个维度诱导权重相同，故应在lookahead成本最低处重采样；(2)对终端奖励，任意前缀分数可定义精确的中间势函数，使前缀可评估奖励成为无需估计、不增加去噪调用的twist。LatticeSMC在块边界基于这些势函数重采样，当打分免费时也在块内重采样，最终返回加权样本或最佳粒子。
AI.result: 在同等算力下，于music-to-dance扩散和40秒文本到音乐生成任务中，32粒子时节拍对齐从0.234提升至0.441（best-of-N为0.354），提示遵循度从0.470提升至0.560，且保持留出质量。在长程奖励上优势依旧，人类评审在60%–77%的成对比较中更偏好其输出。
AI.conclusion: 承诺强度应与当前势函数所含信息量匹配，而lookahead的价值可由未来奖励的集合内可预测性来预测，这为分块长序列生成中的推理期引导提供了原则性设计准则。

title: KV$^2$: A Self-Refining KV Cache
summary: The memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache constrains the practical use of long-context models, and it dominates cost when one prefilled context must later serve many different queries. In this reusable setting, query-agnostic compression trades cost against quality: lightweight estimators are cheap but less accurate, whereas full-context reconstruction scoring is more accurate yet reprocesses the entire prompt. We introduce KV$^2$, a query-agnostic KV-cache compression method based on selective reconstruction. KV$^2$ first uses a lightweight proxy scorer to identify informative in-context tokens, then reprocesses only this subset to compute final eviction scores. On RULER, Needle-in-a-Haystack, and LongBench, KV$^2$'s margin over baselines widens as the budget tightens: on RULER 16K at a 2% KV-cache budget it improves the average score over the next-best baseline by more than 40 percentage points, and on LongBench it attains the highest average across 2%-10% budgets at lower compression-stage runtime and peak memory than full-context reconstruction. Reusable KV-cache compression thus does not require reprocessing the full context. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/KVsquared-0B97.

AI.tldr: KV² 提出一种基于选择性重建的查询无关 KV 缓存压缩方法，无需重处理完整上下文即可实现高效压缩。
AI.motivation: 长上下文模型中 KV 缓存占用巨大内存，在预填充上下文需服务多个查询的可复用场景下，压缩需在成本与质量间权衡：轻量估计器便宜但不准，全上下文重建评分准确却需重处理整个提示。
AI.method: 先用轻量代理评分器识别信息量大的上下文 token，再仅对该子集进行重处理以计算最终驱逐分数。
AI.result: 在 RULER、Needle-in-a-Haystack 和 LongBench 上，预算越紧优势越明显：RULER 16K 在 2% KV 预算下平均分比次优基线高 40 多个百分点；LongBench 上在 2%-10% 预算取得最高平均分，且压缩阶段运行时间和峰值内存均低于全上下文重建。
AI.conclusion: 可复用 KV 缓存压缩无需重处理完整上下文，KV² 验证了选择性重建的有效性。

title: On-Board Anomaly Detection for Efficient Marine Environmental Monitoring
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Presented at the 9th International Workshop on On-Board Payload Data Compression (OBPDC 2024), Gran Canaria, Spain, 2-4 October 2024
summary: Marine ecosystems are impacted by various threats such as oil spills, algal blooms, and sediment floods, which disrupt habitats, wildlife, and human activities. Advances in satellite imagery and Artificial Intelligence (AI) have enhanced our capabilities for early detection and mitigation of such hazards. In this paper, we propose a marine event detection pipeline for Earth observation satellites equipped with multi- or hyperspectral sensors. Our approach includes a self-supervised neural network encoder that compresses satellite images into a reduced latent space, enabling efficient onboard processing. A machine learning anomaly detection model identifies deviations from normal sea patterns to detect environmental anomalies. We compare its performance against traditional algorithms such as Isolation Forest, One-Class Support Vector Machine and Local Outlier Factors. Our lightweight, resource-efficient pipeline is optimized for deployment on satellites with limited computational resources, ranging from embedded CPUs to AI hardware accelerators. By prioritizing the transmission of critical information, our solution enhances system responsiveness and optimizes satellite communication bandwidth. Demonstrated through current integration across multiple missions, including European Space Agency's (ESA) Phisat-2 mission and Microsoft/Thales Alenia Space IMAGIN-e mission, our pipeline aims to improve marine environmental monitoring by providing timely alerts and efficient data reduction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向多/高光谱卫星的在轨海洋事件检测流水线，利用自监督编码器压缩图像并在潜空间中进行异常检测，兼顾资源受限环境下的高效部署。
AI.motivation: 海洋生态系统受溢油、藻华、泥沙洪等威胁，破坏栖息地、野生动物与人类活动；卫星遥感与AI虽提升了早期检测能力，但星上计算资源有限、通信带宽受限，亟需轻量高效的检测方案。
AI.method: 构建自监督神经网络编码器，将卫星图像压缩至低维潜空间以支持高效在轨处理；采用机器学习异常检测模型识别偏离正常海面模式的异常，并与Isolation Forest、One-Class SVM、Local Outlier Factor等传统算法进行对比；流水线针对嵌入式CPU到AI加速器等不同硬件进行轻量化优化。
AI.result: 流水线实现轻量、资源高效，可在从嵌入式CPU到AI硬件加速器的星载平台上部署；通过优先传输关键信息，提升系统响应速度并优化卫星通信带宽；已在ESA Phisat-2及Microsoft/Thales Alenia Space IMAGIN-e等多项任务中集成验证。
AI.conclusion: 该方案通过自监督压缩与潜空间异常检测，实现海洋环境监测的及时告警与数据缩减，提升海洋环境监测效率，适用于多任务星载部署。

title: Tailoring the Quantization Space for 1-Bit KV Cache Compression
summary: The key-value (KV) cache becomes a major memory bottleneck in long-context LLM inference, placing substantial pressure on memory capacity and bandwidth. To mitigate this bottleneck, vector quantization (VQ) has emerged as a promising approach for aggressive KV cache compression. However, existing VQ methods degrade substantially in the 1-bit regime. At such extreme compression, each codebook must represent a larger group of channels with a limited set of centroids, making effective use of its capacity increasingly challenging. To address this, we introduce $\textbf{TaSQ}$, which tailors the VQ target space by combining query-guided channel weighting, cross-head normalization, and covariance-aware channel grouping to better reflect the error sensitivity and statistical structure of cached activations. Since these transforms are RoPE-compatible and can be easily merged into projection weights and codebooks, TaSQ preserves the conventional VQ lookup structure and adds negligible serving overhead. Across general, long-chain-of-thought reasoning, and long-context retrieval benchmarks, TaSQ consistently outperforms existing low-bit KV cache VQ baselines while preserving reasoning stability. On a single RTX 6000 Ada GPU, its SGLang implementation supports up to $14\times$ larger batch sizes and achieves $1.87\times$ higher peak throughput compared to the BF16 baseline.

AI.tldr: TaSQ通过定制向量量化（VQ）目标空间——融合查询引导通道加权、跨头归一化与协方差感知通道分组——在1-bit极端压缩下实现高效KV cache量化，兼顾推理稳定性与serving效率。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM推理中KV cache成为内存容量与带宽瓶颈，向量量化是激进压缩的有前景方案，但现有VQ方法在1-bit极端压缩下性能显著退化：每个码本需用有限质心表示更大通道组，容量利用愈发困难。
AI.method: 提出TaSQ，通过定制VQ目标空间改善压缩效果，包含三项关键设计：查询引导的通道加权（query-guided channel weighting）、跨头归一化（cross-head normalization）、协方差感知的通道分组（covariance-aware channel grouping），以更好反映缓存激活的误差敏感性与统计结构。这些变换兼容RoPE，并可合并进投影权重与码本，从而保留常规VQ查表结构，serving开销可忽略。
AI.result: 在通用、长链思维链推理与长上下文检索基准上，TaSQ持续优于现有低比特KV cache VQ基线，并保持推理稳定性。在单张RTX 6000 Ada GPU上，其SGLang实现相比BF16基线支持最高14倍更大批处理规模，峰值吞吐提升1.87倍。
AI.conclusion: TaSQ通过针对性定制VQ目标空间，有效缓解1-bit KV cache量化的容量瓶颈，在多项任务中超越基线、保持推理稳定，并在实际serving中显著提升批处理规模与吞吐，是一种高效且低开销的低比特KV cache压缩方案。

title: Controlling Polar Exposure to Delay Memorization in Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models can reach useful sample quality before copying training examples, but fast optimization can compress this generalization window by accelerating sample-specific fitting. We investigate this effect through update geometry and propose Quality-Gated De-whitening (QGD), a controller that retains a fast polar-update prefix and progressively restores fixed-gain momentum. Our random-feature analysis separates covariance-controlled, curvature-equalized and amplitude-controlled memorization clocks. Under aligned spectral assumptions, it establishes a finite-exposure condition under which a fixed-gain tail recovers a delay proportional to dataset size. QGD implements this principle with a confirmed quality gate, a bounded decay envelope and causal copy feedback. Immediate switching is the conservative limit; gradual control balances delayed copying against continued quality improvement. We pair QGD with Copy-Budgeted Selection (CBS), which applies simultaneous binomial calibration to a frozen checkpoint family, followed by a fresh evaluation of the released checkpoint. On 2,000-image CIFAR-10 subsets, QGD preserves the polar baseline's quality-arrival time while expanding its useful interval by 8.32x and reducing common-checkpoint copying by 75.9%. With identical calibration and independent quality evaluation, QGD achieves FID 75.56 versus 79.37 for SGD with the same selector. Exposure-matched controls, independent detector audits and transfer to flow matching and dance generation support adaptive exposure control as a practical way to improve the quality-copying tradeoff.

AI.tldr: 本文研究扩散模型快速优化压缩泛化窗口（加速样本特定拟合）的现象，提出质量门控去白化（QGD）控制器，在快速极坐标更新前缀后逐步恢复固定增益动量，以延迟复制同时保持质量提升。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在复制训练样本之前可达到可用样本质量，但快速优化会通过加速样本特定拟合压缩这一泛化窗口，即质量达标与开始复制之间的"有用区间"。作者希望从更新几何角度理解该效应，并找到一种实用的曝光控制方法来改善质量-复制权衡。
AI.method: 通过随机特征分析区分协方差控制、曲率均衡和幅度控制的三种记忆时钟；在对齐谱假设下给出有限曝光条件，证明固定增益尾部可恢复与数据集规模成正比的延迟。据此设计QGD：保留快速极坐标更新前缀，逐步恢复固定增益动量，并配备经确认的质量门、有界衰减包络与因果复制反馈。即时切换为保守极限。同时提出Copy-Budgeted Selection（CBS），对冻结检查点族做同期二项校准，再对发布检查点进行独立评估。
AI.result: 在2,000张图像的CIFAR-10子集上，QGD在保持极坐标基线质量到达时间的同时，将有用区间扩大8.32倍，并将共同检查点复制降低75.9%。在相同校准与独立质量评估下，QGD相比使用同一选择器的SGD达到FID 75.56对79.37。曝光匹配对照、独立检测器审计以及向流匹配和舞蹈生成的迁移均支持该结果。
AI.conclusion: 自适应曝光控制是改善扩散模型质量-复制权衡的实用方法，QGD通过更新几何层面的延迟复制机制有效扩展泛化窗口，并具备跨任务迁移能力。

title: Toward SLM-based agentic task-tool intent matching
summary: Tool-equipped AI agents use tool calls to access data and act on external systems. Horizontal growth of agentic systems increases the number of these interactions, and further motivates the need for automated, per-call oversight that can operate at low latency and/or on-prem. Conventional authorization schemes can determine whether an agent is allowed to invoke a tool, but cannot assess the agent's underlying cognition, specifically, whether the tool selection represents a logical, relevant step toward satisfying the intent of the task or not. Consequently, an allowed call may still deviate from the task's intent: a rogue agent might deviate the calls or nudge other agents to make a combination of calls that would not align with the intent of the task. Therefore, every call needs to be verified. In this study we investigate the applicability of Small Language Models (SLMs) to this purpose: an SLM functions as a task-tool relevance classifier that evaluates every selected tool independently against the assigned task and returns a relevance signal for downstream enforcement. Equipped with a novel dataset with multi-tool tasks whose required tools span distinct Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, we used prompt-optimization, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning through GRPO to optimize and specialize SLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究用小语言模型（SLM）充当任务-工具相关性分类器，对AI智能体的每次工具调用独立评估其与任务意图的相关性，以弥补传统授权机制无法判断"认知层"合理性的缺陷；采用提示优化、监督微调与GRPO强化学习在多MCP服务器任务数据集上优化并专用化SLM。
AI.motivation: 工具型AI智能体通过工具调用访问数据并作用于外部系统，智能体系统的横向扩张使交互数量激增，产生了低延迟、可本地部署的逐次调用自动监管需求。传统授权方案只能判断智能体是否被允许调用某工具，无法评估其底层认知——即该工具选择是否是朝向任务意图的合乎逻辑、相关的步骤。因此被授权的调用仍可能偏离任务意图：恶意智能体可能使调用偏离，或诱导其他智能体组合出与任务意图不符的调用。故每一次调用都需被验证。
AI.method: 将SLM用作任务-工具相关性分类器，对每个被选中的工具独立地针对所分配任务进行评估，并输出相关性信号供下游执行环节使用。构建了一个新数据集，其多工具任务所需工具跨越不同的模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器。使用提示优化、监督微调，以及通过GRPO进行的强化学习来优化并专用化SLM。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体的实验数值结果，仅说明研究路线与资源情况：以自建的多MCP服务器多工具任务数据集为基础，采用提示优化、监督微调与GRPO强化学习三类手段对SLM进行优化与专用化。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，仅靠传统授权不足以保障智能体工具调用的意图一致性，需对每次调用进行相关性验证；SLM作为逐调用的任务-工具相关性分类器具备可行性，可作为低延迟、可本地部署的监管组件向下游输出相关性信号。

title: ProAR: Learning Prospective Reasoning with Autoregressive Video Models
summary: Autoregressive (AR) video models excel at causal generation, but their reliance on next-chunk prediction confines them to a short-sighted, reactive paradigm. This limitation is particularly consequential for reasoning-oriented generation, where achieving a target outcome through valid intermediate states matters more than local visual plausibility. To address this challenge, we propose Learning Prospective Reasoning with Autoregressive Video Models (ProAR), a novel framework that transforms autoregressive video generation into a goal-oriented reasoning process. ProAR introduces two key components: (1) To anchor generation to the long-range outcome, we integrate goal-frame prediction into the autoregressive loop via an asymmetric attention mask, enabling the predicted goal frame to guide the generation of intermediate states without being disrupted by them. (2) To guide short-range transitions, we introduce future representation self-alignment to encourage current hidden states to anticipate upcoming temporal dynamics. By leveraging teacher-forcing in AR training, we extract clean future representations in a single forward pass and align current representations with them using a lightweight, training-only predictor. Together, these two mechanisms seamlessly combine explicit, sparse target supervision with implicit, dense step-wise guidance, promoting coherent, goal-directed reasoning progress with modest computational cost. Experiments show that ProAR's complementary components consistently improve performance across diverse visual reasoning benchmarks. The framework proves highly training-efficient, surpassing fully trained standard AR baselines using only 25% of the training steps. This paradigm also demonstrates promising applicability to embodied reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出ProAR框架，将自回归视频生成转变为目标导向的推理过程，通过目标帧预测与未来表征自对齐两大机制，在少量训练成本下提升视觉推理性能。
AI.motivation: 自回归（AR）视频模型擅长因果生成，但依赖"下一块预测"（next-chunk prediction）使其局限于短视、被动的范式。在面向推理的生成任务中，通过有效的中间状态达成目标结果比局部视觉合理性更为重要，而现有AR范式难以满足这一需求，因此需要将自回归视频生成转化为目标导向的推理过程。
AI.method: ProAR包含两个关键组件：(1) 目标帧预测（goal-frame prediction）：通过非对称注意力掩码（asymmetric attention mask）将目标帧预测整合进自回归循环，使预测的目标帧引导中间状态的生成，且不被中间状态干扰；(2) 未来表征自对齐（future representation self-alignment）：借助AR训练中的teacher-forcing，在单次前向传播中提取干净的未来表征，并用轻量级、仅训练时使用的预测器将当前表征与之对齐。两者结合了显式稀疏目标监督与隐式密集逐步引导。
AI.result: 实验表明，ProAR的互补组件在多种视觉推理基准上持续提升性能；该框架训练效率极高，仅用25%的训练步数即可超越完全训练的标准AR基线；在具身推理任务上也展现出良好的适用性。
AI.conclusion: ProAR通过将目标帧预测与未来表征自对齐相结合，以适中的计算成本实现了连贯、目标导向的推理过程，验证了将自回归视频生成重构为前瞻性推理范式的有效性，并具备向具身推理等任务推广的潜力。

title: Adaptive Second-Order Solvers for Fast Stochastic Diffusion Sampling
summary: Diffusion models rely on numerical solvers requiring time-discretization, which has a large influence on the tradeoff between sampling cost and quality. However, the computational difficulty of the reverse process varies along the sampling trajectory and across data distributions, making the choice of discretization important. We adapt proportional-integral (PI) step-size control to diffusion, using our diffusion noise-normalised error estimator. Unlike existing adaptive methods in diffusion that respond only to the current error, the PI solver also incorporates the previous error, yielding smoother step adaptation. We further show that these per-sample trajectories exhibit shared structure and can be aggregated into a fixed schedule that retains much of the benefit of adaptive sampling. We evaluate both approaches on natural-image and language datasets, in terms of quality, measured by FID at a matched number of neural network evaluations (NFE), comparing them with widely used stochastic solvers and schedules. For images, our fixed discretization outperforms the commonly used EDM schedule in terms of sample quality when used with the stochastic Heun sampler, and with the EDM-churn sampler at low NFE. Additionally, our PI adaptive solver obtains better FID than most stochastic and adaptive baselines, although it does not beat the EDM-churn sampler at low NFE. Moreover, we find our solver outperforms both the EDM and the entropy schedule on language diffusion at low-to-medium NFE in terms of perplexity, with the drawback of lower token entropy. Lastly, we find that the benefit of per-sample adaptivity is problem-dependent. It is highly beneficial in 1D toy examples, while only marginal for image and language data, where the average schedule sometimes even outperforms the PI-adaptive solver. Code is available at https://github.com/ellakemperman/adaptive-second-order-diffusion-solvers

AI.tldr: 本文将比例-积分（PI）步长控制引入扩散模型采样，提出基于噪声归一化误差估计的自适应求解器，并将自适应轨迹聚合为固定调度；在图像和语言数据上，固定调度在部分设置下优于EDM调度，PI自适应求解器在FID/困惑度上优于多数随机与自适应基线，但自适应收益具有问题依赖性。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型的数值求解需要时间离散化，其直接影响采样成本与生成质量的权衡。反向过程的计算难度沿采样轨迹及不同数据分布而变化，因此离散化（步长/调度）的选择至关重要。现有扩散自适应方法仅对当前误差作出响应，步长调整不够平滑，且缺乏对自适应收益普适性的考察。
AI.method: 将比例-积分（PI）步长控制迁移到扩散采样，配合所提出的扩散噪声归一化误差估计器；与仅依赖当前误差的自适应方法不同，PI求解器同时纳入历史（先前）误差，从而获得更平滑的步长调整。进一步观察到逐样本轨迹存在共享结构，将其聚合为固定调度，以保留自适应采样的大部分收益。在自然图像与语言数据集上，以匹配的神经网络评估次数（NFE）下的FID（图像）和困惑度（语言）为指标，与广泛使用的随机求解器及调度进行对比。
AI.result: 图像方面：固定离散化配合随机Heun采样器时，样本质量优于常用的EDM调度，在低NFE下配EDM-churn采样器时同样更优；PI自适应求解器的FID优于大多数随机与自适应基线，但在低NFE下不及EDM-churn采样器。语言扩散方面：在低至中等NFE下，求解器在困惑度上优于EDM调度与熵调度，代价是更低的token熵。此外，逐样本自适应性的收益依赖具体问题：在一维玩具示例中收益显著，而在图像与语言数据上仅边际，平均调度有时甚至优于PI自适应求解器。
AI.conclusion: PI步长控制可为扩散采样提供更平滑的自适应，且其逐样本轨迹可聚合为具有竞争力的固定调度；但自适应的实际收益具有问题依赖性，在图像和语言任务上相对于精心设计的固定调度优势有限。代码已开源。

title: Learning a Fact Is Not Learning How to Retrieve It
summary: A model trained on "The capital of X is Y" may produce "Y" after "The capital of X is" but fail after "The capital of X:". We call these different ways of eliciting the same fact request forms. To separate learning a fact from retrieving it, we train two models in two stages. In the first stage (request-form training), one model sees each fact in five forms and the other sees the same facts only as statements. In the second stage (target-fact training), both receive identical training on new facts, all as statements. Both then retrieve the new facts almost equally well from statements, but differ sharply on other request forms. Thus, a model can learn how to retrieve through a request form before it learns the facts. To understand this difference, we examine the hidden state immediately before the answer, which we call the context state. When given two different request forms for the same fact, the model trained on five forms in stage one produces more similar context states than the model trained on statements alone in that stage. Changing this state at retrieval time can enable or prevent retrieval of an already learned fact, and the same effect transfers across facts and factual relations, such as capitals and currencies. To test its role during learning, we change the context state only during target-fact training. This intervention changes later retrieval without intervention at test time. Together, these results show that later retrieval depends on earlier request-form experience and the context state during fact learning.

AI.tldr: 论文通过两阶段训练分离"学习事实"与"检索事实"，发现请求形式的经验与答案前的上下文状态（context state）共同决定后续检索表现。
AI.motivation: 模型对同一事实的不同提问形式（request forms）表现差异很大，例如"The capital of X is Y"能答对，但"The capital of X:"却失败。作者希望厘清：模型究竟是在何时、以何种方式学会"检索"一个事实，以及这一能力与事实学习本身如何分离。核心问题是：检索能力能否在学习事实之前就已获得？答案前的隐藏状态在检索中扮演什么角色？
AI.method: 采用两阶段训练范式。第一阶段（request-form training）：一个模型以五种形式接触每个事实，另一个模型仅以陈述句形式接触相同事实。第二阶段（target-fact training）：两模型以完全相同的方式（均为陈述句）学习新事实。随后测量两者从陈述句及其他请求形式中检索新事实的能力，并比较答案前一刻的隐藏状态（context state）的相似性。进一步在检索时或仅在目标事实训练期间干预该上下文状态，检验其因果作用及跨事实、跨关系（如首都、货币）的迁移性。
AI.result: 两模型从陈述句中检索新事实的表现几乎相当，但在其他请求形式上差异显著。第一阶段接触多形式的模型，对同一事实的不同请求形式会产生更相似的上下文状态。在检索时改动该状态可促成或阻止对已学事实的检索，且该效应可迁移到不同事实和事实关系（如首都与货币）。仅在目标事实训练期间改动上下文状态，即可在不干预测试的情况下改变后续检索表现。
AI.conclusion: 后续检索能力依赖两个因素：早期的请求形式经验，以及事实学习过程中的上下文状态。这意味着"学会检索"可以先于"学会事实"发生，且上下文状态是连接学习与检索的关键中介变量。

title: SigLIP2 for aerial fire risk classification
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Code available at https://github.com/yunusserhat/firerisk
summary: We examine the transfer of a pretrained SigLIP2 image encoder to seven class fire risk classification from aerial imagery. We introduce a reproducible partition of the public FireRisk training mirror and an implementation that records data provenance, preprocessing and model selection. Two initial runs compare a frozen encoder probe with full model adaptation. On the validation partition, full adaptation reaches 63.05% accuracy and 58.94% macro F1, compared with 55.95% and 50.19% for the probe. Both runs use one training seed and select their checkpoint on the same validation partition. These development results support further evaluation of SigLIP2 but do not establish performance on an independent test set or unseen regions. The accompanying code provides a common framework for repeated experiments and comparisons with additional visual encoders.

AI.tldr: 该文将预训练SigLIP2图像编码器迁移至航空影像的7类火灾风险分类任务，构建了可复现的数据划分与实验框架，并比较了冻结探针与全模型适配两种方案。
AI.motivation: 探索预训练视觉编码器（SigLIP2）在航空影像火灾风险分类中的迁移能力，并建立一个可复现、记录数据来源与预处理流程的通用实验框架，以便后续与更多视觉编码器进行对比。
AI.method: 对公开FireRisk训练镜像进行可复现划分；记录数据来源、预处理与模型选择过程；开展两组初期实验，对比冻结编码器探针（frozen encoder probe）与全模型适配（full model adaptation），两者均使用单一训练随机种子，并在同一验证集上选择检查点。
AI.result: 在验证集上，全模型适配达到63.05%准确率与58.94%宏F1，优于探针的55.95%准确率与50.19%宏F1。
AI.conclusion: 上述仅为开发阶段结果，支持对SigLIP2的进一步评估，但尚不能确立其在独立测试集或未见区域上的性能；随附代码为重复实验及与其他视觉编码器的比较提供了统一框架。

title: Efficient Memory Crystallization for Graph Learning under Non-Stationary Distribution Shifts
comment: Accepted by the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Deep graph learning models deployed in real-world systems often need to cope with non-stationary environments, where the underlying graph distribution drifts continually over time. Prevailing solutions rely on training auxiliary generative modules to synthesize memory graphs for cross-domain adaptation, which incurs substantial computational overhead and scales poorly under prolonged distribution shifts. We argue that a more economical path exists: rather than generating memory, one can crystallize it. To this end, we propose Efficient Memory Crystallization (EMC), a training-free test-time framework that distills each incoming graph domain into a compact, semantically faithful memory through a closed-form solution to a memory-oriented distribution-matching objective, thereby eliminating redundant domain information under continual covariate shifts. To preserve both generalizability and adaptability as the model traverses a long sequence of target domains, EMC further models inter-domain dependencies through state-evolving memories and admits a theoretically grounded, tighter generalization error bound than direct adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of EMC over state-of-the-art baselines on graphs under non-stationary distribution shifts, while reducing average runtime by 87.4% and GPU memory consumption by 92.4% relative to the recent competitor, making continual graph adaptation practical at scale.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练测试时框架EMC，通过闭式解将每个到来的图域"结晶"为紧凑记忆，实现非平稳图分布漂移下的高效持续图适应。
AI.motivation: 真实系统中的深度图学习模型需应对底层图分布随时间持续漂移的非平稳环境。现有方法依赖训练辅助生成模块合成记忆图以进行跨域适应，计算开销大，且在长时间分布漂移下扩展性差，因此需要更经济的路径。
AI.method: EMC为免训练（training-free）的测试时框架：通过求解面向记忆的分布匹配目标的闭式解，将每个到来的图域蒸馏为紧凑且语义忠实的记忆，从而在持续协变量漂移下消除冗余域信息；同时通过状态演化记忆建模域间依赖，以在长序列目标域上兼顾泛化性与适应性。
AI.result: 在非平稳分布漂移图上的大量实验表明，EMC优于当前最先进基线；相比近期竞品，平均运行时间降低87.4%，GPU显存消耗降低92.4%。
AI.conclusion: EMC以"结晶而非生成"的思路替代传统生成式记忆合成，提供理论上更紧的泛化误差界，使大规模持续图适应变得实用可行。

title: EVOL: Simulator-Guided Evolutionary Expert Synthesis for Deployment-Free Learning Path Recommendation
comment: Accepted at the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for learning path recommendation (LPR) faces two coupled obstacles. First, the policy must commit to a sequence of L concepts without intermediate feedback, producing a combinatorial search space that grows super-exponentially with L and provides reward only at the final step. Second, expert learning paths would be the natural cure for sparse-reward RL, but they do not exist in educational data, because student logs record what learners did, not what they should have done. We address both obstacles by importing a recipe from simulator-based demonstration learning in robotics: the knowledge tracing simulator is used both to synthesize per-learner expert demonstrations through evolutionary search and to train a deployment-free policy that distills these demonstrations into a feed-forward learner. Our framework, EVOL, instantiates this pipeline with an asymmetric actor-critic where the actor commits to deployment-realistic blind planning while the critic exploits the privileged simulator state during training. Across three datasets (ASSIST15, Junyi, and EdNet; 39-189 concepts) and path lengths L = 5, 10, and 20, EVOL surpasses 8 baselines spanning heuristic, sequential, RL, graph-enhanced RL, and LLM-enhanced methods. We further compare three imitation strategies (BC, AWR, and DAPG) and show that final performance is governed by the quality of evolutionary experts rather than by the particular imitation objective.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出EVOL框架，通过知识追踪模拟器合成专家示范并蒸馏为前馈策略，解决学习路径推荐中组合搜索空间大与奖励稀疏的问题。
AI.motivation: 学习路径推荐（LPR）的强化学习面临两个耦合障碍：一是策略需在无中间反馈情况下一次性提交L个概念的序列，导致搜索空间随L超指数增长且仅在最后一步获得奖励；二是专家学习路径本可缓解稀疏奖励问题，但教育数据中并不存在，因为学生日志记录的是学习者实际做了什么，而非本应做什么。
AI.method: 借鉴机器人基于模拟器的示范学习方法，利用知识追踪模拟器：一方面通过进化搜索为每个学习者合成专家示范，另一方面训练一个无需部署的策略，将这些示范蒸馏为前馈学习器。EVOL采用非对称actor-critic架构，actor执行符合部署现实的"盲规划"，而critic在训练时利用特权模拟器状态。
AI.result: 在三个数据集（ASSIST15、Junyi、EdNet；39-189个概念）及路径长度L=5、10、20上，EVOL超越8个基线方法，涵盖启发式、序列式、RL、图增强RL及LLM增强方法。此外比较了三种模仿策略（BC、AWR、DAPG），表明最终性能由进化专家的质量决定，而非特定模仿目标。
AI.conclusion: EVOL通过引入基于模拟器的示范学习范式，有效应对了LPR中组合搜索与稀疏奖励的双重挑战，且性能关键在于进化专家示范的质量。

title: FlowHMR: Physically Plausible Motion Capture from Video
summary: We present FlowHMR, a framework for recovering physically plausible global 3D human motion from monocular video. Previous learning-based methods typically regress human motion directly from video and train the network with geometric supervision. However, recovering human motion from monocular video is inherently ambiguous in depth, and direct regression tends to collapse toward an averaged solution. Moreover, the recovered motions are not guaranteed to be physically plausible, so physics-based tracking of them often fails. To address these challenges, we formulate video motion capture as a video-conditioned motion generation problem and first pretrain a flow matching model for this task. Given an input video, the pretrained model generates diverse motion candidates, but not all of them are faithful to the video or physically trackable. We therefore post-train the model using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with two rewards. A fidelity reward encourages consistency with the input video. A tracking reward favors motions that a physics-based controller can track successfully. Together, these rewards shift the model's output preference, so the post-trained model stays faithful to the input video while producing more physically plausible motion. We further introduce Wild-4K, a large and diverse dataset of about 4K internet videos, for evaluating human motion recovery in the wild. Qualitative and quantitative experiments on Wild-4K show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods in overall motion fidelity and achieves a physical tracking success rate of 82.47%, compared with 62.82% for the strongest baseline, GVHMR.

AI.tldr: 提出 FlowHMR，将单目视频人体运动捕捉重构为"视频条件运动生成"问题：先预训练流匹配模型生成多样运动候选，再用 GRPO 结合"保真度奖励"与"可跟踪性奖励"进行后训练，并发布 Wild-4K 数据集。方法在整体运动保真度上超越 SOTA，物理跟踪成功率达 82.47%（基线 GVHMR 为 62.82%）。
AI.motivation: 从单目视频恢复全局 3D 人体运动存在深度固有的歧义性，直接回归易坍缩到"平均解"，且所恢复运动不保证物理可行，导致基于物理的跟踪经常失败。现有基于学习的方法仅依赖几何监督，难以同时兼顾对视频的忠实性与物理可跟踪性。
AI.method: 将视频动作捕捉形式化为视频条件的运动生成任务。首先在该任务上预训练一个流匹配（flow matching）模型，由输入视频生成多样化的运动候选；随后使用 GRPO（组相对策略优化）进行后训练，引入两类奖励：保真度奖励（fidelity reward）促使生成结果与输入视频一致，跟踪奖励（tracking reward）偏好物理控制器能够成功跟踪的运动。二者共同改变模型的输出偏好，使其在保持视频忠实性的同时生成更符合物理规律的运动。
AI.result: 在自建的 Wild-4K（约 4K 段互联网视频、规模大且多样）数据集上进行定性与定量实验，所提方法在整体运动保真度上优于现有最先进方法，物理跟踪成功率达到 82.47%，而最强基线 GVHMR 仅为 62.82%。
AI.conclusion: 以"生成+强化学习后训练"的范式替代传统直接回归，可有效缓解单目运动恢复中的深度歧义与平均解坍缩问题，并显著提升物理可跟踪性；同时 Wild-4K 为野外场景下的人体运动恢复评估提供了大规模多样化基准。

title: Muon Learns Facts Better: Understanding the Role of Spectral Orthogonalization
summary: The Muon optimizer applies spectral orthogonalization to matrix-valued updates and has shown strong performance in large-scale neural network training, yet the mechanisms of this transformation in feature learning remain poorly understood. In this work, we investigate this question through a tractable factual-recall model, where a fact maps each subject-relation pair to an answer, and a linear transformer learns the subject- and relation-dependent information required to recover this mapping. The transformer is optimized with gradient flow (GF), spectral GF, or Sign GF, which are continuous-time limits of gradient descent, Muon, and Adam, respectively. Prior studies (Nichani et al., 2025) have shown that when the number of subjects exceeds the number of relations, GF learns relation-dependent information before subject-dependent information, producing a feature-separation phase during training. We characterize this separation with the learning times when the subject- and relation-dependent components of the prediction reach a target accuracy. With $S$ subjects and $R$ relations, GF has a learning-time ratio of $\widetildeΘ(\sqrt{S/R})$, whereas Spectral GF reduces this ratio to $\widetildeΘ(1)$. In addition, for fixed $S$ and $R$, the subject- and relation-dependent errors decay as $1/(T\log T)$ in training time $T$ under GF, but as $\exp(-\mathrm{poly}(T))$ under spectral GF. Finally, we show that GF and spectral GF are equivariant under orthogonal transformations of the token embeddings, whereas Sign GF is not: Different orthonormal embeddings can potentially produce no feature separation, a large feature-separation phase, or even a reversed learning order. These results provide a mechanistic view of how spectral orthogonalization can fundamentally reshape feature-learning dynamics.

AI.tldr: 通过可处理的事实回忆模型，揭示Muon（谱正交化）相对梯度流的特征学习机制优势。
AI.motivation: Muon优化器对矩阵更新做谱正交化并在大规模训练中表现优异，但其对特征学习的作用机制尚不清楚，需要可解释的理论分析。
AI.method: 采用线性Transformer的事实回忆模型（主体-关系对映射到答案），分别用梯度流(GF)、谱GF(Muon连续极限)与Sign GF(Adam连续极限)优化，刻画主体与关系依赖成分的学习时间、误差衰减及正交等变性。
AI.result: GF的学习时间比为Θ̃(√(S/R))，谱GF降为Θ̃(1)；固定S、R时GF误差按1/(T log T)衰减，谱GF按exp(-poly(T))衰减；GF与谱GF对token嵌入的正交变换等变，Sign GF不等变，可导致无分离、大分离相位甚至学习顺序反转。
AI.conclusion: 谱正交化能从机制上根本重塑特征学习动力学，加速并均衡特征分离过程。

title: JOVE: Joint Execution and Verification for Resource-Aware LLM Task Graphs
summary: Complex reasoning queries can be decomposed into directed acyclic task graphs and distributed across heterogeneous LLMs, reducing latency through parallelism and enabling smaller models to solve complex tasks. In practice, however, the suitability of an LLM for a given subtask may be a priori unknown, and execution alone does not reveal output correctness. We propose JOVE, an online framework that jointly assigns executor LLMs and selects intermediate outputs for paid verification. Verification runs asynchronously and is used to improve future allocations, so the system must balance spending on execution now against learning for later. We study how to optimize this trade-off under a long-term budget and a per-query latency constraint, with stochastic, initially unknown LLM service quality, invocation costs, and execution times. JOVE makes execution and verification decisions by solving a sequence of per-query mixed-integer linear programs. Online learning updates task-dependent estimates of LLM quality based on verification feedback, while an information-gain bonus incorporates the value of learning into allocation decisions. Under a natural set of assumptions, we establish sublinear quality-learning regret for JOVE. Across four reasoning benchmarks, JOVE achieves competitive accuracy against standard inference baselines while reducing average cost and latency by at least 3.17 times.

AI.tldr: JOVE是一个在线框架，通过联合分配执行LLM与挑选中间输出进行付费验证，并在长期预算和单查询延迟约束下优化执行开销与学习收益的权衡，实现复杂的DAG式推理任务分解与异构LLM调度。
AI.motivation: 复杂推理查询可分解为有向无环任务图并分布式执行于异构LLM，但LLM对特定子任务的适配性先验未知，且仅靠执行无法揭示输出正确性，因此需要引入付费验证并在线学习服务质量、调用成本与执行时间的随机分布。
AI.method: JOVE求解一系列逐查询混合整数线性规划（MILP）以同时决策执行与验证；利用异步验证反馈进行在线学习，更新任务相关的LLM质量估计；并在分配决策中引入信息增益奖励以纳入学习价值，从而在长期预算与延迟约束下平衡当期执行开销与未来学习。
AI.result: 在自然假设下，JOVE获得了次线性的质量学习遗憾（sublinear quality-learning regret）；在四个推理基准上，JOVE在保持与标准推理基线竞争性精度的同时，将平均成本与延迟降低至少3.17倍。
AI.conclusion: JOVE证明了将执行分配与付费验证联合建模为序贯MILP并结合在线学习与信息增益奖励，可在预算与延迟约束下有效提升异构LLM推理效率，兼顾精度、成本与延迟。

title: Decoding the Functional Roles of Register and High-Norm Patch Tokens in Vision Transformers
summary: Self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs), such as DINOv2, learn rich visual representations, but the functions of their internal tokens remain poorly understood. Recent architectures introduce dedicated register tokens to reduce high-norm out- lier patch tokens that emerge in background re- gions, yet the semantic and functional roles of both token types have not been fully established. In this paper, we analyze these roles by training sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on register-token and outlier-token activations in DINOv2. Using an automated interpretability pipeline, UMAP clus- tering, and CLIP-space cross-checks, we find that register-token features are more strongly associ- ated with high-level semantic concepts. Outlier- token features, by contrast, are more often associ- ated with lower-level structural, background, and texture-dominant patterns. Causal ablations fur- ther reveal a substantial functional asymmetry: disrupting top-activating register-derived features produces a 48.17% drop in representation cosine similarity, whereas disrupting outlier-derived fea- tures produces only a 0.31% drop. Together, our results provide evidence for token specialization in self-supervised ViTs.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）分析DINOv2中register token与高范数离群patch token的语义与功能差异，发现register token偏高层语义、离群token偏底层纹理结构，且两者功能影响存在显著不对称（48.17% vs 0.31%）。
AI.motivation: 自监督ViT（如DINOv2）虽学到丰富视觉表征，但内部token功能理解不足；已有架构引入register token以抑制背景区域的高范数离群patch token，却缺乏对这两类token语义与功能角色的系统刻画，作者因此希望填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在DINOv2的register-token与outlier-token激活上训练稀疏自编码器（SAE），结合自动化可解释性pipeline、UMAP聚类与CLIP空间交叉验证分析特征语义，并进行因果消融实验比较两类token衍生特征对表征的影响。
AI.result: register-token特征更强关联高层语义概念；outlier-token特征更多关联底层结构、背景与纹理主导模式。因果消融显示显著功能不对称：破坏top-activating的register衍生特征导致表征余弦相似度下降48.17%，而破坏outlier衍生特征仅下降0.31%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持自监督ViT中token存在专门化（token specialization），即register与outlier token在语义层级和功能贡献上具有明确分工。

title: Gated Slot Attention-2: Two-Sided Associative Memory Correction in Linear Attention
summary: Linear attention models have emerged as efficient alternatives to standard attention, but effectively managing their fixed-size recurrent memory remains challenging. To improve memory, recent work has explored two distinct directions: delta-rule variants for precise correction of values associated with keys, and slot-based architectures such as Gated Slot Attention for modeling key and value memories in two stages. We observe that these directions are complementary--the delta rule provides effective memory correction, while the two-stage structure provides a natural way to operate on both sides of an association. Building on this insight, we introduce a new Gated Oja Rule for key-side correction and extend it with decoupled erase and write control to obtain Gated Oja Rule-2. We then introduce Gated Slot Attention-2 (GSA2), which combines Gated Oja Rule-2 for key-side correction with Gated Delta Rule-2 for value-side correction through shared latent slots. We further derive a hardware-efficient chunkwise algorithm for parallel training. Experiments demonstrate that GSA2 consistently improves over strong linear-attention baselines across benchmarks while retaining linear-time sequence modeling and constant-memory recurrent decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Gated Oja Rule 及 Gated Oja Rule-2，并构建 Gated Slot Attention-2（GSA2），通过关键侧校正与值侧校正的互补结合提升线性注意力记忆管理能力，同时给出分块并行训练算法。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力虽高效，但其固定大小的循环记忆难以有效管理。现有两条改进路线各有优势且互补：delta-rule 变体用于精确校正键对应的值；槽位架构（如 Gated Slot Attention）以两阶段方式建模键记忆与值记忆，为在关联两侧操作提供了自然结构。
AI.method: 基于上述互补性，提出用于键侧校正的 Gated Oja Rule，并通过解耦擦除与写入控制扩展为 Gated Oja Rule-2。进一步提出 GSA2，将键侧校正的 Gated Oja Rule-2 与值侧校正的 Gated Delta Rule-2 通过共享潜在槽位结合，并推导出硬件高效的分块（chunkwise）算法以支持并行训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，GSA2 在多个基准上持续优于强线性注意力基线，同时保持线性时间序列建模与常数内存的循环解码。
AI.conclusion: 键侧校正与值侧校正具有互补性，结合二者可有效提升线性注意力的记忆管理；GSA2 在性能与效率之间取得良好平衡。

title: Optimal Planning in a Dynamic World
summary: Background: We address the problem of planning when the set of feasible states or actions changes over time. For example, in the problem of path planning among moving obstacles (sometimes known as SIPP), the feasibility of being at a particular location can change as the obstacles move. Or, the action of boarding a particular train is feasible only while it is stopped at the station. This dynamism means that the optimal plan and its duration can change depending on when execution begins. In practice, execution start time is often unknown until planning has completed or another agent gives the go-ahead. However, most prior planning work either ignores dynamism or assumes a known start time. This makes it straightforward to assess state and action feasibility but is impractical for some applications. Objectives: In this paper, we relax the assumption of a known start time. We define the setting of {\em any-start-time planning} and provide algorithms for it. Methods: We present a data structure called a compound arrival time function (cATF) that compactly encodes the optimal plan as a function of start time. We provide general-purpose planning algorithms, based on heuristic graph search, that assemble cATFs by propagating functions along edges instead of scalar costs. Results: We prove that the size of a cATF is at most linear in the problem size. An experimental evaluation of an implementation for the specific problem of SIPP shows that, on difficult problems, agents that rely on replanning often fail, while any-start-time algorithms using cATFs can quickly look up the optimal plan once the execution start time is known. Conclusions: By enabling efficient representations and reasoning for time-dependent plans, this work provides a foundation for planning in dynamic worlds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“任意起始时间规划”问题，用复合到达时间函数(cATF)紧凑编码最优计划作为起始时间的函数，并给出基于启发式图搜索的通用算法。
AI.motivation: 在移动障碍物路径规划等场景中，可行状态或动作随时间变化，最优计划及其时长取决于执行起始时间；但现实中起始时间常在规划完成后才确定，而既有工作多忽略动态性或假定已知起始时间，导致不实用。
AI.method: 放宽已知起始时间假设，定义any-start-time planning；引入compound arrival time function(cATF)数据结构，沿边传播函数而非标量代价，基于启发式图搜索组装cATF的通用规划算法。
AI.result: 证明cATF规模至多与问题规模成线性关系；针对SIPP的实验显示，依赖重规划的智能体在困难问题上常失败，而使用cATF的任意起始时间算法一旦获知起始时间即可快速查得最优计划。
AI.conclusion: 通过支持时变计划的高效表示与推理，为动态世界中的规划奠定基础。

title: 4DCodeBench: Benchmarking Agents on Inverse Graphics of Dynamic Scenes
summary: We introduce 4DCodeBench, a benchmark for 4D inverse graphics through code generation, in which agents reconstruct dynamic scenes from video as executable graphics programs. To accomplish this, agents must translate visual observations into compact representations of scene structure and dynamics, by implementing abstractions such as physical simulations to reproduce complex behavior. To evaluate this capability, we curate a set of real-world videos and construct synthetic scenes spanning diverse physical phenomena, including deformation, fluid flow, and fracture. We perform extensive benchmarking of frontier models, finding that strong static reconstruction capabilities do not yet translate into reliable reconstruction of complex dynamics. 4DCodeBench provides a testbed for tracking progress toward agents that can interpret the dynamics of the world through code. Our benchmark is available at https://github.com/4DCodeBench/4DCodeBench

AI.tldr: 提出4DCodeBench基准，通过代码生成实现4D逆图形，评估智能体从视频中重建动态场景为可执行图形程序的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体具备较强的静态场景重建能力，但尚不清楚其能否可靠地重建复杂动态场景（如形变、流体、断裂等物理现象），缺乏相关评测基准。
AI.method: 构建4DCodeBench基准：收集真实世界视频并构造涵盖形变、流体流动、断裂等多种物理现象的合成场景，要求智能体将视觉观测转化为包含场景结构与动力学的紧凑表示，并通过物理模拟等抽象实现；对前沿模型进行大规模基准测试。
AI.result: 实验发现，现有模型的强静态重建能力尚不能迁移为对复杂动力学的可靠重建。
AI.conclusion: 4DCodeBench为追踪"通过代码理解世界动态"的智能体进展提供了测试平台，基准已开源。

title: Adaptive Spectral-Koopman Dynamics Modeling for Temporal Domain Generalization
summary: Temporal Domain Generalization (TDG) has emerged to address real-world streaming data with distribution shifts over time. However, existing methods are either prone to overfitting to domain-specific noise in the data space or become overly complex and less interpretable in the parameter space. To bridge these gaps, we propose \textbf{AdaSpecK}, a spectral-Koopman framework with adaptive context extraction for TDG. To mitigate noise fitting to irregularly sampled domains, we introduce spectral-regularized Koopman dynamics modeling, which applies spectral-aware filtering in the latent space to extract denoised low-frequency trajectories and learn a Koopman operator to model the system dynamics in a linearized space. To model complex historical environments under non-stationarity, we design a context-informed heterogeneous pattern extraction mechanism. Specifically, we employ a target-conditioned attention module to attend to distinct past windows, producing a dynamic, target-specific historical summary. By constructing an environmental signature from the current evolutionary pattern, our model adaptively perceives which aspects of the past context are most informative for future prediction via a learned router. Extensive experiments on eight diverse classification and regression benchmarks demonstrate that AdaSpecK achieves state-of-the-art performance. The code and datasets are available at \href{}{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Ada-Spec-K}.

AI.tldr: 提出AdaSpecK，一个结合谱正则化Koopman动力学与自适应上下文提取的时序域泛化框架，在8个分类与回归基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现实流式数据随时间存在分布偏移，时序域泛化(TDG)需应对非平稳性。现有方法要么在数据空间过拟合域相关噪声，要么在参数空间过于复杂且可解释性差。本文旨在同时缓解噪声拟合与模型复杂性问题。
AI.method: 提出AdaSpecK谱-Koopman框架：(1) 谱正则化Koopman动力学建模——在潜空间施加谱感知滤波，提取去噪的低频轨迹，并学习Koopman算子在线性化空间中建模系统动力学，以缓解不规则采样域上的噪声拟合；(2) 上下文感知异构模式提取机制——用目标条件注意力模块关注不同历史窗口，生成动态的、目标特定的历史摘要；再从当前演化模式构造环境签名，通过可学习路由器自适应感知过去上下文中对预测最有信息量的部分。
AI.result: 在8个多样化分类与回归基准上，AdaSpecK取得最先进(state-of-the-art)性能，验证了方法的有效性与通用性。
AI.conclusion: AdaSpecK通过谱正则化Koopman建模与自适应上下文提取，兼顾去噪、线性化动力学建模与历史上下文选择，为时序域泛化提供了一种有效且相对可解释的解决方案，代码与数据集已公开。

title: Lightweight, Rubric-Guided Trajectory Evaluation for Production AI Agents
summary: Trajectory evaluation is essential for improving the reliability of LLM-based agents, but production use makes it expensive to run repeatedly. Modern agents generate long traces containing tool calls, observations, retries, and external outputs, while not all raw tokens are equally useful for diagnosis. We present \textit{LiteTrajEval}, a lightweight architecture for budget-bounded trajectory evaluation. LiteTrajEval derives compact domain-specific rule profiles offline, then preprocesses each trajectory online, marks heuristic failure signals, serializes it under a fixed global budget, and invokes a single rubric-guided LLM judge to produce structured diagnostic reports. Evaluated on public Magentic-One-style and $τ$-bench-style trajectory datasets, LiteTrajEval improves failure-localization alignment with human annotations by roughly 20--35 percentage points on Magentic-One and up to 23 percentage points on $τ$-retail compared with AgentRx, while reducing cost by about 6$\times$ and evaluation time by more than 8$\times$. This solution has also been deployed in our enterprise agentic platform.

AI.tldr: LiteTrajEval 是一种预算受限的轻量级 LLM 智能体轨迹评估架构，通过离线规则画像与在线预算化序列化，结合单次评分引导的 LLM 评判，在提升故障定位对齐度的同时大幅降低成本与评估时间。
AI.motivation: 基于 LLM 的智能体轨迹评估对提升可靠性至关重要，但在生产环境中反复运行成本高昂。现代智能体产生的长轨迹包含工具调用、观测、重试与外部输出，而并非所有原始 token 对诊断都同等有用，因此需要一种在有限预算下高效评估轨迹的方案。
AI.method: LiteTrajEval 采用两阶段设计：离线阶段抽取紧凑的领域特定规则画像；在线阶段对每条轨迹进行预处理，标记启发式失败信号，在固定全局预算下进行序列化，并调用单次评分引导（rubric-guided）的 LLM 评判器生成结构化诊断报告。
AI.result: 在公开的 Magentic-One 风格与 τ-bench 风格轨迹数据集上，与 AgentRx 相比，LiteTrajEval 在 Magentic-One 上将故障定位与人工标注的对齐度提升约 20–35 个百分点，在 τ-retail 上最高提升 23 个百分点，同时成本降低约 6 倍，评估时间缩短 8 倍以上。该方案已在企业智能体平台中部署。
AI.conclusion: LiteTrajEval 证明了在预算约束下通过规则画像、启发式信号标记与单次 LLM 评判即可实现高质量、低成本、低延迟的智能体轨迹诊断，具备生产级可用性。

title: MoSE3: Learning World-Space SE(3) at Every Pixel
summary: Dense 3D point tracking has been a prominent paradigm for modeling motion in dynamic scenes, but a point track is just a 3-DoF translation curve per pixel: it captures where pixels go, not the rotation of the underlying part, nor which pixels move together as one body. We propose MoSE3, the first feed-forward model that predicts dense SE(3) motion from monocular RGB video, producing full 6-DoF rigid transforms at every pixel in world space. Per-pixel SE(3) motion offers a richer view of how a scene moves: rotation, translation, and grouping all at once. Directly predicting SE(3) is challenging: rotations lie on a curved manifold that is ill-suited to Euclidean regression, and annotations for SE(3) are particularly difficult to acquire. To address these challenges, MoSE3 predicts per-pixel SE(3) through two jointly learned intermediates, 3D point tracks and rigidity embeddings, and recovers SE(3) by differentiably fitting transforms within each soft rigid cluster, enabling end-to-end prediction and supervision. To close the data gap, we introduce Art-Kubric, a large-scale synthetic dataset with dense SE(3) and rigidity labels for articulated objects with rich physical interactions. MoSE3 achieves state-of-the-art SE(3) estimation at pixel, part, and object levels on both rigid and articulated benchmarks, and state-of-the-art average 3D point tracking accuracy across three datasets, while showing strong generalization to real-world videos despite being trained solely on synthetic motion data.

AI.tldr: MoSE3是首个从单目RGB视频前馈预测稠密SE(3)运动（每像素6自由度刚体变换）的模型，通过联合学习3D点轨迹与刚性嵌入并做可微聚类拟合实现端到端监督，同时提出Art-Kubric合成数据集，在多个基准上达到SOTA并泛化到真实视频。
AI.motivation: 现有稠密3D点跟踪只给出每像素3自由度平移曲线，只能反映"像素去哪了"，无法刻画部件旋转，也无法识别哪些像素属于同一刚体。场景运动建模需要同时获得旋转、平移与分组信息。此外，直接预测SE(3)存在两大困难：旋转位于弯曲流形上不适合欧氏回归；SE(3)标注极难获取，存在数据缺口。
AI.method: MoSE3以单目RGB视频为输入，前馈预测世界坐标系下每像素的完整6自由度刚体变换。为规避旋转流形回归问题，模型不直接回归SE(3)，而是联合学习两个中间表示——3D点轨迹与刚性嵌入（rigidity embeddings），再通过在不同可微软刚性聚类内拟合变换（differentiable fitting）来恢复SE(3)，从而支持端到端预测与监督。为弥补数据缺口，作者构建了Art-Kubric大规模合成数据集，为具有丰富物理交互的铰接物体提供稠密SE(3)与刚性标注。
AI.result: MoSE3在刚性与铰接基准上，于像素级、部件级、物体级均取得最先进的SE(3)估计性能；在三个数据集上取得最先进平均3D点跟踪精度；尽管仅在合成运动数据上训练，仍对真实世界视频表现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 以每像素SE(3)替代3自由度点轨迹，可统一表达场景的旋转、平移与刚体分组；借助3D点轨迹与刚性嵌入的联合中间表示及可微聚类拟合，能够绕开旋转流形回归难题并实现端到端监督；Art-Kubric数据集有效缓解了稠密SE(3)标注缺失问题。该方法在多项任务上达到SOTA，并展现出从合成到真实的迁移潜力。

title: All Work And No Play Makes Jack a Dull Boy: Understanding and Preventing Catastrophic Strategy Collapse in RLVR
summary: During post-training of large language models (LLMs) with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), GRPO-style algorithms can exhibit severe late-stage collapse. Prompt-based probing reveals that this is not benign strategic pruning, but a harmful contraction of effective strategy capacity that makes distinct reasoning strategies increasingly inaccessible. To characterize this phenomenon, we define strategies through trajectory-level policy-update interactions and develop a unified theoretical framework combining optimization dynamics and information theory. We prove that major RLVR objectives progressively concentrate probability mass onto a single strategy, while sustaining nontrivial task accuracy requires a minimum strategy capacity. The conflict between these two results provides a mechanistic explanation for catastrophic collapse. We further derive the {Mirrored Entanglement Index (MEI)} as a lightweight online warning signal. To prevent collapse, we propose \textbf{Mesh Learning}, which exposes multiple reasoning strategies and prevents any single strategy from dominating optimization. Across AIME26, AIME25, MATH-500, GPQA, and LiveCodeBench, Mesh Learning consistently outperforms strong baselines across Qwen and Phi model families, with gains of up to 13.4 pp and 11.5 pp, respectively. These results establish strategy preservation as a key principle for stable RLVR. Code is available at https://github.com/Ayanami-0123/Open-Mesh-Learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究RLVR中GRPO类算法的后期崩溃现象，证明其主要RLVR目标会将概率质量集中于单一策略，并提出MEI预警信号与Mesh Learning方法以维持策略多样性，在多个基准上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: GRPO类算法在大模型RLVR后训练中会出现严重的后期崩溃。提示式探测表明这并非良性的策略剪枝，而是有效策略容量的有害收缩，使不同推理策略逐渐不可访问。作者希望从机制上解释这一现象并加以防止。
AI.method: 通过轨迹级策略更新交互定义策略，结合优化动力学与信息论构建统一理论框架，证明主要RLVR目标会将概率质量逐步集中到单一策略，而维持任务准确率需要最低策略容量；并推导出镜像纠缠指数（MEI）作为轻量级在线预警信号。为防崩溃，提出Mesh Learning，暴露多个推理策略并防止任一策略主导优化。
AI.result: 在AIME26、AIME25、MATH-500、GPQA和LiveCodeBench上，Mesh Learning在Qwen与Phi模型家族中持续优于强基线，增益分别最高达13.4个百分点和11.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 策略保持（strategy preservation）是稳定RLVR的关键原则。理论分析揭示的优化目标与任务准确率需求间的冲突为灾难性崩溃提供了机制解释，MEI可用于在线预警，Mesh Learning有效缓解崩溃并提升性能。

title: Multi-Task Evolution for Zero-Shot Cross-Problem Generalization using LLMs
summary: Designing effective heuristics for diverse combinatorial optimization problems requires substantial expertise and repeated search. Large language models (LLMs) automate heuristic generation and refinement, but heuristic search typically depends on evaluation feedback from the problem being optimized. Generalizing to new problem definitions using only source-task feedback therefore remains a central challenge. We introduce MECo, an LLM-driven multi-task evolutionary framework for zero-shot cross-problem generalization. MECo maintains task-conditioned heuristic populations and uses a transfer gap based on cross-task population performance to guide their interactions. These interactions enable the transfer and recombination of heuristics. A complementary selection criterion then constructs a compact heuristic set by rewarding each member's additional coverage of source combinations. The selected set is applied to target problems without further search or adaptation. Experiments on 32 problem variants across vehicle routing (VRP) and flexible job-shop scheduling (FJSP) show that MECo achieves the lowest mean costs compared with eight automated heuristic design (AHD) baselines under the same budgets. On out-of-domain problems, it outperforms the strongest baseline in each family. Moreover, integrating the framework of MECo with different AHD methods improves their ID and OOD performance in both families, supporting its effectiveness across different methods.

AI.tldr: MECo：LLM驱动的多任务进化框架，通过跨任务种群交互实现零样本跨问题启发式泛化。
AI.motivation: LLM可自动化启发式生成与改进，但启发式搜索通常依赖目标任务自身的评估反馈，仅用源任务反馈难以泛化到新问题定义，这是核心挑战。
AI.method: 维护任务条件化的启发式种群；以跨任务种群表现为基础的迁移差距指导种群交互，实现启发式的迁移与重组；再用互补选择准则，奖励各成员对源任务组合的额外覆盖，构建紧凑启发式集；该集直接用于目标任务，无需再搜索或适配。
AI.result: 在车辆路径（VRP）与柔性作业车间调度（FJSP）共32个问题变体上，相同预算下平均成本低于八个自动启发式设计（AHD）基线；在域外问题上，于两个问题族中均优于最强基线；将MECo框架与不同AHD方法结合，可同时提升它们的域内（ID）与域外（OOD）性能。
AI.conclusion: MECo验证了基于跨任务种群交互与互补选择的零样本跨问题启发式泛化有效性，并具有良好的方法兼容性。

title: Predicting and Repairing Merge Collapse in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models fine-tuned from a shared base can be merged by averaging their task vectors, but some merges collapse far below the base model, and common merge operators give no warning before evaluation. We show that one statistic of the specialists' task vectors both predicts this collapse and calibrates its repair. The power that averaging removes equals the variance of the task vectors across specialists, our measure of interference. Under a working noise model, the disturbance that a merge injects grows with the merge coefficient and with interference, yielding a pre-merge score. In our experiments on twenty-two merge configurations from four model families, only destructive merges exceed a threshold on this score.
