We find that statistics of sign conflict between specialists, a common target of existing merge operators, are anti-predictive. We then predicted the outcomes of fourteen merges before evaluating them, and twelve predictions were correct, including the destructive outcome of a specialist pair pushed past the threshold by continued pretraining. To address this collapse, we introduce PRISM, an operator that averages the task vectors first and then soft-thresholds each layer at a level set by the layer's interference. Without data or tuning, PRISM keeps all five destructive merges above the threshold within evaluation noise of the base model, where plain averaging falls at least 14.4 points below it or collapses entirely. We apply PRISM only above the threshold and keep the plain average for merges below it, which include all fifteen harmless ones. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/PRISM.

AI.tldr: 论文发现任务向量间的方差（干涉度）可预测模型合并的崩溃，提出预合并评分与无需数据调参的PRISM算子修复崩溃。
AI.motivation: 共享基座微调的大模型可通过平均任务向量合并，但部分合并会严重崩溃且现有算子无法在评估前预警，缺乏崩溃预测与修复手段。
AI.method: 指出平均所移除的"功率"等于任务向量跨专家间的方差，作为干涉度量；在工作噪声模型下，合并注入的扰动随合并系数与干涉度增长，据此构建预合并评分。提出PRISM算子：先平均任务向量，再按每层干涉度设置水平对各层进行软阈值处理，仅在评分超阈值时启用。
AI.result: 在四模型家族、22种合并配置中，仅破坏性合并超过评分阈值；符号冲突统计反而具有反向预测性。预测14次合并结果，12次正确。PRISM在无数据无调参下使全部5个破坏性合并保持在阈值之上，而朴素平均低至少14.4分甚至完全崩溃；15个无害合并仍用朴素平均。
AI.conclusion: 任务向量方差是兼具崩溃预测与修复校准作用的统计量；基于干涉度阈值的PRISM可实现无需数据和调参的稳健模型合并。

title: Refinement Buys Intelligibility, Search Buys Identity: What Test-Time Compute Buys in Masked-Diffusion TTS
summary: Diffusion language models for text-to-speech combine two forms of computation: model depth (parameters) and refinement steps (inference budget). We ask whether they scale equally across capabilities. We train 15 masked-diffusion codec TTS models varying depth (19-133M parameters, 3 seeds) on 2,000 hours of speech and sweep refinement steps T in [1,16] at inference, measuring zero-shot synthesis via ASR word error rate (intelligibility) and speaker verification (identity) on 174 held-out speakers. Against measured floors, refinement closes 86.2% of the intelligibility range but only 46.4% of the identity range - a 1.86x asymmetry robust across multiple error metrics. Retraining at 3x and 6x schedule attenuates but does not reverse this gap (1.84 to 1.36 to 1.23x), because intelligibility saturates with steps while identity continues improving. Best-of-K search recovers speaker identity where refinement fails, with 64.6-79.0% win rates across four independent encoders. Depth and steps are not interchangeable: separable B(d)B(T) fits significantly better (Delta AICc=+69.3) than substitution models. Analysis shows 62% of remaining identity deficit lies in the codec, not the generator. We conclude that refinement and depth target different bottlenecks and should be optimized separately.

AI.tldr: 在掩码扩散编解码TTS上扫描模型深度(19-133M)与推理细化步数T∈[1,16)，发现细化步数对可懂度的补偿(86.2%)远高于对说话人身份(46.4%)，呈1.86倍不对称，且二者不可互换，需分别优化。
AI.motivation: 扩散式TTS同时消耗两类计算预算：模型深度（参数量）与细化步数（推理预算）。论文质疑二者是否在不同能力维度上等价缩放，即是否存在"深度与步数可互相替代"的隐含假设。
AI.method: 训练15个掩码扩散编解码TTS模型，深度覆盖19-133M参数（3个随机种子），数据为2000小时语音；推理端扫描细化步数T∈[1,16]。在174个留出说话人上做零样本评测，用ASR词错误率衡量可懂度、用说话人验证衡量身份一致性。设置实测下限（floor），对比细化步数对两类指标区间缺口的填补比例；并在3x、6x训练预算下重训验证稳健性；用Best-of-K搜索检验身份瓶颈可否被采样弥补；用B(d)B(T)可分解模型与替换模型做AICc比较；最后定位剩余身份缺口的来源。
AI.result: 细化步数填补了86.2%的可懂度区间，但仅填补46.4%的身份区间，不对称比1.86x，且在多种误差指标下稳健。加大训练预算(3x/6x)仅使该比值从1.84降至1.36、再降至1.23，未反转，原因是可懂度随步数饱和而身份持续提升。Best-of-K搜索在四个独立编码器上取得64.6-79.0%的胜率，可弥补细化无法挽回的身份损失。模型比较显示可分解的B(d)B(T)拟合显著优于替换模型(ΔAICc=+69.3)。分析表明剩余身份缺口中62%来自编解码器而非生成器。
AI.conclusion: 细化步数与模型深度针对不同瓶颈：步数主要解决可懂度，深度（及编解码器容量）主导说话人身份。二者不可互换，应作为独立维度分别优化；身份维度的改进重点应放在编解码器侧。

title: AdaStep: Adaptive Step Credit Weighting for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents are typically trained with sparse outcome rewards, making trajectory-level objectives too coarse to distinguish the contribution of individual decisions. Step-level credit assignment provides finer-grained supervision, but its estimates can be unreliable because observed returns also depend on subsequent actions, environment transitions, and trajectory length. We propose AdaStep, an Adaptive Step-credit weighting method that controls how strongly each group-derived local advantage modifies the trajectory-level signal. We formulate this weighting as a mean-squared-error estimation problem for the latent step advantage and, under an explicit conditional sampling assumption, derive an optimal per-state shrinkage coefficient. The coefficient admits a signal-to-total-variance interpretation: it preserves local credit when return variation is attributable to the selected action and suppresses it when variation is dominated by downstream randomness. AdaStep requires only lightweight scalar computation, with no critic, additional rollouts, or extra model inference. Experiments with three model backbones on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld show consistent improvements over baselines at low computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出AdaStep，一种自适应步级信用加权方法，将步级优势加权建模为MSE估计问题，在条件采样假设下推导最优收缩系数，无需critic或额外采样，在三个基准上稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 长时程LLM智能体通常仅用稀疏结果奖励训练，轨迹级目标过于粗糙，无法区分单个决策的贡献；而步级信用分配虽提供更细粒度监督，但其估计不可靠，因为观测回报还依赖后续动作、环境转移和轨迹长度。因此需要一种机制来调节步级信号的可靠性。
AI.method: 将轨迹级信号与组内推导的局部优势的加权强度设计为对潜在步级优势的均方误差（MSE）估计问题；在显式条件采样假设下推导出每状态的最优收缩系数（shrinkage coefficient），该系数具有信噪比/信总方差解释：当回报方差可归因于所选动作时保留局部信用，当方差被下游随机性主导时抑制之。实现仅需轻量标量计算，不需要critic、额外rollout或额外模型推理。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和ScienceWorld三个环境中，使用三种模型骨干进行实验，相比基线在低计算成本下取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: AdaStep以最小开销实现可靠的步级信用分配，用理论推导的自适应收缩系数平衡轨迹级与步级信号，实验验证其有效性与效率。

title: Understanding Enrichment in Reinforcement Learning
summary: When rewards are sparse, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) often uses hints or intermediate guidance to generate more successful rollouts. This enrichment biases policy-gradient updates unless corrected via importance weights, but existing methods omit correction or truncate importance weights in order to avoid the high variance of correction. It thus remains unclear what exactly is gained or lost in RLVR by correcting enriched rollouts. We show, mathematically, that omitted or truncated correction implicitly reweights the defined reward, and we decompose the resulting gradient error into scale, rotation, and variance to explain their distinct effects on learning. To make correction practical, we develop a novel sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) weight correction mechanism that, under stability and particle-order assumptions, tempers the exponential compounding of standard correction variance over the length of a sample to an additive accumulation. We then apply our analysis of enrichment to interpreting the results of a fine-tune of Qwen3-1.7B on a sparse band of OpenMathReasoning, establishing a concrete mechanism of how enrichment, both corrected and uncorrected, helps avoid collapse in sparse domains. Our main contribution is to understand, in general, how enrichment and correction can affect training, as opposed to claiming that either mode of operation is superior to unenriched RL.

AI.tldr: 本文从数学上刻画了在可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中，使用提示/中间引导"富集"rollout 并进行或不进行重要性修正时对策略梯度的隐式影响，并提出基于序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）的权重修正机制以实用化修正。
AI.motivation: 奖励稀疏时，RLVR 常借助提示或中间引导生成更成功的 rollout；但这种富集会使策略梯度产生偏差，除非用重要性权重修正。现有方法要么忽略修正，要么为规避高方差而截断权重，导致"修正富集 rollout 到底带来什么收益与损失"这一问题尚不清楚。
AI.method: (1) 数学证明：省略或截断的修正等价于对既定奖励进行隐式重加权；(2) 将该梯度误差分解为尺度（scale）、旋转（rotation）与方差（variance）三个分量，以解释它们各自的学习效应；(3) 提出一种新的序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）权重修正机制，在稳定性与粒子序假设下，将标准修正方差随样本长度的指数级累积降低为加性累积。
AI.result: 理论上给出了修正的隐式重加权解释与梯度误差的尺度/旋转/方差分解，并将修正方差由指数增长改善为加性累积。实证上将该富集分析用于解释 Qwen3-1.7B 在 OpenMathReasoning 稀疏区段微调的结果，揭示了富集（无论修正与否）帮助避免稀疏域崩塌的具体机制。
AI.conclusion: 本文的主要贡献在于一般性地理解富集与修正如何影响训练，而非宣称某种操作模式优于未富集的 RL。

title: Preserving Mathematical Reasoning in Compressed Diffusion Language Models via Trajectory-Aware Low-Rank Approximation
summary: Diffusion language model (dLLM) compression faces a known challenge because calibration is typically performed on clean, fully visible activations, whereas inference traverses partially masked intermediate states. For low-rank compression, this raises two questions. First, can low-rank optimality still be characterized when approximation quality is measured over trajectory-distributed states, and second, does the choice of calibration states affect mathematical reasoning preservation under compression? We address these questions by formulating a trajectory-aware low-rank objective over corruption levels and masking realizations. To estimate this objective efficiently, we propose Traj-MC, which estimates the trajectory second moment through Monte Carlo sampling and yields exact sampled-state optimality and population consistency. Under matched compression budgets, trajectory-aware calibration improves reconstruction over the generation trajectory and preserves substantially more mathematical reasoning than clean calibration on mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Our results connect trajectory-aware low-rank optimality to the reasoning capability retained after dLLM compression. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Zishan-Shao/traj-mc.git.

AI.tldr: 针对扩散语言模型（dLLM）压缩中"校准态与推理态不匹配"的问题，提出轨迹感知低秩目标及Traj-MC估计方法，在同等压缩预算下优于干净校准，并更好保留数学推理能力。
AI.motivation: dLLM压缩存在校准与推理不一致：校准通常在干净、全可见激活上进行，而推理过程中会经过部分掩码的中间状态。这一差异引发两个问题：当近似质量在轨迹分布状态上度量时，低秩最优性是否仍可刻画；以及校准状态的选择是否影响压缩后数学推理能力的保持。
AI.method: 将低秩压缩目标形式化为跨"加噪/破坏水平"与"掩码实现"的轨迹感知目标；提出Traj-MC，通过蒙特卡洛采样估计轨迹二阶矩，从而高效求解该目标。
AI.result: Traj-MC具有采样状态上的精确最优性与总体一致性；在匹配压缩预算下，轨迹感知校准在生成轨迹上的重构优于干净校准，并在数学推理基准上显著保留更多推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 将轨迹感知低秩最优性与dLLM压缩后保留的推理能力建立联系，说明校准状态选择对推理保持有实质影响。代码已开源。

title: Multilingual GSM-Symbolic: What determines capability transfer across languages?
summary:
We understand little about how capabilities acquired in one language carry over to another, or what governs this transfer: evaluations rely on incomparable, saturation-prone datasets and rarely examine its determinants jointly. Identifying what predicts transfer would let us avoid exhaustive evaluation across all language pairs and let developers target the factors that limit performance in low-resource languages. To evaluate cross-lingual capability transfer, we introduce Multilingual GSM-Symbolic, an extensible multilingual mathematical dataset covering 30,000 item-matched question-answer pairs and spanning 15 languages. It utilises symbolic templates to prevent overfitting and ensure generalisation by allowing generation of millions of high-quality variations from a single sample. Using Multilingual GSM-Symbolic, we quantify the largest determinants of capability as model size ($β= 1.77$), language resource level ($β= 0.77$), reasoning ($β= 0.67$) and typological distance ($β= -0.25$). This joint estimation allows these determinants to be expressed in terms of one another: a 32B model evaluated in Marathi performs like a 10B model in English. Our findings have important implications for model developers, showing that model size and reasoning narrow the performance gap between low- and high-resource languages ($β= -0.27$ and $β= -0.20$, respectively), while similar levers have little or no effect on typologically distant languages.
  Overall, our analysis framework explains 92% of between-language variation, but only 23% of the model-by-language variation, and predicts a model's performance on an unseen language within 6.0pp (r=.96). Incorporating measurements from just 10 templates in the target language reduces this to 4.19pp, enabling reasonable estimates of performance with little or no downstream dataset.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Multilingual GSM-Symbolic 多语言数学数据集（3 万题对、15 种语言），联合量化跨语言能力迁移的决定因素，并构建能解释与预测跨语言性能差异的分析框架。
AI.motivation: 学界对能力如何从一种语言迁移到另一种语言知之甚少，现有评估依赖不可比且易饱和的数据集，且很少联合考察迁移的决定因素。识别迁移的预测因子可避免穷举所有语言对的评估，并帮助开发者针对制约低资源语言性能的因素进行优化。
AI.method: 构建 Multilingual GSM-Symbolic：可扩展的多语言数学数据集，包含 30,000 条题目匹配的问答对，覆盖 15 种语言；利用符号化模板防止过拟合、保证泛化，可从单一样本生成数百万高质量变体。基于该数据集，对模型规模、语言资源水平、推理能力和类型学距离等决定因素进行联合回归估计，并考察各因素对语言间性能差距的交互影响。
AI.result: 能力的主要决定因素为：模型规模（β=1.77）、语言资源水平（β=0.77）、推理（β=0.67）、类型学距离（β=-0.25）。联合估计使各因素可相互换算，例如 32B 模型在马拉地语上的表现相当于 10B 模型在英语上的表现。模型规模与推理能缩小低资源与高资源语言间的差距（β=-0.27 与 β=-0.20），但对类型学距离较远的语言效果甚微。框架解释语言间变异的 92%，但仅解释"模型×语言"变异的 23%；对未见语言的性能预测误差在 6.0pp 内（r=.96），加入目标语言仅 10 个模板的测量后可降至 4.19pp。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言能力迁移可由少量可解释因素高效刻画与预测，无需穷举评估；开发者应针对低资源语言优先扩大模型规模与强化推理，而对类型学远距离语言需另寻手段。仅需极少量目标语言数据即可获得较可靠性能估计。

title: Counterfactual Action Evaluation, Observation Bottlenecks, and Representation Geometry in Joint-Embedding Predictive World Models
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures. Published in the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Workshop on Physical World AI: Geometry, Characteristics, and Multimodal Sensing. Replication Package: https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/T432P
summary: Low latent prediction error does not establish that a world model distinguishes the consequences of its actions. We introduce an evaluation protocol that traces the same intervention through simulator state, raster observations, target embeddings, and predictor outputs. Exact simulator-state forks in a controlled deformable-physics testbed reveal distinct bottlenecks. Changed commands alter particle motion, yet 41.5% of one-step raster pairs are identical. Observation loss is not the whole explanation: among 579 high-visibility counterfactuals, median predictor-to-target response is 0.0051 and 0.0217 across two seeds, falling to 0.0027 and 0.0116 after variance normalization. An isotropic state perturbation matched to the target counterfactual embedding shift produces 190x and 53x larger predictor changes on the same visible pairs, isolating action-path under-use rather than a dead or globally shrunk predictor. MSE-only training gives 8.36x lower 10-step latent error in matched seeds, but in spectrally concentrated spaces; one VICReg target encoder is also strongly concentrated, so neither error nor rank alone certifies physical state. Finally, stiffness remains near chance even from full-resolution rasters and mechanical state while privileged material parameters decode perfectly, indicating weak identifiability under this excitation rather than encoder discard. These results motivate auditing physical effect, observation visibility, representation geometry, and action dependence separately.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一套从模拟器状态、光栅观测、目标嵌入到预测器输出逐层追踪同一干预的评测协议，揭示低潜空间预测误差并不能证明世界模型能区分动作后果，并定位了动作路径未被充分利用等多个瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 低潜空间预测误差常被当作世界模型质量的证据，但这并不足以证明模型真正区分自身动作带来的不同后果。作者希望建立可归因的评测方法，找出误差低却未编码动作效应的具体环节。
AI.method: 在可控的可变形物理测试台上构造精确的模拟器状态分叉，沿同一干预链条追踪：模拟器状态→光栅观测→目标嵌入→预测器输出。对比改变指令后的粒子运动与光栅对、高可见度反事实下的预测器-目标响应、方差归一化后的响应，并以同目标反事实嵌入位移匹配的各向同性状态扰动作为对照，分离"动作路径未使用"与"预测器失效或整体收缩"。同时比较仅用MSE训练与VICReg目标编码器的潜空间误差和谱几何，并检验从全分辨率光栅与机械状态解码刚度。
AI.result: 改变指令可改变粒子运动，但41.5%的单步光栅对完全相同；579个高可见度反事实中，预测器-目标响应中位数在两个种子下为0.0051和0.0217，方差归一化后降至0.0027和0.0116；匹配目标反事实嵌入位移的各向同性状态扰动在同一可见对上产生190倍和53倍更大的预测器变化。仅用MSE训练在匹配种子下10步潜误差低8.36倍，但潜空间谱高度集中；一个VICReg目标编码器也强烈集中。刚度从全分辨率光栅和机械状态解码仍接近随机水平，而特权材料参数可完美解码。
AI.conclusion: 低预测误差不能证明物理状态被正确编码。应分别审计物理效应、观测可见性、表征几何与动作依赖性，而非仅以误差或秩作为世界模型可靠性的证明。

title: ReFract: Benchmarking Perspective Awareness in Language Model Agents with Text World Models
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings such as industrial maintenance and equipment fault troubleshooting, where workers occupy a variety of roles. A capable agent must therefore act in a way that is calibrated to user's role: taking actions and providing information that respect the role's knowledge and capability boundaries. Unlike coding, where mistakes are usually recoverable, agent responses in these settings are enacted on physical equipment, and can therefore cause irreversible equipment damage, production loss, or personnel harm. Existing benchmarks, however, largely overlook the need for agents to infer what a role intends and acting only through tools that role may legitimately use, a capability which we term Perspective Awareness. To this end, we introduce ReFract, a benchmark of 150 expert-validated entries in which an agent must act differently in response to the same query depending on user's role. Entries of ReFract are grounded in anonymized queries from domain support conversations, against which we construct Text World Models that simulate the agent's operating environments and assemble perspective-aware action trajectories. State-of-the-art LLMs solve at most 69% of the tasks with more than 50% of their trajectories contain attempts of taking perspective-violating actions. ReFract exposes perspective awareness as a distinct, largely unsolved axis of agent evaluation and motivates agents that calibrate not just how to act, but for whom.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReFract 基准，用于评估 LLM 智能体的"视角感知"能力：同一查询下，智能体需根据用户角色采取不同的行动与信息提供方式，且仅使用该角色被允许使用的工具。ReFract 包含 150 条经专家验证的条目，基于匿名化的领域支持对话构建文本世界模型与视角感知动作轨迹。实验显示，最先进 LLM 最多解决 69% 的任务，且超过 50% 的轨迹包含视角违规动作尝试。
AI.motivation: 在高风险场景（如工业维护与设备故障排查）中，LLM 智能体的错误不可逆，可能造成设备损坏、生产损失或人员伤害。此类环境中用户角色多样，智能体必须依据用户角色的知识与能力边界来行动，即推断角色意图并仅通过该角色可合法使用的工具执行操作。然而现有基准基本忽视了这一能力需求。
AI.method: 作者提出 Perspective Awareness（视角感知）能力概念，并构建 ReFract 基准：包含 150 条经专家验证的条目，要求智能体在相同查询下因用户角色不同而采取不同行动。条目基于领域支持对话中的匿名化查询，并据此构建 Text World Models 以模拟智能体运行环境，组装视角感知的动作轨迹。
AI.result: 最先进 LLM 最多仅能解决 69% 的任务；超过 50% 的轨迹中存在视角违规动作尝试。
AI.conclusion: ReFract 揭示了视角感知是智能体评估中一个独立且尚未解决的维度，推动研究者开发不仅能判断"如何行动"、还能判断"为谁行动"的智能体。

title: Benchmarking Candidate Coverage in Typed Decision Models
summary: Typed decision models return choices or distributions over answer options supplied at request time. Accuracy with complete options does not establish whether a model recognizes that a reference answer is missing or avoids rejecting valid candidates. We present a paired candidate-coverage benchmark protocol and an initial evaluation of Laya and Jev across AG News, DBpedia, Emotion, and TREC. The models receive identical frozen texts and requests: 300 calibration and 589 test texts yield 23,932 predictions per model. Present/absent pairs match ordinary candidate count, and name variants preserve descriptions, members, and order. Native rejection behavior differs sharply: at five TREC candidates with natural names, Laya detects 97.2% of missing-answer cases but falsely rejects 69.7% of present controls; Jev's rates are 24.8% and 0.0%. Calibration-only none-score thresholds change these rates to 33.9%/3.7% and 45.0%/1.8%, respectively. On DBpedia, Jev's high coverage-score AUROC supports a stronger operating point, whereas both models have weak complete-set accuracy on Emotion. Competence-conditioned analysis, probability-precision sensitivity, and interface audits show why classification, score ranking, and rejection policies need separate measurement. This initial benchmark is descriptive and limited to reference-label omission; it does not establish natural out-of-scope generalization, causal mechanisms, or a new rejection method.

AI.tldr: 论文提出配对候选覆盖度基准协议，考察类型化决策模型能否识别参考答案缺失，而非仅在全选项下测准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有类型化决策模型在请求时给出的选项上返回选择或分布，其完整选项下的准确率无法说明模型是否识别参考答案缺失，也无法说明其是否避免错误拒绝有效候选，因此需要将分类、分数排序与拒绝策略分开测量。
AI.method: 设计配对候选覆盖度基准协议：接收相同冻结文本与请求，300条校准文本与589条测试文本共产生每模型23,932条预测；构造present/absent配对且匹配普通候选数，名称变体保留描述、成员与顺序；对Laya与Jev在AG News、DBpedia、Emotion、TREC上做初始评测，并开展仅校准none分数阈值、能力条件分析、概率-精度敏感性与接口审计。
AI.result: 原生拒绝行为差异显著：TREC五个候选且自然名称下，Laya检出97.2%缺失答案但误拒69.7%的present对照，Jev分别为24.8%与0.0%；仅用校准none分数阈值后变为33.9%/3.7%与45.0%/1.8%；DBpedia上Jev的高覆盖分数AUROC支持更强工作点，而两模型在Emotion上的完整集准确率均较弱。
AI.conclusion: 该初始基准为描述性研究且仅限参考标签缺失情形，不能确立自然域外泛化、因果机制或新的拒绝方法；结论是分类、分数排序与拒绝策略必须分别测量。

title: Geometry Meets Physics: Data-Efficient Pre-Training for Unstructured Neural PDE Solvers
summary: Neural surrogate models for Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) on unstructured 3D geometries are often limited by poor generalization and the high cost of generating large-scale training datasets. Consequently, pre-training on massive datasets of related PDE dynamics has emerged as a critical alternative to enhance the robustness and scalability of these models. However, this strategy is neither compute- nor data-efficient, as it relies on massive pre-computed data that is very costly to generate. In this work, we introduce a disk-data-free pre-training framework tailored to both steady-state and transient regimes. For steady-state problems, we propose a geometry-driven strategy that leverages intrinsic shape descriptors to learn representations of complex 3D domains. For transient problems, we introduce a physics-driven approach based on online generation of synthetic PDE data, enabling scalable pre-training without reliance on expensive datasets. Across multiple experiments, our approach achieves faster convergence, greater data efficiency, and higher accuracy during fine-tuning, particularly under realistic low-data regimes. This methodology provides a practical pathway toward data-efficient neural emulators for large-scale simulations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需预计算数据集的预训练框架，针对稳态问题用几何驱动策略、瞬态问题用物理驱动的在线合成数据策略，实现更快的收敛、更高的数据效率和精度。
AI.motivation: 非结构3D几何上的PDE神经代理模型泛化能力差，且生成大规模训练数据集成本高。虽有研究用海量相关PDE动力学数据进行预训练以提升鲁棒性和可扩展性，但该策略在计算和数据上都不高效，因为依赖大量预计算数据，生成代价高昂。
AI.method: 提出无磁盘数据（disk-data-free）预训练框架，同时适用于稳态和瞬态两类问题。稳态问题采用几何驱动策略，利用内在形状描述子学习复杂3D域的表征；瞬态问题采用物理驱动方法，基于在线生成合成PDE数据，从而无需昂贵数据集即可实现可扩展预训练。
AI.result: 在多项实验中，该方法在微调阶段实现更快的收敛、更高的数据效率和更高精度，尤其在现实低数据场景下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为大规模仿真提供了一条实现数据高效神经仿真器的实用路径。

title: On Unlearning for Time-series Forecasting
summary: Time-series forecasting is widely used in sensitive domains. Models in these settings are often trained on longitudinal user- or entity-level records, which may later require removal because they contain sensitive or proprietary information or have been corrupted by sensor failures. To address such deletion requests without costly retraining, machine unlearning has been widely studied as a practical mechanism for privacy protection and data governance. However, the application of machine unlearning to time series prediction has not yet been well realized; this is mainly due to the following unique challenges: Gradient-based unlearning can be unstable because a deleted observation participates in multiple causally connected forecasting windows, causing parameter updates to propagate beyond the requested interval and degrade retained forecasting utility. Label-guided updating offers a more controlled alternative, but continuous and context-dependent forecasts lack a suitable replacement target, while the exact-retrained output is unavailable during unlearning. Moreover, the remaining support for a deleted temporal pattern is highly non-uniform. Some affected windows retain structurally similar counterparts in the retained data, whereas others become underrepresented or isolated. We present RDTU, a Residual Diffusion framework for time-series unlearning. RDTU first uses a retained-set neural tangent kernel predictor to obtain a deletion-compatible base forecast. Then it quantifies the global and local structural support of each affected window using the volume contribution of the retained-reference data. Then a diffusion model generates a residual correction that estimates the counterfactual forecast, yielding a pseudo-label field that guides a lightweight model update. Experiments show that RDTU consistently produces unlearned models that most closely match exact retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RDTU——一个基于残差扩散的时间序列机器遗忘框架。它利用留集神经正切核预测器生成与删除兼容的基础预测，用留参考数据的体积贡献量化受影响窗口的全局与局部结构支撑，再通过扩散模型生成残差修正以估计反事实预测并指导轻量更新。实验表明RDTU的遗忘模型最接近精确重训练结果。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测广泛用于敏感领域，其模型常在纵向用户/实体记录上训练，这些记录可能因敏感、专有或传感器故障而需被删除。为避免高昂的重训练成本，机器遗忘成为隐私保护与数据治理的实用机制。但机器遗忘在时间序列预测中的应用尚未成熟，主要挑战包括：基于梯度的遗忘不稳定，因为被删除观测会参与多个因果相连的预测窗口，参数更新会传播到请求区间之外并损害保留预测效用；基于标签引导的更新更可控，但连续且依赖上下文的预测缺乏合适的替换目标，且遗忘过程中精确重训练输出不可得；此外，被删除时间模式在剩余数据中的支撑分布高度不均匀——部分受影响窗口仍保留结构相似的对等样本，另一些则变得表征不足或孤立。
AI.method: RDTU首先使用留集神经正切核（NTK）预测器获得与删除兼容的基础预测；随后通过留参考数据的体积贡献量化每个受影响窗口的全局与局部结构支撑；接着用扩散模型生成残差修正以估计反事实预测，形成伪标签场，并以此引导轻量级模型更新。
AI.result: 实验表明，RDTU持续产生最接近精确重训练（exact retraining）的遗忘模型。
AI.conclusion: RDTU通过残差扩散框架有效解决了时间序列机器遗忘中的梯度不稳定、替换目标缺失及时间模式支撑非均匀等难题，在无需昂贵重训练的前提下实现了与精确重训练高度一致的遗忘效果。

title: A Near-Zero Monitor Readout Is Not Evidence of Behavioral Control
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundations of LLM Post-Training in Changing Environments (FLLMPT)
summary: Post-training with verifiable rewards can induce reward hacking, motivating the use of monitors within the training objective rather than solely for offline auditing. We show that a low monitor readout does not identify whether such an intervention controls behavior. In a code-generation environment whose dominant exploit is available at the start of the reasoning trace, we train policies against three monitors that pass the same offline gate: an in-domain activation probe and two penalties conditioned on how early the policy commits to its own final answer. The probe score is at its numerical floor from the first recorded training step, and the trained-score median is zero for every prefix-trained run at the endpoint. These readouts estimate different quantities, and we do not compare their scales; within each monitor family, however, low values do not establish behavioral control. Within one fixed configuration, prefix-trained runs with the same zero-median trained score range, by seed alone, from a mixed regime with a low hacking share to near-pure reward hacking. All probe runs reach the hacking regime, but their floor-level readout reflects a mismatch between the position where the probe was validated and the position where it was read during training, not a second instance of this ambiguity. Text-level analysis identifies a prefix failure mode: generic planning and filler shells postpone the exploit past the cut without eliminating it from the final output. Low measured commitment therefore does not distinguish a low hacking share from delayed commitment to the exploit. Offline discrimination and low monitor-aligned readouts are insufficient evidence of behavioral control; an out-of-band behavioral check is required. We characterize the endpoint readout, not its evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/zhezhou1106/spoof-cost.

AI.tldr: 论文指出：在可验证奖励的后训练中，监控器读数值低并不能证明行为已被控制；离线判别力与低读数值均不足以作为行为控制的证据，必须引入带外（out-of-band）的行为检查。
AI.motivation: 可验证奖励的后训练可能诱发奖励黑客，因此需要把监控器纳入训练目标而非仅用于离线审计。然而，监控读出的低值常被当作控制成功的信号，本文质疑这一推断的有效性。
AI.method: 在代码生成环境中（主要利用方式在推理轨迹开始处即可获得），对通过同一离线门槛的三类监控器训练策略：域内激活探针，以及两个以「策略多早承诺自身最终答案」为条件的惩罚项。比较训练分数与文本层面分析，考察同配置下不同随机种子造成的差异。
AI.result: 探针分数自首个记录训练步起即处于数值下限；所有前缀训练运行在终点处训练分数中位数均为零。在固定配置下、训练分数中位数同样为零时，不同种子间从「混合少量黑客」到「近乎纯奖励黑客」大幅波动。所有探针运行均进入黑客状态，但其下限读数源于验证位置与训练读取位置不匹配，而非同类歧义的再现。文本分析发现前缀失败模式：泛化式规划与填充式外壳把利用行为推迟到切分点之后，却未从最终输出中移除它。
AI.conclusion: 低测量承诺值无法区分「低黑客比例」与「延迟承诺的利用行为」；离线判别力与低监控读数值都不足以证明行为控制，需补充带外行为检查。本文刻画的是终点读数而非其演化过程。

title: DIVINE: Simple Cross-Market Stock Pretraining via Diverse Indicator Reconstruction
summary: Financial time-series pretraining typically learns from masked observations, contrastive relations, or future outcomes---yet existing objectives struggle to simultaneously avoid future-supervision uncertainty and maintain return-prediction alignment. We propose DIVINE (DIVerse INdicator rEconstruction), a simple cross-market pretraining framework that reconstructs technical indicators from raw OHLCV history. Computed from observed price-volume history, technical indicators provide consistently defined supervision across markets while summarizing diverse market dynamics with established relevance to return prediction. Pretrained jointly on six-equity market datasets, DIVINE reconstructs 77 targets derived from 16 standard indicators and transfers only the learned encoder to downstream stock ranking. Across all six markets, DIVINE achieves the strongest average portfolio performance with a lightweight 0.05M-parameter encoder, outperforming pretraining baselines and matching or exceeding substantially larger financial foundation models, while remaining robust and data-efficient. Systematic analyses show that indicator diversity and market diversity provide complementary gains in transfer. Together, these results suggest that supervision design and cross-market diversity---rather than model scale---are the key drivers of strong, transferable financial representations.

AI.tldr: 提出 DIVINE，一种跨市场预训练框架，通过从原始 OHLCV 历史重建技术指标来学习可迁移的金融表征，仅用 0.05M 参数编码器即在六个股票市场取得最优组合表现。
AI.motivation: 现有金融时序预训练目标（掩码观测、对比关系、未来结果）难以同时兼顾两点：避免未来监督信号的不确定性，以及保持与收益预测的对齐。作者希望找到一种既定义一致、又与收益预测有公认相关性，且不依赖未来信息的监督方式。
AI.method: 提出 DIVINE（DIVerse INdicator rEconstruction）：从原始 OHLCV 历史重建技术指标。技术指标由已观测的量价历史计算得到，在各市场间定义一致，并能刻画多样的市场动态。在六个股票市场数据集上联合预训练，重建由 16 个标准指标派生出的 77 个目标，下游仅迁移学到的编码器用于股票排序。
AI.result: 在全部六个市场上，DIVINE 以仅 0.05M 参数的轻量编码器取得最强的平均组合表现，优于预训练基线，并匹配或超越规模大得多的金融基础模型；同时具备稳健性和数据高效性。消融/系统分析显示，指标多样性与市场多样性在迁移中带来互补增益。
AI.conclusion: 监督目标的设计与跨市场多样性，而非模型规模，才是获得强且可迁移金融表征的关键驱动因素。

title: CVE2AP: Automated Generation of PDDL-Encoded Attack Paths via Large Language Models
summary: Attack Path (AP) modeling is fundamental to cybersecurity analysis, where the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) has been widely adopted to encode APs into formal and machine-verifiable representations for automated reasoning about vulnerability exploitation, attack progression, and their potential impacts. However, existing AP modeling approaches largely rely on expert-driven manual construction, limiting their scalability and ability to keep pace with rapidly evolving cyber threats. Large language models (LLMs) are promising candidates, as their extensive pre-trained knowledge and reasoning capabilities enable them to interpret and transform threat intelligence into formal representations. In this paper, we propose \textbf{CVE2AP}, an LLM-based approach for automatically generating PDDL-encoded attack paths from natural language CVE (Common Vulnerability Exposure) descriptions. CVE2AP leverages structured prompting and incorporates an error-feedback mechanism that iteratively refines the generated paths using planner-reported syntactic and solvability errors. We conduct a systematic empirical evaluation across multiple LLMs and generation configurations, assessing generation quality across syntactic, solvability and semantic dimensions, together with token consumption and generation time. The results demonstrate that CVE2AP effectively generates high-quality PDDL-encoded attack paths, achieving up to 86.9\% syntax correctness, 78.6\% solvability, and 93.1\% semantic correctness under LLM-as-expert evaluation, while \texttt{GPT-5.5} offers the best quality-cost trade-off and error feedback yields the most consistent quality improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出CVE2AP，利用LLM从自然语言CVE描述自动生成PDDL编码的攻击路径，并通过错误反馈机制迭代优化，在多维度评估中取得较高生成质量。
AI.motivation: 攻击路径建模是网络安全分析的基础，PDDL被广泛用于将攻击路径编码为形式化、可机器验证的表示，以支持漏洞利用、攻击进展及影响推理。但现有方法主要依赖专家手工构建，难以规模化，也无法跟上快速演变的网络威胁。LLM具备丰富预训练知识与推理能力，有望将威胁情报转化为形式化表示。
AI.method: CVE2AP采用基于LLM的方法，从自然语言CVE描述自动生成PDDL编码的攻击路径。其核心为结构化提示（structured prompting），并引入错误反馈机制，根据规划器报告的语法错误与可解性错误迭代精炼生成结果。
AI.result: 在多种LLM与生成配置下进行系统实证评估，从语法、可解性与语义三个维度衡量生成质量，并统计token消耗与生成时间。结果显示最高达到86.9%语法正确率、78.6%可解性与93.1%语义正确率（LLM-as-expert评估）；GPT-5.5在质量-成本权衡上表现最佳，错误反馈带来最稳定的质量提升。
AI.conclusion: CVE2AP能够有效生成高质量的PDDL编码攻击路径，验证了LLM自动化攻击路径建模的可行性；错误反馈机制与合适模型选择是提升质量与效率的关键因素。

title: Divergence controls entropy in distillation
summary: Distillation has become a core primitive of large language model training, but its properties are not yet well understood. We take an entropic perspective, studying how the entropy of the student depends on the data and the divergence that define the distillation objective. We prove that forward KL inflates the entropy of the student above that of the teacher. Since cross-entropy training is a special case, this yields an identity that we verify quantitatively in pretraining and supervised finetuning. Other divergences come with no such guarantee: reverse KL deflates entropy until the gap between student and teacher gets too large, and interpolating between the two changes entropy smoothly early in training but abruptly at convergence. The lower entropy of on-policy distillation comes from token-level reverse KL, not from on-policy sampling. The divergence therefore acts as an implicit entropy regularizer, whose role is clearest in self-distillation: as conditioning on privileged information deflates entropy, the divergence hyperparameters that work best are those that compensate for it.

AI.tldr: 本文从熵的角度分析了大模型蒸馏中散度目标对学�生模型熵的影响：前向KL会抬高学生熵至高于教师，反向KL则压低熵，散度充当隐式熵正则化器。
AI.motivation: 蒸馏已成为大语言模型训练的核心技术，但其性质尚未被充分理解，尤其是数据与目标散度如何影响学生模型的熵缺乏理论刻画。
AI.method: 采用熵的视角，理论分析不同散度（前向KL、反向KL及其插值）下学生熵与教师熵的关系，并定量验证于预训练与监督微调，同时分析on-policy蒸馏与自蒸馏中的熵效应来源。
AI.result: 证明前向KL会使学生熵高于教师熵，交叉熵训练作为特例由此得到一个可定量验证的恒等式；反向KL会压低熵直至学生-教师差距过大；二者插值在训练早期熵平滑变化但在收敛时突变。on-policy蒸馏的低熵源于token级反向KL而非on-policy采样。
AI.conclusion: 散度充当隐式熵正则化器，这一作用在自蒸馏中最明显：由于特权信息条件化会压低熵，最优的散度超参数正是那些能补偿该效应的取值。

title: Distributionally Robust Survival Models under Subpopulation Shift and Outlier Contamination
summary: Learning robust survival models under distribution shift is an important but challenging problem in many applications. In heterogeneous populations, a model that performs well on average may still perform poorly on certain subpopulations, and this issue becomes even more severe when the training data are contaminated by outliers. In this paper, we propose a novel distributionally robust framework for survival analysis that jointly addresses latent subpopulation shift and outlier contamination. The proposed method combines an outer minimization that selects a refined nominal distribution by reducing the influence of contaminated samples and an inner maximization that focuses on the most challenging subpopulation. This formulation directly accommodates non-decomposable survival losses while preserving interactions across samples, including the risk-set structure of the Cox negative partial log-likelihood. We develop an alternating gradient-based algorithm with outer updates derived from the KKT conditions of the inner maximization. Experiments on simulated data and two survival benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method remains robust when subpopulation shift and outlier contamination occur simultaneously. It stabilizes training in contaminated settings and substantially improves worst-group performance across both linear and nonlinear survival models, while maintaining competitive and sometimes superior overall performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向生存分析的分布鲁棒框架，同时应对潜在亚人群偏移与离群点污染：外层最小化通过削弱污染样本影响精炼名义分布，内层最大化聚焦最难亚人群，并保持Cox负偏对数似然的风险集结构。
AI.motivation: 生存模型在分布偏移下的鲁棒性很重要。异质人群中，平均表现好的模型可能在特定亚人群上表现很差；当训练数据还被离群点污染时，该问题进一步加剧。已有方法通常难以同时处理潜在亚人群偏移与离群点污染，且生存损失非可分解、样本间存在交互（风险集结构），给鲁棒建模带来额外困难。
AI.method: 提出联合处理潜在亚人群偏移与离群点污染的分布鲁棒生存分析框架。外层最小化：选择精炼的名义分布，降低污染样本影响。内层最大化：聚焦最具挑战性的亚人群。该形式直接适配非可分解的生存损失，并保留样本间交互，包括Cox负偏对数似然的风险集结构。算法为交替梯度法，外层更新由内层最大化的KKT条件导出。
AI.result: 在模拟数据与两个生存基准上实验。当亚人群偏移与离群点污染同时发生时，方法保持鲁棒：在污染场景下稳定训练，在训练线性和非线性生存模型时均显著提升最差组性能，同时整体性能具有竞争力，有时更优。
AI.conclusion: 所提分布鲁棒框架能够同时应对亚人群偏移与离群点污染，适配非可分解生存损失与风险集交互，并在理论与实验上显示出对最差组性能和训练稳定性的改进，适用于线性和非线性生存模型。

title: Peer Effects in Signed Networks: Separating Influence Through Positive and Negative Ties
summary: Evaluating network interventions requires understanding how treatment affects people through their social relationships. Counting treated neighbors without distinguishing supportive and antagonistic ties can conceal opposing influences. We define effects through positive and negative ties, their interaction, and a sign-composition effect of reallocating treatment between the two types at a fixed total, and give their identification formulas. Under sign-blind assignment, we show how ignoring signs mixes the effects of the two tie types. We propose SiDE (Signed-exposure Doubly robust Estimator), which combines sign-specific outcome models with exposure probabilities induced by individual treatment assignment. We establish double robustness of its score and assess approximate intervals that account for overlapping neighborhoods. Semi-synthetic experiments on six real signed networks demonstrate accurate effect estimation and examine the limits of interval coverage. An exploratory reanalysis of published school-experiment data yields a positive estimate of the peer effect through spend-time ties on wristband wearing, but the intervals for all four effects include zero after adjustment for multiple comparisons. This framework can inform network intervention design by showing when influences through the two tie types reinforce or offset one another.

AI.tldr: 该文提出按符号（支持性/对抗性）区分网络干预效应的因果框架与识别公式，并开发了双重稳健估计器SiDE，用于在符号盲分配下估计正负关系及其交互的同伴效应，实证表明忽略符号会混淆两类关系的效应。
AI.motivation: 评估网络干预时，治疗会通过社会关系影响个体。若仅统计受治疗的邻居而不区分支持性关系与对抗性关系，可能使方向相反的两种影响相互抵消而被掩盖，因此需要在因果推断中显式纳入关系符号。
AI.method: 定义基于正向关系、负向关系、二者交互的因果效应，以及固定总量下在两类关系间重新分配治疗的“符号构成效应”，并给出各自的识别公式；在符号盲分配情形下刻画忽略符号造成的效应混合。提出SiDE（Signed-exposure Doubly robust Estimator），将按符号分别建模的结果模型与由个体治疗分配诱导的暴露概率相结合，建立其得分的双重稳健性，并给出考虑邻域重叠的近似置信区间。
AI.result: 在六个真实符号网络上的半合成实验显示效应估计准确，并检验了区间覆盖的局限。对已发表学校实验数据的探索性再分析得到通过“共处时间”关系产生的同伴效应对腕带佩戴的正向估计，但在多重比较校正后，四个效应的区间均包含零。
AI.conclusion: 按关系符号区分的效应框架可揭示两类关系的影响是相互强化还是相互抵消，从而为网络干预设计提供依据；但实际数据的证据仍不充分，需谨慎解释。

title: Becoming Suspicious Across Borders: Algorithmic Extraterritoriality and AI-Driven Financial Surveillance
summary: Suspicion is an important, yet elusive concept in anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing (AML/CFT), which allows for intervention below the threshold of proof. In its traditional form, suspicion can be understood as a situated legal judgement by human actors within identifiable jurisdictions. It is argued that this understanding is no longer adequate. As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes an integral part of financial surveillance, suspicion is increasingly produced through data-driven processes. This transformation is epistemic, but also spatial. Since AI-driven financial surveillance operates through transnational data infrastructures, regulatory reach is less a matter of where conduct occurs than a question of whether such conduct becomes visible within data systems. This article develops the concept of algorithmic extraterritoriality, understood as a form of regulatory power mediated by data infrastructures rather than formal assertions of jurisdiction. Moreover, since individuals are increasingly constituted as datafied subjects of suspicion, they are rendered governable through dispersed and opaque processes of evaluation. This constitutes a challenge for accountability and contestability because suspicion becomes more difficult to locate, explain or contest.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"算法域外性"概念，指出AI驱动的金融监控使"怀疑"从人类在特定法域内的情境化法律判断，转变为经由跨国数据基础设施生成的数据化过程，重构了反洗钱/反恐融资的规制权力与问责逻辑。
AI.motivation: 传统上"怀疑"被理解为可识别的司法管辖区内人类行为者作出的情境化法律判断，允许在低于证明标准的门槛上实施干预。然而随着人工智能成为金融监控的组成部分，怀疑越来越多地通过数据驱动过程产生，这一传统理解已不再充分，亟需新的理论框架加以解释。
AI.method: 概念分析与理论建构。作者辨析"怀疑"概念的转变，将其界定为兼具认识论与空间维度的转型，并在此基础上提出"算法域外性"这一新概念，用以刻画由数据基础设施而非正式管辖权主张所中介的规制权力形态。
AI.result: 研究发现：AI驱动的金融监控通过跨国数据基础设施运作，规制触达不再取决于行为发生地，而取决于该行为能否在数据系统中被"可见"；同时，个体日益被建构为被数据化的怀疑主体，经由分散且不透明的评估过程被治理。
AI.conclusion: 怀疑的定位、解释与抗辩变得愈发困难，这对问责性与可争辩性构成重大挑战。算法域外性揭示了金融监控中规制权力的空间与认识论重构，需要新的问责机制予以回应。

title: Pivot-SD: Efficient Self-Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (dLMs) offer a promising parallel alternative to autoregressive models for complex reasoning. However, they face a distinct credit-assignment challenge, since a few commitments during denoising sharply reduce the uncertainty over the remaining masked positions and shape much of the response. Most post-training recipes for dLMs do not use this signal to decide which tokens to train on: they typically train on the final text or assign rewards to whole denoising steps, rather than selecting the individual commitments that shape the response. We introduce Pivot-SD, an efficient offline self-distillation framework that supervises only these high-impact commitments (pivots). Pivot-SD selects pivots using an information-gain metric measuring uncertainty reduction over the remaining masked positions. Pivots from successful trajectories are trained with cross-entropy, and pivots from failed trajectories with targeted unlikelihood, leaving the rest of the failed trajectory untouched. Using only 200 questions and four rollouts each, Pivot-SD improves LLaDA-8B-Instruct over full-sequence SFT and budget-matched diffusion RL baselines across math and code benchmarks.

AI.tldr: Pivot-SD是一种离线自蒸馏框架，通过信息增益度量筛选高影响力的"关键承诺"（pivots），仅对成功轨迹的关键token做交叉熵训练、对失败轨迹的关键token做针对性似然降低，用极少数据提升掩码扩散语言模型推理能力。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型（dLMs）在复杂推理上有潜力，但存在信用分配难题：去噪过程中少数承诺会大幅降低剩余掩码位置的uncertainty并决定响应走向。现有后训练方法多在最终文本或整个去噪步骤上分配reward，无法定位这些塑造响应的关键token。
AI.method: 提出Pivot-SD离线自蒸馏框架，仅监督高影响力承诺（pivots）。用信息增益度量（剩余掩码位置的不确定性下降）选择pivots；成功轨迹的pivots用交叉熵训练，失败轨迹的pivots用针对性unlikelihood训练，失败轨迹其余部分不调整。
AI.result: 仅用200个问题和每条4次rollout，在数学与代码基准上，Pivot-SD优于全序列SFT和预算匹配的扩散RL基线，提升LLaDA-8B-Instruct表现。
AI.conclusion: 将监督聚焦于少数高影响力pivots，是一种高效的后训练策略，以极低数据预算即可改善dLMs推理能力。

title: Toward Omni Multimodal Graph Foundation Model: A Topology-Driven Binding Approach
summary: Multimodal graph foundation models (MGFMs) seek to learn generalizable representations from large-scale graphs with heterogeneous node modalities. However, real-world Multimodal-Attributed Graphs (MAGs) often contain incomplete node attributes, limiting the scale and diversity of available pretraining corpora. Besides, existing MGFMs primarily incorporate graph topology as structural context, overlooking its role in guiding multimodal binding and shaping a unified representation space. To address these challenges, we propose GraphBind, a topology-driven approach that uses graph topology to bind rich modality information into a unified shared space. GraphBind is motivated by the stability of graph topology, which provides structural references and complementary semantic information for multimodal binding. Concretely, GraphBind uses topology to organize self semantics and reliable neighborhood semantics into a global shared space that integrates structure and semantics, and adapts this space to discriminative and generative tasks through lightweight interfaces. Extensive experiments against 11 representative baselines demonstrate that GraphBind achieves leading performance on both discriminative and generative tasks, with relative improvements of up to 28.1% over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GraphBind，一种以图拓扑为驱动的多模态图基础模型方法，利用拓扑将模态信息绑定到统一共享空间，在判别与生成任务上均取得领先性能，最高相对提升28.1%。
AI.motivation: 现实中的多模态属性图(MAGs)常存在节点属性不完整的问题，限制了预训练语料的规模与多样性；同时现有MGFMs主要将图拓扑作为结构上下文，忽视了其在引导多模态绑定和塑造统一表示空间方面的作用。
AI.method: GraphBind受图拓扑稳定性的启发，利用拓扑为多模态绑定提供结构参考和互补语义信息。具体而言，它用拓扑将自语义与可靠的邻域语义组织到一个融合结构与语义的全局共享空间，并通过轻量级接口将该空间适配到判别性与生成性任务。
AI.result: 与11个代表性基线方法的广泛实验表明，GraphBind在判别性和生成性任务上均取得领先性能，相较最强基线相对提升最高达28.1%。
AI.conclusion: GraphBind通过拓扑驱动的多模态绑定构建统一共享空间，有效应对属性不完整与表示空间割裂问题，验证了拓扑在引导多模态融合中的关键作用。

title: Jumping the Line: Exploiting Length Predictions in LLM Scheduling
summary: Efficient request scheduling is increasingly important for reducing completion time in large language model (LLM) serving. Size-based policies such as Shortest Job First prioritize shorter requests, but output lengths are unknown before generation, so practical schedulers rely on predicted lengths. We introduce JIL, an attack on prediction-based LLM schedulers that manipulates the scheduling signal to obtain higher priority and reduce completion time. Using TRAIL as a case study, JIL optimizes an adversarial suffix that causes a lightweight output-length probe to underestimate a request's length. We evaluate JIL on two datasets and four LLMs across varied request profiles and deployment configurations. JIL reduces predicted output lengths by up to 83.4 percent, and adversarial requests complete up to 1.53 times faster on average in end-to-end serving experiments. The reduction in predicted length is substantially larger than the change in actual output length, revealing a mismatch between the scheduler's estimate and the request's realized size. Response utility varies across models and tasks, exposing a trade-off between scheduling advantage and response quality. We also evaluate scheduler-side defenses and find that grouping length predictions into coarse intervals reduces JIL's scheduling advantage and mitigates delays to benign requests.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 JIL，一种针对基于预测的 LLM 调度器的攻击，通过优化对抗性后缀使轻量级输出长度探针低估请求长度，从而提升请求优先级、缩短完成时间。
AI.motivation: 大规模 LLM 服务中，请求调度对降低完成时间至关重要。基于长度的策略（如 SJF）偏好短请求，但生成前输出长度未知，实际调度器依赖预测长度。这种对预测信号的依赖存在被操纵的风险，而此前缺乏对该攻击面的系统研究。
AI.method: 以 TRAIL 为案例，JIL 优化一个对抗性后缀，使轻量级输出长度探针低估请求的输出长度，从而在调度中获得更高优先级。作者在两个数据集、四种 LLM 上，跨不同请求画像与部署配置进行评估。
AI.result: JIL 将预测输出长度最多降低 83.4%；端到端服务实验中，对抗性请求平均完成速度快至 1.53 倍。预测长度的下降幅度远大于实际输出长度的变化，揭示调度器估计与请求真实规模之间的错位。响应效用因模型和任务而异，体现调度优势与响应质量之间的权衡。调度器侧防御中，将长度预测分组为粗粒度区间可削弱 JIL 的调度优势并缓解对良性请求的延迟。
AI.conclusion: 基于预测的 LLM 调度器存在可被对抗性后缀利用的信号操纵漏洞，导致调度公平性与性能受损。将长度预测粗粒度分组是一种可行的防御方向。

title: DyRA: Dynamic Residual Approximation for Efficient Matrix Multiplication in DNNs
summary: Large-scale foundation models achieve strong performance across diverse tasks, but their size makes inference costly, largely due to dense matrix multiplications. Prior work reduces this cost by replacing dense weight matrices with efficient structured forms such as low-rank factorizations. However, these methods approximate weights rather than the output activations that determine inference accuracy. Consequently, small weight-space errors can be amplified by input activations, producing large output errors. In this work, we propose DyRA, an input-adaptive method that improves structured matrix multiplication approximation by correcting residual output errors during inference. We show that matrix multiplication can be approximated more effectively by directly optimizing low-rank factors of the output. DyRA builds on this insight by dynamically approximating and correcting the output error introduced by structured weight approximations. This combines efficient structured computation with input-dependent correction, yielding a more faithful approximation of full matrix multiplication under the same computational budget. Across vision, speech, and language models, DyRA consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off over structured weight approximations alone. Notably, DyRA achieves a 1.5$\times$ end-to-end GPU speedup for DINOv3 while reducing accuracy degradation by more than 3$\times$ relative to weight-only baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出DyRA——一种输入自适应方法，通过直接优化输出的低秩因子并动态校正结构化权重近似带来的残差输出误差，在同等算力预算下更忠实地逼近全矩阵乘法。
AI.motivation: 大规模基础模型推理开销主要来自稠密矩阵乘法。已有方法用低秩分解等结构化形式替代稠密权重矩阵，但这些方法近似的是权重而非决定推理精度的输出激活，导致权重空间的小误差会被输入激活放大，产生较大的输出误差。
AI.method: 指出矩阵乘法可通过直接优化输出的低秩因子来更有效近似；DyRA据此在推理时动态近似并校正由结构化权重近似引入的输出误差，将高效结构化计算与输入相关的校正相结合。
AI.result: 在视觉、语音和语言模型上，DyRA相比单纯的结构化权重近似持续改善精度—效率权衡；在DINOv3上实现1.5倍端到端GPU加速，同时将精度退化降低3倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 以输出为中心、输入自适应的近似与校正策略，优于仅近似权重的结构化方法，在相同算力预算下可获得更优的精度—效率折衷。

title: When Can We Trust the Matching Principle? Robust Deployment Geometry Under Finite-Sample and Model Uncertainty
comment: 14 pages. Companion to arXiv:2604.21395 and arXiv:2605.22800
summary: Match only geometry you can identify; otherwise spread the penalty. We quantify that decision by the trust ratio tau = epsilon / gamma (estimation uncertainty over spectral separation). Under the linear-quadratic Matching response, oracle-relative drift between estimated and oracle projector matching scales as tau^2 for probes in the chosen top-r deployment subspace -- O(tau^2) in the Davis-Kahan separation region tau < 1/2, with practical usefulness depending on constants. Confidence-Calibrated Matching (CCM) turns tau into a policy -- directional when tau is small, progressively isotropic when not -- with thresholds from calibration, not from the theorem (match sits in the separation region; soft is mostly heuristic). Experiments show both regimes, including UCI HAR embeddings where always-match is worse than abstain on every cell.

AI.tldr: 该文提出信任比 tau = epsilon / gamma（估计不确定性/谱分离度）来量化匹配决策：仅在几何可辨识时匹配，否则扩散惩罚。在二次匹配响应下，估计投影器相对oracle投影器的漂移在所选top-r部署子空间内随 tau^2 缩放（分离区 tau < 1/2 时为 O(tau^2)）；并提出置信校准匹配（CCM）策略，阈值来自校准而非定理。实验验证了两种机制。
AI.motivation: 匹配（matching）中的核心问题是：当几何结构无法可靠辨识时，是否应当强行匹配，还是应当将惩罚扩散/退化为各向同性？作者需要一个可量化的判据来刻画"何时匹配、何时退化"的决策，并把该决策从启发式上升到有理论保证的框架。
AI.method: 1) 定义信任比 tau = epsilon / gamma，其中 epsilon 为估计不确定性，gamma 为谱分离度；2) 在"线性-二次匹配响应"（linear-quadratic Matching response）下分析估计投影器与oracle投影器之间的漂移；3) 提出置信校准匹配（CCM）：当 tau 小则采用方向性（directional）匹配，tau 大则逐步各向同性（isotropic），阈值由校准而非定理给出；4) 在含 UCI HAR 嵌入等数据集上做实验。
AI.result: 理论：在所选 top-r 部署子空间内，oracle-相对漂移随 tau^2 缩放；在 Davis-Kahan 分离区 tau < 1/2 时达到 O(tau^2)，实际有效性取决于常数。实验：观察到两种机制（方向性与各向同性）；在 UCI HAR 嵌入上，"总是匹配"在每一个格子（cell）上都劣于"弃权（abstain）"。
AI.conclusion: 匹配决策可由信任比 tau 统一刻画：tau 小则匹配有利、tau 大则退化（扩散惩罚）更优。CCM 提供了从校准获得阈值的策略，兼顾理论与实用；但需注意匹配落在分离区、软策略多为启发式的局限性。

title: Efficient Reasoning Training Does Not Always Harm CoT Faithfulness and Monitorability
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning allows humans to inspect how large language models reach their answers, and oversee model behaviour. This reasoning comes at an increased inference cost, motivating efficient methods that train models to solve tasks using fewer tokens. However, a common concern is that such training may cause models to skip important reasoning steps, so the CoT no longer faithfully reflects the model's decision. It is unclear whether or when this occurs in practice, since different efficiency methods apply length pressure to models' CoT in distinct ways, and faithfully explaining a model's decision takes more tokens on some tasks than others. To understand these dynamics, we fine-tune a variety of models with three methods that apply length pressure differently, namely a fixed generation budget, a per-example length target, and a group-relative length reward. We evaluate how efficient reasoning affects CoT faithfulness (i.e., how well the CoT reflects model decisions on related inputs) and monitorability (i.e., whether the CoT reveals when input interventions alter the output). We find that it affects faithfulness and monitorability differently. Faithfulness falls in most settings, primarily because the trained models are less consistent. Monitorability is more robust, as models keep acknowledging the influence on their answer even when the CoT is much shorter.

AI.tldr: 本文研究高效推理训练（缩短思维链）对思维链忠实性与可监控性的影响，发现二者受影响程度不同：忠实性多数情况下下降（因模型一致性降低），而可监控性更稳健。
AI.motivation: 思维链推理让人类可检查大模型如何得出答案并监督其行为，但推理成本高，催生了用更少token解题的高效训练方法。然而人们担心这类训练会使模型跳过关键推理步骤，使CoT不再忠实反映模型决策。由于不同效率方法施加长度压力的方式各异，且忠实解释决策在不同任务上所需token不同，该问题在实践中的表现尚不明确。
AI.method: 作者用三种以不同方式施加长度压力的方法微调多种模型：固定生成预算、按样本长度目标、群组相对长度奖励；并评估高效推理对CoT忠实性（CoT在相关输入上反映模型决策的程度）与可监控性（CoT是否揭示输入干预改变了输出）的影响。
AI.result: 高效推理对忠实性和可监控性影响不同。忠实性在多数设置下下降，主要因为训练后模型一致性降低；可监控性更稳健，即使CoT大幅缩短，模型仍会承认输入对其答案的影响。
AI.conclusion: 缩短CoT的高效推理训练会以牺牲忠实性（尤其通过降低模型一致性）为代价，但并不必然损害可监控性，后者对长度压力更具鲁棒性。

title: WebFovea: When the Model Is Right but the Click Is Wrong -- Reliable Round Trips for Vision-Based Web Agents on Live Websites
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Technical report of the 2nd-place solution in the WebRetriever Challenge 2026
summary: We present WebFovea, a vision-based web agent that placed 2nd in the WebRetriever Challenge 2026 with a final score of 57.0 out of 100. The challenge evaluates agents end to end on Protocol III of the WebRetriever benchmark (arXiv:2607.06118): starting from an entry URL on a live website, the agent must operate the site's own interface and return a verifiable answer. A capable multimodal large language model (LLM) is necessary for this, but not sufficient. The model's decisions reach the browser through the harness, the code between the model and the page. At every step, four things must go right: the model's reply must be parsed into the intended action, the action must take effect on the page, the result must be reported back accurately, and the model must be shown the information it needs. On real websites, many of the failures we observed occurred at one of these four stages rather than in the model's reasoning. A coordinate-space mismatch placed every click at 3/4 of its intended coordinates; actions on native dropdowns, inside iframes, and in text boxes failed silently; and self-generated chat-template tokens contaminated 4.9% of task episodes. WebFovea hardens each stage and surrounds the loop with guardrails that keep the agent within the rules and its budget. The four-stage view does not depend on the model, although some individual fixes do. Because we used the same model in all four submissions, the rise of our official hidden-set score from 31.0 to 57.0 reflects changes to the harness, up to run-to-run variance on live sites. We describe the design, the evidence for each component (including negative results), a failure analysis, the limitations, and a roadmap that includes routing different steps to different models.

AI.tldr: WebFovea是一个基于视觉的网页智能体，在WebRetriever Challenge 2026中获得第二名（57.0/100）。论文提出"四阶段"框架（动作解析、动作生效、结果回传、信息呈现），强调在真实网站上失败多源于模型与页面之间的harness而非模型推理，并通过加固各阶段与护栏机制，在固定模型下将隐藏集分数从31.0提升至57.0。
AI.motivation: 在真实网站端到端评测中，仅具备强大的多模态大模型并不足以保证成功；模型决策需经由harness传递到浏览器。作者观察到许多失败发生在模型与页面交互的四个环节（回复解析、动作生效、结果回传、信息呈现）而非模型推理本身，因此动机是系统性地诊断并加固这一中间层。
AI.method: 基于WebRetriever基准Protocol III构建视觉网页智能体WebFovea。提出四阶段分析框架：1）模型回复需被解析为预期动作；2）动作需在页面上生效；3）结果需被准确回传；4）模型需被展示所需信息。针对各阶段缺陷进行修复：修正坐标空间错配（点击偏移至3/4坐标）、解决原生下拉框/iframe/文本框内动作静默失败、清除自生成chat-template token污染（占4.9%任务片段）。同时在循环外围设置护栏，使智能体遵守规则与预算，并保持部分修复不依赖于特定模型。
AI.result: 在模型完全相同、共四次提交的条件下，官方隐藏集得分从31.0提升至57.0（考虑真实网站运行间方差），证明提升主要来自harness改进。论文报告了各组件证据（含负结果）、失败分析、局限性及路线图（如将不同步骤路由到不同模型），最终在WebRetriever Challenge 2026中获第二名。
AI.conclusion: 在真实网站的网页智能体任务中，模型与页面之间的harness是决定成败的关键瓶颈；四阶段视角不依赖模型，可系统性定位并修复失败。通过加固harness各环节并配合护栏，可在不更换模型的情况下实现显著性能提升，未来可探索推理步骤与模型的差异化路由。

title: Tangent Schrödinger Bridge Matching: Learning Stochastic Transport with Mechanistic Sensitivities
summary: Predicting how stochastic systems respond to changes in viscosity, reaction rates, or external forces requires costly simulations, motivating reusable learned models. Yet matching observed outcome distributions does not ensure accurate intervention responses. We introduce Tangent Schrödinger Bridge Matching (Tangent-SBM), which learns stochastic transports from endpoint observations and mechanistic sensitivities. It propagates parameter derivatives alongside trajectories and supervises them against supplied targets. For average-response targets, single-rollout squared error also penalizes response variability; our objective uses two independent rollouts to match the mean without this additional penalty. We establish conditions under which sensitivity accuracy bounds finite-change prediction error and decision regret. Across Gaussian, stochastic double-well, PDEBench reaction--diffusion, and stochastic Navier--Stokes systems, Tangent-SBM improves sensitivity and finite-change prediction over matched conditional-bridge baselines while maintaining comparable endpoint and distributional accuracy. Controls examine target correctness, response objectives, and simulator-budget allocation. To test decision usefulness, we evaluate calibrated viscosity selection in Navier--Stokes: Tangent-SBM reduces tracking error relative to taking no action on every evaluated task.

AI.tldr: 提出Tangent Schrödinger Bridge Matching (Tangent-SBM)，通过联合学习随机输运与机制敏感度，实现对外部参数变化的准确干预响应预测，并在多类随机系统中优于条件桥基线。
AI.motivation: 随机系统对黏度、反应速率或外力等参数变化的响应预测通常依赖昂贵仿真，需要可复用的学习模型。然而，仅匹配观测结果的分布并不能保证对干预响应的准确性，这是现有方法的关键缺陷。
AI.method: Tangent-SBM从端点观测和机制敏感度中学习随机输运：在传播轨迹的同时传播参数导数，并用给定目标监督这些敏感度。针对平均响应目标，单次 rollout 的平方误差会额外惩罚响应变异性，因此采用两次独立 rollout 以匹配均值而不引入该惩罚。理论上建立了敏感度精度对有限变化预测误差和决策后悔的界定条件。
AI.result: 在高斯系统、随机双势井、PDEBench 反应-扩散以及随机 Navier-Stokes 系统上，Tangent-SBM在保持端点与分布精度可比的同时，提升了敏感度和有限变化预测，优于匹配的条件桥基线。消融实验检验了目标正确性、响应目标与仿真预算分配。在 Navier-Stokes 的校准黏度选择任务中，相比不采取行动，Tangent-SBM将跟踪误差降低。
AI.conclusion: Tangent-SBM表明，结合机制敏感度监督可显著提升学习模型对干预响应的预测能力，并支撑更优的决策，具有跨随机系统与偏微分方程任务的通用性。

title: Do ResNets Route? Sparse Interaction Experts in Residual Networks
summary: Residual networks execute every block for every input, yet their functional contributions need not be input independent. We formulate a trained ResNet as a set function over binary residual-branch masks and apply Möbius inversion to decompose its output exactly into individual residual corrections and higher-order interactions. For smooth residual stacks, we show that each fixed $k$-way interaction scales as $\mathcal{O}(λ^k)$ under residual scaling. Exhaustive analysis of ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-18 and ResNet-34 reveals that interaction mass peaks at orders five and ten, respectively, rather than at low orders. Reducing the residual scale shifts both spectra toward lower orders, but also changes model predictions. The interaction coefficients are concentrated in magnitude but not hard sparse, and prediction-preserving sparsity weakens with depth. Crucially, the dominant interactions vary across inputs and predicted classes around a shared global core, while their overall complexity changes little with sample difficulty. These results show that dense ResNets implement an implicit form of soft routing: every block is executed, but different inputs rely on different residual interaction experts. Routing can therefore emerge at the level of functional contribution without an explicit router or sparse execution.

AI.tldr: 该论文将训练好的ResNet建模为二值残差分支掩码上的集合函数，用Möbius反演把网络输出精确分解为各阶残差修正与高阶交互，发现ImageNet预训练的ResNet-18/34的交互质量分别在第5阶和第10阶达到峰值，且主导交互随输入与预测类别变化，表明稠密ResNet隐含实现了"软路由"。
AI.motivation: ResNet对每个输入都执行全部残差块，但各块的功能贡献未必与输入无关。作者希望超越"逐块执行"的表象，量化各残差支路及其高阶组合对输出的真实功能贡献，并检验这种贡献是否随输入变化，从而判断稠密网络中是否存在隐式的输入依赖路由机制。
AI.method: 将训练好的ResNet表述为关于二值残差分支掩码的集合函数，利用Möbius反演对其输出做精确的分解，得到单个残差修正项与各阶（k阶）交互项；对平滑残差堆叠进行理论分析，证明固定k阶交互在残差缩放λ下按O(λ^k)缩放；对ImageNet预训练的ResNet-18与ResNet-34做穷举式交互谱分析，考察交互质量随阶数的分布、残差缩放对谱的影响、系数的稀疏性、交互随输入与预测类别的变化，以及复杂度与样本难度的关系。
AI.result: ResNet-18与ResNet-34的交互质量峰值分别出现在第5阶和第10阶，而非低阶；降低残差缩放会使两个交互谱向低阶移动，但同时改变模型预测。交互系数在幅度上集中但并非硬稀疏，且保持预测不变的稀疏性随深度增加而减弱。主导交互围绕一个共享的全局核心随输入和预测类别变化，而其总体复杂度随样本难度的变化很小。
AI.conclusion: 稠密ResNet实现了一种隐式的软路由：每个残差块都被执行，但不同输入依赖不同的"残差交互专家"。因此，路由可以在功能贡献层面自发涌现，而无需显式路由器或稀疏执行机制。

title: From Benchmarks to Production: A Text-to-SQL System for Complex Financial Data
summary: General-purpose Text-to-SQL systems achieve strong performance on academic benchmarks like Spider and BIRD, where schemas are relatively shallow and column values are often human readable. In production financial databases, where concepts are stored as opaque integer keys rather than human-readable strings, these methods fall below 50%, as even simple queries require multiple joins and filter predicates reference opaque IDs. We present Financial LINking Text-to-SQL (FLINT), a domain-specialized Text-to-SQL system that closes this gap through three key components: (1) a lookup agent that dynamically resolves natural-language concepts to question-specific reference table constraints, (2) embedding-based retrieval of structurally similar query templates from a compact, expert-authored bank, and (3) schema linking that prunes a large table schema to the relevant subset by traversing foreign-key chains, rather than relying on name similarity alone. We evaluate on two datasets totaling 359 questions over production financial schemas. FLINT outperforms various state-of-the-art baselines using the same LLM. The system is deployed in production as part of a financial data retrieval service.

AI.tldr: FLINT 是一个面向生产金融数据库的领域专用 Text-to-SQL 系统，通过查询语义分解、模板检索与基于外键链的 schema 剪枝，解决不透明整型键、多表连接与 ID 过滤带来的性能瓶颈，在 359 道题上超越同基座 LLM 的 SOTA 基线，并已上线部署。
AI.motivation: 通用 Text-to-SQL 在 Spider、BIRD 等学术基准上表现优异，但这些基准的 schema 较浅、列值多为人类可读字符串。生产金融数据库中概念以不透明整型键存储，即便简单查询也需多次连接，过滤条件引用的是 ID，导致通用方法准确率不足 50%，存在显著落地落差。
AI.method: FLINT 由三部分组成：(1) lookup agent，将自然语言概念动态解析为针对具体问题的参考表约束；(2) 基于嵌入的检索，从紧凑的专家编写查询模板库中召回结构相似的模板；(3) schema linking，通过遍历外键链将大表 schema 剪枝为相关子集，而非仅依赖名称相似度。
AI.result: 在两个数据集、共 359 个问题、面向生产金融 schema 的评测中，FLINT 在使用相同 LLM 的条件下优于多种 SOTA 基线。系统已作为金融数据检索服务的一部分投入生产部署。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，针对领域特性显式建模概念链接、模板复用与结构感知的 schema 剪枝，可有效弥补通用 Text-to-SQL 在生产金融数据库上的性能缺口，并具备实际部署可行性。

title: Constraint-Aware Training
comment: Accepted at Neurips 2026 workshop AI for Verifiable Coding
summary: When generating programs with language models, constrained decoding can apply program analyses to exclude tokens that violate syntax, scope, or typing rules. However, there is a duplication: standard training already teaches the model to suppress the tokens rejected by these analyses. This duplication leads to the question: if we will perform some analysis to filter a set tokens out during inference anyways, can we avoid teaching the model the said analysis altogether during training, and does this externalization lead to more efficient models? This paper defines a general constraint-aware objective satisfying this externalization desideratum and formalizes the benefits of externalization into three concrete theorems about model size and data efficiency. We show, through a controlled synthetic experiment, that the theorems survive training dynamics: constraint-aware training yields lower prediction loss at a matched parameter count and data compared to ordinary cross-entropy training, motivating training objectives that incorporate the analyses used during generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"约束感知"训练目标，将推理时约束解码所用的程序分析从模型训练中外部化，并从理论（三条定理）与合成实验两方面论证其在模型规模与数据效率上的优势。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型生成程序时常采用约束解码，通过程序分析排除违反语法、作用域或类型规则的token。但标准训练本身已教会模型抑制这些被分析拒绝的token，造成训练目标与推理约束之间的重复。作者由此发问：既然推理时无论如何都会用分析过滤token，能否在训练中完全不再教授这些分析，以及这种"外部化"是否能带来更高效的模型。
AI.method: 论文定义一个满足"外部化"要求的通用约束感知目标（constraint-aware objective），并将外部化带来的收益形式化为关于模型规模与数据效率的三条定理。随后通过一个受控的合成实验，在相同参数量和相同数据量下比较约束感知训练与普通交叉熵训练的表现。
AI.result: 在受控合成实验中，三条定理在训练动力学下依然成立：与普通交叉熵训练相比，约束感知训练在匹配参数数量和数据量时取得更低的预测损失。
AI.conclusion: 外部化约束有利于提升模型效率，该结果鼓励训练目标纳入生成阶段所使用的程序分析。

title: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement for Frontier Reasoning Data Synthesis
summary: Generating progressively harder reasoning problems requires synthesis procedures that adapt as the task distribution evolves. Existing task-level recursion reuses generated problems as seeds but leaves the construction harness unchanged. We present task-harness co-evolution, a framework for recursive harness self-improvement (RSI) in reasoning-data synthesis. Online self-improvement converts intermediate solver failures into reusable skills during generation. Post-task self-improvement revises skills, prompts, and workflows after each batch, adopting candidates only when they generate harder valid tasks within a bounded cost increase. Model weights and verification criteria remain fixed. Across mathematics, coding, and science, mean solver accuracy decreases from 100.0% to 54.8% over fourteen evolution rounds. Ablations show that combining both update schedules produces harder tasks than fixed-harness recursion or either schedule alone. The resulting data improves downstream SFT and GRPO performance. In particular, a 27B student fine-tuned on 10K synthesized mathematics examples achieves 62.5% mean-16 accuracy on APEX, competitive with selected frontier-model references. These results support adapting the synthesis harness alongside the tasks to generate increasingly challenging data with downstream training value.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"任务-工具协同演化"(task-harness co-evolution)框架，在推理数据合成中实现递归式工具自我改进(RSI)，通过让合成流程与任务同步进化来持续生成更难的有效任务。
AI.motivation: 生成难度递增的推理问题需要能随任务分布演化而自适应的合成流程。现有"任务级递归"方法虽复用已生成问题作为种子，但构造工具(harness)本身保持不变，限制了任务难度的持续提升。
AI.method: 提出任务-工具协同演化框架，包含两种自我改进机制：(1)在线自我改进——在生成过程中将求解器的中间失败转化为可复用技能；(2)任务后自我改进——每批次结束后修订技能、提示词与工作流，仅当候选方案能在成本增量受限的前提下生成更难的有效任务时才予以采纳。模型权重与验证标准保持固定。
AI.result: 在数学、编程与科学领域，经过14轮演化，求解器平均准确率从100.0%降至54.8%。消融实验表明，结合两种更新调度比固定工具递归或单一调度能生成更难的任务。合成数据提升了下游SFT与GRPO表现：一个27B学生模型在10K合成数学样本上微调后，在APEX上达到62.5%的mean-16准确率，与部分前沿模型参考水平相当。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，让合成工具与任务协同演化可生成难度递增且具下游训练价值的数据，验证了工具层面自我改进对推理数据合成的有效性。

title: Knowledge or Calculator? Decomposing the Skill Premium in Verifiable Financial Agent Workflows
summary: Financial AI agents must do more than retrieve facts: investment workflows require correct quantitative execution, reliable use of procedural resources, and auditable structured outputs. We introduce FinSkillBench, an evaluation suite of 2,603 point in time episodes across 12 subtasks in portfolio construction, risk management, and fundamental analysis, with hidden regenerable ground truth and task specific deterministic verifiers. Executing 17,820 episodes across 9 models and 3 resource conditions, the paired analysis across 8 models shows that curated skill packages raise mean scores by +16.2 points (0.366 to 0.528), whereas skills generated within a single episode add only +0.5 points while consuming more tokens and turns. We then decompose the curated premium by granting human authored procedural documents and executable domain tools separately: documents alone add +5.6 points, tools alone add +19.5 points, and their combination is subadditive. The premium is strongly workflow dependent: executable tools dominate numerically intensive workflows, documentation matters more when procedural or output schema guidance is the bottleneck, and interpretive tasks benefit from both. The effects are sign stable across 10 scoring variants and cluster bootstrap analyses, and an independently implemented second harness reproduces the directional pattern while showing that effect magnitudes depend on how tools and data are exposed. Overall, a measured "skill premium" is a property of the full model, resource, and harness system rather than of the underlying model alone.

AI.tldr: 提出 FinSkillBench 评测套件（12 个子任务、2603 个时点情景），执行 17820 个 episode 发现：精选技能包平均提分 +16.2，单集内生成技能仅 +0.5；可执行工具贡献 +19.5 高于文档 +5.6，且二者次可加；技能溢价依赖工作流类型，并受模型、资源与评测框架共同影响。
AI.motivation: 金融 AI 代理不能只做事实检索：投资工作流要求正确的定量执行、程序性资源的可靠调用以及可审计的结构化输出。然而现有评测多聚焦事实问答，缺乏对"技能/资源"在真实金融任务中增益的量化刻画，也缺乏对增益来源（文档 vs 工具）与工作流依赖性的分解分析。
AI.method: 构建 FinSkillBench：覆盖组合构建、风险管理、基本面分析三大类共 12 个子任务、2603 个 point-in-time 情景，采用可隐藏再生成的真值（hidden regenerable ground truth）与任务专用确定性验证器。在 9 个模型、3 种资源条件下执行 17820 个 episode，并对其中 8 个模型做配对分析；进一步将精选技能包拆分为人工编写程序性文档与可执行领域工具两种资源分别授予，以分解溢价来源；通过 10 种评分变体与聚类自助法检验稳健性，并用独立实现的第二套评测框架复现。
AI.result: 精选技能包使平均分由 0.366 提升至 0.528（+16.2 分），而单集内生成的技能仅 +0.5 分，且消耗更多 token 与轮次。分解显示：仅文档 +5.6 分，仅工具 +19.5 分，二者组合呈次可加性。溢价强烈依赖工作流：数值密集型工作流由可执行工具主导，程序性或输出模式指引为瓶颈时文档更重要，解释性任务两者兼益。效应符号在 10 种评分变体与聚类自助分析下稳定；第二套独立评测框架复现了方向性模式，但效应量级取决于工具与数据的暴露方式。
AI.conclusion: 可测量的"技能溢价"是完整模型—资源—评测框架系统层面的属性，而非仅取决于底层模型本身；因此金融 AI 代理的评测与优化需将模型、资源形态与评测框架视为整体来设计与报告。

title: Dynamic Expert Pruning for Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale language models efficiently by activating only a few experts per token, but the saving is confined to computation: every expert must stay resident on the accelerator, so memory bounds where these models can be deployed. Expert pruning reduces this footprint, yet existing methods are static --- a single mask, calibrated offline, is applied to the model for every subsequent request. This assumption can fail when the workload is heterogeneous, most prominently in multi-agent systems, where one backbone serves many tasks and roles at once: our analysis shows that different tasks and roles recruit different experts, while static methods assign one fixed subset to all of them. We therefore propose Dynamic Expert Pruning (DEP), which rests on a finding we establish here: an agent's system and task prompts are by themselves sufficient to identify the experts that agent and its task require, since that text already describes what the agent will do. A lightweight predictor, trained once on workflow transcripts, turns those prompts into a specialized per-request mask in a single forward pass, with no per-configuration calibration. Across diverse tasks and roles, model scales, and MoE architectures, DEP achieves better overall accuracy than static pruning and merging baselines, and generalizes to workflows unseen in training without retraining. Its margin over those baselines is largest when few experts are retained, suggesting that the role specialization inherent to multi-agent systems permits sparser serving than static pruning allows.

AI.tldr: 提出动态专家剪枝DEP，用提示词预测每请求专属专家掩码。
AI.motivation: MoE虽只激活少量专家以节省计算，但所有专家需常驻显存，内存成为部署瓶颈；现有专家剪枝方法为静态离线校准的单一掩码，在异构负载（如多智能体系统）下失效，因为不同任务与角色会调用不同专家，而静态方法对所有场景固定同一子集。
AI.method: 基于作者验证的发现——智能体的系统提示与任务提示本身足以识别其所需专家，因为文本已描述智能体行为——训练一个轻量预测器（一次基于工作流转录训练），在单次前向传播中把提示转化为每请求专属剪枝掩码，无需逐配置校准。
AI.result: 在多种任务与角色、模型规模及MoE架构上，DEP整体准确率优于静态剪枝与专家合并基线，且无需重训练即可泛化到训练未见的工作流；在保留专家数较少时优势最大。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体系统固有的角色专门化支持比静态剪枝更稀疏的服务配置，提示词驱动的动态专家剪枝可实现更优的准确率-稀疏度权衡。

title: Learning to Assess Heartbeat Observability for mmWave Heart-Rate Sensing
summary: Contactless heart-rate sensing with millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar requires assessing whether individual measurements support reliable estimation. We study learning to assess heartbeat observability, defined as the readability of the heartbeat component in an acquired phase spectrum, for selective heart-rate estimation. Coherent superposition of scatterer returns can suppress this component even under similar macroscopic observation geometry, motivating assessment directly from acquired measurements. To obtain training supervision across different observability conditions, we develop a controllable multi-scatterer frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) simulator. Agreement between the dominant heartbeat-band peak and the known heart rate provides an automatic observability label for each simulated measurement. We propose HEAR (Heartbeat Estimation with Assessed Reliability), a compact dual-task Transformer that jointly predicts an observability score and heart rate. Its input combines spectral magnitudes with frequencies relative to the respiration fundamental, providing context for respiratory harmonics. Trained solely on simulated observations, HEAR transfers zero-shot to two public real-world datasets collected at 60 and 120 GHz from 134 subjects. The same learned score supports selective prediction with both HEAR's own heart-rate head and multiple existing estimators. On the 120 GHz dataset, score-based selection reduces the HR head's mean absolute error from 17.9 BPM at full coverage to 1.6 BPM at 50% coverage. The complete pipeline achieves an end-to-end processing latency of 50.8 ms on an edge device. Project page: https://yuxuanhu9.github.io/HEAR/.

AI.tldr: 提出HEAR，一种紧凑双任务Transformer，联合预测心跳可观测性得分与心率，仅用仿真数据训练即可零样本迁移至真实毫米波雷达数据，实现选择性心率估计。
AI.motivation: 非接触式毫米波雷达心率感知中，散射体回波相干叠加会抑制心跳分量，即使在宏观观测几何相似时也难以保证单次测量可靠，因此需要直接基于采集测量评估心跳可观测性，以支持可靠的心率估计与选择性预测。
AI.method: 开发可控多散射体FMCW仿真器，以心跳频段主峰与已知心率的吻合度自动生成可观测性标签；提出HEAR双任务Transformer，输入为频谱幅度及相对于呼吸基频的频率以提供呼吸谐波上下文，联合输出可观测性得分与心率。
AI.result: 仅在仿真数据上训练，HEAR零样本迁移至60 GHz与120 GHz两个公开真实数据集（共134名受试者）；所学得分可支持HEAR自身心率头及多种现有估计器的选择性预测。120 GHz数据集上，基于得分的选择将心率头MAE从全覆盖时的17.9 BPM降至50%覆盖率时的1.6 BPM；完整流程在边缘设备上端到端延迟50.8 ms。
AI.conclusion: 直接从测量中学习心跳可观测性可有效实现选择性心率估计，仿真训练可零样本迁移至真实场景，且计算轻量适合边缘部署。

title: Low-Cost Video--Time Priors as a Strong Baseline for EEG--fNIRS Emotion Regression on Familiar Videos
summary: Continuous emotion regression estimates moment-to-moment valence and arousal while a viewer watches a video. In familiar-video deployment, responses fron training participant-specific estimate, and prior-dominating fixed fusion tests whether physiology adds residual correction. In five-fold subject-held-out evaluation on 24was within 0.05 and 0.32 MAE of fusion in the internal and external evaluations, respectively. Source-explicit ablations showed that video identity and within-video tine accounted for most of the reduction, while EG-FNIRS gains were smaller and varied across participants and videos. These results identify the video-time prior as a strong, low-cost baseline and position EEG-fNIRS as an optional residual signal for familiar-video emotion regression.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出在熟悉视频场景下，以视频-时间先验作为强基线进行连续情绪回归（效价与唤醒度），并将生理信号（EEG-fNIRS）定位为可选的残差修正信号。
AI.motivation: 在熟悉的视频部署场景中，观看者对视频内容已有先前经验，其情绪反应可能主要由训练参与者的个体化先验主导。研究旨在检验融合生理信号是否能在这一强先验之上提供额外的残差修正，即生理信息是否真正带来增益。
AI.method: 采用固定的、以先验为主导的融合框架，并设置源显式（source-explicit）消融实验，分解视频身份、视频内时间以及 EEG-fNIRS 各因素的贡献。评估采用五折、以被试为留出单位的交叉验证，样本为 24 名被试，并包含内部与外部两次评估。
AI.result: 在内部与外部评估中，被试留出结果显示所提出方法与融合结果的平均绝对误差（MAE）分别相差在 0.05 与 0.32 以内。消融表明，视频身份与视频内时间贡献了大部分误差缩减，而 EEG-fNIRS 带来的增益较小，且在被试与视频之间波动明显。
AI.conclusion: 视频-时间先验是一个强劲且低成本的基线；EEG-fNIRS 在熟悉视频情绪回归中应被视为可选的残差信号，而非主要信息来源。

title: SlimKV: Joint Token-Feature KV Cache Compression with Reconstruction-Free Beacon Attention
summary: Long-context LLM serving is increasingly bottlenecked by KV-cache memory, especially in resource-constrained scenarios. Among existing KV-cache compression strategies, token-wise methods reduce cached states but risk information loss through eviction or condensation, while feature-wise methods reduce per-token KV dimensions but can require full-dimensional reconstruction to apply positional embedding, limiting decoding speedups. We introduce SlimKV, a question-agnostic joint token-feature KV-cache compression method. SlimKV uses low-rank-aware training to compress long contexts into beacon memory states with latent KV representations, together with layer-adaptive rank allocation. We further uncover a positional asymmetry: removing key-side RoPE affects beacon and raw tokens differently, with much smaller degradation for beacon tokens. Exploiting this asymmetry, SlimKV trains beacon KV projections under a K-RoPE-free constraint and enables latent-space attention during decoding, mitigating reconstruction latency. On LongBench, SlimKV outperforms baselines at 16x/32x compression and remains leading at 4x/8x, where it retains over 96% of the uncompressed model's score. Needle-in-a-Haystack confirms robustness across evidence positions, and efficiency evaluation shows up to 7.34x attention speedup and 3.38x end-to-end decoding speedup over the uncompressed model at 128K length.

AI.tldr: SlimKV：一种免问句的联合 token-特征 KV 缓存压缩方法，通过低秩感知训练将长上下文压缩为携带潜在 KV 表示的 beacon 记忆状态，并结合层自适应秩分配与 K-RoPE-free 约束下的潜在空间注意力，在 16x/32x 压缩下优于基线，4x/8x 下保留超 96% 原模型得分，实现最高 7.34x 注意力加速与 3.38x 端到端解码加速。
AI.motivation: 长上下文 LLM 服务受限于 KV-cache 显存，尤其在资源受限场景。现有压缩策略分两类：token 级方法减少缓存状态但存在驱逐或凝练导致的信息损失；特征级方法降低每 token 的 KV 维度，但往往需要全维重建才能施加位置编码，限制了加速效果。因此需要兼顾压缩率与解码速度的方案。
AI.method: 提出 SlimKV，一种 question-agnostic 的 token-特征联合 KV-cache 压缩方法：1) 采用低秩感知训练，将长上下文压缩为携带潜在 KV 表示的 beacon 记忆状态；2) 层自适应秩分配；3) 发现位置不对称性——去除 key 侧 RoPE 对 beacon token 与原始 token 的影响不同，beacon token 退化远小；4) 利用该不对称，在 K-RoPE-free 约束下训练 beacon KV 投影，并在解码时进行潜在空间注意力，从而缓解重建延迟。
AI.result: 在 LongBench 上，SlimKV 在 16x/32x 压缩率下优于基线，在 4x/8x 下保持领先，并保留超过 96% 未压缩模型得分。Needle-in-a-Haystack 验证其在各证据位置上的稳健性；效率评估显示在 128K 长度下相比未压缩模型实现最高 7.34x 注意力加速和 3.38x 端到端解码加速。
AI.conclusion: SlimKV 通过联合 token-特征压缩、层自适应秩分配与 K-RoPE-free 潜在空间注意力，在保持高压缩率的同时显著提升长上下文服务的效率与准确性，证明位置不对称性可被有效利用来规避重建延迟。

title: HyperBrowseComp: A Multilingual and Multimodal Stress Test for Web-Browsing Agents
summary: We introduce HyperBrowseComp, a multilingual and multimodal browsing benchmark comprising 423 manually authored and human-validated questions across 13 languages, written by native or highly proficient speakers. Questions are designed to be extremely challenging. Each question targets a concise, publicly verifiable answer whose discovery requires locating obscure evidence, following multi-step clue chains, or inspecting heterogeneous sources such as videos, scanned documents, images, or maps. Easier questions are filtered out by evaluating them with models without internet access to reduce the likelihood that they can be answered with parametric knowledge alone. We evaluate several models using provider-native search and a shared external retrieval harness under a common agent protocol. To contextualize model performance and effort, we also conduct a human evaluation on a sample of the questions. HyperBrowseComp provides a challenging testbed for persistent information seeking across languages and evidence modalities, with difficulty arising from discovering and connecting evidence on the open web.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HyperBrowseComp，一个包含 13 种语言、423 道人工编写并人工验证问题的多语言多模态浏览基准，问题设计极具挑战性，需跨网页发现并串联隐蔽证据（含视频、扫描文档、图像、地图等异构来源），用于评测模型的持续信息检索能力。
AI.motivation: 现有浏览/检索基准在语言覆盖、证据模态多样性及难度上不足，且部分问题可仅凭参数化知识作答，无法真正考验模型在开放网络上发现与连接证据的能力。
AI.method: 由母语或高熟练度者人工编写 423 道题，覆盖 13 种语言，答案简短且公开可验证；通过无联网模型评测过滤掉可凭参数化知识直接作答的简单题；采用统一的智能体协议，用厂商原生搜索与共享外部检索框架评测多个模型；并对部分题目进行人工评测以对照模型表现与投入。
AI.result: 构建出跨语言与跨证据模态的高难度基准 HyperBrowseComp，其难度来源于在开放网络上发现并串联证据；模型评测与人工评测结果共同刻画了当前模型的表现与检索投入水平。
AI.conclusion: HyperBrowseComp 为多语言、多模态的持续信息检索提供了具有挑战性的测试平台，推动对开放网络证据发现与整合能力的评估。

title: What Should World Models Forget? Stratified Retention for Continual Adaptation
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Continual World Models Workshop
summary: Continual learning treats degradation on previously seen data as evidence of failure, a convention inherited from settings with a stationary prediction target, where a correct label remains correct indefinitely. World models do not satisfy this condition. Their prediction target is the environment, which changes, so knowledge that was accurate when acquired may later become false, and discarding it is required behavior rather than a defect. Non-stationary ground truth is well studied in the concept drift literature and in the temporal factuality of language models, but has not been formulated for world models, which are distinctive in that they also encode knowledge that must never be revised. We argue that continual world models require retention stratified by invariance timescale, separating invariants such as physics and object permanence, which must never be revised, from instance-level facts that should be revised as soon as the environment changes. Standard forgetting metrics cannot distinguish a world model that has correctly revised outdated knowledge from one that has suffered catastrophic forgetting, and consequently rank a frozen model highest, while existing physical-reasoning benchmarks evaluate only frozen checkpoints. We propose differential retention, which reports invariant regression testing across the adaptation stream jointly with revision latency, without aggregation.

AI.tldr: 该文主张持续世界模型需要按"不变性时间尺度"分层保留知识，并提出了"差分保留"（differential retention）评估方案，即在不做聚合的前提下同时报告整个适应流上的不变性回归测试与修订延迟。
AI.motivation: 持续学习沿用了平稳预测目标的传统设定，把对旧数据的性能退化一律视为失败；但世界模型的预测目标（环境）本身是非平稳的，曾经正确的知识后可能变假，丢弃它是必要行为而非缺陷。现有概念漂移研究与语言模型时间事实性研究虽处理了非平稳真值，却未针对世界模型加以形式化——世界模型的独特之处在于它同时编码了绝不可被修订的知识（如物理规律、客体恒常性）与应当随环境变化立即修订的实例级事实。
AI.method: 提出按不变性时间尺度分层的保留框架：区分绝不可修订的不变量（物理、客体恒常性等）与应随环境变化及时修订的实例级事实。同时指出标准遗忘度量无法区分"正确修订过时知识"与"灾难性遗忘"，会把冻结模型排为最优，而现有物理推理基准也只评估冻结检查点。据此提出 differential retention：在适应流上联合报告不变性回归测试与修订延迟，且不进行聚合。
AI.result: 该文为立场/框架类工作，未报告实验数值结果，其"结果"体现为对现有评估的诊断性结论：标准遗忘指标会把冻结模型评为最佳，物理推理基准仅测试冻结检查点，因而无法检验世界模型的知识修订能力。
AI.conclusion: 持续世界模型应采用按不变性时间尺度分层的保留策略，并以差分保留（不聚合地联合报告不变量回归测试与修订延迟）取代传统遗忘度量，从而正确区分必要的知识修订与灾难性遗忘。

title: Hyperparameter selection for equation learning with biologically-informed neural networks
comment: 18 pages, 11 figures, 2 tables (main text); 29 pages, 13 figures, 1 algorithm (appendices and supplementary material)
summary: Biologically-informed neural networks (BINNs) have emerged as a flexible subclass of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for learning terms in partial differential equations from data. BINNs are particularly suited for biological systems, where the governing equations are highly nonlinear and only partially known a priori, and where data observations are often sparse, noisy, and incomplete. However, applying BINNs effectively in practice depends critically on hyperparameter selection, which remains a central challenge in equation-learning frameworks. Hyperparameters are often chosen heuristically and only cursorily documented, which limits the reproducibility of results and the transferability of methods. We present a diagnostic workflow for hyperparameter selection that can be used when the ground-truth equations are not known. The workflow is guided by three main questions: (1) Are the benefits of greater network capacity worth the cost? (2) Do more training epochs keep reducing the validation loss?
