AI.method: 将随机PDE解u(t,x,Z)表示为可学习高斯空间字典、Fourier时间特征与广义多项式混沌(gPC)随机基，并通过低秩Canonical Polyadic(CP)张量分解核心耦合；采用强形式与gPC投影残差的混合损失进行训练。
AI.result: 理论证明可分离类在温和条件下于L²中稠密，投影残差恰对应随机Galerkin约束，小批量投影系数对gPC模态数呈对数依赖，正交惩罚控制空间字典条件数；在四个制造基准上均值与方差精度及校准均优于九个基线且参数显著更少，并在非制造Poisson与Darcy、随机Navier-Stokes、高维扩散缩放及两个随机反问题中展现泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明随机可分离性是一种有效的物理信息神经UQ设计原则。

title: Training-Loss Guarantees for Muon with Finite-Step Newton--Schulz Orthogonalization
summary: Existing convergence analyses of Muon either assume exact orthogonalization or analyze classical Newton--Schulz polynomials, and guarantee only stationarity, so it is unresolved what Muon's five tuned Newton--Schulz steps preserve and whether that suffices to reach a prescribed neural-network training loss. We establish a finite-time training guarantee that accounts for both momentum accumulation before orthogonalization and the tuned finite-step update. For full-batch training of a sufficiently wide two-layer ReLU network with fixed random output weights and a positive-definite limiting neural tangent kernel, we prove that Muon reaches any target empirical squared loss $\varepsilon>0$ with high probability over initialization. For every momentum parameter $μ\in[0,1)$, a target-dependent constant learning rate proportional to $(1-μ)\sqrt{\varepsilon}$ yields a hitting-time bound of $O((1-μ)^{-1}\varepsilon^{-1/2})$, with other problem parameters fixed. The sufficient width is independent of both target accuracy and momentum. The analysis shows that the tuned Newton--Schulz map preserves alignment with the momentum buffer while bounding the update's spectral norm. Control of gradient variation near initialization transfers this alignment to the current gradient, ensuring descent until the target is reached without requiring exact orthogonalization. Numerical experiments support these mechanisms at widths below the sufficient theoretical threshold: gradient-update alignment remains above the analytical reference, and all 30 runs across six widths and five student initializations on a fixed teacher-student dataset reach the target loss while maintaining kernel positivity.

AI.tldr: 该论文为Muon优化器在宽两层ReLU网络全批量训练下建立了有限时间收敛保证，首次同时纳入动量累积与调优的有限步Newton–Schulz更新，证明其能以高概率达到任意目标损失。
AI.motivation: 现有Muon收敛分析要么假设精确正交化，要么只分析经典Newton–Schulz多项式，且仅保证收敛到驻点，因此不清楚Muon五个调优Newton–Schulz步骤究竟保持了何种性质，以及是否足以达到给定的神经网络训练损失。
AI.method: 针对输出权固定、极限神经正切核正定的足够宽两层ReLU网络全批量训练，分析动量累积后的正交化与调优有限步更新。证明调优Newton–Schulz映射在保持与动量缓冲对齐的同时约束更新的谱范数，并通过控制初始化附近的梯度变化将这种对齐传递到当前梯度。
AI.result: 证明Muon以高概率在初始化上达到任意目标经验平方损失ε>0；对任意动量参数μ∈[0,1)，目标相关常数学习率正比于(1−μ)√ε时，命中时间界为O((1−μ)^{-1}ε^{-1/2})；足够宽度与目标精度和动量均无关。数值实验中梯度—更新对齐高于分析参考值，六种宽度、五种学生初始化共30次运行全部达到目标损失并保持核正定。
AI.conclusion: Muon无需精确正交化即可保证下降并达到目标损失，其机制在于调优有限步Newton–Schulz映射保持对齐并约束谱范数；理论阈值以下的数值实验也验证了该机制。

title: Cordial Learning: Distributed Training with Correlated Data
summary: We consider a distributed learning task with agents that have correlated data. Specifically, the label of an agent depends on the input of other agents for the same sample, and these inputs are also correlated. Correlated data is the reality when agents share the same environment. Existing decentralized methods, such as federated learning, ignore the structure of the problem and perform poorly on correlated data. On the other hand, centralized approaches are infeasible due to privacy and communication constraints. We introduce cordial (correlated and distributed) learning to address this gap by sharing only low-dimensional outputs between the agents while training local models to extract informative signals from peers. This distributed learning induces a game in which the loss function of each agent depends on the models of others. Assuming a linear model, we prove that cordial learning converges with probability one to a globally optimal solution, despite the nonconvex global objective. Experiments on structured multi-digit MNIST tasks demonstrate that cordial learning remains highly effective even in highly nonlinear settings.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 cordial（correlated and distributed）学习框架，通过仅共享低维输出、训练本地模型提取同伴信号，解决数据相关场景下分布式学习难题，并证明线性模型下以概率1收敛到全局最优。
AI.motivation: 现实中智能体共享同一环境，其数据往往相关：某智能体的标签依赖于其他智能体对同一样本的输入，且这些输入本身也相关。现有去中心化方法（如联邦学习）忽略该结构，在相关数据上表现差；集中式方法又受隐私与通信约束不可行。因此需要兼顾隐私/通信限制与相关数据结构的分布式学习方案。
AI.method: 提出 cordial 学习：智能体之间仅共享低维输出，同时训练本地模型从同伴输出中提取有用信号。该分布式学习过程形成一个博弈，每个智能体的损失函数依赖于其他智能体的模型。作者在线性模型假设下对该博弈/优化过程进行理论分析。
AI.result: 理论证明：在线性模型下，尽管全局目标非凸，cordial 学习仍以概率1收敛到全局最优解。实验方面，在结构化 multi-digit MNIST 任务上，即使处于高度非线性场景，cordial 学习仍保持高度有效性。
AI.conclusion: cordial 学习填补了联邦学习等去中心化方法与集中式方法之间的空白，在满足隐私与通信约束的同时利用数据相关性，理论上保证全局最优收敛，实验上对非线性场景亦有效。

title: Follow the Winners: Conservative Policy Improvement with the Cross-Entropy Method for Critic-Free RFT
summary: Critic-free reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) for agentic large language models is often done through GRPO-style methods, which compute a group baseline over repeated rollouts to reduce target variance. However, this setup is ill-suited to agents acting in stateful environments such as live services or security sandboxes, where repeated rollouts are impractical to obtain and aggressive updates entrench the noise of long, sparsely verified trajectories. We propose \textit{Follow the Winners} (FTW), a critic-free policy-learning algorithm that adapts the cross-entropy method to RFT, replacing group rollouts with an ordinal filter on replay-buffer samples that yields polynomial concentration in the order statistic of returns. We derive FTW through a control-as-inference lens, which also recovers GRPO and DPO as specific modelling choices, identifying GRPO as risk-neutral while DPO and FTW share a bounded risk-seeking offset that FTW controls. We identify this offset as an inherent trade-off of variance reduction through ordinal filters on samples, whereas a critic model induces a different trade-off between bias and variance. Scaled to agentic LLM post-training, FTW matches GRPO and PPO on Sokoban and Search-R1 baselines, showing a viable trade-off from a value model or group rollouts to CPU memory.

AI.tldr: 提出 Follow the Winners (FTW)，一种无 critic 的强化微调算法，用回放缓冲区样本上的序数滤波替代 GRPO 的组内重复采样，并给出其控制即推断推导。
AI.motivation: GRPO 类方法依赖重复 rollout 计算组基线以降低目标方差，但在有状态环境（如在线服务、安全沙箱）中重复 rollout 不切实际，且激进更新会放大长程稀疏验证轨迹中的噪声。
AI.method: 将交叉熵方法适配到 RFT：以回放缓冲区样本上的序数滤波（ordinal filter）替代组内 rollout，对收益的次序统计量实现多项式集中；通过 control-as-inference 视角推导 FTW，该框架同时可还原 GRPO 与 DPO。
AI.result: 在 agentic LLM 后训练中，FTW 在 Sokoban 与 Search-R1 基准上匹配 GRPO 和 PPO 的表现；分析表明 GRPO 为风险中性，DPO 与 FTW 共享一个有界风险寻求偏移，且该偏移由 FTW 控制。
AI.conclusion: 序数滤波带来风险寻求偏移是样本级方差降低的固有代价，而 critic 模型则带来偏差-方差的不同权衡；FTW 以 CPU 内存为代价替代价值模型或组 rollout，是一条可行的权衡路径。

title: SCAD: Structured Credit Assignment and Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Training long-horizon agents to solve complex tasks requires effective supervision over extended interaction sequences. However, sparse terminal rewards obscure intermediate contributions, while on-policy distillation can lose informative teacher guidance as student-generated histories grow. To address this problem, we introduce SCAD, which organizes interactions into planning and bounded subtask execution, distills execution in local contexts, and refines planning credit through cross-rollout subtask prefix trees, with planning receiving full terminal credit and execution receiving positive terminal credit and teacher guidance. Across all evaluated benchmarks, SCAD improves macro-average accuracy over the strongest training baseline by 4.48 percentage points for text tasks and 4.19 points for multimodal tasks. SCAD effectively combines outcome-based credit assignment with teacher-guided distillation to improve planning and execution in long-horizon agents.

AI.tldr: 提出SCAD方法，将长时程智能体交互分为规划与有界子任务执行，通过跨轨迹子任务前缀树分配信用并结合教师蒸馏，在文本与多模态基准上分别较最强基线提升4.48与4.19个百分点。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体训练需要覆盖长交互序列的有效监督。稀疏的终端奖励难以揭示中间步骤的贡献，而在策略蒸馏会因学生生成的历史不断增长而丢失有价值的教师指导信号。因此需要一种兼顾结果信用分配与教师引导的监督机制。
AI.method: SCAD将交互组织为规划（planning）与有界子任务执行（bounded subtask execution）两个层次；在局部上下文中对执行阶段进行蒸馏；并通过跨轨迹（cross-rollout）子任务前缀树细化规划的信用分配。信用分配上，规划获得完整的终端奖励，执行获得正向终端奖励及教师指导。
AI.result: 在所有评估基准上，SCAD相较最强训练基线，文本任务宏平均准确率提升4.48个百分点，多模态任务提升4.19个百分点。
AI.conclusion: SCAD有效结合了基于结果的信用分配与教师引导蒸馏，同时改进了长时程智能体的规划与执行能力。

title: Operator-informed initialization for Fourier features physics-informed neural networks
summary: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) typically exhibit spectral bias, where some frequencies of the target function converge more slowly than others. In this work, we analyze the training dynamics of Fourier Feature PINNs in the Neural Tangent Kernel regime to address this limitation. We derive an explicit evolution equation to estimate the residual error in the frequency domain, demonstrating that the convergence rate of specific frequencies is primarily governed by the product of the differential operator's symbol and the spectral density of the initialization weights. Leveraging this theoretical insight, we propose an informative initialization strategy that tailors the initial weight distribution to the specific PDE being solved. With this method, we can diminish the operator-induced spectral bias, balancing the convergence rates across the frequency spectrum and achieving better prediction accuracy. Numerical experiments on linear and nonlinear partial differential equations confirm that this initialization strategy improves learning dynamics and approximation accuracy across frequencies compared to standard initialization methods, with no additional training cost.

AI.tldr: 该论文从NTK角度分析Fourier Feature PINNs的频域训练动力学，提出依据PDE算子符号定制初始权重谱密度的"信息初始化"策略，在不增加训练成本下缓解算子诱导的谱偏差。
AI.motivation: PINNs存在谱偏差，即目标函数中某些频率成分收敛明显慢于其他频率，导致高频信息学习不足、精度受限。作者希望从理论上解释该现象成因并加以缓解。
AI.method: 在神经正切核（NTK）框架下分析Fourier Feature PINNs的训练动力学，推导频域残差误差的显式演化方程；理论上证明各频率收敛速率主要由微分算子符号（symbol）与初始化权重谱密度的乘积决定；据此设计"信息初始化"策略，根据所求解PDE的算子特性定制初始权重分布。
AI.result: 理论上揭示了收敛速率的决定因素，并据此提出可减轻算子诱导谱偏差的初始化方法；在线性与非线性PDE数值实验中，相比标准初始化，该方法改善了学习动力学，在更宽的频率范围内提升了逼近精度，且不带来额外训练开销。
AI.conclusion: 频域收敛速率由算子符号与初始权重谱密度的乘积支配，通过针对PDE定制初始权重分布的信息初始化策略，可平衡各频率收敛速度、缓解谱偏差并提升PINNs的预测精度，且成本不增加。

title: A Unified Framework for Bayesian Data Assimilation with Generative Models and Observation Interpolants
summary: Bayesian data assimilation combines model forecasts with noisy observations, but sampling high-dimensional, non-Gaussian posteriors remains challenging. We introduce an observation-interpolant framework that turns pretrained stochastic interpolant, flow matching, and diffusion models into posterior samplers without retraining. Conditioning the interpolant path on observations yields a shared likelihood-score correction to the drift or velocity, unifying stochastic and deterministic posterior sampling. The resulting SDEs and ODEs sample the exact posterior when the intermediate likelihood score is known. For practical computation, we approximate this score using a closed-form Gaussian surrogate with a bias-corrected mean and covariance inflated by the model's source covariance. Jacobian-free and ensemble-shared approximations make the method tractable in high dimensions. We evaluate the framework on linear-Gaussian dynamics, stochastic two-dimensional Navier-Stokes, and urban airflow with up to $O(10^4)$ degrees of freedom.

AI.tldr: 提出观测插值框架，将预训练随机插值、流匹配与扩散模型转化为后验采样器，无需重训练，并在高维非高斯动力学任务上验证。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯数据同化融合模型预测与含噪观测，但高维、非高斯后验采样仍具挑战；现有生成模型需重训练或不适用于后验采样。
AI.method: 构建观测插值框架：对插值路径施加观测条件，导出漂移/速度项上的共享似然分数修正，统一随机与确定性后验采样；理论上当中间似然分数已知时所得SDE/ODE可精确采样后验。实际中以闭式高斯代理近似该分数（均值偏差校正、协方差由模型源协方差膨胀），并采用无雅可比与集合共享近似以保证高维可计算性。
AI.result: 在线性高斯动力学、随机二维Navier-Stokes及城市气流场景（自由度达O(10^4)）上完成评估。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可将预训练生成模型直接转为精确/可近似的后验采样器，无需重训练，并具备高维适用性。

title: 16-bit Precision of Convolutional Neural Networks on Microcontroller Units for 8-bit Costs
summary: To deploy deep neural networks on edge hardware, highly efficient inference schemes are necessary that retain high accuracy. This work presents W16A16, a high precision (16-bit), fast speed, low energy quantization method. On a widely applied microcontroller architecture Armv7E-M, our proposed approach achieves faster speed and lower energy consumption on layer- and model-level compared to alternative quantization schemes. We analyze the architecture of Armv7E-M, explain the underlying principles behind the performance advantages of 16-bit approaches, and evaluate the empiric quantization errors for regression and classification tasks, as well as empiric time- and energy consumption in MCU deployment. We observe ca.\ 10 times lower quantization errors compared to 8-bit quantization schemes while achieving similar or better inference times and energy consumption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出W16A16，一种面向Armv7E-M微控制器的高精度16位低功耗量化方法，在层级与模型级均实现更快速度和更低能耗，量化误差较8位方案降低约10倍。
AI.motivation: 为在边缘硬件（尤其是MCU）上部署深度神经网络，需要兼具高效率与高精度的推理方案。现有量化方法在精度与效率之间往往难以兼顾，因此需要探索一种既能保持高精度又能实现快速、低能耗的量化方案。
AI.method: 提出W16A16高精度（16位）量化方法，针对Armv7E-M架构进行适配。具体包括：分析Armv7E-M架构特性，解释16位方法性能优势的底层原理；在层级和模型级进行对比评估，并对回归与分类任务的量化误差以及MCU部署中的实际时间与能耗进行实证测量。
AI.result: 在Armv7E-M上，相比其他量化方案，层级与模型级均实现更快速度与更低能耗；量化误差较8位量化方案降低约10倍，同时推理时间与能耗相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 16位量化（W16A16）在边缘MCU部署中可同时实现高精度、快速推理与低能耗，是优于8位方案的量化选择，适用于回归和分类等任务。

title: AIBL: Augmented Instance-Based Learning with Structured Memory and Neural Embeddings
summary: Sequential learning systems often make decisions from accumulated experience while receiving high-dimensional inputs whose distribution may change over time. Instance-Based Learning Theory (IBLT) provides a principled case-based framework for such settings through stored situation-decision-utility instances, partial matching, activation, and blending. IBLT relies on symbolic knowledge representation in dictionary-like formats, but text, images, transaction vectors, and user-item histories often require learned similarity rather than hand-specified matching rules. In this paper, we introduce AIBL (Augmented Instance-Based Learning), an instance-learning model formulated in a learned vector space for high- dimensional sequential data. AIBL generalizes symbolic situation matching to neural embedding similarity while retaining instance storage, activation- weighted retrieval, and utility blending. The AIBL model organizes memory into active, forgotten, and surprise stores. Surprise memory separates weakly matched, possible out-of-distribution, or corner-case observations from active memory, reducing forced fitting to the nearest available cases. An observation-driven graduation algorithm promotes recurring surprise instances to active memory, allowing the memory to incorporate repeated novel patterns that may arise under concept drift. We evaluate the same implementation on five machine learning tasks and three controlled simulation tasks, comparing AIBL with classical IBLT variants and task-specific baselines where appropriate. AIBL improves accuracy by 6 to 17 percentage points. The results show where vector-space retrieval improves over symbolic matching and how the added memory mechanisms govern novelty detection, cold-start handling, drift adaptation, and reward learning under the tested protocols.

AI.tldr: AIBL将实例学习理论(IBLT)拓展到学习型向量空间，用神经嵌入相似度替代符号匹配，并引入主动/遗忘/惊讶三种记忆存储与"毕业"机制，在5个机器学习任务和3个仿真任务上比经典IBLT变体准确率提升6–17个百分点。
AI.motivation: IBLT虽为基于案例的序贯决策提供了原则性框架，但其依赖字典式符号知识表示与人工指定的匹配规则；而文本、图像、交易向量、用户-物品历史等高维数据需要可学习的相似度度量。因此需要一种能在学习到的向量空间中运作、同时保留IBLT核心机制的实例学习模型。
AI.method: 提出AIBL(Augmented Instance-Based Learning)：将符号情境匹配泛化为神经嵌入相似度，同时保留实例存储、激活加权检索和效用混合；记忆被组织为主动(active)、遗忘(forgotten)与惊讶(surprise)三类存储，惊讶记忆隔离弱匹配、潜在分布外或边角案例以避免被迫拟合最近邻；并设计由观测驱动的"毕业"(graduation)算法，将反复出现的惊讶实例提升为主动实例以应对概念漂移。
AI.result: 在同一实现上评测5个机器学习任务和3个受控仿真任务，并与经典IBLT变体及任务专用基线比较，准确率提升6–17个百分点。结果揭示了向量空间检索相对符号匹配的优势，以及新增记忆机制在novelty检测、冷启动处理、概念漂移适应和奖励学习中的作用。
AI.conclusion: AIBL证明了将IBLT从符号表示迁移到学习型向量空间是可行且有效的，并为高维序贯数据下的基于实例的序贯决策、分布外检测与漂移适应提供了统一的记忆框架。

title: Rethinking Epistemic Uncertainty in Node Classification through Information Growth
summary: Epistemic uncertainty should decrease as additional information about the data-generating process (DGP) becomes available to the predictor. Yet, existing graph evidential deep learning (EDL) methods for node classification typically construct epistemic uncertainty from graph-specific properties and evaluate it on downstream tasks such as out-of-distribution detection, which do not test its reducibility as information about the DGP increases. To make reducibility directly testable, we introduce a statistical framework for studying epistemic uncertainty under information growth. Our framework specifies an information-growth experimental protocol and a consistency criterion for epistemic predictors, while using projective graph DGPs to ensure that growing graphs, which in general need not provide increasing information about the same DGP, constitute coherent observations of the same underlying process. We show that EDL methods do not explicitly estimate data uncertainty arising from a single finite graph observation and instead regulate epistemic uncertainty through model hyperparameters, precluding consistency, as corroborated by controlled information-growth experiments. As an alternative, we propose graph bootstrap ensembles, capturing both data and procedural uncertainty through graph resampling and randomized training. Under the same experimental protocol, these ensembles exhibit epistemic uncertainty reduction beyond standard deep ensembles. These findings support bootstrap ensembles as candidate consistent epistemic predictors under information growth.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一个研究信息增长下认知不确定性的统计框架，指出图证据深度学习（EDL）方法无法保证一致性，并论证图自举集成（bootstrap ensembles）是更优候选。
AI.motivation: 认知不确定性应随关于数据生成过程（DGP）的信息增加而减小，但现有图EDL方法从图特有属性构造认知不确定性，并在OOD检测等下游任务上评估，无法检验其可约性（reducibility）。因此需要建立一个使可约性可直接检验的统计框架。
AI.method: 提出信息增长实验协议与认知预测器的一致性判据；使用投影式图DGP（projective graph DGPs）保证增长的图构成同一底层过程的一致观测。并以对照实验检验EDL方法，同时提出图自举集成，通过图重采样与随机化训练同时刻画数据不确定性与过程不确定性。
AI.result: EDL方法未显式估计来自单一有限图观测的数据不确定性，而是通过模型超参数调节认知不确定性，因而无法满足一致性，受控信息增长实验证实了这一点。在相同实验协议下，图自举集成展现出超越标准深度集成的认知不确定性下降。
AI.conclusion: 图自举集成是信息增长下候选的一致性认知预测器，为图不确定性建模提供了可检验的理论与实证基础。

title: Deep Bayesian REFoCUS
summary: In this work we formulate ultrasound multistatic recovery from arbitrary transmit sequences as a Bayesian inference problem. To that end, we train a deep generative prior on multistatic data sets to tackle the rank-deficient regime in which classical linear REFoCUS decoders fail. This appproach, which we term Deep Bayesian REFoCUS, outperforms the linear baselines for all regimes of rank-deficiency and noise levels, and regresses to linear decoding when inversion is exact. The model also expresses uncertainty in the null space of the acquisitions, whereas the linear REFoCUS decoders only provide point estimates. Finally, we analyze the impact of distribution shift between simulation and in-vivo acquisitions, showing remarkable generalization ability without any fine-tuning or adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文将超声多基地恢复问题建模为贝叶斯推断，通过深度生成先验解决线性REFoCUS解码器在秩亏情形下失效的问题，提出Deep Bayesian REFoCUS方法。
AI.motivation: 经典线性REFoCUS解码器在秩亏（rank-deficient）情形下无法有效工作，而任意发射序列下的多基地超声恢复本质上是病态逆问题，需要更强的先验与不确定性建模。
AI.method: 将任意发射序列下的超声多基地恢复形式化为贝叶斯推断问题；在多基地数据集上训练深度生成先验（deep generative prior），替代线性解码器进行后验推断，方法命名为Deep Bayesian REFoCUS。
AI.result: 在所有秩亏程度与噪声水平下均优于线性基线；当逆问题可精确求解时退化为线性解码；模型能在采集数据的零空间（null space）中表达不确定性，而线性REFoCUS仅给出点估计；在仿真与在体（in-vivo）数据之间存在分布偏移时，无需任何微调或自适应即展现出显著的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 深度生成先验结合贝叶斯推断可有效克服线性REFoCUS在秩亏逆问题中的局限，同时提供不确定性量化与对分布偏移的良好泛化，是多基地超声恢复的有前景框架。

title: OptiSelect: How does the Optimizer Shape Data Curriculum?
summary: Online data selection has demonstrated substantial efficiency gains for LLM pretraining by training on the most valuable candidates within each batch. Since a candidate's value is realized through its effective model update, principled selection should account for the optimizer step, which reshapes the raw gradient before it updates model parameters. We formalize this optimizer-aware selection paradigm as OptiSelect and present the first systematic study of how the optimizer shapes data selection. Our theory establishes a selection gain principle in which the advantage of online selection is governed by the discriminability of the optimizer-induced utility scores. We prove that sign-based and polar-tangential preconditioners of Lion and Muon would suffer from a discriminability collapse which caps attainable gains from OptiSelect, whereas diagonal-adaptive optimizers such as AdamW and Sophia admit strictly better upper bounds. The proposed principle also yields a quantitative derivation of the optimal candidate oversampling ratio. Pretraining experiments on 124M and 720M models are consistent with our theoretical analysis and show that AdamW's diagonal-adaptive scoring geometry remains the strongest scoring geometry even with Muon as optimizer. We further demonstrate that OptiSelect retains its benefits under data rephrasing, a technique used in modern data processing pipelines. Our findings provide theoretical foundations and practical guidance for co-designing optimizers and data selection in LLM pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文将"优化器感知的在线数据选择"形式化为 OptiSelect，首次系统研究优化器如何塑造数据选择，证明对角自适应优化器（AdamW/Sophia）的可分性优于符号/极坐标切向预条件器（Lion/Muon），并给出最优候选过采样比，在 124M 和 720M 模型上验证。
AI.motivation: 在线数据选择已在 LLM 预训练中展现效率增益，但候选数据的价值是通过其"有效模型更新"实现的，而原始梯度在更新参数前会被优化器重塑。以往的选择准则忽略了优化器步骤，因此缺乏原则性的选择依据，需要将优化器纳入数据选择的考量。
AI.method: 提出 OptiSelect 的优化器感知选择范式，并给出理论分析：建立"选择增益原理"，即在线选择的优势由优化器诱导效用分数的可分性（discriminability）决定。对比分析符号型与极坐标切向预条件器（Lion、Muon）与对角自适应优化器（AdamW、Sophia）的效用分数可分性，并由此定量推导最优候选过采样比。在 124M 与 720M 模型上进行预训练实验验证。
AI.result: 理论上证明 Lion 与 Muon 的符号型和极坐标切向预条件器会出现"可分性崩塌"，从而限制 OptiSelect 可获得的增益；而 AdamW 与 Sophia 等对角自适应优化器具有严格更优的上界。实验与理论一致：即便使用 Muon 作为优化器，AdamW 的对角自适应评分几何仍是最强的评分几何。此外，OptiSelect 在数据改写（rephrasing）下仍保持增益。
AI.conclusion: 研究为 LLM 预训练中优化器与数据选择的协同设计提供了理论基础与实践指导，表明评分几何（而非仅优化器本身）决定在线选择增益，对角自适应评分几何具有普适优势。

title: Causal Representation Learning with Instantaneous and Lagged Relations via Nonstationarity
summary: Causal representation learning for time-series data aims to identify latent states and their causal relations from observations. In this setting, an important challenge is to model both lagged causal relations across observation intervals and faster causal effects that appear as instantaneous relations within an interval, while accounting for nonstationarity in time-series data. However, methods that jointly handle these causal relations and nonstationarity remain limited. To address this gap, we establish sufficient conditions for identifying latent states up to component permutation and component-wise invertible transformations, and their instantaneous and lagged causal structures up to the same permutation, using an observed auxiliary variable, such as time or a condition label, associated with changes in transition-noise distributions. Based on these results, we propose iCReN, a framework that uses contrastive learning with discrete or continuous auxiliary variables to learn latent representations and estimate their instantaneous and lagged causal structures. Experiments demonstrate accurate recovery of latent states and both instantaneous and lagged causal structures on synthetic data and the utility of the learned representations for downstream forecasting on real-world data.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究时间序列的因果表示学习，提出用辅助变量应对非平稳性，建立可识别性条件并给出方法iCReN，可同时恢复潜在状态、瞬时与滞后因果结构。
AI.motivation: 时间序列因果表示学习需同时建模跨观测区间的滞后因果关系与区间内的瞬时因果效应，并处理非平稳性；现有方法难以联合处理这三者，存在研究空白。
AI.method: 利用与转移噪声分布变化相关的观测辅助变量（如时间或条件标签），建立潜在状态（至多分量置换与逐分量可逆变换）及瞬时、滞后因果结构（至多同一置换）可识别的充分条件；据此提出iCReN框架，采用离散或连续辅助变量的对比学习来学习潜在表示并估计瞬时与滞后因果结构。
AI.result: 在合成数据上准确恢复潜在状态以及瞬时和滞后因果结构；在真实数据上所学表示对下游预测任务具有实用性。
AI.conclusion: 通过辅助变量刻画非平稳性，可实现潜在状态与瞬时、滞后因果结构的联合可识别，iCReN验证了该理论框架的有效性与实用价值。

title: Measure Less, Know More: Self-Supervised Test-Time Feature Acquisition
summary: Recent progress in multimodal, high-dimensional learning has enabled foundation models to process heterogeneous, large-scale data. However, at test time, acquiring all features or modalities can be prohibitively costly and often redundant. Sequentially selecting informative modalities is therefore critical, yet challenging when the downstream task or prediction target is unknown. To this end, we introduce ECHO-$k$, a task-agnostic and self-supervised learning principle for modality acquisition: we use a deep model's internal pretrained representations (e.g., from a foundation model) as proxy targets that summarize cross-modal information. We provide theoretical guarantees in a stylized linear setting that motivate a reinforcement learning (RL) policy for sequential modality selection. Across task-agnostic and label-free acquisition baselines, ECHO-$k$ consistently improves budgeted downstream performance across diverse foundation-model backends. Our method provides a principled route to cost-aware test-time deployment, with implications for any multimodal system where measurements are expensive or time-constrained, and downstream tasks unknown a priori.

AI.tldr: 提出任务无关、自监督的模态顺序选择原则 ECHO-k，用预训练模型内部表征作为跨模态代理目标，并用 RL 策略实现预算约束下的模态采集。
AI.motivation: 多模态基础模型可处理异构大规模数据，但测试时获取全部特征或模态代价高昂且常存在冗余；当下游任务或预测目标未知时，顺序选择信息量大的模态十分困难。
AI.method: ECHO-k：任务无关、自监督的模态获取原则，以深度模型（如基础模型）的内部预训练表征作为总结跨模态信息的代理目标；在简化的线性设定下给出理论保证，并据此设计用于顺序模态选择的强化学习策略。
AI.result: 在任务无关且无标签的获取基线对比中，ECHO-k 在多种基础模型后端上持续提升预算约束下的下游性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为成本感知的测试时部署提供了有原则的路径，适用于测量昂贵、时间受限且下游任务事先未知的多模态系统。

title: Beyond Random Splits: Evaluating Drug-Target Affinity Models Under Chemically and Biologically Motivated Distribution Shifts Copy
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD)
summary: Drug-target affinity (DTA) prediction is widely used to prioritize candidate compounds before costly experimental screening. DTA models are often compared under a single data split, even though deployment may require extrapolation to new chemical series, new protein targets, or both. We ask whether the distribution shift used for evaluation changes which architecture appears best. We curate 718,800 unique drug-protein pairs from the ChEMBL and BindingDB datasets. We compare a Morgan-fingerprint + protein-CNN baseline with 12 controlled architectures that combine four drug representations with three ESM-2 interaction modes. Mean validation RMSE increases from 0.950 and 0.945 under scaffold and fingerprint-cluster OOD to 1.299 and 1.321 under protein-cluster and dual OOD. Model rankings are similar across the two chemical shifts (tau = 0.79), but agreement with scaffold OOD falls under protein OOD (tau = 0.39) and reverses under dual OOD (tau = -0.55). Held-out evaluation, repeated seeds, group-aware bootstrap analysis, and a size-matched control support the same conclusion: architecture selection depends on the form of extrapolation, not only on average error or training-set size. DTA benchmarks should therefore match the chemical and target shifts expected at deployment.

AI.tldr: 该论文质疑DTA模型仅在单一数据划分下比较的做法，通过在718,800个药物-蛋白对上比较13种架构在四种分布偏移下的表现，发现模型排名随外推类型而变化，甚至在双重OOD下排名反转。
AI.motivation: DTA预测常用于实验筛选前的化合物优先级排序，但现有DTA模型通常在单一数据划分下评估，而实际部署往往需要外推到新的化学系列、新的蛋白靶点或两者兼有。作者因此提出核心问题：用于评估的分布偏移形式是否会改变哪种架构看起来最优。
AI.method: 作者从ChEMBL和BindingDB整理出718,800个唯一药物-蛋白对，将Morgan指纹+蛋白CNN基线，与12种受控架构（4种药物表示 × 3种ESM-2交互模式）进行比较。评估覆盖四类分布偏移：scaffold OOD、fingerprint-cluster OOD、protein-cluster OOD以及dual OOD，并采用留出评估、重复随机种子、分组感知bootstrap分析和规模匹配对照来验证结论。
AI.result: 平均验证RMSE在scaffold和fingerprint-cluster OOD下分别为0.950和0.945，而在protein-cluster和dual OOD下升至1.299和1.321。模型排名在两种化学偏移间相似（tau = 0.79），但与scaffold OOD的一致性在protein OOD下降低（tau = 0.39），并在dual OOD下反转（tau = -0.55）。留出评估、重复种子、分组bootstrap及规模匹配对照均支持同一结论。
AI.conclusion: 架构选择取决于外推的形式，而不仅仅取决于平均误差或训练集规模。因此，DTA基准测试的划分方式应匹配部署时预期的化学与靶点偏移，否则可能得出误导性的最优模型结论。

title: Single or Multiple Policies for Phase-Structured Reinforcement Learning?
comment: 40 pages, 13 figures, main paper with appendix
summary: Many reinforcement-learning (RL) problems are non-stationary yet structured and can be decomposed into phases, each with its own transition probabilities and reward functions. When the phase sequence is known, the common solution augments the state with information to satisfy the Markovian property and applies standard RL techniques. However, prior work finds that the multi-policy approach for different phases can outperform a single state-augmented policy shared among the phases, for reasons that remain unclear. In this work, we first show that the shared policy can theoretically achieve performance of any multi-policy solution. However, whether a multi-policy solution can perform better than the corresponding single shared policy in practice depends on function approximation, learning and optimization processes, as well as, for multi-policy solutions, the sample efficiency and loss of continuity from one policy to another. We propose a regime-based phase decomposition method to identify which policy can provide better performance. The method is based on consideration of the duration of transient system dynamics relative to the duration of the quasi-stationary period. Numerical experiments are conducted with different non-stationary RL problems to validate our four major hypotheses: (a) longer phase durations favor multi-policies, (b) the heterogeneity between phases increases the burden on single policy, (c) multi-policies need sufficient data for each phase, and (d) environment-specific transition dynamics between phases can affect which policy is preferable.

AI.tldr: 本文分析非平稳强化学习中单策略与多策略的优劣，提出基于瞬态与准稳态时长的“regime-based phase decomposition”方法判断何时多策略更优，并用实验验证四个假设。
AI.motivation: 非平稳RL问题虽可分解为多个阶段，但当阶段序列已知时，通常将信息增广到状态并应用标准RL技术。然而已有工作发现按阶段使用多策略可能优于共享的单一状态增广策略，其原因尚不明确，本文旨在厘清这一现象并给出策略选择依据。
AI.method: 首先从理论上证明共享策略可以达到任意多策略解的性能；随后指出实际优劣取决于函数逼近、学习与优化过程，以及多策略方案的样本效率和策略间连续性损失。提出基于瞬态系统动力学时长相对于准稳态周期时长考量的regime-based phase decomposition方法，用于识别哪种策略更优。
AI.result: 在不同非平稳RL问题上进行数值实验，验证了四个主要假设：(a) 阶段持续时间越长越有利于多策略；(b) 阶段间异质性增加单策略负担；(c) 多策略需要每阶段足够数据；(d) 阶段间环境特定的转移动态会影响策略偏好。
AI.conclusion: 理论上共享策略可达多策略的性能，但实践中选择取决于函数逼近、学习优化及样本效率与连续性等因素；提出的regime-based分解方法可依据瞬态与准稳态时长判断单策略或多策略更优，实验支持该框架及相关假设。

title: Metropolis-Hastings Dominates Importance Resampling for Policy Composition
summary: Post-training a large language model (LLM) often requires exploring trade-offs between multiple rewards, but retraining for each trade-off is expensive. Decoding-time policy composition allows these trade-offs to be adjusted by combining reward-specific policies at inference time. This composition targets a weighted product of the policies' probabilities over complete responses, but standard implementations combine their next-token probabilities, generally introducing sampling bias. We analyze a known iterative correction based on independence Metropolis-Hastings (MH). Our main result shows that, for every rollout budget, MH produces an output distribution at least as close to the target as sampling-importance-resampling (SIR) with the same budget, as measured by every convex f-divergence. We also derive a lower bound on MH's improvement over the uncorrected decoder in a consensus objective measuring agreement with the supplied policies. We further characterize the correction's sampling error in two asymptotic regimes: when the reward-specific policies approach agreement, and when the log ratio between target and uncorrected-decoder probabilities fluctuates increasingly widely, as can happen for long responses. We complement our analysis with experiments in enumerable and LLM-scale settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了解码时策略组合中的独立性Metropolis-Hastings（MH）修正方法，证明在任意rollout预算下，MH的输出分布按任意凸f-散度度量都至少与同预算的SIR一样接近目标分布，并给出其相对未修正解码器改进的下界及两种渐近情形下的采样误差刻画。
AI.motivation: 后训练大模型需要在多个奖励之间权衡，但为每种权衡重新训练代价高昂。解码时策略组合可在推理阶段通过合并奖励特定策略来调节权衡。然而标准实现组合的是下一token概率，而组合目标应为完整响应上的概率加权乘积，因而一般会引入采样偏差。论文旨在分析一种已知的基于独立性Metropolis-Hastings的迭代修正方法，以解决该偏差问题。
AI.method: 论文对基于独立性Metropolis-Hastings（MH）的迭代修正进行理论分析：以完整响应上的策略概率加权乘积为目标分布，将MH与同预算的采样-重要性-重采样（SIR）进行对比；用凸f-散度度量输出分布与目标的接近程度；推导MH相对未修正解码器在一致性目标上的改进下界；并在两种渐近情形下刻画修正的采样误差，最后辅以可枚举设置与LLM规模实验。
AI.result: 主要结果表明，对任意rollout预算，MH产生的输出分布在所有凸f-散度度量下都至少与同预算的SIR一样接近目标分布。论文还给出了MH相对未修正解码器在一致性目标上的改进下界，并刻画了两种渐近情形下的采样误差：奖励特定策略趋于一致时，以及目标与未修正解码器概率之间的对数比波动越来越大时（长响应中可能出现）。可枚举与LLM规模实验对分析进行了补充验证。
AI.conclusion: 基于独立性MH的解码时策略组合修正具有理论保证：其输出分布按凸f-散度优于同预算SIR，并能以可量化下界改进未修正解码器，同时论文明确了其采样误差在策略趋同与长响应高波动等情形下的行为，为多奖励权衡的高效推理时调节提供了理论支撑与实验依据。

title: Dual-Context Analog Retrieval for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Most long-term time-series forecasting models map the look-back window directly to the full horizon in a single pass. While efficient, this design does not explicitly identify which historical states are most relevant to different future segments or exploit what followed those states. Analog forecasting addresses this by retrieving past states similar to the present and using their observed continuations, but single nearest matches can be unreliable and overlapping patches may produce redundant candidates. We propose DuoTS, a Dual-Context Time Series forecasting model that uses retrieved evidence without relying on it exclusively. DuoTS first produces a base forecast with a parallel patch encoder and linear prediction head, then progressively refines it one future patch at a time. Each refinement combines two views: a current context that attends to recent tokens and captures the latest dynamics, and a detail context that provides distinct retrieved analogs together with their subsequent trajectories. Patch-wise refinement allows the model to balance these views across the forecast horizon and associate each future segment with evidence appropriate to its temporal distance from the present. Experiments on multiple real-world datasets show that DuoTS achieves state-of-the-art performance, while ablations confirm the contribution of each context. The refinement mechanism is also model-agnostic, requiring only an encoded look-back window and the future-patch position, and can therefore be integrated into existing forecasting models.

AI.tldr: DuoTS是一种双上下文时间序列预测模型，先由并行patch编码器与线性预测头生成基础预测，再逐patch精炼，结合当前上下文与检索到的相似历史片段（analog）后续轨迹，在多个真实数据集上取得SOTA，且精炼机制模型无关。
AI.motivation: 现有长期时间序列预测模型通常将回看窗口单次直接映射到整个预测区间，虽高效但未显式识别哪些历史状态与不同未来片段最相关，也未利用这些状态之后的实际演变。类比预测（analog forecasting）通过检索与当前状态相似的历史状态并利用其后续观测来解决该问题，但单一最近邻匹配不可靠，且重叠patch会产生冗余候选。因此需要一种既利用检索证据又不完全依赖它的方法。
AI.method: 提出DuoTS双上下文预测模型。第一阶段用并行patch编码器和线性预测头生成基础预测；第二阶段逐个未来patch渐进精炼，每次精炼融合两种视角：当前上下文（current context）关注近期token以捕捉最新动态，细节上下文（detail context）提供彼此不同的检索类比及其后续轨迹。逐patch精炼使模型能随预测步长平衡两种视角，并按各未来片段与当前的时间距离关联合适证据。该精炼机制模型无关，仅需编码后的回看窗口与未来patch位置。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界数据集上的实验表明DuoTS达到state-of-the-art性能；消融实验验证了两种上下文各自的贡献。
AI.conclusion: DuoTS通过双上下文逐patch精炼，在不完全依赖检索证据的前提下有效融合近期动态与类比轨迹信息，提升长期预测精度；其精炼机制具有通用性，可集成到现有预测模型中。

title: Most-Recent Anchoring with Recurrent Ordering for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Long-term forecasting models commonly process all patches in a look-back window using the same fixed stack. Older contextual patches and recent evidence therefore receive the same computational depth. Yet the information closest to the forecast and the more distant context do not contribute equally. Uniform processing leaves this distinction unexpressed in the architecture. We propose MARO, a Most-Recent Anchoring with Recurrent Ordering model that processes the look-back window from the most recent patch to the oldest. The most recent patch serves as the anchor. It initializes the latent state and conditions each subsequent step, so older patches are folded into a representation that remains centered on recent evidence. A single shared module is reused at every step, so extending the scan further into the past introduces no additional parameters. Intermediate states retained during the scan allow the forecast head to weigh short and long portions of the history separately. This expresses recency through the order of recurrent refinement. Extensive experiments across multiple real-world time series datasets show that MARO achieves state-of-the-art performance on both long-term and short-term forecasting tasks.Ablation studies examine the contribution of the main architectural components.

AI.tldr: MARO提出“最近锚定+循环排序”的长时序预测模型：从最近片段向最旧片段处理，最近片段作为锚点初始化隐状态并对每步条件化，共享单模块复用避免额外参数，保留中间状态供预测头分别加权近期与远期历史，在多个真实数据集上取得长短期预测SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有长时序预测模型对回看窗口内所有patch使用相同的固定堆叠结构，逐层同深度处理。但离预测点最近的证据与较远上下文贡献并不相等，均匀处理使这一重要性差异未在架构中体现。
AI.method: MARO（Most-Recent Anchoring with Recurrent Ordering）：按“最近patch→最旧patch”的顺序扫描回看窗口；以最近patch为锚点，初始化隐状态并条件化后续每一步，使旧patch被折叠进以近期证据为中心的表示；每一步复用同一共享模块，向更远历史扩展不增加参数；扫描中保留的中间状态使预测头可分别对短、长历史片段加权，通过循环精炼的顺序表达时间近因性。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界时间序列数据集上的大量实验表明，MARO在长期与短期预测任务上均达到最先进（SOTA）性能；消融实验考察了主要架构组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 将时间近因性编码为循环精炼的顺序（最近锚定、参数共享、多尺度状态加权），可在不增加参数的前提下更合理地分配历史信息，并带来长短期预测的稳定性能提升。

title: Below what training size do deep tabular generators stop beating trivial baselines? A preregistered benchmark on a size ladder of clinical and standard datasets
comment: 31 pages, 5 figures. Code, all 2,220 result files and the frozen preregistration: https://github.com/ShivamShrivastava18/sdts-benchmark ; archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22712401
summary: Deep tabular generative models are benchmarked on datasets with tens of thousands of rows; clinical datasets have hundreds. We preregistered and ran a size-ladder benchmark to find where the two regimes diverge: 8 public datasets subsampled from 200 to 20,000 training rows, seven generators (independent marginals, Gaussian copula, SMOTE, unconditional SMOTE, CTGAN, TVAE, TabDDPM) with a fixed 20-trial tuning budget and 5 evaluation seeds, plus 4 natively small clinical datasets at true size, for 2,220 committed runs in total. The primary metric is the AUROC of fixed classifiers trained on synthetic and tested on real data. In 23 of 24 (dataset, deep model) pairs no deep model ever beats the best trivial baseline by more than seed noise, at any training size we measured. The best baseline wins 40 of 49 (dataset, size) cells. Our preregistered prediction that the deep models' ranking would be unstable at small sizes is falsified: mean Kendall tau between adjacent rungs below 5,000 rows is 0.806, above our 0.8 threshold, and stability is highest at the smallest sizes rather than lowest. One caveat bounds all of this: in 81% of cells the gap between the top two methods is smaller than the variation between seeds. Finally, method rankings on natively small clinical datasets agree only moderately with rankings on subsampled large ones (mean tau 0.57 to 0.64), which questions whether a subsampled large dataset can stand in for a small one. All 2,220 result files, the preregistration and its hash, and the code that regenerates every figure and number from those files are public.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过一个预注册的规模阶梯基准测试（2,220次运行，200–20,000训练行、7个生成器），发现深度表格生成模型在中小规模数据上并不优于最佳平凡基线，且其排名在小规模下反而更稳定；同时，原生小临床数据集与子采样大数据集的方法排名仅中等一致。
AI.motivation: 深度表格生成模型的基准测试通常使用数万行的数据集，而临床数据集往往只有数百行，二者所处数据规模区间存在显著差异。作者希望确定深度模型与平凡基线在何种训练规模上出现性能分化，并检验“深度模型排名在小规模下不稳定”这一假设，同时考察用子采样大数据集替代原生小数据集的有效性。
AI.method: 预注册并运行规模阶梯基准：8个公开数据集从200到20,000训练行进行子采样，7个生成器（独立边缘分布、高斯copula、SMOTE、无条件SMOTE、CTGAN、TVAE、TabDDPM），固定20次试验调参预算与5个评估种子，另加4个原生小临床数据集按真实规模测试，共2,220次提交运行。主指标为在合成数据上训练、在真实数据上测试的固定分类器的AUROC。
AI.result: 在24个（数据集，深度模型）对中有23个，深度模型在任何训练规模下均未超过最佳平凡基线一个以上的种子噪声；最佳基线在49个（数据集，规模）单元中赢得40个。预注册的“小规模下深度模型排名不稳定”预测被证伪：低于5,000行时相邻阶梯的平均Kendall tau为0.806，高于0.8阈值，且稳定性在最小规模处最高。81%的单元中前两名方法差距小于种子间变异。原生小临床数据集与子采样大数据集的方法排名仅中等一致（平均tau 0.57–0.64）。
AI.conclusion: 在中小规模表格数据上，深度生成模型相对平凡基线缺乏可复现的优势，其排名稳定性并非随规模缩小而下降，反而更高。由于前两名方法差距常小于种子噪声，方法选择应谨慎；并且子采样大数据集不能可靠替代原生小数据集，临床等小数据场景的基准测试需直接使用原生小数据集。全部2,220个结果文件、预注册及其哈希、以及可复现所有图表与数字的代码均已公开。

title: Getting Your Guidance Weights Right in diffusion and flow-matching posterior sampling
summary: Training-free posterior sampling methods, also known as Plug-and-Play methods, leverage pretrained unconditional diffusion or flow-matching models to solve inverse problems. Most existing approaches rely on guidance weights to balance, at each time step, prior information from the unconditional score or velocity network with measurement consistency, yet the tuning of these weights is often not discussed and is largely left to heuristics. We introduce a simple and principled offline strategy for automatically tuning these guidance weights. Our key observation is that, at each time step, the conditional denoising score-matching objective for diffusion models, or the conditional flow-matching objective for flow-matching models, is a least-squares objective. Therefore, when the conditional prediction is expressed as a weighted sum of the unconditional network output and a measurement-guidance term, optimizing over these weights reduces to a two-dimensional linear least-squares problem. The resulting time-dependent guidance weights can be optimized offline for a given measurement operator, noise level and sampler at the cost of a single minibatch of sampling trajectories, without retraining or fine-tuning the pretrained generative model. Instantiated with the standard Tweedie-based measurement-consistency term, our approach improves posterior sampling and achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance across diffusion- and flow-matching-based methods. Moreover, the optimized guidance weights enable diffusion samplers to reduce the number of sampling steps from 1000 to 50 with no significant degradation in reconstruction quality. Code will be made available.

AI.tldr: 提出一种离线自动调参策略，将引导权重优化化为二维线性最小二乘问题，无需重训练即可提升扩散/流匹配后验采样的重建性能。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练后验采样（Plug-and-Play）方法依赖引导权重来平衡无条件先验与测量一致性，但这些权重的调节缺乏讨论，多凭启发式设定，影响重建效果与稳定性。
AI.method: 观察到各时间步的条件去噪得分匹配目标（扩散）或条件流匹配目标（流匹配）均为最小二乘目标；当条件预测表示为无条件网络输出与测量引导项的加权和时，权重优化退化为二维线性最小二乘问题，可离线针对给定测量算子、噪声水平和采样器优化时间相关引导权重，仅需一个采样轨迹小批量，无需重训练或微调预训练模型；采用标准Tweedie-based测量一致性项实例化。
AI.result: 在扩散与流匹配方法上实现最先进的重建性能，改进后验采样；优化后的引导权重可使扩散采样步数从1000降至50而无明显重建质量下降。
AI.conclusion: 引导权重的自动离线调参可简单、有原则地解决权重调节问题，提升后验采样性能并显著降低采样步数，且不依赖模型重训练。

title: An Automated and Reproducible Workflow for Crack Identification and Damage Assessment of Fusion Materials
summary: Post-exposure microscopy is central to qualification of fusion materials. However, manual analysis does not scale to the volume, heterogeneity, and multiresolution character of modern fusion-materials campaigns. To address this challenge, we present a reproducible workflow, implemented in the Galaxy scientific workflow environment, for automated crack identification and quantitative damage assessment from scanning electron microscopy images. The workflow processes SEM images and experimental metadata to identify cracks, quantify damage, and retain the intermediate products and processing history needed for reproducibility. Outputs include crack masks, skeletonized crack networks, quality-control visualizations, and scalar damage descriptors. The method is designed to operate without image-specific parameter tuning across tungsten grades, microstructures, magnifications, and damage states. We demonstrate the workflow on a sparse electron-beam thermal-shock dataset containing 418 images from 114 experiments spanning five tungsten grades and three microstructural states. We define a crack-density descriptor, which provides standardized inputs for downstream machine-learning prediction and physics-based crack simulation. These predictive components are exposed in the same Galaxy environment and are intentionally treated here as extensible workflow modules. The principal contribution is therefore an end-to-end, shareable, and computationally portable workflow that links experimental characterization, automated image analysis, preliminary damage prediction, and simulation-guided data acquisition for fusion-materials research.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于Galaxy环境的可复现工作流，实现SEM图像中裂纹的自动识别与定量损伤评估，链接实验表征、自动图像分析、损伤预测与模拟。
AI.motivation: 后曝露显微分析是聚变材料合格性评估的核心，但人工分析无法应对现代聚变材料实验数据的规模、异质性与多分辨率特征。
AI.method: 在Galaxy科学工作流环境中实现可复现流程，处理SEM图像与实验元数据，执行裂纹识别、损伤量化，并保留中间产物与处理历史；方法设计为跨钨牌号、微观结构、放大倍数与损伤状态无需图像特定参数调优。
AI.result: 在一个稀疏电子束热冲击数据集上验证：418张图像、114个实验、五个钨牌号、三种微观结构状态；输出裂纹掩膜、骨架化裂纹网络、质控可视化与标量损伤描述符，并定义裂纹密度描述符。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是一个端到端、可共享、计算可移植的工作流，将实验表征、自动化图像分析、初步损伤预测与模拟引导的数据采集连接起来，为下游机器学习与物理裂纹模拟提供标准化输入。

title: Beyond Trained Models: Compiling GNNs for a Sound Explainer Benchmark
summary: Explainers for Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are commonly evaluated by their plausibility, i.e., how well their explanations recover a predefined ground truth, such as a motif planted in the data. This protocol implicitly assumes that a GNN trained on such data relies on the intended motif. Although prior work has questioned this assumption, plausibility remains widespread. First, we show that the assumption is violated on several widely used benchmarks, where, e.g., degree statistics alone suffice to solve the task. Then, we remove this confounder by replacing training with compilation. We achieve this by introducing $\mathsf{Gracr}$, the first compiler translating graded modal logic formulas into GNN weights, yielding models that replicate the behaviour of the corresponding formulas. Since the behaviour of the model is now known by construction, we can define its ground truth explanation formally and compute it exactly. Building on this, we introduce $\mathsf{Gracr}\mathsf{Bench}$, a benchmark of compiled GNNs for the evaluation of explainers against this exact ground truth. Experiments on eleven explainers across six tasks show its effectiveness for fine-grained diagnostic evaluation: notably, we discover that most explainers are not robust to indirect influences or alternative implementations of the same formula. These results position $\mathsf{Gracr}\mathsf{Bench}$ as a novel, rigorous evaluation setting for graph post-hoc explainability.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑现有GNN解释器评估中"合理性"假设（即模型依赖预设motif），证明该假设在常用基准上不成立（度数统计即可解题），进而用逻辑公式编译替代训练，构建精确真值的基准GracrBench。
AI.motivation: GNN解释器通常以"合理性"评估，即解释能否恢复预设的真值（如植入的motif）。这一协议隐含假设：在如此数据上训练的GNN确实依赖该预设motif。尽管已有工作质疑该假设，该评估方式仍被广泛使用。作者发现该假设在多个常用基准上被违背，因此需要一种行为已知、真值可精确计算的评估设置。
AI.method: 1) 实证检验常用基准：发现在若干基准上仅凭度数统计即可解题，说明模型可能未依赖预设motif；2) 为消除该混淆因素，用"编译"取代"训练"：提出Gracr，首个将分级模态逻辑（graded modal logic）公式翻译为GNN权重的编译器，使模型行为与对应逻辑公式一致；3) 由于模型行为由构造已知，可形式化定义其真值解释并精确计算；4) 基于此构建GracrBench，包含已编译的GNN，用于对照该精确真值评估解释器。
AI.result: 在六个任务、十一种解释器上的实验表明GracrBench可实现细粒度诊断性评估；尤其发现多数解释器对间接影响（indirect influences）以及同一公式的替代实现（alternative implementations）并不稳健。
AI.conclusion: GracrBench为图后置解释性（post-hoc explainability）提供了一个新颖且严谨的评估设置，通过编译而非训练消除真值假设的混淆，使解释器评估可基于形式化定义、可精确计算的真实解释。

title: ZeroMAG: Zero-Shot Multimodal Adapter Generation for Plug-and-Play EEG Foundation Models
summary: EEG foundation models (EFMs) capture reusable knowledge from large-scale EEG data, while many EEG recordings also include companion physiological signals that provide complementary information beyond the EEG-only interface. The challenge is to preserve this pretrained knowledge while extending the EFM to heterogeneous multimodal recordings through an adaptation inferred from unlabeled target data. We introduce ZeroMAG, a zero-shot multimodal adapter generation framework that extends a frozen EEG encoder and prediction head using unlabeled target recordings, without target labels or target-side optimization. The target datasets are held out from all model training and selection in the ZeroMAG pipeline. ZeroMAG organizes companion modalities around a configuration-invariant adapter, constructs a modality-subject-task condition from unlabeled recordings and task context, and generates adapter weights in a function-constrained latent space learned from source adapters. Across six held-out target datasets and three EFM backbones, ZeroMAG improves balanced accuracy by 7.22 percentage points over EEG-only inference and 4.89 points over direct weight regression, while coming within 0.50 points of supervised multimodal adaptation on average. Ablations further show that removing functional supervision from either representation learning or conditional generation degrades generated-adapter performance, confirming the contribution of both components.

AI.tldr: ZeroMAG 提出一种零样本多模态适配器生成框架，在不使用目标标签、不进行目标端优化的前提下，将冻结的 EEG 基础模型扩展至多模态记录，平均超越纯 EEG 推理 7.22 个百分点。
AI.motivation: EEG 基础模型（EFMs）能从大规模 EEG 数据中学习可复用知识，但许多 EEG 记录还包含可提供互补信息的伴随生理信号。核心挑战在于：既要保留预训练知识，又要通过从无标签目标数据推断出的适配，将纯 EEG 接口的 EFM 扩展到异构多模态记录。
AI.method: 提出 ZeroMAG 零样本多模态适配器生成框架：冻结 EEG 编码器与预测头，利用无标签目标记录扩展；围绕配置不变的适配器组织伴随模态；从无标签记录与任务上下文构建“模态-被试-任务”条件；在从源适配器学习到的函数约束潜空间中生成适配器权重。目标数据集在整个流程中均不参与任何训练与模型选择。
AI.result: 在六个留出目标数据集与三种 EFM 骨干上，ZeroMAG 的平衡准确率较纯 EEG 推理提升 7.22 个百分点，较直接权重回归提升 4.89 个百分点，平均仅比有监督多模态适配低 0.50 个百分点。消融实验表明，移除表示学习或条件生成中的任一函数监督都会降低生成适配器性能，验证了两部分组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: ZeroMAG 能够在无目标标签与无目标端优化的零样本设定下，有效保留冻结 EFM 的预训练知识并扩展至多模态记录，性能接近有监督多模态适配，为跨模态 EEG 迁移提供了可行路径。

title: Objects Without Morphisms: What LLMs for Mathematics Do Not Represent
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have reached expert-level performance on competition mathematics largely through the volume of search placed around them: candidate solutions are sampled in quantity and retained only when an external criterion accepts them. Such a procedure improves the outcome that survives it while leaving untouched what the model represents. We examine that question where no external criterion exists: translating statements between the dialects of neighbouring subfields, where fidelity turns on the level of generality at which content is asserted. The source leaves that level implicit in its vocabulary, so a faithful translation must recover it from the relation between the theories. We introduce an instrument that codes truth, content and scope in separate blind queues, with a judge-free measure of whether a rewrite states the hypothesis implicit in its source, and establish its sensitivity with a planted-positive control. Across seven models from four families, translating towards the general framing widens the domain of quantification in 60.6% of rewrites and narrows it in none; translating towards the concrete framing narrows it in 28.3% and widens it in 0.3%. The hypothesis that would prevent it is stated in 21.6% of model rewrites and 4.2% of human statements. Capability does not govern the asymmetry: it appears in every model tested, and the most capable widens least. It replicates on the half of the benchmark held out by a pre-registered rule, and on statements written by mathematicians. Instructing a model to state every hypothesis it requires raises that rate but not its sensitivity to direction. We argue that these systems have acquired an object-level correspondence between subfield vocabularies without the constraint under which a translation between theories carries hypotheses to hypotheses.

AI.tldr: 论文研究大语言模型在缺乏外部判据的翻译任务中（相邻子领域方言之间的陈述翻译）是否真正表征了源文本的泛化层次，发现模型系统性地倾向于拓宽量化域、丢失源文中隐含假设，且这一不对称性与模型能力无关、跨模型家族与人类文本复现。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在竞赛数学上的专家级表现主要依赖围绕模型的大量搜索与外部判据筛选（采样大量候选解、只保留通过外部标准者），这种做法只改善幸存结果，而不改变模型内部表征。作者希望在没有外部判据的场景下检验模型表征本身：即子领域方言间的翻译，其保真度取决于内容被断言时所处的泛化层次，而源文用词汇隐含该层次，忠实翻译须从理论间关系恢复它。
AI.method: 引入一套评测工具：将真值、内容与作用域分别编码入独立的盲队列，并采用无判官（judge-free）的度量，判定改写是否陈述了其源文所隐含的假设；以植入式正样本对照（planted-positive control）确立该工具的敏感性。在来自四个模型家族的七个模型上，于预注册规则划分出的留出基准集以及数学家撰写的陈述上进行测试，并做方向性指令实验。
AI.result: 向一般化框架翻译时，60.6%的改写拓宽了量化域，无一提窄；向具体化框架翻译时，28.3%提窄、0.3%拓宽。应能阻止该现象的假设仅在21.6%的模型改写与4.2%的人类陈述中被陈述。该不对称性不随能力变化：在所有测试模型中都出现，且能力最强者拓宽最少。结论在预注册留出的基准半集与数学家撰写的陈述上均复现。指令模型陈述其所需要的全部假设可提高该比例，但不提高其对方向的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 这些系统已获得子领域词汇之间的对象层对应关系，却缺乏"理论间翻译应将假设映射为假设"这一约束，因而在无外部判据时翻译会系统性地偏移泛化层次。作者据此提出，此类系统在缺乏外部筛选时并不真正维持源文的表征保真度。

title: Get a GRIP, this will be a long TRIP: A Quantifiable Long-Range Framework for Verifying Over-squashing
comment: Published at the Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Track on Evaluations and Datasets
summary: Empirical claims about the connection between over-squashing and long-range interactions in GNNs, can only be trusted if the benchmarks used to validate them genuinely require long-range interactions. The de-facto standard, the Long Range Graph Benchmark, has been repeatedly shown to be saturated by tuned short-range models, with existing synthetic alternatives being tied to specific topologies. As such, there is a lack of principled certificate of long-rangedness on arbitrary graphs. This state reflects the absence of a precise characterization of long-ranged benchmarks. We address this fundamental gap by introducing four verifiable axioms: Predictability, Tightness, Strictly $k$-Range, and Topology-Invariance, that any task claiming to test $k$-hop interactions must satisfy. We formally prove that violating any one of them admits failure modes that undermine conclusions drawn from the task. Based on these axioms, we introduce TRIP (Truly Ranged Interactions Problem) and its generalisation GRIP (Generally Ranged Interactions Problem), constructive procedures that turn any graph into a provably long-ranged task by drawing features from stable distributions. Moreover, by construction, GRIP admits a closed-form, per-range Maximum-Likelihood oracle that yields the first a priori per-range lower bound on test error available on any benchmark. Using our framework, we: (i) audit 4 common long-range benchmarks and identify their failures modes with respect to our axioms; (ii) on TRIP-instantiated topologies, we find a popular notion of curvature is uncorrelated with GNN performance, supporting topological-vs-computational bottleneck distinction; and (iii) we show that a novel benchmark's over-squashing measures factors beyond pure long-rangedness. Code to use the framework and reproduce experiments is released https://github.com/ferranhernandezc/graph-grip.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出长程图基准（LRGB等）缺乏对"长程性"的严格刻画，提出四条可验证公理并构建TRIP/GRIP构造性基准，任意图均可转化为可证明的长程任务，并提供首个按范围的下界oracle，进而审计现有基准、质疑曲率指标并揭示过度压缩度量混杂因素。
AI.motivation: GNN中"过度压缩（over-squashing）与长程交互"关系的实证结论，只有在基准确实需要长程交互时才可信。然而事实标准LRGB已被调优的短程模型饱和，现有合成基准又绑定特定拓扑，任意图上缺乏长程性的原则性证书。该现状源于对长程基准缺少精确刻画，本文旨在填补这一根本性空白。
AI.method: 提出四条必须满足的可验证公理：可预测性（Predictability）、紧致性（Tightness）、严格k-范围（Strictly k-Range）、拓扑不变性（Topology-Invariance），并形式化证明违反任一公理都会引入破坏任务结论的失效模式。据此设计TRIP（Truly Ranged Interactions Problem）及其推广GRIP（Generally Ranged Interactions Problem），通过从稳定分布中采样特征，将任意图构造性地转化为可证明的长程任务；GRIP按构造具有闭式的、逐范围的最大似然oracle，给出任意基准上首个先验的逐范围测试误差下界。
AI.result: (i) 按公理审计4个常见长程基准，识别其失效模式；(ii) 在TRIP实例化拓扑上，发现一种流行的曲率概念与GNN性能不相关，支持"拓扑瓶颈 vs 计算瓶颈"的区分；(iii) 新基准的过度压缩度量所反映的因素超出纯长程性本身。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 本文为长程图基准提供了首个原则性的公理化刻画与构造性生成框架，TRIP/GRIP可保证任务确实需要k跳交互，并提供逐范围误差下界；由此可诊断现有基准缺陷，并为过度压缩与长程交互的理论/实证研究提供更可靠的基准基础。

title: Cephalonauts One: A deep fMRI dataset for decoding naturalistic speech in the human brain
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track
summary: Cephalonauts One is a whole-brain 3 Tesla (3T) functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) dataset recorded while subjects listened to audio podcasts. Three healthy subjects underwent multiple scanning sessions, each consisting of five 15-minute runs, while listening to podcasts in their native language. With 30 hours of fMRI data per subject, the current release is the deepest available fMRI dataset using naturalistic speech stimuli. The dataset pairs brain activity with the corresponding podcast audio, transcript annotations, and derived stimulus embeddings. Furthermore, we introduce a brain decoding benchmark formulated as audio segment retrieval: given fMRI activity from a held-out session, the decoder must identify the corresponding time-aligned podcast audio segment among candidate segments. We provide standardized splits, evaluation metrics, and baseline decoders for this task. Finally, a scaling analysis shows that decoding performance improves continuously with the amount of training data per subject.

AI.tldr: 本文发布 Cephalonauts One，一个 3T 全脑 fMRI 数据集：3 名健康被试在收听母语播客时扫描，每位被试累计 30 小时数据，为目前使用自然语音刺激的最深 fMRI 数据集；同时提出以音频片段检索为形式的脑解码基准，并给出数据划分、评价指标、基线解码器及数据规模缩放分析。
AI.motivation: 现有 fMRI 数据集在自然语音刺激下的单被试数据量有限，难以支撑深层建模与数据规模效应研究；作者希望提供更深、更长时的自然语音 fMRI 数据，并建立可复现的解码评测基准。
AI.method: 采集 3 名健康被试的 3T 全脑 fMRI 数据，每名被试多轮扫描，每轮含 5 个 15 分钟 run，被试收听母语播客；数据与播客音频、转写标注及派生刺激嵌入配对。构建音频片段检索式脑解码基准：以留出会话的 fMRI 活动为输入，在候选片段中识别时间对齐的播客音频；提供标准划分、评价指标与基线解码器，并进行训练数据量缩放分析。
AI.result: 每位被试获得 30 小时 fMRI 数据，构成当前自然语音刺激下最深度的公开 fMRI 数据集；基线解码器可实现音频片段检索，且解码性能随单被试训练数据量增加而持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集与基准为自然语音条件下的脑解码研究提供了高深度资源与标准化评测框架，并表明扩大单被试训练数据可持续改善解码表现。

title: Mastering Atari 2600 Games with Discovered Options
summary: Temporal abstractions, often instantiated as options, have long been regarded as a mechanism for accelerating credit assignment, facilitating exploration, and enabling generalisation in reinforcement learning (RL). However, developing general option discovery methods that are effective in large-scale, high-dimensional domains remains a fundamental challenge. Existing option discovery methods are either confined to relatively simple domains, depend on handcrafted or quasi-symbolic representations, or offer little improvement over learning without options. We present Wayfarer, a general, domain-agnostic, online deep RL agent that discovers options through Laplacian representation learning from high-dimensional observations and leverages them for control. We show that the resulting options simultaneously improve exploration, accelerate credit assignment, and generalise effectively to unseen settings, enabling substantially faster learning of complex policies. Wayfarer achieves state-of-the-art performance among single-stream agents on the most challenging Atari 2600 games, with the largest gains in games that require long-horizon exploration and strategic behaviour, such as Montezuma's Revenge and Private Eye.

AI.tldr: 提出Wayfarer，一种域无关的在线深度强化学习智能体，通过拉普拉斯表示学习从高维观测中发现选项，并同时改善探索、加速信用分配与泛化，在困难Atari游戏上取得单流智能体最优表现。
AI.motivation: 时序抽象（常以选项形式实现）被认为可加速信用分配、促进探索和泛化，但在大规模高维领域中开发通用的选项发现方法仍是基本挑战。现有方法要么局限于较简单领域，要么依赖手工设计或准符号表示，要么相较无选项学习提升有限。
AI.method: Wayfarer：通用、域无关的在线深度RL智能体。它从高维观测中通过拉普拉斯表示学习（Laplacian representation learning）发现选项，并利用这些选项进行控制。
AI.result: 所得到的选项同时改善探索、加速信用分配，并能有效泛化到未见场景，从而显著加快复杂策略的学习。Wayfarer在最困难的Atari 2600游戏上达到单流智能体的最优性能，在需要长时程探索与策略行为的游戏（如Montezuma's Revenge、Private Eye）中增益最大。
AI.conclusion: Wayfarer表明基于拉普拉斯表示学习的选项发现可作为通用、域无关的在线深度RL方案，兼顾探索、信用分配与泛化，为高维长时程任务提供有效途径。

title: IDRF: Inverse-Distilled Reward Fine-tuning of Masked Discrete Diffusion Models
summary: Masked discrete diffusion models offer a promising alternative to autoregressive generation, but iterative sampling can be costly, and intractable sequence likelihoods complicate reward fine-tuning. We introduce IDRF, a framework for reward fine-tuning of few-step masked discrete diffusion generators. Starting from a standard reverse-KL-regularized objective, IDRF replaces the intractable sequence-level KL penalty with inverse-distillation regularization. With an optimal auxiliary denoiser, we prove that the population inverse-distillation loss upper-bounds the sequence-level KL divergence to the reference distribution. IDRF optimizes a trajectory-based surrogate of this loss without reference-model rollouts, so the student keeps its own few-step sampler. We view few-step generation as a finite-horizon Markov decision process and optimize reward with a clipped policy-gradient objective over the student's trajectories. Across DNA, image, and text generation, IDRF achieves high reward with up to $32\times$ fewer denoising steps than the reference while mitigating reward hacking and preserving sample quality.

AI.tldr: 提出IDRF框架，用逆蒸馏正则化替代不可解序列级KL惩罚，实现少步掩码离散扩散生成器的奖励微调。
AI.motivation: 掩码离散扩散模型是自回归生成的有前景替代方案，但迭代采样成本高，且序列似然不可解使得奖励微调困难。
AI.method: 从标准反向KL正则化目标出发，用逆蒸馏正则化替代不可解的序列级KL惩罚；在最优辅助去噪器下证明群体逆蒸馏损失上界参考分布的序列级KL散度；优化该损失的轨迹级代理目标，无需参考模型rollout，保留学生自身的少步采样器；将少步生成视为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程，在轨迹上以裁剪策略梯度目标优化奖励。
AI.result: 在DNA、图像和文本生成任务上，IDRF在比参考模型少最多32倍去噪步数的情况下取得高奖励，同时缓解奖励黑客并保持样本质量。
AI.conclusion: IDRF为少步掩码离散扩散生成器提供了有效且高效的奖励微调方案，兼顾采样效率、奖励提升与样本质量。

title: On the Convergence of Success Conditioning for Policy Optimization
summary: Success conditioning is a strategy for improving decision-making policies in stochastic environments; it updates a policy by increasing the probability of taking actions that yield successful outcomes. Success conditioning is common to many reinforcement learning applications, yet its limiting behavior and convergence rates are not well understood. In this work, we demonstrate that success conditioning converges to an optimal policy on a broad class of Markov decision processes (MDPs). We also derive convergence rates in some common settings. For discounted MDPs, we prove convergence within $\mathcal{O}(1/\varepsilon^p)$ iterations to an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy, where the exponent $p$ depends on problem data. For single-period MDPs, such a policy is obtained within $\mathcal{O}(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ iterations.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了成功条件化策略在广泛的MDP类上收敛到最优策略，并给出了折现MDP与单周期MDP的收敛速率。
AI.motivation: 成功条件化广泛应用于强化学习以改进随机环境下的决策策略，但其极限行为与收敛速率尚缺乏理论理解。
AI.method: 通过理论分析，研究成功条件化策略的收敛性质，在广泛的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）类上分析其极限行为，并针对折现MDP和单周期MDP推导收敛速率。
AI.result: 成功条件化收敛到最优策略；对折现MDP，可在O(1/ε^p)次迭代内收敛到ε-最优策略，其中指数p依赖于问题数据；对单周期MDP，可在O(log(1/ε))次迭代内获得该策略。
AI.conclusion: 成功条件化具有收敛到最优策略的理论保证，并在常见设定下具有明确的收敛速率。

title: When May a Bandit Leave Its Anchor? E-Process-Authorized Thompson Sampling under Non-stationarity
comment: 25 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to the E-Values Workshop at NeurIPS 2026 (poster)
summary: Stationarity rewards memory, but after a change the same history can mislead. We ask when forgetting should be permitted. E-process-authorized Thompson sampling (e-ATS) gives each arm full-history and discounted Beta states. An anytime-valid e-process first authorizes the discounted state, then a reversible relevance score controls its influence. Before authorization, e-ATS exactly follows optimistic Thompson sampling (OTS). Under a Beta-Bernoulli prior-predictive stationary model, e-ATS's probability of ever departing from OTS is at most the chosen $α_E$, without fitted thresholds. Relative to e-ATS, removing authorization increased mean normalized dynamic pseudo-regret by $38.4\%$ on the registered suite but reduced it by $7.5\%$ on the literature-derived replay suite. Therefore, evidence controls when adaptation begins, not whether it always helps.

AI.tldr: e-ATS通过任意时间有效的e-process授权折扣状态并用可逆相关性分数控制其影响，在平稳模型下以不超过α_E的概率偏离OTS；授权移除在注册套件上使动态伪遗憾增加38.4%，在文献回放套件上降低7.5%。
AI.motivation: 平稳环境下记忆有益，但在分布变化后同一历史可能误导决策，因此需要研究何时允许遗忘。
AI.method: 为每个臂维护全历史与折扣Beta状态；先用任意时间有效的e-process授权折扣状态，再由可逆相关性分数控制其影响，授权前严格等同于乐观Thompson采样（OTS）。
AI.result: 在Beta-Bernoulli先验预测平稳模型下，e-ATS偏离OTS的概率上界为选定的α_E且无需拟合阈值；相较e-ATS，移除授权使注册套件平均归一化动态伪遗憾增加38.4%，而在文献衍生回放套件上降低7.5%。
AI.conclusion: 证据决定自适应何时开始，而非其是否总能带来收益。

title: Forecasting from Counterfactual Simulator Rollouts: A Sim2Real Evaluation
summary: Deploying a new decision policy creates a cold-start problem for prediction models whose targets depend on the policy's actions: historical observations reflect earlier policies, while real observations under the new policy are not yet available. Simulation offers a way to address this gap by rolling out the target policy across counterfactual scenarios and using the resulting trajectories to learn how the system responds to those controls. The simulation-to-reality (Sim2Real) transfer of this simulator-trained model can then be backtested by evaluating it against real observations from past deployments. Using two real-world inventory-control deployments, we evaluate this process from three angles: simulator fidelity, zero-shot transfer to real behavior, and adaptation as real target-policy observations accumulate. The simulator-trained forecaster achieves lower point-estimate mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) than the same architecture trained on historical real data, reducing MAPE by 1.2-3.1 percentage points in Study 1 and 12.5-18.7 points in Study 2. After deployment, lightweight calibration using early real observations further reduces error by up to 2.5 percentage points. These results provide empirical evidence that simulator-generated counterfactual data can support cold-start forecasting under a new policy, and the resulting model can be further refined as real deployment data become available.

AI.tldr: 部署新决策策略会使依赖策略动作的预测模型面临冷启动问题；本文通过仿真生成反事实轨迹训练预测模型，并用两个真实库存控制部署从仿真保真度、零样本迁移与在线校准三方面评估，证明仿真数据可支持冷启动预测。
AI.motivation: 新策略上线时，历史观测反映旧策略，而新策略下的真实观测尚不可得，导致预测模型出现冷启动问题；仿真可在反事实场景中推演目标策略并生成轨迹，从而弥补这一数据缺口。
AI.method: 在目标策略下进行仿真推演，收集反事实场景轨迹，训练系统对控制变量的响应预测模型；随后通过Sim2Real迁移，在历史部署的真实观测上回测模型；并使用两个真实库存控制部署，从仿真保真度、零样本迁移到真实行为、以及随真实目标策略观测积累的适应（轻量校准）三方面进行评估。
AI.result: 仿真训练的预测器在点估计MAPE上优于用历史真实数据训练的相同架构模型：研究1降低1.2–3.1个百分点，研究2降低12.5–18.7个百分点；部署后利用早期真实观测进行轻量校准，进一步将误差最多降低2.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 仿真生成的反事实数据能够支持新策略下的冷启动预测，且所得模型可在真实部署数据逐步积累后进一步优化，为Sim2Real冷启动预测流程提供了实证支持。

title: Planning to Learn
summary: Policy-gradient methods are central to modern reinforcement learning, including LLM post-training. When they struggle, the usual suspects are exploration, credit assignment and action-sampling noise. Classification has none of them. A classifier is a policy whose expected reward, its \emph{expected accuracy}, is the probability it assigns to the correct label, and because that label is known, the policy gradient is exact and smooth. Yet exact policy gradient loses to cross-entropy, even on expected accuracy. The exact gradient is myopic: it values an update only by what it buys now, but each update also sets where the next one starts, so an update's value depends on how much learning remains. Viewed this way, cross-entropy is patient accuracy, the total error an example would pay if its log-odds rose at unit speed forever, while exact policy gradient is the zero-horizon limit. Truncating this total at the learning that remains yields the horizon loss, a one-line change that moves from cross-entropy toward exact policy gradient as training runs out. In a simple allocation model, it provably escapes the trap that catches each endpoint. On MNIST and on ImageNet with ResNet-50, ResNet-101 and ViT-S/16, the horizon loss improves top-1 accuracy over cross-entropy at a flat learning rate, and the gain grows with label noise.

AI.tldr: 本文指出精确策略梯度在分类任务中因"近视性"而劣于交叉熵，提出将交叉熵理解为"耐心准确率"（无限视界的总误差），并通过在学习剩余量处截断得到"horizon loss"，在MNIST与ImageNet（ResNet-50/101、ViT-S/16）上以恒定学习率提升top-1准确率，且标签噪声越大增益越显著。
AI.motivation: 策略梯度是强化学习与LLM后训练的核心方法，其困难通常归因于探索、信用分配与动作采样噪声；但分类任务并不存在这三者——分类器即策略，其期望奖励（期望准确率）等于赋予正确标签的概率，且标签已知，因此策略梯度是精确且平滑的。然而精确策略梯度在期望准确率上仍劣于交叉熵。作者意在揭示这一悖论的根源：精确梯度是"近视的"，它只按当前收益评估更新，忽略了更新会改变下一次更新的起点，因此更新价值取决于剩余学习量。
AI.method: 1) 将策略梯度问题置于分类框架下：策略为分类器，期望奖励为赋予正确标签的概率，梯度精确可导。2) 从"近视性/视界"视角重新诠释：交叉熵等价于"耐心准确率"，即假设样本对数几率以单位速度无限上升时累积的总误差；精确策略梯度则是零视界极限。3) 将这一总误差在"剩余学习量"处截断，得到horizon loss，仅需一行代码改动，随训练接近尾声从交叉熵平滑过渡到精确策略梯度。4) 通过一个简单的分配模型证明该损失可同时避开两个端点的陷阱。
AI.result: 在MNIST以及ImageNet上使用ResNet-50、ResNet-101与ViT-S/16的实验中，采用恒定学习率时，horizon loss的top-1准确率优于交叉熵；并且标签噪声越大，提升幅度越明显。
AI.conclusion: 精确策略梯度的近视性解释了其在分类中不及交叉熵的原因；将交叉熵视为无限视界的"耐心准确率"、并在剩余学习量处截断所得出的horizon loss，是一个简洁有效的改进，可与现有交叉熵训练无缝衔接、随训练进程自适应地趋向精确策略梯度，实证上鲁棒地提升准确率并增强对标签噪声的耐受性。

title: Simulation-Free Learning of Population Dynamics with Wasserstein Lagrangian Residuals
summary: The dynamics of cells, organisms, and fluids are often modeled as probability distributions evolving over time. Reconstructing and extrapolating this evolution from unpaired snapshots requires assumptions about the underlying process. Wasserstein gradient flows are a common choice, but they cannot describe conservative or periodic dynamics. Lagrangian mechanics in Wasserstein space covers both, but existing methods for learning it are simulation-based: they run a numerical solver at every training step, which makes training expensive. We propose Double-Stitch, a simulation-free method that learns these mechanics by penalizing the residual of the equation of motion along a learned population path. We derive this equation from a Clebsch variational principle that does not require gradient velocities, and show that the residual vanishes exactly when the equation holds. We test Double-Stitch on synthetic, single-cell and ocean vortex datasets and find that it matches or outperforms gradient-flow methods and simulation-based WLM on most tasks, while training $4$-$14$ times faster than WLM. We provide a JAX implementation of Double-Stitch at https://github.com/BasisResearch/stitching.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Double-Stitch，一种无模拟（simulation-free）方法，用于从无配对快照中学习 Wasserstein 空间中的拉格朗日力学，训练速度比基于模拟的 WLM 快 4–14 倍。
AI.motivation: 细胞、生物体与流体的动力学常被建模为随时间演化的概率分布，从无配对快照重建并外推该演化需要关于底层过程的假设。Wasserstein 梯度流是常见选择，但无法描述守恒或周期动力学；Wasserstein 空间中的拉格朗日力学虽能覆盖二者，但现有学习方法基于模拟，每一步训练都要运行数值求解器，训练代价高昂。
AI.method: 提出 Double-Stitch：一种无模拟方法，通过沿学习到的种群路径惩罚运动方程残差来学习该力学。该运动方程由 Clebsch 变分原理导出，无需梯度速度，并证明当方程成立时残差恰好为零。
AI.result: 在合成数据、单细胞与海洋涡旋数据集上测试，Double-Stitch 在多数任务上达到或优于梯度流方法与基于模拟的 WLM，同时训练速度比 WLM 快 4–14 倍。提供 JAX 实现。
AI.conclusion: Double-Stitch 通过无模拟的残差惩罚与 Clebsch 变分推导，实现了高效且具竞争力的 Wasserstein 拉格朗日力学学习，兼顾守恒与周期动力学，并显著降低训练成本。

title: LESSER: Post-Training Data Selection with Output-Layer Gradients
summary: The choice of post-training data for large language models substantially affects downstream performance. Gradient-based data selection is a popular approach that ranks training data by how well their gradients align with those of a small validation set. However, ranking with full-parameter gradients requires an expensive backward pass on every sample, making computation intractable for large candidate pools. This raises a natural question: can we approximate full-gradient features at a fraction of the cost? Conveniently, we find that output-layer gradients suffice for effective data selection, yet require only the cheaper forward pass. We implement this as LESSER, a drop-in wrapper for selection methods that reduces the feature-extraction FLOP cost by $9.7\times$ for SFT and $3.0\times$ for RL benchmarks, while tracking full-gradient performance on downstream tasks. Empirically, we find that even when output-layer and full gradients rank individual samples differently, they select batches with aligned gradients.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LESSER，利用输出层梯度替代全参数梯度进行后训练数据选择，仅需前向传播即可提取特征，在 SFT 与 RL 场景下分别降低 9.7× 和 3.0× 的特征提取 FLOP 成本，同时保持与全梯度方法相当的下游性能。
AI.motivation: 基于梯度的数据选择依赖样本梯度与小型验证集梯度的对齐程度来排序训练数据，但全参数梯度排序需要对每个样本进行昂贵的反向传播，导致在大型候选池上计算不可行。因此作者希望以更低成本近似全梯度特征。
AI.method: 作者发现输出层梯度足以支撑有效的数据选择，且只需较廉价的前向传播即可获得。据此实现 LESSER，作为现有选择方法的可插拔封装（drop-in wrapper），用输出层梯度特征替代全参数梯度特征进行数据排序与批次选择。
AI.result: 在 SFT 与 RL 基准上，LESSER 将特征提取的 FLOP 成本分别降低 9.7× 和 3.0×，并在下游任务上追平全梯度方法的性能。分析还发现，即使输出层梯度与全参数梯度对单样本的排序不同，二者选出的批次在梯度上仍保持对齐。
AI.conclusion: 输出层梯度可作为全参数梯度的有效廉价代理用于数据选择，LESSER 在显著降低计算成本的同时维持选择质量，说明批次层面的梯度对齐比单样本排序一致性更为关键。
